column.value: "Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not murder.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not commit adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not steal.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not covet your neighbor's house. You shall not covet your neighbor's wife, or his manservant or maidservant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

column.name: text
column.value: When the people saw the thunder and lightning and heard the trumpet and saw the mountain in smoke, they trembled with fear. They stayed at a distance

column.name: text
column.value: and said to Moses, "Speak to us yourself and we will listen. But do not have God speak to us or we will die."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid. God has come to test you, so that the fear of God will be with you to keep you from sinning."

column.name: text
column.value: The people remained at a distance, while Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites this: 'You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven:

column.name: text
column.value: Do not make any gods to be alongside me; do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gods of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Make an altar of earth for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your sheep and goats and your cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be honored, I will come to you and bless you.

column.name: text
column.value: If you make an altar of stones for me, do not build it with dressed stones, for you will defile it if you use a tool on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not go up to my altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.'

column.name: text
column.value: "These are the laws you are to set before them:

column.name: text
column.value: "If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free, without paying anything.

column.name: text
column.value: If he comes alone, he is to go free alone; but if he has a wife when he comes, she is to go with him.

column.name: text
column.value: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.

column.name: text
column.value: "But if the servant declares, 'I love my master and my wife and children and do not want to go free,'

column.name: text
column.value: then his master must take him before the judges. He shall take him to the door or the doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he will be his servant for life.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as menservants do.

column.name: text
column.value: If she does not please the master who has selected her for himself, he must let her be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, because he has broken faith with her.

column.name: text
column.value: If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: If he marries another woman, he must not deprive the first one of her food, clothing and marital rights.

column.name: text
column.value: If he does not provide her with these three things, she is to go free, without any payment of money.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone who strikes a man and kills him shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if he does not do it intentionally, but God lets it happen, he is to flee to a place I will designate.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a man schemes and kills another man deliberately, take him away from my altar and put him to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone who attacks his father or his mother must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone who kidnaps another and either sells him or still has him when he is caught must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "If men quarrel and one hits the other with a stone or with his fist and he does not die but is confined to bed,

column.name: text
column.value: the one who struck the blow will not be held responsible if the other gets up and walks around outside with his staff; however, he must pay the injured man for the loss of his time and see that he is completely healed.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man beats his male or female slave with a rod and the slave dies as a direct result, he must be punished,

column.name: text
column.value: but he is not to be punished if the slave gets up after a day or two, since the slave is his property.

column.name: text
column.value: "If men who are fighting hit a pregnant woman and she gives birth prematurely but there is no serious injury, the offender must be fined whatever the woman's husband demands and the court allows.

column.name: text
column.value: But if there is serious injury, you are to take life for life,

column.name: text
column.value: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

column.name: text
column.value: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man hits a manservant or maidservant in the eye and destroys it, he must let the servant go free to compensate for the eye.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he knocks out the tooth of a manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free to compensate for the tooth.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull must be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the bull will not be held responsible.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, the bull has had the habit of goring and the owner has been warned but has not kept it penned up and it kills a man or woman, the bull must be stoned and the owner also must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if payment is demanded of him, he may redeem his life by paying whatever is demanded.

column.name: text
column.value: This law also applies if the bull gores a son or daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: If the bull gores a male or female slave, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of the slave, and the bull must be stoned.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man uncovers a pit or digs one and fails to cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into it,

column.name: text
column.value: the owner of the pit must pay for the loss; he must pay its owner, and the dead animal will be his.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man's bull injures the bull of another and it dies, they are to sell the live one and divide both the money and the dead animal equally.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if it was known that the bull had the habit of goring, yet the owner did not keep it penned up, the owner must pay, animal for animal, and the dead animal will be his.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD had said to Moses, "I will bring one more plague on Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that, he will let you go from here, and when he does, he will drive you out completely.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell the people that men and women alike are to ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold."

column.name: text
column.value: (The LORD made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh's officials and by the people.)

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses said, "This is what the LORD says: 'About midnight I will go throughout Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Every firstborn son in Egypt will die, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh, who sits on the throne, to the firstborn son of the slave girl, who is at her hand mill, and all the firstborn of the cattle as well.

column.name: text
column.value: There will be loud wailing throughout Egypt--worse than there has ever been or ever will be again.

column.name: text
column.value: But among the Israelites not a dog will bark at any man or animal.' Then you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: All these officials of yours will come to me, bowing down before me and saying, 'Go, you and all the people who follow you!' After that I will leave." Then Moses, hot with anger, left Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD had said to Moses, "Pharaoh will refuse to listen to you--so that my wonders may be multiplied in Egypt."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Aaron performed all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let the Israelites go out of his country.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it, he must pay back five head of cattle for the ox and four sheep for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a thief is caught breaking in and is struck so that he dies, the defender is not guilty of bloodshed;

column.name: text
column.value: but if it happens after sunrise, he is guilty of bloodshed. "A thief must certainly make restitution, but if he has nothing, he must be sold to pay for his theft.

column.name: text
column.value: "If the stolen animal is found alive in his possession--whether ox or donkey or sheep--he must pay back double.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and lets them stray and they graze in another man's field, he must make restitution from the best of his own field or vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a fire breaks out and spreads into thornbushes so that it burns shocks of grain or standing grain or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make restitution.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man gives his neighbor silver or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor's house, the thief, if he is caught, must pay back double.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has laid his hands on the other man's property.

column.name: text
column.value: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any other lost property about which somebody says, 'This is mine,' both parties are to bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges declare guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep or any other animal to his neighbor for safekeeping and it dies or is injured or is taken away while no one is looking,

column.name: text
column.value: the issue between them will be settled by the taking of an oath before the LORD that the neighbor did not lay hands on the other person's property. The owner is to accept this, and no restitution is required.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the animal was stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.

column.name: text
column.value: If it was torn to pieces by a wild animal, he shall bring in the remains as evidence and he will not be required to pay for the torn animal.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while the owner is not present, he must make restitution.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the owner is with the animal, the borrower will not have to pay. If the animal was hired, the money paid for the hire covers the loss.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged to be married and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price, and she shall be his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, he must still pay the bride-price for virgins.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not allow a sorceress to live.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "Whoever sacrifices to any god other than the LORD must be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not mistreat an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not take advantage of a widow or an orphan.

column.name: text
column.value: If you do and they cry out to me, I will certainly hear their cry.

column.name: text
column.value: My anger will be aroused, and I will kill you with the sword; your wives will become widows and your children fatherless.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you lend money to one of my people among you who is needy, do not be like a moneylender; charge him no interest.

column.name: text
column.value: If you take your neighbor's cloak as a pledge, return it to him by sunset,

column.name: text
column.value: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? When he cries out to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not hold back offerings from your granaries or your vats."You must give me the firstborn of your sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Do the same with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but give them to me on the eighth day.

column.name: text
column.value: "You are to be my holy people. So do not eat the meat of an animal torn by wild beasts; throw it to the dogs.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not spread false reports. Do not help a wicked man by being a malicious witness.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you give testimony in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd,

column.name: text
column.value: and do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you come across your enemy's ox or donkey wandering off, be sure to take it back to him.

column.name: text
column.value: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen down under its load, do not leave it there; be sure you help him with it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

column.name: text
column.value: Have nothing to do with a false charge and do not put an innocent or honest person to death, for I will not acquit the guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not oppress an alien; you yourselves know how it feels to be aliens, because you were aliens in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "For six years you are to sow your fields and harvest the crops,

column.name: text
column.value: but during the seventh year let the land lie unplowed and unused. Then the poor among your people may get food from it, and the wild animals may eat what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.

column.name: text
column.value: "Six days do your work, but on the seventh day do not work, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the slave born in your household, and the alien as well, may be refreshed.

column.name: text
column.value: "Be careful to do everything I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips.

column.name: text
column.value: "Three times a year you are to celebrate a festival to me.

column.name: text
column.value: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread; for seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in that month you came out of Egypt. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: "Celebrate the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the crops you sow in your field. "Celebrate the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in your crops from the field.

column.name: text
column.value: "Three times a year all the men are to appear before the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast. "The fat of my festival offerings must not be kept until morning.

column.name: text
column.value: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

column.name: text
column.value: "See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him.

column.name: text
column.value: If you listen carefully to what he says and do all that I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and will oppose those who oppose you.

column.name: text
column.value: My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: Worship the LORD your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,

column.name: text
column.value: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the River. I will hand over to you the people who live in the land and you will drive them out before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let them live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to Moses, "Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. You are to worship at a distance,

column.name: text
column.value: but Moses alone is to approach the LORD; the others must not come near. And the people may not come up with him."

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses went and told the people all the LORD'S words and laws, they responded with one voice, "Everything the LORD has said we will do."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then wrote down everything the LORD had said. He got up early the next morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars representing the twelve tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as fellowship offerings to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, "We will do everything the LORD has said; we will obey."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then took the blood, sprinkled it on the people and said, "This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up

column.name: text
column.value: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of sapphire, clear as the sky itself.

column.name: text
column.value: But God did not raise his hand against these leaders of the Israelites; they saw God, and they ate and drank.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain and stay here, and I will give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commands I have written for their instruction."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses set out with Joshua his aide, and Moses went up on the mountain of God.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur are with you, and anyone involved in a dispute can go to them."

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,

column.name: text
column.value: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered the mountain, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.

column.name: text
column.value: To the Israelites the glory of the LORD looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses entered the cloud as he went on up the mountain. And he stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim worked into them by a skilled craftsman.

column.name: text
column.value: All the curtains are to be the same size--twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.

column.name: text
column.value: Make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same with the end curtain in the other set.

column.name: text
column.value: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

column.name: text
column.value: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle--eleven altogether.

column.name: text
column.value: All eleven curtains are to be the same size--thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

column.name: text
column.value: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.

column.name: text
column.value: Make for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of hides of sea cows.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

column.name: text
column.value: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

column.name: text
column.value: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

column.name: text
column.value: and make forty silver bases to go under them--two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

column.name: text
column.value: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames

column.name: text
column.value: and forty silver bases--two under each frame.

column.name: text
column.value: Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: and make two frames for the corners at the far end.

column.name: text
column.value: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top, and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.

column.name: text
column.value: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases--two under each frame.

column.name: text
column.value: "Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: The center crossbar is to extend from end to end at the middle of the frames.

column.name: text
column.value: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: "Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim worked into it by a skilled craftsman.

column.name: text
column.value: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

column.name: text
column.value: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

column.name: text
column.value: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.

column.name: text
column.value: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.

column.name: text
column.value: "For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen--the work of an embroiderer.

column.name: text
column.value: Make gold hooks for this curtain and five posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold. And cast five bronze bases for them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Make a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar are of one piece, and overlay the altar with bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: Make all its utensils of bronze--its pots to remove the ashes, and its shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

column.name: text
column.value: Make a grating for it, a bronze network, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the network.

column.name: text
column.value: Put it under the ledge of the altar so that it is halfway up the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so they will be on two sides of the altar when it is carried.

column.name: text
column.value: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,

column.name: text
column.value: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

column.name: text
column.value: The north side shall also be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

column.name: text
column.value: "The west end of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide and have curtains, with ten posts and ten bases.

column.name: text
column.value: On the east end, toward the sunrise, the courtyard shall also be fifty cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

column.name: text
column.value: and curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on the other side, with three posts and three bases.

column.name: text
column.value: "For the entrance to the courtyard, provide a curtain twenty cubits long, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen--the work of an embroiderer--with four posts and four bases.

column.name: text
column.value: All the posts around the courtyard are to have silver bands and hooks, and bronze bases.

column.name: text
column.value: The courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely twisted linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.

column.name: text
column.value: All the other articles used in the service of the tabernacle, whatever their function, including all the tent pegs for it and those for the courtyard, are to be of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning.

column.name: text
column.value: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the curtain that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to keep the lamps burning before the LORD from evening till morning. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for the generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from each man whose heart prompts him to give.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;

column.name: text
column.value: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

column.name: text
column.value: ram skins dyed red and hides of sea cows; acacia wood;

column.name: text
column.value: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

column.name: text
column.value: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Make this tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Have them make a chest of acacia wood--two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

column.name: text
column.value: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.

column.name: text
column.value: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the chest to carry it.

column.name: text
column.value: The poles are to remain in the rings of this ark; they are not to be removed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make an atonement cover of pure gold--two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

column.name: text
column.value: And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

column.name: text
column.value: Make one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; make the cherubim of one piece with the cover, at the two ends.

column.name: text
column.value: The cherubim are to have their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the cover.

column.name: text
column.value: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.

column.name: text
column.value: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make a table of acacia wood--two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

column.name: text
column.value: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.

column.name: text
column.value: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

column.name: text
column.value: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.

column.name: text
column.value: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

column.name: text
column.value: Make the poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold and carry the table with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And make its plates and dishes of pure gold, as well as its pitchers and bowls for the pouring out of offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make a lampstand of pure gold and hammer it out, base and shaft; its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms shall be of one piece with it.

column.name: text
column.value: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand--three on one side and three on the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

column.name: text
column.value: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair--six branches in all.

column.name: text
column.value: The buds and branches shall all be of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.

column.name: text
column.value: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: "Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: Make sacred garments for your brother Aaron, to give him dignity and honor.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell all the skilled men to whom I have given wisdom in such matters that they are to make garments for Aaron, for his consecration, so he may serve me as priest.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the garments they are to make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so they may serve me as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: Have them use gold, and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen--the work of a skilled craftsman.

column.name: text
column.value: It is to have two shoulder pieces attached to two of its corners, so it can be fastened.

column.name: text
column.value: Its skillfully woven waistband is to be like it--of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel

column.name: text
column.value: in the order of their birth--six names on one stone and the remaining six on the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings

column.name: text
column.value: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Make gold filigree settings

column.name: text
column.value: and two braided chains of pure gold, like a rope, and attach the chains to the settings.

column.name: text
column.value: "Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions--the work of a skilled craftsman. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: It is to be square--a span long and a span wide--and folded double.

column.name: text
column.value: Then mount four rows of precious stones on it. In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz and a beryl;

column.name: text
column.value: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire and an emerald;

column.name: text
column.value: in the third row a jacinth, an agate and an amethyst;

column.name: text
column.value: in the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. Mount them in gold filigree settings.

column.name: text
column.value: There are to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: "For the breastpiece make braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

column.name: text
column.value: Make two gold rings for it and fasten them to two corners of the breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: Fasten the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

column.name: text
column.value: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

column.name: text
column.value: Make two gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: The rings of the breastpiece are to be tied to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband, so that the breastpiece will not swing out from the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: "Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastpiece, so they may be over Aaron's heart whenever he enters the presence of the LORD. Thus Aaron will always bear the means of making decisions for the Israelites over his heart before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,

column.name: text
column.value: with an opening for the head in its center. There shall be a woven edge like a collar around this opening, so that it will not tear.

column.name: text
column.value: Make pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn around the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.

column.name: text
column.value: The gold bells and the pomegranates are to alternate around the hem of the robe.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron must wear it when he ministers. The sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the Holy Place before the LORD and when he comes out, so that he will not die.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Fasten a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban; it is to be on the front of the turban.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be on Aaron's forehead, and he will bear the guilt involved in the sacred gifts the Israelites consecrate, whatever their gifts may be. It will be on Aaron's forehead continually so that they will be acceptable to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Weave the tunic of fine linen and make the turban of fine linen. The sash is to be the work of an embroiderer.

column.name: text
column.value: Make tunics, sashes and headbands for Aaron's sons, to give them dignity and honor.

column.name: text
column.value: After you put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. "This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what you are to do to consecrate them, so they may serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: And from fine wheat flour, without yeast, make bread, and cakes mixed with oil, and wafers spread with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Put them in a basket and present them in it--along with the bull and the two rams.

column.name: text
column.value: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: Take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself and the breastpiece. Fasten the ephod on him by its skillfully woven waistband.

column.name: text
column.value: Put the turban on his head and attach the sacred diadem to the turban.

column.name: text
column.value: Take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics

column.name: text
column.value: and put headbands on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. In this way you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: "Bring the bull to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaughter it in the LORD'S presence at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Take some of the bull's blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then take all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: But burn the bull's flesh and its hide and its offal outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaughter it and take the blood and sprinkle it against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: Cut the ram into pieces and wash the inner parts and the legs, putting them with the head and the other pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaughter it, take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then sprinkle blood against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. Then he and his sons and their garments will be consecrated.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take from this ram the fat, the fat tail, the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh. (This is the ram for the ordination.)

column.name: text
column.value: From the basket of bread made without yeast, which is before the LORD, take a loaf, and a cake made with oil, and a wafer.

column.name: text
column.value: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the LORD, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: After you take the breast of the ram for Aaron's ordination, wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your share.

column.name: text
column.value: "Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.

column.name: text
column.value: This is always to be the regular share from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons. It is the contribution the Israelites are to make to the LORD from their fellowship offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: "Aaron's sacred garments will belong to his descendants so that they can be anointed and ordained in them.

column.name: text
column.value: The son who succeeds him as priest and comes to the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place is to wear them seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.

column.name: text
column.value: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to eat these offerings by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no one else may eat them, because they are sacred.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any of the meat of the ordination ram or any bread is left over till morning, burn it up. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

column.name: text
column.value: Sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering to make atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will be most holy, and whatever touches it will be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.

column.name: text
column.value: Offer one in the morning and the other at twilight.

column.name: text
column.value: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives, and a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning--a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "For the generations to come this burnt offering is to be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD. There I will meet you and speak to you;

column.name: text
column.value: there also I will meet with the Israelites, and the place will be consecrated by my glory.

column.name: text
column.value: "So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar and will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: They will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.

column.name: text
column.value: It is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high--its horns of one piece with it.

column.name: text
column.value: Overlay the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

column.name: text
column.value: Make two gold rings for the altar below the molding--two on opposite sides--to hold the poles used to carry it.

column.name: text
column.value: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Put the altar in front of the curtain that is before the ark of the Testimony--before the atonement cover that is over the Testimony--where I will meet with you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he tends the lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: He must burn incense again when he lights the lamps at twilight so incense will burn regularly before the LORD for the generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not offer on this altar any other incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns. This annual atonement must be made with the blood of the atoning sin offering for the generations to come. It is most holy to the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the LORD a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.

column.name: text
column.value: Each one who crosses over to those already counted is to give a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: All who cross over, those twenty years old or more, are to give an offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less when you make the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives.

column.name: text
column.value: Receive the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD, making atonement for your lives."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Make a bronze basin, with its bronze stand, for washing. Place it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet with water from it.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water so that they will not die. Also, when they approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made to the LORD by fire,

column.name: text
column.value: they shall wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the following fine spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much (that is, 250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,

column.name: text
column.value: 500 shekels of cassia--all according to the sanctuary shekel--and a hin of olive oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Make these into a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer. It will be the sacred anointing oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Then use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,

column.name: text
column.value: the table and all its articles, the lampstand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

column.name: text
column.value: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall consecrate them so they will be most holy, and whatever touches them will be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the Israelites, 'This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not pour it on men's bodies and do not make any oil with the same formula. It is sacred, and you are to consider it sacred.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever makes perfume like it and whoever puts it on anyone other than a priest must be cut off from his people.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Take fragrant spices--gum resin, onycha and galbanum--and pure frankincense, all in equal amounts,

column.name: text
column.value: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer. It is to be salted and pure and sacred.

column.name: text
column.value: Grind some of it to powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not make any incense with this formula for yourselves; consider it holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever makes any like it to enjoy its fragrance must be cut off from his people."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of crafts--

column.name: text
column.value: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

column.name: text
column.value: to cut and set stones, to work in wood, and to engage in all kinds of craftsmanship.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I have appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, to help him. Also I have given skill to all the craftsmen to make everything I have commanded you:

column.name: text
column.value: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony with the atonement cover on it, and all the other furnishings of the tent--

column.name: text
column.value: the table and its articles, the pure gold lampstand and all its accessories, the altar of incense,

column.name: text
column.value: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, the basin with its stand--

column.name: text
column.value: and also the woven garments, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests,

column.name: text
column.value: and the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them just as I commanded you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites, 'You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the LORD, who makes you holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it must be put to death; whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he abstained from work and rested.'"

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

column.name: text
column.value: When the people saw that Moses was so long in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, "Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don't know what has happened to him."

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron answered them, "Take off the gold earrings that your wives, your sons and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me."

column.name: text
column.value: So all the people took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: He took what they handed him and made it into an idol cast in the shape of a calf, fashioning it with a tool. Then they said, "These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."

column.name: text
column.value: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of the calf and announced, "Tomorrow there will be a festival to the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: So the next day the people rose early and sacrificed burnt offerings and presented fellowship offerings. Afterward they sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go down, because your people, whom you brought up out of Egypt, have become corrupt.

column.name: text
column.value: They have been quick to turn away from what I commanded them and have made themselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. They have bowed down to it and sacrificed to it and have said, 'These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.'

column.name: text
column.value: "I have seen these people," the LORD said to Moses, "and they are a stiff-necked people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now leave me alone so that my anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation."

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God. "O LORD," he said, "why should your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Why should the Egyptians say, 'It was with evil intent that he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to wipe them off the face of the earth'? Turn from your fierce anger; relent and do not bring disaster on your people.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, to whom you swore by your own self: 'I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land I promised them, and it will be their inheritance forever.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD relented and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.

column.name: text
column.value: The tablets were the work of God; the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

column.name: text
column.value: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said to Moses, "There is the sound of war in the camp."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses replied: "It is not the sound of victory, it is not the sound of defeat; it is the sound of singing that I hear."

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets out of his hands, breaking them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the calf they had made and burned it in the fire; then he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the Israelites drink it.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to Aaron, "What did these people do to you, that you led them into such great sin?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not be angry, my lord," Aaron answered. "You know how prone these people are to evil.

column.name: text
column.value: They said to me, 'Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don't know what has happened to him.'

column.name: text
column.value: So I told them, 'Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.' Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!"

column.name: text
column.value: Moses saw that the people were running wild and that Aaron had let them get out of control and so become a laughingstock to their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and said, "Whoever is for the LORD, come to me." And all the Levites rallied to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people died.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said, "You have been set apart to the LORD today, for you were against your own sons and brothers, and he has blessed you this day."

column.name: text
column.value: The next day Moses said to the people, "You have committed a great sin. But now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses went back to the LORD and said, "Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made themselves gods of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, please forgive their sin--but if not, then blot me out of the book you have written."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD replied to Moses, "Whoever has sinned against me I will blot out of my book.

column.name: text
column.value: Now go, lead the people to the place I spoke of, and my angel will go before you. However, when the time comes for me to punish, I will punish them for their sin."

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD struck the people with a plague because of what they did with the calf Aaron had made.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of Egypt, and go up to the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, 'I will give it to your descendants.'

column.name: text
column.value: I will send an angel before you and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way."

column.name: text
column.value: When the people heard these distressing words, they began to mourn and no one put on any ornaments.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites, 'You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I might destroy you. Now take off your ornaments and I will decide what to do with you.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So the Israelites stripped off their ornaments at Mount Horeb.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses used to take a tent and pitch it outside the camp some distance away, calling it the "tent of meeting." Anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the tent of meeting outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose and stood at the entrances to their tents, watching Moses until he entered the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: As Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the entrance, while the LORD spoke with Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they all stood and worshiped, each at the entrance to his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young aide Joshua son of Nun did not leave the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the LORD, "You have been telling me, 'Lead these people,' but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. You have said, 'I know you by name and you have found favor with me.'

column.name: text
column.value: If you are pleased with me, teach me your ways so I may know you and continue to find favor with you. Remember that this nation is your people."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD replied, "My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to him, "If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here.

column.name: text
column.value: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?"

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, "I will do the very thing you have asked, because I am pleased with you and I know you by name."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said, "Now show me your glory."

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, "I will cause all my goodness to pass in front of you, and I will proclaim my name, the LORD, in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

column.name: text
column.value: But," he said, "you cannot see my face, for no one may see me and live."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said, "There is a place near me where you may stand on a rock.

column.name: text
column.value: When my glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will remove my hand and you will see my back; but my face must not be seen."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ready in the morning, and then come up on Mount Sinai. Present yourself to me there on top of the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: No one is to come with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain; not even the flocks and herds may graze in front of the mountain."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones and went up Mount Sinai early in the morning, as the LORD had commanded him; and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and stood there with him and proclaimed his name, the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, "The LORD, the LORD, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,

column.name: text
column.value: maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children and their children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses bowed to the ground at once and worshiped.

column.name: text
column.value: "O Lord, if I have found favor in your eyes," he said, "then let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our wickedness and our sin, and take us as your inheritance."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said: "I am making a covenant with you. Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world. The people you live among will see how awesome is the work that I, the LORD, will do for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Obey what I command you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and cut down their Asherah poles.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

column.name: text
column.value: "Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land; for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: And when you choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons and those daughters prostitute themselves to their gods, they will lead your sons to do the same.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not make cast idols.

column.name: text
column.value: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in that month you came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.

column.name: text
column.value: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem all your firstborn sons. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: "Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during the plowing season and harvest you must rest.

column.name: text
column.value: "Celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign LORD, the God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning.

column.name: text
column.value: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant--the Ten Commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, his face was radiant, and they were afraid to come near him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the LORD had given him on Mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.

column.name: text
column.value: But whenever he entered the LORD'S presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,

column.name: text
column.value: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the LORD has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the LORD has commanded."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the LORD had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.

column.name: text
column.value: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work

column.name: text
column.value: and said to Moses, "The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD commanded to be done."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: "No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary." And so the people were restrained from bringing more,

column.name: text
column.value: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.

column.name: text
column.value: All the skilled men among the workmen made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim worked into them by a skilled craftsman.

column.name: text
column.value: All the curtains were the same size--twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: They joined five of the curtains together and did the same with the other five.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.

column.name: text
column.value: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.

column.name: text
column.value: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle--eleven altogether.

column.name: text
column.value: All eleven curtains were the same size--thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: They joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another set.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

column.name: text
column.value: They made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the tent together as a unit.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of hides of sea cows.

column.name: text
column.value: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

column.name: text
column.value: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

column.name: text
column.value: They made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

column.name: text
column.value: and made forty silver bases to go under them--two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

column.name: text
column.value: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames

column.name: text
column.value: and forty silver bases--two under each frame.

column.name: text
column.value: They made six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: and two frames were made for the corners of the tabernacle at the far end.

column.name: text
column.value: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.

column.name: text
column.value: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases--two under each frame.

column.name: text
column.value: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the center crossbar so that it extended from end to end at the middle of the frames.

column.name: text
column.value: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim worked into it by a skilled craftsman.

column.name: text
column.value: They made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold. They made gold hooks for them and cast their four silver bases.

column.name: text
column.value: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen--the work of an embroiderer;

column.name: text
column.value: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: They built the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, three cubits high; it was square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: They made a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar were of one piece, and they overlaid the altar with bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: They made all its utensils of bronze--its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

column.name: text
column.value: They made a grating for the altar, a bronze network, to be under its ledge, halfway up the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: They cast bronze rings to hold the poles for the four corners of the bronze grating.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: They inserted the poles into the rings so they would be on the sides of the altar for carrying it. They made it hollow, out of boards.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Next they made the courtyard. The south side was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely twisted linen,

column.name: text
column.value: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

column.name: text
