column.value: The north side was also a hundred cubits long and had twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

column.name: text
column.value: The west end was fifty cubits wide and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

column.name: text
column.value: The east end, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Curtains fifteen cubits long were on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

column.name: text
column.value: and curtains fifteen cubits long were on the other side of the entrance to the courtyard, with three posts and three bases.

column.name: text
column.value: All the curtains around the courtyard were of finely twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: The bases for the posts were bronze. The hooks and bands on the posts were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver; so all the posts of the courtyard had silver bands.

column.name: text
column.value: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen--the work of an embroiderer. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,

column.name: text
column.value: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks and bands were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver.

column.name: text
column.value: All the tent pegs of the tabernacle and of the surrounding courtyard were bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the amounts of the materials used for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, which were recorded at Moses' command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: (Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything the LORD commanded Moses;

column.name: text
column.value: with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan--a craftsman and designer, and an embroiderer in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen.)

column.name: text
column.value: The total amount of the gold from the wave offering used for all the work on the sanctuary was 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

column.name: text
column.value: The silver obtained from those of the community who were counted in the census was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel--

column.name: text
column.value: one beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone who had crossed over to those counted, twenty years old or more, a total of 603,550 men.

column.name: text
column.value: The 100 talents of silver were used to cast the bases for the sanctuary and for the curtain--100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent for each base.

column.name: text
column.value: They used the 1,775 shekels to make the hooks for the posts, to overlay the tops of the posts, and to make their bands.

column.name: text
column.value: The bronze from the wave offering was 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,

column.name: text
column.value: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and those for its entrance and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and those for the surrounding courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "Set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: Place the ark of the Testimony in it and shield the ark with the curtain.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony and put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: "Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;

column.name: text
column.value: place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Then anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: Then dress Aaron in the sacred garments, anoint him and consecrate him so he may serve me as priest.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics.

column.name: text
column.value: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue for all generations to come."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses did everything just as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: He took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attached the poles to the ark and put the atonement cover over it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the shielding curtain and shielded the ark of the Testimony, as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain

column.name: text
column.value: and set out the bread on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: He placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle

column.name: text
column.value: and set up the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting in front of the curtain

column.name: text
column.value: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: He set the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,

column.name: text
column.value: and Moses and Aaron and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet.

column.name: text
column.value: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and altar and put up the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. And so Moses finished the work.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses could not enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled upon it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: In all the travels of the Israelites, whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, they would set out;

column.name: text
column.value: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out--until the day it lifted.

column.name: text
column.value: So the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel during all their travels.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, "These are the things the LORD has commanded you to do:

column.name: text
column.value: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on it must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, "This is what the LORD has commanded:

column.name: text
column.value: From what you have, take an offering for the LORD. Everyone who is willing is to bring to the LORD an offering of gold, silver and bronze;

column.name: text
column.value: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

column.name: text
column.value: ram skins dyed red and hides of sea cows; acacia wood;

column.name: text
column.value: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

column.name: text
column.value: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: "All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the LORD has commanded:

column.name: text
column.value: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

column.name: text
column.value: the ark with its poles and the atonement cover and the curtain that shields it;

column.name: text
column.value: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

column.name: text
column.value: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;

column.name: text
column.value: the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;

column.name: text
column.value: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the bronze basin with its stand;

column.name: text
column.value: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;

column.name: text
column.value: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;

column.name: text
column.value: the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary--both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses' presence,

column.name: text
column.value: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.

column.name: text
column.value: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who had blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen, or goat hair, ram skins dyed red or hides of sea cows brought them.

column.name: text
column.value: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the LORD, and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.

column.name: text
column.value: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun--blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.

column.name: text
column.value: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.

column.name: text
column.value: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the LORD freewill offerings for all the work the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to the Israelites, "See, the LORD has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of crafts--

column.name: text
column.value: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

column.name: text
column.value: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic craftsmanship.

column.name: text
column.value: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

column.name: text
column.value: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as craftsmen, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers--all of them master craftsmen and designers.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting. He said,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he is to offer a male without defect. He must present it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting so that it will be acceptable to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and then Aaron's sons the priests shall bring the blood and sprinkle it against the altar on all sides at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron's sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the burning wood that is on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to wash the inner parts and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, he is to offer a male without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the burning wood that is on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to wash the inner parts and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of it and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If the offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, he is to offer a dove or a young pigeon.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to remove the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar, where the ashes are.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall tear it open by the wings, not severing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is on the fire on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When someone brings a grain offering to the LORD, his offering is to be of fine flour. He is to pour oil on it, put incense on it

column.name: text
column.value: and take it to Aaron's sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the fine flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of fine flour: cakes made without yeast and mixed with oil, or wafers made without yeast and spread with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: If your grain offering is prepared on a griddle, it is to be made of fine flour mixed with oil, and without yeast.

column.name: text
column.value: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

column.name: text
column.value: If your grain offering is cooked in a pan, it is to be made of fine flour and oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the LORD; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Every grain offering you bring to the LORD must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

column.name: text
column.value: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If someone's offering is a fellowship offering, and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he is to present before the LORD an animal without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the LORD by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

column.name: text
column.value: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron's sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is on the burning wood, as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If he offers an animal from the flock as a fellowship offering to the LORD, he is to offer a male or female without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: If he offers a lamb, he is to present it before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the LORD by fire: its fat, the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

column.name: text
column.value: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If his offering is a goat, he is to present it before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: From what he offers he is to make this offering to the LORD by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

column.name: text
column.value: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a person sins because he does not speak up when he hears a public charge to testify regarding something he has seen or learned about, he will be held responsible.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Or if a person touches anything ceremonially unclean--whether the carcasses of unclean wild animals or of unclean livestock or of unclean creatures that move along the ground--even though he is unaware of it, he has become unclean and is guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Or if he touches human uncleanness--anything that would make him unclean--even though he is unaware of it, when he learns of it he will be guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Or if a person thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil--in any matter one might carelessly swear about--even though he is unaware of it, in any case when he learns of it he will be guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When anyone is guilty in any of these ways, he must confess in what way he has sinned

column.name: text
column.value: and, as a penalty for the sin he has committed, he must bring to the LORD a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If he cannot afford a lamb, he is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the LORD as a penalty for his sin--one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not severing it completely,

column.name: text
column.value: and is to sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If, however, he cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, he is to bring as an offering for his sin a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He must not put oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the offerings made to the LORD by fire. It is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way the priest will make atonement for him for any of these sins he has committed, and he will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "When a person commits a violation and sins unintentionally in regard to any of the LORD'S holy things, he is to bring to the LORD as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He must make restitution for what he has failed to do in regard to the holy things, add a fifth of the value to that and give it all to the priest, who will make atonement for him with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a person sins and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD'S commands, even though he does not know it, he is guilty and will be held responsible.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the wrong he has committed unintentionally, and he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a guilt offering; he has been guilty of wrongdoing against the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: From the blue, purple and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. They also made sacred garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut strands to be worked into the blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen--the work of a skilled craftsman.

column.name: text
column.value: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached to two of its corners, so it could be fastened.

column.name: text
column.value: Its skillfully woven waistband was like it--of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings and engraved them like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: They fashioned the breastpiece--the work of a skilled craftsman. They made it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: It was square--a span long and a span wide--and folded double.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they mounted four rows of precious stones on it. In the first row there was a ruby, a topaz and a beryl;

column.name: text
column.value: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire and an emerald;

column.name: text
column.value: in the third row a jacinth, an agate and an amethyst;

column.name: text
column.value: in the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.

column.name: text
column.value: There were twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: For the breastpiece they made braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

column.name: text
column.value: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the rings to two of the corners of the breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: They fastened the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

column.name: text
column.value: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

column.name: text
column.value: They made two gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: They tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband so that the breastpiece would not swing out from the ephod--as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth--the work of a weaver--

column.name: text
column.value: with an opening in the center of the robe like the opening of a collar, and a band around this opening, so that it would not tear.

column.name: text
column.value: They made pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen around the hem of the robe.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates.

column.name: text
column.value: The bells and pomegranates alternated around the hem of the robe to be worn for ministering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: For Aaron and his sons, they made tunics of fine linen--the work of a weaver--

column.name: text
column.value: and the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands and the undergarments of finely twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: The sash was of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn--the work of an embroiderer--as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the plate, the sacred diadem, out of pure gold and engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they fastened a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the work on the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

column.name: text
column.value: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of hides of sea cows and the shielding curtain;

column.name: text
column.value: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the atonement cover;

column.name: text
column.value: the table with all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

column.name: text
column.value: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its accessories, and the oil for the light;

column.name: text
column.value: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;

column.name: text
column.value: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

column.name: text
column.value: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs for the courtyard; all the furnishings for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;

column.name: text
column.value: and the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when serving as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses inspected the work and saw that they had done it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood--two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

column.name: text
column.value: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.

column.name: text
column.value: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.

column.name: text
column.value: He made the atonement cover of pure gold--two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

column.name: text
column.value: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.

column.name: text
column.value: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the cover.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the table of acacia wood--two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.

column.name: text
column.value: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

column.name: text
column.value: They cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners, where the four legs were.

column.name: text
column.value: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

column.name: text
column.value: The poles for carrying the table were made of acacia wood and were overlaid with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made from pure gold the articles for the table--its plates and dishes and bowls and its pitchers for the pouring out of drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the lampstand of pure gold and hammered it out, base and shaft; its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms were of one piece with it.

column.name: text
column.value: Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand--three on one side and three on the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

column.name: text
column.value: One bud was under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair--six branches in all.

column.name: text
column.value: The buds and the branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: They made its seven lamps, as well as its wick trimmers and trays, of pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the lampstand and all its accessories from one talent of pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high--its horns of one piece with it.

column.name: text
column.value: They overlaid the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

column.name: text
column.value: They made two gold rings below the molding--two on opposite sides--to hold the poles used to carry it.

column.name: text
column.value: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: They also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense--the work of a perfumer.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the LORD by deceiving his neighbor about something entrusted to him or left in his care or stolen, or if he cheats him,

column.name: text
column.value: or if he finds lost property and lies about it, or if he swears falsely, or if he commits any such sin that people may do--

column.name: text
column.value: when he thus sins and becomes guilty, he must return what he has stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to him, or the lost property he found,

column.name: text
column.value: or whatever it was he swore falsely about. He must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day he presents his guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And as a penalty he must bring to the priest, that is, to the LORD, his guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven for any of these things he did that made him guilty."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "Give Aaron and his sons this command: 'These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.

column.name: text
column.value: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.

column.name: text
column.value: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.

column.name: text
column.value: "'These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron's sons are to bring it before the LORD, in front of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to take a handful of fine flour and oil, together with all the incense on the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in a holy place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the offerings made to me by fire. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. It is his regular share of the offerings made to the LORD by fire for the generations to come. Whatever touches them will become holy.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the LORD on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare it with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the LORD'S regular share and is to be burned completely.

column.name: text
column.value: Every grain offering of a priest shall be burned completely; it must not be eaten."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to Aaron and his sons: 'These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the LORD in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever touches any of the flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in a holy place.

column.name: text
column.value: The clay pot the meat is cooked in must be broken; but if it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot is to be scoured and rinsed with water.

column.name: text
column.value: Any male in a priest's family may eat it; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD'S commands--

column.name: text
column.value: "'If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to present the bull at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD. He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull's blood and carry it into the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD, in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the bull's blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering--the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

column.name: text
column.value: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys--

column.name: text
column.value: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the inner parts and offal--

column.name: text
column.value: that is, all the rest of the bull--he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it in a wood fire on the ash heap.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD'S commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, they are guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: When they become aware of the sin they committed, the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: The elders of the community are to lay their hands on the bull's head before the LORD, and the bull shall be slaughtered before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the anointed priest is to take some of the bull's blood into the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it before the LORD seven times in front of the curtain.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar,

column.name: text
column.value: and do with this bull just as he did with the bull for the sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the commands of the LORD his God, he is guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: When he is made aware of the sin he committed, he must bring as his offering a male goat without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay his hand on the goat's head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man's sin, and he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD'S commands, he is guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: When he is made aware of the sin he committed, he must bring as his offering for the sin he committed a female goat without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, he is to bring a female without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the offerings made to the LORD by fire. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,

column.name: text
column.value: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses did as the LORD commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the assembly, "This is what the LORD has commanded to be done."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also tied the ephod to him by its skillfully woven waistband; so it was fastened on him.

column.name: text
column.value: He placed the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he placed the turban on Aaron's head and set the gold plate, the sacred diadem, on the front of it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and so consecrated them.

column.name: text
column.value: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.

column.name: text
column.value: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him to consecrate him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought Aaron's sons forward, put tunics on them, tied sashes around them and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: He then presented the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses slaughtered the bull and took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to purify the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it to make atonement for it.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses also took all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its offal he burned up outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: He then presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses slaughtered the ram and sprinkled the blood against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces and the fat.

column.name: text
column.value: He washed the inner parts and the legs with water and burned the whole ram on the altar as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: He then presented the other ram, the ram for the ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses also brought Aaron's sons forward and put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he sprinkled blood against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, both kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then from the basket of bread made without yeast, which was before the LORD, he took a cake of bread, and one made with oil, and a wafer; he put these on the fat portions and on the right thigh.

column.name: text
column.value: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the LORD as a wave offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering as an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: He also took the breast--Moses' share of the ordination ram--and waved it before the LORD as a wave offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood from the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments and his sons and their garments.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then said to Aaron and his sons, "Cook the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, 'Aaron and his sons are to eat it.'

column.name: text
column.value: Then burn up the rest of the meat and the bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not leave the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for your ordination will last seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: What has been done today was commanded by the LORD to make atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: You must stay at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days and do what the LORD requires, so you will not die; for that is what I have been commanded."

column.name: text
column.value: So Aaron and his sons did everything the LORD commanded through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to Aaron, "Take a bull calf for your sin offering and a ram for your burnt offering, both without defect, and present them before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then say to the Israelites: 'Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb--both a year old and without defect--for a burnt offering,

column.name: text
column.value: and an ox and a ram for a fellowship offering to sacrifice before the LORD, together with a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.'"

column.name: text
column.value: They took the things Moses commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the entire assembly came near and stood before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said, "This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to Aaron, "Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and the people; sacrifice the offering that is for the people and make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded."

column.name: text
column.value: So Aaron came to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: His sons brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the horns of the altar; the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys and the covering of the liver from the sin offering, as the LORD commanded Moses;

column.name: text
column.value: the flesh and the hide he burned up outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He washed the inner parts and the legs and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron then brought the offering that was for the people. He took the goat for the people's sin offering and slaughtered it and offered it for a sin offering as he did with the first one.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought the burnt offering and offered it in the prescribed way.

column.name: text
column.value: He also brought the grain offering, took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning's burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as the fellowship offering for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fat portions of the ox and the ram--the fat tail, the layer of fat, the kidneys and the covering of the liver--

column.name: text
column.value: these they laid on the breasts, and then Aaron burned the fat on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh before the LORD as a wave offering, as Moses commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having sacrificed the sin offering, the burnt offering and the fellowship offering, he stepped down.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Aaron then went into the Tent of Meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.

column.name: text
column.value: "'These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:

column.name: text
column.value: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be sprinkled against the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the inner parts,

column.name: text
column.value: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made to the LORD by fire. It is a guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Any male in a priest's family may eat it, but it must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Every grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who offers it,

column.name: text
column.value: and every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: "'These are the regulations for the fellowship offering a person may present to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "'If he offers it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering he is to offer cakes of bread made without yeast and mixed with oil, wafers made without yeast and spread with oil, and cakes of fine flour well-kneaded and mixed with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Along with his fellowship offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of bread made with yeast.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the LORD; it belongs to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the fellowship offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: The meat of his fellowship offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered; he must leave none of it till morning.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If, however, his offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day he offers it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.

column.name: text
column.value: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.

column.name: text
column.value: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted. It will not be credited to the one who offered it, for it is impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone touches something unclean--whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean, detestable thing--and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.

column.name: text
column.value: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which an offering by fire may be made to the LORD must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone eats blood, that person must be cut off from his people.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the LORD is to bring part of it as his sacrifice to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: With his own hands he is to bring the offering made to the LORD by fire; he is to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the LORD as a wave offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.

column.name: text
column.value: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their regular share from the Israelites.'"

column.name: text
column.value: This is the portion of the offerings made to the LORD by fire that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the LORD as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day they were anointed, the LORD commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their regular share for the generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,

column.name: text
column.value: which the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the LORD, in the Desert of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense; and they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, contrary to his command.

column.name: text
column.value: So fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then said to Aaron, "This is what the LORD spoke of when he said: "'Among those who approach me I will show myself holy; in the sight of all the people I will be honored.'" Aaron remained silent.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel, and said to them, "Come here; carry your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary."

column.name: text
column.value: So they came and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses ordered.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let your hair become unkempt, and do not tear your clothes, or you will die and the LORD will be angry with the whole community. But your relatives, all the house of Israel, may mourn for those the LORD has destroyed by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not leave the entrance to the Tent of Meeting or you will die, because the LORD'S anointing oil is on you." So they did as Moses said.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "You and your sons are not to drink wine or other fermented drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: You must distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean,

column.name: text
column.value: and you must teach the Israelites all the decrees the LORD has given them through Moses."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, "Take the grain offering left over from the offerings made to the LORD by fire and eat it prepared without yeast beside the altar, for it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons' share of the offerings made to the LORD by fire; for so I have been commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: But you and your sons and your daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. Eat them in a ceremonially clean place; they have been given to you and your children as your share of the Israelites' fellowship offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: The thigh that was presented and the breast that was waved must be brought with the fat portions of the offerings made by fire, to be waved before the LORD as a wave offering. This will be the regular share for you and your children, as the LORD has commanded."

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering and found that it had been burned up, he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's remaining sons, and asked,

column.name: text
column.value: "Why didn't you eat the sin offering in the sanctuary area? It is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the community by making atonement for them before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Since its blood was not taken into the Holy Place, you should have eaten the goat in the sanctuary area, as I commanded."

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron replied to Moses, "Today they sacrificed their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD, but such things as this have happened to me. Would the LORD have been pleased if I had eaten the sin offering today?"

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'Of all the animals that live on land, these are the ones you may eat:

column.name: text
column.value: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.

column.name: text
column.value: "'There are some that only chew the cud or only have a split hoof, but you must not eat them. The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is ceremonially unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: The coney, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the pig, though it has a split hoof completely divided, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Of all the creatures living in the water of the seas and the streams, you may eat any that have fins and scales.

column.name: text
column.value: But all creatures in the seas or streams that do not have fins and scales--whether among all the swarming things or among all the other living creatures in the water--you are to detest.

column.name: text
column.value: And since you are to detest them, you must not eat their meat and you must detest their carcasses.

column.name: text
column.value: Anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales is to be detestable to you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'These are the birds you are to detest and not eat because they are detestable: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

column.name: text
column.value: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

column.name: text
column.value: any kind of raven,

column.name: text
column.value: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

column.name: text
column.value: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

column.name: text
column.value: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

column.name: text
column.value: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

column.name: text
column.value: "'All flying insects that walk on all fours are to be detestable to you.

column.name: text
column.value: There are, however, some winged creatures that walk on all fours that you may eat: those that have jointed legs for hopping on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket or grasshopper.

column.name: text
column.value: But all other winged creatures that have four legs you are to detest.

column.name: text
column.value: "'You will make yourselves unclean by these; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Every animal that has a split hoof not completely divided or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you; whoever touches the carcass of any of them will be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Of all the animals that walk on all fours, those that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who picks up their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening. They are unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Of the animals that move about on the ground, these are unclean for you: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

column.name: text
column.value: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink and the chameleon.

column.name: text
column.value: Of all those that move along the ground, these are unclean for you. Whoever touches them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article, whatever its use, will be unclean, whether it is made of wood, cloth, hide or sackcloth. Put it in water; it will be unclean till evening, and then it will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: If one of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean, and you must break the pot.

column.name: text
column.value: Any food that could be eaten but has water on it from such a pot is unclean, and any liquid that could be drunk from it is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Anything that one of their carcasses falls on becomes unclean; an oven or cooking pot must be broken up. They are unclean, and you are to regard them as unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: A spring, however, or a cistern for collecting water remains clean, but anyone who touches one of these carcasses is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: If a carcass falls on any seeds that are to be planted, they remain clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If an animal that you are allowed to eat dies, anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who eats some of the carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening. Anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Every creature that moves about on the ground is detestable; it is not to be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not to eat any creature that moves about on the ground, whether it moves on its belly or walks on all fours or on many feet; it is detestable.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not defile yourselves by any of these creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean by means of them or be made unclean by them.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. Do not make yourselves unclean by any creature that moves about on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD who brought you up out of Egypt to be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'These are the regulations concerning animals, birds, every living thing that moves in the water and every creature that moves about on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day the boy is to be circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman must wait thirty-three days to be purified from her bleeding. She must not touch anything sacred or go to the sanctuary until the days of her purification are over.

column.name: text
column.value: If she gives birth to a daughter, for two weeks the woman will be unclean, as during her period. Then she must wait sixty-six days to be purified from her bleeding.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When the days of her purification for a son or daughter are over, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall offer them before the LORD to make atonement for her, and then she will be ceremonially clean from her flow of blood. "'These are the regulations for the woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.

column.name: text
column.value: If she cannot afford a lamb, she is to bring two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "When anyone has a swelling or a rash or a bright spot on his skin that may become an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to examine the sore on his skin, and if the hair in the sore has turned white and the sore appears to be more than skin deep, it is an infectious skin disease. When the priest examines him, he shall pronounce him ceremonially unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: If the spot on his skin is white but does not appear to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest is to put the infected person in isolation for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him, and if he sees that the sore is unchanged and has not spread in the skin, he is to keep him in isolation another seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him again, and if the sore has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a rash. The man must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the rash does spread in his skin after he has shown himself to the priest to be pronounced clean, he must appear before the priest again.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to examine him, and if the rash has spread in the skin, he shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious disease.

column.name: text
column.value: "When anyone has an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to examine him, and if there is a white swelling in the skin that has turned the hair white and if there is raw flesh in the swelling,

column.name: text
column.value: it is a chronic skin disease and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He is not to put him in isolation, because he is already unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: "If the disease breaks out all over his skin and, so far as the priest can see, it covers all the skin of the infected person from head to foot,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest is to examine him, and if the disease has covered his whole body, he shall pronounce that person clean. Since it has all turned white, he is clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But whenever raw flesh appears on him, he will be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he shall pronounce him unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; he has an infectious disease.

column.name: text
column.value: Should the raw flesh change and turn white, he must go to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to examine him, and if the sores have turned white, the priest shall pronounce the infected person clean; then he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "When someone has a boil on his skin and it heals,

column.name: text
column.value: and in the place where the boil was, a white swelling or reddish-white spot appears, he must present himself to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to examine it, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it has turned white, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an infectious skin disease that has broken out where the boil was.

column.name: text
column.value: But if, when the priest examines it, there is no white hair in it and it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to put him in isolation for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is infectious.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the spot is unchanged and has not spread, it is only a scar from the boil, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "When someone has a burn on his skin and a reddish-white or white spot appears in the raw flesh of the burn,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest is to examine the spot, and if the hair in it has turned white, and it appears to be more than skin deep, it is an infectious disease that has broken out in the burn. The priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious skin disease.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in the spot and if it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to put him in isolation for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him, and if it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious skin disease.
