column.name: text
column.value: If, however, the spot is unchanged and has not spread in the skin but has faded, it is a swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a scar from the burn.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man or woman has a sore on the head or on the chin,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest is to examine the sore, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it is yellow and thin, the priest shall pronounce that person unclean; it is an itch, an infectious disease of the head or chin.

column.name: text
column.value: But if, when the priest examines this kind of sore, it does not seem to be more than skin deep and there is no black hair in it, then the priest is to put the infected person in isolation for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if the itch has not spread and there is no yellow hair in it and it does not appear to be more than skin deep,

column.name: text
column.value: he must be shaved except for the diseased area, and the priest is to keep him in isolation another seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the itch, and if it has not spread in the skin and appears to be no more than skin deep, the priest shall pronounce him clean. He must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the itch does spread in the skin after he is pronounced clean,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest is to examine him, and if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest does not need to look for yellow hair; the person is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, in his judgment it is unchanged and black hair has grown in it, the itch is healed. He is clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "When a man or woman has white spots on the skin,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest is to examine them, and if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; that person is clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "When a man has lost his hair and is bald, he is clean.

column.name: text
column.value: If he has lost his hair from the front of his scalp and has a bald forehead, he is clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he has a reddish-white sore on his bald head or forehead, it is an infectious disease breaking out on his head or forehead.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to examine him, and if the swollen sore on his head or forehead is reddish-white like an infectious skin disease,

column.name: text
column.value: the man is diseased and is unclean. The priest shall pronounce him unclean because of the sore on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: "The person with such an infectious disease must wear torn clothes, let his hair be unkempt, cover the lower part of his face and cry out, 'Unclean! Unclean!'

column.name: text
column.value: As long as he has the infection he remains unclean. He must live alone; he must live outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: "If any clothing is contaminated with mildew--any woolen or linen clothing,

column.name: text
column.value: any woven or knitted material of linen or wool, any leather or anything made of leather--

column.name: text
column.value: and if the contamination in the clothing, or leather, or woven or knitted material, or any leather article, is greenish or reddish, it is a spreading mildew and must be shown to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to examine the mildew and isolate the affected article for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day he is to examine it, and if the mildew has spread in the clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or the leather, whatever its use, it is a destructive mildew; the article is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: He must burn up the clothing, or the woven or knitted material of wool or linen, or any leather article that has the contamination in it, because the mildew is destructive; the article must be burned up.

column.name: text
column.value: "But if, when the priest examines it, the mildew has not spread in the clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or the leather article,

column.name: text
column.value: he shall order that the contaminated article be washed. Then he is to isolate it for another seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: After the affected article has been washed, the priest is to examine it, and if the mildew has not changed its appearance, even though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it with fire, whether the mildew has affected one side or the other.

column.name: text
column.value: If, when the priest examines it, the mildew has faded after the article has been washed, he is to tear the contaminated part out of the clothing, or the leather, or the woven or knitted material.

column.name: text
column.value: But if it reappears in the clothing, or in the woven or knitted material, or in the leather article, it is spreading, and whatever has the mildew must be burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: The clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or any leather article that has been washed and is rid of the mildew, must be washed again, and it will be clean."

column.name: text
column.value: These are the regulations concerning contamination by mildew in woolen or linen clothing, woven or knitted material, or any leather article, for pronouncing them clean or unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "These are the regulations for the diseased person at the time of his ceremonial cleansing, when he is brought to the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to go outside the camp and examine him. If the person has been healed of his infectious skin disease,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest shall order that two live clean birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall order that one of the birds be killed over fresh water in a clay pot.

column.name: text
column.value: He is then to take the live bird and dip it, together with the cedar wood, the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, into the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the infectious disease and pronounce him clean. Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields.

column.name: text
column.value: "The person to be cleansed must wash his clothes, shave off all his hair and bathe with water; then he will be ceremonially clean. After this he may come into the camp, but he must stay outside his tent for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day he must shave off all his hair; he must shave his head, his beard, his eyebrows and the rest of his hair. He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "On the eighth day he must bring two male lambs and one ewe lamb a year old, each without defect, along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, and one log of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest who pronounces him clean shall present both the one to be cleansed and his offerings before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and offer it as a guilt offering, along with the log of oil; he shall wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to slaughter the lamb in the holy place where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then take some of the log of oil, pour it in the palm of his own left hand,

column.name: text
column.value: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of it before the LORD seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed and make atonement for him before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering

column.name: text
column.value: and offer it on the altar, together with the grain offering, and make atonement for him, and he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "If, however, he is poor and cannot afford these, he must take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for him, together with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, a log of oil,

column.name: text
column.value: and two doves or two young pigeons, which he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "On the eighth day he must bring them for his cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to take the lamb for the guilt offering, together with the log of oil, and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall slaughter the lamb for the guilt offering and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand,

column.name: text
column.value: and with his right forefinger sprinkle some of the oil from his palm seven times before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the oil in his palm he is to put on the same places he put the blood of the guilt offering--on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall sacrifice the doves or the young pigeons, which the person can afford,

column.name: text
column.value: one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. In this way the priest will make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the one to be cleansed."

column.name: text
column.value: These are the regulations for anyone who has an infectious skin disease and who cannot afford the regular offerings for his cleansing.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in that land,

column.name: text
column.value: the owner of the house must go and tell the priest, 'I have seen something that looks like mildew in my house.'

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to order the house to be emptied before he goes in to examine the mildew, so that nothing in the house will be pronounced unclean. After this the priest is to go in and inspect the house.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to examine the mildew on the walls, and if it has greenish or reddish depressions that appear to be deeper than the surface of the wall,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest shall go out the doorway of the house and close it up for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day the priest shall return to inspect the house. If the mildew has spread on the walls,

column.name: text
column.value: he is to order that the contaminated stones be torn out and thrown into an unclean place outside the town.

column.name: text
column.value: He must have all the inside walls of the house scraped and the material that is scraped off dumped into an unclean place outside the town.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they are to take other stones to replace these and take new clay and plaster the house.

column.name: text
column.value: "If the mildew reappears in the house after the stones have been torn out and the house scraped and plastered,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest is to go and examine it and, if the mildew has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew; the house is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: It must be torn down--its stones, timbers and all the plaster--and taken out of the town to an unclean place.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone who goes into the house while it is closed up will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who sleeps or eats in the house must wash his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: "But if the priest comes to examine it and the mildew has not spread after the house has been plastered, he shall pronounce the house clean, because the mildew is gone.

column.name: text
column.value: To purify the house he is to take two birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall kill one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he is to take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn and the live bird, dip them into the blood of the dead bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall purify the house with the bird's blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the scarlet yarn.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean."

column.name: text
column.value: These are the regulations for any infectious skin disease, for an itch,

column.name: text
column.value: for mildew in clothing or in a house,

column.name: text
column.value: and for a swelling, a rash or a bright spot,

column.name: text
column.value: to determine when something is clean or unclean. These are the regulations for infectious skin diseases and mildew.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron who died when they approached the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses: "Tell your brother Aaron not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die, because I appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is how Aaron is to enter the sanctuary area: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to put on the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments next to his body; he is to tie the linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are sacred garments; so he must bathe himself with water before he puts them on.

column.name: text
column.value: From the Israelite community he is to take two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "Aaron is to offer the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he is to take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to cast lots for the two goats--one lot for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron shall bring the goat whose lot falls to the LORD and sacrifice it for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD to be used for making atonement by sending it into the desert as a scapegoat.

column.name: text
column.value: "Aaron shall bring the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household, and he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense and take them behind the curtain.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to put the incense on the fire before the LORD, and the smoke of the incense will conceal the atonement cover above the Testimony, so that he will not die.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to take some of the bull's blood and with his finger sprinkle it on the front of the atonement cover; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the atonement cover.

column.name: text
column.value: "He shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and take its blood behind the curtain and do with it as he did with the bull's blood: He shall sprinkle it on the atonement cover and in front of it.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way he will make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the uncleanness and rebellion of the Israelites, whatever their sins have been. He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting, which is among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: No one is to be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he comes out, having made atonement for himself, his household and the whole community of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then he shall come out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull's blood and some of the goat's blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and to consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: "When Aaron has finished making atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting and the altar, he shall bring forward the live goat.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wickedness and rebellion of the Israelites--all their sins--and put them on the goat's head. He shall send the goat away into the desert in the care of a man appointed for the task.

column.name: text
column.value: The goat will carry on itself all their sins to a solitary place; and the man shall release it in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then Aaron is to go into the Tent of Meeting and take off the linen garments he put on before he entered the Most Holy Place, and he is to leave them there.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his regular garments. Then he shall come out and sacrifice the burnt offering for himself and the burnt offering for the people, to make atonement for himself and for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall also burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: "The man who releases the goat as a scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: The bull and the goat for the sin offerings, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; their hides, flesh and offal are to be burned up.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month you must deny yourselves and not do any work--whether native-born or an alien living among you--

column.name: text
column.value: because on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you. Then, before the LORD, you will be clean from all your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a sabbath of rest, and you must deny yourselves; it is a lasting ordinance.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest is to make atonement. He is to put on the sacred linen garments

column.name: text
column.value: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, for the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and for the priests and all the people of the community.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: Atonement is to be made once a year for all the sins of the Israelites." And it was done, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When any man has a bodily discharge, the discharge is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Whether it continues flowing from his body or is blocked, it will make him unclean. This is how his discharge will bring about uncleanness:

column.name: text
column.value: "'Any bed the man with a discharge lies on will be unclean, and anything he sits on will be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever sits on anything that the man with a discharge sat on must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Whoever touches the man who has a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If the man with the discharge spits on someone who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Everything the man sits on when riding will be unclean,

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever touches any of the things that were under him will be unclean till evening; whoever picks up those things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Anyone the man with a discharge touches without rinsing his hands with water must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'A clay pot that the man touches must be broken, and any wooden article is to be rinsed with water.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When a man is cleansed from his discharge, he is to count off seven days for his ceremonial cleansing; he must wash his clothes and bathe himself with fresh water, and he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day he must take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the LORD to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and give them to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to sacrifice them, the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement before the LORD for the man because of his discharge.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Any clothing or leather that has semen on it must be washed with water, and it will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: When a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When a woman has her regular flow of blood, the impurity of her monthly period will last seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Anything she lies on during her period will be unclean, and anything she sits on will be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever touches anything she sits on must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Whether it is the bed or anything she was sitting on, when anyone touches it, he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man lies with her and her monthly flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days; any bed he lies on will be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When a woman has a discharge of blood for many days at a time other than her monthly period or has a discharge that continues beyond her period, she will be unclean as long as she has the discharge, just as in the days of her period.

column.name: text
column.value: Any bed she lies on while her discharge continues will be unclean, as is her bed during her monthly period, and anything she sits on will be unclean, as during her period.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever touches them will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When she is cleansed from her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day she must take two doves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to sacrifice one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.

column.name: text
column.value: "'You must keep the Israelites separate from things that make them unclean, so they will not die in their uncleanness for defiling my dwelling place, which is among them.'"

column.name: text
column.value: These are the regulations for a man with a discharge, for anyone made unclean by an emission of semen,

column.name: text
column.value: for a woman in her monthly period, for a man or a woman with a discharge, and for a man who lies with a woman who is ceremonially unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: 'This is what the LORD has commanded:

column.name: text
column.value: Any Israelite who sacrifices an ox, a lamb or a goat in the camp or outside of it

column.name: text
column.value: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD in front of the tabernacle of the LORD--that man shall be considered guilty of bloodshed; he has shed blood and must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: This is so the Israelites will bring to the LORD the sacrifices they are now making in the open fields. They must bring them to the priest, that is, to the LORD, at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and sacrifice them as fellowship offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to sprinkle the blood against the altar of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They must no longer offer any of their sacrifices to the goat idols to whom they prostitute themselves. This is to be a lasting ordinance for them and for the generations to come.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to them: 'Any Israelite or any alien living among them who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice

column.name: text
column.value: and does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD--that man must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Any Israelite or any alien living among them who eats any blood--I will set my face against that person who eats blood and will cut him off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one's life.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I say to the Israelites, "None of you may eat blood, nor may an alien living among you eat blood."

column.name: text
column.value: "'Any Israelite or any alien living among you who hunts any animal or bird that may be eaten must drain out the blood and cover it with earth,

column.name: text
column.value: because the life of every creature is its blood. That is why I have said to the Israelites, "You must not eat the blood of any creature, because the life of every creature is its blood; anyone who eats it must be cut off."

column.name: text
column.value: "'Anyone, whether native-born or alien, who eats anything found dead or torn by wild animals must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be ceremonially unclean till evening; then he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself, he will be held responsible.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not do as they do in Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. Do not follow their practices.

column.name: text
column.value: You must obey my laws and be careful to follow my decrees. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep my decrees and laws, for the man who obeys them will live by them. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'No one is to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not dishonor your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; do not have relations with her.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your father's wife; that would dishonor your father.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter; that would dishonor you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father's wife, born to your father; she is your sister.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your father's sister; she is your father's close relative.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your mother's sister, because she is your mother's close relative.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not dishonor your father's brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations; she is your aunt.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son's wife; do not have relations with her.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your brother's wife; that would dishonor your brother.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. Do not have sexual relations with either her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter; they are her close relatives. That is wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not take your wife's sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is living.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not approach a woman to have sexual relations during the uncleanness of her monthly period.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with your neighbor's wife and defile yourself with her.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not lie with a man as one lies with a woman; that is detestable.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with an animal and defile yourself with it. A woman must not present herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it; that is a perversion.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, because this is how the nations that I am going to drive out before you became defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the land was defiled; so I punished it for its sin, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.

column.name: text
column.value: But you must keep my decrees and my laws. The native-born and the aliens living among you must not do any of these detestable things,

column.name: text
column.value: for all these things were done by the people who lived in the land before you, and the land became defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: And if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it vomited out the nations that were before you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Everyone who does any of these detestable things--such persons must be cut off from their people.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep my requirements and do not follow any of the detestable customs that were practiced before you came and do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'Any Israelite or any alien living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the community are to stone him.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set my face against that man and I will cut him off from his people; for by giving his children to Molech, he has defiled my sanctuary and profaned my holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: If the people of the community close their eyes when that man gives one of his children to Molech and they fail to put him to death,

column.name: text
column.value: I will set my face against that man and his family and will cut off from their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves to Molech.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I will set my face against the person who turns to mediums and spiritists to prostitute himself by following them, and I will cut him off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep my decrees and follow them. I am the LORD, who makes you holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother, and his blood will be on his own head.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man commits adultery with another man's wife--with the wife of his neighbor--both the adulterer and the adulteress must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man sleeps with his father's wife, he has dishonored his father. Both the man and the woman must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be put to death. What they have done is a perversion; their blood will be on their own heads.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man lies with a man as one lies with a woman, both of them have done what is detestable. They must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is wicked. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that no wickedness will be among you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he must be put to death, and you must kill the animal.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a woman approaches an animal to have sexual relations with it, kill both the woman and the animal. They must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man marries his sister, the daughter of either his father or his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off before the eyes of their people. He has dishonored his sister and will be held responsible.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man lies with a woman during her monthly period and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has also uncovered it. Both of them must be cut off from their people.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not have sexual relations with the sister of either your mother or your father, for that would dishonor a close relative; both of you would be held responsible.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man sleeps with his aunt, he has dishonored his uncle. They will be held responsible; they will die childless.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man marries his brother's wife, it is an act of impurity; he has dishonored his brother. They will be childless.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not live according to the customs of the nations I am going to drive out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

column.name: text
column.value: But I said to you, "You will possess their land; I will give it to you as an inheritance, a land flowing with milk and honey." I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: "'You must therefore make a distinction between clean and unclean animals and between unclean and clean birds. Do not defile yourselves by any animal or bird or anything that moves along the ground--those which I have set apart as unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to be holy to me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

column.name: text
column.value: "'A man or woman who is a medium or spiritist among you must be put to death. You are to stone them; their blood will be on their own heads.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the entire assembly of Israel and say to them: 'Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must observe my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not turn to idols or make gods of cast metal for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When you sacrifice a fellowship offering to the LORD, sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it or on the next day; anything left over until the third day must be burned up.

column.name: text
column.value: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is impure and will not be accepted.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever eats it will be held responsible because he has desecrated what is holy to the LORD; that person must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not go over your vineyard a second time or pick up the grapes that have fallen. Leave them for the poor and the alien. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not steal. "'Do not lie. "'Do not deceive one another.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not swear falsely by my name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not defraud your neighbor or rob him. "'Do not hold back the wages of a hired man overnight.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind, but fear your God. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great, but judge your neighbor fairly.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not go about spreading slander among your people. "'Do not do anything that endangers your neighbor's life. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not hate your brother in your heart. Rebuke your neighbor frankly so you will not share in his guilt.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against one of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Keep my decrees. "'Do not mate different kinds of animals. "'Do not plant your field with two kinds of seed. "'Do not wear clothing woven of two kinds of material.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man sleeps with a woman who is a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been ransomed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. Yet they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

column.name: text
column.value: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for a guilt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: With the ram of the guilt offering the priest is to make atonement for him before the LORD for the sin he has committed, and his sin will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When you enter the land and plant any kind of fruit tree, regard its fruit as forbidden. For three years you are to consider it forbidden; it must not be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourth year all its fruit will be holy, an offering of praise to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit. In this way your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. "'Do not practice divination or sorcery.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not cut the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not degrade your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will turn to prostitution and be filled with wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not turn to mediums or seek out spiritists, for you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Rise in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When an alien lives with you in your land, do not mistreat him.

column.name: text
column.value: The alien living with you must be treated as one of your native-born. Love him as yourself, for you were aliens in Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight or quantity.

column.name: text
column.value: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Keep all my decrees and all my laws and follow them. I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: 'A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean for any of his people who die,

column.name: text
column.value: except for a close relative, such as his mother or father, his son or daughter, his brother,

column.name: text
column.value: or an unmarried sister who is dependent on him since she has no husband--for her he may make himself unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: He must not make himself unclean for people related to him by marriage, and so defile himself.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Priests must not shave their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or cut their bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: They must be holy to their God and must not profane the name of their God. Because they present the offerings made to the LORD by fire, the food of their God, they are to be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'They must not marry women defiled by prostitution or divorced from their husbands, because priests are holy to their God.

column.name: text
column.value: Regard them as holy, because they offer up the food of your God. Consider them holy, because I the LORD am holy--I who make you holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a priest's daughter defiles herself by becoming a prostitute, she disgraces her father; she must be burned in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The high priest, the one among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and who has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair become unkempt or tear his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: He must not enter a place where there is a dead body. He must not make himself unclean, even for his father or mother,

column.name: text
column.value: nor leave the sanctuary of his God or desecrate it, because he has been dedicated by the anointing oil of his God. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The woman he marries must be a virgin.

column.name: text
column.value: He must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by prostitution, but only a virgin from his own people,

column.name: text
column.value: so he will not defile his offspring among his people. I am the LORD, who makes him holy.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to Aaron: 'For the generations to come none of your descendants who has a defect may come near to offer the food of his God.

column.name: text
column.value: No man who has any defect may come near: no man who is blind or lame, disfigured or deformed;

column.name: text
column.value: no man with a crippled foot or hand,

column.name: text
column.value: or who is hunchbacked or dwarfed, or who has any eye defect, or who has festering or running sores or damaged testicles.

column.name: text
column.value: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has any defect is to come near to present the offerings made to the LORD by fire. He has a defect; he must not come near to offer the food of his God.

column.name: text
column.value: He may eat the most holy food of his God, as well as the holy food;

column.name: text
column.value: yet because of his defect, he must not go near the curtain or approach the altar, and so desecrate my sanctuary. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings the Israelites consecrate to me, so they will not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to them: 'For the generations to come, if any of your descendants is ceremonially unclean and yet comes near the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the LORD, that person must be cut off from my presence. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a descendant of Aaron has an infectious skin disease or a bodily discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is cleansed. He will also be unclean if he touches something defiled by a corpse or by anyone who has an emission of semen,

column.name: text
column.value: or if he touches any crawling thing that makes him unclean, or any person who makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who touches any such thing will be unclean till evening. He must not eat any of the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.

column.name: text
column.value: When the sun goes down, he will be clean, and after that he may eat the sacred offerings, for they are his food.

column.name: text
column.value: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, and so become unclean through it. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The priests are to keep my requirements so that they do not become guilty and die for treating them with contempt. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'No one outside a priest's family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired worker eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a priest buys a slave with money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.

column.name: text
column.value: If a priest's daughter marries anyone other than a priest, she may not eat any of the sacred contributions.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a priest's daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, yet has no children, and she returns to live in her father's house as in her youth, she may eat of her father's food. No unauthorized person, however, may eat any of it.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If anyone eats a sacred offering by mistake, he must make restitution to the priest for the offering and add a fifth of the value to it.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests must not desecrate the sacred offerings the Israelites present to the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: by allowing them to eat the sacred offerings and so bring upon them guilt requiring payment. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: 'If any of you--either an Israelite or an alien living in Israel--presents a gift for a burnt offering to the LORD, either to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,

column.name: text
column.value: you must present a male without defect from the cattle, sheep or goats in order that it may be accepted on your behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not bring anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: When anyone brings from the herd or flock a fellowship offering to the LORD to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without defect or blemish to be acceptable.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not offer to the LORD the blind, the injured or the maimed, or anything with warts or festering or running sores. Do not place any of these on the altar as an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: You may, however, present as a freewill offering an ox or a sheep that is deformed or stunted, but it will not be accepted in fulfillment of a vow.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not offer to the LORD an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn or cut. You must not do this in your own land,

column.name: text
column.value: and you must not accept such animals from the hand of a foreigner and offer them as the food of your God. They will not be accepted on your behalf, because they are deformed and have defects.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "When a calf, a lamb or a goat is born, it is to remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not slaughter a cow or a sheep and its young on the same day.

column.name: text
column.value: "When you sacrifice a thank offering to the LORD, sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: It must be eaten that same day; leave none of it till morning. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Keep my commands and follow them. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not profane my holy name. I must be acknowledged as holy by the Israelites. I am the LORD, who makes you holy

column.name: text
column.value: and who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'These are my appointed feasts, the appointed feasts of the LORD, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.

column.name: text
column.value: "'There are six days when you may work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest, a day of sacred assembly. You are not to do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'These are the LORD'S appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD'S Passover begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: On the fifteenth day of that month the LORD'S Feast of Unleavened Bread begins; for seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days present an offering made to the LORD by fire. And on the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land I am going to give you and you reap its harvest, bring to the priest a sheaf of the first grain you harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to wave the sheaf before the LORD so it will be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day you wave the sheaf, you must sacrifice as a burnt offering to the LORD a lamb a year old without defect,

column.name: text
column.value: together with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil--an offering made to the LORD by fire, a pleasing aroma--and its drink offering of a quarter of a hin of wine.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not eat any bread, or roasted or new grain, until the very day you bring this offering to your God. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

column.name: text
column.value: "'From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, count off seven full weeks.

column.name: text
column.value: Count off fifty days up to the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: From wherever you live, bring two loaves made of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with yeast, as a wave offering of firstfruits to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Present with this bread seven male lambs, each a year old and without defect, one young bull and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings--an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then sacrifice one male goat for a sin offering and two lambs, each a year old, for a fellowship offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to wave the two lambs before the LORD as a wave offering, together with the bread of the firstfruits. They are a sacred offering to the LORD for the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly and do no regular work. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the alien. I am the LORD your God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest, a sacred assembly commemorated with trumpet blasts.

column.name: text
column.value: Do no regular work, but present an offering made to the LORD by fire.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. Hold a sacred assembly and deny yourselves, and present an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Do no work on that day, because it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who does not deny himself on that day must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on that day.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall do no work at all. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a sabbath of rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to observe your sabbath."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the LORD'S Feast of Tabernacles begins, and it lasts for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: The first day is a sacred assembly; do no regular work.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days present offerings made to the LORD by fire, and on the eighth day hold a sacred assembly and present an offering made to the LORD by fire. It is the closing assembly; do no regular work.

column.name: text
column.value: ("'These are the LORD'S appointed feasts, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for bringing offerings made to the LORD by fire--the burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings required for each day.

column.name: text
column.value: These offerings are in addition to those for the LORD'S Sabbaths and in addition to your gifts and whatever you have vowed and all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD.)

column.name: text
column.value: "'So beginning with the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the crops of the land, celebrate the festival to the LORD for seven days; the first day is a day of rest, and the eighth day also is a day of rest.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day you are to take choice fruit from the trees, and palm fronds, leafy branches and poplars, and rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: Celebrate this as a festival to the LORD for seven days each year. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come; celebrate it in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: Live in booths for seven days: All native-born Israelites are to live in booths

column.name: text
column.value: so your descendants will know that I had the Israelites live in booths when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed feasts of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Outside the curtain of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening till morning, continually. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: The lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD must be tended continually.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take fine flour and bake twelve loaves of bread, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.

column.name: text
column.value: Set them in two rows, six in each row, on the table of pure gold before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Along each row put some pure incense as a memorial portion to represent the bread and to be an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: This bread is to be set out before the LORD regularly, Sabbath after Sabbath, on behalf of the Israelites, as a lasting covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place, because it is a most holy part of their regular share of the offerings made to the LORD by fire."

column.name: text
column.value: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.

column.name: text
column.value: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse; so they brought him to Moses. (His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri the Danite.)

column.name: text
column.value: They put him in custody until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the blasphemer outside the camp. All those who heard him are to lay their hands on his head, and the entire assembly is to stone him.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the Israelites: 'If anyone curses his God, he will be held responsible;

column.name: text
column.value: anyone who blasphemes the name of the LORD must be put to death. The entire assembly must stone him. Whether an alien or native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, he must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If anyone takes the life of a human being, he must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who takes the life of someone's animal must make restitution--life for life.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone injures his neighbor, whatever he has done must be done to him:

column.name: text
column.value: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As he has injured the other, so he is to be injured.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to have the same law for the alien and the native-born. I am the LORD your God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. The Israelites did as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land I am going to give you, the land itself must observe a sabbath to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For six years sow your fields, and for six years prune your vineyards and gather their crops.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the seventh year the land is to have a sabbath of rest, a sabbath to the LORD. Do not sow your fields or prune your vineyards.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the grapes of your untended vines. The land is to have a year of rest.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever the land yields during the sabbath year will be food for you--for yourself, your manservant and maidservant, and the hired worker and temporary resident who live among you,

column.name: text
column.value: as well as for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. Whatever the land produces may be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Count off seven sabbaths of years--seven times seven years--so that the seven sabbaths of years amount to a period of forty-nine years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then have the trumpet sounded everywhere on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement sound the trumpet throughout your land.

column.name: text
column.value: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each one of you is to return to his family property and each to his own clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; do not sow and do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the untended vines.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is a jubilee and is to be holy for you; eat only what is taken directly from the fields.

column.name: text
column.value: "'In this Year of Jubilee everyone is to return to his own property.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If you sell land to one of your countrymen or buy any from him, do not take advantage of each other.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to buy from your countryman on the basis of the number of years since the Jubilee. And he is to sell to you on the basis of the number of years left for harvesting crops.

column.name: text
column.value: When the years are many, you are to increase the price, and when the years are few, you are to decrease the price, because what he is really selling you is the number of crops.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live there in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: You may ask, "What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not plant or harvest our crops?"

column.name: text
column.value: I will send you such a blessing in the sixth year that the land will yield enough for three years.

column.name: text
column.value: While you plant during the eighth year, you will eat from the old crop and will continue to eat from it until the harvest of the ninth year comes in.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The land must not be sold permanently, because the land is mine and you are but aliens and my tenants.

column.name: text
column.value: Throughout the country that you hold as a possession, you must provide for the redemption of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If one of your countrymen becomes poor and sells some of his property, his nearest relative is to come and redeem what his countryman has sold.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, a man has no one to redeem it for him but he himself prospers and acquires sufficient means to redeem it,

column.name: text
column.value: he is to determine the value for the years since he sold it and refund the balance to the man to whom he sold it; he can then go back to his own property.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he does not acquire the means to repay him, what he sold will remain in the possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. It will be returned in the Jubilee, and he can then go back to his property.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains the right of redemption a full year after its sale. During that time he may redeem it.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is not redeemed before a full year has passed, the house in the walled city shall belong permanently to the buyer and his descendants. It is not to be returned in the Jubilee.

column.name: text
column.value: But houses in villages without walls around them are to be considered as open country. They can be redeemed, and they are to be returned in the Jubilee.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the Levitical towns, which they possess.

column.name: text
column.value: So the property of the Levites is redeemable--that is, a house sold in any town they hold--and is to be returned in the Jubilee, because the houses in the towns of the Levites are their property among the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: But the pastureland belonging to their towns must not be sold; it is their permanent possession.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If one of your countrymen becomes poor and is unable to support himself among you, help him as you would an alien or a temporary resident, so he can continue to live among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take interest of any kind from him, but fear your God, so that your countryman may continue to live among you.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not lend him money at interest or sell him food at a profit.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If one of your countrymen becomes poor among you and sells himself to you, do not make him work as a slave.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to be treated as a hired worker or a temporary resident among you; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he and his children are to be released, and he will go back to his own clan and to the property of his forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Because the Israelites are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt, they must not be sold as slaves.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not rule over them ruthlessly, but fear your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Your male and female slaves are to come from the nations around you; from them you may buy slaves.

column.name: text
column.value: You may also buy some of the temporary residents living among you and members of their clans born in your country, and they will become your property.

column.name: text
column.value: You can will them to your children as inherited property and can make them slaves for life, but you must not rule over your fellow Israelites ruthlessly.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If an alien or a temporary resident among you becomes rich and one of your countrymen becomes poor and sells himself to the alien living among you or to a member of the alien's clan,

column.name: text
column.value: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his relatives may redeem him:

column.name: text
column.value: An uncle or a cousin or any blood relative in his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.

column.name: text
column.value: He and his buyer are to count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price for his release is to be based on the rate paid to a hired man for that number of years.

column.name: text
column.value: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption a larger share of the price paid for him.

column.name: text
column.value: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to compute that and pay for his redemption accordingly.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to be treated as a man hired from year to year; you must see to it that his owner does not rule over him ruthlessly.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children are to be released in the Year of Jubilee,

column.name: text
column.value: for the Israelites belong to me as servants. They are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not make idols or set up an image or a sacred stone for yourselves, and do not place a carved stone in your land to bow down before it. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,

column.name: text
column.value: I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops and the trees of the field their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: Your threshing will continue until grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until planting, and you will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid. I will remove savage beasts from the land, and the sword will not pass through your country.

column.name: text
column.value: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers, and I will keep my covenant with you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will still be eating last year's harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.

column.name: text
column.value: I will put my dwelling place among you, and I will not abhor you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians; I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But if you will not listen to me and carry out all these commands,

column.name: text
column.value: and if you reject my decrees and abhor my laws and fail to carry out all my commands and so violate my covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will do this to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting diseases and fever that will destroy your sight and drain away your life. You will plant seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set my face against you so that you will be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee even when no one is pursuing you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If after all this you will not listen to me, I will punish you for your sins seven times over.

column.name: text
column.value: I will break down your stubborn pride and make the sky above you like iron and the ground beneath you like bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: Your strength will be spent in vain, because your soil will not yield its crops, nor will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If you remain hostile toward me and refuse to listen to me, I will multiply your afflictions seven times over, as your sins deserve.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children, destroy your cattle and make you so few in number that your roads will be deserted.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction but continue to be hostile toward me,

column.name: text
column.value: I myself will be hostile toward you and will afflict you for your sins seven times over.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring the sword upon you to avenge the breaking of the covenant. When you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be given into enemy hands.

column.name: text
column.value: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake your bread in one oven, and they will dole out the bread by weight. You will eat, but you will not be satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If in spite of this you still do not listen to me but continue to be hostile toward me,

column.name: text
column.value: then in my anger I will be hostile toward you, and I myself will punish you for your sins seven times over.

column.name: text
column.value: You will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars and pile your dead bodies on the lifeless forms of your idols, and I will abhor you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn your cities into ruins and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will take no delight in the pleasing aroma of your offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who live there will be appalled.

column.name: text
column.value: I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out my sword and pursue you. Your land will be laid waste, and your cities will lie in ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the land will enjoy its sabbath years all the time that it lies desolate and you are in the country of your enemies; then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: All the time that it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not have during the sabbaths you lived in it.

column.name: text
column.value: "'As for those of you who are left, I will make their hearts so fearful in the lands of their enemies that the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. They will run as though fleeing from the sword, and they will fall, even though no one is pursuing them.

column.name: text
column.value: They will stumble over one another as though fleeing from the sword, even though no one is pursuing them. So you will not be able to stand before your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.

column.name: text
column.value: Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of their enemies because of their sins; also because of their fathers' sins they will waste away.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their fathers--their treachery against me and their hostility toward me,

column.name: text
column.value: which made me hostile toward them so that I sent them into the land of their enemies--then when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they pay for their sin,

column.name: text
column.value: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

column.name: text
column.value: For the land will be deserted by them and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They will pay for their sins because they rejected my laws and abhorred my decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to destroy them completely, breaking my covenant with them. I am the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God. I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the LORD established on Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
