column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate persons to the LORD by giving equivalent values,

column.name: text
column.value: set the value of a male between the ages of twenty and sixty at fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel;

column.name: text
column.value: and if it is a female, set her value at thirty shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is a person between the ages of five and twenty, set the value of a male at twenty shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is a person between one month and five years, set the value of a male at five shekels of silver and that of a female at three shekels of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is a person sixty years old or more, set the value of a male at fifteen shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone making the vow is too poor to pay the specified amount, he is to present the person to the priest, who will set the value for him according to what the man making the vow can afford.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If what he vowed is an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the LORD, such an animal given to the LORD becomes holy.

column.name: text
column.value: He must not exchange it or substitute a good one for a bad one, or a bad one for a good one; if he should substitute one animal for another, both it and the substitute become holy.

column.name: text
column.value: If what he vowed is a ceremonially unclean animal--one that is not acceptable as an offering to the LORD--the animal must be presented to the priest,

column.name: text
column.value: who will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, that is what it will be.

column.name: text
column.value: If the owner wishes to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man dedicates his house as something holy to the LORD, the priest will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, so it will remain.

column.name: text
column.value: If the man who dedicates his house redeems it, he must add a fifth to its value, and the house will again become his.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man dedicates to the LORD part of his family land, its value is to be set according to the amount of seed required for it--fifty shekels of silver to a homer of barley seed.

column.name: text
column.value: If he dedicates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the value that has been set remains.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, the priest will determine the value according to the number of years that remain until the next Year of Jubilee, and its set value will be reduced.

column.name: text
column.value: If the man who dedicates the field wishes to redeem it, he must add a fifth to its value, and the field will again become his.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold it to someone else, it can never be redeemed.

column.name: text
column.value: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD; it will become the property of the priests.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man dedicates to the LORD a field he has bought, which is not part of his family land,

column.name: text
column.value: the priest will determine its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man must pay its value on that day as something holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In the Year of Jubilee the field will revert to the person from whom he bought it, the one whose land it was.

column.name: text
column.value: Every value is to be set according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.

column.name: text
column.value: "'No one, however, may dedicate the firstborn of an animal, since the firstborn already belongs to the LORD; whether an ox or a sheep, it is the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is one of the unclean animals, he may buy it back at its set value, adding a fifth of the value to it. If he does not redeem it, it is to be sold at its set value.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But nothing that a man owns and devotes to the LORD--whether man or animal or family land--may be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'No person devoted to destruction may be ransomed; he must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "'A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man redeems any of his tithe, he must add a fifth of the value to it.

column.name: text
column.value: The entire tithe of the herd and flock--every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd's rod--will be holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He must not pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If he does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.'"

column.name: text
column.value: These are the commands the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai for the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron:

column.name: text
column.value: "The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting some distance from it, each man under his standard with the banners of his family."

column.name: text
column.value: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 74,600.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 54,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Zebulun will be next. The leader of the people of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 57,400.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.

column.name: text
column.value: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 46,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 59,300.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Gad will be next. The leader of the people of Gad is Eliasaph son of Deuel.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 45,650.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men assigned to the camp of Reuben, according to their divisions, number 151,450. They will set out second.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Tent of Meeting and the camp of the Levites will set out in the middle of the camps. They will set out in the same order as they encamp, each in his own place under his standard.

column.name: text
column.value: On the west will be the divisions of the camp of Ephraim under their standard. The leader of the people of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 40,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to them. The leader of the people of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 32,200.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Benjamin will be next. The leader of the people of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 35,400.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men assigned to the camp of Ephraim, according to their divisions, number 108,100. They will set out third.

column.name: text
column.value: On the north will be the divisions of the camp of Dan, under their standard. The leader of the people of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 62,700.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Asher will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Asher is Pagiel son of Ocran.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 41,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Naphtali will be next. The leader of the people of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.

column.name: text
column.value: His division numbers 53,400.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men assigned to the camp of Dan number 157,600. They will set out last, under their standards.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the Israelites, counted according to their families. All those in the camps, by their divisions, number 603,550.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each with his clan and family.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Desert of Sinai on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. He said:

column.name: text
column.value: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.

column.name: text
column.value: You and Aaron are to number by their divisions all the men in Israel twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army.

column.name: text
column.value: One man from each tribe, each the head of his family, is to help you.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;

column.name: text
column.value: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;

column.name: text
column.value: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

column.name: text
column.value: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;

column.name: text
column.value: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;

column.name: text
column.value: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;

column.name: text
column.value: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;

column.name: text
column.value: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

column.name: text
column.value: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;

column.name: text
column.value: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;

column.name: text
column.value: from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan."

column.name: text
column.value: These were the men appointed from the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes. They were the heads of the clans of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Aaron took these men whose names had been given,

column.name: text
column.value: and they called the whole community together on the first day of the second month. The people indicated their ancestry by their clans and families, and the men twenty years old or more were listed by name, one by one,

column.name: text
column.value: as the LORD commanded Moses. And so he counted them in the Desert of Sinai:

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Reuben was 46,500.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Simeon: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were counted and listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Simeon was 59,300.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Gad: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Gad was 45,650.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Judah: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Judah was 74,600.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Issachar: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Issachar was 54,400.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Zebulun: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Zebulun was 57,400.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Joseph: From the descendants of Ephraim: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Ephraim was 40,500.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Manasseh: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Manasseh was 32,200.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Benjamin: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Benjamin was 35,400.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Dan: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Dan was 62,700.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Asher: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Asher was 41,500.

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of Naphtali: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: The number from the tribe of Naphtali was 53,400.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.

column.name: text
column.value: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel's army were counted according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: The total number was 603,550.

column.name: text
column.value: The families of the tribe of Levi, however, were not counted along with the others.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD had said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the Testimony--over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who goes near it shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each man in his own camp under his own standard.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the Testimony so that wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the Testimony."

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites did all this just as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD talked with Moses on Mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: The names of the sons of Aaron were Nadab the firstborn and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: Those were the names of Aaron's sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: Nadab and Abihu, however, fell dead before the LORD when they made an offering with unauthorized fire before him in the Desert of Sinai. They had no sons; so only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the Tent of Meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests; anyone else who approaches the sanctuary must be put to death."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of the first male offspring of every Israelite woman. The Levites are mine,

column.name: text
column.value: for all the firstborn are mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, whether man or animal. They are to be mine. I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,

column.name: text
column.value: "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the names of the Gershonite clans: Libni and Shimei.

column.name: text
column.value: The Kohathite clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: The Merarite clans: Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans, according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.

column.name: text
column.value: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.

column.name: text
column.value: At the Tent of Meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes--and everything related to their use.

column.name: text
column.value: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites; these were the Kohathite clans.

column.name: text
column.value: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. The Kohathites were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: They were responsible for the care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used in ministering, the curtain, and everything related to their use.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest. He was appointed over those who were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.

column.name: text
column.value: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 6,200.

column.name: text
column.value: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: The Merarites were appointed to take care of the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts, bases, all its equipment, and everything related to their use,

column.name: text
column.value: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Aaron and his sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, in front of the Tent of Meeting. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites. Anyone else who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The total number of Levites counted at the LORD'S command by Moses and Aaron according to their clans, including every male a month old or more, was 22,000.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names.

column.name: text
column.value: Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites are to be mine. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,

column.name: text
column.value: collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.

column.name: text
column.value: Give the money for the redemption of the additional Israelites to Aaron and his sons."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses collected the redemption money from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: From the firstborn of the Israelites he collected silver weighing 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'If a man or woman wants to make a special vow, a vow of separation to the LORD as a Nazirite,

column.name: text
column.value: he must abstain from wine and other fermented drink and must not drink vinegar made from wine or from other fermented drink. He must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.

column.name: text
column.value: As long as he is a Nazirite, he must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.

column.name: text
column.value: "'During the entire period of his vow of separation no razor may be used on his head. He must be holy until the period of his separation to the LORD is over; he must let the hair of his head grow long.

column.name: text
column.value: Throughout the period of his separation to the LORD he must not go near a dead body.

column.name: text
column.value: Even if his own father or mother or brother or sister dies, he must not make himself ceremonially unclean on account of them, because the symbol of his separation to God is on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: Throughout the period of his separation he is consecrated to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If someone dies suddenly in his presence, thus defiling the hair he has dedicated, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing--the seventh day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the eighth day he must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him because he sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. That same day he is to consecrate his head.

column.name: text
column.value: He must dedicate himself to the LORD for the period of his separation and must bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The previous days do not count, because he became defiled during his separation.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Now this is the law for the Nazirite when the period of his separation is over. He is to be brought to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: There he is to present his offerings to the LORD: a year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a year-old ewe lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a fellowship offering,

column.name: text
column.value: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and a basket of bread made without yeast--cakes made of fine flour mixed with oil, and wafers spread with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The priest is to present them before the LORD and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to present the basket of unleavened bread and is to sacrifice the ram as a fellowship offering to the LORD, together with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the Nazirite must shave off the hair that he dedicated. He is to take the hair and put it in the fire that is under the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'After the Nazirite has shaved off the hair of his dedication, the priest is to place in his hands a boiled shoulder of the ram, and a cake and a wafer from the basket, both made without yeast.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then wave them before the LORD as a wave offering; they are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD in accordance with his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford. He must fulfill the vow he has made, according to the law of the Nazirite.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell Aaron and his sons, 'This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:

column.name: text
column.value: "' "The LORD bless you and keep you;

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you;

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD turn his face toward you and give you peace." '

column.name: text
column.value: "So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone who has an infectious skin disease or a discharge of any kind, or who is ceremonially unclean because of a dead body.

column.name: text
column.value: Send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them."

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites did this; they sent them outside the camp. They did just as the LORD had instructed Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites: 'When a man or woman wrongs another in any way and so is unfaithful to the LORD, that person is guilty

column.name: text
column.value: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution for his wrong, add one fifth to it and give it all to the person he has wronged.

column.name: text
column.value: But if that person has no close relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest, along with the ram with which atonement is made for him.

column.name: text
column.value: All the sacred contributions the Israelites bring to a priest will belong to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Each man's sacred gifts are his own, but what he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'If a man's wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him

column.name: text
column.value: by sleeping with another man, and this is hidden from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act),

column.name: text
column.value: and if feelings of jealousy come over her husband and he suspects his wife and she is impure--or if he is jealous and suspects her even though she is not impure--

column.name: text
column.value: then he is to take his wife to the priest. He must also take an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour on her behalf. He must not pour oil on it or put incense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, a reminder offering to draw attention to guilt.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The priest shall bring her and have her stand before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall take some holy water in a clay jar and put some dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.

column.name: text
column.value: After the priest has had the woman stand before the LORD, he shall loosen her hair and place in her hands the reminder offering, the grain offering for jealousy, while he himself holds the bitter water that brings a curse.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall put the woman under oath and say to her, "If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become impure while married to your husband, may this bitter water that brings a curse not harm you.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you have gone astray while married to your husband and you have defiled yourself by sleeping with a man other than your husband"--

column.name: text
column.value: here the priest is to put the woman under this curse of the oath--"may the LORD cause your people to curse and denounce you when he causes your thigh to waste away and your abdomen to swell.

column.name: text
column.value: May this water that brings a curse enter your body so that your abdomen swells and your thigh wastes away." "'Then the woman is to say, "Amen. So be it."

column.name: text
column.value: "'The priest is to write these curses on a scroll and then wash them off into the bitter water.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and this water will enter her and cause bitter suffering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to take from her hands the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the LORD and bring it to the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is then to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial offering and burn it on the altar; after that, he is to have the woman drink the water.

column.name: text
column.value: If she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then when she is made to drink the water that brings a curse, it will go into her and cause bitter suffering; her abdomen will swell and her thigh waste away, and she will become accursed among her people.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, the woman has not defiled herself and is free from impurity, she will be cleared of guilt and will be able to have children.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This, then, is the law of jealousy when a woman goes astray and defiles herself while married to her husband,

column.name: text
column.value: or when feelings of jealousy come over a man because he suspects his wife. The priest is to have her stand before the LORD and is to apply this entire law to her.

column.name: text
column.value: The husband will be innocent of any wrongdoing, but the woman will bear the consequences of her sin.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron:

column.name: text
column.value: "Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work in the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the work of the Kohathites in the Tent of Meeting: the care of the most holy things.

column.name: text
column.value: When the camp is to move, Aaron and his sons are to go in and take down the shielding curtain and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they are to cover this with hides of sea cows, spread a cloth of solid blue over that and put the poles in place.

column.name: text
column.value: "Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes and bowls, and the jars for drink offerings; the bread that is continually there is to remain on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Over these they are to spread a scarlet cloth, cover that with hides of sea cows and put its poles in place.

column.name: text
column.value: "They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that is for light, together with its lamps, its wick trimmers and trays, and all its jars for the oil used to supply it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they are to wrap it and all its accessories in a covering of hides of sea cows and put it on a carrying frame.

column.name: text
column.value: "Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth and cover that with hides of sea cows and put its poles in place.

column.name: text
column.value: "They are to take all the articles used for ministering in the sanctuary, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with hides of sea cows and put them on a carrying frame.

column.name: text
column.value: "They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they are to place on it all the utensils used for ministering at the altar, including the firepans, meat forks, shovels and sprinkling bowls. Over it they are to spread a covering of hides of sea cows and put its poles in place.

column.name: text
column.value: "After Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy furnishings and all the holy articles, and when the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites are to come to do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy things or they will die. The Kohathites are to carry those things that are in the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: "Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, is to have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering and the anointing oil. He is to be in charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including its holy furnishings and articles."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "See that the Kohathite tribal clans are not cut off from the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: So that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go into the sanctuary and assign to each man his work and what he is to carry.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Kohathites must not go in to look at the holy things, even for a moment, or they will die."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Take a census also of the Gershonites by their families and clans.

column.name: text
column.value: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the service of the Gershonite clans as they work and carry burdens:

column.name: text
column.value: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, its covering and the outer covering of hides of sea cows, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: the curtains of the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, the curtain for the entrance, the ropes and all the equipment used in its service. The Gershonites are to do all that needs to be done with these things.

column.name: text
column.value: All their service, whether carrying or doing other work, is to be done under the direction of Aaron and his sons. You shall assign to them as their responsibility all they are to carry.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting. Their duties are to be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: "Count the Merarites by their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: This is their duty as they perform service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts and bases,

column.name: text
column.value: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, ropes, all their equipment and everything related to their use. Assign to each man the specific things he is to carry.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the service of the Merarite clans as they work at the Tent of Meeting under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses, Aaron and the leaders of the community counted the Kohathites by their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work in the Tent of Meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: counted by clans, were 2,750.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the total of all those in the Kohathite clans who served in the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the LORD'S command through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The Gershonites were counted by their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: counted by their clans and families, were 2,630.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the total of those in the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the LORD'S command.

column.name: text
column.value: The Merarites were counted by their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: counted by their clans, were 3,200.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the total of those in the Merarite clans. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the LORD'S command through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses, Aaron and the leaders of Israel counted all the Levites by their clans and families.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting

column.name: text
column.value: numbered 8,580.

column.name: text
column.value: At the LORD'S command through Moses, each was assigned his work and told what to carry. Thus they were counted, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed it and consecrated it and all its furnishings. He also anointed and consecrated the altar and all its utensils.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of families who were the tribal leaders in charge of those who were counted, made offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: They brought as their gifts before the LORD six covered carts and twelve oxen--an ox from each leader and a cart from every two. These they presented before the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in the work at the Tent of Meeting. Give them to the Levites as each man's work requires."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required,

column.name: text
column.value: and he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. They were all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were to carry on their shoulders the holy things, for which they were responsible.

column.name: text
column.value: When the altar was anointed, the leaders brought their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had said to Moses, "Each day one leader is to bring his offering for the dedication of the altar."

column.name: text
column.value: The one who brought his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab of the tribe of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: His offering was one silver plate weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver sprinkling bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel, each filled with fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one young bull, one ram and one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat for a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and two oxen, five rams, five male goats and five male lambs a year old, to be sacrificed as a fellowship offering. This was the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.

column.name: text
column.value: On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, brought his offering.

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: These were the offerings of the Israelite leaders for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver plates, twelve silver sprinkling bowls and twelve gold dishes.

column.name: text
column.value: Each silver plate weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each sprinkling bowl seventy shekels. Altogether, the silver dishes weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

column.name: text
column.value: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. Altogether, the gold dishes weighed a hundred and twenty shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: The total number of animals for the burnt offering came to twelve young bulls, twelve rams and twelve male lambs a year old, together with their grain offering. Twelve male goats were used for the sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The total number of animals for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering came to twenty-four oxen, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old. These were the offerings for the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the atonement cover on the ark of the Testimony. And he spoke with him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, 'When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron did so; he set up the lamps so that they faced forward on the lampstand, just as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how the lampstand was made: It was made of hammered gold--from its base to its blossoms. The lampstand was made exactly like the pattern the LORD had shown Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the Levites from among the other Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.

column.name: text
column.value: To purify them, do this: Sprinkle the water of cleansing on them; then have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil; then you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring the Levites to the front of the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole Israelite community.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to bring the Levites before the LORD, and the Israelites are to lay their hands on them.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may be ready to do the work of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "After the Levites lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, use the one for a sin offering to the LORD and the other for a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons and then present them as a wave offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way you are to set the Levites apart from the other Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.

column.name: text
column.value: "After you have purified the Levites and presented them as a wave offering, they are to come to do their work at the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: They are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to me. I have taken them as my own in place of the firstborn, the first male offspring from every Israelite woman.

column.name: text
column.value: Every firstborn male in Israel, whether man or animal, is mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set them apart for myself.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Of all the Israelites, I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons to do the work at the Tent of Meeting on behalf of the Israelites and to make atonement for them so that no plague will strike the Israelites when they go near the sanctuary."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses, Aaron and the whole Israelite community did with the Levites just as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD and made atonement for them to purify them.

column.name: text
column.value: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the Tent of Meeting under the supervision of Aaron and his sons. They did with the Levites just as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years old or more shall come to take part in the work at the Tent of Meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: but at the age of fifty, they must retire from their regular service and work no longer.

column.name: text
column.value: They may assist their brothers in performing their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves must not do the work. This, then, is how you are to assign the responsibilities of the Levites."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Desert of Sinai in the first month of the second year after they came out of Egypt. He said,

column.name: text
column.value: "Have the Israelites celebrate the Passover at the appointed time.

column.name: text
column.value: Celebrate it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with all its rules and regulations."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses told the Israelites to celebrate the Passover,

column.name: text
column.value: and they did so in the Desert of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them could not celebrate the Passover on that day because they were ceremonially unclean on account of a dead body. So they came to Moses and Aaron that same day

column.name: text
column.value: and said to Moses, "We have become unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be kept from presenting the LORD'S offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?"

column.name: text
column.value: Moses answered them, "Wait until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell the Israelites: 'When any of you or your descendants are unclean because of a dead body or are away on a journey, they may still celebrate the LORD'S Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to celebrate it on the fourteenth day of the second month at twilight. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

column.name: text
column.value: They must not leave any of it till morning or break any of its bones. When they celebrate the Passover, they must follow all the regulations.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and not on a journey fails to celebrate the Passover, that person must be cut off from his people because he did not present the LORD'S offering at the appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: "'An alien living among you who wants to celebrate the LORD'S Passover must do so in accordance with its rules and regulations. You must have the same regulations for the alien and the native-born.'"

column.name: text
column.value: On the day the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it. From evening till morning the cloud above the tabernacle looked like fire.

column.name: text
column.value: That is how it continued to be; the cloud covered it, and at night it looked like fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped.

column.name: text
column.value: At the LORD'S command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.

column.name: text
column.value: When the cloud remained over the tabernacle a long time, the Israelites obeyed the LORD'S order and did not set out.

column.name: text
column.value: Sometimes the cloud was over the tabernacle only a few days; at the LORD'S command they would encamp, and then at his command they would set out.

column.name: text
column.value: Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening till morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they set out. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud lifted, they set out.

column.name: text
column.value: Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a year, the Israelites would remain in camp and not set out; but when it lifted, they would set out.

column.name: text
column.value: At the LORD'S command they encamped, and at the LORD'S command they set out. They obeyed the LORD'S order, in accordance with his command through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "Make two trumpets of hammered silver, and use them for calling the community together and for having the camps set out.

column.name: text
column.value: When both are sounded, the whole community is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: If only one is sounded, the leaders--the heads of the clans of Israel--are to assemble before you.

column.name: text
column.value: When a trumpet blast is sounded, the tribes camping on the east are to set out.

column.name: text
column.value: At the sounding of a second blast, the camps on the south are to set out. The blast will be the signal for setting out.

column.name: text
column.value: To gather the assembly, blow the trumpets, but not with the same signal.

column.name: text
column.value: "The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to blow the trumpets. This is to be a lasting ordinance for you and the generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: When you go into battle in your own land against an enemy who is oppressing you, sound a blast on the trumpets. Then you will be remembered by the LORD your God and rescued from your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Also at your times of rejoicing--your appointed feasts and New Moon festivals--you are to sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, and they will be a memorial for you before your God. I am the LORD your God."

column.name: text
column.value: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Israelites set out from the Desert of Sinai and traveled from place to place until the cloud came to rest in the Desert of Paran.

column.name: text
column.value: They set out, this first time, at the LORD'S command through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The divisions of the camp of Judah went first, under their standard. Nahshon son of Amminadab was in command.

column.name: text
column.value: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,

column.name: text
column.value: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites, who carried it, set out.

column.name: text
column.value: The divisions of the camp of Reuben went next, under their standard. Elizur son of Shedeur was in command.

column.name: text
column.value: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,

column.name: text
column.value: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. The tabernacle was to be set up before they arrived.

column.name: text
column.value: The divisions of the camp of Ephraim went next, under their standard. Elishama son of Ammihud was in command.

column.name: text
column.value: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,

column.name: text
column.value: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, as the rear guard for all the units, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out, under their standard. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was in command.

column.name: text
column.value: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,

column.name: text
column.value: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place about which the LORD said, 'I will give it to you.' Come with us and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, "No, I will not go; I am going back to my own land and my own people."

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses said, "Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the desert, and you can be our eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us."

column.name: text
column.value: So they set out from the mountain of the LORD and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest.

column.name: text
column.value: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever the ark set out, Moses said, "Rise up, O LORD! May your enemies be scattered; may your foes flee before you."

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever it came to rest, he said, "Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: Now the people complained about their hardships in the hearing of the LORD, and when he heard them his anger was aroused. Then fire from the LORD burned among them and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: When the people cried out to Moses, he prayed to the LORD and the fire died down.

column.name: text
column.value: So that place was called Taberah, because fire from the LORD had burned among them.

column.name: text
column.value: The rabble with them began to crave other food, and again the Israelites started wailing and said, "If only we had meat to eat!

column.name: text
column.value: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt at no cost--also the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic.

column.name: text
column.value: But now we have lost our appetite; we never see anything but this manna!"

column.name: text
column.value: The manna was like coriander seed and looked like resin.

column.name: text
column.value: The people went around gathering it, and then ground it in a handmill or crushed it in a mortar. They cooked it in a pot or made it into cakes. And it tasted like something made with olive oil.

column.name: text
column.value: When the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna also came down.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses heard the people of every family wailing, each at the entrance to his tent. The LORD became exceedingly angry, and Moses was troubled.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked the LORD, "Why have you brought this trouble on your servant? What have I done to displease you that you put the burden of all these people on me?

column.name: text
column.value: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their forefathers?

column.name: text
column.value: Where can I get meat for all these people? They keep wailing to me, 'Give us meat to eat!'

column.name: text
column.value: I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.

column.name: text
column.value: If this is how you are going to treat me, put me to death right now--if I have found favor in your eyes--and do not let me face my own ruin."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses: "Bring me seventy of Israel's elders who are known to you as leaders and officials among the people. Have them come to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take of the Spirit that is on you and put the Spirit on them. They will help you carry the burden of the people so that you will not have to carry it alone.

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell the people: 'Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The LORD heard you when you wailed, "If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days,

column.name: text
column.value: but for a whole month--until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it--because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?" '"

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses said, "Here I am among six hundred thousand men on foot, and you say, 'I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!'

column.name: text
column.value: Would they have enough if flocks and herds were slaughtered for them? Would they have enough if all the fish in the sea were caught for them?"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD answered Moses, "Is the LORD'S arm too short? You will now see whether or not what I say will come true for you."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses went out and told the people what the LORD had said. He brought together seventy of their elders and had them stand around the Tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took of the Spirit that was on him and put the Spirit on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did not do so again.

column.name: text
column.value: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the Tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: A young man ran and told Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses' aide since youth, spoke up and said, "Moses, my lord, stop them!"

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses replied, "Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD'S people were prophets and that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a wind went out from the LORD and drove quail in from the sea. It brought them down all around the camp to about three feet above the ground, as far as a day's walk in any direction.

column.name: text
column.value: All that day and night and all the next day the people went out and gathered quail. No one gathered less than ten homers. Then they spread them out all around the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: But while the meat was still between their teeth and before it could be consumed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the place was named Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.

column.name: text
column.value: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders."

column.name: text
column.value: So at the LORD'S command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, "Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.

column.name: text
column.value: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.

column.name: text
column.value: What kind of land do they live in? Is it good or bad? What kind of towns do they live in? Are they unwalled or fortified?

column.name: text
column.value: How is the soil? Is it fertile or poor? Are there trees on it or not? Do your best to bring back some of the fruit of the land." (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)

column.name: text
column.value: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.

column.name: text
column.value: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

column.name: text
column.value: When they reached the Valley of Eshcol, they cut off a branch bearing a single cluster of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them, along with some pomegranates and figs.

column.name: text
column.value: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.

column.name: text
column.value: They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: They gave Moses this account: "We went into the land to which you sent us, and it does flow with milk and honey! Here is its fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.

column.name: text
column.value: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, "We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it."

column.name: text
column.value: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We can't attack those people; they are stronger than we are."

column.name: text
column.value: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, "The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.

column.name: text
column.value: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them."

column.name: text
column.value: That night all the people of the community raised their voices and wept aloud.

column.name: text
column.value: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, "If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this desert!

column.name: text
column.value: Why is the LORD bringing us to this land only to let us fall by the sword? Our wives and children will be taken as plunder. Wouldn't it be better for us to go back to Egypt?"

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to each other, "We should choose a leader and go back to Egypt."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown in front of the whole Israelite assembly gathered there.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes

column.name: text
column.value: and said to the entire Israelite assembly, "The land we passed through and explored is exceedingly good.

column.name: text
column.value: If the LORD is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and will give it to us.

column.name: text
column.value: Only do not rebel against the LORD. And do not be afraid of the people of the land, because we will swallow them up. Their protection is gone, but the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them."

column.name: text
column.value: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the LORD appeared at the Tent of Meeting to all the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the miraculous signs I have performed among them?

column.name: text
column.value: I will strike them down with a plague and destroy them, but I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the LORD, "Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land about it. They have already heard that you, O LORD, are with these people and that you, O LORD, have been seen face to face, that your cloud stays over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.

column.name: text
column.value: If you put these people to death all at one time, the nations who have heard this report about you will say,

column.name: text
column.value: 'The LORD was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath; so he slaughtered them in the desert.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Now may the Lord's strength be displayed, just as you have declared:

column.name: text
column.value: 'The LORD is slow to anger, abounding in love and forgiving sin and rebellion. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation.'

column.name: text
column.value: In accordance with your great love, forgive the sin of these people, just as you have pardoned them from the time they left Egypt until now."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD replied, "I have forgiven them, as you asked.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, as surely as I live and as surely as the glory of the LORD fills the whole earth,

column.name: text
column.value: not one of the men who saw my glory and the miraculous signs I performed in Egypt and in the desert but who disobeyed me and tested me ten times--

column.name: text
column.value: not one of them will ever see the land I promised on oath to their forefathers. No one who has treated me with contempt will ever see it.

column.name: text
column.value: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it.

column.name: text
column.value: Since the Amalekites and Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron:

column.name: text
column.value: "How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: So tell them, 'As surely as I live, declares the LORD, I will do to you the very things I heard you say:

column.name: text
column.value: In this desert your bodies will fall--every one of you twenty years old or more who was counted in the census and who has grumbled against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Not one of you will enter the land I swore with uplifted hand to make your home, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: As for your children that you said would be taken as plunder, I will bring them in to enjoy the land you have rejected.

column.name: text
column.value: But you--your bodies will fall in this desert.

column.name: text
column.value: Your children will be shepherds here for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies lies in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: For forty years--one year for each of the forty days you explored the land--you will suffer for your sins and know what it is like to have me against you.'

column.name: text
column.value: I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this whole wicked community, which has banded together against me. They will meet their end in this desert; here they will die."

column.name: text
column.value: So the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who returned and made the whole community grumble against him by spreading a bad report about it--

column.name: text
column.value: these men responsible for spreading the bad report about the land were struck down and died of a plague before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the men who went to explore the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh survived.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses reported this to all the Israelites, they mourned bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: Early the next morning they went up toward the high hill country. "We have sinned," they said. "We will go up to the place the LORD promised."

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses said, "Why are you disobeying the LORD'S command? This will not succeed!

column.name: text
column.value: Do not go up, because the LORD is not with you. You will be defeated by your enemies,

column.name: text
column.value: for the Amalekites and Canaanites will face you there. Because you have turned away from the LORD, he will not be with you and you will fall by the sword."

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, in their presumption they went up toward the high hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the LORD'S covenant moved from the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and attacked them and beat them down all the way to Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'After you enter the land I am giving you as a home

column.name: text
column.value: and you present to the LORD offerings made by fire, from the herd or the flock, as an aroma pleasing to the LORD--whether burnt offerings or sacrifices, for special vows or freewill offerings or festival offerings--

column.name: text
column.value: then the one who brings his offering shall present to the LORD a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: With each lamb for the burnt offering or the sacrifice, prepare a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'With a ram prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of oil,

column.name: text
column.value: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering. Offer it as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, for a special vow or a fellowship offering to the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: bring with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Also bring half a hin of wine as a drink offering. It will be an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Each bull or ram, each lamb or young goat, is to be prepared in this manner.

column.name: text
column.value: Do this for each one, for as many as you prepare.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Everyone who is native-born must do these things in this way when he brings an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For the generations to come, whenever an alien or anyone else living among you presents an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, he must do exactly as you do.

column.name: text
column.value: The community is to have the same rules for you and for the alien living among you; this is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. You and the alien shall be the same before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: The same laws and regulations will apply both to you and to the alien living among you.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land to which I am taking you

column.name: text
column.value: and you eat the food of the land, present a portion as an offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Present a cake from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.

column.name: text
column.value: Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the LORD from the first of your ground meal.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Now if you unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the LORD gave Moses--

column.name: text
column.value: any of the LORD'S commands to you through him, from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come--

column.name: text
column.value: and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to make atonement for the whole Israelite community, and they will be forgiven, for it was not intentional and they have brought to the LORD for their wrong an offering made by fire and a sin offering.
