column.name: text
column.value: The whole Israelite community and the aliens living among them will be forgiven, because all the people were involved in the unintentional wrong.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But if just one person sins unintentionally, he must bring a year-old female goat for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to make atonement before the LORD for the one who erred by sinning unintentionally, and when atonement has been made for him, he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: One and the same law applies to everyone who sins unintentionally, whether he is a native-born Israelite or an alien.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But anyone who sins defiantly, whether native-born or alien, blasphemes the LORD, and that person must be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he has despised the LORD'S word and broken his commands, that person must surely be cut off; his guilt remains on him.'"

column.name: text
column.value: While the Israelites were in the desert, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly,

column.name: text
column.value: and they kept him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp."

column.name: text
column.value: So the assembly took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.

column.name: text
column.value: You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the LORD, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by going after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will remember to obey all my commands and will be consecrated to your God.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD your God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and get twelve staffs from them, one from the leader of each of their ancestral tribes. Write the name of each man on his staff.

column.name: text
column.value: On the staff of Levi write Aaron's name, for there must be one staff for the head of each ancestral tribe.

column.name: text
column.value: Place them in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.

column.name: text
column.value: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid myself of this constant grumbling against you by the Israelites."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and their leaders gave him twelve staffs, one for the leader of each of their ancestral tribes, and Aaron's staff was among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony and saw that Aaron's staff, which represented the house of Levi, had not only sprouted but had budded, blossomed and produced almonds.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD'S presence to all the Israelites. They looked at them, and each man took his own staff.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Put back Aaron's staff in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign to the rebellious. This will put an end to their grumbling against me, so that they will not die."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses did just as the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites said to Moses, "We will die! We are lost, we are all lost!

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who even comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to die?"

column.name: text
column.value: Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and certain Reubenites--Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth--became insolent

column.name: text
column.value: and rose up against Moses. With them were 250 Israelite men, well-known community leaders who had been appointed members of the council.

column.name: text
column.value: They came as a group to oppose Moses and Aaron and said to them, "You have gone too far! The whole community is holy, every one of them, and the LORD is with them. Why then do you set yourselves above the LORD'S assembly?"

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: "In the morning the LORD will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.

column.name: text
column.value: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do this: Take censers

column.name: text
column.value: and tomorrow put fire and incense in them before the LORD. The man the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy. You Levites have gone too far!"

column.name: text
column.value: Moses also said to Korah, "Now listen, you Levites!

column.name: text
column.value: Isn't it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the LORD'S tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?

column.name: text
column.value: He has brought you and all your fellow Levites near himself, but now you are trying to get the priesthood too.

column.name: text
column.value: It is against the LORD that you and all your followers have banded together. Who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, "We will not come!

column.name: text
column.value: Isn't it enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the desert? And now you also want to lord it over us?

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, you haven't brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you gouge out the eyes of these men? No, we will not come!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD, "Do not accept their offering. I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, nor have I wronged any of them."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to Korah, "You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow--you and they and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: Each man is to take his censer and put incense in it--250 censers in all--and present it before the LORD. You and Aaron are to present your censers also."

column.name: text
column.value: So each man took his censer, put fire and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: When Korah had gathered all his followers in opposition to them at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the glory of the LORD appeared to the entire assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "Separate yourselves from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once."

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and cried out, "O God, God of the spirits of all mankind, will you be angry with the entire assembly when only one man sins?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the assembly, 'Move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: He warned the assembly, "Move back from the tents of these wicked men! Do not touch anything belonging to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins."

column.name: text
column.value: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing with their wives, children and little ones at the entrances to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said, "This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things and that it was not my idea:

column.name: text
column.value: If these men die a natural death and experience only what usually happens to men, then the LORD has not sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the LORD brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the grave, then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt."

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as he finished saying all this, the ground under them split apart

column.name: text
column.value: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, with their households and all Korah's men and all their possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: They went down alive into the grave, with everything they owned; the earth closed over them, and they perished and were gone from the community.

column.name: text
column.value: At their cries, all the Israelites around them fled, shouting, "The earth is going to swallow us too!"

column.name: text
column.value: And fire came out from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, to take the censers out of the smoldering remains and scatter the coals some distance away, for the censers are holy--

column.name: text
column.value: the censers of the men who sinned at the cost of their lives. Hammer the censers into sheets to overlay the altar, for they were presented before the LORD and have become holy. Let them be a sign to the Israelites."

column.name: text
column.value: So Eleazar the priest collected the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned up, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,

column.name: text
column.value: as the LORD directed him through Moses. This was to remind the Israelites that no one except a descendant of Aaron should come to burn incense before the LORD, or he would become like Korah and his followers.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day the whole Israelite community grumbled against Moses and Aaron. "You have killed the LORD'S people," they said.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the assembly gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron and turned toward the Tent of Meeting, suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the LORD appeared.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the Tent of Meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: and the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Get away from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once." And they fell facedown.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Take your censer and put incense in it, along with fire from the altar, and hurry to the assembly to make atonement for them. Wrath has come out from the LORD; the plague has started."

column.name: text
column.value: So Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. The plague had already started among the people, but Aaron offered the incense and made atonement for them.

column.name: text
column.value: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague stopped.

column.name: text
column.value: But 14,700 people died from the plague, in addition to those who had died because of Korah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, for the plague had stopped.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Aaron, "You, your sons and your father's family are to bear the responsibility for offenses against the sanctuary, and you and your sons alone are to bear the responsibility for offenses against the priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring your fellow Levites from your ancestral tribe to join you and assist you when you and your sons minister before the Tent of the Testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to be responsible to you and are to perform all the duties of the Tent, but they must not go near the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to join you and be responsible for the care of the Tent of Meeting--all the work at the Tent--and no one else may come near where you are.

column.name: text
column.value: "You are to be responsible for the care of the sanctuary and the altar, so that wrath will not fall on the Israelites again.

column.name: text
column.value: I myself have selected your fellow Levites from among the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to do the work at the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: But only you and your sons may serve as priests in connection with everything at the altar and inside the curtain. I am giving you the service of the priesthood as a gift. Anyone else who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Aaron, "I myself have put you in charge of the offerings presented to me; all the holy offerings the Israelites give me I give to you and your sons as your portion and regular share.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to have the part of the most holy offerings that is kept from the fire. From all the gifts they bring me as most holy offerings, whether grain or sin or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Eat it as something most holy; every male shall eat it. You must regard it as holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "This also is yours: whatever is set aside from the gifts of all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I give this to you and your sons and daughters as your regular share. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: "I give you all the finest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain they give the LORD as the firstfruits of their harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: All the land's firstfruits that they bring to the LORD will be yours. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Everything in Israel that is devoted to the LORD is yours.

column.name: text
column.value: The first offspring of every womb, both man and animal, that is offered to the LORD is yours. But you must redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.

column.name: text
column.value: When they are a month old, you must redeem them at the redemption price set at five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.

column.name: text
column.value: "But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox, a sheep or a goat; they are holy. Sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Their meat is to be yours, just as the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh are yours.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever is set aside from the holy offerings the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and your sons and daughters as your regular share. It is an everlasting covenant of salt before the LORD for both you and your offspring."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Aaron, "You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any share among them; I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: "I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance in return for the work they do while serving at the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: From now on the Israelites must not go near the Tent of Meeting, or they will bear the consequences of their sin and will die.

column.name: text
column.value: It is the Levites who are to do the work at the Tent of Meeting and bear the responsibility for offenses against it. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. They will receive no inheritance among the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, I give to the Levites as their inheritance the tithes that the Israelites present as an offering to the LORD. That is why I said concerning them: 'They will have no inheritance among the Israelites.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Levites and say to them: 'When you receive from the Israelites the tithe I give you as your inheritance, you must present a tenth of that tithe as the LORD'S offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way you also will present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites. From these tithes you must give the LORD'S portion to Aaron the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: You must present as the LORD'S portion the best and holiest part of everything given to you.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Levites: 'When you present the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the product of the threshing floor or the winepress.

column.name: text
column.value: You and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere, for it is your wages for your work at the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: By presenting the best part of it you will not be guilty in this matter; then you will not defile the holy offerings of the Israelites, and you will not die.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron:

column.name: text
column.value: "This is a requirement of the law that the LORD has commanded: Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer without defect or blemish and that has never been under a yoke.

column.name: text
column.value: Give it to Eleazar the priest; it is to be taken outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: While he watches, the heifer is to be burned--its hide, flesh, blood and offal.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to take some cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.

column.name: text
column.value: After that, the priest must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water. He may then come into the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who burns it must also wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he too will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: "A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and put them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They shall be kept by the Israelite community for use in the water of cleansing; it is for purification from sin.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who gathers up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he too will be unclean till evening. This will be a lasting ordinance both for the Israelites and for the aliens living among them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Whoever touches the dead body of anyone will be unclean for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever touches the dead body of anyone and fails to purify himself defiles the LORD'S tabernacle. That person must be cut off from Israel. Because the water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on him, he is unclean; his uncleanness remains on him.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the law that applies when a person dies in a tent: Anyone who enters the tent and anyone who is in it will be unclean for seven days,

column.name: text
column.value: and every open container without a lid fastened on it will be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone out in the open who touches someone who has been killed with a sword or someone who has died a natural death, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: "For the unclean person, put some ashes from the burned purification offering into a jar and pour fresh water over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water and sprinkle the tent and all the furnishings and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who has touched a human bone or a grave or someone who has been killed or someone who has died a natural death.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who is clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third and seventh days, and on the seventh day he is to purify him. The person being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and that evening he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself, he must be cut off from the community, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on him, and he is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: This is a lasting ordinance for them. "The man who sprinkles the water of cleansing must also wash his clothes, and anyone who touches the water of cleansing will be unclean till evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Anything that an unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it becomes unclean till evening."

column.name: text
column.value: In the first month the whole Israelite community arrived at the Desert of Zin, and they stayed at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was no water for the community, and the people gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: They quarreled with Moses and said, "If only we had died when our brothers fell dead before the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: Why did you bring the LORD'S community into this desert, that we and our livestock should die here?

column.name: text
column.value: Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to this terrible place? It has no grain or figs, grapevines or pomegranates. And there is no water to drink!"

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Aaron went from the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the staff, and you and your brother Aaron gather the assembly together. Speak to that rock before their eyes and it will pour out its water. You will bring water out of the rock for the community so they and their livestock can drink."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses took the staff from the LORD'S presence, just as he commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: He and Aaron gathered the assembly together in front of the rock and Moses said to them, "Listen, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses raised his arm and struck the rock twice with his staff. Water gushed out, and the community and their livestock drank.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not trust in me enough to honor me as holy in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this community into the land I give them."

column.name: text
column.value: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD and where he showed himself holy among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: "This is what your brother Israel says: You know about all the hardships that have come upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: Our forefathers went down into Egypt, and we lived there many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: but when we cried out to the LORD, he heard our cry and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. "Now we are here at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.

column.name: text
column.value: Please let us pass through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the king's highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory."

column.name: text
column.value: But Edom answered: "You may not pass through here; if you try, we will march out and attack you with the sword."

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites replied: "We will go along the main road, and if we or our livestock drink any of your water, we will pay for it. We only want to pass through on foot--nothing else."

column.name: text
column.value: Again they answered: "You may not pass through." Then Edom came out against them with a large and powerful army.

column.name: text
column.value: Since Edom refused to let them go through their territory, Israel turned away from them.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole Israelite community set out from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.

column.name: text
column.value: At Mount Hor, near the border of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: "Aaron will be gathered to his people. He will not enter the land I give the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.

column.name: text
column.value: Get Aaron and his son Eleazar and take them up Mount Hor.

column.name: text
column.value: Remove Aaron's garments and put them on his son Eleazar, for Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will die there."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses did as the LORD commanded: They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole community.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses removed Aaron's garments and put them on his son Eleazar. And Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain,

column.name: text
column.value: and when the whole community learned that Aaron had died, the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days.

column.name: text
column.value: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses because of his Cushite wife, for he had married a Cushite.

column.name: text
column.value: "Has the LORD spoken only through Moses?" they asked. "Hasn't he also spoken through us?" And the LORD heard this.

column.name: text
column.value: (Now Moses was a very humble man, more humble than anyone else on the face of the earth.)

column.name: text
column.value: At once the LORD said to Moses, Aaron and Miriam, "Come out to the Tent of Meeting, all three of you." So the three of them came out.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud; he stood at the entrance to the Tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them stepped forward,

column.name: text
column.value: he said, "Listen to my words: "When a prophet of the LORD is among you, I reveal myself to him in visions, I speak to him in dreams.

column.name: text
column.value: But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house.

column.name: text
column.value: With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?"

column.name: text
column.value: The anger of the LORD burned against them, and he left them.

column.name: text
column.value: When the cloud lifted from above the Tent, there stood Miriam--leprous, like snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had leprosy;

column.name: text
column.value: and he said to Moses, "Please, my lord, do not hold against us the sin we have so foolishly committed.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let her be like a stillborn infant coming from its mother's womb with its flesh half eaten away."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses cried out to the LORD, "O God, please heal her!"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD replied to Moses, "If her father had spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Confine her outside the camp for seven days; after that she can be brought back."

column.name: text
column.value: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on till she was brought back.

column.name: text
column.value: After that, the people left Hazeroth and encamped in the Desert of Paran.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked the Israelites and captured some of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel made this vow to the LORD: "If you will deliver these people into our hands, we will totally destroy their cities."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD listened to Israel's plea and gave the Canaanites over to them. They completely destroyed them and their towns; so the place was named Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: They traveled from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, to go around Edom. But the people grew impatient on the way;

column.name: text
column.value: they spoke against God and against Moses, and said, "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the desert? There is no bread! There is no water! And we detest this miserable food!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD sent venomous snakes among them; they bit the people and many Israelites died.

column.name: text
column.value: The people came to Moses and said, "We sinned when we spoke against the LORD and against you. Pray that the LORD will take the snakes away from us." So Moses prayed for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Make a snake and put it up on a pole; anyone who is bitten can look at it and live."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses made a bronze snake and put it up on a pole. Then when anyone was bitten by a snake and looked at the bronze snake, he lived.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites moved on and camped at Oboth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they set out from Oboth and camped in Iye Abarim, in the desert that faces Moab toward the sunrise.

column.name: text
column.value: From there they moved on and camped in the Zered Valley.

column.name: text
column.value: They set out from there and camped alongside the Arnon, which is in the desert extending into Amorite territory. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why the Book of the Wars of the LORD says: ". . . Waheb in Suphah and the ravines, the Arnon

column.name: text
column.value: and the slopes of the ravines that lead to the site of Ar and lie along the border of Moab."

column.name: text
column.value: From there they continued on to Beer, the well where the LORD said to Moses, "Gather the people together and I will give them water."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel sang this song: "Spring up, O well! Sing about it,

column.name: text
column.value: about the well that the princes dug, that the nobles of the people sank--the nobles with scepters and staffs." Then they went from the desert to Mattanah,

column.name: text
column.value: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

column.name: text
column.value: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel sent messengers to say to Sihon king of the Amorites:

column.name: text
column.value: "Let us pass through your country. We will not turn aside into any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the king's highway until we have passed through your territory."

column.name: text
column.value: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. He mustered his entire army and marched out into the desert against Israel. When he reached Jahaz, he fought with Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel, however, put him to the sword and took over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but only as far as the Ammonites, because their border was fortified.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its surrounding settlements.

column.name: text
column.value: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why the poets say: "Come to Heshbon and let it be rebuilt; let Sihon's city be restored.

column.name: text
column.value: "Fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the citizens of Arnon's heights.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, O Moab! You are destroyed, O people of Chemosh! He has given up his sons as fugitives and his daughters as captives to Sihon king of the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: "But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed all the way to Dibon. We have demolished them as far as Nophah, which extends to Medeba."

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, the Israelites captured its surrounding settlements and drove out the Amorites who were there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army marched out to meet them in battle at Edrei.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have handed him over to you, with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

column.name: text
column.value: So they struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army, leaving them no survivors. And they took possession of his land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Israelites traveled to the plains of Moab and camped along the Jordan across from Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites,

column.name: text
column.value: and Moab was terrified because there were so many people. Indeed, Moab was filled with dread because of the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: The Moabites said to the elders of Midian, "This horde is going to lick up everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field." So Balak son of Zippor, who was king of Moab at that time,

column.name: text
column.value: sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor, who was at Pethor, near the River, in his native land. Balak said: "A people has come out of Egypt; they cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now come and put a curse on these people, because they are too powerful for me. Perhaps then I will be able to defeat them and drive them out of the country. For I know that those you bless are blessed, and those you curse are cursed."

column.name: text
column.value: The elders of Moab and Midian left, taking with them the fee for divination. When they came to Balaam, they told him what Balak had said.

column.name: text
column.value: "Spend the night here," Balaam said to them, "and I will bring you back the answer the LORD gives me." So the Moabite princes stayed with him.

column.name: text
column.value: God came to Balaam and asked, "Who are these men with you?"

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:

column.name: text
column.value: 'A people that has come out of Egypt covers the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps then I will be able to fight them and drive them away.'"

column.name: text
column.value: But God said to Balaam, "Do not go with them. You must not put a curse on those people, because they are blessed."

column.name: text
column.value: The next morning Balaam got up and said to Balak's princes, "Go back to your own country, for the LORD has refused to let me go with you."

column.name: text
column.value: So the Moabite princes returned to Balak and said, "Balaam refused to come with us."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balak sent other princes, more numerous and more distinguished than the first.

column.name: text
column.value: They came to Balaam and said: "This is what Balak son of Zippor says: Do not let anything keep you from coming to me,

column.name: text
column.value: because I will reward you handsomely and do whatever you say. Come and put a curse on these people for me."

column.name: text
column.value: But Balaam answered them, "Even if Balak gave me his palace filled with silver and gold, I could not do anything great or small to go beyond the command of the LORD my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now stay here tonight as the others did, and I will find out what else the LORD will tell me."

column.name: text
column.value: That night God came to Balaam and said, "Since these men have come to summon you, go with them, but do only what I tell you."

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey and went with the princes of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: But God was very angry when he went, and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, she turned off the road into a field. Balaam beat her to get her back on the road.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow path between two vineyards, with walls on both sides.

column.name: text
column.value: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she pressed close to the wall, crushing Balaam's foot against it. So he beat her again.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn, either to the right or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam, and he was angry and beat her with his staff.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD opened the donkey's mouth, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?"

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam answered the donkey, "You have made a fool of me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now."

column.name: text
column.value: The donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your own donkey, which you have always ridden, to this day? Have I been in the habit of doing this to you?" "No," he said.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD opened Balaam's eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with his sword drawn. So he bowed low and fell facedown.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD asked him, "Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? I have come here to oppose you because your path is a reckless one before me.

column.name: text
column.value: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away, I would certainly have killed you by now, but I would have spared her."

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, "I have sinned. I did not realize you were standing in the road to oppose me. Now if you are displeased, I will go back."

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD said to Balaam, "Go with the men, but speak only what I tell you." So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

column.name: text
column.value: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite town on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.

column.name: text
column.value: Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why didn't you come to me? Am I really not able to reward you?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Well, I have come to you now," Balaam replied. "But can I say just anything? I must speak only what God puts in my mouth."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth.

column.name: text
column.value: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the princes who were with him.

column.name: text
column.value: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, and from there he saw part of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."

column.name: text
column.value: Balak did as Balaam said, and the two of them offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I go aside. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet with me. Whatever he reveals to me I will tell you." Then he went off to a barren height.

column.name: text
column.value: God met with him, and Balaam said, "I have prepared seven altars, and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD put a message in Balaam's mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this message."

column.name: text
column.value: So he went back to him and found him standing beside his offering, with all the princes of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balaam uttered his oracle: "Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains. 'Come,' he said, 'curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.'

column.name: text
column.value: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the LORD has not denounced?

column.name: text
column.value: From the rocky peaks I see them, from the heights I view them. I see a people who live apart and do not consider themselves one of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and may my end be like theirs!"

column.name: text
column.value: Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them!"

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, "Must I not speak what the LORD puts in my mouth?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balak said to him, "Come with me to another place where you can see them; you will see only a part but not all of them. And from there, curse them for me."

column.name: text
column.value: So he took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Pisgah, and there he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I meet with him over there."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD met with Balaam and put a message in his mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this message."

column.name: text
column.value: So he went to him and found him standing beside his offering, with the princes of Moab. Balak asked him, "What did the LORD say?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then he uttered his oracle: "Arise, Balak, and listen; hear me, son of Zippor.

column.name: text
column.value: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?

column.name: text
column.value: I have received a command to bless; he has blessed, and I cannot change it.

column.name: text
column.value: "No misfortune is seen in Jacob, no misery observed in Israel. The LORD their God is with them; the shout of the King is among them.

column.name: text
column.value: God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no sorcery against Jacob, no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and of Israel, 'See what God has done!'

column.name: text
column.value: The people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion that does not rest till he devours his prey and drinks the blood of his victims."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!"

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam answered, "Did I not tell you I must do whatever the LORD says?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Come, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there."

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, overlooking the wasteland.

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."

column.name: text
column.value: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he did not resort to sorcery as at other times, but turned his face toward the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came upon him

column.name: text
column.value: and he uttered his oracle: "The oracle of Balaam son of Beor, the oracle of one whose eye sees clearly,

column.name: text
column.value: the oracle of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:

column.name: text
column.value: "How beautiful are your tents, O Jacob, your dwelling places, O Israel!

column.name: text
column.value: "Like valleys they spread out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes planted by the LORD, like cedars beside the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: Water will flow from their buckets; their seed will have abundant water. "Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: "God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox. They devour hostile nations and break their bones in pieces; with their arrows they pierce them.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a lion they crouch and lie down, like a lioness--who dares to rouse them? "May those who bless you be blessed and those who curse you be cursed!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balak's anger burned against Balaam. He struck his hands together and said to him, "I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them these three times.

column.name: text
column.value: Now leave at once and go home! I said I would reward you handsomely, but the LORD has kept you from being rewarded."

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam answered Balak, "Did I not tell the messengers you sent me,

column.name: text
column.value: 'Even if Balak gave me his palace filled with silver and gold, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD--and I must say only what the LORD says'?

column.name: text
column.value: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you of what this people will do to your people in days to come."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he uttered his oracle: "The oracle of Balaam son of Beor, the oracle of one whose eye sees clearly,

column.name: text
column.value: the oracle of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:

column.name: text
column.value: "I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel. He will crush the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of all the sons of Sheth.

column.name: text
column.value: Edom will be conquered; Seir, his enemy, will be conquered, but Israel will grow strong.

column.name: text
column.value: A ruler will come out of Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balaam saw Amalek and uttered his oracle: "Amalek was first among the nations, but he will come to ruin at last."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he saw the Kenites and uttered his oracle: "Your dwelling place is secure, your nest is set in a rock;

column.name: text
column.value: yet you Kenites will be destroyed when Asshur takes you captive."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he uttered his oracle: "Ah, who can live when God does this?

column.name: text
column.value: Ships will come from the shores of Kittim; they will subdue Asshur and Eber, but they too will come to ruin."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balaam got up and returned home and Balak went his own way.

column.name: text
column.value: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with Moabite women,

column.name: text
column.value: who invited them to the sacrifices to their gods. The people ate and bowed down before these gods.

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel joined in worshiping the Baal of Peor. And the LORD'S anger burned against them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of these people, kill them and expose them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that the LORD'S fierce anger may turn away from Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses said to Israel's judges, "Each of you must put to death those of your men who have joined in worshiping the Baal of Peor."

column.name: text
column.value: Then an Israelite man brought to his family a Midianite woman right before the eyes of Moses and the whole assembly of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw this, he left the assembly, took a spear in his hand

column.name: text
column.value: and followed the Israelite into the tent. He drove the spear through both of them--through the Israelite and into the woman's body. Then the plague against the Israelites was stopped;

column.name: text
column.value: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites; for he was as zealous as I am for my honor among them, so that in my zeal I did not put an end to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore tell him I am making my covenant of peace with him.

column.name: text
column.value: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites."

column.name: text
column.value: The name of the Israelite who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the Midianite woman who was put to death was Cozbi daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Treat the Midianites as enemies and kill them,

column.name: text
column.value: because they treated you as enemies when they deceived you in the affair of Peor and their sister Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, the woman who was killed when the plague came as a result of Peor."

column.name: text
column.value: After the plague the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,

column.name: text
column.value: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by families--all those twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them and said,

column.name: text
column.value: "Take a census of the men twenty years old or more, as the LORD commanded Moses." These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were: through Hanoch, the Hanochite clan; through Pallu, the Palluite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Carmi, the Carmite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Reuben; those numbered were 43,730.

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Pallu was Eliab,

column.name: text
column.value: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. The same Dathan and Abiram were the community officials who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and were among Korah's followers when they rebelled against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.

column.name: text
column.value: The line of Korah, however, did not die out.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Simeon by their clans were: through Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; through Jamin, the Jaminite clan; through Jakin, the Jakinite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Zerah, the Zerahite clan; through Shaul, the Shaulite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Simeon; there were 22,200 men.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Gad by their clans were: through Zephon, the Zephonite clan; through Haggi, the Haggite clan; through Shuni, the Shunite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Ozni, the Oznite clan; through Eri, the Erite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Arodi, the Arodite clan; through Areli, the Arelite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Gad; those numbered were 40,500.

column.name: text
column.value: Er and Onan were sons of Judah, but they died in Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Judah by their clans were: through Shelah, the Shelanite clan; through Perez, the Perezite clan; through Zerah, the Zerahite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Perez were: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Hamul, the Hamulite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Issachar by their clans were: through Tola, the Tolaite clan; through Puah, the Puite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Jashub, the Jashubite clan; through Shimron, the Shimronite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Issachar; those numbered were 64,300.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Zebulun by their clans were: through Sered, the Seredite clan; through Elon, the Elonite clan; through Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Manasseh: through Makir, the Makirite clan (Makir was the father of Gilead); through Gilead, the Gileadite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the descendants of Gilead: through Iezer, the Iezerite clan; through Helek, the Helekite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Asriel, the Asrielite clan; through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: (Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons; he had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.)

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: through Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; through Beker, the Bekerite clan; through Tahan, the Tahanite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the descendants of Shuthelah: through Eran, the Eranite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500. These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were: through Bela, the Belaite clan; through Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; through Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Bela through Ard and Naaman were: through Ard, the Ardite clan; through Naaman, the Naamite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan:

column.name: text
column.value: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Asher by their clans were: through Imnah, the Imnite clan; through Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; through Beriah, the Beriite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: and through the descendants of Beriah: through Heber, the Heberite clan; through Malkiel, the Malkielite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans were: through Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; through Guni, the Gunite clan;

column.name: text
column.value: through Jezer, the Jezerite clan; through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.

column.name: text
column.value: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.

column.name: text
column.value: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.

column.name: text
column.value: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups."

column.name: text
column.value: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.

column.name: text
column.value: These also were Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, the Korahite clan. (Kohath was the forefather of Amram;

column.name: text
column.value: the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, who was born to the Levites in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the LORD with unauthorized fire.)

column.name: text
column.value: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had told those Israelites they would surely die in the desert, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah. They approached

column.name: text
column.value: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: "Our father died in the desert. He was not among Korah's followers, who banded together against the LORD, but he died for his own sin and left no sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Why should our father's name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father's relatives."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses brought their case before the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: and the LORD said to him,

column.name: text
column.value: "What Zelophehad's daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father's relatives and turn their father's inheritance over to them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to the Israelites, 'If a man dies and leaves no son, turn his inheritance over to his daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father's brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to be a legal requirement for the Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go up this mountain in the Abarim range and see the land I have given the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,

column.name: text
column.value: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes." (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: "May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all mankind, appoint a man over this community

column.name: text
column.value: to go out and come in before them, one who will lead them out and bring them in, so the LORD'S people will not be like sheep without a shepherd."

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD said to Moses, "Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay your hand on him.

column.name: text
column.value: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the LORD. At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD instructed through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: 'See that you present to me at the appointed time the food for my offerings made by fire, as an aroma pleasing to me.'

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them: 'This is the offering made by fire that you are to present to the LORD: two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,

column.name: text
column.value: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the LORD at the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you prepare in the morning. This is an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the first of every month, present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil;

column.name: text
column.value: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.

column.name: text
column.value: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the fourteenth day of the first month the LORD'S Passover is to be held.

column.name: text
column.value: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

column.name: text
column.value: Present to the LORD an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With each bull prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

column.name: text
column.value: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way prepare the food for the offering made by fire every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the LORD; it is to be prepared in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the day of firstfruits, when you present to the LORD an offering of new grain during the Feast of Weeks, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

column.name: text
column.value: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

column.name: text
column.value: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the first day of the seventh month hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. It is a day for you to sound the trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: As an aroma pleasing to the LORD, prepare a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bull prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

column.name: text
column.value: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are offerings made to the LORD by fire--a pleasing aroma.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.

column.name: text
column.value: Present as an aroma pleasing to the LORD a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bull prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

column.name: text
column.value: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the LORD for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: Present an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With each of the thirteen bulls prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with each of the two rams, two-tenths;

column.name: text
column.value: and with each of the fourteen lambs, one-tenth.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the second day prepare twelve young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bulls, rams and lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the third day prepare eleven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bulls, rams and lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the fourth day prepare ten bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bulls, rams and lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the fifth day prepare nine bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bulls, rams and lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the sixth day prepare eight bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bulls, rams and lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the seventh day prepare seven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bulls, rams and lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On the eighth day hold an assembly and do no regular work.

column.name: text
column.value: Present an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, a burnt offering of one bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: With the bull, the ram and the lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.

column.name: text
column.value: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'In addition to what you vow and your freewill offerings, prepare these for the LORD at your appointed feasts: your burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings and fellowship offerings.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Moses told the Israelites all that the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel: "This is what the LORD commands:

column.name: text
column.value: When a man makes a vow to the LORD or takes an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word but must do everything he said.

column.name: text
column.value: "When a young woman still living in her father's house makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge

column.name: text
column.value: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the LORD will release her because her father has forbidden her.

column.name: text
column.value: "If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself

column.name: text
column.value: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the LORD will release her.

column.name: text
column.value: "Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath

column.name: text
column.value: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid her, then all her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband nullifies them when he hears about them, then none of the vows or pledges that came from her lips will stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will release her.

column.name: text
column.value: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow she makes or any sworn pledge to deny herself.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, he nullifies them some time after he hears about them, then he is responsible for her guilt."

column.name: text
column.value: These are the regulations the LORD gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and his young daughter still living in his house.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses said to the people, "Arm some of your men to go to war against the Midianites and to carry out the LORD'S vengeance on them.

column.name: text
column.value: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses sent them into battle, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, who took with him articles from the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.

column.name: text
column.value: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses, and killed every man.

column.name: text
column.value: Among their victims were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba--the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and children and took all the Midianite herds, flocks and goods as plunder.

column.name: text
column.value: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.

column.name: text
column.value: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,

column.name: text
