column.value: and brought the captives, spoils and plunder to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the Israelite assembly at their camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses was angry with the officers of the army--the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds--who returned from the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: "Have you allowed all the women to live?" he asked them.

column.name: text
column.value: "They were the ones who followed Balaam's advice and were the means of turning the Israelites away from the LORD in what happened at Peor, so that a plague struck the LORD'S people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now kill all the boys. And kill every woman who has slept with a man,

column.name: text
column.value: but save for yourselves every girl who has never slept with a man.

column.name: text
column.value: "All of you who have killed anyone or touched anyone who was killed must stay outside the camp seven days. On the third and seventh days you must purify yourselves and your captives.

column.name: text
column.value: Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, "This is the requirement of the law that the LORD gave Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead

column.name: text
column.value: and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day wash your clothes and you will be clean. Then you may come into the camp."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the community are to count all the people and animals that were captured.

column.name: text
column.value: Divide the spoils between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.

column.name: text
column.value: From the soldiers who fought in the battle, set apart as tribute for the LORD one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep or goats.

column.name: text
column.value: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the LORD'S part.

column.name: text
column.value: From the Israelites' half, select one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, goats or other animals. Give them to the Levites, who are responsible for the care of the LORD'S tabernacle."

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The plunder remaining from the spoils that the soldiers took was 675,000 sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: 72,000 cattle,

column.name: text
column.value: 61,000 donkeys

column.name: text
column.value: and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man.

column.name: text
column.value: The half share of those who fought in the battle was: 337,500 sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: of which the tribute for the LORD was 675;

column.name: text
column.value: 36,000 cattle, of which the tribute for the LORD was 72;

column.name: text
column.value: 30,500 donkeys, of which the tribute for the LORD was 61;

column.name: text
column.value: 16,000 people, of which the tribute for the LORD was 32.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as the LORD'S part, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The half belonging to the Israelites, which Moses set apart from that of the fighting men--

column.name: text
column.value: the community's half--was 337,500 sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: 36,000 cattle,

column.name: text
column.value: 30,500 donkeys

column.name: text
column.value: and 16,000 people.

column.name: text
column.value: From the Israelites' half, Moses selected one out of every fifty persons and animals, as the LORD commanded him, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the care of the LORD'S tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officers who were over the units of the army--the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds--went to Moses

column.name: text
column.value: and said to him, "Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one is missing.

column.name: text
column.value: So we have brought as an offering to the LORD the gold articles each of us acquired--armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings and necklaces--to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted from them the gold--all the crafted articles.

column.name: text
column.value: All the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds that Moses and Eleazar presented as a gift to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: Each soldier had taken plunder for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, saw that the lands of Jazer and Gilead were suitable for livestock.

column.name: text
column.value: So they came to Moses and Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the community, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo and Beon--

column.name: text
column.value: the land the LORD subdued before the people of Israel--are suitable for livestock, and your servants have livestock.

column.name: text
column.value: If we have found favor in your eyes," they said, "let this land be given to your servants as our possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan."

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the Gadites and Reubenites, "Shall your countrymen go to war while you sit here?

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you discourage the Israelites from going over into the land the LORD has given them?

column.name: text
column.value: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to look over the land.

column.name: text
column.value: After they went up to the Valley of Eshcol and viewed the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land the LORD had given them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD'S anger was aroused that day and he swore this oath:

column.name: text
column.value: 'Because they have not followed me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years old or more who came up out of Egypt will see the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob--

column.name: text
column.value: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed the LORD wholeheartedly.'

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD'S anger burned against Israel and he made them wander in the desert forty years, until the whole generation of those who had done evil in his sight was gone.

column.name: text
column.value: "And here you are, a brood of sinners, standing in the place of your fathers and making the LORD even more angry with Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: If you turn away from following him, he will again leave all this people in the desert, and you will be the cause of their destruction."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they came up to him and said, "We would like to build pens here for our livestock and cities for our women and children.

column.name: text
column.value: But we are ready to arm ourselves and go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our women and children will live in fortified cities, for protection from the inhabitants of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has received his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: We will not receive any inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to them, "If you will do this--if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,

column.name: text
column.value: and if all of you will go armed over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven his enemies out before him--

column.name: text
column.value: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free from your obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will be your possession before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the LORD; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.

column.name: text
column.value: Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised."

column.name: text
column.value: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, "We your servants will do as our lord commands.

column.name: text
column.value: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: But your servants, every man armed for battle, will cross over to fight before the LORD, just as our lord says."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the Israelite tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "If the Gadites and Reubenites, every man armed for battle, cross over the Jordan with you before the LORD, then when the land is subdued before you, give them the land of Gilead as their possession.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they do not cross over with you armed, they must accept their possession with you in Canaan."

column.name: text
column.value: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, "Your servants will do what the LORD has said.

column.name: text
column.value: We will cross over before the LORD into Canaan armed, but the property we inherit will be on this side of the Jordan."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan--the whole land with its cities and the territory around them.

column.name: text
column.value: The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

column.name: text
column.value: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh and Kiriathaim,

column.name: text
column.value: as well as Nebo and Baal Meon (these names were changed) and Sibmah. They gave names to the cities they rebuilt.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, the descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.

column.name: text
column.value: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured their settlements and called them Havvoth Jair.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Command the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter Canaan, the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance will have these boundaries:

column.name: text
column.value: "'Your southern side will include some of the Desert of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern boundary will start from the end of the Salt Sea,

column.name: text
column.value: cross south of Scorpion Pass, continue on to Zin and go south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it will go to Hazar Addar and over to Azmon,

column.name: text
column.value: where it will turn, join the Wadi of Egypt and end at the Sea.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Your western boundary will be the coast of the Great Sea. This will be your boundary on the west.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For your northern boundary, run a line from the Great Sea to Mount Hor

column.name: text
column.value: and from Mount Hor to Lebo Hamath. Then the boundary will go to Zedad,

column.name: text
column.value: continue to Ziphron and end at Hazar Enan. This will be your boundary on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For your eastern boundary, run a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary will go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Kinnereth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the boundary will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. "'This will be your land, with its boundaries on every side.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Moses commanded the Israelites: "Assign this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has ordered that it be given to the nine and a half tribes,

column.name: text
column.value: because the families of the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan of Jericho, toward the sunrise."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "These are the names of the men who are to assign the land for you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: And appoint one leader from each tribe to help assign the land.

column.name: text
column.value: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh, from the tribe of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: Shemuel son of Ammihud, from the tribe of Simeon;

column.name: text
column.value: Elidad son of Kislon, from the tribe of Benjamin;

column.name: text
column.value: Bukki son of Jogli, the leader from the tribe of Dan;

column.name: text
column.value: Hanniel son of Ephod, the leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;

column.name: text
column.value: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, the leader from the tribe of Ephraim son of Joseph;

column.name: text
column.value: Elizaphan son of Parnach, the leader from the tribe of Zebulun;

column.name: text
column.value: Paltiel son of Azzan, the leader from the tribe of Issachar;

column.name: text
column.value: Ahihud son of Shelomi, the leader from the tribe of Asher;

column.name: text
column.value: Pedahel son of Ammihud, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali."

column.name: text
column.value: These are the men the LORD commanded to assign the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: Here are the stages in the journey of the Israelites when they came out of Egypt by divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: At the LORD'S command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages:

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the Passover. They marched out boldly in full view of all the Egyptians,

column.name: text
column.value: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had brought judgment on their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Succoth.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Etham, turned back to Pi Hahiroth, to the east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the sea into the desert, and when they had traveled for three days in the Desert of Etham, they camped at Marah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Marah and went to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

column.name: text
column.value: They left the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.

column.name: text
column.value: They left the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Dophkah and camped at Alush.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Rephidim and camped in the Desert of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: They left the Desert of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Libnah and camped at Rissah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Tahath and camped at Terah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Terah and camped at Mithcah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Mithcah and camped at Hashmonah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Haggidgad.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Hor Haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Ezion Geber and camped at Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: At the LORD'S command Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor, where he died on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.

column.name: text
column.value: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim, on the border of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Iyim and camped at Dibon Gad.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.

column.name: text
column.value: They left Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, near Nebo.

column.name: text
column.value: They left the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: There on the plains of Moab they camped along the Jordan from Beth Jeshimoth to Abel Shittim.

column.name: text
column.value: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

column.name: text
column.value: drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. Destroy all their carved images and their cast idols, and demolish all their high places.

column.name: text
column.value: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

column.name: text
column.value: Distribute the land by lot, according to your clans. To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one. Whatever falls to them by lot will be theirs. Distribute it according to your ancestral tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will give you trouble in the land where you will live.

column.name: text
column.value: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.'"

column.name: text
column.value: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: "Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from the inheritance the Israelites will possess. And give them pasturelands around the towns.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will have towns to live in and pasturelands for their cattle, flocks and all their other livestock.

column.name: text
column.value: "The pasturelands around the towns that you give the Levites will extend out fifteen hundred feet from the town wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Outside the town, measure three thousand feet on the east side, three thousand on the south side, three thousand on the west and three thousand on the north, with the town in the center. They will have this area as pastureland for the towns.

column.name: text
column.value: "Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone may flee. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.

column.name: text
column.value: In all you must give the Levites forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.

column.name: text
column.value: The towns you give the Levites from the land the Israelites possess are to be given in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: Take many towns from a tribe that has many, but few from one that has few."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

column.name: text
column.value: select some towns to be your cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone accidentally may flee.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be places of refuge from the avenger, so that a person accused of murder may not die before he stands trial before the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: These six towns you give will be your cities of refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: Give three on this side of the Jordan and three in Canaan as cities of refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: These six towns will be a place of refuge for Israelites, aliens and any other people living among them, so that anyone who has killed another accidentally can flee there.

column.name: text
column.value: "'If a man strikes someone with an iron object so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if anyone has a stone in his hand that could kill, and he strikes someone so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if anyone has a wooden object in his hand that could kill, and he hits someone so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death; when he meets him, he shall put him to death.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone with malice aforethought shoves another or throws something at him intentionally so that he dies

column.name: text
column.value: or if in hostility he hits him with his fist so that he dies, that person shall be put to death; he is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But if without hostility someone suddenly shoves another or throws something at him unintentionally

column.name: text
column.value: or, without seeing him, drops a stone on him that could kill him, and he dies, then since he was not his enemy and he did not intend to harm him,

column.name: text
column.value: the assembly must judge between him and the avenger of blood according to these regulations.

column.name: text
column.value: The assembly must protect the one accused of murder from the avenger of blood and send him back to the city of refuge to which he fled. He must stay there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But if the accused ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he has fled

column.name: text
column.value: and the avenger of blood finds him outside the city, the avenger of blood may kill the accused without being guilty of murder.

column.name: text
column.value: The accused must stay in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest; only after the death of the high priest may he return to his own property.

column.name: text
column.value: "'These are to be legal requirements for you throughout the generations to come, wherever you live.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Anyone who kills a person is to be put to death as a murderer only on the testimony of witnesses. But no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer, who deserves to die. He must surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not accept a ransom for anyone who has fled to a city of refuge and so allow him to go back and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Do not pollute the land where you are. Bloodshed pollutes the land, and atonement cannot be made for the land on which blood has been shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell, for I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, who were from the clans of the descendants of Joseph, came and spoke before Moses and the leaders, the heads of the Israelite families.

column.name: text
column.value: They said, "When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, he ordered you to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Now suppose they marry men from other Israelite tribes; then their inheritance will be taken from our ancestral inheritance and added to that of the tribe they marry into. And so part of the inheritance allotted to us will be taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Year of Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to that of the tribe into which they marry, and their property will be taken from the tribal inheritance of our forefathers."

column.name: text
column.value: Then at the LORD'S command Moses gave this order to the Israelites: "What the tribe of the descendants of Joseph is saying is right.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD commands for Zelophehad's daughters: They may marry anyone they please as long as they marry within the tribal clan of their father.

column.name: text
column.value: No inheritance in Israel is to pass from tribe to tribe, for every Israelite shall keep the tribal land inherited from his forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Every daughter who inherits land in any Israelite tribe must marry someone in her father's tribal clan, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: No inheritance may pass from tribe to tribe, for each Israelite tribe is to keep the land it inherits."

column.name: text
column.value: So Zelophehad's daughters did as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Zelophehad's daughters--Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah and Noah--married their cousins on their father's side.

column.name: text
column.value: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in their father's clan and tribe.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the commands and regulations the LORD gave through Moses to the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel in the desert east of the Jordan--that is, in the Arabah--opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth and Dizahab.

column.name: text
column.value: (It takes eleven days to go from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea by the Mount Seir road.)

column.name: text
column.value: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them.

column.name: text
column.value: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, and at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

column.name: text
column.value: East of the Jordan in the territory of Moab, Moses began to expound this law, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD our God said to us at Horeb, "You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: Break camp and advance into the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the mountains, in the western foothills, in the Negev and along the coast, to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the Euphrates.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have given you this land. Go in and take possession of the land that the LORD swore he would give to your fathers--to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob--and to their descendants after them."

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I said to you, "You are too heavy a burden for me to carry alone.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God has increased your numbers so that today you are as many as the stars in the sky.

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times and bless you as he has promised!

column.name: text
column.value: But how can I bear your problems and your burdens and your disputes all by myself?

column.name: text
column.value: Choose some wise, understanding and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will set them over you."

column.name: text
column.value: You answered me, "What you propose to do is good."

column.name: text
column.value: So I took the leading men of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them to have authority over you--as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties and of tens and as tribal officials.

column.name: text
column.value: And I charged your judges at that time: Hear the disputes between your brothers and judge fairly, whether the case is between brother Israelites or between one of them and an alien.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not show partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be afraid of any man, for judgment belongs to God. Bring me any case too hard for you, and I will hear it.

column.name: text
column.value: And at that time I told you everything you were to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Then, as the LORD our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful desert that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to you, "You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.

column.name: text
column.value: See, the LORD your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it as the LORD, the God of your fathers, told you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."

column.name: text
column.value: Then all of you came to me and said, "Let us send men ahead to spy out the land for us and bring back a report about the route we are to take and the towns we will come to."

column.name: text
column.value: The idea seemed good to me; so I selected twelve of you, one man from each tribe.

column.name: text
column.value: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and explored it.

column.name: text
column.value: Taking with them some of the fruit of the land, they brought it down to us and reported, "It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us."

column.name: text
column.value: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: You grumbled in your tents and said, "The LORD hates us; so he brought us out of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.

column.name: text
column.value: Where can we go? Our brothers have made us lose heart. They say, 'The people are stronger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the sky. We even saw the Anakites there.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to you, "Do not be terrified; do not be afraid of them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God, who is going before you, will fight for you, as he did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes,

column.name: text
column.value: and in the desert. There you saw how the LORD your God carried you, as a father carries his son, all the way you went until you reached this place."

column.name: text
column.value: In spite of this, you did not trust in the LORD your God,

column.name: text
column.value: who went ahead of you on your journey, in fire by night and in a cloud by day, to search out places for you to camp and to show you the way you should go.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD heard what you said, he was angry and solemnly swore:

column.name: text
column.value: "Not a man of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your forefathers,

column.name: text
column.value: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land he set his feet on, because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly."

column.name: text
column.value: Because of you the LORD became angry with me also and said, "You shall not enter it, either.

column.name: text
column.value: But your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will enter it. Encourage him, because he will lead Israel to inherit it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the little ones that you said would be taken captive, your children who do not yet know good from bad--they will enter the land. I will give it to them and they will take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, turn around and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea."

column.name: text
column.value: Then you replied, "We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, as the LORD our God commanded us." So every one of you put on his weapons, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to me, "Tell them, 'Do not go up and fight, because I will not be with you. You will be defeated by your enemies.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So I told you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the LORD'S command and in your arrogance you marched up into the hill country.

column.name: text
column.value: The Amorites who lived in those hills came out against you; they chased you like a swarm of bees and beat you down from Seir all the way to Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: You came back and wept before the LORD, but he paid no attention to your weeping and turned a deaf ear to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And so you stayed in Kadesh many days--all the time you spent there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we turned back and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea, as the LORD had directed me. For a long time we made our way around the hill country of Seir.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me,

column.name: text
column.value: "You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north.

column.name: text
column.value: Give the people these orders: 'You are about to pass through the territory of your brothers the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, but be very careful.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, not even enough to put your foot on. I have given Esau the hill country of Seir as his own.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast desert. These forty years the LORD your God has been with you, and you have not lacked anything.

column.name: text
column.value: So we went on past our brothers the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion Geber, and traveled along the desert road of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any part of their land. I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession."

column.name: text
column.value: (The Emites used to live there--a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the Anakites, they too were considered Rephaites, but the Moabites called them Emites.

column.name: text
column.value: Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land the LORD gave them as their possession.)

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, "Now get up and cross the Zered Valley." So we crossed the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: Thirty-eight years passed from the time we left Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley. By then, that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD'S hand was against them until he had completely eliminated them from the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the last of these fighting men among the people had died,

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD said to me,

column.name: text
column.value: "Today you are to pass by the region of Moab at Ar.

column.name: text
column.value: When you come to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them to war, for I will not give you possession of any land belonging to the Ammonites. I have given it as a possession to the descendants of Lot."

column.name: text
column.value: (That too was considered a land of the Rephaites, who used to live there; but the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.

column.name: text
column.value: They were a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites. The LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD had done the same for the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for the Avvites who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorites coming out from Caphtor destroyed them and settled in their place.)

column.name: text
column.value: "Set out now and cross the Arnon Gorge. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his country. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: This very day I will begin to put the terror and fear of you on all the nations under heaven. They will hear reports of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you."

column.name: text
column.value: From the desert of Kedemoth I sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon offering peace and saying,

column.name: text
column.value: "Let us pass through your country. We will stay on the main road; we will not turn aside to the right or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Sell us food to eat and water to drink for their price in silver. Only let us pass through on foot--

column.name: text
column.value: as the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, did for us--until we cross the Jordan into the land the LORD our God is giving us."

column.name: text
column.value: But Sihon king of Heshbon refused to let us pass through. For the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate in order to give him into your hands, as he has now done.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his country over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land."

column.name: text
column.value: When Sihon and all his army came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz,

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD our God delivered him over to us and we struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time we took all his towns and completely destroyed them--men, women and children. We left no survivors.

column.name: text
column.value: But the livestock and the plunder from the towns we had captured we carried off for ourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the gorge, even as far as Gilead, not one town was too strong for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.

column.name: text
column.value: But in accordance with the command of the LORD our God, you did not encroach on any of the land of the Ammonites, neither the land along the course of the Jabbok nor that around the towns in the hills.

column.name: text
column.value: Next we turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan with his whole army marched out to meet us in battle at Edrei.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have handed him over to you with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD our God also gave into our hands Og king of Bashan and all his army. We struck them down, leaving no survivors.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time we took all his cities. There was not one of the sixty cities that we did not take from them--the whole region of Argob, Og's kingdom in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: All these cities were fortified with high walls and with gates and bars, and there were also a great many unwalled villages.

column.name: text
column.value: We completely destroyed them, as we had done with Sihon king of Heshbon, destroying every city--men, women and children.

column.name: text
column.value: But all the livestock and the plunder from their cities we carried off for ourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: So at that time we took from these two kings of the Amorites the territory east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge as far as Mount Hermon.

column.name: text
column.value: (Hermon is called Sirion by the Sidonians; the Amorites call it Senir.)

column.name: text
column.value: We took all the towns on the plateau, and all Gilead, and all Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, towns of Og's kingdom in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: (Only Og king of Bashan was left of the remnant of the Rephaites. His bed was made of iron and was more than thirteen feet long and six feet wide. It is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)

column.name: text
column.value: Of the land that we took over at that time, I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory north of Aroer by the Arnon Gorge, including half the hill country of Gilead, together with its towns.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of Gilead and also all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh. (The whole region of Argob in Bashan used to be known as a land of the Rephaites.

column.name: text
column.value: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites; it was named after him, so that to this day Bashan is called Havvoth Jair.)

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave Gilead to Makir.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory extending from Gilead down to the Arnon Gorge (the middle of the gorge being the border) and out to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites.

column.name: text
column.value: Its western border was the Jordan in the Arabah, from Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), below the slopes of Pisgah.

column.name: text
column.value: I commanded you at that time: "The LORD your God has given you this land to take possession of it. But all your able-bodied men, armed for battle, must cross over ahead of your brother Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: However, your wives, your children and your livestock (I know you have much livestock) may stay in the towns I have given you,

column.name: text
column.value: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as he has to you, and they too have taken over the land that the LORD your God is giving them, across the Jordan. After that, each of you may go back to the possession I have given you."

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I commanded Joshua: "You have seen with your own eyes all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms over there where you are going.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be afraid of them; the LORD your God himself will fight for you."

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I pleaded with the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "O Sovereign LORD, you have begun to show to your servant your greatness and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do the deeds and mighty works you do?

column.name: text
column.value: Let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan--that fine hill country and Lebanon."

column.name: text
column.value: But because of you the LORD was angry with me and would not listen to me. "That is enough," the LORD said. "Do not speak to me anymore about this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to the top of Pisgah and look west and north and south and east. Look at the land with your own eyes, since you are not going to cross this Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: But commission Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead this people across and will cause them to inherit the land that you will see."

column.name: text
column.value: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear now, O Israel, the decrees and laws I am about to teach you. Follow them so that you may live and may go in and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not add to what I command you and do not subtract from it, but keep the commands of the LORD your God that I give you.

column.name: text
column.value: You saw with your own eyes what the LORD did at Baal Peor. The LORD your God destroyed from among you everyone who followed the Baal of Peor,

column.name: text
column.value: but all of you who held fast to the LORD your God are still alive today.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have taught you decrees and laws as the LORD my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding to the nations, who will hear about all these decrees and say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people."

column.name: text
column.value: What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the LORD our God is near us whenever we pray to him?

column.name: text
column.value: And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today?

column.name: text
column.value: Only be careful, and watch yourselves closely so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen or let them slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and to their children after them.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, when he said to me, "Assemble the people before me to hear my words so that they may learn to revere me as long as they live in the land and may teach them to their children."

column.name: text
column.value: You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain while it blazed with fire to the very heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of words but saw no form; there was only a voice.

column.name: text
column.value: He declared to you his covenant, the Ten Commandments, which he commanded you to follow and then wrote them on two stone tablets.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD directed me at that time to teach you the decrees and laws you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

column.name: text
column.value: You saw no form of any kind the day the LORD spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire. Therefore watch yourselves very carefully,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you do not become corrupt and make for yourselves an idol, an image of any shape, whether formed like a man or a woman,

column.name: text
column.value: or like any animal on earth or any bird that flies in the air,

column.name: text
column.value: or like any creature that moves along the ground or any fish in the waters below.

column.name: text
column.value: And when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon and the stars--all the heavenly array--do not be enticed into bowing down to them and worshiping things the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, the LORD took you and brought you out of the iron-smelting furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his inheritance, as you now are.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD was angry with me because of you, and he solemnly swore that I would not cross the Jordan and enter the good land the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: I will die in this land; I will not cross the Jordan; but you are about to cross over and take possession of that good land.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful not to forget the covenant of the LORD your God that he made with you; do not make for yourselves an idol in the form of anything the LORD your God has forbidden.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

column.name: text
column.value: After you have had children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time--if you then become corrupt and make any kind of idol, doing evil in the eyes of the LORD your God and provoking him to anger,

column.name: text
column.value: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live there long but will certainly be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.

column.name: text
column.value: There you will worship man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

column.name: text
column.value: But if from there you seek the LORD your God, you will find him if you look for him with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the LORD your God and obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon or destroy you or forget the covenant with your forefathers, which he confirmed to them by oath.

column.name: text
column.value: Ask now about the former days, long before your time, from the day God created man on the earth; ask from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything so great as this ever happened, or has anything like it ever been heard of?

column.name: text
column.value: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of fire, as you have, and lived?

column.name: text
column.value: Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by miraculous signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?

column.name: text
column.value: You were shown these things so that you might know that the LORD is God; besides him there is no other.

column.name: text
column.value: From heaven he made you hear his voice to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from out of the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he loved your forefathers and chose their descendants after them, he brought you out of Egypt by his Presence and his great strength,

column.name: text
column.value: to drive out before you nations greater and stronger than you and to bring you into their land to give it to you for your inheritance, as it is today.

column.name: text
column.value: Acknowledge and take to heart this day that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep his decrees and commands, which I am giving you today, so that it may go well with you and your children after you and that you may live long in the land the LORD your God gives you for all time.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses set aside three cities east of the Jordan,

column.name: text
column.value: to which anyone who had killed a person could flee if he had unintentionally killed his neighbor without malice aforethought. He could flee into one of these cities and save his life.

column.name: text
column.value: The cities were these: Bezer in the desert plateau, for the Reubenites; Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the law Moses set before the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the stipulations, decrees and laws Moses gave them when they came out of Egypt

column.name: text
column.value: and were in the valley near Beth Peor east of the Jordan, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites as they came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: This land extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge to Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),

column.name: text
column.value: and included all the Arabah east of the Jordan, as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses summoned all Israel and said: Hear, O Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them and be sure to follow them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

column.name: text
column.value: It was not with our fathers that the LORD made this covenant, but with us, with all of us who are alive here today.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke to you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: (At that time I stood between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and did not go up the mountain.) And he said:

column.name: text
column.value: "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall have no other gods before me.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

column.name: text
column.value: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

column.name: text
column.value: "Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

column.name: text
column.value: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox, your donkey or any of your animals, nor the alien within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest, as you do.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.

column.name: text
column.value: "Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and that it may go well with you in the land the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not murder.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not commit adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not steal.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

column.name: text
column.value: "You shall not covet your neighbor's wife. You shall not set your desire on your neighbor's house or land, his manservant or maidservant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

column.name: text
column.value: These are the commandments the LORD proclaimed in a loud voice to your whole assembly there on the mountain from out of the fire, the cloud and the deep darkness; and he added nothing more. Then he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: When you heard the voice out of the darkness, while the mountain was ablaze with fire, all the leading men of your tribes and your elders came to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And you said, "The LORD our God has shown us his glory and his majesty, and we have heard his voice from the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, why should we die? This great fire will consume us, and we will die if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.

column.name: text
column.value: For what mortal man has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and survived?

column.name: text
column.value: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then tell us whatever the LORD our God tells you. We will listen and obey."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD heard you when you spoke to me and the LORD said to me, "I have heard what this people said to you. Everything they said was good.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that their hearts would be inclined to fear me and keep all my commands always, so that it might go well with them and their children forever!

column.name: text
column.value: "Go, tell them to return to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: But you stay here with me so that I may give you all the commands, decrees and laws you are to teach them to follow in the land I am giving them to possess."

column.name: text
column.value: So be careful to do what the LORD your God has commanded you; do not turn aside to the right or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Walk in all the way that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the commands, decrees and laws the LORD your God directed me to teach you to observe in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you, your children and their children after them may fear the LORD your God as long as you live by keeping all his decrees and commands that I give you, and so that you may enjoy long life.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to obey so that it may go well with you and that you may increase greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, promised you.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is one.

column.name: text
column.value: Love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

column.name: text
column.value: These commandments that I give you today are to be upon your hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

column.name: text
column.value: Tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God brings you into the land he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, to give you--a land with large, flourishing cities you did not build,

column.name: text
column.value: houses filled with all kinds of good things you did not provide, wells you did not dig, and vineyards and olive groves you did not plant--then when you eat and are satisfied,

column.name: text
column.value: be careful that you do not forget the LORD, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear the LORD your God, serve him only and take your oaths in his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you;

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God and his anger will burn against you, and he will destroy you from the face of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not test the LORD your God as you did at Massah.

column.name: text
column.value: Be sure to keep the commands of the LORD your God and the stipulations and decrees he has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do what is right and good in the LORD'S sight, so that it may go well with you and you may go in and take over the good land that the LORD promised on oath to your forefathers,

column.name: text
column.value: thrusting out all your enemies before you, as the LORD said.

column.name: text
column.value: In the future, when your son asks you, "What is the meaning of the stipulations, decrees and laws the LORD our God has commanded you?"

column.name: text
column.value: tell him: "We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Before our eyes the LORD sent miraculous signs and wonders--great and terrible--upon Egypt and Pharaoh and his whole household.

column.name: text
column.value: But he brought us out from there to bring us in and give us the land that he promised on oath to our forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear the LORD our God, so that we might always prosper and be kept alive, as is the case today.

column.name: text
column.value: And if we are careful to obey all this law before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us, that will be our righteousness."

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess and drives out before you many nations--the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you--

column.name: text
column.value: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you and you have defeated them, then you must destroy them totally. Make no treaty with them, and show them no mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,

column.name: text
column.value: for they will turn your sons away from following me to serve other gods, and the LORD'S anger will burn against you and will quickly destroy you.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what you are to do to them: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones, cut down their Asherah poles and burn their idols in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth to be his people, his treasured possession.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD did not set his affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: But it was because the LORD loved you and kept the oath he swore to your forefathers that he brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the land of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commands.

column.name: text
column.value: But those who hate him he will repay to their face by destruction; he will not be slow to repay to their face those who hate him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, take care to follow the commands, decrees and laws I give you today.

column.name: text
column.value: If you pay attention to these laws and are careful to follow them, then the LORD your God will keep his covenant of love with you, as he swore to your forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: He will love you and bless you and increase your numbers. He will bless the fruit of your womb, the crops of your land--your grain, new wine and oil--the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks in the land that he swore to your forefathers to give you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be blessed more than any other people; none of your men or women will be childless, nor any of your livestock without young.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will keep you free from every disease. He will not inflict on you the horrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will inflict them on all who hate you.

column.name: text
column.value: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God gives over to you. Do not look on them with pity and do not serve their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

column.name: text
column.value: You may say to yourselves, "These nations are stronger than we are. How can we drive them out?"

column.name: text
column.value: But do not be afraid of them; remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, the miraculous signs and wonders, the mighty hand and outstretched arm, with which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet among them until even the survivors who hide from you have perished.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God will drive out those nations before you, little by little. You will not be allowed to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals will multiply around you.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD your God will deliver them over to you, throwing them into great confusion until they are destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: He will give their kings into your hand, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand up against you; you will destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: The images of their gods you are to burn in the fire. Do not covet the silver and gold on them, and do not take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it, for it is detestable to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not bring a detestable thing into your house or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. Utterly abhor and detest it, for it is set apart for destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land that the LORD promised on oath to your forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember how the LORD your God led you all the way in the desert these forty years, to humble you and to test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep his commands.

column.name: text
column.value: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your fathers had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Your clothes did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: Know then in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

column.name: text
column.value: Observe the commands of the LORD your God, walking in his ways and revering him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land--a land with streams and pools of water, with springs flowing in the valleys and hills;

column.name: text
column.value: a land with wheat and barley, vines and fig trees, pomegranates, olive oil and honey;

column.name: text
column.value: a land where bread will not be scarce and you will lack nothing; a land where the rocks are iron and you can dig copper out of the hills.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have eaten and are satisfied, praise the LORD your God for the good land he has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful that you do not forget the LORD your God, failing to observe his commands, his laws and his decrees that I am giving you this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses and settle down,

column.name: text
column.value: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all you have is multiplied,

column.name: text
column.value: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

column.name: text
column.value: He led you through the vast and dreadful desert, that thirsty and waterless land, with its venomous snakes and scorpions. He brought you water out of hard rock.

column.name: text
column.value: He gave you manna to eat in the desert, something your fathers had never known, to humble and to test you so that in the end it might go well with you.

column.name: text
column.value: You may say to yourself, "My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me."

column.name: text
column.value: But remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your forefathers, as it is today.

column.name: text
column.value: If you ever forget the LORD your God and follow other gods and worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the nations the LORD destroyed before you, so you will be destroyed for not obeying the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the LORD said to me, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden chest.

column.name: text
column.value: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. Then you are to put them in the chest."

column.name: text
column.value: So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD wrote on these tablets what he had written before, the Ten Commandments he had proclaimed to you on the mountain, out of the fire, on the day of the assembly. And the LORD gave them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I came back down the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made, as the LORD commanded me, and they are there now.

column.name: text
column.value: (The Israelites traveled from the wells of the Jaakanites to Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.

column.name: text
column.value: From there they traveled to Gudgodah and on to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister and to pronounce blessings in his name, as they still do today.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why the Levites have no share or inheritance among their brothers; the LORD is their inheritance, as the LORD your God told them.)

column.name: text
column.value: Now I had stayed on the mountain forty days and nights, as I did the first time, and the LORD listened to me at this time also. It was not his will to destroy you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Go," the LORD said to me, "and lead the people on their way, so that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them."

column.name: text
column.value: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

column.name: text
column.value: and to observe the LORD'S commands and decrees that I am giving you today for your own good?

column.name: text
column.value: To the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the LORD set his affection on your forefathers and loved them, and he chose you, their descendants, above all the nations, as it is today.

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and do not be stiff-necked any longer.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribes.

column.name: text
column.value: He defends the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the alien, giving him food and clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: And you are to love those who are aliens, for you yourselves were aliens in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear the LORD your God and serve him. Hold fast to him and take your oaths in his name.

column.name: text
column.value: He is your praise; he is your God, who performed for you those great and awesome wonders you saw with your own eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Your forefathers who went down into Egypt were seventy in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O Israel. You are now about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities that have walls up to the sky.

column.name: text
column.value: The people are strong and tall--Anakites! You know about them and have heard it said: "Who can stand up against the Anakites?"

column.name: text
column.value: But be assured today that the LORD your God is the one who goes across ahead of you like a devouring fire. He will destroy them; he will subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them quickly, as the LORD has promised you.

column.name: text
column.value: After the LORD your God has driven them out before you, do not say to yourself, "The LORD has brought me here to take possession of this land because of my righteousness." No, it is on account of the wickedness of these nations that the LORD is going to drive them out before you.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not because of your righteousness or your integrity that you are going in to take possession of their land; but on account of the wickedness of these nations, the LORD your God will drive them out before you, to accomplish what he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember this and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God to anger in the desert. From the day you left Egypt until you arrived here, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: At Horeb you aroused the LORD'S wrath so that he was angry enough to destroy you.

column.name: text
column.value: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the LORD had made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD gave me two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God. On them were all the commandments the LORD proclaimed to you on the mountain out of the fire, on the day of the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of the forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.

column.name: text
