column.value: Then the LORD told me, "Go down from here at once, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have become corrupt. They have turned away quickly from what I commanded them and have made a cast idol for themselves."

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, "I have seen this people, and they are a stiff-necked people indeed!

column.name: text
column.value: Let me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. And I will make you into a nation stronger and more numerous than they."

column.name: text
column.value: So I turned and went down from the mountain while it was ablaze with fire. And the two tablets of the covenant were in my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: When I looked, I saw that you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, breaking them to pieces before your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then once again I fell prostrate before the LORD for forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water, because of all the sin you had committed, doing what was evil in the LORD'S sight and so provoking him to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: I feared the anger and wrath of the LORD, for he was angry enough with you to destroy you. But again the LORD listened to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I prayed for Aaron too.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I took that sinful thing of yours, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust and threw the dust into a stream that flowed down the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: You also made the LORD angry at Taberah, at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD sent you out from Kadesh Barnea, he said, "Go up and take possession of the land I have given you." But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God. You did not trust him or obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: You have been rebellious against the LORD ever since I have known you.

column.name: text
column.value: I lay prostrate before the LORD those forty days and forty nights because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

column.name: text
column.value: I prayed to the LORD and said, "O Sovereign LORD, do not destroy your people, your own inheritance that you redeemed by your great power and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people, their wickedness and their sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, the country from which you brought us will say, 'Because the LORD was not able to take them into the land he had promised them, and because he hated them, he brought them out to put them to death in the desert.'

column.name: text
column.value: But they are your people, your inheritance that you brought out by your great power and your outstretched arm."

column.name: text
column.value: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a miraculous sign or wonder,

column.name: text
column.value: and if the sign or wonder of which he has spoken takes place, and he says, "Let us follow other gods" (gods you have not known) "and let us worship them,"

column.name: text
column.value: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The LORD your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: It is the LORD your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.

column.name: text
column.value: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he preached rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery; he has tried to turn you from the way the LORD your God commanded you to follow. You must purge the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: If your very own brother, or your son or daughter, or the wife you love, or your closest friend secretly entices you, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" (gods that neither you nor your fathers have known,

column.name: text
column.value: gods of the peoples around you, whether near or far, from one end of the land to the other),

column.name: text
column.value: do not yield to him or listen to him. Show him no pity. Do not spare him or shield him.

column.name: text
column.value: You must certainly put him to death. Your hand must be the first in putting him to death, and then the hands of all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Stone him to death, because he tried to turn you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.

column.name: text
column.value: If you hear it said about one of the towns the LORD your God is giving you to live in

column.name: text
column.value: that wicked men have arisen among you and have led the people of their town astray, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" (gods you have not known),

column.name: text
column.value: then you must inquire, probe and investigate it thoroughly. And if it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done among you,

column.name: text
column.value: you must certainly put to the sword all who live in that town. Destroy it completely, both its people and its livestock.

column.name: text
column.value: Gather all the plunder of the town into the middle of the public square and completely burn the town and all its plunder as a whole burnt offering to the LORD your God. It is to remain a ruin forever, never to be rebuilt.

column.name: text
column.value: None of those condemned things shall be found in your hands, so that the LORD will turn from his fierce anger; he will show you mercy, have compassion on you, and increase your numbers, as he promised on oath to your forefathers,

column.name: text
column.value: because you obey the LORD your God, keeping all his commands that I am giving you today and doing what is right in his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: You are the children of the LORD your God. Do not cut yourselves or shave the front of your heads for the dead,

column.name: text
column.value: for you are a people holy to the LORD your God. Out of all the peoples on the face of the earth, the LORD has chosen you to be his treasured possession.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not eat any detestable thing.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

column.name: text
column.value: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope and the mountain sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof divided in two and that chews the cud.

column.name: text
column.value: However, of those that chew the cud or that have a split hoof completely divided you may not eat the camel, the rabbit or the coney. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a split hoof; they are ceremonially unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: The pig is also unclean; although it has a split hoof, it does not chew the cud. You are not to eat their meat or touch their carcasses.

column.name: text
column.value: Of all the creatures living in the water, you may eat any that has fins and scales.

column.name: text
column.value: But anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; for you it is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: You may eat any clean bird.

column.name: text
column.value: But these you may not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

column.name: text
column.value: the red kite, the black kite, any kind of falcon,

column.name: text
column.value: any kind of raven,

column.name: text
column.value: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

column.name: text
column.value: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,

column.name: text
column.value: the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant,

column.name: text
column.value: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

column.name: text
column.value: All flying insects that swarm are unclean to you; do not eat them.

column.name: text
column.value: But any winged creature that is clean you may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to an alien living in any of your towns, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner. But you are a people holy to the LORD your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

column.name: text
column.value: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.

column.name: text
column.value: Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the LORD your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the LORD your God always.

column.name: text
column.value: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the LORD your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the LORD will choose to put his Name is so far away),

column.name: text
column.value: then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the LORD your God will choose.

column.name: text
column.value: Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the LORD your God and rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not neglect the Levites living in your towns, for they have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of every three years, bring all the tithes of that year's produce and store it in your towns,

column.name: text
column.value: so that the Levites (who have no allotment or inheritance of their own) and the aliens, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns may come and eat and be satisfied, and so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Love the LORD your God and keep his requirements, his decrees, his laws and his commands always.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember today that your children were not the ones who saw and experienced the discipline of the LORD your God: his majesty, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm;

column.name: text
column.value: the signs he performed and the things he did in the heart of Egypt, both to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his whole country;

column.name: text
column.value: what he did to the Egyptian army, to its horses and chariots, how he overwhelmed them with the waters of the Red Sea as they were pursuing you, and how the LORD brought lasting ruin on them.

column.name: text
column.value: It was not your children who saw what he did for you in the desert until you arrived at this place,

column.name: text
column.value: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab the Reubenite, when the earth opened its mouth right in the middle of all Israel and swallowed them up with their households, their tents and every living thing that belonged to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But it was your own eyes that saw all these great things the LORD has done.

column.name: text
column.value: Observe therefore all the commands I am giving you today, so that you may have the strength to go in and take over the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

column.name: text
column.value: and so that you may live long in the land that the LORD swore to your forefathers to give to them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: The land you are entering to take over is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you planted your seed and irrigated it by foot as in a vegetable garden.

column.name: text
column.value: But the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks rain from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a land the LORD your God cares for; the eyes of the LORD your God are continually on it from the beginning of the year to its end.

column.name: text
column.value: So if you faithfully obey the commands I am giving you today--to love the LORD your God and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul--

column.name: text
column.value: then I will send rain on your land in its season, both autumn and spring rains, so that you may gather in your grain, new wine and oil.

column.name: text
column.value: I will provide grass in the fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful, or you will be enticed to turn away and worship other gods and bow down to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD'S anger will burn against you, and he will shut the heavens so that it will not rain and the ground will yield no produce, and you will soon perish from the good land the LORD is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach them to your children, talking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

column.name: text
column.value: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates,

column.name: text
column.value: so that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land that the LORD swore to give your forefathers, as many as the days that the heavens are above the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: If you carefully observe all these commands I am giving you to follow--to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways and to hold fast to him--

column.name: text
column.value: then the LORD will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and stronger than you.

column.name: text
column.value: Every place where you set your foot will be yours: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the western sea.

column.name: text
column.value: No man will be able to stand against you. The LORD your God, as he promised you, will put the terror and fear of you on the whole land, wherever you go.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse--

column.name: text
column.value: the blessing if you obey the commands of the LORD your God that I am giving you today;

column.name: text
column.value: the curse if you disobey the commands of the LORD your God and turn from the way that I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God has brought you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim on Mount Gerizim the blessings, and on Mount Ebal the curses.

column.name: text
column.value: As you know, these mountains are across the Jordan, west of the road, toward the setting sun, near the great trees of Moreh, in the territory of those Canaanites living in the Arabah in the vicinity of Gilgal.

column.name: text
column.value: You are about to cross the Jordan to enter and take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving you. When you have taken it over and are living there,

column.name: text
column.value: be sure that you obey all the decrees and laws I am setting before you today.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of every seven years you must cancel debts.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how it is to be done: Every creditor shall cancel the loan he has made to his fellow Israelite. He shall not require payment from his fellow Israelite or brother, because the LORD'S time for canceling debts has been proclaimed.

column.name: text
column.value: You may require payment from a foreigner, but you must cancel any debt your brother owes you.

column.name: text
column.value: However, there should be no poor among you, for in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess as your inheritance, he will richly bless you,

column.name: text
column.value: if only you fully obey the LORD your God and are careful to follow all these commands I am giving you today.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations but will borrow from none. You will rule over many nations but none will rule over you.

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a poor man among your brothers in any of the towns of the land that the LORD your God is giving you, do not be hardhearted or tightfisted toward your poor brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Rather be openhanded and freely lend him whatever he needs.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought: "The seventh year, the year for canceling debts, is near," so that you do not show ill will toward your needy brother and give him nothing. He may then appeal to the LORD against you, and you will be found guilty of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Give generously to him and do so without a grudging heart; then because of this the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you put your hand to.

column.name: text
column.value: There will always be poor people in the land. Therefore I command you to be openhanded toward your brothers and toward the poor and needy in your land.

column.name: text
column.value: If a fellow Hebrew, a man or a woman, sells himself to you and serves you six years, in the seventh year you must let him go free.

column.name: text
column.value: And when you release him, do not send him away empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: Supply him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor and your winepress. Give to him as the LORD your God has blessed you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you. That is why I give you this command today.

column.name: text
column.value: But if your servant says to you, "I do not want to leave you," because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,

column.name: text
column.value: then take an awl and push it through his ear lobe into the door, and he will become your servant for life. Do the same for your maidservant.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not consider it a hardship to set your servant free, because his service to you these six years has been worth twice as much as that of a hired hand. And the LORD your God will bless you in everything you do.

column.name: text
column.value: Set apart for the LORD your God every firstborn male of your herds and flocks. Do not put the firstborn of your oxen to work, and do not shear the firstborn of your sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place he will choose.

column.name: text
column.value: If an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to eat it in your own towns. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it, as if it were gazelle or deer.

column.name: text
column.value: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

column.name: text
column.value: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover of the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib he brought you out of Egypt by night.

column.name: text
column.value: Sacrifice as the Passover to the LORD your God an animal from your flock or herd at the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for his Name.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not eat it with bread made with yeast, but for seven days eat unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left Egypt in haste--so that all the days of your life you may remember the time of your departure from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no yeast be found in your possession in all your land for seven days. Do not let any of the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain until morning.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not sacrifice the Passover in any town the LORD your God gives you

column.name: text
column.value: except in the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name. There you must sacrifice the Passover in the evening, when the sun goes down, on the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Roast it and eat it at the place the LORD your God will choose. Then in the morning return to your tents.

column.name: text
column.value: For six days eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day hold an assembly to the LORD your God and do no work.

column.name: text
column.value: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God by giving a freewill offering in proportion to the blessings the LORD your God has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: And rejoice before the LORD your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name--you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, the Levites in your towns, and the aliens, the fatherless and the widows living among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and follow carefully these decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.

column.name: text
column.value: Be joyful at your Feast--you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites, the aliens, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days celebrate the Feast to the LORD your God at the place the LORD will choose. For the LORD your God will bless you in all your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and your joy will be complete.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times a year all your men must appear before the LORD your God at the place he will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles. No man should appear before the LORD empty-handed:

column.name: text
column.value: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the LORD your God has blessed you.

column.name: text
column.value: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every town the LORD your God is giving you, and they shall judge the people fairly.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Follow justice and justice alone, so that you may live and possess the land the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build to the LORD your God,

column.name: text
column.value: and do not erect a sacred stone, for these the LORD your God hates.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep that has any defect or flaw in it, for that would be detestable to him.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man or woman living among you in one of the towns the LORD gives you is found doing evil in the eyes of the LORD your God in violation of his covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: and contrary to my command has worshiped other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or the moon or the stars of the sky,

column.name: text
column.value: and this has been brought to your attention, then you must investigate it thoroughly. If it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done in Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: take the man or woman who has done this evil deed to your city gate and stone that person to death.

column.name: text
column.value: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but no one shall be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

column.name: text
column.value: The hands of the witnesses must be the first in putting him to death, and then the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: If cases come before your courts that are too difficult for you to judge--whether bloodshed, lawsuits or assaults--take them to the place the LORD your God will choose.

column.name: text
column.value: Go to the priests, who are Levites, and to the judge who is in office at that time. Inquire of them and they will give you the verdict.

column.name: text
column.value: You must act according to the decisions they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they direct you to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Act according to the law they teach you and the decisions they give you. Do not turn aside from what they tell you, to the right or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who shows contempt for the judge or for the priest who stands ministering there to the LORD your God must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not be contemptuous again.

column.name: text
column.value: When you enter the land the LORD your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, "Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,"

column.name: text
column.value: be sure to appoint over you the king the LORD your God chooses. He must be from among your own brothers. Do not place a foreigner over you, one who is not a brother Israelite.

column.name: text
column.value: The king, moreover, must not acquire great numbers of horses for himself or make the people return to Egypt to get more of them, for the LORD has told you, "You are not to go back that way again."

column.name: text
column.value: He must not take many wives, or his heart will be led astray. He must not accumulate large amounts of silver and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: When he takes the throne of his kingdom, he is to write for himself on a scroll a copy of this law, taken from that of the priests, who are Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the LORD his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees

column.name: text
column.value: and not consider himself better than his brothers and turn from the law to the right or to the left. Then he and his descendants will reign a long time over his kingdom in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the decrees and laws you must be careful to follow in the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess--as long as you live in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Destroy completely all the places on the high mountains and on the hills and under every spreading tree where the nations you are dispossessing worship their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and burn their Asherah poles in the fire; cut down the idols of their gods and wipe out their names from those places.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not worship the LORD your God in their way.

column.name: text
column.value: But you are to seek the place the LORD your God will choose from among all your tribes to put his Name there for his dwelling. To that place you must go;

column.name: text
column.value: there bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, what you have vowed to give and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: There, in the presence of the LORD your God, you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice in everything you have put your hand to, because the LORD your God has blessed you.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not to do as we do here today, everyone as he sees fit,

column.name: text
column.value: since you have not yet reached the resting place and the inheritance the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around you so that you will live in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: Then to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name--there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice possessions you have vowed to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And there rejoice before the LORD your God, you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites from your towns, who have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings anywhere you please.

column.name: text
column.value: Offer them only at the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribes, and there observe everything I command you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, you may slaughter your animals in any of your towns and eat as much of the meat as you want, as if it were gazelle or deer, according to the blessing the LORD your God gives you. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, you are to eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place the LORD your God will choose--you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites from your towns--and you are to rejoice before the LORD your God in everything you put your hand to.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, "I would like some meat," then you may eat as much of it as you want.

column.name: text
column.value: If the place where the LORD your God chooses to put his Name is too far away from you, you may slaughter animals from the herds and flocks the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you, and in your own towns you may eat as much of them as you want.

column.name: text
column.value: Eat them as you would gazelle or deer. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But take your consecrated things and whatever you have vowed to give, and go to the place the LORD will choose.

column.name: text
column.value: Present your burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD your God, both the meat and the blood. The blood of your sacrifices must be poured beside the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat the meat.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful to obey all these regulations I am giving you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God will cut off before you the nations you are about to invade and dispossess. But when you have driven them out and settled in their land,

column.name: text
column.value: and after they have been destroyed before you, be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, "How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same."

column.name: text
column.value: You must not worship the LORD your God in their way, because in worshiping their gods, they do all kinds of detestable things the LORD hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: See that you do all I command you; do not add to it or take away from it.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests, who are Levites--indeed the whole tribe of Levi--are to have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall live on the offerings made to the LORD by fire, for that is their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers; the LORD is their inheritance, as he promised them.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the jowls and the inner parts.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the LORD'S name always.

column.name: text
column.value: If a Levite moves from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he is living, and comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose,

column.name: text
column.value: he may minister in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to share equally in their benefits, even though he has received money from the sale of family possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: When you enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, do not learn to imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft,

column.name: text
column.value: or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the LORD, and because of these detestable practices the LORD your God will drive out those nations before you.

column.name: text
column.value: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations you will dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery or divination. But as for you, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own brothers. You must listen to him.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said, "Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God nor see this great fire anymore, or we will die."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me: "What they say is good.

column.name: text
column.value: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers; I will put my words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name, I myself will call him to account.

column.name: text
column.value: But a prophet who presumes to speak in my name anything I have not commanded him to say, or a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, must be put to death."

column.name: text
column.value: You may say to yourselves, "How can we know when a message has not been spoken by the LORD?"

column.name: text
column.value: If what a prophet proclaims in the name of the LORD does not take place or come true, that is a message the LORD has not spoken. That prophet has spoken presumptuously. Do not be afraid of him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God has destroyed the nations whose land he is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,

column.name: text
column.value: then set aside for yourselves three cities centrally located in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

column.name: text
column.value: Build roads to them and divide into three parts the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that anyone who kills a man may flee there.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the rule concerning the man who kills another and flees there to save his life--one who kills his neighbor unintentionally, without malice aforethought.

column.name: text
column.value: For instance, a man may go into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as he swings his ax to fell a tree, the head may fly off and hit his neighbor and kill him. That man may flee to one of these cities and save his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in a rage, overtake him if the distance is too great, and kill him even though he is not deserving of death, since he did it to his neighbor without malice aforethought.

column.name: text
column.value: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities.

column.name: text
column.value: If the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as he promised on oath to your forefathers, and gives you the whole land he promised them,

column.name: text
column.value: because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today--to love the LORD your God and to walk always in his ways--then you are to set aside three more cities.

column.name: text
column.value: Do this so that innocent blood will not be shed in your land, which the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance, and so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him, assaults and kills him, and then flees to one of these cities,

column.name: text
column.value: the elders of his town shall send for him, bring him back from the city, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to die.

column.name: text
column.value: Show him no pity. You must purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, so that it may go well with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not move your neighbor's boundary stone set up by your predecessors in the inheritance you receive in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

column.name: text
column.value: One witness is not enough to convict a man accused of any crime or offense he may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: If a malicious witness takes the stand to accuse a man of a crime,

column.name: text
column.value: the two men involved in the dispute must stand in the presence of the LORD before the priests and the judges who are in office at the time.

column.name: text
column.value: The judges must make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a liar, giving false testimony against his brother,

column.name: text
column.value: then do to him as he intended to do to his brother. You must purge the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the people will hear of this and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

column.name: text
column.value: When you go to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots and an army greater than yours, do not be afraid of them, because the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt, will be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are about to go into battle, the priest shall come forward and address the army.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall say: "Hear, O Israel, today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not be terrified or give way to panic before them.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory."

column.name: text
column.value: The officers shall say to the army: "Has anyone built a new house and not dedicated it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else may dedicate it.

column.name: text
column.value: Has anyone planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else enjoy it.

column.name: text
column.value: Has anyone become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else marry her."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officers shall add, "Is any man afraid or fainthearted? Let him go home so that his brothers will not become disheartened too."

column.name: text
column.value: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they shall appoint commanders over it.

column.name: text
column.value: When you march up to attack a city, make its people an offer of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: If they accept and open their gates, all the people in it shall be subject to forced labor and shall work for you.

column.name: text
column.value: If they refuse to make peace and they engage you in battle, lay siege to that city.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, put to the sword all the men in it.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the women, the children, the livestock and everything else in the city, you may take these as plunder for yourselves. And you may use the plunder the LORD your God gives you from your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are at a distance from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.

column.name: text
column.value: However, in the cities of the nations the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, do not leave alive anything that breathes.

column.name: text
column.value: Completely destroy them--the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites--as the LORD your God has commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the detestable things they do in worshiping their gods, and you will sin against the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: When you lay siege to a city for a long time, fighting against it to capture it, do not destroy its trees by putting an ax to them, because you can eat their fruit. Do not cut them down. Are the trees of the field people, that you should besiege them?

column.name: text
column.value: However, you may cut down trees that you know are not fruit trees and use them to build siege works until the city at war with you falls.

column.name: text
column.value: If you see your brother's ox or sheep straying, do not ignore it but be sure to take it back to him.

column.name: text
column.value: If the brother does not live near you or if you do not know who he is, take it home with you and keep it until he comes looking for it. Then give it back to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Do the same if you find your brother's donkey or his cloak or anything he loses. Do not ignore it.

column.name: text
column.value: If you see your brother's donkey or his ox fallen on the road, do not ignore it. Help him get it to its feet.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman must not wear men's clothing, nor a man wear women's clothing, for the LORD your God detests anyone who does this.

column.name: text
column.value: If you come across a bird's nest beside the road, either in a tree or on the ground, and the mother is sitting on the young or on the eggs, do not take the mother with the young.

column.name: text
column.value: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may go well with you and you may have a long life.

column.name: text
column.value: When you build a new house, make a parapet around your roof so that you may not bring the guilt of bloodshed on your house if someone falls from the roof.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not plant two kinds of seed in your vineyard; if you do, not only the crops you plant but also the fruit of the vineyard will be defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

column.name: text
column.value: Make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man takes a wife and, after lying with her, dislikes her

column.name: text
column.value: and slanders her and gives her a bad name, saying, "I married this woman, but when I approached her, I did not find proof of her virginity,"

column.name: text
column.value: then the girl's father and mother shall bring proof that she was a virgin to the town elders at the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: The girl's father will say to the elders, "I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he dislikes her.

column.name: text
column.value: Now he has slandered her and said, 'I did not find your daughter to be a virgin.' But here is the proof of my daughter's virginity." Then her parents shall display the cloth before the elders of the town,

column.name: text
column.value: and the elders shall take the man and punish him.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the girl's father, because this man has given an Israelite virgin a bad name. She shall continue to be his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, the charge is true and no proof of the girl's virginity can be found,

column.name: text
column.value: she shall be brought to the door of her father's house and there the men of her town shall stone her to death. She has done a disgraceful thing in Israel by being promiscuous while still in her father's house. You must purge the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man is found sleeping with another man's wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man happens to meet in a town a virgin pledged to be married and he sleeps with her,

column.name: text
column.value: you shall take both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death--the girl because she was in a town and did not scream for help, and the man because he violated another man's wife. You must purge the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: But if out in the country a man happens to meet a girl pledged to be married and rapes her, only the man who has done this shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: Do nothing to the girl; she has committed no sin deserving death. This case is like that of someone who attacks and murders his neighbor,

column.name: text
column.value: for the man found the girl out in the country, and though the betrothed girl screamed, there was no one to rescue her.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man happens to meet a virgin who is not pledged to be married and rapes her and they are discovered,

column.name: text
column.value: he shall pay the girl's father fifty shekels of silver. He must marry the girl, for he has violated her. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.

column.name: text
column.value: A man is not to marry his father's wife; he must not dishonor his father's bed.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man is found slain, lying in a field in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who killed him,

column.name: text
column.value: your elders and judges shall go out and measure the distance from the body to the neighboring towns.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke

column.name: text
column.value: and lead her down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and where there is a flowing stream. There in the valley they are to break the heifer's neck.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests, the sons of Levi, shall step forward, for the LORD your God has chosen them to minister and to pronounce blessings in the name of the LORD and to decide all cases of dispute and assault.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the elders of the town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,

column.name: text
column.value: and they shall declare: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it done.

column.name: text
column.value: Accept this atonement for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, O LORD, and do not hold your people guilty of the blood of an innocent man." And the bloodshed will be atoned for.

column.name: text
column.value: So you will purge from yourselves the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hands and you take captives,

column.name: text
column.value: if you notice among the captives a beautiful woman and are attracted to her, you may take her as your wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring her into your home and have her shave her head, trim her nails

column.name: text
column.value: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.

column.name: text
column.value: If you are not pleased with her, let her go wherever she wishes. You must not sell her or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man has two wives, and he loves one but not the other, and both bear him sons but the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love,

column.name: text
column.value: when he wills his property to his sons, he must not give the rights of the firstborn to the son of the wife he loves in preference to his actual firstborn, the son of the wife he does not love.

column.name: text
column.value: He must acknowledge the son of his unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double share of all he has. That son is the first sign of his father's strength. The right of the firstborn belongs to him.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,

column.name: text
column.value: his father and mother shall take hold of him and bring him to the elders at the gate of his town.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall say to the elders, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a profligate and a drunkard."

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the men of his town shall stone him to death. You must purge the evil from among you. All Israel will hear of it and be afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man guilty of a capital offense is put to death and his body is hung on a tree,

column.name: text
column.value: you must not leave his body on the tree overnight. Be sure to bury him that same day, because anyone who is hung on a tree is under God's curse. You must not desecrate the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: No one who has been emasculated by crushing or cutting may enter the assembly of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: No one born of a forbidden marriage nor any of his descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, even down to the tenth generation.

column.name: text
column.value: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of his descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, even down to the tenth generation.

column.name: text
column.value: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.

column.name: text
column.value: However, the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them as long as you live.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. Do not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as an alien in his country.

column.name: text
column.value: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are encamped against your enemies, keep away from everything impure.

column.name: text
column.value: If one of your men is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.

column.name: text
column.value: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you.

column.name: text
column.value: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand him over to his master.

column.name: text
column.value: Let him live among you wherever he likes and in whatever town he chooses. Do not oppress him.

column.name: text
column.value: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.

column.name: text
column.value: You must not bring the earnings of a female prostitute or of a male prostitute into the house of the LORD your God to pay any vow, because the LORD your God detests them both.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not charge your brother interest, whether on money or food or anything else that may earn interest.

column.name: text
column.value: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a brother Israelite, so that the LORD your God may bless you in everything you put your hand to in the land you are entering to possess.

column.name: text
column.value: If you make a vow to the LORD your God, do not be slow to pay it, for the LORD your God will certainly demand it of you and you will be guilty of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever your lips utter you must be sure to do, because you made your vow freely to the LORD your God with your own mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: If you enter your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat all the grapes you want, but do not put any in your basket.

column.name: text
column.value: If you enter your neighbor's grainfield, you may pick kernels with your hands, but you must not put a sickle to his standing grain.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house,

column.name: text
column.value: and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man,

column.name: text
column.value: and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies,

column.name: text
column.value: then her first husband, who divorced her, is not allowed to marry her again after she has been defiled. That would be detestable in the eyes of the LORD. Do not bring sin upon the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man has recently married, he must not be sent to war or have any other duty laid on him. For one year he is to be free to stay at home and bring happiness to the wife he has married.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take a pair of millstones--not even the upper one--as security for a debt, because that would be taking a man's livelihood as security.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his brother Israelites and treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. You must purge the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: In cases of leprous diseases be very careful to do exactly as the priests, who are Levites, instruct you. You must follow carefully what I have commanded them.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam along the way after you came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: When you make a loan of any kind to your neighbor, do not go into his house to get what he is offering as a pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Stay outside and let the man to whom you are making the loan bring the pledge out to you.

column.name: text
column.value: If the man is poor, do not go to sleep with his pledge in your possession.

column.name: text
column.value: Return his cloak to him by sunset so that he may sleep in it. Then he will thank you, and it will be regarded as a righteous act in the sight of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take advantage of a hired man who is poor and needy, whether he is a brother Israelite or an alien living in one of your towns.

column.name: text
column.value: Pay him his wages each day before sunset, because he is poor and is counting on it. Otherwise he may cry to the LORD against you, and you will be guilty of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not deprive the alien or the fatherless of justice, or take the cloak of the widow as a pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you from there. That is why I command you to do this.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are harvesting in your field and you overlook a sheaf, do not go back to get it. Leave it for the alien, the fatherless and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: When you beat the olives from your trees, do not go over the branches a second time. Leave what remains for the alien, the fatherless and the widow.

column.name: text
column.value: When you harvest the grapes in your vineyard, do not go over the vines again. Leave what remains for the alien, the fatherless and the widow.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.

column.name: text
column.value: When men have a dispute, they are to take it to court and the judges will decide the case, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: If the guilty man deserves to be beaten, the judge shall make him lie down and have him flogged in his presence with the number of lashes his crime deserves,

column.name: text
column.value: but he must not give him more than forty lashes. If he is flogged more than that, your brother will be degraded in your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.

column.name: text
column.value: If brothers are living together and one of them dies without a son, his widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband's brother shall take her and marry her and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to her.

column.name: text
column.value: The first son she bears shall carry on the name of the dead brother so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if a man does not want to marry his brother's wife, she shall go to the elders at the town gate and say, "My husband's brother refuses to carry on his brother's name in Israel. He will not fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to me."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and talk to him. If he persists in saying, "I do not want to marry her,"

column.name: text
column.value: his brother's widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, take off one of his sandals, spit in his face and say, "This is what is done to the man who will not build up his brother's family line."

column.name: text
column.value: That man's line shall be known in Israel as The Family of the Unsandaled.

column.name: text
column.value: If two men are fighting and the wife of one of them comes to rescue her husband from his assailant, and she reaches out and seizes him by his private parts,

column.name: text
column.value: you shall cut off her hand. Show her no pity.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not have two differing weights in your bag--one heavy, one light.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not have two differing measures in your house--one large, one small.

column.name: text
column.value: You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God detests anyone who does these things, anyone who deals dishonestly.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along the way when you came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: When you were weary and worn out, they met you on your journey and cut off all who were lagging behind; they had no fear of God.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God gives you rest from all the enemies around you in the land he is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!

column.name: text
column.value: When you have entered the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance and have taken possession of it and settled in it,

column.name: text
column.value: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name

column.name: text
column.value: and say to the priest in office at the time, "I declare today to the LORD your God that I have come to the land the LORD swore to our forefathers to give us."

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall declare before the LORD your God: "My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down into Egypt with a few people and lived there and became a great nation, powerful and numerous.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, putting us to hard labor.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we cried out to the LORD, the God of our fathers, and the LORD heard our voice and saw our misery, toil and oppression.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror and with miraculous signs and wonders.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey;

column.name: text
column.value: and now I bring the firstfruits of the soil that you, O LORD, have given me." Place the basket before the LORD your God and bow down before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And you and the Levites and the aliens among you shall rejoice in all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your household.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have finished setting aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you shall give it to the Levite, the alien, the fatherless and the widow, so that they may eat in your towns and be satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: Then say to the LORD your God: "I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the alien, the fatherless and the widow, according to all you commanded. I have not turned aside from your commands nor have I forgotten any of them.

column.name: text
column.value: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while I was in mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor have I offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God; I have done everything you commanded me.

column.name: text
column.value: Look down from heaven, your holy dwelling place, and bless your people Israel and the land you have given us as you promised on oath to our forefathers, a land flowing with milk and honey."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these decrees and laws; carefully observe them with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: You have declared this day that the LORD is your God and that you will walk in his ways, that you will keep his decrees, commands and laws, and that you will obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD has declared this day that you are his people, his treasured possession as he promised, and that you are to keep all his commands.

column.name: text
column.value: He has declared that he will set you in praise, fame and honor high above all the nations he has made and that you will be a people holy to the LORD your God, as he promised.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: "Keep all these commands that I give you today.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have crossed the Jordan into the land the LORD your God is giving you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.

column.name: text
column.value: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, promised you.

column.name: text
column.value: And when you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.

column.name: text
column.value: Build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. Do not use any iron tool upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Build the altar of the LORD your God with fieldstones and offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Sacrifice fellowship offerings there, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall write very clearly all the words of this law on these stones you have set up."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses and the priests, who are Levites, said to all Israel, "Be silent, O Israel, and listen! You have now become the people of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Obey the LORD your God and follow his commands and decrees that I give you today."

column.name: text
column.value: On the same day Moses commanded the people:

column.name: text
column.value: When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites shall recite to all the people of Israel in a loud voice:

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who carves an image or casts an idol--a thing detestable to the LORD, the work of the craftsman's hands--and sets it up in secret." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who dishonors his father or his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who moves his neighbor's boundary stone." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who leads the blind astray on the road." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who withholds justice from the alien, the fatherless or the widow." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his father's wife, for he dishonors his father's bed." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who has sexual relations with any animal." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his mother-in-law." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who kills his neighbor secretly." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Cursed is the man who does not uphold the words of this law by carrying them out." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

column.name: text
column.value: These are the terms of the covenant the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials and to all his land.

column.name: text
column.value: With your own eyes you saw those great trials, those miraculous signs and great wonders.

column.name: text
column.value: But to this day the LORD has not given you a mind that understands or eyes that see or ears that hear.

column.name: text
column.value: During the forty years that I led you through the desert, your clothes did not wear out, nor did the sandals on your feet.

column.name: text
column.value: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other fermented drink. I did this so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.

column.name: text
column.value: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: Carefully follow the terms of this covenant, so that you may prosper in everything you do.

column.name: text
column.value: All of you are standing today in the presence of the LORD your God--your leaders and chief men, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: together with your children and your wives, and the aliens living in your camps who chop your wood and carry your water.

column.name: text
column.value: You are standing here in order to enter into a covenant with the LORD your God, a covenant the LORD is making with you this day and sealing with an oath,

column.name: text
column.value: to confirm you this day as his people, that he may be your God as he promised you and as he swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: I am making this covenant, with its oath, not only with you

column.name: text
column.value: who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God but also with those who are not here today.

column.name: text
column.value: You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the countries on the way here.

column.name: text
column.value: You saw among them their detestable images and idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations; make sure there is no root among you that produces such bitter poison.

column.name: text
column.value: When such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself and therefore thinks, "I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way." This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will never be willing to forgive him; his wrath and zeal will burn against that man. All the curses written in this book will fall upon him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will single him out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: Your children who follow you in later generations and foreigners who come from distant lands will see the calamities that have fallen on the land and the diseases with which the LORD has afflicted it.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole land will be a burning waste of salt and sulfur--nothing planted, nothing sprouting, no vegetation growing on it. It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations will ask: "Why has the LORD done this to this land? Why this fierce, burning anger?"

column.name: text
column.value: And the answer will be: "It is because this people abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: They went off and worshiped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods he had not given them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD'S anger burned against this land, so that he brought on it all the curses written in this book.

column.name: text
column.value: In furious anger and in great wrath the LORD uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now."

column.name: text
column.value: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law.

column.name: text
column.value: When all these blessings and curses I have set before you come upon you and you take them to heart wherever the LORD your God disperses you among the nations,

column.name: text
column.value: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey him with all your heart and with all your soul according to everything I command you today,

column.name: text
column.value: then the LORD your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.

column.name: text
column.value: Even if you have been banished to the most distant land under the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you and bring you back.

column.name: text
column.value: He will bring you to the land that belonged to your fathers, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him with all your heart and with all your soul, and live.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies who hate and persecute you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will again obey the LORD and follow all his commands I am giving you today.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD your God will make you most prosperous in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your land. The LORD will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: if you obey the LORD your God and keep his commands and decrees that are written in this Book of the Law and turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Now what I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, "Who will ascend into heaven to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"

column.name: text
column.value: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, "Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"

column.name: text
column.value: No, the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart so you may obey it.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the LORD your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess.

column.name: text
column.value: But if your heart turns away and you are not obedient, and if you are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,

column.name: text
column.value: I declare to you this day that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.

column.name: text
column.value: This day I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live

column.name: text
column.value: and that you may love the LORD your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the LORD is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: If you fully obey the LORD your God and carefully follow all his commands I give you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations on earth.

column.name: text
column.value: All these blessings will come upon you and accompany you if you obey the LORD your God:

column.name: text
column.value: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

column.name: text
