column.value: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also gave that city and its king into Israel's hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD handed Lachish over to Israel, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile, Horam king of Gezer had come up to help Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army--until no survivors were left.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.

column.name: text
column.value: They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

column.name: text
column.value: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.

column.name: text
column.value: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.

column.name: text
column.value: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:

column.name: text
column.value: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge--from the middle of the gorge--to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

column.name: text
column.value: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maacah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the LORD gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (their lands Joshua gave as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions--

column.name: text
column.value: the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the desert and the Negev--the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites):

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Jericho one the king of Ai (near Bethel) one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Jerusalem one the king of Hebron one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Jarmuth one the king of Lachish one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Eglon one the king of Gezer one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Debir one the king of Geder one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Hormah one the king of Arad one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Libnah one the king of Adullam one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Makkedah one the king of Bethel one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Tappuah one the king of Hepher one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Aphek one the king of Lasharon one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Madon one the king of Hazor one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Shimron Meron one the king of Acshaph one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Taanach one the king of Megiddo one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Kedesh one the king of Jokneam in Carmel one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Dor (in Naphoth Dor) one the king of Goyim in Gilgal one

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Tirzah one thirty-one kings in all.

column.name: text
column.value: When Joshua was old and well advanced in years, the LORD said to him, "You are very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the land that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites:

column.name: text
column.value: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite (the territory of the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron--that of the Avvites);

column.name: text
column.value: from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek, the region of the Amorites,

column.name: text
column.value: the area of the Gebalites; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

column.name: text
column.value: "As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,

column.name: text
column.value: and divide it as an inheritance among the nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh."

column.name: text
column.value: The other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had received the inheritance that Moses had given them east of the Jordan, as he, the servant of the LORD, had assigned it to them.

column.name: text
column.value: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,

column.name: text
column.value: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.

column.name: text
column.value: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maacah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salecah--

column.name: text
column.value: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had survived as one of the last of the Rephaites. Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maacah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the offerings made by fire to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, clan by clan:

column.name: text
column.value: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba

column.name: text
column.value: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

column.name: text
column.value: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

column.name: text
column.value: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth

column.name: text
column.value: --all the towns on the plateau and the entire realm of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled at Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the Midianite chiefs, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba--princes allied with Sihon--who lived in that country.

column.name: text
column.value: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, clan by clan:

column.name: text
column.value: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;

column.name: text
column.value: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;

column.name: text
column.value: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Kinnereth).

column.name: text
column.value: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, clan by clan:

column.name: text
column.value: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan--all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,

column.name: text
column.value: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh--for half of the sons of Makir, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the areas the Israelites received as an inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel allotted to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,

column.name: text
column.value: for the sons of Joseph had become two tribes--Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the men of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea about you and me.

column.name: text
column.value: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,

column.name: text
column.value: but my brothers who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear. I, however, followed the LORD my God wholeheartedly.

column.name: text
column.value: So on that day Moses swore to me, 'The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the LORD my God wholeheartedly.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Now then, just as the LORD promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the desert. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!

column.name: text
column.value: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I'm just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.

column.name: text
column.value: Now give me this hill country that the LORD promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the LORD helping me, I will drive them out just as he said."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.

column.name: text
column.value: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.

column.name: text
column.value: The allotment for the tribe of Judah, clan by clan, extended down to the territory of Edom, to the Desert of Zin in the extreme south.

column.name: text
column.value: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Salt Sea,

column.name: text
column.value: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.

column.name: text
column.value: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the sea. This is their southern boundary.

column.name: text
column.value: The eastern boundary is the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,

column.name: text
column.value: went up to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).

column.name: text
column.value: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.

column.name: text
column.value: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: The western boundary is the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the people of Judah by their clans.

column.name: text
column.value: In accordance with the LORD'S command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah--Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

column.name: text
column.value: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites--Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai--descendants of Anak.

column.name: text
column.value: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."

column.name: text
column.value: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.

column.name: text
column.value: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

column.name: text
column.value: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, clan by clan:

column.name: text
column.value: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

column.name: text
column.value: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

column.name: text
column.value: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that is, Hazor),

column.name: text
column.value: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

column.name: text
column.value: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

column.name: text
column.value: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain and Rimmon--a total of twenty-nine towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: In the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

column.name: text
column.value: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

column.name: text
column.value: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

column.name: text
column.value: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim)--fourteen towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

column.name: text
column.value: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

column.name: text
column.value: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

column.name: text
column.value: Cabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,

column.name: text
column.value: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah and Makkedah--sixteen towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

column.name: text
column.value: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

column.name: text
column.value: Keilah, Aczib and Mareshah--nine towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Ekron, with its surrounding settlements and villages;

column.name: text
column.value: west of Ekron, all that were in the vicinity of Ashdod, together with their villages;

column.name: text
column.value: Ashdod, its surrounding settlements and villages; and Gaza, its settlements and villages, as far as the Wadi of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.

column.name: text
column.value: In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

column.name: text
column.value: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (that is, Debir),

column.name: text
column.value: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

column.name: text
column.value: Goshen, Holon and Giloh--eleven towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

column.name: text
column.value: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

column.name: text
column.value: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) and Zior--nine towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,

column.name: text
column.value: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

column.name: text
column.value: Kain, Gibeah and Timnah--ten towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

column.name: text
column.value: Maarath, Beth Anoth and Eltekon--six towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah--two towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: In the desert: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

column.name: text
column.value: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi--six towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: The allotment for Joseph began at the Jordan of Jericho, east of the waters of Jericho, and went up from there through the desert into the hill country of Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,

column.name: text
column.value: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the territory of Ephraim, clan by clan: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon

column.name: text
column.value: and continued to the sea. From Micmethath on the north it curved eastward to Taanath Shiloh, passing by it to Janoah on the east.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.

column.name: text
column.value: They did not dislodge the Canaanites living in Gezer; to this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim but are required to do forced labor.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph's firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh's firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.

column.name: text
column.value: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh--the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons but only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, "The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the LORD'S command.

column.name: text
column.value: Manasseh's share consisted of ten tracts of land besides Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan,

column.name: text
column.value: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Micmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.

column.name: text
column.value: (Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah itself, on the boundary of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.

column.name: text
column.value: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth).

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.

column.name: text
column.value: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, "Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people and the LORD has blessed us abundantly."

column.name: text
column.value: "If you are so numerous," Joshua answered, "and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites."

column.name: text
column.value: The people of Joseph replied, "The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites who live in the plain have iron chariots, both those in Beth Shan and its settlements and those in the Valley of Jezreel."

column.name: text
column.value: But Joshua said to the house of Joseph--to Ephraim and Manasseh--"You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment

column.name: text
column.value: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have iron chariots and though they are strong, you can drive them out."

column.name: text
column.value: The whole assembly of the Israelites gathered at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The country was brought under their control,

column.name: text
column.value: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua said to the Israelites: "How long will you wait before you begin to take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

column.name: text
column.value: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the house of Joseph in its territory on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the LORD is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it to them."

column.name: text
column.value: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, "Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD, and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.

column.name: text
column.value: The lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:

column.name: text
column.value: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the desert of Beth Aven.

column.name: text
column.value: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.

column.name: text
column.value: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.

column.name: text
column.value: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel.

column.name: text
column.value: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

column.name: text
column.value: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.

column.name: text
column.value: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: The tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan, had the following cities: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

column.name: text
column.value: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

column.name: text
column.value: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni and Geba--twelve towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

column.name: text
column.value: Mizpah, Kephirah, Mozah,

column.name: text
column.value: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

column.name: text
column.value: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath--fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.

column.name: text
column.value: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon, clan by clan. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

column.name: text
column.value: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen--thirteen towns and their villages;

column.name: text
column.value: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan--four towns and their villages--

column.name: text
column.value: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah's portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: The third lot came up for Zebulun, clan by clan: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.

column.name: text
column.value: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.

column.name: text
column.value: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.

column.name: text
column.value: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.

column.name: text
column.value: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,

column.name: text
column.value: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

column.name: text
column.value: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

column.name: text
column.value: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph,

column.name: text
column.value: Allammelech, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.

column.name: text
column.value: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.

column.name: text
column.value: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the sea in the region of Aczib,

column.name: text
column.value: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali, clan by clan:

column.name: text
column.value: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east.

column.name: text
column.value: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,

column.name: text
column.value: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

column.name: text
column.value: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath and Beth Shemesh. There were nineteen towns and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: The territory of their inheritance included: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,

column.name: text
column.value: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

column.name: text
column.value: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

column.name: text
column.value: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

column.name: text
column.value: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

column.name: text
column.value: Me Jarkon and Rakkon, with the area facing Joppa.

column.name: text
column.value: (But the Danites had difficulty taking possession of their territory, so they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their forefather.)

column.name: text
column.value: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, clan by clan.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had finished dividing the land into its allotted portions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,

column.name: text
column.value: as the LORD had commanded. They gave him the town he asked for--Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he built up the town and settled there.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh in the presence of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. And so they finished dividing the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Joshua:

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: so that anyone who kills a person accidentally and unintentionally may flee there and find protection from the avenger of blood.

column.name: text
column.value: "When he flees to one of these cities, he is to stand in the entrance of the city gate and state his case before the elders of that city. Then they are to admit him into their city and give him a place to live with them.

column.name: text
column.value: If the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the one accused, because he killed his neighbor unintentionally and without malice aforethought.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to stay in that city until he has stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then he may go back to his own home in the town from which he fled."

column.name: text
column.value: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: On the east side of the Jordan of Jericho they designated Bezer in the desert on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: Any of the Israelites or any alien living among them who killed someone accidentally could flee to these designated cities and not be killed by the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribal families of Israel

column.name: text
column.value: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, "The LORD commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock."

column.name: text
column.value: So, as the LORD had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance:

column.name: text
column.value: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, clan by clan. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of Kohath's descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these towns and their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they allotted the following towns by name

column.name: text
column.value: (these towns were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them):

column.name: text
column.value: They gave them Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pastureland, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

column.name: text
column.value: But the fields and villages around the city they had given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Libnah,

column.name: text
column.value: Jattir, Eshtemoa,

column.name: text
column.value: Holon, Debir,

column.name: text
column.value: Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands--nine towns from these two tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,

column.name: text
column.value: Anathoth and Almon, together with their pasturelands--four towns.

column.name: text
column.value: All the towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim:

column.name: text
column.value: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer,

column.name: text
column.value: Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands--four towns.

column.name: text
column.value: Also from the tribe of Dan they received Eltekeh, Gibbethon,

column.name: text
column.value: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands--four towns.

column.name: text
column.value: From half the tribe of Manasseh they received Taanach and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands--two towns.

column.name: text
column.value: All these ten towns and their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Be Eshtarah, together with their pasturelands--two towns;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion, Daberath,

column.name: text
column.value: Jarmuth and En Gannim, together with their pasturelands--four towns;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Asher, Mishal, Abdon,

column.name: text
column.value: Helkath and Rehob, together with their pasturelands--four towns;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Hammoth Dor and Kartan, together with their pasturelands--three towns.

column.name: text
column.value: All the towns of the Gershonite clans were thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

column.name: text
column.value: The Merarite clans (the rest of the Levites) were given: from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam, Kartah,

column.name: text
column.value: Dimnah and Nahalal, together with their pasturelands--four towns;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer, Jahaz,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands--four towns;

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Mahanaim,

column.name: text
column.value: Heshbon and Jazer, together with their pasturelands--four towns in all.

column.name: text
column.value: All the towns allotted to the Merarite clans, who were the rest of the Levites, were twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: The towns of the Levites in the territory held by the Israelites were forty-eight in all, together with their pasturelands.

column.name: text
column.value: Each of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it; this was true for all these towns.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their forefathers, and they took possession of it and settled there.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their forefathers. Not one of their enemies withstood them; the LORD handed all their enemies over to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Not one of all the LORD'S good promises to the house of Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh

column.name: text
column.value: and said to them, "You have done all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and you have obeyed me in everything I commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: For a long time now--to this very day--you have not deserted your brothers but have carried out the mission the LORD your God gave you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that the LORD your God has given your brothers rest as he promised, return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side of the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you: to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to obey his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and all your soul."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their homes.

column.name: text
column.value: (To the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, and to the other half of the tribe Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan with their brothers.) When Joshua sent them home, he blessed them,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, "Return to your homes with your great wealth--with large herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great quantity of clothing--and divide with your brothers the plunder from your enemies."

column.name: text
column.value: So the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in Canaan to return to Gilead, their own land, which they had acquired in accordance with the command of the LORD through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Israelites heard that they had built the altar on the border of Canaan at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side,

column.name: text
column.value: the whole assembly of Israel gathered at Shiloh to go to war against them.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the land of Gilead--to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: With him they sent ten of the chief men, one for each of the tribes of Israel, each the head of a family division among the Israelite clans.

column.name: text
column.value: When they went to Gilead--to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh--they said to them:

column.name: text
column.value: "The whole assembly of the LORD says: 'How could you break faith with the God of Israel like this? How could you turn away from the LORD and build yourselves an altar in rebellion against him now?

column.name: text
column.value: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us? Up to this very day we have not cleansed ourselves from that sin, even though a plague fell on the community of the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: And are you now turning away from the LORD? "'If you rebel against the LORD today, tomorrow he will be angry with the whole community of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: If the land you possess is defiled, come over to the LORD'S land, where the LORD'S tabernacle stands, and share the land with us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building an altar for yourselves, other than the altar of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: When Achan son of Zerah acted unfaithfully regarding the devoted things, did not wrath come upon the whole community of Israel? He was not the only one who died for his sin.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh replied to the heads of the clans of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: "The Mighty One, God, the LORD! The Mighty One, God, the LORD! He knows! And let Israel know! If this has been in rebellion or disobedience to the LORD, do not spare us this day.

column.name: text
column.value: If we have built our own altar to turn away from the LORD and to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, or to sacrifice fellowship offerings on it, may the LORD himself call us to account.

column.name: text
column.value: "No! We did it for fear that some day your descendants might say to ours, 'What do you have to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you--you Reubenites and Gadites! You have no share in the LORD.' So your descendants might cause ours to stop fearing the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "That is why we said, 'Let us get ready and build an altar--but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.'

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, it is to be a witness between us and you and the generations that follow, that we will worship the LORD at his sanctuary with our burnt offerings, sacrifices and fellowship offerings. Then in the future your descendants will not be able to say to ours, 'You have no share in the LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: "And we said, 'If they ever say this to us, or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the LORD'S altar, which our fathers built, not for burnt offerings and sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Far be it from us to rebel against the LORD and turn away from him today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings and sacrifices, other than the altar of the LORD our God that stands before his tabernacle."

column.name: text
column.value: When Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the community--the heads of the clans of the Israelites--heard what Reuben, Gad and Manasseh had to say, they were pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: And Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, said to Reuben, Gad and Manasseh, "Today we know that the LORD is with us, because you have not acted unfaithfully toward the LORD in this matter. Now you have rescued the Israelites from the LORD'S hand."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, and the leaders returned to Canaan from their meeting with the Reubenites and Gadites in Gilead and reported to the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: They were glad to hear the report and praised God. And they talked no more about going to war against them to devastate the country where the Reubenites and the Gadites lived.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Reubenites and the Gadites gave the altar this name: A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges and officials of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua said to all the people, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Long ago your forefathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the River and worshiped other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But I took your father Abraham from the land beyond the River and led him throughout Canaan and gave him many descendants. I gave him Isaac,

column.name: text
column.value: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I assigned the hill country of Seir to Esau, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and I brought you out.

column.name: text
column.value: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt, you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

column.name: text
column.value: But they cried to the LORD for help, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians; he brought the sea over them and covered them. You saw with your own eyes what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the desert for a long time.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan. They fought against you, but I gave them into your hands. I destroyed them from before you, and you took possession of their land.

column.name: text
column.value: When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you out of his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The citizens of Jericho fought against you, as did also the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites, but I gave them into your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: I sent the hornet ahead of you, which drove them out before you--also the two Amorite kings. You did not do it with your own sword and bow.

column.name: text
column.value: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build; and you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Now fear the LORD and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your forefathers worshiped beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But if serving the LORD seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your forefathers served beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!

column.name: text
column.value: It was the LORD our God himself who brought us and our fathers up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because he is our God."

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve the LORD. He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster on you and make an end of you, after he has been good to you."

column.name: text
column.value: But the people said to Joshua, "No! We will serve the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua said, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD." "Yes, we are witnesses," they replied.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now then," said Joshua, "throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to Joshua, "We will serve the LORD our God and obey him."

column.name: text
column.value: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he drew up for them decrees and laws.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "See!" he said to all the people. "This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the LORD has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of a hundred and ten.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel served the LORD throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the LORD had done for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph's bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph's descendants.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, which had been allotted to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: After a long time had passed and the LORD had given Israel rest from all their enemies around them, Joshua, by then old and well advanced in years,

column.name: text
column.value: summoned all Israel--their elders, leaders, judges and officials--and said to them: "I am old and well advanced in years.

column.name: text
column.value: You yourselves have seen everything the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake; it was the LORD your God who fought for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember how I have allotted as an inheritance for your tribes all the land of the nations that remain--the nations I conquered--between the Jordan and the Great Sea in the west.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God himself will drive them out of your way. He will push them out before you, and you will take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Be very strong; be careful to obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, without turning aside to the right or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not associate with these nations that remain among you; do not invoke the names of their gods or swear by them. You must not serve them or bow down to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But you are to hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have until now.

column.name: text
column.value: "The LORD has driven out before you great and powerful nations; to this day no one has been able to withstand you.

column.name: text
column.value: One of you routs a thousand, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as he promised.

column.name: text
column.value: So be very careful to love the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you and if you intermarry with them and associate with them,

column.name: text
column.value: then you may be sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become snares and traps for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land, which the LORD your God has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the LORD your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed.

column.name: text
column.value: But just as every good promise of the LORD your God has come true, so the LORD will bring on you all the evil he has threatened, until he has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: If you violate the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, the LORD'S anger will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from the good land he has given you."

column.name: text
column.value: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the LORD, "Who will be the first to go up and fight for us against the Canaanites?"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD answered, "Judah is to go; I have given the land into their hands."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men of Judah said to the Simeonites their brothers, "Come up with us into the territory allotted to us, to fight against the Canaanites. We in turn will go with you into yours." So the Simeonites went with them.

column.name: text
column.value: When Judah attacked, the LORD gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.

column.name: text
column.value: It was there that they found Adoni-Bezek and fought against him, putting to rout the Canaanites and Perizzites.

column.name: text
column.value: Adoni-Bezek fled, but they chased him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Judah attacked Jerusalem also and took it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.

column.name: text
column.value: After that, the men of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev and the western foothills.

column.name: text
column.value: They advanced against the Canaanites living in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath Arba) and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.

column.name: text
column.value: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."

column.name: text
column.value: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.

column.name: text
column.value: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

column.name: text
column.value: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." Then Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

column.name: text
column.value: The descendants of Moses' father-in-law, the Kenite, went up from the City of Palms with the men of Judah to live among the people of the Desert of Judah in the Negev near Arad.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men of Judah went with the Simeonites their brothers and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they totally destroyed the city. Therefore it was called Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Judah also took Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron--each city with its territory.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country, but they were unable to drive the people from the plains, because they had iron chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.

column.name: text
column.value: The Benjamites, however, failed to dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the Benjamites.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the house of Joseph attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.

column.name: text
column.value: When they sent men to spy out Bethel (formerly called Luz),

column.name: text
column.value: the spies saw a man coming out of the city and they said to him, "Show us how to get into the city and we will see that you are treated well."

column.name: text
column.value: So he showed them, and they put the city to the sword but spared the man and his whole family.

column.name: text
column.value: He then went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a city and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth Shan or Taanach or Dor or Ibleam or Megiddo and their surrounding settlements, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.

column.name: text
column.value: When Israel became strong, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor but never drove them out completely.

column.name: text
column.value: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, but the Canaanites continued to live there among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Zebulun drive out the Canaanites living in Kitron or Nahalol, who remained among them; but they did subject them to forced labor.

column.name: text
column.value: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Acco or Sidon or Ahlab or Aczib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob,

column.name: text
column.value: and because of this the people of Asher lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Naphtali drive out those living in Beth Shemesh or Beth Anath; but the Naphtalites too lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and those living in Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath became forced laborers for them.

column.name: text
column.value: The Amorites confined the Danites to the hill country, not allowing them to come down into the plain.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Amorites were determined also to hold out in Mount Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim, but when the power of the house of Joseph increased, they too were pressed into forced labor.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and beyond.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, "I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land that I swore to give to your forefathers. I said, 'I will never break my covenant with you,

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall not make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall break down their altars.' Yet you have disobeyed me. Why have you done this?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore I tell you that I will not drive them out before you; they will be thorns in your sides and their gods will be a snare to you."

column.name: text
column.value: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,

column.name: text
column.value: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: The people served the LORD throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had seen all the great things the LORD had done for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of a hundred and ten.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

column.name: text
column.value: After that whole generation had been gathered to their fathers, another generation grew up, who knew neither the LORD nor what he had done for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD and served the Baals.

column.name: text
column.value: They forsook the LORD, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of Egypt. They followed and worshiped various gods of the peoples around them. They provoked the LORD to anger

column.name: text
column.value: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.

column.name: text
column.value: In his anger against Israel the LORD handed them over to raiders who plundered them. He sold them to their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever Israel went out to fight, the hand of the LORD was against them to defeat them, just as he had sworn to them. They were in great distress.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they would not listen to their judges but prostituted themselves to other gods and worshiped them. Unlike their fathers, they quickly turned from the way in which their fathers had walked, the way of obedience to the LORD'S commands.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for them, he was with the judge and saved them out of the hands of their enemies as long as the judge lived; for the LORD had compassion on them as they groaned under those who oppressed and afflicted them.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the judge died, the people returned to ways even more corrupt than those of their fathers, following other gods and serving and worshiping them. They refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel and said, "Because this nation has violated the covenant that I laid down for their forefathers and has not listened to me,

column.name: text
column.value: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.

column.name: text
column.value: I will use them to test Israel and see whether they will keep the way of the LORD and walk in it as their forefathers did."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD had allowed those nations to remain; he did not drive them out at once by giving them into the hands of Joshua.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the nations the LORD left to test all those Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars in Canaan

column.name: text
column.value: (he did this only to teach warfare to the descendants of the Israelites who had not had previous battle experience):

column.name: text
column.value: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

column.name: text
column.value: They were left to test the Israelites to see whether they would obey the LORD'S commands, which he had given their forefathers through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

column.name: text
column.value: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.

column.name: text
column.value: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel so that he sold them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram Naharaim, to whom the Israelites were subject for eight years.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they cried out to the LORD, he raised up for them a deliverer, Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, who saved them.

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him, so that he became Israel's judge and went to war. The LORD gave Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram into the hands of Othniel, who overpowered him.

column.name: text
column.value: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.

column.name: text
column.value: Once again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and because they did this evil the LORD gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.

column.name: text
column.value: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the Israelites cried out to the LORD, and he gave them a deliverer--Ehud, a left-handed man, the son of Gera the Benjamite. The Israelites sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Ehud had made a double-edged sword about a foot and a half long, which he strapped to his right thigh under his clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

column.name: text
column.value: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way the men who had carried it.

column.name: text
column.value: At the idols near Gilgal he himself turned back and said, "I have a secret message for you, O king." The king said, "Quiet!" And all his attendants left him.

column.name: text
column.value: Ehud then approached him while he was sitting alone in the upper room of his summer palace and said, "I have a message from God for you." As the king rose from his seat,

column.name: text
column.value: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king's belly.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the handle sank in after the blade, which came out his back. Ehud did not pull the sword out, and the fat closed in over it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ehud went out to the porch; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.

column.name: text
column.value: After he had gone, the servants came and found the doors of the upper room locked. They said, "He must be relieving himself in the inner room of the house."

column.name: text
column.value: They waited to the point of embarrassment, but when he did not open the doors of the room, they took a key and unlocked them. There they saw their lord fallen to the floor, dead.

column.name: text
column.value: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.

column.name: text
column.value: When he arrived there, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the hills, with him leading them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Follow me," he ordered, "for the LORD has given Moab, your enemy, into your hands." So they followed him down and, taking possession of the fords of the Jordan that led to Moab, they allowed no one to cross over.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not a man escaped.

column.name: text
column.value: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.

column.name: text
column.value: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: After Ehud died, the Israelites once again did evil in the eyes of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD sold them into the hands of Jabin, a king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth Haggoyim.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he had nine hundred iron chariots and had cruelly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years, they cried to the LORD for help.

column.name: text
column.value: Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites came to her to have their disputes decided.

column.name: text
column.value: She sent for Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, "The LORD, the God of Israel, commands you: 'Go, take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun and lead the way to Mount Tabor.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lure Sisera, the commander of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his troops to the Kishon River and give him into your hands.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Barak said to her, "If you go with me, I will go; but if you don't go with me, I won't go."

column.name: text
column.value: "Very well," Deborah said, "I will go with you. But because of the way you are going about this, the honor will not be yours, for the LORD will hand Sisera over to a woman." So Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh,

column.name: text
column.value: where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah also went with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Heber the Kenite had left the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses' brother-in-law, and pitched his tent by the great tree in Zaanannim near Kedesh.

column.name: text
column.value: When they told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,

column.name: text
column.value: Sisera gathered together his nine hundred iron chariots and all the men with him, from Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Go! This is the day the LORD has given Sisera into your hands. Has not the LORD gone ahead of you?" So Barak went down Mount Tabor, followed by ten thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: At Barak's advance, the LORD routed Sisera and all his chariots and army by the sword, and Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.

column.name: text
column.value: But Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth Haggoyim. All the troops of Sisera fell by the sword; not a man was left.

column.name: text
column.value: Sisera, however, fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there were friendly relations between Jabin king of Hazor and the clan of Heber the Kenite.

column.name: text
column.value: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, "Come, my lord, come right in. Don't be afraid." So he entered her tent, and she put a covering over him.

column.name: text
column.value: "I'm thirsty," he said. "Please give me some water." She opened a skin of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him up.

column.name: text
column.value: "Stand in the doorway of the tent," he told her. "If someone comes by and asks you, 'Is anyone here?' say 'No.'"

column.name: text
column.value: But Jael, Heber's wife, picked up a tent peg and a hammer and went quietly to him while he lay fast asleep, exhausted. She drove the peg through his temple into the ground, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Barak came by in pursuit of Sisera, and Jael went out to meet him. "Come," she said, "I will show you the man you're looking for." So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera with the tent peg through his temple--dead.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day God subdued Jabin, the Canaanite king, before the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hand of the Israelites grew stronger and stronger against Jabin, the Canaanite king, until they destroyed him.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:

column.name: text
column.value: "When the princes in Israel take the lead, when the people willingly offer themselves--praise the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: "Hear this, you kings! Listen, you rulers! I will sing to the LORD, I will sing; I will make music to the LORD, the God of Israel.

column.name: text
