column.value: He repays a man for what he has done; he brings upon him what his conduct deserves.

column.name: text
column.value: It is unthinkable that God would do wrong, that the Almighty would pervert justice.

column.name: text
column.value: Who appointed him over the earth? Who put him in charge of the whole world?

column.name: text
column.value: If it were his intention and he withdrew his spirit and breath,

column.name: text
column.value: all mankind would perish together and man would return to the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: Can he who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One?

column.name: text
column.value: Is he not the One who says to kings, 'You are worthless,' and to nobles, 'You are wicked,'

column.name: text
column.value: who shows no partiality to princes and does not favor the rich over the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?

column.name: text
column.value: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night; the people are shaken and they pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.

column.name: text
column.value: "His eyes are on the ways of men; he sees their every step.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no dark place, no deep shadow, where evildoers can hide.

column.name: text
column.value: God has no need to examine men further, that they should come before him for judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Without inquiry he shatters the mighty and sets up others in their place.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he takes note of their deeds, he overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.

column.name: text
column.value: He punishes them for their wickedness where everyone can see them,

column.name: text
column.value: because they turned from following him and had no regard for any of his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: They caused the cry of the poor to come before him, so that he heard the cry of the needy.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he remains silent, who can condemn him? If he hides his face, who can see him? Yet he is over man and nation alike,

column.name: text
column.value: to keep a godless man from ruling, from laying snares for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: "Suppose a man says to God, 'I am guilty but will offend no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do so again.'

column.name: text
column.value: Should God then reward you on your terms, when you refuse to repent? You must decide, not I; so tell me what you know.

column.name: text
column.value: "Men of understanding declare, wise men who hear me say to me,

column.name: text
column.value: 'Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.'

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that Job might be tested to the utmost for answering like a wicked man!

column.name: text
column.value: To his sin he adds rebellion; scornfully he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God."

column.name: text
column.value: "At this my heart pounds and leaps from its place.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen! Listen to the roar of his voice, to the rumbling that comes from his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: He unleashes his lightning beneath the whole heaven and sends it to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: After that comes the sound of his roar; he thunders with his majestic voice. When his voice resounds, he holds nothing back.

column.name: text
column.value: God's voice thunders in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: He says to the snow, 'Fall on the earth,' and to the rain shower, 'Be a mighty downpour.'

column.name: text
column.value: So that all men he has made may know his work, he stops every man from his labor.

column.name: text
column.value: The animals take cover; they remain in their dens.

column.name: text
column.value: The tempest comes out from its chamber, the cold from the driving winds.

column.name: text
column.value: The breath of God produces ice, and the broad waters become frozen.

column.name: text
column.value: He loads the clouds with moisture; he scatters his lightning through them.

column.name: text
column.value: At his direction they swirl around over the face of the whole earth to do whatever he commands them.

column.name: text
column.value: He brings the clouds to punish men, or to water his earth and show his love.

column.name: text
column.value: "Listen to this, Job; stop and consider God's wonders.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you know how God controls the clouds and makes his lightning flash?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you know how the clouds hang poised, those wonders of him who is perfect in knowledge?

column.name: text
column.value: You who swelter in your clothes when the land lies hushed under the south wind,

column.name: text
column.value: can you join him in spreading out the skies, hard as a mirror of cast bronze?

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell us what we should say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Should he be told that I want to speak? Would any man ask to be swallowed up?

column.name: text
column.value: Now no one can look at the sun, bright as it is in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the north he comes in golden splendor; God comes in awesome majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: The Almighty is beyond our reach and exalted in power; in his justice and great righteousness, he does not oppress.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, men revere him, for does he not have regard for all the wise in heart?"

column.name: text
column.value: Elihu continued:

column.name: text
column.value: "Bear with me a little longer and I will show you that there is more to be said in God's behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: I get my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe justice to my Maker.

column.name: text
column.value: Be assured that my words are not false; one perfect in knowledge is with you.

column.name: text
column.value: "God is mighty, but does not despise men; he is mighty, and firm in his purpose.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not keep the wicked alive but gives the afflicted their rights.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; he enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.

column.name: text
column.value: But if men are bound in chains, held fast by cords of affliction,

column.name: text
column.value: he tells them what they have done--that they have sinned arrogantly.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes them listen to correction and commands them to repent of their evil.

column.name: text
column.value: If they obey and serve him, they will spend the rest of their days in prosperity and their years in contentment.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they do not listen, they will perish by the sword and die without knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: "The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when he fetters them, they do not cry for help.

column.name: text
column.value: They die in their youth, among male prostitutes of the shrines.

column.name: text
column.value: But those who suffer he delivers in their suffering; he speaks to them in their affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: "He is wooing you from the jaws of distress to a spacious place free from restriction, to the comfort of your table laden with choice food.

column.name: text
column.value: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have taken hold of you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful that no one entices you by riches; do not let a large bribe turn you aside.

column.name: text
column.value: Would your wealth or even all your mighty efforts sustain you so you would not be in distress?

column.name: text
column.value: Do not long for the night, to drag people away from their homes.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware of turning to evil, which you seem to prefer to affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: "God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

column.name: text
column.value: Who has prescribed his ways for him, or said to him, 'You have done wrong'?

column.name: text
column.value: Remember to extol his work, which men have praised in song.

column.name: text
column.value: All mankind has seen it; men gaze on it from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: How great is God--beyond our understanding! The number of his years is past finding out.

column.name: text
column.value: "He draws up the drops of water, which distill as rain to the streams;

column.name: text
column.value: the clouds pour down their moisture and abundant showers fall on mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can understand how he spreads out the clouds, how he thunders from his pavilion?

column.name: text
column.value: See how he scatters his lightning about him, bathing the depths of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the way he governs the nations and provides food in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: He fills his hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.

column.name: text
column.value: His thunder announces the coming storm; even the cattle make known its approach.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elihu said:

column.name: text
column.value: "Do you think this is just? You say, 'I will be cleared by God.'

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you ask him, 'What profit is it to me, and what do I gain by not sinning?'

column.name: text
column.value: "I would like to reply to you and to your friends with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Look up at the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds so high above you.

column.name: text
column.value: If you sin, how does that affect him? If your sins are many, what does that do to him?

column.name: text
column.value: If you are righteous, what do you give to him, or what does he receive from your hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Your wickedness affects only a man like yourself, and your righteousness only the sons of men.

column.name: text
column.value: "Men cry out under a load of oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the powerful.

column.name: text
column.value: But no one says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

column.name: text
column.value: who teaches more to us than to the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the air?'

column.name: text
column.value: He does not answer when men cry out because of the arrogance of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, God does not listen to their empty plea; the Almighty pays no attention to it.

column.name: text
column.value: How much less, then, will he listen when you say that you do not see him, that your case is before him and you must wait for him,

column.name: text
column.value: and further, that his anger never punishes and he does not take the least notice of wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: So Job opens his mouth with empty talk; without knowledge he multiplies words."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD answered Job out of the storm. He said:

column.name: text
column.value: "Who is this that darkens my counsel with words without knowledge?

column.name: text
column.value: Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: "Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.

column.name: text
column.value: Who marked off its dimensions? Surely you know! Who stretched a measuring line across it?

column.name: text
column.value: On what were its footings set, or who laid its cornerstone--

column.name: text
column.value: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?

column.name: text
column.value: "Who shut up the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,

column.name: text
column.value: when I made the clouds its garment and wrapped it in thick darkness,

column.name: text
column.value: when I fixed limits for it and set its doors and bars in place,

column.name: text
column.value: when I said, 'This far you may come and no farther; here is where your proud waves halt'?

column.name: text
column.value: "Have you ever given orders to the morning, or shown the dawn its place,

column.name: text
column.value: that it might take the earth by the edges and shake the wicked out of it?

column.name: text
column.value: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its features stand out like those of a garment.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked are denied their light, and their upraised arm is broken.

column.name: text
column.value: "Have you journeyed to the springs of the sea or walked in the recesses of the deep?

column.name: text
column.value: Have the gates of death been shown to you? Have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

column.name: text
column.value: Have you comprehended the vast expanses of the earth? Tell me, if you know all this.

column.name: text
column.value: "What is the way to the abode of light? And where does darkness reside?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you take them to their places? Do you know the paths to their dwellings?

column.name: text
column.value: Surely you know, for you were already born! You have lived so many years!

column.name: text
column.value: "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of the hail,

column.name: text
column.value: which I reserve for times of trouble, for days of war and battle?

column.name: text
column.value: What is the way to the place where the lightning is dispersed, or the place where the east winds are scattered over the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: Who cuts a channel for the torrents of rain, and a path for the thunderstorm,

column.name: text
column.value: to water a land where no man lives, a desert with no one in it,

column.name: text
column.value: to satisfy a desolate wasteland and make it sprout with grass?

column.name: text
column.value: Does the rain have a father? Who fathers the drops of dew?

column.name: text
column.value: From whose womb comes the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens

column.name: text
column.value: when the waters become hard as stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen?

column.name: text
column.value: "Can you bind the beautiful Pleiades? Can you loose the cords of Orion?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear with its cubs?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set up God'sdominion over the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: "Can you raise your voice to the clouds and cover yourself with a flood of water?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, 'Here we are'?

column.name: text
column.value: Who endowed the heart with wisdom or gave understanding to the mind?

column.name: text
column.value: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Who can tip over the water jars of the heavens

column.name: text
column.value: when the dust becomes hard and the clods of earth stick together?

column.name: text
column.value: "Do you hunt the prey for the lioness and satisfy the hunger of the lions

column.name: text
column.value: when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in a thicket?

column.name: text
column.value: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God and wander about for lack of food?

column.name: text
column.value: "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears her fawn?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you count the months till they bear? Do you know the time they give birth?

column.name: text
column.value: They crouch down and bring forth their young; their labor pains are ended.

column.name: text
column.value: Their young thrive and grow strong in the wilds; they leave and do not return.

column.name: text
column.value: "Who let the wild donkey go free? Who untied his ropes?

column.name: text
column.value: I gave him the wasteland as his home, the salt flats as his habitat.

column.name: text
column.value: He laughs at the commotion in the town; he does not hear a driver's shout.

column.name: text
column.value: He ranges the hills for his pasture and searches for any green thing.

column.name: text
column.value: "Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will he stay by your manger at night?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you hold him to the furrow with a harness? Will he till the valleys behind you?

column.name: text
column.value: Will you rely on him for his great strength? Will you leave your heavy work to him?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you trust him to bring in your grain and gather it to your threshing floor?

column.name: text
column.value: "The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but they cannot compare with the pinions and feathers of the stork.

column.name: text
column.value: She lays her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand,

column.name: text
column.value: unmindful that a foot may crush them, that some wild animal may trample them.

column.name: text
column.value: She treats her young harshly, as if they were not hers; she cares not that her labor was in vain,

column.name: text
column.value: for God did not endow her with wisdom or give her a share of good sense.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet when she spreads her feathers to run, she laughs at horse and rider.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do you give the horse his strength or clothe his neck with a flowing mane?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you make him leap like a locust, striking terror with his proud snorting?

column.name: text
column.value: He paws fiercely, rejoicing in his strength, and charges into the fray.

column.name: text
column.value: He laughs at fear, afraid of nothing; he does not shy away from the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: The quiver rattles against his side, along with the flashing spear and lance.

column.name: text
column.value: In frenzied excitement he eats up the ground; he cannot stand still when the trumpet sounds.

column.name: text
column.value: At the blast of the trumpet he snorts, 'Aha!' He catches the scent of battle from afar, the shout of commanders and the battle cry.

column.name: text
column.value: "Does the hawk take flight by your wisdom and spread his wings toward the south?

column.name: text
column.value: Does the eagle soar at your command and build his nest on high?

column.name: text
column.value: He dwells on a cliff and stays there at night; a rocky crag is his stronghold.

column.name: text
column.value: From there he seeks out his food; his eyes detect it from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: His young ones feast on blood, and where the slain are, there is he."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Job:

column.name: text
column.value: "Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him? Let him who accuses God answer him!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job answered the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "I am unworthy--how can I reply to you? I put my hand over my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: I spoke once, but I have no answer--twice, but I will say no more."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm:

column.name: text
column.value: "Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: "Would you discredit my justice? Would you condemn me to justify yourself?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you have an arm like God's, and can your voice thunder like his?

column.name: text
column.value: Then adorn yourself with glory and splendor, and clothe yourself in honor and majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: Unleash the fury of your wrath, look at every proud man and bring him low,

column.name: text
column.value: look at every proud man and humble him, crush the wicked where they stand.

column.name: text
column.value: Bury them all in the dust together; shroud their faces in the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Look at the behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.

column.name: text
column.value: What strength he has in his loins, what power in the muscles of his belly!

column.name: text
column.value: His tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are close-knit.

column.name: text
column.value: His bones are tubes of bronze, his limbs like rods of iron.

column.name: text
column.value: He ranks first among the works of God, yet his Maker can approach him with his sword.

column.name: text
column.value: The hills bring him their produce, and all the wild animals play nearby.

column.name: text
column.value: Under the lotus plants he lies, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.

column.name: text
column.value: The lotuses conceal him in their shadow; the poplars by the stream surround him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the river rages, he is not alarmed; he is secure, though the Jordan should surge against his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Can anyone capture him by the eyes, or trap him and pierce his nose?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job replied to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "I know that you can do all things; no plan of yours can be thwarted.

column.name: text
column.value: You asked,'Who is this that obscures my counsel without knowledge?' Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.

column.name: text
column.value: "You said,'Listen now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you shall answer me.'

column.name: text
column.value: My ears had heard of you but now my eyes have seen you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes."

column.name: text
column.value: After the LORD had said these things to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "I am angry with you and your two friends, because you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has.

column.name: text
column.value: So now take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. You have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has."

column.name: text
column.value: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the LORD told them; and the LORD accepted Job's prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD made him prosperous again and gave him twice as much as he had before.

column.name: text
column.value: All his brothers and sisters and everyone who had known him before came and ate with him in his house. They comforted and consoled him over all the trouble the LORD had brought upon him, and each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD blessed the latter part of Job's life more than the first. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen and a thousand donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: The first daughter he named Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-Happuch.

column.name: text
column.value: Nowhere in all the land were there found women as beautiful as Job's daughters, and their father granted them an inheritance along with their brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.

column.name: text
column.value: And so he died, old and full of years.

column.name: text
column.value: "Can you pull in the leviathan with a fishhook or tie down his tongue with a rope?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?

column.name: text
column.value: Will he keep begging you for mercy? Will he speak to you with gentle words?

column.name: text
column.value: Will he make an agreement with you for you to take him as your slave for life?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you make a pet of him like a bird or put him on a leash for your girls?

column.name: text
column.value: Will traders barter for him? Will they divide him up among the merchants?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?

column.name: text
column.value: If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the struggle and never do it again!

column.name: text
column.value: Any hope of subduing him is false; the mere sight of him is overpowering.

column.name: text
column.value: No one is fierce enough to rouse him. Who then is able to stand against me?

column.name: text
column.value: Who has a claim against me that I must pay? Everything under heaven belongs to me.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will not fail to speak of his limbs, his strength and his graceful form.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can strip off his outer coat? Who would approach him with a bridle?

column.name: text
column.value: Who dares open the doors of his mouth, ringed about with his fearsome teeth?

column.name: text
column.value: His back has rows of shields tightly sealed together;

column.name: text
column.value: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.

column.name: text
column.value: They are joined fast to one another; they cling together and cannot be parted.

column.name: text
column.value: His snorting throws out flashes of light; his eyes are like the rays of dawn.

column.name: text
column.value: Firebrands stream from his mouth; sparks of fire shoot out.

column.name: text
column.value: Smoke pours from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

column.name: text
column.value: His breath sets coals ablaze, and flames dart from his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Strength resides in his neck; dismay goes before him.

column.name: text
column.value: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.

column.name: text
column.value: His chest is hard as rock, hard as a lower millstone.

column.name: text
column.value: When he rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before his thrashing.

column.name: text
column.value: The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or the dart or the javelin.

column.name: text
column.value: Iron he treats like straw and bronze like rotten wood.

column.name: text
column.value: Arrows do not make him flee; slingstones are like chaff to him.

column.name: text
column.value: A club seems to him but a piece of straw; he laughs at the rattling of the lance.

column.name: text
column.value: His undersides are jagged potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.

column.name: text
column.value: Behind him he leaves a glistening wake; one would think the deep had white hair.

column.name: text
column.value: Nothing on earth is his equal--a creature without fear.

column.name: text
column.value: He looks down on all that are haughty; he is king over all that are proud."

column.name: text
column.value: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the LORD and against his Anointed One.

column.name: text
column.value: "Let us break their chains," they say, "and throw off their fetters."

column.name: text
column.value: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: "I have installed my King on Zion, my holy hill."

column.name: text
column.value: I will proclaim the decree of the LORD: He said to me, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Ask of me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.

column.name: text
column.value: You will rule them with an iron scepter; you will dash them to pieces like pottery."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Serve the LORD with fear and rejoice with trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry and you be destroyed in your way, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or stand in the way of sinners or sit in the seat of mockers.

column.name: text
column.value: But his delight is in the law of the LORD, and on his law he meditates day and night.

column.name: text
column.value: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither. Whatever he does prospers.

column.name: text
column.value: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. When he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!

column.name: text
column.value: Many are saying of me, "God will not deliver him." Selah

column.name: text
column.value: But you are a shield around me, O LORD; you bestow glory on me and lift up my head.

column.name: text
column.value: To the LORD I cry aloud, and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the LORD sustains me.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not fear the tens of thousands drawn up against me on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD! Deliver me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: From the LORD comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm of David. Answer me when I call to you, O my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; be merciful to me and hear my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: How long, O men, will you turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods? Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for himself; the LORD will hear when I call to him.

column.name: text
column.value: In your anger do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Offer right sacrifices and trust in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Many are asking, "Who can show us any good?" Let the light of your face shine upon us, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You have filled my heart with greater joy than when their grain and new wine abound.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. According to sheminith. A psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: Be merciful to me, LORD, for I am faint; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are in agony.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul is in anguish. How long, O LORD, how long?

column.name: text
column.value: Turn, O LORD, and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.

column.name: text
column.value: No one remembers you when he is dead. Who praises you from the grave?

column.name: text
column.value: I am worn out from groaning; all night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.

column.name: text
column.value: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. For flutes. A psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my sighing.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.

column.name: text
column.value: In the morning, O LORD, you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait in expectation.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not a God who takes pleasure in evil; with you the wicked cannot dwell.

column.name: text
column.value: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence; you hate all who do wrong.

column.name: text
column.value: You destroy those who tell lies; bloodthirsty and deceitful men the LORD abhors.

column.name: text
column.value: But I, by your great mercy, will come into your house; in reverence will I bow down toward your holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies--make straight your way before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with destruction. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongue they speak deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.

column.name: text
column.value: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.

column.name: text
column.value: For surely, O LORD, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

column.name: text
column.value: A shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,

column.name: text
column.value: or they will tear me like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands--

column.name: text
column.value: if I have done evil to him who is at peace with me or without cause have robbed my foe--

column.name: text
column.value: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD, in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the assembled peoples gather around you. Rule over them from on high;

column.name: text
column.value: let the LORD judge the peoples. Judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: O righteous God, who searches minds and hearts, bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure.

column.name: text
column.value: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: God is a righteous judge, a God who expresses his wrath every day.

column.name: text
column.value: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.

column.name: text
column.value: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.

column.name: text
column.value: He who is pregnant with evil and conceives trouble gives birth to disillusionment.

column.name: text
column.value: He who digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit he has made.

column.name: text
column.value: The trouble he causes recoils on himself; his violence comes down on his own head.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give thanks to the LORD because of his righteousness and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"The Death of the Son." A psalm of David. I will praise you, O LORD, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonders.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have upheld my right and my cause; you have sat on your throne, judging righteously.

column.name: text
column.value: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Endless ruin has overtaken the enemy, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: He will judge the world in righteousness; he will govern the peoples with justice.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who know your name will trust in you, for you, LORD, have never forsaken those who seek you.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing praises to the LORD, enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,

column.name: text
column.value: that I may declare your praises in the gates of the Daughter of Zion and there rejoice in your salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is known by his justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked return to the grave, all the nations that forget God.

column.name: text
column.value: But the needy will not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the afflicted ever perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD, let not man triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Strike them with terror, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. According to gittith. A psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: From the lips of children and infants you have ordained praise because of your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.

column.name: text
column.value: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,

column.name: text
column.value: what is man that you are mindful of him, the son of man that you care for him?

column.name: text
column.value: You made him a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned him with glory and honor.

column.name: text
column.value: You made him ruler over the works of your hands; you put everything under his feet:

column.name: text
column.value: all flocks and herds, and the beasts of the field,

column.name: text
column.value: the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

column.name: text
column.value: Why, O LORD, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

column.name: text
column.value: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.

column.name: text
column.value: He boasts of the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In his pride the wicked does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.

column.name: text
column.value: His ways are always prosperous; he is haughty and your laws are far from him; he sneers at all his enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: He says to himself, "Nothing will shake me; I'll always be happy and never have trouble."

column.name: text
column.value: His mouth is full of curses and lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent, watching in secret for his victims.

column.name: text
column.value: He lies in wait like a lion in cover; he lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.

column.name: text
column.value: His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.

column.name: text
column.value: He says to himself, "God has forgotten; he covers his face and never sees."

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, LORD! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.

column.name: text
column.value: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, "He won't call me to account"?

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O God, do see trouble and grief; you consider it to take it in hand. The victim commits himself to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.

column.name: text
column.value: Break the arm of the wicked and evil man; call him to account for his wickedness that would not be found out.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.

column.name: text
column.value: You hear, O LORD, the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,

column.name: text
column.value: defending the fatherless and the oppressed, in order that man, who is of the earth, may terrify no more.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. According to sheminith. A psalm of David. Help, LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone lies to his neighbor; their flattering lips speak with deception.

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue

column.name: text
column.value: that says, "We will triumph with our tongues; we own our lips--who is our master?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Because of the oppression of the weak and the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says the LORD. "I will protect them from those who malign them."

column.name: text
column.value: And the words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace of clay, purified seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, you will keep us safe and protect us from such people forever.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked freely strut about when what is vile is honored among men.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: "Flee like a bird to your mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD is on his heavenly throne. He observes the sons of men; his eyes examine them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD examines the righteous, but the wicked and those who love violence his soul hates.

column.name: text
column.value: On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD is righteous, he loves justice; upright men will see his face.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

column.name: text
column.value: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and every day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?

column.name: text
column.value: Look on me and answer, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death;

column.name: text
column.value: my enemy will say, "I have overcome him," and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

column.name: text
column.value: But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sing to the LORD, for he has been good to me.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. LORD, who may dwell in your sanctuary? Who may live on your holy hill?

column.name: text
column.value: He whose walk is blameless and who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from his heart

column.name: text
column.value: and has no slander on his tongue, who does his neighbor no wrong and casts no slur on his fellowman,

column.name: text
column.value: who despises a vile man but honors those who fear the LORD, who keeps his oath even when it hurts,

column.name: text
column.value: who lends his money without usury and does not accept a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David. The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD looks down from heaven on the sons of men to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

column.name: text
column.value: All have turned aside, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

column.name: text
column.value: Will evildoers never learn--those who devour my people as men eat bread and who do not call on the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

column.name: text
column.value: A miktam of David. Keep me safe, O God, for in you I take refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: I said to the LORD, "You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing."

column.name: text
column.value: As for the saints who are in the land, they are the glorious ones in whom is all my delight.

column.name: text
column.value: The sorrows of those will increase who run after other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood or take up their names on my lips.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, you have assigned me my portion and my cup; you have made my lot secure.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise the LORD, who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,

column.name: text
column.value: because you will not abandon me to the grave, nor will you let your Holy One see decay.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer--it does not rise from deceitful lips.

column.name: text
column.value: May my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.

column.name: text
column.value: Though you probe my heart and examine me at night, though you test me, you will find nothing; I have resolved that my mouth will not sin.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the deeds of men--by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

column.name: text
column.value: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not slipped.

column.name: text
column.value: I call on you, O God, for you will answer me; give ear to me and hear my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Show the wonder of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings

column.name: text
column.value: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

column.name: text
column.value: They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.

column.name: text
column.value: They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a great lion crouching in cover.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, O LORD, confront them, bring them down; rescue me from the wicked by your sword.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, by your hand save me from such men, from men of this world whose reward is in this life. You still the hunger of those you cherish; their sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

column.name: text
column.value: And I--in righteousness I will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David the servant of the LORD. He sang to the LORD the words of this song when the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love you, O LORD, my strength.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge. He is my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

column.name: text
column.value: I call to the LORD, who is worthy of praise, and I am saved from my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

column.name: text
column.value: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

column.name: text
column.value: In my distress I called to the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.

column.name: text
column.value: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him--the dark rain clouds of the sky.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

column.name: text
column.value: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemies, great bolts of lightning and routed them.

column.name: text
column.value: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of breath from your nostrils.

column.name: text
column.value: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

column.name: text
column.value: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

column.name: text
column.value: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the LORD was my support.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have kept the ways of the LORD; I have not done evil by turning from my God.

column.name: text
column.value: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

column.name: text
column.value: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the crooked you show yourself shrewd.

column.name: text
column.value: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

column.name: text
column.value: You, O LORD, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

column.name: text
column.value: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

column.name: text
column.value: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield for all who take refuge in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

column.name: text
column.value: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he enables me to stand on the heights.

column.name: text
column.value: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: You give me your shield of victory, and your right hand sustains me; you stoop down to make me great.

column.name: text
column.value: You broaden the path beneath me, so that my ankles do not turn.

column.name: text
column.value: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: You armed me with strength for battle; you made my adversaries bow at my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

column.name: text
column.value: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them--to the LORD, but he did not answer.

column.name: text
column.value: I beat them as fine as dust borne on the wind; I poured them out like mud in the streets.

column.name: text
column.value: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations; people I did not know are subject to me.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cringe before me.

column.name: text
column.value: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!

column.name: text
column.value: He is the God who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,

column.name: text
column.value: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from violent men you rescued me.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will praise you among the nations, O LORD; I will sing praises to your name.

column.name: text
column.value: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they display knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no speech or language where their voice is not heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens he has pitched a tent for the sun,

column.name: text
column.value: which is like a bridegroom coming forth from his pavilion, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

column.name: text
column.value: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is hidden from its heat.

column.name: text
column.value: The law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul. The statutes of the LORD are trustworthy, making wise the simple.

column.name: text
column.value: The precepts of the LORD are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever. The ordinances of the LORD are sure and altogether righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

column.name: text
column.value: By them is your servant warned; in keeping them there is great reward.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can discern his errors? Forgive my hidden faults.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then will I be blameless, innocent of great transgression.

column.name: text
column.value: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. May the LORD answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

column.name: text
column.value: May he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: May he remember all your sacrifices and accept your burnt offerings. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

column.name: text
column.value: We will shout for joy when you are victorious and will lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your requests.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed; he answers him from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, save the king! Answer us when we call!

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in your strength. How great is his joy in the victories you give!

column.name: text
column.value: You have granted him the desire of his heart and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You welcomed him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him--length of days, for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely you have granted him eternal blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.

column.name: text
column.value: At the time of your appearing you will make them like a fiery furnace. In his wrath the LORD will swallow them up, and his fire will consume them.

column.name: text
column.value: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed;

column.name: text
column.value: for you will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted, O LORD, in your strength; we will sing and praise your might.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"The Doe of the Morning." A psalm of David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from the words of my groaning?

column.name: text
column.value: O my God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, and am not silent.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the praise of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In you our fathers put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.

column.name: text
column.value: They cried to you and were saved; in you they trusted and were not disappointed.

column.name: text
column.value: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.

column.name: text
column.value: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads:

column.name: text
column.value: "He trusts in the LORD; let the LORD rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him."

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you even at my mother's breast.

column.name: text
column.value: From birth I was cast upon you; from my mother's womb you have been my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

column.name: text
column.value: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

column.name: text
column.value: Roaring lions tearing their prey open their mouths wide against me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted away within me.

column.name: text
column.value: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Dogs have surrounded me; a band of evil men has encircled me, they have pierced my hands and my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: I can count all my bones; people stare and gloat over me.

column.name: text
column.value: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

column.name: text
column.value: Deliver my life from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen.

column.name: text
column.value: I will declare your name to my brothers; in the congregation I will praise you.

column.name: text
column.value: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!

column.name: text
column.value: For he has not despised or disdained the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened to his cry for help.

column.name: text
column.value: From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear you will I fulfill my vows.

column.name: text
column.value: The poor will eat and be satisfied; they who seek the LORD will praise him--may your hearts live forever!

column.name: text
column.value: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD, and all the families of the nations will bow down before him,

column.name: text
column.value: for dominion belongs to the LORD and he rules over the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him--those who cannot keep themselves alive.

column.name: text
column.value: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: They will proclaim his righteousness to a people yet unborn--for he has done it.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. A psalm. The earth is the LORD'S, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;

column.name: text
column.value: for he founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in his holy place?

column.name: text
column.value: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear by what is false.

column.name: text
column.value: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from God his Savior.

column.name: text
column.value: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your heads, O you gates; be lifted up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your heads, O you gates; lift them up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is he, this King of glory? The LORD Almighty--he is the King of glory. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd, I shall not be in want.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,

column.name: text
column.value: he restores my soul. He guides me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

column.name: text
column.value: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD, for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

column.name: text
column.value: Test me, O LORD, and try me, examine my heart and my mind;

column.name: text
column.value: for your love is ever before me, and I walk continually in your truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor do I consort with hypocrites;

column.name: text
column.value: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about your altar, O LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: I love the house where you live, O LORD, the place where your glory dwells.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with bloodthirsty men,

column.name: text
column.value: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

column.name: text
column.value: But I lead a blameless life; redeem me and be merciful to me.

column.name: text
column.value: My feet stand on level ground; in the great assembly I will praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation--whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life--of whom shall I be afraid?

column.name: text
column.value: When evil men advance against me to devour my flesh, when my enemies and my foes attack me, they will stumble and fall.

column.name: text
column.value: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then will I be confident.

column.name: text
column.value: One thing I ask of the LORD, this is what I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze upon the beauty of the LORD and to seek him in his temple.

column.name: text
column.value: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his tabernacle and set me high upon a rock.

column.name: text
column.value: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his tabernacle will I sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my voice when I call, O LORD; be merciful to me and answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart says of you, "Seek his face!" Your face, LORD, I will seek.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, O God my Savior.

column.name: text
column.value: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me your way, O LORD; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

column.name: text
column.value: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: Wait for the LORD; be strong and take heart and wait for the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. To you, O LORD, I lift up my soul;

column.name: text
column.value: in you I trust, O my God. Do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

column.name: text
column.value: No one whose hope is in you will ever be put to shame, but they will be put to shame who are treacherous without excuse.

column.name: text
column.value: Show me your ways, O LORD, teach me your paths;

column.name: text
column.value: guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, O LORD, your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember not the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you are good, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.

column.name: text
column.value: All the ways of the LORD are loving and faithful for those who keep the demands of his covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, though it is great.

column.name: text
column.value: Who, then, is the man that fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the way chosen for him.

column.name: text
column.value: He will spend his days in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for only he will release my feet from the snare.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: The troubles of my heart have multiplied; free me from my anguish.

column.name: text
column.value: Look upon my affliction and my distress and take away all my sins.

column.name: text
column.value: See how my enemies have increased and how fiercely they hate me!

column.name: text
column.value: Guard my life and rescue me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.

column.name: text
column.value: May integrity and uprightness protect me, because my hope is in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Redeem Israel, O God, from all their troubles!

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. To you I call, O LORD my Rock; do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who have gone down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back upon them what they deserve.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the LORD, for he has heard my cry for mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and I am helped. My heart leaps for joy and I will give thanks to him in song.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.

column.name: text
column.value: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O mighty ones, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the LORD thunders over the mighty waters.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD strikes with flashes of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD shakes the desert; the LORD shakes the Desert of Kadesh.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in his temple all cry, "Glory!"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD gives strength to his people; the LORD blesses his people with peace.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm. A song. For the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt you, O LORD, for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD my God, I called to you for help and you healed me.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, you brought me up from the grave; you spared me from going down into the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD, you saints of his; praise his holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may remain for a night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: When I felt secure, I said, "I will never be shaken."

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, when you favored me, you made my mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.

column.name: text
column.value: To you, O LORD, I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:

column.name: text
column.value: "What gain is there in my destruction, in my going down into the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O LORD, and be merciful to me; O LORD, be my help."

column.name: text
column.value: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

column.name: text
column.value: that my heart may sing to you and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give you thanks forever.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. In you, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.

column.name: text
column.value: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.

column.name: text
column.value: Free me from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: Into your hands I commit my spirit; redeem me, O LORD, the God of truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I hate those who cling to worthless idols; I trust in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: You have not handed me over to the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.

column.name: text
column.value: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and my body with grief.

column.name: text
column.value: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors; I am a dread to my friends--those who see me on the street flee from me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am forgotten by them as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.

column.name: text
column.value: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side; they conspire against me and plot to take my life.

column.name: text
column.value: But I trust in you, O LORD; I say, "You are my God."

column.name: text
column.value: My times are in your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your unfailing love.

column.name: text
column.value: Let me not be put to shame, O LORD, for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and lie silent in the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you bestow in the sight of men on those who take refuge in you.

column.name: text
column.value: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from the intrigues of men; in your dwelling you keep them safe from accusing tongues.

column.name: text
