column.value: Praise be to the LORD, for he showed his wonderful love to me when I was in a besieged city.

column.name: text
column.value: In my alarm I said, "I am cut off from your sight!" Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.

column.name: text
column.value: Love the LORD, all his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, but the proud he pays back in full.

column.name: text
column.value: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing joyfully to the LORD, you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: For the word of the LORD is right and true; he is faithful in all he does.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his unfailing love.

column.name: text
column.value: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars; he puts the deep into storehouses.

column.name: text
column.value: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: But the plans of the LORD stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose for his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: From heaven the LORD looks down and sees all mankind;

column.name: text
column.value: from his dwelling place he watches all who live on earth--

column.name: text
column.value: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.

column.name: text
column.value: No king is saved by the size of his army; no warrior escapes by his great strength.

column.name: text
column.value: A horse is a vain hope for deliverance; despite all its great strength it cannot save.

column.name: text
column.value: But the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear him, on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,

column.name: text
column.value: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

column.name: text
column.value: We wait in hope for the LORD; he is our help and our shield.

column.name: text
column.value: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: May your unfailing love rest upon us, O LORD, even as we put our hope in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. A maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man whose sin the LORD does not count against him and in whose spirit is no deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the LORD"--and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let everyone who is godly pray to you while you may be found; surely when the mighty waters rise, they will not reach him.

column.name: text
column.value: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you and watch over you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the LORD'S unfailing love surrounds the man who trusts in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice in the LORD and be glad, you righteous; sing, all you who are upright in heart!

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. When he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he left. I will extol the LORD at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul will boast in the LORD; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: Glorify the LORD with me; let us exalt his name together.

column.name: text
column.value: I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

column.name: text
column.value: This poor man called, and the LORD heard him; he saved him out of all his troubles.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.

column.name: text
column.value: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear the LORD, you his saints, for those who fear him lack nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,

column.name: text
column.value: keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking lies.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their cry;

column.name: text
column.value: the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: A righteous man may have many troubles, but the LORD delivers him from them all;

column.name: text
column.value: he protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Evil will slay the wicked; the foes of the righteous will be condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD redeems his servants; no one will be condemned who takes refuge in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. Contend, O LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Take up shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

column.name: text
column.value: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to my soul, "I am your salvation."

column.name: text
column.value: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.

column.name: text
column.value: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away;

column.name: text
column.value: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,

column.name: text
column.value: may ruin overtake them by surprise--may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and delight in his salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like you, O LORD? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."

column.name: text
column.value: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.

column.name: text
column.value: They repay me evil for good and leave my soul forlorn.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,

column.name: text
column.value: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.

column.name: text
column.value: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; attackers gathered against me when I was unaware. They slandered me without ceasing.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked; they gnashed their teeth at me.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my life from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among throngs of people I will praise you.

column.name: text
column.value: Let not those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; let not those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: They gape at me and say, "Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it."

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, you have seen this; be not silent. Do not be far from me, O Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Vindicate me in your righteousness, O LORD my God; do not let them gloat over me.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let them think, "Aha, just what we wanted!" or say, "We have swallowed him up."

column.name: text
column.value: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, "The LORD be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant."

column.name: text
column.value: My tongue will speak of your righteousness and of your praises all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David the servant of the LORD. An oracle is within my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For in his own eyes he flatters himself too much to detect or hate his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and to do good.

column.name: text
column.value: Even on his bed he plots evil; he commits himself to a sinful course and does not reject what is wrong.

column.name: text
column.value: Your love, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains, your justice like the great deep. O LORD, you preserve both man and beast.

column.name: text
column.value: How priceless is your unfailing love! Both high and low among men find refuge in the shadow of your wings.

column.name: text
column.value: They feast on the abundance of your house; you give them drink from your river of delights.

column.name: text
column.value: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.

column.name: text
column.value: Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: May the foot of the proud not come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

column.name: text
column.value: See how the evildoers lie fallen--thrown down, not able to rise!

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. A petition. O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: For your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; my bones have no soundness because of my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.

column.name: text
column.value: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.

column.name: text
column.value: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.

column.name: text
column.value: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

column.name: text
column.value: All my longings lie open before you, O Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who seek my life set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they plot deception.

column.name: text
column.value: I am like a deaf man, who cannot hear, like a mute, who cannot open his mouth;

column.name: text
column.value: I have become like a man who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.

column.name: text
column.value: I wait for you, O LORD; you will answer, O Lord my God.

column.name: text
column.value: For I said, "Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."

column.name: text
column.value: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

column.name: text
column.value: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Many are those who are my vigorous enemies; those who hate me without reason are numerous.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who repay my good with evil slander me when I pursue what is good.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, do not forsake me; be not far from me, O my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. Do not fret because of evil men or be envious of those who do wrong;

column.name: text
column.value: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.

column.name: text
column.value: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

column.name: text
column.value: Delight yourself in the LORD and he will give you the desires of your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in him and he will do this:

column.name: text
column.value: He will make your righteousness shine like the dawn, the justice of your cause like the noonday sun.

column.name: text
column.value: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him; do not fret when men succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.

column.name: text
column.value: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret--it leads only to evil.

column.name: text
column.value: For evil men will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

column.name: text
column.value: A little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

column.name: text
column.value: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy great peace.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;

column.name: text
column.value: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked draw the sword and bend the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

column.name: text
column.value: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;

column.name: text
column.value: for the power of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: The days of the blameless are known to the LORD, and their inheritance will endure forever.

column.name: text
column.value: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

column.name: text
column.value: But the wicked will perish: The LORD'S enemies will be like the beauty of the fields, they will vanish--vanish like smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous give generously;

column.name: text
column.value: those the LORD blesses will inherit the land, but those he curses will be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: If the LORD delights in a man's way, he makes his steps firm;

column.name: text
column.value: though he stumble, he will not fall, for the LORD upholds him with his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

column.name: text
column.value: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn from evil and do good; then you will dwell in the land forever.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. They will be protected forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off;

column.name: text
column.value: the righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

column.name: text
column.value: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks what is just.

column.name: text
column.value: The law of his God is in his heart; his feet do not slip.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked lie in wait for the righteous, seeking their very lives;

column.name: text
column.value: but the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned when brought to trial.

column.name: text
column.value: Wait for the LORD and keep his way. He will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen a wicked and ruthless man flourishing like a green tree in its native soil,

column.name: text
column.value: but he soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for him, he could not be found.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; there is a future for the man of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: But all sinners will be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. I waited patiently for the LORD; he turned to me and heard my cry.

column.name: text
column.value: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; he set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.

column.name: text
column.value: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders you have done. The things you planned for us no one can recount to you; were I to speak and tell of them, they would be too many to declare.

column.name: text
column.value: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but my ears you have pierced; burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, "Here I am, I have come--it is written about me in the scroll.

column.name: text
column.value: I desire to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart."

column.name: text
column.value: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, as you know, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and salvation. I do not conceal your love and your truth from the great assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not withhold your mercy from me, O LORD; may your love and your truth always protect me.

column.name: text
column.value: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.

column.name: text
column.value: Be pleased, O LORD, to save me; O LORD, come quickly to help me.

column.name: text
column.value: May all who seek to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" be appalled at their own shame.

column.name: text
column.value: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, "The LORD be exalted!"

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. I said, "I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth as long as the wicked are in my presence."

column.name: text
column.value: But when I was silent and still, not even saying anything good, my anguish increased.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart grew hot within me, and as I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:

column.name: text
column.value: "Show me, O LORD, my life's end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting is my life.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Each man's life is but a breath. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Man is a mere phantom as he goes to and fro: He bustles about, but only in vain; he heaps up wealth, not knowing who will get it.

column.name: text
column.value: "But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.

column.name: text
column.value: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.

column.name: text
column.value: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: You rebuke and discipline men for their sin; you consume their wealth like a moth--each man is but a breath. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: "Hear my prayer, O LORD, listen to my cry for help; be not deaf to my weeping. For I dwell with you as an alien, a stranger, as all my fathers were.

column.name: text
column.value: Look away from me, that I may rejoice again before I depart and am no more."

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. Blessed is he who has regard for the weak; the LORD delivers him in times of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will protect him and preserve his life; he will bless him in the land and not surrender him to the desire of his foes.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed and restore him from his bed of illness.

column.name: text
column.value: I said, "O LORD, have mercy on me; heal me, for I have sinned against you."

column.name: text
column.value: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will he die and his name perish?"

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever one comes to see me, he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: "A vile disease has beset him; he will never get up from the place where he lies."

column.name: text
column.value: Even my close friend, whom I trusted, he who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O LORD, have mercy on me; raise me up, that I may repay them.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that you are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

column.name: text
column.value: In my integrity you uphold me and set me in your presence forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A maskil of the Sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, O God.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?

column.name: text
column.value: My tears have been my food day and night, while men say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

column.name: text
column.value: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God, with shouts of joy and thanksgiving among the festive throng.

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and

column.name: text
column.value: my God. My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon--from Mount Mizar.

column.name: text
column.value: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.

column.name: text
column.value: By day the LORD directs his love, at night his song is with me--a prayer to the God of my life.

column.name: text
column.value: I say to God my Rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?"

column.name: text
column.value: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; rescue me from deceitful and wicked men.

column.name: text
column.value: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

column.name: text
column.value: Send forth your light and your truth, let them guide me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the harp, O God, my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!

column.name: text
column.value: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.

column.name: text
column.value: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD amid the sounding of trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.

column.name: text
column.value: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.

column.name: text
column.value: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on his holy throne.

column.name: text
column.value: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. According to alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

column.name: text
column.value: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.

column.name: text
column.value: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Come and see the works of the LORD, the desolations he has brought on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear, he burns the shields with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"Lilies." Of the Sons of Korah. A maskil. A wedding song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

column.name: text
column.value: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Gird your sword upon your side, O mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in behalf of truth, humility and righteousness; let your right hand display awesome deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king's enemies; let the nations fall beneath your feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.

column.name: text
column.value: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, O daughter, consider and give ear: Forget your people and your father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: The king is enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.

column.name: text
column.value: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift, men of wealth will seek your favor.

column.name: text
column.value: All glorious is the princess within her chamber; her gown is interwoven with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her and are brought to you.

column.name: text
column.value: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: A song. A psalm of the Sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: It is beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth. Like the utmost heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.

column.name: text
column.value: God is in her citadels; he has shown himself to be her fortress.

column.name: text
column.value: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,

column.name: text
column.value: they saw her and were astounded; they fled in terror.

column.name: text
column.value: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.

column.name: text
column.value: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.

column.name: text
column.value: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD Almighty, in the city of our God: God makes her secure forever. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.

column.name: text
column.value: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,

column.name: text
column.value: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.

column.name: text
column.value: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A maskil. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.

column.name: text
column.value: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our fathers; you crushed the peoples and made our fathers flourish.

column.name: text
column.value: It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.

column.name: text
column.value: You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not trust in my bow, my sword does not bring me victory;

column.name: text
column.value: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.

column.name: text
column.value: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.

column.name: text
column.value: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.

column.name: text
column.value: My disgrace is before me all day long, and my face is covered with shame

column.name: text
column.value: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.

column.name: text
column.value: All this happened to us, though we had not forgotten you or been false to your covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.

column.name: text
column.value: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals and covered us over with deep darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

column.name: text
column.value: would not God have discovered it, since he knows the secrets of the heart?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, O Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?

column.name: text
column.value: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up and help us; redeem us because of your unfailing love.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,

column.name: text
column.value: both low and high, rich and poor alike:

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the utterance from my heart will give understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:

column.name: text
column.value: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me--

column.name: text
column.value: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?

column.name: text
column.value: No man can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for him--

column.name: text
column.value: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough--

column.name: text
column.value: that he should live on forever and not see decay.

column.name: text
column.value: For all can see that wise men die; the foolish and the senseless alike perish and leave their wealth to others.

column.name: text
column.value: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: But man, despite his riches, does not endure; he is like the beasts that perish.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Like sheep they are destined for the grave, and death will feed on them. The upright will rule over them in the morning; their forms will decay in the grave, far from their princely mansions.

column.name: text
column.value: But God will redeem my life from the grave; he will surely take me to himself. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be overawed when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases;

column.name: text
column.value: for he will take nothing with him when he dies, his splendor will not descend with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Though while he lived he counted himself blessed--and men praise you when you prosper--

column.name: text
column.value: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of life.

column.name: text
column.value: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to the place where it sets.

column.name: text
column.value: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

column.name: text
column.value: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before him, and around him a tempest rages.

column.name: text
column.value: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that he may judge his people:

column.name: text
column.value: "Gather to me my consecrated ones, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

column.name: text
column.value: And the heavens proclaim his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: "Hear, O my people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices or your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have no need of a bull from your stall or of goats from your pens,

column.name: text
column.value: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

column.name: text
column.value: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are mine.

column.name: text
column.value: If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?

column.name: text
column.value: Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,

column.name: text
column.value: and call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me."

column.name: text
column.value: But to the wicked, God says: "What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?

column.name: text
column.value: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.

column.name: text
column.value: When you see a thief, you join with him; you throw in your lot with adulterers.

column.name: text
column.value: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: You speak continually against your brother and slander your own mother's son.

column.name: text
column.value: These things you have done and I kept silent; you thought I was altogether like you. But I will rebuke you and accuse you to your face.

column.name: text
column.value: "Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with none to rescue:

column.name: text
column.value: He who sacrifices thank offerings honors me, and he prepares the way so that I may show him the salvation of God."

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. When the prophet Nathan came to him after David had committed adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.

column.name: text
column.value: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight, so that you are proved right when you speak and justified when you judge.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely you desire truth in the inner parts; you teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

column.name: text
column.value: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

column.name: text
column.value: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will turn back to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Save me from bloodguilt, O God, the God who saves me, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.

column.name: text
column.value: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

column.name: text
column.value: In your good pleasure make Zion prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there will be righteous sacrifices, whole burnt offerings to delight you; then bulls will be offered on your altar.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A maskil of David. When Doeg the Edomite had gone to Saul and told him: "David has gone to the house of Ahimelech." Why do you boast of evil, you mighty man? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

column.name: text
column.value: Your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor, you who practice deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You love every harmful word, O you deceitful tongue!

column.name: text
column.value: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and tear you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: "Here now is the man who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!"

column.name: text
column.value: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God's unfailing love for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise you forever for what you have done; in your name I will hope, for your name is good. I will praise you in the presence of your saints.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. When the Ziphites had gone to Saul and said, "Is not David hiding among us?" Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Strangers are attacking me; ruthless men seek my life--men without regard for God. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.

column.name: text
column.value: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, O LORD, for it is good.

column.name: text
column.value: For he has delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. According to mahalath. A maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.

column.name: text
column.value: God looks down from heaven on the sons of men to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone has turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

column.name: text
column.value: Will the evildoers never learn--those who devour my people as men eat bread and who do not call on God?

column.name: text
column.value: There they were, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;

column.name: text
column.value: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught

column.name: text
column.value: at the voice of the enemy, at the stares of the wicked; for they bring down suffering upon me and revile me in their anger.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death assail me.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.

column.name: text
column.value: I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest--

column.name: text
column.value: I would flee far away and stay in the desert; Selah

column.name: text
column.value: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm."

column.name: text
column.value: Confuse the wicked, O Lord, confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.

column.name: text
column.value: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.

column.name: text
column.value: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were raising himself against me, I could hide from him.

column.name: text
column.value: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,

column.name: text
column.value: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship as we walked with the throng at the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the grave, for evil finds lodging among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.

column.name: text
column.value: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.

column.name: text
column.value: He ransoms me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

column.name: text
column.value: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear them and afflict them--Selah men who never change their ways and have no fear of God.

column.name: text
column.value: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: His speech is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.

column.name: text
column.value: Cast your cares on the LORD and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous fall.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of corruption; bloodthirsty and deceitful men will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"A Dove on Distant Oaks." Of David. A miktam. When the Philistines had seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men hotly pursue me; all day long they press their attack.

column.name: text
column.value: My slanderers pursue me all day long; many are attacking me in their pride.

column.name: text
column.value: When I am afraid, I will trust in you.

column.name: text
column.value: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can mortal man do to me?

column.name: text
column.value: All day long they twist my words; they are always plotting to harm me.

column.name: text
column.value: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, eager to take my life.

column.name: text
column.value: On no account let them escape; in your anger, O God, bring down the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Record my lament; list my tears on your scroll--are they not in your record?

column.name: text
column.value: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.

column.name: text
column.value: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise--

column.name: text
column.value: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

column.name: text
column.value: I am under vows to you, O God; I will present my thank offerings to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"Do Not Destroy." Of David. A miktam. When he had fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, for in you my soul takes refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.

column.name: text
column.value: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who fulfills his purpose for me.

column.name: text
column.value: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me; Selah God sends his love and his faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: I am in the midst of lions; I lie among ravenous beasts--men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: They spread a net for my feet--I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path--but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise you, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"Do Not Destroy." Of David. A miktam. Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge uprightly among men?

column.name: text
column.value: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward and speak lies.

column.name: text
column.value: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,

column.name: text
column.value: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.

column.name: text
column.value: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; tear out, O LORD, the fangs of the lions!

column.name: text
column.value: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows be blunted.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a slug melting away as it moves along, like a stillborn child, may they not see the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns--whether they be green or dry--the wicked will be swept away.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Then men will say, "Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God who judges the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"Do Not Destroy." Of David. A miktam. When Saul had sent men to watch David's house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O God; protect me from those who rise up against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from bloodthirsty men.

column.name: text
column.value: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Arise to help me; look on my plight!

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to wicked traitors. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

column.name: text
column.value: See what they spew from their mouths--they spew out swords from their lips, and they say, "Who can hear us?"

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O LORD, laugh at them; you scoff at all those nations.

column.name: text
column.value: O my Strength, I watch for you; you, O God, are my fortress,

column.name: text
column.value: my loving God. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.

column.name: text
column.value: But do not kill them, O Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In your might make them wander about, and bring them down.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,

column.name: text
column.value: consume them in wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

column.name: text
column.value: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love; for you are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: O my Strength, I sing praise to you; you, O God, are my fortress, my loving God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"The Lily of the Covenant." A miktam of David. For teaching. When he fought Aram Naharaim and Aram Zobah, and when Joab returned and struck down twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, O God, and burst forth upon us; you have been angry--now restore us!

column.name: text
column.value: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.

column.name: text
column.value: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

column.name: text
column.value: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.

column.name: text
column.value: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.

column.name: text
column.value: Moab is my washbasin, upon Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

column.name: text
column.value: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not you, O God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

column.name: text
column.value: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

column.name: text
column.value: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.

column.name: text
column.value: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: For you have heard my vows, O God; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Increase the days of the king's life, his years for many generations.

column.name: text
column.value: May he be enthroned in God's presence forever; appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I ever sing praise to your name and fulfill my vows day after day.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. My soul finds rest in God alone; my salvation comes from him.

column.name: text
column.value: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down--this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

column.name: text
column.value: They fully intend to topple him from his lofty place; they take delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Find rest, O my soul, in God alone; my hope comes from him.

column.name: text
column.value: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: My salvation and my honor depend on God; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Lowborn men are but a breath, the highborn are but a lie; if weighed on a balance, they are nothing; together they are only a breath.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not trust in extortion or take pride in stolen goods; though your riches increase, do not set your heart on them.

column.name: text
column.value: One thing God has spoken, two things have I heard: that you, O God, are strong,

column.name: text
column.value: and that you, O Lord, are loving. Surely you will reward each person according to what he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. When he was in the Desert of Judah. O God, you are my God, earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land where there is no water.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul will be satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.

column.name: text
column.value: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.

column.name: text
column.value: They who seek my life will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.

column.name: text
column.value: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God's name will praise him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. Hear me, O God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from that noisy crowd of evildoers.

column.name: text
column.value: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their words like deadly arrows.

column.name: text
column.value: They shoot from ambush at the innocent man; they shoot at him suddenly, without fear.

column.name: text
column.value: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, "Who will see them?"

column.name: text
column.value: They plot injustice and say, "We have devised a perfect plan!" Surely the mind and heart of man are cunning.

column.name: text
column.value: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be struck down.

column.name: text
column.value: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.

column.name: text
column.value: All mankind will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him; let all the upright in heart praise him!

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: O you who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

column.name: text
column.value: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: You answer us with awesome deeds of righteousness, O God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,

column.name: text
column.value: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,

column.name: text
column.value: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Those living far away fear your wonders; where morning dawns and evening fades you call forth songs of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.

column.name: text
column.value: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

column.name: text
column.value: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: The grasslands of the desert overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.

column.name: text
column.value: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A song. A psalm. Shout with joy to God, all the earth!

column.name: text
column.value: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious!

column.name: text
column.value: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.

column.name: text
column.value: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing praise to your name." Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Come and see what God has done, how awesome his works in man's behalf!

column.name: text
column.value: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot--come, let us rejoice in him.

column.name: text
column.value: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations--let not the rebellious rise up against him. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Praise our God, O peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;

column.name: text
column.value: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.

column.name: text
column.value: For you, O God, tested us; you refined us like silver.

column.name: text
column.value: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.

column.name: text
column.value: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you--

column.name: text
column.value: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Come and listen, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.

column.name: text
column.value: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;

column.name: text
column.value: but God has surely listened and heard my voice in prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine upon us, Selah

column.name: text
column.value: that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: May the peoples praise you, O God; may all the peoples praise you.

column.name: text
column.value: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples justly and guide the nations of the earth. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: May the peoples praise you, O God; may all the peoples praise you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the land will yield its harvest, and God, our God, will bless us.

column.name: text
column.value: God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. A song. May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.

column.name: text
column.value: As smoke is blown away by the wind, may you blow them away; as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.

column.name: text
column.value: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to God, sing praise to his name, extol him who rides on the clouds--his name is the LORD--and rejoice before him.

column.name: text
column.value: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.

column.name: text
column.value: God sets the lonely in families, he leads forth the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.

column.name: text
column.value: When you went out before your people, O God, when you marched through the wasteland, Selah

column.name: text
column.value: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: You gave abundant showers, O God; you refreshed your weary inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Your people settled in it, and from your bounty, O God, you provided for the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord announced the word, and great was the company of those who proclaimed it:

column.name: text
column.value: "Kings and armies flee in haste; in the camps men divide the plunder.

column.name: text
column.value: Even while you sleep among the campfires, the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver, its feathers with shining gold."

column.name: text
column.value: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Zalmon.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains; rugged are the mountains of Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: Why gaze in envy, O rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the LORD himself will dwell forever?

column.name: text
column.value: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai into his sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: When you ascended on high, you led captives in your train; you received gifts from men, even from the rebellious--that you, O LORD God, might dwell there.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Our God is a God who saves; from the Sovereign LORD comes escape from death.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord says, "I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: that you may plunge your feet in the blood of your foes, while the tongues of your dogs have their share."

column.name: text
column.value: Your procession has come into view, O God, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the maidens playing tambourines.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the LORD in the assembly of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah's princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: Summon your power, O God; show us your strength, O God, as you have done before.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring you gifts.

column.name: text
column.value: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

column.name: text
column.value: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord, Selah

column.name: text
column.value: to him who rides the ancient skies above, who thunders with mighty voice.

column.name: text
column.value: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: You are awesome, O God, in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"Lilies." Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.

column.name: text
column.value: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.

column.name: text
column.value: You know my folly, O God; my guilt is not hidden from you.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me, O Lord, the LORD Almighty; may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me, O God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.

column.name: text
column.value: I am a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my own mother's sons;

column.name: text
column.value: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;

column.name: text
column.value: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.

column.name: text
column.value: But I pray to you, O LORD, in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.

column.name: text
column.value: Answer me, O LORD, out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: Come near and rescue me; redeem me because of my foes.

column.name: text
column.value: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.

column.name: text
column.value: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.

column.name: text
column.value: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.

column.name: text
column.value: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.

column.name: text
column.value: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: I am in pain and distress; may your salvation, O God, protect me.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise God's name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.

column.name: text
column.value: This will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hoofs.

column.name: text
column.value: The poor will see and be glad--you who seek God, may your hearts live!

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.

column.name: text
column.value: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,

column.name: text
column.value: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;

column.name: text
column.value: the children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Solomon. Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: He will judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains will bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: He will defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; he will crush the oppressor.

column.name: text
column.value: He will endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days the righteous will flourish; prosperity will abound till the moon is no more.

column.name: text
column.value: He will rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The desert tribes will bow before him and his enemies will lick the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of Tarshish and of distant shores will bring tribute to him; the kings of Sheba and Seba will present him gifts.

column.name: text
column.value: All kings will bow down to him and all nations will serve him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.

column.name: text
column.value: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.

column.name: text
column.value: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him and bless him all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Let grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. Let its fruit flourish like Lebanon; let it thrive like the grass of the field.

column.name: text
