column.value: May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. All nations will be blessed through him, and they will call him blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David. A petition. Hasten, O God, to save me; O LORD, come quickly to help me.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who seek my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" turn back because of their shame.

column.name: text
column.value: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, "Let God be exalted!"

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.

column.name: text
column.value: In you, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue me and deliver me in your righteousness; turn your ear to me and save me.

column.name: text
column.value: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

column.name: text
column.value: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of evil and cruel men.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have been my hope, O Sovereign LORD, my confidence since my youth.

column.name: text
column.value: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother's womb. I will ever praise you.

column.name: text
column.value: I have become like a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.

column.name: text
column.value: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.

column.name: text
column.value: They say, "God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him."

column.name: text
column.value: Be not far from me, O God; come quickly, O my God, to help me.

column.name: text
column.value: May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth will tell of your righteousness, of your salvation all day long, though I know not its measure.

column.name: text
column.value: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, O Sovereign LORD; I will proclaim your righteousness, yours alone.

column.name: text
column.value: Since my youth, O God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, till I declare your power to the next generation, your might to all who are to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Your righteousness reaches to the skies, O God, you who have done great things. Who, O God, is like you?

column.name: text
column.value: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.

column.name: text
column.value: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to you with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to you--I, whom you have redeemed.

column.name: text
column.value: My tongue will tell of your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.

column.name: text
column.value: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.

column.name: text
column.value: They are free from the burdens common to man; they are not plagued by human ills.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.

column.name: text
column.value: From their callous hearts comes iniquity; the evil conceits of their minds know no limits.

column.name: text
column.value: They scoff, and speak with malice; in their arrogance they threaten oppression.

column.name: text
column.value: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: They say, "How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?"

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the wicked are like--always carefree, they increase in wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely in vain have I kept my heart pure; in vain have I washed my hands in innocence.

column.name: text
column.value: All day long I have been plagued; I have been punished every morning.

column.name: text
column.value: If I had said, "I will speak thus," I would have betrayed your children.

column.name: text
column.value: When I tried to understand all this, it was oppressive to me

column.name: text
column.value: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!

column.name: text
column.value: As a dream when one awakes, so when you arise, O Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.

column.name: text
column.value: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,

column.name: text
column.value: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

column.name: text
column.value: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Sovereign LORD my refuge; I will tell of all your deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: A maskil of Asaph. Why have you rejected us forever, O God? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the people you purchased of old, the tribe of your inheritance, whom you redeemed--Mount Zion, where you dwelt.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Your foes roared in the place where you met with us; they set up their standards as signs.

column.name: text
column.value: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.

column.name: text
column.value: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.

column.name: text
column.value: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.

column.name: text
column.value: They said in their hearts, "We will crush them completely!" They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: We are given no miraculous signs; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.

column.name: text
column.value: How long will the enemy mock you, O God? Will the foe revile your name forever?

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O God, are my king from of old; you bring salvation upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave him as food to the creatures of the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever flowing rivers.

column.name: text
column.value: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.

column.name: text
column.value: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, O LORD, how foolish people have reviled your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Have regard for your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, O God, and defend your cause; remember how fools mock you all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries, the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"Do Not Destroy." A psalm of Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, O God, we give thanks, for your Name is near; men tell of your wonderful deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: You say, "I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge uprightly.

column.name: text
column.value: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: To the arrogant I say, 'Boast no more,' and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horns.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak with outstretched neck.'"

column.name: text
column.value: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt a man.

column.name: text
column.value: But it is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.

column.name: text
column.value: In the hand of the LORD is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song. In Judah God is known; his name is great in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.

column.name: text
column.value: Valiant men lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.

column.name: text
column.value: You alone are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?

column.name: text
column.value: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet--

column.name: text
column.value: when you, O God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Surely your wrath against men brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.

column.name: text
column.value: Make vows to the LORD your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.

column.name: text
column.value: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. For Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A psalm. I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands and my soul refused to be comforted.

column.name: text
column.value: I remembered you, O God, and I groaned; I mused, and my spirit grew faint. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.

column.name: text
column.value: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;

column.name: text
column.value: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart mused and my spirit inquired:

column.name: text
column.value: "Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?

column.name: text
column.value: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?

column.name: text
column.value: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?" Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Then I thought, "To this I will appeal: the years of the right hand of the Most High."

column.name: text
column.value: I will remember the deeds of the LORD; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

column.name: text
column.value: I will meditate on all your works and consider all your mighty deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Your ways, O God, are holy. What god is so great as our God?

column.name: text
column.value: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: The waters saw you, O God, the waters saw you and writhed; the very depths were convulsed.

column.name: text
column.value: The clouds poured down water, the skies resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.

column.name: text
column.value: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

column.name: text
column.value: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.

column.name: text
column.value: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: A maskil of Asaph. O my people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter hidden things, things from of old--

column.name: text
column.value: what we have heard and known, what our fathers have told us.

column.name: text
column.value: We will not hide them from their children; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the LORD, his power, and the wonders he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our forefathers to teach their children,

column.name: text
column.value: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.

column.name: text
column.value: They would not be like their forefathers--a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;

column.name: text
column.value: they did not keep God's covenant and refused to live by his law.

column.name: text
column.value: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.

column.name: text
column.value: He did miracles in the sight of their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

column.name: text
column.value: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand firm like a wall.

column.name: text
column.value: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.

column.name: text
column.value: He split the rocks in the desert and gave them water as abundant as the seas;

column.name: text
column.value: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.

column.name: text
column.value: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.

column.name: text
column.value: They spoke against God, saying, "Can God spread a table in the desert?

column.name: text
column.value: When he struck the rock, water gushed out, and streams flowed abundantly. But can he also give us food? Can he supply meat for his people?"

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD heard them, he was very angry; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;

column.name: text
column.value: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Men ate the bread of angels; he sent them all the food they could eat.

column.name: text
column.value: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and led forth the south wind by his power.

column.name: text
column.value: He rained meat down on them like dust, flying birds like sand on the seashore.

column.name: text
column.value: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: They ate till they had more than enough, for he had given them what they craved.

column.name: text
column.value: But before they turned from the food they craved, even while it was still in their mouths,

column.name: text
column.value: God's anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.

column.name: text
column.value: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever God slew them, they would seek him; they eagerly turned to him again.

column.name: text
column.value: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

column.name: text
column.value: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;

column.name: text
column.value: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he was merciful; he forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time he restrained his anger and did not stir up his full wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

column.name: text
column.value: How often they rebelled against him in the desert and grieved him in the wasteland!

column.name: text
column.value: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: They did not remember his power--the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,

column.name: text
column.value: the day he displayed his miraculous signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned their rivers to blood; they could not drink from their streams.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.

column.name: text
column.value: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.

column.name: text
column.value: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

column.name: text
column.value: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: He unleashed against them his hot anger, his wrath, indignation and hostility--a band of destroying angels.

column.name: text
column.value: He prepared a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.

column.name: text
column.value: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.

column.name: text
column.value: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.

column.name: text
column.value: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

column.name: text
column.value: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: Like their fathers they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.

column.name: text
column.value: They angered him with their high places; they aroused his jealousy with their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: When God heard them, he was very angry; he rejected Israel completely.

column.name: text
column.value: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among men.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent the ark of his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: He gave his people over to the sword; he was very angry with his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Fire consumed their young men, and their maidens had no wedding songs;

column.name: text
column.value: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a man wakes from the stupor of wine.

column.name: text
column.value: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

column.name: text
column.value: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.

column.name: text
column.value: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.

column.name: text
column.value: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;

column.name: text
column.value: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And David shepherded them with integrity of heart; with skillful hands he led them.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.

column.name: text
column.value: They have given the dead bodies of your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of your saints to the beasts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: We are objects of reproach to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.

column.name: text
column.value: How long, O LORD? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?

column.name: text
column.value: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;

column.name: text
column.value: for they have devoured Jacob and destroyed his homeland.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not hold against us the sins of the fathers; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.

column.name: text
column.value: Help us, O God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.

column.name: text
column.value: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; by the strength of your arm preserve those condemned to die.

column.name: text
column.value: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the reproach they have hurled at you, O Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will recount your praise.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. To the tune of"The Lilies of the Covenant." Of Asaph. A psalm. Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock; you who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

column.name: text
column.value: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore us, O God; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD God Almighty, how long will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?

column.name: text
column.value: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made us a source of contention to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore us, O God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.

column.name: text
column.value: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.

column.name: text
column.value: It sent out its boughs to the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.

column.name: text
column.value: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?

column.name: text
column.value: Boars from the forest ravage it and the creatures of the field feed on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Return to us, O God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,

column.name: text
column.value: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore us, O LORD God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. According to gittith. Of Asaph. Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!

column.name: text
column.value: Begin the music, strike the tambourine, play the melodious harp and lyre.

column.name: text
column.value: Sound the ram's horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our Feast;

column.name: text
column.value: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: He established it as a statute for Joseph when he went out against Egypt, where we heard a language we did not understand.

column.name: text
column.value: He says, "I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.

column.name: text
column.value: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: "Hear, O my people, and I will warn you--if you would but listen to me, O Israel!

column.name: text
column.value: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not bow down to an alien god.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.

column.name: text
column.value: "But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.

column.name: text
column.value: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

column.name: text
column.value: "If my people would but listen to me, if Israel would follow my ways,

column.name: text
column.value: how quickly would I subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!

column.name: text
column.value: Those who hate the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

column.name: text
column.value: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. According to gittith. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. How lovely is your dwelling place, O LORD Almighty!

column.name: text
column.value: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young--a place near your altar, O LORD Almighty, my King and my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on pilgrimage.

column.name: text
column.value: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.

column.name: text
column.value: They go from strength to strength, till each appears before God in Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my prayer, O LORD God Almighty; listen to me, O God of Jacob. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Look upon our shield, O God; look with favor on your anointed one.

column.name: text
column.value: Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD God is a sun and shield; the LORD bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD Almighty, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of Asaph. God presides in the great assembly; he gives judgment among the "gods":

column.name: text
column.value: "How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked? Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue the weak and needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: "They know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: "I said, 'You are "gods"; you are all sons of the Most High.'

column.name: text
column.value: But you will die like mere men; you will fall like every other ruler."

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: A song. A psalm of Asaph. O God, do not keep silent; be not quiet, O God, be not still.

column.name: text
column.value: See how your enemies are astir, how your foes rear their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.

column.name: text
column.value: "Come," they say, "let us destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel be remembered no more."

column.name: text
column.value: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you--

column.name: text
column.value: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

column.name: text
column.value: Gebal, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.

column.name: text
column.value: Even Assyria has joined them to lend strength to the descendants of Lot. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

column.name: text
column.value: who perished at Endor and became like refuse on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

column.name: text
column.value: who said, "Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God."

column.name: text
column.value: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

column.name: text
column.value: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.

column.name: text
column.value: Cover their faces with shame so that men will seek your name, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them know that you, whose name is the LORD--that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. You showed favor to your land, O LORD; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore us again, O God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.

column.name: text
column.value: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?

column.name: text
column.value: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

column.name: text
column.value: Show us your unfailing love, O LORD, and grant us your salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; he promises peace to his people, his saints--but let them not return to folly.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.

column.name: text
column.value: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.

column.name: text
column.value: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

column.name: text
column.value: Guard my life, for I am devoted to you. You are my God; save your servant who trusts in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I call to you all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring joy to your servant, for to you, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: You are forgiving and good, O Lord, abounding in love to all who call to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my prayer, O LORD; listen to my cry for mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: In the day of my trouble I will call to you, for you will answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: Among the gods there is none like you, O Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, O Lord; they will bring glory to your name.

column.name: text
column.value: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me your way, O LORD, and I will walk in your truth; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise you, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.

column.name: text
column.value: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths of the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: The arrogant are attacking me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life--men without regard for you.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn to me and have mercy on me; grant your strength to your servant and save the son of your maidservant.

column.name: text
column.value: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. A song. He has set his foundation on the holy mountain;

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Glorious things are said of you, O city of God: Selah

column.name: text
column.value: "I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me--Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush--and will say, 'This one was born in Zion.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will write in the register of the peoples: "This one was born in Zion." Selah

column.name: text
column.value: As they make music they will sing, "All my fountains are in you."

column.name: text
column.value: A song. A psalm of the Sons of Korah. For the director of music. According to mahalath leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD, the God who saves me, day and night I cry out before you.

column.name: text
column.value: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.

column.name: text
column.value: For my soul is full of trouble and my life draws near the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like a man without strength.

column.name: text
column.value: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.

column.name: text
column.value: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

column.name: text
column.value: Your wrath lies heavily upon me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;

column.name: text
column.value: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, O LORD, every day; I spread out my hands to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do those who are dead rise up and praise you? Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction?

column.name: text
column.value: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?

column.name: text
column.value: But I cry to you for help, O LORD; in the morning my prayer comes before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Why, O LORD, do you reject me and hide your face from me?

column.name: text
column.value: From my youth I have been afflicted and close to death; I have suffered your terrors and am in despair.

column.name: text
column.value: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.

column.name: text
column.value: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.

column.name: text
column.value: You have taken my companions and loved ones from me; the darkness is my closest friend.

column.name: text
column.value: A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the LORD'S great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

column.name: text
column.value: You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,

column.name: text
column.value: 'I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.'" Selah

column.name: text
column.value: The heavens praise your wonders, O LORD, your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

column.name: text
column.value: For who in the skies above can compare with the LORD? Who is like the LORD among the heavenly beings?

column.name: text
column.value: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; he is more awesome than all who surround him.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD God Almighty, who is like you? You are mighty, O LORD, and your faithfulness surrounds you.

column.name: text
column.value: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.

column.name: text
column.value: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.

column.name: text
column.value: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Your arm is endued with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They rejoice in your name all day long; they exult in your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: For you are their glory and strength, and by your favor you exalt our horn.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Once you spoke in a vision, to your faithful people you said: "I have bestowed strength on a warrior; I have exalted a young man from among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.

column.name: text
column.value: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.

column.name: text
column.value: No enemy will subject him to tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

column.name: text
column.value: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.

column.name: text
column.value: My faithful love will be with him, and through my name his horn will be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.

column.name: text
column.value: He will call out to me, 'You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.'

column.name: text
column.value: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I will maintain my love to him forever, and my covenant with him will never fail.

column.name: text
column.value: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

column.name: text
column.value: "If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,

column.name: text
column.value: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,

column.name: text
column.value: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;

column.name: text
column.value: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.

column.name: text
column.value: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness--and I will not lie to David--

column.name: text
column.value: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;

column.name: text
column.value: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah

column.name: text
column.value: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.

column.name: text
column.value: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

column.name: text
column.value: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: You have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: How long, O LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?

column.name: text
column.value: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all men!

column.name: text
column.value: What man can live and not see death, or save himself from the power of the grave? Selah

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,

column.name: text
column.value: the taunts with which your enemies have mocked, O LORD, with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the LORD forever! Amen and Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

column.name: text
column.value: You turn men back to dust, saying, "Return to dust, O sons of men."

column.name: text
column.value: For a thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.

column.name: text
column.value: You sweep men away in the sleep of death; they are like the new grass of the morning--

column.name: text
column.value: though in the morning it springs up new, by evening it is dry and withered.

column.name: text
column.value: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

column.name: text
column.value: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of our days is seventy years--or eighty, if we have the strength; yet their span is but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

column.name: text
column.value: Who knows the power of your anger? For your wrath is as great as the fear that is due you.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach us to number our days aright, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Relent, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

column.name: text
column.value: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: May your deeds be shown to your servants, your splendor to their children.

column.name: text
column.value: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish the work of our hands for us--yes, establish the work of our hands.

column.name: text
column.value: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: I will say of the LORD, "He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."

column.name: text
column.value: Surely he will save you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.

column.name: text
column.value: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

column.name: text
column.value: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

column.name: text
column.value: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.

column.name: text
column.value: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: If you make the Most High your dwelling--even the LORD, who is my refuge--

column.name: text
column.value: then no harm will befall you, no disaster will come near your tent.

column.name: text
column.value: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;

column.name: text
column.value: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

column.name: text
column.value: You will tread upon the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.

column.name: text
column.value: "Because he loves me," says the LORD, "I will rescue him; I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.

column.name: text
column.value: He will call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.

column.name: text
column.value: With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation."

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm. A song. For the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD and make music to your name, O Most High,

column.name: text
column.value: to proclaim your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,

column.name: text
column.value: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.

column.name: text
column.value: For you make me glad by your deeds, O LORD; I sing for joy at the works of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: How great are your works, O LORD, how profound your thoughts!

column.name: text
column.value: The senseless man does not know, fools do not understand,

column.name: text
column.value: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O LORD, are exalted forever.

column.name: text
column.value: For surely your enemies, O LORD, surely your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;

column.name: text
column.value: planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,

column.name: text
column.value: proclaiming, "The LORD is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD reigns, he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed in majesty and is armed with strength. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

column.name: text
column.value: Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.

column.name: text
column.value: The seas have lifted up, O LORD, the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.

column.name: text
column.value: Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea--the LORD on high is mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Your statutes stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD is the great God, the great King above all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.

column.name: text
column.value: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;

column.name: text
column.value: for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if you hear his voice,

column.name: text
column.value: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the desert,

column.name: text
column.value: where your fathers tested and tried me, though they had seen what I did.

column.name: text
column.value: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, "They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways."

column.name: text
column.value: So I declared on oath in my anger, "They shall never enter my rest."

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, the God who avenges, O God who avenges, shine forth.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.

column.name: text
column.value: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked be jubilant?

column.name: text
column.value: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.

column.name: text
column.value: They crush your people, O LORD; they oppress your inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: They slay the widow and the alien; they murder the fatherless.

column.name: text
column.value: They say, "The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed."

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?

column.name: text
column.value: Does he who implanted the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?

column.name: text
column.value: Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches man lack knowledge?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD knows the thoughts of man; he knows that they are futile.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man you discipline, O LORD, the man you teach from your law;

column.name: text
column.value: you grant him relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

column.name: text
column.value: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?

column.name: text
column.value: Unless the LORD had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.

column.name: text
column.value: When I said, "My foot is slipping," your love, O LORD, supported me.

column.name: text
column.value: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought joy to my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you--one that brings on misery by its decrees?

column.name: text
column.value: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the LORD our God will destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD, praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: For great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and glory are in his sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.

column.name: text
column.value: Worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns." The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it;

column.name: text
column.value: let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy;

column.name: text
column.value: they will sing before the LORD, for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his truth.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

column.name: text
column.value: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols--worship him, all you gods!

column.name: text
column.value: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For you, O LORD, are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Let those who love the LORD hate evil, for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Light is shed upon the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice in the LORD, you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;

column.name: text
column.value: make music to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,

column.name: text
column.value: with trumpets and the blast of the ram's horn--shout for joy before the LORD, the King.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;

column.name: text
column.value: let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.

column.name: text
column.value: Great is the LORD in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them praise your great and awesome name--he is holy.

column.name: text
column.value: The King is mighty, he loves justice--you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.

column.name: text
column.value: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the LORD and he answered them.

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm. For giving thanks. Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Worship the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.

column.name: text
column.value: Know that the LORD is God. It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

column.name: text
column.value: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. A psalm. I will sing of your love and justice; to you, O LORD, I will sing praise.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be careful to lead a blameless life--when will you come to me? I will walk in my house with blameless heart.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set before my eyes no vile thing. The deeds of faithless men I hate; they will not cling to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Men of perverse heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, him will I put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, him will I not endure.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; he whose walk is blameless will minister to me.

column.name: text
column.value: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A prayer of an afflicted man. When he is faint and pours out his lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of my loud groaning I am reduced to skin and bones.

column.name: text
column.value: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.

column.name: text
column.value: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.

column.name: text
column.value: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears

column.name: text
column.value: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.

column.name: text
column.value: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.

column.name: text
column.value: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations will fear the name of the LORD, all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.

column.name: text
column.value: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "The LORD looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."

column.name: text
column.value: So the name of the LORD will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem

column.name: text
column.value: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.

column.name: text
column.value: So I said: "Do not take me away, O my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.

column.name: text
column.value: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you."

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. Praise the LORD, O my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits--

column.name: text
column.value: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,

column.name: text
column.value: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,

column.name: text
column.value: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

column.name: text
column.value: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.

column.name: text
column.value: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;

column.name: text
column.value: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;

column.name: text
column.value: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

column.name: text
column.value: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him;

column.name: text
column.value: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.

column.name: text
column.value: As for man, his days are like grass, he flourishes like a flower of the field;

column.name: text
column.value: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.

column.name: text
column.value: But from everlasting to everlasting the LORD'S love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children's children--

column.name: text
column.value: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: He wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent

column.name: text
column.value: and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.

column.name: text
column.value: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;

column.name: text
column.value: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.

column.name: text
column.value: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: The birds of the air nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.

column.name: text
column.value: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of his work.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for man to cultivate--bringing forth food from the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil to make his face shine, and bread that sustains his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: The trees of the LORD are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

column.name: text
column.value: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the pine trees.

column.name: text
column.value: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the coneys.

column.name: text
column.value: The moon marks off the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.

column.name: text
column.value: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.

column.name: text
column.value: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.

column.name: text
column.value: Then man goes out to his work, to his labor until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: How many are your works, O LORD! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

column.name: text
column.value: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number--living things both large and small.

column.name: text
column.value: There the ships go to and fro, and the leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.

column.name: text
column.value: These all look to you to give them their food at the proper time.

column.name: text
column.value: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

column.name: text
column.value: When you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in his works--

column.name: text
column.value: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

column.name: text
column.value: May my meditation be pleasing to him, as I rejoice in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

column.name: text
column.value: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: Look to the LORD and his strength; seek his face always.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

column.name: text
column.value: O descendants of Abraham his servant, O sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

column.name: text
column.value: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded, for a thousand generations,

column.name: text
column.value: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

column.name: text
column.value: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

column.name: text
column.value: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

column.name: text
column.value: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

column.name: text
column.value: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."

column.name: text
column.value: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;

column.name: text
column.value: and he sent a man before them--Joseph, sold as a slave.

column.name: text
column.value: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,

column.name: text
column.value: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the LORD proved him true.

column.name: text
column.value: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.

column.name: text
column.value: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,

column.name: text
column.value: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob lived as an alien in the land of Ham.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,

column.name: text
column.value: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

column.name: text
column.value: They performed his miraculous signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent darkness and made the land dark--for had they not rebelled against his words?

column.name: text
column.value: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.

column.name: text
column.value: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;

column.name: text
column.value: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;

column.name: text
column.value: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.

column.name: text
column.value: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.

column.name: text
column.value: They asked, and he brought them quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; like a river it flowed in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

column.name: text
column.value: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for--

column.name: text
column.value: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the LORD or fully declare his praise?

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are they who maintain justice, who constantly do what is right.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember me, O LORD, when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,

column.name: text
column.value: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.

column.name: text
column.value: We have sinned, even as our fathers did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

column.name: text
column.value: When our fathers were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.
