column.name: text
column.value: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, to make his mighty power known.

column.name: text
column.value: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.

column.name: text
column.value: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.

column.name: text
column.value: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.

column.name: text
column.value: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his counsel.

column.name: text
column.value: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wasteland they put God to the test.

column.name: text
column.value: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.

column.name: text
column.value: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.

column.name: text
column.value: They exchanged their Glory for an image of a bull, which eats grass.

column.name: text
column.value: They forgot the God who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

column.name: text
column.value: So he said he would destroy them--had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.

column.name: text
column.value: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the desert,

column.name: text
column.value: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

column.name: text
column.value: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;

column.name: text
column.value: they provoked the LORD to anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.

column.name: text
column.value: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

column.name: text
column.value: By the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them;

column.name: text
column.value: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses' lips.

column.name: text
column.value: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,

column.name: text
column.value: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

column.name: text
column.value: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

column.name: text
column.value: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

column.name: text
column.value: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.

column.name: text
column.value: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: He handed them over to the nations, and their foes ruled over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.

column.name: text
column.value: Many times he delivered them, but they were bent on rebellion and they wasted away in their sin.

column.name: text
column.value: But he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;

column.name: text
column.value: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.

column.name: text
column.value: He caused them to be pitied by all who held them captive.

column.name: text
column.value: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A song. A psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise you, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: For great is your love, higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, and let your glory be over all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.

column.name: text
column.value: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.

column.name: text
column.value: Moab is my washbasin, upon Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

column.name: text
column.value: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not you, O God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

column.name: text
column.value: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

column.name: text
column.value: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the redeemed of the LORD say this--those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,

column.name: text
column.value: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.

column.name: text
column.value: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.

column.name: text
column.value: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.

column.name: text
column.value: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men,

column.name: text
column.value: for he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

column.name: text
column.value: Some sat in darkness and the deepest gloom, prisoners suffering in iron chains,

column.name: text
column.value: for they had rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought them out of darkness and the deepest gloom and broke away their chains.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men,

column.name: text
column.value: for he breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.

column.name: text
column.value: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: They loathed all food and drew near the gates of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent forth his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them sacrifice thank offerings and tell of his works with songs of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Others went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.

column.name: text
column.value: They saw the works of the LORD, his wonderful deeds in the deep.

column.name: text
column.value: For he spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.

column.name: text
column.value: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.

column.name: text
column.value: They reeled and staggered like drunken men; they were at their wits' end.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.

column.name: text
column.value: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.

column.name: text
column.value: They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to their desired haven.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the council of the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,

column.name: text
column.value: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who lived there.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;

column.name: text
column.value: there he brought the hungry to live, and they founded a city where they could settle.

column.name: text
column.value: They sowed fields and planted vineyards that yielded a fruitful harvest;

column.name: text
column.value: he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased, and he did not let their herds diminish.

column.name: text
column.value: Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled by oppression, calamity and sorrow;

column.name: text
column.value: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.

column.name: text
column.value: But he lifted the needy out of their affliction and increased their families like flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: The upright see and rejoice, but all the wicked shut their mouths.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever is wise, let him heed these things and consider the great love of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. O God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,

column.name: text
column.value: for wicked and deceitful men have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.

column.name: text
column.value: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.

column.name: text
column.value: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.

column.name: text
column.value: Appoint an evil man to oppose him; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.

column.name: text
column.value: May his days be few; may another take his place of leadership.

column.name: text
column.value: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

column.name: text
column.value: May his children be wandering beggars; may they be driven from their ruined homes.

column.name: text
column.value: May a creditor seize all he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

column.name: text
column.value: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.

column.name: text
column.value: May his descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.

column.name: text
column.value: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

column.name: text
column.value: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.

column.name: text
column.value: He loved to pronounce a curse--may it come on him; he found no pleasure in blessing--may it be far from him.

column.name: text
column.value: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.

column.name: text
column.value: May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.

column.name: text
column.value: May this be the LORD'S payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil of me.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, O Sovereign LORD, deal well with me for your name's sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

column.name: text
column.value: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

column.name: text
column.value: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.

column.name: text
column.value: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Help me, O LORD my God; save me in accordance with your love.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, O LORD, have done it.

column.name: text
column.value: They may curse, but you will bless; when they attack they will be put to shame, but your servant will rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: My accusers will be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

column.name: text
column.value: With my mouth I will greatly extol the LORD; in the great throng I will praise him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save his life from those who condemn him.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. A psalm. The LORD says to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will extend your mighty scepter from Zion; you will rule in the midst of your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Your troops will be willing on your day of battle. Arrayed in holy majesty, from the womb of the dawn you will receive the dew of your youth.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has sworn and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord is at your right hand; he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He will drink from a brook beside the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. I will extol the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Glorious and majestic are his deeds, and his righteousness endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: He has caused his wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

column.name: text
column.value: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.

column.name: text
column.value: He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the lands of other nations.

column.name: text
column.value: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.

column.name: text
column.value: They are steadfast for ever and ever, done in faithfulness and uprightness.

column.name: text
column.value: He provided redemption for his people; he ordained his covenant forever--holy and awesome is his name.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who finds great delight in his commands.

column.name: text
column.value: His children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for the gracious and compassionate and righteous man.

column.name: text
column.value: Good will come to him who is generous and lends freely, who conducts his affairs with justice.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely he will never be shaken; a righteous man will be remembered forever.

column.name: text
column.value: He will have no fear of bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: His heart is secure, he will have no fear; in the end he will look in triumph on his foes.

column.name: text
column.value: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor, his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked man will see and be vexed, he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Praise, O servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the name of the LORD be praised, both now and forevermore.

column.name: text
column.value: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the LORD is to be praised.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is like the LORD our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,

column.name: text
column.value: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

column.name: text
column.value: he seats them with princes, with the princes of their people.

column.name: text
column.value: He settles the barren woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Not to us, O LORD, not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do the nations say, "Where is their God?"

column.name: text
column.value: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.

column.name: text
column.value: But their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

column.name: text
column.value: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but they cannot see;

column.name: text
column.value: they have ears, but cannot hear, noses, but they cannot smell;

column.name: text
column.value: they have hands, but cannot feel, feet, but they cannot walk; nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

column.name: text
column.value: O house of Israel, trust in the LORD--he is their help and shield.

column.name: text
column.value: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD--he is their help and shield.

column.name: text
column.value: You who fear him, trust in the LORD--he is their help and shield.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD remembers us and will bless us: He will bless the house of Israel, he will bless the house of Aaron,

column.name: text
column.value: he will bless those who fear the LORD--small and great alike.

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD make you increase, both you and your children.

column.name: text
column.value: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth he has given to man.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, those who go down to silence;

column.name: text
column.value: it is we who extol the LORD, both now and forevermore. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When Israel came out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

column.name: text
column.value: Judah became God's sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

column.name: text
column.value: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;

column.name: text
column.value: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

column.name: text
column.value: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,

column.name: text
column.value: you mountains, that you skipped like rams, you hills, like lambs?

column.name: text
column.value: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

column.name: text
column.value: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.

column.name: text
column.value: I love the LORD, for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.

column.name: text
column.value: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came upon me; I was overcome by trouble and sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I called on the name of the LORD: "O LORD, save me!"

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD protects the simplehearted; when I was in great need, he saved me.

column.name: text
column.value: Be at rest once more, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For you, O LORD, have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,

column.name: text
column.value: that I may walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: I believed; therefore I said, "I am greatly afflicted."

column.name: text
column.value: And in my dismay I said, "All men are liars."

column.name: text
column.value: How can I repay the LORD for all his goodness to me?

column.name: text
column.value: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your maidservant; you have freed me from my chains.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people,

column.name: text
column.value: in the courts of the house of the LORD--in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Let Israel say: "His love endures forever."

column.name: text
column.value: Let the house of Aaron say: "His love endures forever."

column.name: text
column.value: Let those who fear the LORD say: "His love endures forever."

column.name: text
column.value: In my anguish I cried to the LORD, and he answered by setting me free.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is with me; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is with me; he is my helper. I will look in triumph on my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.

column.name: text
column.value: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

column.name: text
column.value: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

column.name: text
column.value: They swarmed around me like bees, but they died out as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

column.name: text
column.value: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the LORD helped me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: "The LORD'S right hand has done mighty things!

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD'S right hand is lifted high; the LORD'S right hand has done mighty things!"

column.name: text
column.value: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the LORD has done.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Open for me the gates of righteousness; I will enter and give thanks to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the gate of the LORD through which the righteous may enter.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give you thanks, for you answered me; you have become my salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone;

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, save us; O LORD, grant us success.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is God, and he has made his light shine upon us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: You are my God, and I will give you thanks; you are my God, and I will exalt you.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are they whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are they who keep his statutes and seek him with all their heart.

column.name: text
column.value: They do nothing wrong; they walk in his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that my ways were steadfast in obeying your decrees!

column.name: text
column.value: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.

column.name: text
column.value: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.

column.name: text
column.value: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

column.name: text
column.value: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to you, O LORD; teach me your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.

column.name: text
column.value: I meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Do good to your servant, and I will live; I will obey your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.

column.name: text
column.value: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.

column.name: text
column.value: You rebuke the arrogant, who are cursed and who stray from your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: Remove from me scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.

column.name: text
column.value: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.

column.name: text
column.value: I recounted my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts; then I will meditate on your wonders.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me through your law.

column.name: text
column.value: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set my heart on your laws.

column.name: text
column.value: I hold fast to your statutes, O LORD; do not let me be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: I run in the path of your commands, for you have set my heart free.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me, O LORD, to follow your decrees; then I will keep them to the end.

column.name: text
column.value: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law and obey it with all my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.

column.name: text
column.value: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.

column.name: text
column.value: How I long for your precepts! Preserve my life in your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: May your unfailing love come to me, O LORD, your salvation according to your promise;

column.name: text
column.value: then I will answer the one who taunts me, for I trust in your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not snatch the word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.

column.name: text
column.value: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,

column.name: text
column.value: for I delight in your commands because I love them.

column.name: text
column.value: I lift up my hands to your commands, which I love, and I meditate on your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.

column.name: text
column.value: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.

column.name: text
column.value: The arrogant mock me without restraint, but I do not turn from your law.

column.name: text
column.value: I remember your ancient laws, O LORD, and I find comfort in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.

column.name: text
column.value: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.

column.name: text
column.value: In the night I remember your name, O LORD, and I will keep your law.

column.name: text
column.value: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: You are my portion, O LORD; I have promised to obey your words.

column.name: text
column.value: I have sought your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.

column.name: text
column.value: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.

column.name: text
column.value: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.

column.name: text
column.value: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth is filled with your love, O LORD; teach me your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Do good to your servant according to your word, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I believe in your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.

column.name: text
column.value: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.

column.name: text
column.value: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who fear you rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in your word.

column.name: text
column.value: I know, O LORD, that your laws are righteous, and in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

column.name: text
column.value: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.

column.name: text
column.value: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: May my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"

column.name: text
column.value: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?

column.name: text
column.value: The arrogant dig pitfalls for me, contrary to your law.

column.name: text
column.value: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for men persecute me without cause.

column.name: text
column.value: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: Preserve my life according to your love, and I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Your word, O LORD, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.

column.name: text
column.value: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.

column.name: text
column.value: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.

column.name: text
column.value: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: To all perfection I see a limit; but your commands are boundless.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, for they are ever with me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.

column.name: text
column.value: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.

column.name: text
column.value: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

column.name: text
column.value: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path.

column.name: text
column.value: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light for my path.

column.name: text
column.value: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.

column.name: text
column.value: I have suffered much; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Accept, O LORD, the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.

column.name: text
column.value: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

column.name: text
column.value: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!

column.name: text
column.value: Sustain me according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.

column.name: text
column.value: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.

column.name: text
column.value: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.

column.name: text
column.value: Ensure your servant's well-being; let not the arrogant oppress me.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.

column.name: text
column.value: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: It is time for you to act, O LORD; your law is being broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,

column.name: text
column.value: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path.

column.name: text
column.value: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.

column.name: text
column.value: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

column.name: text
column.value: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.

column.name: text
column.value: Redeem me from the oppression of men, that I may obey your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: Make your face shine upon your servant and teach me your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteous are you, O LORD, and your laws are right.

column.name: text
column.value: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.

column.name: text
column.value: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.

column.name: text
column.value: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.

column.name: text
column.value: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands are my delight.

column.name: text
column.value: Your statutes are forever right; give me understanding that I may live.

column.name: text
column.value: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD, and I will obey your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your laws.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you are near, O LORD, and all your commands are true.

column.name: text
column.value: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Look upon my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.

column.name: text
column.value: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.

column.name: text
column.value: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: Your compassion is great, O LORD; preserve my life according to your laws.

column.name: text
column.value: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.

column.name: text
column.value: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your love.

column.name: text
column.value: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal.

column.name: text
column.value: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.

column.name: text
column.value: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: I hate and abhor falsehood but I love your law.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.

column.name: text
column.value: Great peace have they who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.

column.name: text
column.value: I wait for your salvation, O LORD, and I follow your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you.

column.name: text
column.value: May my cry come before you, O LORD; give me understanding according to your word.

column.name: text
column.value: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.

column.name: text
column.value: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: I long for your salvation, O LORD, and your law is my delight.

column.name: text
column.value: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills--where does my help come from?

column.name: text
column.value: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He will not let your foot slip--he who watches over you will not slumber;

column.name: text
column.value: indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD watches over you--the LORD is your shade at your right hand;

column.name: text
column.value: the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will keep you from all harm--he will watch over your life;

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, to you whose throne is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, till he shows us his mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

column.name: text
column.value: We have endured much ridicule from the proud, much contempt from the arrogant.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side--let Israel say--

column.name: text
column.value: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,

column.name: text
column.value: when their anger flared against us, they would have swallowed us alive;

column.name: text
column.value: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,

column.name: text
column.value: the raging waters would have swept us away.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the LORD, who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: We have escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.

column.name: text
column.value: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. I call on the LORD in my distress, and he answers me.

column.name: text
column.value: Save me, O LORD, from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.

column.name: text
column.value: What will he do to you, and what more besides, O deceitful tongue?

column.name: text
column.value: He will punish you with a warrior's sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom tree.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

column.name: text
column.value: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.

column.name: text
column.value: I am a man of peace; but when I speak, they are for war.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Of David. I rejoiced with those who said to me, "Let us go to the house of the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.

column.name: text
column.value: That is where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, to praise the name of the LORD according to the statute given to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: There the thrones for judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be secure.

column.name: text
column.value: May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels."

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, "Peace be within you."

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people both now and forevermore.

column.name: text
column.value: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. When the LORD brought back the captives to Zion, we were like men who dreamed.

column.name: text
column.value: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore our fortunes, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who sow in tears will reap with songs of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with him.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchmen stand guard in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat--for he grants sleep to those he loves.

column.name: text
column.value: Sons are a heritage from the LORD, children a reward from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are sons born in one's youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their enemies in the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

column.name: text
column.value: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your sons will be like olive shoots around your table.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus is the man blessed who fears the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD bless you from Zion all the days of your life; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: and may you live to see your children's children. Peace be upon Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. They have greatly oppressed me from my youth--let Israel say--

column.name: text
column.value: they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me.

column.name: text
column.value: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

column.name: text
column.value: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;

column.name: text
column.value: with it the reaper cannot fill his hands, nor the one who gathers fill his arms.

column.name: text
column.value: May those who pass by not say, "The blessing of the LORD be upon you; we bless you in the name of the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: If you, O LORD, kept a record of sins, O Lord, who could stand?

column.name: text
column.value: But with you there is forgiveness; therefore you are feared.

column.name: text
column.value: I wait for the LORD, my soul waits, and in his word I put my hope.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is unfailing love and with him is full redemption.

column.name: text
column.value: He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with its mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

column.name: text
column.value: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD both now and forevermore.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. O LORD, remember David and all the hardships he endured.

column.name: text
column.value: He swore an oath to the LORD and made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

column.name: text
column.value: "I will not enter my house or go to my bed--

column.name: text
column.value: I will allow no sleep to my eyes, no slumber to my eyelids,

column.name: text
column.value: till I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

column.name: text
column.value: We heard it in Ephrathah, we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:

column.name: text
column.value: "Let us go to his dwelling place; let us worship at his footstool--

column.name: text
column.value: arise, O LORD, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.

column.name: text
column.value: May your priests be clothed with righteousness; may your saints sing for joy."

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of David your servant, do not reject your anointed one.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD swore an oath to David, a sure oath that he will not revoke: "One of your own descendants I will place on your throne--

column.name: text
column.value: if your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever."

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling:

column.name: text
column.value: "This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it--

column.name: text
column.value: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor will I satisfy with food.

column.name: text
column.value: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will ever sing for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: "Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.

column.name: text
column.value: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown on his head will be resplendent."

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Of David. How good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in unity!

column.name: text
column.value: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron's beard, down upon the collar of his robes.

column.name: text
column.value: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the LORD bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.

column.name: text
column.value: A song of ascents. Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who minister by night in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: There on the poplars we hung our harps,

column.name: text
column.value: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"

column.name: text
column.value: How can we sing the songs of the LORD while in a foreign land?

column.name: text
column.value: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.

column.name: text
column.value: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, O LORD, what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. "Tear it down," they cried, "tear it down to its foundations!"

column.name: text
column.value: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, happy is he who repays you for what you have done to us--

column.name: text
column.value: he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. I will praise you, O LORD, with all my heart; before the "gods" I will sing your praise.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bow down toward your holy temple and will praise your name for your love and your faithfulness, for you have exalted above all things your name and your word.

column.name: text
column.value: When I called, you answered me; you made me bold and stouthearted.

column.name: text
column.value: May all the kings of the earth praise you, O LORD, when they hear the words of your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: May they sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

column.name: text
column.value: Though the LORD is on high, he looks upon the lowly, but the proud he knows from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life; you stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes, with your right hand you save me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me; your love, O LORD, endures forever--do not abandon the works of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. O LORD, you have searched me and you know me.

column.name: text
column.value: You know when I sit and when I rise; you perceive my thoughts from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: You discern my going out and my lying down; you are familiar with all my ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Before a word is on my tongue you know it completely, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You hem me in--behind and before; you have laid your hand upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

column.name: text
column.value: Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?

column.name: text
column.value: If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

column.name: text
column.value: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: even there your hand will guide me, your right hand will hold me fast.

column.name: text
column.value: If I say, "Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me,"

column.name: text
column.value: even the darkness will not be dark to you; the night will shine like the day, for darkness is as light to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb.

column.name: text
column.value: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

column.name: text
column.value: My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place. When I was woven together in the depths of the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: your eyes saw my unformed body. All the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

column.name: text
column.value: How precious to me are your thoughts, O God! How vast is the sum of them!

column.name: text
column.value: Were I to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand. When I awake, I am still with you.

column.name: text
column.value: If only you would slay the wicked, O God! Away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

column.name: text
column.value: They speak of you with evil intent; your adversaries misuse your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Do I not hate those who hate you, O LORD, and abhor those who rise up against you?

column.name: text
column.value: I have nothing but hatred for them; I count them my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.

column.name: text
column.value: See if there is any offensive way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good. His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: to him who alone does great wonders, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: who by his understanding made the heavens, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: who spread out the earth upon the waters, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: who made the great lights--His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: the sun to govern the day, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: the moon and stars to govern the night; His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: and brought Israel out from among them His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: to him who divided the Red Sea asunder His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: and brought Israel through the midst of it, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: to him who led his people through the desert, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: who struck down great kings, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: and killed mighty kings--His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Sihon king of the Amorites His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: and Og king of Bashan--His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: and gave their land as an inheritance, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: an inheritance to his servant Israel; His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: to the One who remembered us in our low estate His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: and freed us from our enemies, His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: and who gives food to every creature. His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Praise the name of the LORD; praise him, you servants of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: you who minister in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

column.name: text
column.value: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of men and animals.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings--

column.name: text
column.value: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan and all the kings of Canaan--

column.name: text
column.value: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, your renown, O LORD, through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

column.name: text
column.value: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but they cannot see;

column.name: text
column.value: they have ears, but cannot hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

column.name: text
column.value: O house of Israel, praise the LORD; O house of Aaron, praise the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: O house of Levi, praise the LORD; you who fear him, praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the LORD from Zion, to him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For the director of music. A psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men; protect me from men of violence,

column.name: text
column.value: who devise evil plans in their hearts and stir up war every day.

column.name: text
column.value: They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent's; the poison of vipers is on their lips. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; protect me from men of violence who plan to trip my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Proud men have hidden a snare for me; they have spread out the cords of their net and have set traps for me along my path. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, I say to you, "You are my God." Hear, O LORD, my cry for mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: O Sovereign LORD, my strong deliverer, who shields my head in the day of battle--

column.name: text
column.value: do not grant the wicked their desires, O LORD; do not let their plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Let the heads of those who surround me be covered with the trouble their lips have caused.

column.name: text
column.value: Let burning coals fall upon them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.

column.name: text
column.value: Let slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down men of violence.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that the LORD secures justice for the poor and upholds the cause of the needy.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the righteous will praise your name and the upright will live before you.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. O LORD, I call to you; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to you.

column.name: text
column.value: May my prayer be set before you like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: Set a guard over my mouth, O LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Let not my heart be drawn to what is evil, to take part in wicked deeds with men who are evildoers; let me not eat of their delicacies.

column.name: text
column.value: Let a righteous man strike me--it is a kindness; let him rebuke me--it is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it. Yet my prayer is ever against the deeds of evildoers;

column.name: text
column.value: their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: They will say,"As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave."

column.name: text
column.value: But my eyes are fixed on you, O Sovereign LORD; in you I take refuge--do not give me over to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, from the traps set by evildoers.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.

column.name: text
column.value: The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; he makes me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

column.name: text
column.value: So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is dismayed.

column.name: text
column.value: I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all your works and consider what your hands have done.

column.name: text
column.value: I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue me from my enemies, O LORD, for I hide myself in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

column.name: text
column.value: For your name's sake, O LORD, preserve my life; in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: In your unfailing love, silence my enemies; destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.

column.name: text
column.value: A maskil of David. When he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift up my voice to the LORD for mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: I pour out my complaint before him; before him I tell my trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who know my way. In the path where I walk men have hidden a snare for me.

column.name: text
column.value: Look to my right and see; no one is concerned for me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.

column.name: text
column.value: I cry to you, O LORD; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

column.name: text
column.value: Set me free from my prison, that I may praise your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Of David. Praise be to the LORD my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.

column.name: text
column.value: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, what is man that you care for him, the son of man that you think of him?

column.name: text
column.value: Man is like a breath; his days are like a fleeting shadow.

column.name: text
column.value: Part your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: Send forth lightning and scatter the enemies; shoot your arrows and rout them.

column.name: text
column.value: Reach down your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners

column.name: text
column.value: whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sing a new song to you, O God; on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,

column.name: text
column.value: to the One who gives victory to kings, who delivers his servant David from the deadly sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Deliver me and rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

column.name: text
column.value: Then our sons in their youth will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters will be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

column.name: text
column.value: Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;

column.name: text
column.value: our oxen will draw heavy loads. There will be no breaching of walls, no going into captivity, no cry of distress in our streets.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are the people of whom this is true; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt you, my God the King; I will praise your name for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Every day I will praise you and extol your name for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.

column.name: text
column.value: One generation will commend your works to another; they will tell of your mighty acts.

column.name: text
column.value: They will speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty, and I will meditate on your wonderful works.

column.name: text
column.value: They will tell of the power of your awesome works, and I will proclaim your great deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: They will celebrate your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.

column.name: text
column.value: All you have made will praise you, O LORD; your saints will extol you.

column.name: text
column.value: They will tell of the glory of your kingdom and speak of your might,

column.name: text
column.value: so that all men may know of your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful to all his promises and loving toward all he has made.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD upholds all those who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.

column.name: text
column.value: You open your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is righteous in all his ways and loving toward all he has made.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth will speak in praise of the LORD. Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

column.name: text
column.value: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.

column.name: text
column.value: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the harp.

column.name: text
column.value: He covers the sky with clouds; he supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.

column.name: text
column.value: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.

column.name: text
column.value: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse, nor his delight in the legs of a man;

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.

column.name: text
column.value: Extol the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion,

column.name: text
column.value: for he strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your people within you.

column.name: text
column.value: He grants peace to your borders and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.

column.name: text
column.value: He sends his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.

column.name: text
column.value: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can withstand his icy blast?

column.name: text
column.value: He sends his word and melts them; he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.

column.name: text
column.value: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD from the heavens, praise him in the heights above.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise him, all his angels, praise him, all his heavenly hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise him, sun and moon, praise him, all you shining stars.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise him, you highest heavens and you waters above the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for he commanded and they were created.

column.name: text
column.value: He set them in place for ever and ever; he gave a decree that will never pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

column.name: text
column.value: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do his bidding,

column.name: text
column.value: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

column.name: text
column.value: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,

column.name: text
column.value: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,

column.name: text
column.value: young men and maidens, old men and children.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

column.name: text
