column.value: He has raised up for his people a horn, the praise of all his saints, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not put your trust in princes, in mortal men, who cannot save.

column.name: text
column.value: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,

column.name: text
column.value: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them--the LORD, who remains faithful forever.

column.name: text
column.value: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets prisoners free,

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD gives sight to the blind, the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down, the LORD loves the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD watches over the alien and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with tambourine and harp.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the saints rejoice in this honor and sing for joy on their beds.

column.name: text
column.value: May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,

column.name: text
column.value: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,

column.name: text
column.value: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,

column.name: text
column.value: to carry out the sentence written against them. This is the glory of all his saints. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre,

column.name: text
column.value: praise him with tambourine and dancing, praise him with the strings and flute,

column.name: text
column.value: praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.

column.name: text
column.value: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: for attaining wisdom and discipline; for understanding words of insight;

column.name: text
column.value: for acquiring a disciplined and prudent life, doing what is right and just and fair;

column.name: text
column.value: for giving prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young--

column.name: text
column.value: let the wise listen and add to their learning, and let the discerning get guidance--

column.name: text
column.value: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my son, to your father's instruction and do not forsake your mother's teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, if sinners entice you, do not give in to them.

column.name: text
column.value: If they say, "Come along with us; let's lie in wait for someone's blood, let's waylay some harmless soul;

column.name: text
column.value: let's swallow them alive, like the grave, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;

column.name: text
column.value: we will get all sorts of valuable things and fill our houses with plunder;

column.name: text
column.value: throw in your lot with us, and we will share a common purse"--

column.name: text
column.value: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;

column.name: text
column.value: for their feet rush into sin, they are swift to shed blood.

column.name: text
column.value: How useless to spread a net in full view of all the birds!

column.name: text
column.value: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they waylay only themselves!

column.name: text
column.value: Such is the end of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the lives of those who get it.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom calls aloud in the street, she raises her voice in the public squares;

column.name: text
column.value: at the head of the noisy streets she cries out, in the gateways of the city she makes her speech:

column.name: text
column.value: "How long will you simple ones love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?

column.name: text
column.value: If you had responded to my rebuke, I would have poured out my heart to you and made my thoughts known to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But since you rejected me when I called and no one gave heed when I stretched out my hand,

column.name: text
column.value: since you ignored all my advice and would not accept my rebuke,

column.name: text
column.value: I in turn will laugh at your disaster; I will mock when calamity overtakes you--

column.name: text
column.value: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,

column.name: text
column.value: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.

column.name: text
column.value: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;

column.name: text
column.value: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm."

column.name: text
column.value: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,

column.name: text
column.value: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding,

column.name: text
column.value: and if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,

column.name: text
column.value: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,

column.name: text
column.value: then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD gives wisdom, and from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: He holds victory in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,

column.name: text
column.value: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair--every good path.

column.name: text
column.value: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,

column.name: text
column.value: who leave the straight paths to walk in dark ways,

column.name: text
column.value: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,

column.name: text
column.value: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.

column.name: text
column.value: It will save you also from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words,

column.name: text
column.value: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.

column.name: text
column.value: For her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus you will walk in the ways of good men and keep to the paths of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

column.name: text
column.value: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, do not forget my teaching, but keep my commands in your heart,

column.name: text
column.value: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you prosperity.

column.name: text
column.value: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.

column.name: text
column.value: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;

column.name: text
column.value: in all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and shun evil.

column.name: text
column.value: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.

column.name: text
column.value: Honor the LORD with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops;

column.name: text
column.value: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, do not despise the LORD'S discipline and do not resent his rebuke,

column.name: text
column.value: because the LORD disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gains understanding,

column.name: text
column.value: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

column.name: text
column.value: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

column.name: text
column.value: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

column.name: text
column.value: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.

column.name: text
column.value: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her; those who lay hold of her will be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: By wisdom the LORD laid the earth's foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;

column.name: text
column.value: by his knowledge the deeps were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, preserve sound judgment and discernment, do not let them out of your sight;

column.name: text
column.value: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble;

column.name: text
column.value: when you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

column.name: text
column.value: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from being snared.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not withhold good from those who deserve it, when it is in your power to act.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back later; I'll give it tomorrow"--when you now have it with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not accuse a man for no reason--when he has done you no harm.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways,

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD detests a perverse man but takes the upright into his confidence.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD'S curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: He mocks proud mockers but gives grace to the humble.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise inherit honor, but fools he holds up to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my sons, to a father's instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: When I was a boy in my father's house, still tender, and an only child of my mother,

column.name: text
column.value: he taught me and said, "Lay hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands and you will live.

column.name: text
column.value: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or swerve from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom is supreme; therefore get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: Esteem her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.

column.name: text
column.value: She will set a garland of grace on your head and present you with a crown of splendor."

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.

column.name: text
column.value: I guide you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.

column.name: text
column.value: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.

column.name: text
column.value: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evil men.

column.name: text
column.value: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.

column.name: text
column.value: For they cannot sleep till they do evil; they are robbed of slumber till they make someone fall.

column.name: text
column.value: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

column.name: text
column.value: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

column.name: text
column.value: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, pay attention to what I say; listen closely to my words.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;

column.name: text
column.value: for they are life to those who find them and health to a man's whole body.

column.name: text
column.value: Above all else, guard your heart, for it is the wellspring of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Put away perversity from your mouth; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your eyes look straight ahead, fix your gaze directly before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Make level paths for your feet and take only ways that are firm.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not swerve to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, listen well to my words of insight,

column.name: text
column.value: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;

column.name: text
column.value: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths are crooked, but she knows it not.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, my sons, listen to me; do not turn aside from what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,

column.name: text
column.value: lest you give your best strength to others and your years to one who is cruel,

column.name: text
column.value: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich another man's house.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.

column.name: text
column.value: You will say, "How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!

column.name: text
column.value: I would not obey my teachers or listen to my instructors.

column.name: text
column.value: I have come to the brink of utter ruin in the midst of the whole assembly."

column.name: text
column.value: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.

column.name: text
column.value: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?

column.name: text
column.value: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.

column.name: text
column.value: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.

column.name: text
column.value: A loving doe, a graceful deer--may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be captivated by her love.

column.name: text
column.value: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another man's wife?

column.name: text
column.value: For a man's ways are in full view of the LORD, and he examines all his paths.

column.name: text
column.value: The evil deeds of a wicked man ensnare him; the cords of his sin hold him fast.

column.name: text
column.value: He will die for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have struck hands in pledge for another,

column.name: text
column.value: if you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth,

column.name: text
column.value: then do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor's hands: Go and humble yourself; press your plea with your neighbor!

column.name: text
column.value: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.

column.name: text
column.value: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

column.name: text
column.value: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!

column.name: text
column.value: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,

column.name: text
column.value: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?

column.name: text
column.value: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest--

column.name: text
column.value: and poverty will come on you like a bandit and scarcity like an armed man.

column.name: text
column.value: A scoundrel and villain, who goes about with a corrupt mouth,

column.name: text
column.value: who winks with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,

column.name: text
column.value: who plots evil with deceit in his heart--he always stirs up dissension.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed--without remedy.

column.name: text
column.value: There are six things the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to him:

column.name: text
column.value: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

column.name: text
column.value: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are quick to rush into evil,

column.name: text
column.value: a false witness who pours out lies and a man who stirs up dissension among brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, keep your father's commands and do not forsake your mother's teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: Bind them upon your heart forever; fasten them around your neck.

column.name: text
column.value: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For these commands are a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the corrections of discipline are the way to life,

column.name: text
column.value: keeping you from the immoral woman, from the smooth tongue of the wayward wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes,

column.name: text
column.value: for the prostitute reduces you to a loaf of bread, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.

column.name: text
column.value: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?

column.name: text
column.value: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?

column.name: text
column.value: So is he who sleeps with another man's wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.

column.name: text
column.value: Men do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger when he is starving.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.

column.name: text
column.value: But a man who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away;

column.name: text
column.value: for jealousy arouses a husband's fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.

column.name: text
column.value: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse the bribe, however great it is.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.

column.name: text
column.value: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call understanding your kinsman;

column.name: text
column.value: they will keep you from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words.

column.name: text
column.value: At the window of my house I looked out through the lattice.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who lacked judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house

column.name: text
column.value: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.

column.name: text
column.value: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.

column.name: text
column.value: (She is loud and defiant, her feet never stay at home;

column.name: text
column.value: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)

column.name: text
column.value: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:

column.name: text
column.value: "I have fellowship offerings at home; today I fulfilled my vows.

column.name: text
column.value: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!

column.name: text
column.value: I have covered my bed with colored linens from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let's drink deep of love till morning; let's enjoy ourselves with love!

column.name: text
column.value: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.

column.name: text
column.value: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon."

column.name: text
column.value: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.

column.name: text
column.value: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose

column.name: text
column.value: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, my sons, listen to me; pay attention to what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.

column.name: text
column.value: Many are the victims she has brought down; her slain are a mighty throng.

column.name: text
column.value: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?

column.name: text
column.value: On the heights along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;

column.name: text
column.value: beside the gates leading into the city, at the entrances, she cries aloud:

column.name: text
column.value: "To you, O men, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, gain understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, for I have worthy things to say; I open my lips to speak what is right.

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.

column.name: text
column.value: To the discerning all of them are right; they are faultless to those who have knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,

column.name: text
column.value: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.

column.name: text
column.value: "I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

column.name: text
column.value: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

column.name: text
column.value: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have understanding and power.

column.name: text
column.value: By me kings reign and rulers make laws that are just;

column.name: text
column.value: by me princes govern, and all nobles who rule on earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

column.name: text
column.value: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.

column.name: text
column.value: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.

column.name: text
column.value: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,

column.name: text
column.value: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.

column.name: text
column.value: "The LORD brought me forth as the first of his works, before his deeds of old;

column.name: text
column.value: I was appointed from eternity, from the beginning, before the world began.

column.name: text
column.value: When there were no oceans, I was given birth, when there were no springs abounding with water;

column.name: text
column.value: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,

column.name: text
column.value: before he made the earth or its fields or any of the dust of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,

column.name: text
column.value: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,

column.name: text
column.value: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I was the craftsman at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,

column.name: text
column.value: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now then, my sons, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever finds me finds life and receives favor from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death."

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn out its seven pillars.

column.name: text
column.value: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

column.name: text
column.value: She has sent out her maids, and she calls from the highest point of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: "Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.

column.name: text
column.value: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: "Whoever corrects a mocker invites insult; whoever rebukes a wicked man incurs abuse.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not rebuke a mocker or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man and he will love you.

column.name: text
column.value: Instruct a wise man and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man and he will add to his learning.

column.name: text
column.value: "The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: For through me your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.

column.name: text
column.value: If you are wise, your wisdom will reward you; if you are a mocker, you alone will suffer."

column.name: text
column.value: The woman Folly is loud; she is undisciplined and without knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,

column.name: text
column.value: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way.

column.name: text
column.value: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: "Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!"

column.name: text
column.value: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Ill-gotten treasures are of no value, but righteousness delivers from death.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Lazy hands make a man poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: He who gathers crops in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: The memory of the righteous will be a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: The man of integrity walks securely, but he who takes crooked paths will be found out.

column.name: text
column.value: He who winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers over all wrongs.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Wise men store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: The wages of the righteous bring them life, but the income of the wicked brings them punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: He who heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.

column.name: text
column.value: He who conceals his hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: When words are many, sin is not absent, but he who holds his tongue is wise.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: The blessing of the LORD brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool finds pleasure in evil conduct, but a man of understanding delights in wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: What the wicked dreads will overtake him; what the righteous desire will be granted.

column.name: text
column.value: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.

column.name: text
column.value: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is a sluggard to those who send him.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

column.name: text
column.value: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of the LORD is a refuge for the righteous, but it is the ruin of those who do evil.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD abhors dishonest scales, but accurate weights are his delight.

column.name: text
column.value: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.

column.name: text
column.value: Wealth is worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteousness of the blameless makes a straight way for them, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.

column.name: text
column.value: When a wicked man dies, his hope perishes; all he expected from his power comes to nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous man is rescued from trouble, and it comes on the wicked instead.

column.name: text
column.value: With his mouth the godless destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous escape.

column.name: text
column.value: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: A man who lacks judgment derides his neighbor, but a man of understanding holds his tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy man keeps a secret.

column.name: text
column.value: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but many advisers make victory sure.

column.name: text
column.value: He who puts up security for another will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to strike hands in pledge is safe.

column.name: text
column.value: A kindhearted woman gains respect, but ruthless men gain only wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked man earns deceptive wages, but he who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

column.name: text
column.value: The truly righteous man attains life, but he who pursues evil goes to his death.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD detests men of perverse heart but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman who shows no discretion.

column.name: text
column.value: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: One man gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.

column.name: text
column.value: A generous man will prosper; he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.

column.name: text
column.value: People curse the man who hoards grain, but blessing crowns him who is willing to sell.

column.name: text
column.value: He who seeks good finds goodwill, but evil comes to him who searches for it.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like a green leaf.

column.name: text
column.value: He who brings trouble on his family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.

column.name: text
column.value: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.

column.name: text
column.value: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.

column.name: text
column.value: A good man obtains favor from the LORD, but the LORD condemns a crafty man.

column.name: text
column.value: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.

column.name: text
column.value: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

column.name: text
column.value: The plans of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

column.name: text
column.value: Wicked men are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands firm.

column.name: text
column.value: A man is praised according to his wisdom, but men with warped minds are despised.

column.name: text
column.value: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than pretend to be somebody and have no food.

column.name: text
column.value: A righteous man cares for the needs of his animal, but the kindest acts of the wicked are cruel.

column.name: text
column.value: He who works his land will have abundant food, but he who chases fantasies lacks judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked desire the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

column.name: text
column.value: An evil man is trapped by his sinful talk, but a righteous man escapes trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: From the fruit of his lips a man is filled with good things as surely as the work of his hands rewards him.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of a fool seems right to him, but a wise man listens to advice.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool shows his annoyance at once, but a prudent man overlooks an insult.

column.name: text
column.value: A truthful witness gives honest testimony, but a false witness tells lies.

column.name: text
column.value: Reckless words pierce like a sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

column.name: text
column.value: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

column.name: text
column.value: There is deceit in the hearts of those who plot evil, but joy for those who promote peace.

column.name: text
column.value: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD detests lying lips, but he delights in men who are truthful.

column.name: text
column.value: A prudent man keeps his knowledge to himself, but the heart of fools blurts out folly.

column.name: text
column.value: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

column.name: text
column.value: An anxious heart weighs a man down, but a kind word cheers him up.

column.name: text
column.value: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

column.name: text
column.value: The lazy man does not roast his game, but the diligent man prizes his possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise son heeds his father's instruction, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.

column.name: text
column.value: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful have a craving for violence.

column.name: text
column.value: He who guards his lips guards his life, but he who speaks rashly will come to ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: The sluggard craves and gets nothing, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

column.name: text
column.value: One man pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: A man's riches may ransom his life, but a poor man hears no threat.

column.name: text
column.value: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

column.name: text
column.value: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.

column.name: text
column.value: Dishonest money dwindles away, but he who gathers money little by little makes it grow.

column.name: text
column.value: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a longing fulfilled is a tree of life.

column.name: text
column.value: He who scorns instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command is rewarded.

column.name: text
column.value: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

column.name: text
column.value: Every prudent man acts out of knowledge, but a fool exposes his folly.

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.

column.name: text
column.value: He who ignores discipline comes to poverty and shame, but whoever heeds correction is honored.

column.name: text
column.value: A longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: He who walks with the wise grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

column.name: text
column.value: Misfortune pursues the sinner, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: A good man leaves an inheritance for his children's children, but a sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: A poor man's field may produce abundant food, but injustice sweeps it away.

column.name: text
column.value: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him is careful to discipline him.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous eat to their hearts' content, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.

column.name: text
column.value: He whose walk is upright fears the LORD, but he whose ways are devious despises him.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool's talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

column.name: text
column.value: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but from the strength of an ox comes an abundant harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: A truthful witness does not deceive, but a false witness pours out lies.

column.name: text
column.value: The mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.

column.name: text
column.value: Stay away from a foolish man, for you will not find knowledge on his lips.

column.name: text
column.value: The wisdom of the prudent is to give thought to their ways, but the folly of fools is deception.

column.name: text
column.value: Fools mock at making amends for sin, but goodwill is found among the upright.

column.name: text
column.value: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.

column.name: text
column.value: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in grief.

column.name: text
column.value: The faithless will be fully repaid for their ways, and the good man rewarded for his.

column.name: text
column.value: A simple man believes anything, but a prudent man gives thought to his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise man fears the LORD and shuns evil, but a fool is hotheaded and reckless.

column.name: text
column.value: A quick-tempered man does foolish things, and a crafty man is hated.

column.name: text
column.value: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Evil men will bow down in the presence of the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: The poor are shunned even by their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.

column.name: text
column.value: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who is kind to the needy.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not those who plot evil go astray? But those who plan what is good find love and faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.

column.name: text
column.value: The wealth of the wise is their crown, but the folly of fools yields folly.

column.name: text
column.value: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is deceitful.

column.name: text
column.value: He who fears the LORD has a secure fortress, and for his children it will be a refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.

column.name: text
column.value: A large population is a king's glory, but without subjects a prince is ruined.

column.name: text
column.value: A patient man has great understanding, but a quick-tempered man displays folly.

column.name: text
column.value: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.

column.name: text
column.value: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.

column.name: text
column.value: When calamity comes, the wicked are brought down, but even in death the righteous have a refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

column.name: text
column.value: A king delights in a wise servant, but a shameful servant incurs his wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting, with strife.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son, and will share the inheritance as one of the brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked man listens to evil lips; a liar pays attention to a malicious tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: He who mocks the poor shows contempt for their Maker; whoever gloats over disaster will not go unpunished.

column.name: text
column.value: Children's children are a crown to the aged, and parents are the pride of their children.

column.name: text
column.value: Arrogant lips are unsuited to a fool--how much worse lying lips to a ruler!

column.name: text
column.value: A bribe is a charm to the one who gives it; wherever he turns, he succeeds.

column.name: text
column.value: He who covers over an offense promotes love, but whoever repeats the matter separates close friends.

column.name: text
column.value: A rebuke impresses a man of discernment more than a hundred lashes a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: An evil man is bent only on rebellion; a merciless official will be sent against him.

column.name: text
column.value: Better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man pays back evil for good, evil will never leave his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Starting a quarrel is like breaching a dam; so drop the matter before a dispute breaks out.

column.name: text
column.value: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent--the LORD detests them both.

column.name: text
column.value: Of what use is money in the hand of a fool, since he has no desire to get wisdom?

column.name: text
column.value: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

column.name: text
column.value: A man lacking in judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security for his neighbor.

column.name: text
column.value: He who loves a quarrel loves sin; he who builds a high gate invites destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: A man of perverse heart does not prosper; he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: To have a fool for a son brings grief; there is no joy for the father of a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked man accepts a bribe in secret to pervert the course of justice.

column.name: text
column.value: A discerning man keeps wisdom in view, but a fool's eyes wander to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to the one who bore him.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not good to punish an innocent man, or to flog officials for their integrity.

column.name: text
column.value: A man of knowledge uses words with restraint, and a man of understanding is even-tempered.

column.name: text
column.value: Even a fool is thought wise if he keeps silent, and discerning if he holds his tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: An unfriendly man pursues selfish ends; he defies all sound judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool finds no pleasure in understanding but delights in airing his own opinions.

column.name: text
column.value: When wickedness comes, so does contempt, and with shame comes disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of a man's mouth are deep waters, but the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not good to be partial to the wicked or to deprive the innocent of justice.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool's lips bring him strife, and his mouth invites a beating.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool's mouth is his undoing, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels; they go down to a man's inmost parts.

column.name: text
column.value: One who is slack in his work is brother to one who destroys.

column.name: text
column.value: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

column.name: text
column.value: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city; they imagine it an unscalable wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Before his downfall a man's heart is proud, but humility comes before honor.

column.name: text
column.value: He who answers before listening--that is his folly and his shame.

column.name: text
column.value: A man's spirit sustains him in sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?

column.name: text
column.value: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge; the ears of the wise seek it out.

column.name: text
column.value: A gift opens the way for the giver and ushers him into the presence of the great.

column.name: text
column.value: The first to present his case seems right, till another comes forward and questions him.

column.name: text
column.value: Casting the lot settles disputes and keeps strong opponents apart.

column.name: text
column.value: An offended brother is more unyielding than a fortified city, and disputes are like the barred gates of a citadel.

column.name: text
column.value: From the fruit of his mouth a man's stomach is filled; with the harvest from his lips he is satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A poor man pleads for mercy, but a rich man answers harshly.

column.name: text
column.value: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

column.name: text
column.value: To man belong the plans of the heart, but from the LORD comes the reply of the tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: All a man's ways seem innocent to him, but motives are weighed by the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Commit to the LORD whatever you do, and your plans will succeed.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD works out everything for his own ends--even the wicked for a day of disaster.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD detests all the proud of heart. Be sure of this: They will not go unpunished.

column.name: text
column.value: Through love and faithfulness sin is atoned for; through the fear of the LORD a man avoids evil.

column.name: text
column.value: When a man's ways are pleasing to the LORD, he makes even his enemies live at peace with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Better a little with righteousness than much gain with injustice.

column.name: text
column.value: In his heart a man plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of a king speak as an oracle, and his mouth should not betray justice.

column.name: text
column.value: Honest scales and balances are from the LORD; all the weights in the bag are of his making.

column.name: text
column.value: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Kings take pleasure in honest lips; they value a man who speaks the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: A king's wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will appease it.

column.name: text
column.value: When a king's face brightens, it means life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.

column.name: text
column.value: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to choose understanding rather than silver!

column.name: text
column.value: The highway of the upright avoids evil; he who guards his way guards his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.

column.name: text
column.value: Better to be lowly in spirit and among the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever gives heed to instruction prospers, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant words promote instruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it, but folly brings punishment to fools.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise man's heart guides his mouth, and his lips promote instruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The laborer's appetite works for him; his hunger drives him on.

column.name: text
column.value: A scoundrel plots evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.

column.name: text
column.value: A perverse man stirs up dissension, and a gossip separates close friends.

column.name: text
column.value: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.

column.name: text
column.value: He who winks with his eye is plotting perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained by a righteous life.

column.name: text
column.value: Better a patient man than a warrior, a man who controls his temper than one who takes a city.

column.name: text
column.value: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Better a poor man whose walk is blameless than a fool whose lips are perverse.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty and miss the way.

column.name: text
column.value: A man's own folly ruins his life, yet his heart rages against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Wealth brings many friends, but a poor man's friend deserts him.

column.name: text
column.value: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who pours out lies will not go free.

column.name: text
column.value: Many curry favor with a ruler, and everyone is the friend of a man who gives gifts.

column.name: text
column.value: A poor man is shunned by all his relatives--how much more do his friends avoid him! Though he pursues them with pleading, they are nowhere to be found.

column.name: text
column.value: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; he who cherishes understanding prospers.

column.name: text
column.value: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who pours out lies will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury--how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!

column.name: text
column.value: A man's wisdom gives him patience; it is to his glory to overlook an offense.

column.name: text
column.value: A king's rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

column.name: text
column.value: A foolish son is his father's ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.

column.name: text
column.value: Houses and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and the shiftless man goes hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: He who obeys instructions guards his life, but he who is contemptuous of his ways will die.

column.name: text
column.value: He who is kind to the poor lends to the LORD, and he will reward him for what he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: Discipline your son, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to his death.

column.name: text
column.value: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty; if you rescue him, you will have to do it again.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to advice and accept instruction, and in the end you will be wise.

column.name: text
column.value: Many are the plans in a man's heart, but it is the LORD'S purpose that prevails.

column.name: text
column.value: What a man desires is unfailing love; better to be poor than a liar.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD leads to life: Then one rests content, untouched by trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth!

column.name: text
column.value: Flog a mocker, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke a discerning man, and he will gain knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: He who robs his father and drives out his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: A corrupt witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Penalties are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

column.name: text
column.value: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of the LORD are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue that brings healing is a tree of life, but a deceitful tongue crushes the spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool spurns his father's discipline, but whoever heeds correction shows prudence.

column.name: text
column.value: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings them trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so the hearts of fools.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD detests the way of the wicked but he loves those who pursue righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Stern discipline awaits him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.

column.name: text
column.value: Death and Destruction lie open before the LORD--how much more the hearts of men!

column.name: text
column.value: A mocker resents correction; he will not consult the wise.

column.name: text
column.value: A happy heart makes the face cheerful, but heartache crushes the spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.

column.name: text
column.value: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great wealth with turmoil.

column.name: text
column.value: Better a meal of vegetables where there is love than a fattened calf with hatred.

column.name: text
column.value: A hot-tempered man stirs up dissension, but a patient man calms a quarrel.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Folly delights a man who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding keeps a straight course.

column.name: text
column.value: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.

column.name: text
column.value: A man finds joy in giving an apt reply--and how good is a timely word!

column.name: text
column.value: The path of life leads upward for the wise to keep him from going down to the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD tears down the proud man's house but he keeps the widow's boundaries intact.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but those of the pure are pleasing to him.

column.name: text
column.value: A greedy man brings trouble to his family, but he who hates bribes will live.

column.name: text
column.value: The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes evil.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is far from the wicked but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart, and good news gives health to the bones.

column.name: text
column.value: He who listens to a life-giving rebuke will be at home among the wise.

column.name: text
column.value: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD teaches a man wisdom, and humility comes before honor.

column.name: text
column.value: Wine is a mocker and beer a brawler; whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

column.name: text
column.value: A king's wrath is like the roar of a lion; he who angers him forfeits his life.

column.name: text
column.value: It is to a man's honor to avoid strife, but every fool is quick to quarrel.

column.name: text
column.value: A sluggard does not plow in season; so at harvest time he looks but finds nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: The purposes of a man's heart are deep waters, but a man of understanding draws them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Many a man claims to have unfailing love, but a faithful man who can find?

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous man leads a blameless life; blessed are his children after him.

column.name: text
column.value: When a king sits on his throne to judge, he winnows out all evil with his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can say, "I have kept my heart pure; I am clean and without sin"?

column.name: text
column.value: Differing weights and differing measures--the LORD detests them both.

column.name: text
column.value: Even a child is known by his actions, by whether his conduct is pure and right.

column.name: text
column.value: Ears that hear and eyes that see--the LORD has made them both.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor; stay awake and you will have food to spare.

column.name: text
column.value: "It's no good, it's no good!" says the buyer; then off he goes and boasts about his purchase.

column.name: text
column.value: Gold there is, and rubies in abundance, but lips that speak knowledge are a rare jewel.

column.name: text
column.value: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if he does it for a wayward woman.

column.name: text
column.value: Food gained by fraud tastes sweet to a man, but he ends up with a mouth full of gravel.

column.name: text
column.value: Make plans by seeking advice; if you wage war, obtain guidance.

column.name: text
column.value: A gossip betrays a confidence; so avoid a man who talks too much.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man curses his father or mother, his lamp will be snuffed out in pitch darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning will not be blessed at the end.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not say, "I'll pay you back for this wrong!" Wait for the LORD, and he will deliver you.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales do not please him.

column.name: text
column.value: A man's steps are directed by the LORD. How then can anyone understand his own way?

column.name: text
column.value: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly and only later to consider his vows.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise king winnows out the wicked; he drives the threshing wheel over them.

column.name: text
column.value: The lamp of the LORD searches the spirit of a man; it searches out his inmost being.

column.name: text
column.value: Love and faithfulness keep a king safe; through love his throne is made secure.

column.name: text
column.value: The glory of young men is their strength, gray hair the splendor of the old.

column.name: text
column.value: Blows and wounds cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the inmost being.

column.name: text
column.value: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD; he directs it like a watercourse wherever he pleases.

column.name: text
column.value: All a man's ways seem right to him, but the LORD weighs the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are sin!

column.name: text
column.value: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.

column.name: text
column.value: A fortune made by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a deadly snare.

column.name: text
column.value: The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do what is right.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

column.name: text
column.value: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked man craves evil; his neighbor gets no mercy from him.

column.name: text
column.value: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; when a wise man is instructed, he gets knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: The Righteous One takes note of the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too will cry out and not be answered.

column.name: text
column.value: A gift given in secret soothes anger, and a bribe concealed in the cloak pacifies great wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: When justice is done, it brings joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.

column.name: text
column.value: A man who strays from the path of understanding comes to rest in the company of the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: He who loves pleasure will become poor; whoever loves wine and oil will never be rich.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the unfaithful for the upright.

column.name: text
column.value: Better to live in a desert than with a quarrelsome and ill-tempered wife.

column.name: text
column.value: In the house of the wise are stores of choice food and oil, but a foolish man devours all he has.

column.name: text
column.value: He who pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise man attacks the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.

column.name: text
column.value: He who guards his mouth and his tongue keeps himself from calamity.

column.name: text
column.value: The proud and arrogant man--"Mocker" is his name; he behaves with overweening pride.

column.name: text
column.value: The sluggard's craving will be the death of him, because his hands refuse to work.

column.name: text
column.value: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.

column.name: text
column.value: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable--how much more so when brought with evil intent!

column.name: text
column.value: A false witness will perish, and whoever listens to him will be destroyed forever.

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked man puts up a bold front, but an upright man gives thought to his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Rich and poor have this in common: The LORD is the Maker of them all.

column.name: text
column.value: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge, but the simple keep going and suffer for it.

column.name: text
column.value: Humility and the fear of the LORD bring wealth and honor and life.

column.name: text
column.value: In the paths of the wicked lie thorns and snares, but he who guards his soul stays far from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Train a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not turn from it.

column.name: text
column.value: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

column.name: text
column.value: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: A generous man will himself be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: Drive out the mocker, and out goes strife; quarrels and insults are ended.

column.name: text
column.value: He who loves a pure heart and whose speech is gracious will have the king for his friend.

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of the LORD keep watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

column.name: text
column.value: The sluggard says, "There is a lion outside!" or, "I will be murdered in the streets!"

column.name: text
column.value: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the LORD'S wrath will fall into it.

column.name: text
column.value: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline will drive it far from him.

column.name: text
column.value: He who oppresses the poor to increase his wealth and he who gives gifts to the rich--both come to poverty.

column.name: text
column.value: Pay attention and listen to the sayings of the wise; apply your heart to what I teach,

column.name: text
column.value: for it is pleasing when you keep them in your heart and have all of them ready on your lips.

column.name: text
column.value: So that your trust may be in the LORD, I teach you today, even you.

column.name: text
column.value: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,

column.name: text
column.value: teaching you true and reliable words, so that you can give sound answers to him who sent you?

column.name: text
column.value: Do not exploit the poor because they are poor and do not crush the needy in court,

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder those who plunder them.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered man, do not associate with one easily angered,

column.name: text
column.value: or you may learn his ways and get yourself ensnared.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be a man who strikes hands in pledge or puts up security for debts;

column.name: text
column.value: if you lack the means to pay, your very bed will be snatched from under you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not move an ancient boundary stone set up by your forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve before kings; he will not serve before obscure men.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not envy wicked men, do not desire their company;

column.name: text
column.value: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about making trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established;

column.name: text
column.value: through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise man has great power, and a man of knowledge increases strength;

column.name: text
column.value: for waging war you need guidance, and for victory many advisers.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom is too high for a fool; in the assembly at the gate he has nothing to say.

column.name: text
column.value: He who plots evil will be known as a schemer.

column.name: text
column.value: The schemes of folly are sin, and men detest a mocker.

column.name: text
column.value: If you falter in times of trouble, how small is your strength!

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue those being led away to death; hold back those staggering toward slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: If you say, "But we knew nothing about this," does not he who weighs the heart perceive it? Does not he who guards your life know it? Will he not repay each person according to what he has done?

column.name: text
column.value: Eat honey, my son, for it is good; honey from the comb is sweet to your taste.

column.name: text
column.value: Know also that wisdom is sweet to your soul; if you find it, there is a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not lie in wait like an outlaw against a righteous man's house, do not raid his dwelling place;

column.name: text
column.value: for though a righteous man falls seven times, he rises again, but the wicked are brought down by calamity.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not gloat when your enemy falls; when he stumbles, do not let your heart rejoice,

column.name: text
column.value: or the LORD will see and disapprove and turn his wrath away from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not fret because of evil men or be envious of the wicked,

column.name: text
column.value: for the evil man has no future hope, and the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear the LORD and the king, my son, and do not join with the rebellious,

column.name: text
column.value: for those two will send sudden destruction upon them, and who knows what calamities they can bring?

column.name: text
column.value: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judging is not good:

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever says to the guilty, "You are innocent"--peoples will curse him and nations denounce him.

column.name: text
column.value: But it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Finish your outdoor work and get your fields ready; after that, build your house.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause, or use your lips to deceive.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not say, "I'll do to him as he has done to me; I'll pay that man back for what he did."

column.name: text
column.value: I went past the field of the sluggard, past the vineyard of the man who lacks judgment;

column.name: text
column.value: thorns had come up everywhere, the ground was covered with weeds, and the stone wall was in ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: I applied my heart to what I observed and learned a lesson from what I saw:

column.name: text
column.value: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest--

column.name: text
