column.value: He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor."

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, "I have labored to no purpose; I have spent my strength in vain and for nothing. Yet what is due me is in the LORD'S hand, and my reward is with my God."

column.name: text
column.value: And now the LORD says--he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the LORD and my God has been my strength--

column.name: text
column.value: he says: "It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring my salvation to the ends of the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says--the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel--to him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the servant of rulers: "Kings will see you and rise up, princes will see and bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "In the time of my favor I will answer you, and in the day of salvation I will help you; I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to reassign its desolate inheritances,

column.name: text
column.value: to say to the captives, 'Come out,' and to those in darkness, 'Be free!' "They will feed beside the roads and find pasture on every barren hill.

column.name: text
column.value: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will the desert heat or the sun beat upon them. He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.

column.name: text
column.value: See, they will come from afar--some from the north, some from the west, some from the region of Aswan."

column.name: text
column.value: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; burst into song, O mountains! For the LORD comforts his people and will have compassion on his afflicted ones.

column.name: text
column.value: But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me, the Lord has forgotten me."

column.name: text
column.value: "Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are ever before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Your sons hasten back, and those who laid you waste depart from you.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your eyes and look around; all your sons gather and come to you. As surely as I live," declares the LORD, "you will wear them all as ornaments; you will put them on, like a bride.

column.name: text
column.value: "Though you were ruined and made desolate and your land laid waste, now you will be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.

column.name: text
column.value: The children born during your bereavement will yet say in your hearing, 'This place is too small for us; give us more space to live in.'

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will say in your heart, 'Who bore me these? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. Who brought these up? I was left all alone, but these--where have they come from?'"

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "See, I will beckon to the Gentiles, I will lift up my banner to the peoples; they will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders.

column.name: text
column.value: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down before you with their faces to the ground; they will lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in me will not be disappointed."

column.name: text
column.value: Can plunder be taken from warriors, or captives rescued from the fierce?

column.name: text
column.value: But this is what the LORD says: "Yes, captives will be taken from warriors, and plunder retrieved from the fierce; I will contend with those who contend with you, and your children I will save.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."

column.name: text
column.value: "Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and come from the line of Judah, you who take oaths in the name of the LORD and invoke the God of Israel--but not in truth or righteousness--

column.name: text
column.value: you who call yourselves citizens of the holy city and rely on the God of Israel--the LORD Almighty is his name:

column.name: text
column.value: I foretold the former things long ago, my mouth announced them and I made them known; then suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: For I knew how stubborn you were; the sinews of your neck were iron, your forehead was bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I told you these things long ago; before they happened I announced them to you so that you could not say, 'My idols did them; my wooden image and metal god ordained them.'

column.name: text
column.value: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not admit them? "From now on I will tell you of new things, of hidden things unknown to you.

column.name: text
column.value: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot say, 'Yes, I knew of them.'

column.name: text
column.value: You have neither heard nor understood; from of old your ear has not been open. Well do I know how treacherous you are; you were called a rebel from birth.

column.name: text
column.value: For my own name's sake I delay my wrath; for the sake of my praise I hold it back from you, so as not to cut you off.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let myself be defamed? I will not yield my glory to another.

column.name: text
column.value: "Listen to me, O Jacob, Israel, whom I have called: I am he; I am the first and I am the last.

column.name: text
column.value: My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together.

column.name: text
column.value: "Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The LORD'S chosen ally will carry out his purpose against Babylon; his arm will be against the Babylonians.

column.name: text
column.value: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I will bring him, and he will succeed in his mission.

column.name: text
column.value: "Come near me and listen to this: "From the first announcement I have not spoken in secret; at the time it happens, I am there." And now the Sovereign LORD has sent me, with his Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says--your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.

column.name: text
column.value: If only you had paid attention to my commands, your peace would have been like a river, your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Your descendants would have been like the sand, your children like its numberless grains; their name would never be cut off nor destroyed from before me."

column.name: text
column.value: Leave Babylon, flee from the Babylonians! Announce this with shouts of joy and proclaim it. Send it out to the ends of the earth; say, "The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob."

column.name: text
column.value: They did not thirst when he led them through the deserts; he made water flow for them from the rock; he split the rock and water gushed out.

column.name: text
column.value: "There is no peace," says the LORD, "for the wicked."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Where is your mother's certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Because of your sins you were sold; because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.

column.name: text
column.value: When I came, why was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Was my arm too short to ransom you? Do I lack the strength to rescue you? By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; their fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: I clothe the sky with darkness and make sackcloth its covering."

column.name: text
column.value: The Sovereign LORD has given me an instructed tongue, to know the word that sustains the weary. He wakens me morning by morning, wakens my ear to listen like one being taught.

column.name: text
column.value: The Sovereign LORD has opened my ears, and I have not been rebellious; I have not drawn back.

column.name: text
column.value: I offered my back to those who beat me, my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard; I did not hide my face from mocking and spitting.

column.name: text
column.value: Because the Sovereign LORD helps me, I will not be disgraced. Therefore have I set my face like flint, and I know I will not be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: He who vindicates me is near. Who then will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him confront me!

column.name: text
column.value: It is the Sovereign LORD who helps me. Who is he that will condemn me? They will all wear out like a garment; the moths will eat them up.

column.name: text
column.value: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the word of his servant? Let him who walks in the dark, who has no light, trust in the name of the LORD and rely on his God.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, all you who light fires and provide yourselves with flaming torches, go, walk in the light of your fires and of the torches you have set ablaze. This is what you shall receive from my hand: You will lie down in torment.

column.name: text
column.value: "Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness and who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry from which you were hewn;

column.name: text
column.value: look to Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, who gave you birth. When I called him he was but one, and I blessed him and made him many.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will surely comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; he will make her deserts like Eden, her wastelands like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.

column.name: text
column.value: "Listen to me, my people; hear me, my nation: The law will go out from me; my justice will become a light to the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: My righteousness draws near speedily, my salvation is on the way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait in hope for my arm.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, look at the earth beneath; the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment and its inhabitants die like flies. But my salvation will last forever, my righteousness will never fail.

column.name: text
column.value: "Hear me, you who know what is right, you people who have my law in your hearts: Do not fear the reproach of men or be terrified by their insults.

column.name: text
column.value: For the moth will eat them up like a garment; the worm will devour them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever, my salvation through all generations."

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake! Clothe yourself with strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in days gone by, as in generations of old. Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced that monster through?

column.name: text
column.value: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea so that the redeemed might cross over?

column.name: text
column.value: The ransomed of the LORD will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

column.name: text
column.value: "I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you that you fear mortal men, the sons of men, who are but grass,

column.name: text
column.value: that you forget the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth, that you live in constant terror every day because of the wrath of the oppressor, who is bent on destruction? For where is the wrath of the oppressor?

column.name: text
column.value: The cowering prisoners will soon be set free; they will not die in their dungeon, nor will they lack bread.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the LORD your God, who churns up the sea so that its waves roar--the LORD Almighty is his name.

column.name: text
column.value: I have put my words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of my hand--I who set the heavens in place, who laid the foundations of the earth, and who say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of his wrath, you who have drained to its dregs the goblet that makes men stagger.

column.name: text
column.value: Of all the sons she bore there was none to guide her; of all the sons she reared there was none to take her by the hand.

column.name: text
column.value: These double calamities have come upon you--who can comfort you?--ruin and destruction, famine and sword--who can console you?

column.name: text
column.value: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street, like antelope caught in a net. They are filled with the wrath of the LORD and the rebuke of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear this, you afflicted one, made drunk, but not with wine.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what your Sovereign LORD says, your God, who defends his people: "See, I have taken out of your hand the cup that made you stagger; from that cup, the goblet of my wrath, you will never drink again.

column.name: text
column.value: I will put it into the hands of your tormentors, who said to you, 'Fall prostrate that we may walk over you.' And you made your back like the ground, like a street to be walked over."

column.name: text
column.value: Who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?

column.name: text
column.value: He grew up before him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him, nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.

column.name: text
column.value: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, and familiar with suffering. Like one from whom men hide their faces he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely he took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows, yet we considered him stricken by God, smitten by him, and afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon him, and by his wounds we are healed.

column.name: text
column.value: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

column.name: text
column.value: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth; he was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so he did not open his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: By oppression and judgment he was taken away. And who can speak of his descendants? For he was cut off from the land of the living; for the transgression of my people he was stricken.

column.name: text
column.value: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death, though he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet it was the LORD'S will to crush him and cause him to suffer, and though the LORD makes his life a guilt offering, he will see his offspring and prolong his days, and the will of the LORD will prosper in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light of life and be satisfied; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will give him a portion among the great, and he will divide the spoils with the strong, because he poured out his life unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors. For he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

column.name: text
column.value: "Sing, O barren woman, you who never bore a child; burst into song, shout for joy, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Enlarge the place of your tent, stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes.

column.name: text
column.value: For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your descendants will dispossess nations and settle in their desolate cities.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not be afraid; you will not suffer shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.

column.name: text
column.value: For your Maker is your husband--the LORD Almighty is his name--the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit--a wife who married young, only to be rejected," says your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with deep compassion I will bring you back.

column.name: text
column.value: In a surge of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you," says the LORD your Redeemer.

column.name: text
column.value: "To me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again.

column.name: text
column.value: Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed," says the LORD, who has compassion on you.

column.name: text
column.value: "O afflicted city, lashed by storms and not comforted, I will build you with stones of turquoise, your foundations with sapphires.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make your battlements of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

column.name: text
column.value: All your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be your children's peace.

column.name: text
column.value: In righteousness you will be established: Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone does attack you, it will not be my doing; whoever attacks you will surrender to you.

column.name: text
column.value: "See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to work havoc;

column.name: text
column.value: no weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and this is their vindication from me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.

column.name: text
column.value: Why spend money on what is not bread, and your labor on what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of fare.

column.name: text
column.value: Give ear and come to me; hear me, that your soul may live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful love promised to David.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have made him a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander of the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely you will summon nations you know not, and nations that do not know you will hasten to you, because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor."

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD while he may be found; call on him while he is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the wicked forsake his way and the evil man his thoughts. Let him turn to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him, and to our God, for he will freely pardon.

column.name: text
column.value: "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.

column.name: text
column.value: As the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and do not return to it without watering the earth and making it bud and flourish, so that it yields seed for the sower and bread for the eater,

column.name: text
column.value: so is my word that goes out from my mouth: It will not return to me empty, but will accomplish what I desire and achieve the purpose for which I sent it.

column.name: text
column.value: You will go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of the thornbush will grow the pine tree, and instead of briers the myrtle will grow. This will be for the LORD'S renown, for an everlasting sign, which will not be destroyed."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is close at hand and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who does this, the man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil."

column.name: text
column.value: Let no foreigner who has bound himself to the LORD say, "The LORD will surely exclude me from his people." And let not any eunuch complain, "I am only a dry tree."

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: "To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant--

column.name: text
column.value: to them I will give within my temple and its walls a memorial and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: And foreigners who bind themselves to the LORD to serve him, to love the name of the LORD, and to worship him, all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it and who hold fast to my covenant--

column.name: text
column.value: these I will bring to my holy mountain and give them joy in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations."

column.name: text
column.value: The Sovereign LORD declares--he who gathers the exiles of Israel: "I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered."

column.name: text
column.value: Come, all you beasts of the field, come and devour, all you beasts of the forest!

column.name: text
column.value: Israel's watchmen are blind, they all lack knowledge; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they lie around and dream, they love to sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: They are dogs with mighty appetites; they never have enough. They are shepherds who lack understanding; they all turn to their own way, each seeks his own gain.

column.name: text
column.value: "Come," each one cries, "let me get wine! Let us drink our fill of beer! And tomorrow will be like today, or even far better."

column.name: text
column.value: "Shout it aloud, do not hold back. Raise your voice like a trumpet. Declare to my people their rebellion and to the house of Jacob their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: For day after day they seek me out; they seem eager to know my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not forsaken the commands of its God. They ask me for just decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.

column.name: text
column.value: 'Why have we fasted,' they say, 'and you have not seen it? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you have not noticed?' "Yet on the day of your fasting, you do as you please and exploit all your workers.

column.name: text
column.value: Your fasting ends in quarreling and strife, and in striking each other with wicked fists. You cannot fast as you do today and expect your voice to be heard on high.

column.name: text
column.value: Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for a man to humble himself? Is it only for bowing one's head like a reed and for lying on sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: "Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen: to loose the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and break every yoke?

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter--when you see the naked, to clothe him, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?

column.name: text
column.value: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will quickly appear; then your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say: Here am I. "If you do away with the yoke of oppression, with the pointing finger and malicious talk,

column.name: text
column.value: and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.

column.name: text
column.value: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins and will raise up the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls, Restorer of Streets with Dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath and from doing as you please on my holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight and the LORD'S holy day honorable, and if you honor it by not going your own way and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,

column.name: text
column.value: then you will find your joy in the LORD, and I will cause you to ride on the heights of the land and to feast on the inheritance of your father Jacob." The mouth of the LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake, O Zion, clothe yourself with strength. Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, the holy city. The uncircumcised and defiled will not enter you again.

column.name: text
column.value: Shake off your dust; rise up, sit enthroned, O Jerusalem. Free yourself from the chains on your neck, O captive Daughter of Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: "You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed."

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "At first my people went down to Egypt to live; lately, Assyria has oppressed them.

column.name: text
column.value: "And now what do I have here?" declares the LORD. "For my people have been taken away for nothing, and those who rule them mock," declares the LORD. "And all day long my name is constantly blasphemed.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my people will know my name; therefore in that day they will know that it is I who foretold it. Yes, it is I."

column.name: text
column.value: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, "Your God reigns!"

column.name: text
column.value: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices; together they shout for joy. When the LORD returns to Zion, they will see it with their own eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Burst into songs of joy together, you ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will lay bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Come out from it and be pure, you who carry the vessels of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But you will not leave in haste or go in flight; for the LORD will go before you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

column.name: text
column.value: See, my servant will act wisely; he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as there were many who were appalled at him--his appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any man and his form marred beyond human likeness--

column.name: text
column.value: so will he sprinkle many nations, and kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what they were not told, they will see, and what they have not heard, they will understand.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous perish, and no one ponders it in his heart; devout men are taken away, and no one understands that the righteous are taken away to be spared from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest as they lie in death.

column.name: text
column.value: "But you--come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!

column.name: text
column.value: Whom are you mocking? At whom do you sneer and stick out your tongue? Are you not a brood of rebels, the offspring of liars?

column.name: text
column.value: You burn with lust among the oaks and under every spreading tree; you sacrifice your children in the ravines and under the overhanging crags.

column.name: text
column.value: The idols among the smooth stones of the ravines are your portion; they, they are your lot. Yes, to them you have poured out drink offerings and offered grain offerings. In the light of these things, should I relent?

column.name: text
column.value: You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill; there you went up to offer your sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: Behind your doors and your doorposts you have put your pagan symbols. Forsaking me, you uncovered your bed, you climbed into it and opened it wide; you made a pact with those whose beds you love, and you looked on their nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You went to Molech with olive oil and increased your perfumes. You sent your ambassadors far away; you descended to the grave itself!

column.name: text
column.value: You were wearied by all your ways, but you would not say, 'It is hopeless.' You found renewal of your strength, and so you did not faint.

column.name: text
column.value: "Whom have you so dreaded and feared that you have been false to me, and have neither remembered me nor pondered this in your hearts? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear me?

column.name: text
column.value: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not benefit you.

column.name: text
column.value: When you cry out for help, let your collection of idols save you! The wind will carry all of them off, a mere breath will blow them away. But the man who makes me his refuge will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain."

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be said: "Build up, build up, prepare the road! Remove the obstacles out of the way of my people."

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the high and lofty One says--he who lives forever, whose name is holy: "I live in a high and holy place, but also with him who is contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the contrite.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not accuse forever, nor will I always be angry, for then the spirit of man would grow faint before me--the breath of man that I have created.

column.name: text
column.value: I was enraged by his sinful greed; I punished him, and hid my face in anger, yet he kept on in his willful ways.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comfort to him,

column.name: text
column.value: creating praise on the lips of the mourners in Israel. Peace, peace, to those far and near," says the LORD. "And I will heal them."

column.name: text
column.value: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest, whose waves cast up mire and mud.

column.name: text
column.value: "There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear.

column.name: text
column.value: But your iniquities have separated you from your God; your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

column.name: text
column.value: For your hands are stained with blood, your fingers with guilt. Your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters wicked things.

column.name: text
column.value: No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case with integrity. They rely on empty arguments and speak lies; they conceive trouble and give birth to evil.

column.name: text
column.value: They hatch the eggs of vipers and spin a spider's web. Whoever eats their eggs will die, and when one is broken, an adder is hatched.

column.name: text
column.value: Their cobwebs are useless for clothing; they cannot cover themselves with what they make. Their deeds are evil deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Their feet rush into sin; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are evil thoughts; ruin and destruction mark their ways.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of peace they do not know; there is no justice in their paths. They have turned them into crooked roads; no one who walks in them will know peace.

column.name: text
column.value: So justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We look for light, but all is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in deep shadows.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the blind we grope along the wall, feeling our way like men without eyes. At midday we stumble as if it were twilight; among the strong, we are like the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: We all growl like bears; we moan mournfully like doves. We look for justice, but find none; for deliverance, but it is far away.

column.name: text
column.value: For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities:

column.name: text
column.value: rebellion and treachery against the LORD, turning our backs on our God, fomenting oppression and revolt, uttering lies our hearts have conceived.

column.name: text
column.value: So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter.

column.name: text
column.value: Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.

column.name: text
column.value: He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene; so his own arm worked salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him.

column.name: text
column.value: He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.

column.name: text
column.value: According to what they have done, so will he repay wrath to his enemies and retribution to his foes; he will repay the islands their due.

column.name: text
column.value: From the west, men will fear the name of the LORD, and from the rising of the sun, they will revere his glory. For he will come like a pent-up flood that the breath of the LORD drives along.

column.name: text
column.value: "The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who repent of their sins," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "As for me, this is my covenant with them," says the LORD. "My Spirit, who is on you, and my words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth, or from the mouths of your children, or from the mouths of their descendants from this time on and forever," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of the Sovereign LORD is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners,

column.name: text
column.value: to proclaim the year of the LORD'S favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

column.name: text
column.value: and provide for those who grieve in Zion--to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the LORD for the display of his splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities that have been devastated for generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Aliens will shepherd your flocks; foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will be called priests of the LORD, you will be named ministers of our God. You will feed on the wealth of nations, and in their riches you will boast.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of their shame my people will receive a double portion, and instead of disgrace they will rejoice in their inheritance; and so they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: "For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity. In my faithfulness I will reward them and make an everlasting covenant with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed."

column.name: text
column.value: I delight greatly in the LORD; my soul rejoices in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the soil makes the sprout come up and a garden causes seeds to grow, so the Sovereign LORD will make righteousness and praise spring up before all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: See, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness is over the peoples, but the LORD rises upon you and his glory appears over you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.

column.name: text
column.value: "Lift up your eyes and look about you: All assemble and come to you; your sons come from afar, and your daughters are carried on the arm.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will look and be radiant, your heart will throb and swell with joy; the wealth on the seas will be brought to you, to you the riches of the nations will come.

column.name: text
column.value: Herds of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah. And all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and incense and proclaiming the praise of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: All Kedar's flocks will be gathered to you, the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will adorn my glorious temple.

column.name: text
column.value: "Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the islands look to me; in the lead are the ships of Tarshish, bringing your sons from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: "Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though in anger I struck you, in favor I will show you compassion.

column.name: text
column.value: Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that men may bring you the wealth of the nations--their kings led in triumphal procession.

column.name: text
column.value: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly ruined.

column.name: text
column.value: "The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the pine, the fir and the cypress together, to adorn the place of my sanctuary; and I will glorify the place of my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of your oppressors will come bowing before you; all who despise you will bow down at your feet and will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "Although you have been forsaken and hated, with no one traveling through, I will make you the everlasting pride and the joy of all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and silver in place of iron. Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and iron in place of stones. I will make peace your governor and righteousness your ruler.

column.name: text
column.value: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders, but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun will no more be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you, for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.

column.name: text
column.value: Then will all your people be righteous and they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot I have planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: The least of you will become a thousand, the smallest a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will do this swiftly."

column.name: text
column.value: For Zion's sake I will not keep silent, for Jerusalem's sake I will not remain quiet, till her righteousness shines out like the dawn, her salvation like a blazing torch.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory; you will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be a crown of splendor in the LORD'S hand, a royal diadem in the hand of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: No longer will they call you Deserted, or name your land Desolate. But you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be married.

column.name: text
column.value: As a young man marries a maiden, so will your sons marry you; as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so will your God rejoice over you.

column.name: text
column.value: I have posted watchmen on your walls, O Jerusalem; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD, give yourselves no rest,

column.name: text
column.value: and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: "Never again will I give your grain as food for your enemies, and never again will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled;

column.name: text
column.value: but those who harvest it will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather the grapes will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary."

column.name: text
column.value: Pass through, pass through the gates! Prepare the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones. Raise a banner for the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has made proclamation to the ends of the earth: "Say to the Daughter of Zion, 'See, your Savior comes! See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.'"

column.name: text
column.value: They will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of the LORD; and you will be called Sought After, the City No Longer Deserted.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains would tremble before you!

column.name: text
column.value: As when fire sets twigs ablaze and causes water to boil, come down to make your name known to your enemies and cause the nations to quake before you!

column.name: text
column.value: For when you did awesome things that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.

column.name: text
column.value: You come to the help of those who gladly do right, who remember your ways. But when we continued to sin against them, you were angry. How then can we be saved?

column.name: text
column.value: All of us have become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all shrivel up like a leaf, and like the wind our sins sweep us away.

column.name: text
column.value: No one calls on your name or strives to lay hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and made us waste away because of our sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet, O LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay, you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be angry beyond measure, O LORD; do not remember our sins forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray, for we are all your people.

column.name: text
column.value: Your sacred cities have become a desert; even Zion is a desert, Jerusalem a desolation.

column.name: text
column.value: Our holy and glorious temple, where our fathers praised you, has been burned with fire, and all that we treasured lies in ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: After all this, O LORD, will you hold yourself back? Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?

column.name: text
column.value: "I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me; I was found by those who did not seek me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, 'Here am I, here am I.'

column.name: text
column.value: All day long I have held out my hands to an obstinate people, who walk in ways not good, pursuing their own imaginations--

column.name: text
column.value: a people who continually provoke me to my very face, offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on altars of brick;

column.name: text
column.value: who sit among the graves and spend their nights keeping secret vigil; who eat the flesh of pigs, and whose pots hold broth of unclean meat;

column.name: text
column.value: who say, 'Keep away; don't come near me, for I am too sacred for you!' Such people are smoke in my nostrils, a fire that keeps burning all day.

column.name: text
column.value: "See, it stands written before me: I will not keep silent but will pay back in full; I will pay it back into their laps--

column.name: text
column.value: both your sins and the sins of your fathers," says the LORD. "Because they burned sacrifices on the mountains and defied me on the hills, I will measure into their laps the full payment for their former deeds."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "As when juice is still found in a cluster of grapes and men say, 'Don't destroy it, there is yet some good in it,' so will I do in behalf of my servants; I will not destroy them all.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah those who will possess my mountains; my chosen people will inherit them, and there will my servants live.

column.name: text
column.value: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for my people who seek me.

column.name: text
column.value: "But as for you who forsake the LORD and forget my holy mountain, who spread a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,

column.name: text
column.value: I will destine you for the sword, and you will all bend down for the slaughter; for I called but you did not answer, I spoke but you did not listen. You did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; my servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; my servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: My servants will sing out of the joy of their hearts, but you will cry out from anguish of heart and wail in brokenness of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: You will leave your name to my chosen ones as a curse; the Sovereign LORD will put you to death, but to his servants he will give another name.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth; he who takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: "Behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.

column.name: text
column.value: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I will create, for I will create Jerusalem to be a delight and its people a joy.

column.name: text
column.value: I will rejoice over Jerusalem and take delight in my people; the sound of weeping and of crying will be heard in it no more.

column.name: text
column.value: "Never again will there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not live out his years; he who dies at a hundred will be thought a mere youth; he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.

column.name: text
column.value: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: No longer will they build houses and others live in them, or plant and others eat. For as the days of a tree, so will be the days of my people; my chosen ones will long enjoy the works of their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not toil in vain or bear children doomed to misfortune; for they will be a people blessed by the LORD, they and their descendants with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Before they call I will answer; while they are still speaking I will hear.

column.name: text
column.value: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, but dust will be the serpent's food. They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. Where is the house you will build for me? Where will my resting place be?

column.name: text
column.value: Has not my hand made all these things, and so they came into being?" declares the LORD. "This is the one I esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, and trembles at my word.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever sacrifices a bull is like one who kills a man, and whoever offers a lamb, like one who breaks a dog's neck; whoever makes a grain offering is like one who presents pig's blood, and whoever burns memorial incense, like one who worships an idol. They have chosen their own ways, and their souls delight in their abominations;

column.name: text
column.value: so I also will choose harsh treatment for them and will bring upon them what they dread. For when I called, no one answered, when I spoke, no one listened. They did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me."

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the word of the LORD, you who tremble at his word: "Your brothers who hate you, and exclude you because of my name, have said, 'Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy!' Yet they will be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear that uproar from the city, hear that noise from the temple! It is the sound of the LORD repaying his enemies all they deserve.

column.name: text
column.value: "Before she goes into labor, she gives birth; before the pains come upon her, she delivers a son.

column.name: text
column.value: Who has ever heard of such a thing? Who has ever seen such things? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be brought forth in a moment? Yet no sooner is Zion in labor than she gives birth to her children.

column.name: text
column.value: Do I bring to the moment of birth and not give delivery?" says the LORD. "Do I close up the womb when I bring to delivery?" says your God.

column.name: text
column.value: "Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad for her, all you who love her; rejoice greatly with her, all you who mourn over her.

column.name: text
column.value: For you will nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you will drink deeply and delight in her overflowing abundance."

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: "I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flooding stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm and dandled on her knees.

column.name: text
column.value: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you; and you will be comforted over Jerusalem."

column.name: text
column.value: When you see this, your heart will rejoice and you will flourish like grass; the hand of the LORD will be made known to his servants, but his fury will be shown to his foes.

column.name: text
column.value: See, the LORD is coming with fire, and his chariots are like a whirlwind; he will bring down his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For with fire and with his sword the LORD will execute judgment upon all men, and many will be those slain by the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Those who consecrate and purify themselves to go into the gardens, following the one in the midst of those who eat the flesh of pigs and rats and other abominable things--they will meet their end together," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "And I, because of their actions and their imaginations, am about to come and gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see my glory.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will set a sign among them, and I will send some of those who survive to the nations--to Tarshish, to the Libyans and Lydians (famous as archers), to Tubal and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard of my fame or seen my glory. They will proclaim my glory among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will bring all your brothers, from all the nations, to my holy mountain in Jerusalem as an offering to the LORD--on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels," says the LORD. "They will bring them, as the Israelites bring their grain offerings, to the temple of the LORD in ceremonially clean vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will select some of them also to be priests and Levites," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "As the new heavens and the new earth that I make will endure before me," declares the LORD, "so will your name and descendants endure.

column.name: text
column.value: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come and bow down before me," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "And they will go out and look upon the dead bodies of those who rebelled against me; their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind."

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to him in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: and through the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, down to the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart; I appointed you as a prophet to the nations."

column.name: text
column.value: "Ah, Sovereign LORD," I said, "I do not know how to speak; I am only a child."

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to me, "Do not say, 'I am only a child.' You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD reached out his hand and touched my mouth and said to me, "Now, I have put my words in your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: See, today I appoint you over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me: "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "I see the branch of an almond tree," I replied.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "You have seen correctly, for I am watching to see that my word is fulfilled."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me again: "What do you see?" "I see a boiling pot, tilting away from the north," I answered.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "From the north disaster will be poured out on all who live in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: I am about to summon all the peoples of the northern kingdoms," declares the LORD. "Their kings will come and set up their thrones in the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem; they will come against all her surrounding walls and against all the towns of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: I will pronounce my judgments on my people because of their wickedness in forsaking me, in burning incense to other gods and in worshiping what their hands have made.

column.name: text
column.value: "Get yourself ready! Stand up and say to them whatever I command you. Do not be terrified by them, or I will terrify you before them.

column.name: text
column.value: Today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and a bronze wall to stand against the whole land--against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: They will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem: "'I remember the devotion of your youth, how as a bride you loved me and followed me through the desert, through a land not sown.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel was holy to the LORD, the firstfruits of his harvest; all who devoured her were held guilty, and disaster overtook them,'" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, all you clans of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "What fault did your fathers find in me, that they strayed so far from me? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: They did not ask, 'Where is the LORD, who brought us up out of Egypt and led us through the barren wilderness, through a land of deserts and rifts, a land of drought and darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?'

column.name: text
column.value: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and rich produce. But you came and defiled my land and made my inheritance detestable.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests did not ask, 'Where is the LORD?' Those who deal with the law did not know me; the leaders rebelled against me. The prophets prophesied by Baal, following worthless idols.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore I bring charges against you again," declares the LORD. "And I will bring charges against your children's children.

column.name: text
column.value: Cross over to the coasts of Kittim and look, send to Kedar and observe closely; see if there has ever been anything like this:

column.name: text
column.value: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But my people have exchanged their Glory for worthless idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Be appalled at this, O heavens, and shudder with great horror," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "My people have committed two sins: They have forsaken me, the spring of living water, and have dug their own cisterns, broken cisterns that cannot hold water.

column.name: text
column.value: Is Israel a servant, a slave by birth? Why then has he become plunder?

column.name: text
column.value: Lions have roared; they have growled at him. They have laid waste his land; his towns are burned and deserted.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head.

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not brought this on yourselves by forsaking the LORD your God when he led you in the way?

column.name: text
column.value: Now why go to Egypt to drink water from the Shihor? And why go to Assyria to drink water from the River?

column.name: text
column.value: Your wickedness will punish you; your backsliding will rebuke you. Consider then and realize how evil and bitter it is for you when you forsake the LORD your God and have no awe of me," declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: "Long ago you broke off your yoke and tore off your bonds; you said, 'I will not serve you!' Indeed, on every high hill and under every spreading tree you lay down as a prostitute.

column.name: text
column.value: I had planted you like a choice vine of sound and reliable stock. How then did you turn against me into a corrupt, wild vine?

column.name: text
column.value: Although you wash yourself with soda and use an abundance of soap, the stain of your guilt is still before me," declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "How can you say, 'I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals'? See how you behaved in the valley; consider what you have done. You are a swift she-camel running here and there,

column.name: text
column.value: a wild donkey accustomed to the desert, sniffing the wind in her craving--in her heat who can restrain her? Any males that pursue her need not tire themselves; at mating time they will find her.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not run until your feet are bare and your throat is dry. But you said, 'It's no use! I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.'

column.name: text
column.value: "As a thief is disgraced when he is caught, so the house of Israel is disgraced--they, their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: They say to wood, 'You are my father,' and to stone, 'You gave me birth.' They have turned their backs to me and not their faces; yet when they are in trouble, they say, 'Come and save us!'

column.name: text
column.value: Where then are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them come if they can save you when you are in trouble! For you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: "Why do you bring charges against me? You have all rebelled against me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "In vain I punished your people; they did not respond to correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets like a ravening lion.

column.name: text
column.value: "You of this generation, consider the word of the LORD: "Have I been a desert to Israel or a land of great darkness? Why do my people say, 'We are free to roam; we will come to you no more'?

column.name: text
column.value: Does a maiden forget her jewelry, a bride her wedding ornaments? Yet my people have forgotten me, days without number.

column.name: text
column.value: How skilled you are at pursuing love! Even the worst of women can learn from your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: On your clothes men find the lifeblood of the innocent poor, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all this

column.name: text
column.value: you say, 'I am innocent; he is not angry with me.' But I will pass judgment on you because you say, 'I have not sinned.'

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you go about so much, changing your ways? You will be disappointed by Egypt as you were by Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head, for the LORD has rejected those you trust; you will not be helped by them.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you will return, O Israel, return to me," declares the LORD. "If you put your detestable idols out of my sight and no longer go astray,

column.name: text
column.value: and if in a truthful, just and righteous way you swear, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' then the nations will be blessed by him and in him they will glory."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: "Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among thorns.

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, circumcise your hearts, you men of Judah and people of Jerusalem, or my wrath will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done--burn with no one to quench it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Announce in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem and say: 'Sound the trumpet throughout the land!' Cry aloud and say: 'Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities!'

column.name: text
column.value: Raise the signal to go to Zion! Flee for safety without delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, even terrible destruction."

column.name: text
column.value: A lion has come out of his lair; a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his place to lay waste your land. Your towns will lie in ruins without inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: So put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day," declares the LORD, "the king and the officials will lose heart, the priests will be horrified, and the prophets will be appalled."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, "Ah, Sovereign LORD, how completely you have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, 'You will have peace,' when the sword is at our throats."

column.name: text
column.value: At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told, "A scorching wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward my people, but not to winnow or cleanse;

column.name: text
column.value: a wind too strong for that comes from me. Now I pronounce my judgments against them."

column.name: text
column.value: Look! He advances like the clouds, his chariots come like a whirlwind, his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! We are ruined!

column.name: text
column.value: O Jerusalem, wash the evil from your heart and be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts?

column.name: text
column.value: A voice is announcing from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell this to the nations, proclaim it to Jerusalem: 'A besieging army is coming from a distant land, raising a war cry against the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me,'" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Your own conduct and actions have brought this upon you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!"

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, my anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain. Oh, the agony of my heart! My heart pounds within me, I cannot keep silent. For I have heard the sound of the trumpet; I have heard the battle cry.

column.name: text
column.value: Disaster follows disaster; the whole land lies in ruins. In an instant my tents are destroyed, my shelter in a moment.

column.name: text
column.value: How long must I see the battle standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

column.name: text
column.value: "My people are fools; they do not know me. They are senseless children; they have no understanding. They are skilled in doing evil; they know not how to do good."

column.name: text
column.value: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and empty; and at the heavens, and their light was gone.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked at the mountains, and they were quaking; all the hills were swaying.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and there were no people; every bird in the sky had flown away.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert; all its towns lay in ruins before the LORD, before his fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "The whole land will be ruined, though I will not destroy it completely.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not relent, I have decided and will not turn back."

column.name: text
column.value: At the sound of horsemen and archers every town takes to flight. Some go into the thickets; some climb up among the rocks. All the towns are deserted; no one lives in them.

column.name: text
column.value: What are you doing, O devastated one? Why dress yourself in scarlet and put on jewels of gold? Why shade your eyes with paint? You adorn yourself in vain. Your lovers despise you; they seek your life.

column.name: text
column.value: I hear a cry as of a woman in labor, a groan as of one bearing her first child--the cry of the Daughter of Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands and saying, "Alas! I am fainting; my life is given over to murderers."

column.name: text
column.value: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson? Who is this, robed in splendor, striding forward in the greatness of his strength? "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to save."

column.name: text
column.value: Why are your garments red, like those of one treading the winepress?

column.name: text
column.value: "I have trodden the winepress alone; from the nations no one was with me. I trampled them in my anger and trod them down in my wrath; their blood spattered my garments, and I stained all my clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redemption has come.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, but there was no one to help, I was appalled that no one gave support; so my own arm worked salvation for me, and my own wrath sustained me.

column.name: text
column.value: I trampled the nations in my anger; in my wrath I made them drunk and poured their blood on the ground."

column.name: text
column.value: I will tell of the kindnesses of the LORD, the deeds for which he is to be praised, according to all the LORD has done for us--yes, the many good things he has done for the house of Israel, according to his compassion and many kindnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, "Surely they are my people, sons who will not be false to me"; and so he became their Savior.

column.name: text
column.value: In all their distress he too was distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and mercy he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. So he turned and became their enemy and he himself fought against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then his people recalled the days of old, the days of Moses and his people--where is he who brought them through the sea, with the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who set his Holy Spirit among them,

column.name: text
column.value: who sent his glorious arm of power to be at Moses' right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for himself everlasting renown,

column.name: text
column.value: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble;

column.name: text
column.value: like cattle that go down to the plain, they were given rest by the Spirit of the LORD. This is how you guided your people to make for yourself a glorious name.

column.name: text
column.value: Look down from heaven and see from your lofty throne, holy and glorious. Where are your zeal and your might? Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.

column.name: text
column.value: But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or Israel acknowledge us; you, O LORD, are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Why, O LORD, do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: For a little while your people possessed your holy place, but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your name.

column.name: text
column.value: "If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and marries another man, should he return to her again? Would not the land be completely defiled? But you have lived as a prostitute with many lovers--would you now return to me?" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Look up to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been ravished? By the roadside you sat waiting for lovers, sat like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to blush with shame.

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not just called to me: 'My Father, my friend from my youth,

column.name: text
column.value: will you always be angry? Will your wrath continue forever?' This is how you talk, but you do all the evil you can."

column.name: text
column.value: During the reign of King Josiah, the LORD said to me, "Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every spreading tree and has committed adultery there.

column.name: text
column.value: I thought that after she had done all this she would return to me but she did not, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.

column.name: text
column.value: I gave faithless Israel her certificate of divorce and sent her away because of all her adulteries. Yet I saw that her unfaithful sister Judah had no fear; she also went out and committed adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: Because Israel's immorality mattered so little to her, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stone and wood.

column.name: text
column.value: In spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but only in pretense," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "Faithless Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: "'Return, faithless Israel,' declares the LORD, 'I will frown on you no longer, for I am merciful,' declares the LORD, 'I will not be angry forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Only acknowledge your guilt--you have rebelled against the LORD your God, you have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every spreading tree, and have not obeyed me,'" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Return, faithless people," declares the LORD, "for I am your husband. I will choose you--one from a town and two from a clan--and bring you to Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will lead you with knowledge and understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days, when your numbers have increased greatly in the land," declares the LORD, "men will no longer say, 'The ark of the covenant of the LORD.' It will never enter their minds or be remembered; it will not be missed, nor will another one be made.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD, and all nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD. No longer will they follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days the house of Judah will join the house of Israel, and together they will come from a northern land to the land I gave your forefathers as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: "I myself said, "'How gladly would I treat you like sons and give you a desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.' I thought you would call me 'Father' and not turn away from following me.

column.name: text
column.value: But like a woman unfaithful to her husband, so you have been unfaithful to me, O house of Israel," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
