column.value: A cry is heard on the barren heights, the weeping and pleading of the people of Israel, because they have perverted their ways and have forgotten the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: "Return, faithless people; I will cure you of backsliding." "Yes, we will come to you, for you are the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the idolatrous commotion on the hills and mountains is a deception; surely in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: From our youth shameful gods have consumed the fruits of our fathers' labor--their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our fathers; from our youth till this day we have not obeyed the LORD our God."

column.name: text
column.value: "Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem, look around and consider, search through her squares. If you can find but one person who deals honestly and seeks the truth, I will forgive this city.

column.name: text
column.value: Although they say, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' still they are swearing falsely."

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, do not your eyes look for truth? You struck them, but they felt no pain; you crushed them, but they refused correction. They made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent.

column.name: text
column.value: I thought, "These are only the poor; they are foolish, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the requirements of their God.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will go to the leaders and speak to them; surely they know the way of the LORD, the requirements of their God." But with one accord they too had broken off the yoke and torn off the bonds.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore a lion from the forest will attack them, a wolf from the desert will ravage them, a leopard will lie in wait near their towns to tear to pieces any who venture out, for their rebellion is great and their backslidings many.

column.name: text
column.value: "Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I supplied all their needs, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.

column.name: text
column.value: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for another man's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

column.name: text
column.value: "Go through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not destroy them completely. Strip off her branches, for these people do not belong to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They have lied about the LORD; they said, "He will do nothing! No harm will come to us; we will never see sword or famine.

column.name: text
column.value: The prophets are but wind and the word is not in them; so let what they say be done to them."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD God Almighty says: "Because the people have spoken these words, I will make my words in your mouth a fire and these people the wood it consumes.

column.name: text
column.value: O house of Israel," declares the LORD, "I am bringing a distant nation against you--an ancient and enduring nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you do not understand.

column.name: text
column.value: Their quivers are like an open grave; all of them are mighty warriors.

column.name: text
column.value: They will devour your harvests and food, devour your sons and daughters; they will devour your flocks and herds, devour your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.

column.name: text
column.value: "Yet even in those days," declares the LORD, "I will not destroy you completely.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people ask, 'Why has the LORD our God done all this to us?' you will tell them, 'As you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your own land, so now you will serve foreigners in a land not your own.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Announce this to the house of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, you foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear:

column.name: text
column.value: Should you not fear me?" declares the LORD. "Should you not tremble in my presence? I made the sand a boundary for the sea, an everlasting barrier it cannot cross. The waves may roll, but they cannot prevail; they may roar, but they cannot cross it.

column.name: text
column.value: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they have turned aside and gone away.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not say to themselves, 'Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives autumn and spring rains in season, who assures us of the regular weeks of harvest.'

column.name: text
column.value: Your wrongdoings have kept these away; your sins have deprived you of good.

column.name: text
column.value: "Among my people are wicked men who lie in wait like men who snare birds and like those who set traps to catch men.

column.name: text
column.value: Like cages full of birds, their houses are full of deceit; they have become rich and powerful

column.name: text
column.value: and have grown fat and sleek. Their evil deeds have no limit; they do not plead the case of the fatherless to win it, they do not defend the rights of the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

column.name: text
column.value: "A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land:

column.name: text
column.value: The prophets prophesy lies, the priests rule by their own authority, and my people love it this way. But what will you do in the end?

column.name: text
column.value: "Flee for safety, people of Benjamin! Flee from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa! Raise the signal over Beth Hakkerem! For disaster looms out of the north, even terrible destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy the Daughter of Zion, so beautiful and delicate.

column.name: text
column.value: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents around her, each tending his own portion."

column.name: text
column.value: "Prepare for battle against her! Arise, let us attack at noon! But, alas, the daylight is fading, and the shadows of evening grow long.

column.name: text
column.value: So arise, let us attack at night and destroy her fortresses!"

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Cut down the trees and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; it is filled with oppression.

column.name: text
column.value: As a well pours out its water, so she pours out her wickedness. Violence and destruction resound in her; her sickness and wounds are ever before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Take warning, O Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you and make your land desolate so no one can live in it."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Let them glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine; pass your hand over the branches again, like one gathering grapes."

column.name: text
column.value: To whom can I speak and give warning? Who will listen to me? Their ears are closed so they cannot hear. The word of the LORD is offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.

column.name: text
column.value: But I am full of the wrath of the LORD, and I cannot hold it in. "Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together; both husband and wife will be caught in it, and the old, those weighed down with years.

column.name: text
column.value: Their houses will be turned over to others, together with their fields and their wives, when I stretch out my hand against those who live in the land," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. 'Peace, peace,' they say, when there is no peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they ashamed of their loathsome conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when I punish them," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But you said, 'We will not walk in it.'

column.name: text
column.value: I appointed watchmen over you and said, 'Listen to the sound of the trumpet!' But you said, 'We will not listen.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear, O nations; observe, O witnesses, what will happen to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O earth: I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not listened to my words and have rejected my law.

column.name: text
column.value: What do I care about incense from Sheba or sweet calamus from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please me."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "I will put obstacles before this people. Fathers and sons alike will stumble over them; neighbors and friends will perish."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Look, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: They are armed with bow and spear; they are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, O Daughter of Zion."

column.name: text
column.value: We have heard reports about them, and our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not go out to the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and there is terror on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: O my people, put on sackcloth and roll in ashes; mourn with bitter wailing as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have made you a tester of metals and my people the ore, that you may observe and test their ways.

column.name: text
column.value: They are all hardened rebels, going about to slander. They are bronze and iron; they all act corruptly.

column.name: text
column.value: The bellows blow fiercely to burn away the lead with fire, but the refining goes on in vain; the wicked are not purged out.

column.name: text
column.value: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them."

column.name: text
column.value: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "Stand at the gate of the LORD'S house and there proclaim this message: "'Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Reform your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not trust in deceptive words and say, "This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD!"

column.name: text
column.value: If you really change your ways and your actions and deal with each other justly,

column.name: text
column.value: if you do not oppress the alien, the fatherless or the widow and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your forefathers for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal and follow other gods you have not known,

column.name: text
column.value: and then come and stand before me in this house, which bears my Name, and say, "We are safe"--safe to do all these detestable things?

column.name: text
column.value: Has this house, which bears my Name, become a den of robbers to you? But I have been watching! declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for my Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: While you were doing all these things, declares the LORD, I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen; I called you, but you did not answer.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears my Name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your brothers, the people of Ephraim.'

column.name: text
column.value: "So do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough and make cakes of bread for the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke me to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: But am I the one they are provoking? declares the LORD. Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and on the fruit of the ground, and it will burn and not be quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!

column.name: text
column.value: For when I brought your forefathers out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,

column.name: text
column.value: but I gave them this command: Obey me, and I will be your God and you will be my people. Walk in all the ways I command you, that it may go well with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubborn inclinations of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

column.name: text
column.value: From the time your forefathers left Egypt until now, day after day, again and again I sent you my servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their forefathers.'

column.name: text
column.value: "When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you; when you call to them, they will not answer.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, 'This is the nation that has not obeyed the LORD its God or responded to correction. Truth has perished; it has vanished from their lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Cut off your hair and throw it away; take up a lament on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under his wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, declares the LORD. They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears my Name and have defiled it.

column.name: text
column.value: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire--something I did not command, nor did it enter my mind.

column.name: text
column.value: So beware, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, for they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the carcasses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: "'At that time, declares the LORD, the bones of the kings and officials of Judah, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be exposed to the sun and the moon and all the stars of the heavens, which they have loved and served and which they have followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried, but will be like refuse lying on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever I banish them, all the survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, declares the LORD Almighty.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: "'When men fall down, do they not get up? When a man turns away, does he not return?

column.name: text
column.value: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.

column.name: text
column.value: I have listened attentively, but they do not say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, "What have I done?" Each pursues his own course like a horse charging into battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons, and the dove, the swift and the thrush observe the time of their migration. But my people do not know the requirements of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'How can you say, "We are wise, for we have the law of the LORD," when actually the lying pen of the scribes has handled it falsely?

column.name: text
column.value: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what kind of wisdom do they have?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. "Peace, peace," they say, when there is no peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they ashamed of their loathsome conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when they are punished, says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I will take away their harvest, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine. There will be no figs on the tree, and their leaves will wither. What I have given them will be taken from them.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "Why are we sitting here? Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there! For the LORD our God has doomed us to perish and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against him.

column.name: text
column.value: We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there was only terror.

column.name: text
column.value: The snorting of the enemy's horses is heard from Dan; at the neighing of their stallions the whole land trembles. They have come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who live there."

column.name: text
column.value: "See, I will send venomous snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: O my Comforter in sorrow, my heart is faint within me.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to the cry of my people from a land far away: "Is the LORD not in Zion? Is her King no longer there?" "Why have they provoked me to anger with their images, with their worthless foreign idols?"

column.name: text
column.value: "The harvest is past, the summer has ended, and we are not saved."

column.name: text
column.value: Since my people are crushed, I am crushed; I mourn, and horror grips me.

column.name: text
column.value: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then is there no healing for the wound of my people?

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night for the slain of my people.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that I had in the desert a lodging place for travelers, so that I might leave my people and go away from them; for they are all adulterers, a crowd of unfaithful people.

column.name: text
column.value: "They make ready their tongue like a bow, to shoot lies; it is not by truth that they triumph in the land. They go from one sin to another; they do not acknowledge me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Beware of your friends; do not trust your brothers. For every brother is a deceiver, and every friend a slanderer.

column.name: text
column.value: Friend deceives friend, and no one speaks the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they weary themselves with sinning.

column.name: text
column.value: You live in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to acknowledge me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty says: "See, I will refine and test them, for what else can I do because of the sin of my people?

column.name: text
column.value: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks with deceit. With his mouth each speaks cordially to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?"

column.name: text
column.value: I will weep and wail for the mountains and take up a lament concerning the desert pastures. They are desolate and untraveled, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds of the air have fled and the animals are gone.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals; and I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."

column.name: text
column.value: What man is wise enough to understand this? Who has been instructed by the LORD and can explain it? Why has the land been ruined and laid waste like a desert that no one can cross?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said, "It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts; they have followed the Baals, as their fathers taught them."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "See, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.

column.name: text
column.value: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will pursue them with the sword until I have destroyed them."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Consider now! Call for the wailing women to come; send for the most skillful of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them come quickly and wail over us till our eyes overflow with tears and water streams from our eyelids.

column.name: text
column.value: The sound of wailing is heard from Zion: 'How ruined we are! How great is our shame! We must leave our land because our houses are in ruins.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Now, O women, hear the word of the LORD; open your ears to the words of his mouth. Teach your daughters how to wail; teach one another a lament.

column.name: text
column.value: Death has climbed in through our windows and has entered our fortresses; it has cut off the children from the streets and the young men from the public squares.

column.name: text
column.value: Say, "This is what the LORD declares: "'The dead bodies of men will lie like refuse on the open field, like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather them.'"

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Let not the wise man boast of his wisdom or the strong man boast of his strength or the rich man boast of his riches,

column.name: text
column.value: but let him who boasts boast about this: that he understands and knows me, that I am the LORD, who exercises kindness, justice and righteousness on earth, for in these I delight," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh--

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab and all who live in the desert in distant places. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and even the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart."

column.name: text
column.value: Hear what the LORD says to you, O house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by signs in the sky, though the nations are terrified by them.

column.name: text
column.value: For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut a tree out of the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with his chisel.

column.name: text
column.value: They adorn it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so it will not totter.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a scarecrow in a melon patch, their idols cannot speak; they must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them; they can do no harm nor can they do any good."

column.name: text
column.value: No one is like you, O LORD; you are great, and your name is mighty in power.

column.name: text
column.value: Who should not revere you, O King of the nations? This is your due. Among all the wise men of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.

column.name: text
column.value: They are all senseless and foolish; they are taught by worthless wooden idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. What the craftsman and goldsmith have made is then dressed in blue and purple--all made by skilled workers.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD is the true God; he is the living God, the eternal King. When he is angry, the earth trembles; the nations cannot endure his wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell them this: 'These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.'"

column.name: text
column.value: But God made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. His images are a fraud; they have no breath in them.

column.name: text
column.value: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including Israel, the tribe of his inheritance--the LORD Almighty is his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Gather up your belongings to leave the land, you who live under siege.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: "At this time I will hurl out those who live in this land; I will bring distress on them so that they may be captured."

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to me because of my injury! My wound is incurable! Yet I said to myself, "This is my sickness, and I must endure it."

column.name: text
column.value: My tent is destroyed; all its ropes are snapped. My sons are gone from me and are no more; no one is left now to pitch my tent or to set up my shelter.

column.name: text
column.value: The shepherds are senseless and do not inquire of the LORD; so they do not prosper and all their flock is scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen! The report is coming--a great commotion from the land of the north! It will make the towns of Judah desolate, a haunt of jackals.

column.name: text
column.value: I know, O LORD, that a man's life is not his own; it is not for man to direct his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: Correct me, LORD, but only with justice--not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the peoples who do not call on your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him completely and destroyed his homeland.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "Listen to the terms of this covenant and tell them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Cursed is the man who does not obey the terms of this covenant--

column.name: text
column.value: the terms I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.' I said, 'Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey'--the land you possess today." I answered, "Amen, LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: 'Listen to the terms of this covenant and follow them.

column.name: text
column.value: From the time I brought your forefathers up from Egypt until today, I warned them again and again, saying, "Obey me."

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of the covenant I had commanded them to follow but that they did not keep.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, "There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers, who refused to listen to my words. They have followed other gods to serve them. Both the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: 'I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Although they cry out to me, I will not listen to them.

column.name: text
column.value: The towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they will not help them at all when disaster strikes.

column.name: text
column.value: You have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them, because I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their distress.

column.name: text
column.value: "What is my beloved doing in my temple as she works out her evil schemes with many? Can consecrated meat avert your punishment? When you engage in your wickedness, then you rejoice."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD called you a thriving olive tree with fruit beautiful in form. But with the roar of a mighty storm he will set it on fire, and its branches will be broken.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD Almighty, who planted you, has decreed disaster for you, because the house of Israel and the house of Judah have done evil and provoked me to anger by burning incense to Baal.

column.name: text
column.value: Because the LORD revealed their plot to me, I knew it, for at that time he showed me what they were doing.

column.name: text
column.value: I had been like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; I did not realize that they had plotted against me, saying, "Let us destroy the tree and its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more."

column.name: text
column.value: But, O LORD Almighty, you who judge righteously and test the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance upon them, for to you I have committed my cause.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the LORD says about the men of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, 'Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD or you will die by our hands'--

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the LORD Almighty says: 'I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.

column.name: text
column.value: Not even a remnant will be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the men of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.'"

column.name: text
column.value: You are always righteous, O LORD, when I bring a case before you. Yet I would speak with you about your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

column.name: text
column.value: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they grow and bear fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you know me, O LORD; you see me and test my thoughts about you. Drag them off like sheep to be butchered! Set them apart for the day of slaughter!

column.name: text
column.value: How long will the land lie parched and the grass in every field be withered? Because those who live in it are wicked, the animals and birds have perished. Moreover, the people are saying, "He will not see what happens to us."

column.name: text
column.value: "If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in safe country, how will you manage in the thickets by the Jordan?

column.name: text
column.value: Your brothers, your own family--even they have betrayed you; they have raised a loud cry against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will forsake my house, abandon my inheritance; I will give the one I love into the hands of her enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She roars at me; therefore I hate her.

column.name: text
column.value: Has not my inheritance become to me like a speckled bird of prey that other birds of prey surround and attack? Go and gather all the wild beasts; bring them to devour.

column.name: text
column.value: Many shepherds will ruin my vineyard and trample down my field; they will turn my pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be made a wasteland, parched and desolate before me; the whole land will be laid waste because there is no one who cares.

column.name: text
column.value: Over all the barren heights in the desert destroyers will swarm, for the sword of the LORD will devour from one end of the land to the other; no one will be safe.

column.name: text
column.value: They will sow wheat but reap thorns; they will wear themselves out but gain nothing. So bear the shame of your harvest because of the LORD'S fierce anger."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to his own inheritance and his own country.

column.name: text
column.value: And if they learn well the ways of my people and swear by my name, saying, 'As surely as the LORD lives'--even as they once taught my people to swear by Baal--then they will be established among my people.

column.name: text
column.value: But if any nation does not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water."

column.name: text
column.value: So I bought a belt, as the LORD directed, and put it around my waist.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time:

column.name: text
column.value: "Take the belt you bought and are wearing around your waist, and go now to Perath and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks."

column.name: text
column.value: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the LORD told me.

column.name: text
column.value: Many days later the LORD said to me, "Go now to Perath and get the belt I told you to hide there."

column.name: text
column.value: So I went to Perath and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, but now it was ruined and completely useless.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the LORD says: 'In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: These wicked people, who refuse to listen to my words, who follow the stubbornness of their hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them, will be like this belt--completely useless!

column.name: text
column.value: For as a belt is bound around a man's waist, so I bound the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to me,' declares the LORD, 'to be my people for my renown and praise and honor. But they have not listened.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to them: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine.' And if they say to you, 'Don't we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?'

column.name: text
column.value: then tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land, including the kings who sit on David's throne, the priests, the prophets and all those living in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: I will smash them one against the other, fathers and sons alike, declares the LORD. I will allow no pity or mercy or compassion to keep me from destroying them.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Hear and pay attention, do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Give glory to the LORD your God before he brings the darkness, before your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light, but he will turn it to thick darkness and change it to deep gloom.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly, overflowing with tears, because the LORD'S flock will be taken captive.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Come down from your thrones, for your glorious crowns will fall from your heads."

column.name: text
column.value: The cities in the Negev will be shut up, and there will be no one to open them. All Judah will be carried into exile, carried completely away.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your eyes and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was entrusted to you, the sheep of which you boasted?

column.name: text
column.value: What will you say when the LORD sets over you those you cultivated as your special allies? Will not pain grip you like that of a woman in labor?

column.name: text
column.value: And if you ask yourself, "Why has this happened to me?"--it is because of your many sins that your skirts have been torn off and your body mistreated.

column.name: text
column.value: Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard its spots? Neither can you do good who are accustomed to doing evil.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.

column.name: text
column.value: This is your lot, the portion I have decreed for you," declares the LORD, "because you have forgotten me and trusted in false gods.

column.name: text
column.value: I will pull up your skirts over your face that your shame may be seen--

column.name: text
column.value: your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution! I have seen your detestable acts on the hills and in the fields. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will you be unclean?"

column.name: text
column.value: This is the word of the LORD to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

column.name: text
column.value: "Judah mourns, her cities languish; they wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns but find no water. They return with their jars unfilled; dismayed and despairing, they cover their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: The ground is cracked because there is no rain in the land; the farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.

column.name: text
column.value: Wild donkeys stand on the barren heights and pant like jackals; their eyesight fails for lack of pasture."

column.name: text
column.value: Although our sins testify against us, O LORD, do something for the sake of your name. For our backsliding is great; we have sinned against you.

column.name: text
column.value: O Hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are you like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays only a night?

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? You are among us, O LORD, and we bear your name; do not forsake us!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says about this people: "They greatly love to wander; they do not restrain their feet. So the LORD does not accept them; he will now remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not pray for the well-being of this people.

column.name: text
column.value: Although they fast, I will not listen to their cry; though they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with the sword, famine and plague."

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, "Ah, Sovereign LORD, the prophets keep telling them, 'You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give you lasting peace in this place.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, "The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, divinations, idolatries and the delusions of their own minds.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD says about the prophets who are prophesying in my name: I did not send them, yet they are saying, 'No sword or famine will touch this land.' Those same prophets will perish by sword and famine.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them or their wives, their sons or their daughters. I will pour out on them the calamity they deserve.

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak this word to them: "'Let my eyes overflow with tears night and day without ceasing; for my virgin daughter--my people--has suffered a grievous wound, a crushing blow.

column.name: text
column.value: If I go into the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I go into the city, I see the ravages of famine. Both prophet and priest have gone to a land they know not.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Have you rejected Judah completely? Do you despise Zion? Why have you afflicted us so that we cannot be healed? We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, we acknowledge our wickedness and the guilt of our fathers; we have indeed sinned against you.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of your name do not despise us; do not dishonor your glorious throne. Remember your covenant with us and do not break it.

column.name: text
column.value: Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies themselves send down showers? No, it is you, O LORD our God. Therefore our hope is in you, for you are the one who does all this.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me: "Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence! Let them go!

column.name: text
column.value: And if they ask you, 'Where shall we go?' tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: "'Those destined for death, to death; those for the sword, to the sword; those for starvation, to starvation; those for captivity, to captivity.'

column.name: text
column.value: "I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," declares the LORD, "the sword to kill and the dogs to drag away and the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: "Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?

column.name: text
column.value: You have rejected me," declares the LORD. "You keep on backsliding. So I will lay hands on you and destroy you; I can no longer show compassion.

column.name: text
column.value: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the city gates of the land. I will bring bereavement and destruction on my people, for they have not changed their ways.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of their young men; suddenly I will bring down on them anguish and terror.

column.name: text
column.value: The mother of seven will grow faint and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. I will put the survivors to the sword before their enemies," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Alas, my mother, that you gave me birth, a man with whom the whole land strives and contends! I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said, "Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will make your enemies plead with you in times of disaster and times of distress.

column.name: text
column.value: "Can a man break iron--iron from the north--or bronze?

column.name: text
column.value: Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without charge, because of all your sins throughout your country.

column.name: text
column.value: I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you."

column.name: text
column.value: You understand, O LORD; remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are long-suffering--do not take me away; think of how I suffer reproach for your sake.

column.name: text
column.value: When your words came, I ate them; they were my joy and my heart's delight, for I bear your name, O LORD God Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: I never sat in the company of revelers, never made merry with them; I sat alone because your hand was on me and you had filled me with indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: Why is my pain unending and my wound grievous and incurable? Will you be to me like a deceptive brook, like a spring that fails?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "If you repent, I will restore you that you may serve me; if you utter worthy, not worthless, words, you will be my spokesman. Let this people turn to you, but you must not turn to them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to rescue and save you," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will save you from the hands of the wicked and redeem you from the grasp of the cruel."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "You must not marry and have sons or daughters in this place."

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the women who are their mothers and the men who are their fathers:

column.name: text
column.value: "They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will be like refuse lying on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: "Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut himself or shave his head for them.

column.name: text
column.value: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead--not even for a father or a mother--nor will anyone give them a drink to console them.

column.name: text
column.value: "And do not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Before your eyes and in your days I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: "When you tell these people all this and they ask you, 'Why has the LORD decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the LORD our God?'

column.name: text
column.value: then say to them, 'It is because your fathers forsook me,' declares the LORD, 'and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook me and did not keep my law.

column.name: text
column.value: But you have behaved more wickedly than your fathers. See how each of you is following the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying me.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will throw you out of this land into a land neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.'

column.name: text
column.value: "However, the days are coming," declares the LORD, "when men will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,'

column.name: text
column.value: but they will say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.' For I will restore them to the land I gave their forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: "But now I will send for many fishermen," declares the LORD, "and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and from the crevices of the rocks.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, nor is their sin concealed from my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and have filled my inheritance with their detestable idols."

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in time of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, "Our fathers possessed nothing but false gods, worthless idols that did them no good.

column.name: text
column.value: Do men make their own gods? Yes, but they are not gods!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore I will teach them--this time I will teach them my power and might. Then they will know that my name is the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and of the priests

column.name: text
column.value: and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. There proclaim the words I tell you,

column.name: text
column.value: and say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Listen! I am going to bring a disaster on this place that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it tingle.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have forsaken me and made this a place of foreign gods; they have burned sacrifices in it to gods that neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.

column.name: text
column.value: They have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons in the fire as offerings to Baal--something I did not command or mention, nor did it enter my mind.

column.name: text
column.value: So beware, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: "'In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, at the hands of those who seek their lives, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I will devastate this city and make it an object of scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another's flesh during the stress of the siege imposed on them by the enemies who seek their lives.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then break the jar while those who go with you are watching,

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter's jar is smashed and cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what I will do to this place and to those who live here, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.

column.name: text
column.value: The houses in Jerusalem and those of the kings of Judah will be defiled like this place, Topheth--all the houses where they burned incense on the roofs to all the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Jeremiah then returned from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and stood in the court of the LORD'S temple and said to all the people,

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'Listen! I am going to bring on this city and the villages around it every disaster I pronounced against them, because they were stiff-necked and would not listen to my words.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "Judah's sin is engraved with an iron tool, inscribed with a flint point, on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.

column.name: text
column.value: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles beside the spreading trees and on the high hills.

column.name: text
column.value: My mountain in the land and your wealth and all your treasures I will give away as plunder, together with your high places, because of sin throughout your country.

column.name: text
column.value: Through your own fault you will lose the inheritance I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for you have kindled my anger, and it will burn forever."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Cursed is the one who trusts in man, who depends on flesh for his strength and whose heart turns away from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be like a bush in the wastelands; he will not see prosperity when it comes. He will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.

column.name: text
column.value: "But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in him.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit."

column.name: text
column.value: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?

column.name: text
column.value: "I the LORD search the heart and examine the mind, to reward a man according to his conduct, according to what his deeds deserve."

column.name: text
column.value: Like a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay is the man who gains riches by unjust means. When his life is half gone, they will desert him, and in the end he will prove to be a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn away from you will be written in the dust because they have forsaken the LORD, the spring of living water.

column.name: text
column.value: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.

column.name: text
column.value: They keep saying to me, "Where is the word of the LORD? Let it now be fulfilled!"

column.name: text
column.value: I have not run away from being your shepherd; you know I have not desired the day of despair. What passes my lips is open before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.

column.name: text
column.value: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but keep me from shame; let them be terrified, but keep me from terror. Bring on them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and stand at the gate of the people, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; stand also at all the other gates of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, 'Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem who come through these gates.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not bring a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they did not listen or pay attention; they were stiff-necked and would not listen or respond to discipline.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you are careful to obey me, declares the LORD, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it,

column.name: text
column.value: then kings who sit on David's throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials. They and their officials will come riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by the men of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.

column.name: text
column.value: People will come from the towns of Judah and the villages around Jerusalem, from the territory of Benjamin and the western foothills, from the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings, incense and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not obey me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying any load as you come through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem that will consume her fortresses.'"

column.name: text
column.value: When the priest Pashhur son of Immer, the chief officer in the temple of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

column.name: text
column.value: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin at the LORD'S temple.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day, when Pashhur released him from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The LORD'S name for you is not Pashhur, but Magor-Missabib.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: 'I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; with your own eyes you will see them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will hand all Judah over to the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: I will hand over to their enemies all the wealth of this city--all its products, all its valuables and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take it away as plunder and carry it off to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into exile to Babylon. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.'"

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, you deceived me, and I was deceived; you overpowered me and prevailed. I am ridiculed all day long; everyone mocks me.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever I speak, I cry out proclaiming violence and destruction. So the word of the LORD has brought me insult and reproach all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I say, "I will not mention him or speak any more in his name," his word is in my heart like a fire, a fire shut up in my bones. I am weary of holding it in; indeed, I cannot.

column.name: text
column.value: I hear many whispering, "Terror on every side! Report him! Let's report him!" All my friends are waiting for me to slip, saying, "Perhaps he will be deceived; then we will prevail over him and take our revenge on him."

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD is with me like a mighty warrior; so my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will fail and be thoroughly disgraced; their dishonor will never be forgotten.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD Almighty, you who examine the righteous and probe the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance upon them, for to you I have committed my cause.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD! Give praise to the LORD! He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me not be blessed!

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, who made him very glad, saying, "A child is born to you--a son!"

column.name: text
column.value: May that man be like the towns the LORD overthrew without pity. May he hear wailing in the morning, a battle cry at noon.

column.name: text
column.value: For he did not kill me in the womb, with my mother as my grave, her womb enlarged forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame?

column.name: text
column.value: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: "Go down to the potter's house, and there I will give you my message."

column.name: text
column.value: So I went down to the potter's house, and I saw him working at the wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: But the pot he was shaping from the clay was marred in his hands; so the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter does?" declares the LORD. "Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, O house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down and destroyed,

column.name: text
column.value: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not inflict on it the disaster I had planned.

column.name: text
column.value: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,

column.name: text
column.value: and if it does evil in my sight and does not obey me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, 'This is what the LORD says: Look! I am preparing a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and reform your ways and your actions.'

column.name: text
column.value: But they will reply, 'It's no use. We will continue with our own plans; each of us will follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard anything like this? A most horrible thing has been done by Virgin Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from distant sources ever cease to flow?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to worthless idols, which made them stumble in their ways and in the ancient paths. They made them walk in bypaths and on roads not built up.

column.name: text
column.value: Their land will be laid waste, an object of lasting scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a wind from the east, I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them my back and not my face in the day of their disaster."

column.name: text
column.value: They said, "Come, let's make plans against Jeremiah; for the teaching of the law by the priest will not be lost, nor will counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophets. So come, let's attack him with our tongues and pay no attention to anything he says."

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to me, O LORD; hear what my accusers are saying!

column.name: text
column.value: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember that I stood before you and spoke in their behalf to turn your wrath away from them.

column.name: text
column.value: So give their children over to famine; hand them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives be made childless and widows; let their men be put to death, their young men slain by the sword in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring invaders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: But you know, O LORD, all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their crimes or blot out their sins from your sight. Let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.

column.name: text
column.value: The word came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said:

column.name: text
column.value: "Inquire now of the LORD for us because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the LORD will perform wonders for us as in times past so that he will withdraw from us."

column.name: text
column.value: But Jeremiah answered them, "Tell Zedekiah,

column.name: text
column.value: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them inside this city.

column.name: text
column.value: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm in anger and fury and great wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: I will strike down those who live in this city--both men and animals--and they will die of a terrible plague.

column.name: text
column.value: After that, declares the LORD, I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the people in this city who survive the plague, sword and famine, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who seek their lives. He will put them to the sword; he will show them no mercy or pity or compassion.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Furthermore, tell the people, 'This is what the LORD says: See, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are besieging you will live; he will escape with his life.

column.name: text
column.value: I have determined to do this city harm and not good, declares the LORD. It will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will destroy it with fire.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Moreover, say to the royal house of Judah, 'Hear the word of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: O house of David, this is what the LORD says: "'Administer justice every morning; rescue from the hand of his oppressor the one who has been robbed, or my wrath will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done--burn with no one to quench it.

column.name: text
column.value: I am against you, Jerusalem,you who live above this valley on the rocky plateau, declares the LORD--you who say, "Who can come against us? Who can enter our refuge?"

column.name: text
column.value: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in your forests that will consume everything around you.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of my pasture!" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who tend my people: "Because you have scattered my flock and driven them away and have not bestowed care on them, I will bestow punishment on you for the evil you have done," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them and will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and increase in number.

column.name: text
column.value: I will place shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or terrified, nor will any be missing," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will raise up to David a righteous Branch, a King who will reign wisely and do what is just and right in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. This is the name by which he will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: "So then, the days are coming," declares the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,'

column.name: text
column.value: but they will say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the descendants of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.' Then they will live in their own land."

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like a man overcome by wine, because of the LORD and his holy words.

column.name: text
column.value: The land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land lies parched and the pastures in the desert are withered. The prophets follow an evil course and use their power unjustly.

column.name: text
column.value: "Both prophet and priest are godless; even in my temple I find their wickedness," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore their path will become slippery; they will be banished to darkness and there they will fall. I will bring disaster on them in the year they are punished," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Among the prophets of Samaria I saw this repulsive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.

column.name: text
column.value: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible: They commit adultery and live a lie. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns from his wickedness. They are all like Sodom to me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty says concerning the prophets: "I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Do not listen to what the prophets are prophesying to you; they fill you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They keep saying to those who despise me, 'The LORD says: You will have peace.' And to all who follow the stubbornness of their hearts they say, 'No harm will come to you.'

column.name: text
column.value: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see or to hear his word? Who has listened and heard his word?

column.name: text
column.value: See, the storm of the LORD will burst out in wrath, a whirlwind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand it clearly.

column.name: text
column.value: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they had stood in my council, they would have proclaimed my words to my people and would have turned them from their evil ways and from their evil deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: "Am I only a God nearby," declares the LORD, "and not a God far away?

column.name: text
column.value: Can anyone hide in secret places so that I cannot see him?" declares the LORD. "Do not I fill heaven and earth?" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in my name. They say, 'I had a dream! I had a dream!'

column.name: text
column.value: How long will this continue in the hearts of these lying prophets, who prophesy the delusions of their own minds?

column.name: text
column.value: They think the dreams they tell one another will make my people forget my name, just as their fathers forgot my name through Baal worship.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the prophet who has a dream tell his dream, but let the one who has my word speak it faithfully. For what has straw to do with grain?" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Is not my word like fire," declares the LORD, "and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore," declares the LORD, "I am against the prophets who steal from one another words supposedly from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Yes," declares the LORD, "I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and yet declare, 'The LORD declares.'

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, I am against those who prophesy false dreams," declares the LORD. "They tell them and lead my people astray with their reckless lies, yet I did not send or appoint them. They do not benefit these people in the least," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask you, 'What is the oracle of the LORD?' say to them, 'What oracle? I will forsake you, declares the LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: If a prophet or a priest or anyone else claims, 'This is the oracle of the LORD,' I will punish that man and his household.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what each of you keeps on saying to his friend or relative: 'What is the LORD'S answer?' or 'What has the LORD spoken?'

column.name: text
column.value: But you must not mention 'the oracle of the LORD' again, because every man's own word becomes his oracle and so you distort the words of the living God, the LORD Almighty, our God.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what you keep saying to a prophet: 'What is the LORD'S answer to you?' or 'What has the LORD spoken?'

column.name: text
column.value: Although you claim, 'This is the oracle of the LORD,' this is what the LORD says: You used the words, 'This is the oracle of the LORD,' even though I told you that you must not claim, 'This is the oracle of the LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I will surely forget you and cast you out of my presence along with the city I gave to you and your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring upon you everlasting disgrace--everlasting shame that will not be forgotten."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there:

column.name: text
column.value: 'Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, you who sit on David's throne--you, your officials and your people who come through these gates.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of his oppressor the one who has been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to the alien, the fatherless or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you are careful to carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David's throne will come through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by their officials and their people.

column.name: text
