column.value: Again and again I sent my servants the prophets, who said, 'Do not do this detestable thing that I hate!'

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not listen or pay attention; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my fierce anger was poured out; it raged against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem and made them the desolate ruins they are today.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now this is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Why bring such great disaster on yourselves by cutting off from Judah the men and women, the children and infants, and so leave yourselves without a remnant?

column.name: text
column.value: Why provoke me to anger with what your hands have made, burning incense to other gods in Egypt, where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and make yourselves an object of cursing and reproach among all the nations on earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your fathers and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: I will take away the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt to settle there. They will all perish in Egypt; they will fall by the sword or die from famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine. They will become an object of cursing and horror, of condemnation and reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: I will punish those who live in Egypt with the sword, famine and plague, as I punished Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: None of the remnant of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, to which they long to return and live; none will return except a few fugitives."

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, along with all the women who were present--a large assembly--and all the people living in Lower and Upper Egypt, said to Jeremiah,

column.name: text
column.value: "We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: We will certainly do everything we said we would: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and will pour out drink offerings to her just as we and our fathers, our kings and our officials did in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and were well off and suffered no harm.

column.name: text
column.value: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine."

column.name: text
column.value: The women added, "When we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did not our husbands know that we were making cakes like her image and pouring out drink offerings to her?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,

column.name: text
column.value: "Did not the LORD remember and think about the incense burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem by you and your fathers, your kings and your officials and the people of the land?

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD could no longer endure your wicked actions and the detestable things you did, your land became an object of cursing and a desolate waste without inhabitants, as it is today.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you have burned incense and have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed him or followed his law or his decrees or his stipulations, this disaster has come upon you, as you now see."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women, "Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have shown by your actions what you promised when you said, 'We will certainly carry out the vows we made to burn incense and pour out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven.' "Go ahead then, do what you promised! Keep your vows!

column.name: text
column.value: But hear the word of the LORD, all Jews living in Egypt: 'I swear by my great name,' says the LORD, 'that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name or swear, "As surely as the Sovereign LORD lives."

column.name: text
column.value: For I am watching over them for harm, not for good; the Jews in Egypt will perish by sword and famine until they are all destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand--mine or theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This will be the sign to you that I will punish you in this place,' declares the LORD, 'so that you will know that my threats of harm against you will surely stand.'

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: 'I am going to hand Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt over to his enemies who seek his life, just as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who was seeking his life.'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.

column.name: text
column.value: On the fifth of the month--it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin--

column.name: text
column.value: the word of the LORD came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, by the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians. There the hand of the LORD was upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and I saw a windstorm coming out of the north--an immense cloud with flashing lightning and surrounded by brilliant light. The center of the fire looked like glowing metal,

column.name: text
column.value: and in the fire was what looked like four living creatures. In appearance their form was that of a man,

column.name: text
column.value: but each of them had four faces and four wings.

column.name: text
column.value: Their legs were straight; their feet were like those of a calf and gleamed like burnished bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: Under their wings on their four sides they had the hands of a man. All four of them had faces and wings,

column.name: text
column.value: and their wings touched one another. Each one went straight ahead; they did not turn as they moved.

column.name: text
column.value: Their faces looked like this: Each of the four had the face of a man, and on the right side each had the face of a lion, and on the left the face of an ox; each also had the face of an eagle.

column.name: text
column.value: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out upward; each had two wings, one touching the wing of another creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.

column.name: text
column.value: Each one went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they went.

column.name: text
column.value: The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among the creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: The creatures sped back and forth like flashes of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like chrysolite, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not turn about as the creatures went.

column.name: text
column.value: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.

column.name: text
column.value: When the living creatures moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

column.name: text
column.value: When the creatures moved, they also moved; when the creatures stood still, they also stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

column.name: text
column.value: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was what looked like an expanse, sparkling like ice, and awesome.

column.name: text
column.value: Under the expanse their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.

column.name: text
column.value: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood with lowered wings.

column.name: text
column.value: Above the expanse over their heads was what looked like a throne of sapphire, and high above on the throne was a figure like that of a man.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw that from what appeared to be his waist up he looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire, and that from there down he looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the radiance around him. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of one speaking.

column.name: text
column.value: How the gold has lost its luster, the fine gold become dull! The sacred gems are scattered at the head of every street.

column.name: text
column.value: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in gold, are now considered as pots of clay, the work of a potter's hands!

column.name: text
column.value: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but my people have become heartless like ostriches in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of thirst the infant's tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth; the children beg for bread, but no one gives it to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those nurtured in purple now lie on ash heaps.

column.name: text
column.value: The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment without a hand turned to help her.

column.name: text
column.value: Their princes were brighter than snow and whiter than milk, their bodies more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.

column.name: text
column.value: But now they are blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.

column.name: text
column.value: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of famine; racked with hunger, they waste away for lack of food from the field.

column.name: text
column.value: With their own hands compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food when my people were destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has given full vent to his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion that consumed her foundations.

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the world's people, that enemies and foes could enter the gates of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: But it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed within her the blood of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they grope through the streets like men who are blind. They are so defiled with blood that no one dares to touch their garments.

column.name: text
column.value: "Go away! You are unclean!" men cry to them. "Away! Away! Don't touch us!" When they flee and wander about, people among the nations say, "They can stay here no longer."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD himself has scattered them; he no longer watches over them. The priests are shown no honor, the elders no favor.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, our eyes failed, looking in vain for help; from our towers we watched for a nation that could not save us.

column.name: text
column.value: Men stalked us at every step, so we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near, our days were numbered, for our end had come.

column.name: text
column.value: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD'S anointed, our very life breath, was caught in their traps. We thought that under his shadow we would live among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.

column.name: text
column.value: O Daughter of Zion, your punishment will end; he will not prolong your exile. But, O Daughter of Edom, he will punish your sin and expose your wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us; look, and see our disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: Our inheritance has been turned over to aliens, our homes to foreigners.

column.name: text
column.value: We have become orphans and fatherless, our mothers like widows.

column.name: text
column.value: We must buy the water we drink; our wood can be had only at a price.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are weary and find no rest.

column.name: text
column.value: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers sinned and are no more, and we bear their punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaves rule over us, and there is none to free us from their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.

column.name: text
column.value: Women have been ravished in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.

column.name: text
column.value: Young men toil at the millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.

column.name: text
column.value: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.

column.name: text
column.value: Joy is gone from our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this our hearts are faint, because of these things our eyes grow dim

column.name: text
column.value: for Mount Zion, which lies desolate, with jackals prowling over it.

column.name: text
column.value: You, O LORD, reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?

column.name: text
column.value: Restore us to yourself, O LORD, that we may return; renew our days as of old

column.name: text
column.value: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak to you."

column.name: text
column.value: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.

column.name: text
column.value: He said: "Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their fathers have been in revolt against me to this very day.

column.name: text
column.value: The people to whom I am sending you are obstinate and stubborn. Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says.'

column.name: text
column.value: And whether they listen or fail to listen--for they are a rebellious house--they will know that a prophet has been among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns are all around you and you live among scorpions. Do not be afraid of what they say or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen, for they are rebellious.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll,

column.name: text
column.value: which he unrolled before me. On both sides of it were written words of lament and mourning and woe.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now, son of man, take a clay tablet, put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then lay siege to it: Erect siege works against it, build a ramp up to it, set up camps against it and put battering rams around it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then take an iron pan, place it as an iron wall between you and the city and turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the house of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side.

column.name: text
column.value: I have assigned you the same number of days as the years of their sin. So for 390 days you will bear the sin of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "After you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the sin of the house of Judah. I have assigned you 40 days, a day for each year.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem and with bared arm prophesy against her.

column.name: text
column.value: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt; put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the 390 days you lie on your side.

column.name: text
column.value: Weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day and eat it at set times.

column.name: text
column.value: Also measure out a sixth of a hin of water and drink it at set times.

column.name: text
column.value: Eat the food as you would a barley cake; bake it in the sight of the people, using human excrement for fuel."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said, "In this way the people of Israel will eat defiled food among the nations where I will drive them."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, "Not so, Sovereign LORD! I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything found dead or torn by wild animals. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth."

column.name: text
column.value: "Very well," he said, "I will let you bake your bread over cow manure instead of human excrement."

column.name: text
column.value: He then said to me: "Son of man, I will cut off the supply of food in Jerusalem. The people will eat rationed food in anxiety and drink rationed water in despair,

column.name: text
column.value: for food and water will be scarce. They will be appalled at the sight of each other and will waste away because of their sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the house of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, "Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it." So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: He then said to me: "Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak my words to them.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not being sent to a people of obscure speech and difficult language, but to the house of Israel--

column.name: text
column.value: not to many peoples of obscure speech and difficult language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But the house of Israel is not willing to listen to you because they are not willing to listen to me, for the whole house of Israel is hardened and obstinate.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will make you as unyielding and hardened as they are.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make your forehead like the hardest stone, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious house."

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, "Son of man, listen carefully and take to heart all the words I speak to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Go now to your countrymen in exile and speak to them. Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says,' whether they listen or fail to listen."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound--May the glory of the LORD be praised in his dwelling place!--

column.name: text
column.value: the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit then lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: I came to the exiles who lived at Tel Abib near the Kebar River. And there, where they were living, I sat among them for seven days--overwhelmed.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I say to a wicked man, 'You will surely die,' and you do not warn him or speak out to dissuade him from his evil ways in order to save his life, that wicked man will die for his sin, and I will hold you accountable for his blood.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do warn the wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness or from his evil ways, he will die for his sin; but you will have saved yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: "Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. Since you did not warn him, he will die for his sin. The righteous things he did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for his blood.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do warn the righteous man not to sin and he does not sin, he will surely live because he took warning, and you will have saved yourself."

column.name: text
column.value: The hand of the LORD was upon me there, and he said to me, "Get up and go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you."

column.name: text
column.value: So I got up and went out to the plain. And the glory of the LORD was standing there, like the glory I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes; you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, though they are a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says.' Whoever will listen let him listen, and whoever will refuse let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says to the land of Israel: The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The end is now upon you and I will unleash my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not look on you with pity or spare you; I will surely repay you for your conduct and the detestable practices among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Disaster! An unheard-of disaster is coming.

column.name: text
column.value: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. It has come!

column.name: text
column.value: Doom has come upon you--you who dwell in the land. The time has come, the day is near; there is panic, not joy, upon the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: I am about to pour out my wrath on you and spend my anger against you; I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not look on you with pity or spare you; I will repay you in accordance with your conduct and the detestable practices among you. Then you will know that it is I the LORD who strikes the blow.

column.name: text
column.value: "The day is here! It has come! Doom has burst forth, the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed!

column.name: text
column.value: Violence has grown into a rod to punish wickedness; none of the people will be left, none of that crowd--no wealth, nothing of value.

column.name: text
column.value: The time has come, the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice nor the seller grieve, for wrath is upon the whole crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: The seller will not recover the land he has sold as long as both of them live, for the vision concerning the whole crowd will not be reversed. Because of their sins, not one of them will preserve his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Though they blow the trumpet and get everything ready, no one will go into battle, for my wrath is upon the whole crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: "Outside is the sword, inside are plague and famine; those in the country will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.

column.name: text
column.value: All who survive and escape will be in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valleys, each because of his sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will become as weak as water.

column.name: text
column.value: They will put on sackcloth and be clothed with terror. Their faces will be covered with shame and their heads will be shaved.

column.name: text
column.value: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be an unclean thing. Their silver and gold will not be able to save them in the day of the LORD'S wrath. They will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it, for it has made them stumble into sin.

column.name: text
column.value: They were proud of their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their detestable idols and vile images. Therefore I will turn these into an unclean thing for them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will hand it all over as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, and they will defile it.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn my face away from them, and they will desecrate my treasured place; robbers will enter it and desecrate it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Prepare chains, because the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of violence.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring the most wicked of the nations to take possession of their houses; I will put an end to the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be desecrated.

column.name: text
column.value: When terror comes, they will seek peace, but there will be none.

column.name: text
column.value: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor upon rumor. They will try to get a vision from the prophet; the teaching of the law by the priest will be lost, as will the counsel of the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and by their own standards I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: "Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a barber's razor to shave your head and your beard. Then take a set of scales and divide up the hair.

column.name: text
column.value: When the days of your siege come to an end, burn a third of the hair with fire inside the city. Take a third and strike it with the sword all around the city. And scatter a third to the wind. For I will pursue them with drawn sword.

column.name: text
column.value: But take a few strands of hair and tuck them away in the folds of your garment.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, take a few of these and throw them into the fire and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to the whole house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet in her wickedness she has rebelled against my laws and decrees more than the nations and countries around her. She has rejected my laws and has not followed my decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: You have been more unruly than the nations around you and have not followed my decrees or kept my laws. You have not even conformed to the standards of the nations around you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will inflict punishment on you in the sight of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of all your detestable idols, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore in your midst fathers will eat their children, and children will eat their fathers. I will inflict punishment on you and will scatter all your survivors to the winds.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your vile images and detestable practices, I myself will withdraw my favor; I will not look on you with pity or spare you.

column.name: text
column.value: A third of your people will die of the plague or perish by famine inside you; a third will fall by the sword outside your walls; and a third I will scatter to the winds and pursue with drawn sword.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then my anger will cease and my wrath against them will subside, and I will be avenged. And when I have spent my wrath upon them, they will know that I the LORD have spoken in my zeal.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and an object of horror to the nations around you when I inflict punishment on you in anger and in wrath and with stinging rebuke. I the LORD have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: When I shoot at you with my deadly and destructive arrows of famine, I will shoot to destroy you. I will bring more and more famine upon you and cut off your supply of food.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I the LORD have spoken."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel; prophesy against them

column.name: text
column.value: and say: 'O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.

column.name: text
column.value: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will slay your people in front of your idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lay the dead bodies of the Israelites in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever you live, the towns will be laid waste and the high places demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and devastated, your idols smashed and ruined, your incense altars broken down, and what you have made wiped out.

column.name: text
column.value: Your people will fall slain among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But I will spare some, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the lands and nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then in the nations where they have been carried captive, those who escape will remember me--how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts, which have turned away from me, and by their eyes, which have lusted after their idols. They will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their detestable practices.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not threaten in vain to bring this calamity on them.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Strike your hands together and stamp your feet and cry out "Alas!" because of all the wicked and detestable practices of the house of Israel, for they will fall by the sword, famine and plague.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is far away will die of the plague, and he that is near will fall by the sword, and he that survives and is spared will die of famine. So will I spend my wrath upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will know that I am the LORD, when their people lie slain among their idols around their altars, on every high hill and on all the mountaintops, under every spreading tree and every leafy oak--places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land a desolate waste from the desert to Diblah--wherever they live. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the sixth year, in the sixth month on the fifth day, while I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, the hand of the Sovereign LORD came upon me there.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and I saw a figure like that of a man. From what appeared to be his waist down he was like fire, and from there up his appearance was as bright as glowing metal.

column.name: text
column.value: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and in visions of God he took me to Jerusalem, to the entrance to the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes to jealousy stood.

column.name: text
column.value: And there before me was the glory of the God of Israel, as in the vision I had seen in the plain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." So I looked, and in the entrance north of the gate of the altar I saw this idol of jealousy.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing--the utterly detestable things the house of Israel is doing here, things that will drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see things that are even more detestable."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the entrance to the court. I looked, and I saw a hole in the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "Son of man, now dig into the wall." So I dug into the wall and saw a doorway there.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, "Go in and see the wicked and detestable things they are doing here."

column.name: text
column.value: So I went in and looked, and I saw portrayed all over the walls all kinds of crawling things and detestable animals and all the idols of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In front of them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? They say, 'The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Again, he said, "You will see them doing things that are even more detestable."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the entrance to the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, mourning for Tammuz.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? You will see things that are even more detestable than this."

column.name: text
column.value: He then brought me into the inner court of the house of the LORD, and there at the entrance to the temple, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men. With their backs toward the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east, they were bowing down to the sun in the east.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a trivial matter for the house of Judah to do the detestable things they are doing here? Must they also fill the land with violence and continually provoke me to anger? Look at them putting the branch to their nose!

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will deal with them in anger; I will not look on them with pity or spare them. Although they shout in my ears, I will not listen to them."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I heard him call out in a loud voice, "Bring the guards of the city here, each with a weapon in his hand."

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the glory of the God of Israel went up from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple. Then the LORD called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit at his side

column.name: text
column.value: and said to him, "Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and lament over all the detestable things that are done in it."

column.name: text
column.value: As I listened, he said to the others, "Follow him through the city and kill, without showing pity or compassion.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaughter old men, young men and maidens, women and children, but do not touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at my sanctuary." So they began with the elders who were in front of the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, "Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go!" So they went out and began killing throughout the city.

column.name: text
column.value: While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell facedown, crying out, "Ah, Sovereign LORD! Are you going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel in this outpouring of your wrath on Jerusalem?"

column.name: text
column.value: He answered me, "The sin of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, 'The LORD has forsaken the land; the LORD does not see.'

column.name: text
column.value: So I will not look on them with pity or spare them, but I will bring down on their own heads what they have done."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man in linen with the writing kit at his side brought back word, saying, "I have done as you commanded."

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and I saw the likeness of a throne of sapphire above the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to the man clothed in linen, "Go in among the wheels beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city." And as I watched, he went in.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the temple. The cloud filled the temple, and the court was full of the radiance of the glory of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far away as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD commanded the man in linen, "Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim," the man went in and stood beside a wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand to the fire that was among them. He took up some of it and put it into the hands of the man in linen, who took it and went out.

column.name: text
column.value: (Under the wings of the cherubim could be seen what looked like the hands of a man.)

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and I saw beside the cherubim four wheels, one beside each of the cherubim; the wheels sparkled like chrysolite.

column.name: text
column.value: As for their appearance, the four of them looked alike; each was like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the cherubim faced; the wheels did not turn about as the cherubim went. The cherubim went in whatever direction the head faced, without turning as they went.

column.name: text
column.value: Their entire bodies, including their backs, their hands and their wings, were completely full of eyes, as were their four wheels.

column.name: text
column.value: I heard the wheels being called "the whirling wheels."

column.name: text
column.value: Each of the cherubim had four faces: One face was that of a cherub, the second the face of a man, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the Kebar River.

column.name: text
column.value: When the cherubim moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the cherubim spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not leave their side.

column.name: text
column.value: When the cherubim stood still, they also stood still; and when the cherubim rose, they rose with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the glory of the LORD departed from over the threshold of the temple and stopped above the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: While I watched, the cherubim spread their wings and rose from the ground, and as they went, the wheels went with them. They stopped at the entrance to the east gate of the LORD'S house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the Kebar River, and I realized that they were cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: Each had four faces and four wings, and under their wings was what looked like the hands of a man.

column.name: text
column.value: Their faces had the same appearance as those I had seen by the Kebar River. Each one went straight ahead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east. There at the entrance to the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who are plotting evil and giving wicked advice in this city.

column.name: text
column.value: They say, 'Will it not soon be time to build houses? This city is a cooking pot, and we are the meat.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon me, and he told me to say: "This is what the LORD says: That is what you are saying, O house of Israel, but I know what is going through your mind.

column.name: text
column.value: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: The bodies you have thrown there are the meat and this city is the pot, but I will drive you out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will drive you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners and inflict punishment on you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will fall by the sword, and I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat in it; I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will know that I am the LORD, for you have not followed my decrees or kept my laws but have conformed to the standards of the nations around you."

column.name: text
column.value: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, "Ah, Sovereign LORD! Will you completely destroy the remnant of Israel?"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, your brothers--your brothers who are your blood relatives and the whole house of Israel--are those of whom the people of Jerusalem have said, 'They are far away from the LORD; this land was given to us as our possession.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel again.'

column.name: text
column.value: "They will return to it and remove all its vile images and detestable idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

column.name: text
column.value: The glory of the LORD went up from within the city and stopped above the mountain east of it.

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Babylonia in the vision given by the Spirit of God. Then the vision I had seen went up from me,

column.name: text
column.value: and I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: 'Hear the word of the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!

column.name: text
column.value: Your prophets, O Israel, are like jackals among ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: You have not gone up to the breaks in the wall to repair it for the house of Israel so that it will stand firm in the battle on the day of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Their visions are false and their divinations a lie. They say, "The LORD declares," when the LORD has not sent them; yet they expect their words to be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not seen false visions and uttered lying divinations when you say, "The LORD declares," though I have not spoken?

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because of your false words and lying visions, I am against you, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and utter lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of my people or be listed in the records of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Because they lead my people astray, saying, "Peace," when there is no peace, and because, when a flimsy wall is built, they cover it with whitewash,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore tell those who cover it with whitewash that it is going to fall. Rain will come in torrents, and I will send hailstones hurtling down, and violent winds will burst forth.

column.name: text
column.value: When the wall collapses, will people not ask you, "Where is the whitewash you covered it with?"

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: In my wrath I will unleash a violent wind, and in my anger hailstones and torrents of rain will fall with destructive fury.

column.name: text
column.value: I will tear down the wall you have covered with whitewash and will level it to the ground so that its foundation will be laid bare. When it falls, you will be destroyed in it; and you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will spend my wrath against the wall and against those who covered it with whitewash. I will say to you, "The wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it,

column.name: text
column.value: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Sovereign LORD." '

column.name: text
column.value: "Now, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them

column.name: text
column.value: and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on all their wrists and make veils of various lengths for their heads in order to ensnare people. Will you ensnare the lives of my people but preserve your own?

column.name: text
column.value: You have profaned me among my people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to my people, who listen to lies, you have killed those who should not have died and have spared those who should not live.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against your magic charms with which you ensnare people like birds and I will tear them from your arms; I will set free the people that you ensnare like birds.

column.name: text
column.value: I will tear off your veils and save my people from your hands, and they will no longer fall prey to your power. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies, when I had brought them no grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so save their lives,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will save my people from your hands. And then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, you are living among a rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious people.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, son of man, pack your belongings for exile and in the daytime, as they watch, set out and go from where you are to another place. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: During the daytime, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, go out like those who go into exile.

column.name: text
column.value: While they watch, dig through the wall and take your belongings out through it.

column.name: text
column.value: Put them on your shoulder as they are watching and carry them out at dusk. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have made you a sign to the house of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: So I did as I was commanded. During the day I brought out my things packed for exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulders while they watched.

column.name: text
column.value: In the morning the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, did not that rebellious house of Israel ask you, 'What are you doing?'

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: This oracle concerns the prince in Jerusalem and the whole house of Israel who are there.'

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, 'I am a sign to you.' "As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives.

column.name: text
column.value: "The prince among them will put his things on his shoulder at dusk and leave, and a hole will be dug in the wall for him to go through. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare; I will bring him to Babylonia, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.

column.name: text
column.value: I will scatter to the winds all those around him--his staff and all his troops--and I will pursue them with drawn sword.

column.name: text
column.value: "They will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, famine and plague, so that in the nations where they go they may acknowledge all their detestable practices. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, tremble as you eat your food, and shudder in fear as you drink your water.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the people of the land: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabited towns will be laid waste and the land will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, what is this proverb you have in the land of Israel: 'The days go by and every vision comes to nothing'?

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer quote it in Israel.' Say to them, 'The days are near when every vision will be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations among the people of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But I the LORD will speak what I will, and it shall be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, you rebellious house, I will fulfill whatever I say, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, the house of Israel is saying, 'The vision he sees is for many years from now, and he prophesies about the distant future.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: None of my words will be delayed any longer; whatever I say will be fulfilled, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I let them inquire of me at all?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore speak to them and tell them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face and then goes to a prophet, I the LORD will answer him myself in keeping with his great idolatry.

column.name: text
column.value: I will do this to recapture the hearts of the people of Israel, who have all deserted me for their idols.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Repent! Turn from your idols and renounce all your detestable practices!

column.name: text
column.value: "'When any Israelite or any alien living in Israel separates himself from me and sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face and then goes to a prophet to inquire of me, I the LORD will answer him myself.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set my face against that man and make him an example and a byword. I will cut him off from my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'And if the prophet is enticed to utter a prophecy, I the LORD have enticed that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from among my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: They will bear their guilt--the prophet will be as guilty as the one who consults him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people of Israel will no longer stray from me, nor will they defile themselves anymore with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, if a country sins against me by being unfaithful and I stretch out my hand against it to cut off its food supply and send famine upon it and kill its men and their animals,

column.name: text
column.value: even if these three men--Noah, Daniel and Job--were in it, they could save only themselves by their righteousness, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Or if I send wild beasts through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one can pass through it because of the beasts,

column.name: text
column.value: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: "Or if I bring a sword against that country and say, 'Let the sword pass throughout the land,' and I kill its men and their animals,

column.name: text
column.value: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: "Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out my wrath upon it through bloodshed, killing its men and their animals,

column.name: text
column.value: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if Noah, Daniel and Job were in it, they could save neither son nor daughter. They would save only themselves by their righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: "For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem my four dreadful judgments--sword and famine and wild beasts and plague--to kill its men and their animals!

column.name: text
column.value: Yet there will be some survivors--sons and daughters who will be brought out of it. They will come to you, and when you see their conduct and their actions, you will be consoled regarding the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem--every disaster I have brought upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be consoled when you see their conduct and their actions, for you will know that I have done nothing in it without cause, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, how is the wood of a vine better than that of a branch on any of the trees in the forest?

column.name: text
column.value: Is wood ever taken from it to make anything useful? Do they make pegs from it to hang things on?

column.name: text
column.value: And after it is thrown on the fire as fuel and the fire burns both ends and chars the middle, is it then useful for anything?

column.name: text
column.value: If it was not useful for anything when it was whole, how much less can it be made into something useful when the fire has burned it and it is charred?

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest as fuel for the fire, so will I treat the people living in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set my face against them. Although they have come out of the fire, the fire will yet consume them. And when I set my face against them, you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make the land desolate because they have been unfaithful, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices

column.name: text
column.value: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: O city that brings on herself doom by shedding blood in her midst and defiles herself by making idols,

column.name: text
column.value: you have become guilty because of the blood you have shed and have become defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close, and the end of your years has come. Therefore I will make you an object of scorn to the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, O infamous city, full of turmoil.

column.name: text
column.value: "'See how each of the princes of Israel who are in you uses his power to shed blood.

column.name: text
column.value: In you they have treated father and mother with contempt; in you they have oppressed the alien and mistreated the fatherless and the widow.

column.name: text
column.value: You have despised my holy things and desecrated my Sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: In you are slanderous men bent on shedding blood; in you are those who eat at the mountain shrines and commit lewd acts.

column.name: text
column.value: In you are those who dishonor their fathers' bed; in you are those who violate women during their period, when they are ceremonially unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: In you one man commits a detestable offense with his neighbor's wife, another shamefully defiles his daughter-in-law, and another violates his sister, his own father's daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: In you men accept bribes to shed blood; you take usury and excessive interest and make unjust gain from your neighbors by extortion. And you have forgotten me, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I will surely strike my hands together at the unjust gain you have made and at the blood you have shed in your midst.

column.name: text
column.value: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.

column.name: text
column.value: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you through the countries; and I will put an end to your uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have been defiled in the eyes of the nations, you will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me; all of them are the copper, tin, iron and lead left inside a furnace. They are but the dross of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because you have all become dross, I will gather you into Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: As men gather silver, copper, iron, lead and tin into a furnace to melt it with a fiery blast, so will I gather you in my anger and my wrath and put you inside the city and melt you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will gather you and I will blow on you with my fiery wrath, and you will be melted inside her.

column.name: text
column.value: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside her, and you will know that I the LORD have poured out my wrath upon you.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, say to the land, 'You are a land that has had no rain or showers in the day of wrath.'

column.name: text
column.value: There is a conspiracy of her princes within her like a roaring lion tearing its prey; they devour people, take treasures and precious things and make many widows within her.

column.name: text
column.value: Her priests do violence to my law and profane my holy things; they do not distinguish between the holy and the common; they teach that there is no difference between the unclean and the clean; and they shut their eyes to the keeping of my Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey; they shed blood and kill people to make unjust gain.

column.name: text
column.value: Her prophets whitewash these deeds for them by false visions and lying divinations. They say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says'--when the LORD has not spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery; they oppress the poor and needy and mistreat the alien, denying them justice.

column.name: text
column.value: "I looked for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the gap on behalf of the land so I would not have to destroy it, but I found none.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will pour out my wrath on them and consume them with my fiery anger, bringing down on their own heads all they have done, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: "Take up a lament concerning the princes of Israel

column.name: text
column.value: and say: "'What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among the young lions and reared her cubs.

column.name: text
column.value: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he devoured men.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations heard about him, and he was trapped in their pit. They led him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When she saw her hope unfulfilled, her expectation gone, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.

column.name: text
column.value: He prowled among the lions, for he was now a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he devoured men.

column.name: text
column.value: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and all who were in it were terrified by his roaring.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the nations came against him, those from regions round about. They spread their net for him, and he was trapped in their pit.

column.name: text
column.value: With hooks they pulled him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of abundant water.

column.name: text
column.value: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler's scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.

column.name: text
column.value: But it was uprooted in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind made it shrivel, it was stripped of its fruit; its strong branches withered and fire consumed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.

column.name: text
column.value: Fire spread from one of its main branches and consumed its fruit. No strong branch is left on it fit for a ruler's scepter.' This is a lament and is to be used as a lament."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set forth an allegory and tell the house of Israel a parable.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon. Taking hold of the top of a cedar,

column.name: text
column.value: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.

column.name: text
column.value: "'He took some of the seed of your land and put it in fertile soil. He planted it like a willow by abundant water,

column.name: text
column.value: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. The vine now sent out its roots toward him from the plot where it was planted and stretched out its branches to him for water.

column.name: text
column.value: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will it thrive? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it withers? All its new growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots.

column.name: text
column.value: Even if it is transplanted, will it thrive? Will it not wither completely when the east wind strikes it--wither away in the plot where it grew?'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Say to this rebellious house, 'Do you not know what these things mean?' Say to them: 'The king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and carried off her king and her nobles, bringing them back with him to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took a member of the royal family and made a treaty with him, putting him under oath. He also carried away the leading men of the land,

column.name: text
column.value: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to rise again, surviving only by keeping his treaty.

column.name: text
column.value: But the king rebelled against him by sending his envoys to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the treaty and yet escape?

column.name: text
column.value: "'As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, he shall die in Babylon, in the land of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose treaty he broke.

column.name: text
column.value: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great horde will be of no help to him in war, when ramps are built and siege works erected to destroy many lives.

column.name: text
column.value: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his hand in pledge and yet did all these things, he shall not escape.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As surely as I live, I will bring down on his head my oath that he despised and my covenant that he broke.

column.name: text
column.value: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment upon him there because he was unfaithful to me.

column.name: text
column.value: All his fleeing troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I the LORD have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it; it will produce branches and bear fruit and become a splendid cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it; they will find shelter in the shade of its branches.

column.name: text
column.value: All the trees of the field will know that I the LORD bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. "'I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: "'The fathers eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?

column.name: text
column.value: "As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For every living soul belongs to me, the father as well as the son--both alike belong to me. The soul who sins is the one who will die.

column.name: text
column.value: "Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor's wife or lie with a woman during her period.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not oppress anyone, but returns what he took in pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not lend at usury or take excessive interest. He withholds his hand from doing wrong and judges fairly between man and man.

column.name: text
column.value: He follows my decrees and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Suppose he has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these other things

column.name: text
column.value: (though the father has done none of them): "He eats at the mountain shrines. He defiles his neighbor's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: He oppresses the poor and needy. He commits robbery. He does not return what he took in pledge. He looks to the idols. He does detestable things.

column.name: text
column.value: He lends at usury and takes excessive interest. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he will surely be put to death and his blood will be on his own head.

column.name: text
column.value: "But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father commits, and though he sees them, he does not do such things:

column.name: text
column.value: "He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not oppress anyone or require a pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

column.name: text
column.value: He withholds his hand from sin and takes no usury or excessive interest. He keeps my laws and follows my decrees. He will not die for his father's sin; he will surely live.

column.name: text
column.value: But his father will die for his own sin, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother and did what was wrong among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: "Yet you ask, 'Why does the son not share the guilt of his father?' Since the son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all my decrees, he will surely live.

column.name: text
column.value: The soul who sins is the one who will die. The son will not share the guilt of the father, nor will the father share the guilt of the son. The righteousness of the righteous man will be credited to him, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against him.

column.name: text
