column.value: "But if a wicked man turns away from all the sins he has committed and keeps all my decrees and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.

column.name: text
column.value: None of the offenses he has committed will be remembered against him. Because of the righteous things he has done, he will live.

column.name: text
column.value: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign LORD. Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?

column.name: text
column.value: "But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits sin and does the same detestable things the wicked man does, will he live? None of the righteous things he has done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness he is guilty of and because of the sins he has committed, he will die.

column.name: text
column.value: "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' Hear, O house of Israel: Is my way unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

column.name: text
column.value: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits sin, he will die for it; because of the sin he has committed he will die.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a wicked man turns away from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he considers all the offenses he has committed and turns away from them, he will surely live; he will not die.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' Are my ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each one according to his ways, declares the Sovereign LORD. Repent! Turn away from all your offenses; then sin will not be your downfall.

column.name: text
column.value: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, O house of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign LORD. Repent and live!

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuary. Prophesy against the land of Israel

column.name: text
column.value: and say to her: 'This is what the LORD says: I am against you. I will draw my sword from its scabbard and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Because I am going to cut off the righteous and the wicked, my sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all people will know that I the LORD have drawn my sword from its scabbard; it will not return again.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore groan, son of man! Groan before them with broken heart and bitter grief.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they ask you, 'Why are you groaning?' you shall say, 'Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt and every hand go limp; every spirit will become faint and every knee become as weak as water.' It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord says: "'A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished--

column.name: text
column.value: sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! "'Shall we rejoice in the scepter of my son Judah? The sword despises every such stick.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The sword is appointed to be polished, to be grasped with the hand; it is sharpened and polished, made ready for the hand of the slayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. Therefore beat your breast.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Testing will surely come. And what if the scepter of Judah, which the sword despises, does not continue? declares the Sovereign LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: "So then, son of man, prophesy and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for slaughter--a sword for great slaughter, closing in on them from every side.

column.name: text
column.value: So that hearts may melt and the fallen be many, I have stationed the sword for slaughter at all their gates. Oh! It is made to flash like lightning, it is grasped for slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: O sword, slash to the right, then to the left, wherever your blade is turned.

column.name: text
column.value: I too will strike my hands together, and my wrath will subside. I the LORD have spoken."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same country. Make a signpost where the road branches off to the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites and another against Judah and fortified Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver.

column.name: text
column.value: Into his right hand will come the lot for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to give the command to slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp and to erect siege works.

column.name: text
column.value: It will seem like a false omen to those who have sworn allegiance to him, but he will remind them of their guilt and take them captive.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because you people have brought to mind your guilt by your open rebellion, revealing your sins in all that you do--because you have done this, you will be taken captive.

column.name: text
column.value: "'O profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax,

column.name: text
column.value: this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Take off the turban, remove the crown. It will not be as it was: The lowly will be exalted and the exalted will be brought low.

column.name: text
column.value: A ruin! A ruin! I will make it a ruin! It will not be restored until he comes to whom it rightfully belongs; to him I will give it.'

column.name: text
column.value: "And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says about the Ammonites and their insults: "'A sword, a sword, drawn for the slaughter, polished to consume and to flash like lightning!

column.name: text
column.value: Despite false visions concerning you and lying divinations about you, it will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are to be slain, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax.

column.name: text
column.value: Return the sword to its scabbard. In the place where you were created, in the land of your ancestry, I will judge you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will pour out my wrath upon you and breathe out my fiery anger against you; I will hand you over to brutal men, men skilled in destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be fuel for the fire, your blood will be shed in your land, you will be remembered no more; for I the LORD have spoken.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable practices

column.name: text
column.value: and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Jerusalem: Your ancestry and birth were in the land of the Canaanites; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day you were born your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water to make you clean, nor were you rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.

column.name: text
column.value: No one looked on you with pity or had compassion enough to do any of these things for you. Rather, you were thrown out into the open field, for on the day you were born you were despised.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Then I passed by and saw you kicking about in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, "Live!"

column.name: text
column.value: I made you grow like a plant of the field. You grew up and developed and became the most beautiful of jewels. Your breasts were formed and your hair grew, you who were naked and bare.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Later I passed by, and when I looked at you and saw that you were old enough for love, I spread the corner of my garment over you and covered your nakedness. I gave you my solemn oath and entered into a covenant with you, declares the Sovereign LORD, and you became mine.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I bathed you with water and washed the blood from you and put ointments on you.

column.name: text
column.value: I clothed you with an embroidered dress and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you in fine linen and covered you with costly garments.

column.name: text
column.value: I adorned you with jewelry: I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck,

column.name: text
column.value: and I put a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.

column.name: text
column.value: So you were adorned with gold and silver; your clothes were of fine linen and costly fabric and embroidered cloth. Your food was fine flour, honey and olive oil. You became very beautiful and rose to be a queen.

column.name: text
column.value: And your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, because the splendor I had given you made your beauty perfect, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.

column.name: text
column.value: You took some of your garments to make gaudy high places, where you carried on your prostitution. Such things should not happen, nor should they ever occur.

column.name: text
column.value: You also took the fine jewelry I gave you, the jewelry made of my gold and silver, and you made for yourself male idols and engaged in prostitution with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And you took your embroidered clothes to put on them, and you offered my oil and incense before them.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the food I provided for you--the fine flour, olive oil and honey I gave you to eat--you offered as fragrant incense before them. That is what happened, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'And you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to me and sacrificed them as food to the idols. Was your prostitution not enough?

column.name: text
column.value: You slaughtered my children and sacrificed them to the idols.

column.name: text
column.value: In all your detestable practices and your prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Woe! Woe to you, declares the Sovereign LORD. In addition to all your other wickedness,

column.name: text
column.value: you built a mound for yourself and made a lofty shrine in every public square.

column.name: text
column.value: At the head of every street you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty, offering your body with increasing promiscuity to anyone who passed by.

column.name: text
column.value: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your lustful neighbors, and provoked me to anger with your increasing promiscuity.

column.name: text
column.value: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.

column.name: text
column.value: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you increased your promiscuity to include Babylonia, a land of merchants, but even with this you were not satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: "'How weak-willed you are, declares the Sovereign LORD, when you do all these things, acting like a brazen prostitute!

column.name: text
column.value: When you built your mounds at the head of every street and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were unlike a prostitute, because you scorned payment.

column.name: text
column.value: "'You adulterous wife! You prefer strangers to your own husband!

column.name: text
column.value: Every prostitute receives a fee, but you give gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.

column.name: text
column.value: So in your prostitution you are the opposite of others; no one runs after you for your favors. You are the very opposite, for you give payment and none is given to you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers, and because of all your detestable idols, and because you gave them your children's blood,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore I am going to gather all your lovers, with whom you found pleasure, those you loved as well as those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and will strip you in front of them, and they will see all your nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and who shed blood; I will bring upon you the blood vengeance of my wrath and jealous anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will hand you over to your lovers, and they will tear down your mounds and destroy your lofty shrines. They will strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry and leave you naked and bare.

column.name: text
column.value: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and hack you to pieces with their swords.

column.name: text
column.value: They will burn down your houses and inflict punishment on you in the sight of many women. I will put a stop to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.

column.name: text
column.value: Then my wrath against you will subside and my jealous anger will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged me with all these things, I will surely bring down on your head what you have done, declares the Sovereign LORD. Did you not add lewdness to all your other detestable practices?

column.name: text
column.value: "'Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: "Like mother, like daughter."

column.name: text
column.value: You are a true daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are a true sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

column.name: text
column.value: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived to the north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you with her daughters, was Sodom.

column.name: text
column.value: You not only walked in their ways and copied their detestable practices, but in all your ways you soon became more depraved than they.

column.name: text
column.value: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Now this was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and unconcerned; they did not help the poor and needy.

column.name: text
column.value: They were haughty and did detestable things before me. Therefore I did away with them as you have seen.

column.name: text
column.value: Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have done more detestable things than they, and have made your sisters seem righteous by all these things you have done.

column.name: text
column.value: Bear your disgrace, for you have furnished some justification for your sisters. Because your sins were more vile than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So then, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: "'However, I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and of Samaria and her daughters, and your fortunes along with them,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you have done in giving them comfort.

column.name: text
column.value: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to what they were before; and you and your daughters will return to what you were before.

column.name: text
column.value: You would not even mention your sister Sodom in the day of your pride,

column.name: text
column.value: before your wickedness was uncovered. Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all her neighbors and the daughters of the Philistines--all those around you who despise you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your detestable practices, declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have despised my oath by breaking the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both those who are older than you and those who are younger. I will give them to you as daughters, but not on the basis of my covenant with you.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then, when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your humiliation, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the seventh year, in the fifth month on the tenth day, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down in front of me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Have you come to inquire of me? As surely as I live, I will not let you inquire of me, declares the Sovereign LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Will you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? Then confront them with the detestable practices of their fathers

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore with uplifted hand to the descendants of the house of Jacob and revealed myself to them in Egypt. With uplifted hand I said to them, "I am the LORD your God."

column.name: text
column.value: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, "Each of you, get rid of the vile images you have set your eyes on, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God."

column.name: text
column.value: "'But they rebelled against me and would not listen to me; they did not get rid of the vile images they had set their eyes on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations they lived among and in whose sight I had revealed myself to the Israelites by bringing them out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I led them out of Egypt and brought them into the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: I gave them my decrees and made known to them my laws, for the man who obeys them will live by them.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I gave them my Sabbaths as a sign between us, so they would know that I the LORD made them holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Yet the people of Israel rebelled against me in the desert. They did not follow my decrees but rejected my laws--although the man who obeys them will live by them--and they utterly desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and destroy them in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the desert that I would not bring them into the land I had given them--a land flowing with milk and honey, most beautiful of all lands--

column.name: text
column.value: because they rejected my laws and did not follow my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths. For their hearts were devoted to their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or put an end to them in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: I said to their children in the desert, "Do not follow the statutes of your fathers or keep their laws or defile yourselves with their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God; follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep my Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God."

column.name: text
column.value: "'But the children rebelled against me: They did not follow my decrees, they were not careful to keep my laws--although the man who obeys them will live by them--and they desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: But I withheld my hand, and for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the desert that I would disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries,

column.name: text
column.value: because they had not obeyed my laws but had rejected my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths, and their eyes lusted after their fathers' idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and laws they could not live by;

column.name: text
column.value: I let them become defiled through their gifts--the sacrifice of every firstborn--that I might fill them with horror so they would know that I am the LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, son of man, speak to the people of Israel and say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In this also your fathers blasphemed me by forsaking me:

column.name: text
column.value: When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, made offerings that provoked me to anger, presented their fragrant incense and poured out their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to them: What is this high place you go to?'" (It is called Bamah to this day.)

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore say to the house of Israel: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did and lust after their vile images?

column.name: text
column.value: When you offer your gifts--the sacrifice of your sons in the fire--you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. Am I to let you inquire of me, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will not let you inquire of me.

column.name: text
column.value: "'You say, "We want to be like the nations, like the peoples of the world, who serve wood and stone." But what you have in mind will never happen.

column.name: text
column.value: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will rule over you with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring you from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered--with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring you into the desert of the nations and there, face to face, I will execute judgment upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: As I judged your fathers in the desert of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will take note of you as you pass under my rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: I will purge you of those who revolt and rebel against me. Although I will bring them out of the land where they are living, yet they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'As for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you! But afterward you will surely listen to me and no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and idols.

column.name: text
column.value: For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD, there in the land the entire house of Israel will serve me, and there I will accept them. There I will require your offerings and your choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: I will accept you as fragrant incense when I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will show myself holy among you in the sight of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I had sworn with uplifted hand to give to your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: There you will remember your conduct and all the actions by which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evil you have done.

column.name: text
column.value: You will know that I am the LORD, when I deal with you for my name's sake and not according to your evil ways and your corrupt practices, O house of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southland.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the southern forest: 'Hear the word of the LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to set fire to you, and it will consume all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone will see that I the LORD have kindled it; it will not be quenched.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, "Ah, Sovereign LORD! They are saying of me, 'Isn't he just telling parables?'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the ninth year, in the tenth month on the tenth day, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, record this date, this very date, because the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell this rebellious house a parable and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Put on the cooking pot; put it on and pour water into it.

column.name: text
column.value: Put into it the pieces of meat, all the choice pieces--the leg and the shoulder. Fill it with the best of these bones;

column.name: text
column.value: take the pick of the flock. Pile wood beneath it for the bones; bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now encrusted, whose deposit will not go away! Empty it piece by piece without casting lots for them.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For the blood she shed is in her midst: She poured it on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground, where the dust would cover it.

column.name: text
column.value: To stir up wrath and take revenge I put her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the wood high.

column.name: text
column.value: So heap on the wood and kindle the fire. Cook the meat well, mixing in the spices; and let the bones be charred.

column.name: text
column.value: Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows so its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away.

column.name: text
column.value: It has frustrated all efforts; its heavy deposit has not been removed, not even by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Now your impurity is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse you but you would not be cleansed from your impurity, you will not be clean again until my wrath against you has subsided.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I the LORD have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not hold back; I will not have pity, nor will I relent. You will be judged according to your conduct and your actions, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from you the delight of your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or shed any tears.

column.name: text
column.value: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Keep your turban fastened and your sandals on your feet; do not cover the lower part of your face or eat the customary food of mourners."

column.name: text
column.value: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people asked me, "Won't you tell us what these things have to do with us?"

column.name: text
column.value: So I said to them, "The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to desecrate my sanctuary--the stronghold in which you take pride, the delight of your eyes, the object of your affection. The sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will do as I have done. You will not cover the lower part of your face or eat the customary food of mourners.

column.name: text
column.value: You will keep your turbans on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep but will waste away because of your sins and groan among yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Ezekiel will be a sign to you; you will do just as he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: "And you, son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes, their heart's desire, and their sons and daughters as well--

column.name: text
column.value: on that day a fugitive will come to tell you the news.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time your mouth will be opened; you will speak with him and will no longer be silent. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.

column.name: text
column.value: They became prostitutes in Egypt, engaging in prostitution from their youth. In that land their breasts were fondled and their virgin bosoms caressed.

column.name: text
column.value: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. They were mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: "Oholah engaged in prostitution while she was still mine; and she lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians--warriors

column.name: text
column.value: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, and mounted horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: She gave herself as a prostitute to all the elite of the Assyrians and defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.

column.name: text
column.value: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when during her youth men slept with her, caressed her virgin bosom and poured out their lust upon her.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore I handed her over to her lovers, the Assyrians, for whom she lusted.

column.name: text
column.value: They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, and punishment was inflicted on her.

column.name: text
column.value: "Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.

column.name: text
column.value: She too lusted after the Assyrians--governors and commanders, warriors in full dress, mounted horsemen, all handsome young men.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw that she too defiled herself; both of them went the same way.

column.name: text
column.value: "But she carried her prostitution still further. She saw men portrayed on a wall, figures of Chaldeans portrayed in red,

column.name: text
column.value: with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like Babylonian chariot officers, natives of Chaldea.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. After she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.

column.name: text
column.value: When she carried on her prostitution openly and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet she became more and more promiscuous as she recalled the days of her youth, when she was a prostitute in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: There she lusted after her lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses.

column.name: text
column.value: So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when in Egypt your bosom was caressed and your young breasts fondled.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will stir up your lovers against you, those you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side--

column.name: text
column.value: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, handsome young men, all of them governors and commanders, chariot officers and men of high rank, all mounted on horses.

column.name: text
column.value: They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons and with a throng of people; they will take up positions against you on every side with large and small shields and with helmets. I will turn you over to them for punishment, and they will punish you according to their standards.

column.name: text
column.value: I will direct my jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take away your sons and daughters, and those of you who are left will be consumed by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: They will also strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will put a stop to the lewdness and prostitution you began in Egypt. You will not look on these things with longing or remember Egypt anymore.

column.name: text
column.value: "For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to hand you over to those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.

column.name: text
column.value: They will deal with you in hatred and take away everything you have worked for. They will leave you naked and bare, and the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your lewdness and promiscuity

column.name: text
column.value: have brought this upon you, because you lusted after the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: You have gone the way of your sister; so I will put her cup into your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "You will drink your sister's cup, a cup large and deep; it will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, the cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: You will drink it and drain it dry; you will dash it to pieces and tear your breasts. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Since you have forgotten me and thrust me behind your back, you must bear the consequences of your lewdness and prostitution."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their detestable practices,

column.name: text
column.value: for they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols; they even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to me, as food for them.

column.name: text
column.value: They have also done this to me: At that same time they defiled my sanctuary and desecrated my Sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they entered my sanctuary and desecrated it. That is what they did in my house.

column.name: text
column.value: "They even sent messengers for men who came from far away, and when they arrived you bathed yourself for them, painted your eyes and put on your jewelry.

column.name: text
column.value: You sat on an elegant couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed the incense and oil that belonged to me.

column.name: text
column.value: "The noise of a carefree crowd was around her; Sabeans were brought from the desert along with men from the rabble, and they put bracelets on the arms of the woman and her sister and beautiful crowns on their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, 'Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is.'

column.name: text
column.value: And they slept with her. As men sleep with a prostitute, so they slept with those lewd women, Oholah and Oholibah.

column.name: text
column.value: But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment of women who commit adultery and shed blood, because they are adulterous and blood is on their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Bring a mob against them and give them over to terror and plunder.

column.name: text
column.value: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.

column.name: text
column.value: "So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not imitate you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will suffer the penalty for your lewdness and bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gate to the nations is broken, and its doors have swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will prosper,'

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, O Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, like the sea casting up its waves.

column.name: text
column.value: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers; I will scrape away her rubble and make her a bare rock.

column.name: text
column.value: Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishnets, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD. She will become plunder for the nations,

column.name: text
column.value: and her settlements on the mainland will be ravaged by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army.

column.name: text
column.value: He will ravage your settlements on the mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp up to your walls and raise his shields against you.

column.name: text
column.value: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and demolish your towers with his weapons.

column.name: text
column.value: His horses will be so many that they will cover you with dust. Your walls will tremble at the noise of the war horses, wagons and chariots when he enters your gates as men enter a city whose walls have been broken through.

column.name: text
column.value: The hoofs of his horses will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: They will plunder your wealth and loot your merchandise; they will break down your walls and demolish your fine houses and throw your stones, timber and rubble into the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: I will put an end to your noisy songs, and the music of your harps will be heard no more.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread fishnets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the LORD have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in you?

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will take up a lament concerning you and say to you: "'How you are destroyed, O city of renown, peopled by men of the sea! You were a power on the seas, you and your citizens; you put your terror on all who lived there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall; the islands in the sea are terrified at your collapse.'

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the ocean depths over you and its vast waters cover you,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you dwell in the earth below, as in ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, and you will not return or take your place in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring you to a horrible end and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never again be found, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Tyre.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to Tyre, situated at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coasts, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'You say, O Tyre, "I am perfect in beauty."

column.name: text
column.value: Your domain was on the high seas; your builders brought your beauty to perfection.

column.name: text
column.value: They made all your timbers of pine trees from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, inlaid with ivory.

column.name: text
column.value: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail and served as your banner; your awnings were of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah.

column.name: text
column.value: Men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; your skilled men, O Tyre, were aboard as your seamen.

column.name: text
column.value: Veteran craftsmen of Gebal were on board as shipwrights to caulk your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to trade for your wares.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Men of Persia, Lydia and Put served as soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls, bringing you splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: Men of Arvad and Helech manned your walls on every side; men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they brought your beauty to perfection.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Tarshish did business with you because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin and lead for your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Greece, Tubal and Meshech traded with you; they exchanged slaves and articles of bronze for your wares.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Men of Beth Togarmah exchanged work horses, war horses and mules for your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The men of Rhodes traded with you, and many coastlands were your customers; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Aram did business with you because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Judah and Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith and confections, honey, oil and balm for your wares.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Damascus, because of your many products and great wealth of goods, did business with you in wine from Helbon and wool from Zahar.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Danites and Greeks from Uzal bought your merchandise; they exchanged wrought iron, cassia and calamus for your wares.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Dedan traded in saddle blankets with you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers; they did business with you in lambs, rams and goats.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your merchandise they exchanged the finest of all kinds of spices and precious stones, and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Haran, Canneh and Eden and merchants of Sheba, Asshur and Kilmad traded with you.

column.name: text
column.value: In your marketplace they traded with you beautiful garments, blue fabric, embroidered work and multicolored rugs with cords twisted and tightly knotted.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The ships of Tarshish serve as carriers for your wares. You are filled with heavy cargo in the heart of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Your oarsmen take you out to the high seas. But the east wind will break you to pieces in the heart of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Your wealth, merchandise and wares, your mariners, seamen and shipwrights, your merchants and all your soldiers, and everyone else on board will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your shipwreck.

column.name: text
column.value: The shorelands will quake when your seamen cry out.

column.name: text
column.value: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships; the mariners and all the seamen will stand on the shore.

column.name: text
column.value: They will raise their voice and cry bitterly over you; they will sprinkle dust on their heads and roll in ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: They will shave their heads because of you and will put on sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and with bitter mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament concerning you: "Who was ever silenced like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?"

column.name: text
column.value: When your merchandise went out on the seas, you satisfied many nations; with your great wealth and your wares you enriched the kings of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now you are shattered by the sea in the depths of the waters; your wares and all your company have gone down with you.

column.name: text
column.value: All who live in the coastlands are appalled at you; their kings shudder with horror and their faces are distorted with fear.

column.name: text
column.value: The merchants among the nations hiss at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, 'Hear the word of the Sovereign LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you said "Aha!" over my sanctuary when it was desecrated and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste and over the people of Judah when they went into exile,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore I am going to give you to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and Ammon into a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore I will stretch out my hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the nations and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because Moab and Seir said, "Look, the house of Judah has become like all the other nations,"

column.name: text
column.value: therefore I will expose the flank of Moab, beginning at its frontier towns--Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim--the glory of that land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give Moab along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations;

column.name: text
column.value: and I will inflict punishment on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because Edom took revenge on the house of Judah and became very guilty by doing so,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and kill its men and their animals. I will lay it waste, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: I will take vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom in accordance with my anger and my wrath; they will know my vengeance, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and took revenge with malice in their hearts, and with ancient hostility sought to destroy Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Kerethites and destroy those remaining along the coast.

column.name: text
column.value: I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I take vengeance on them.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'In the pride of your heart you say, "I am a god; I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas." But you are a man and not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god.

column.name: text
column.value: Are you wiser than Daniel? Is no secret hidden from you?

column.name: text
column.value: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained wealth for yourself and amassed gold and silver in your treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and because of your wealth your heart has grown proud.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Because you think you are wise, as wise as a god,

column.name: text
column.value: I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations; they will draw their swords against your beauty and wisdom and pierce your shining splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: Will you then say, "I am a god," in the presence of those who kill you? You will be but a man, not a god, in the hands of those who slay you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'You were the model of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz and emerald, chrysolite, onyx and jasper, sapphire, turquoise and beryl. Your settings and mountings were made of gold; on the day you were created they were prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for so I ordained you. You were on the holy mount of God; you walked among the fiery stones.

column.name: text
column.value: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created till wickedness was found in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Through your widespread trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mount of God, and I expelled you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.

column.name: text
column.value: Your heart became proud on account of your beauty, and you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the earth; I made a spectacle of you before kings.

column.name: text
column.value: By your many sins and dishonest trade you have desecrated your sanctuaries. So I made a fire come out from you, and it consumed you, and I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations who knew you are appalled at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face against Sidon; prophesy against her

column.name: text
column.value: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I am against you, O Sidon, and I will gain glory within you. They will know that I am the LORD, when I inflict punishment on her and show myself holy within her.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send a plague upon her and make blood flow in her streets. The slain will fall within her, with the sword against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will show myself holy among them in the sight of the nations. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards; they will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who maligned them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, prophesy and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Wail and say, "Alas for that day!"

column.name: text
column.value: For the day is near, the day of the LORD is near--a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will come upon Cush. When the slain fall in Egypt, her wealth will be carried away and her foundations torn down.

column.name: text
column.value: Cush and Put, Lydia and all Arabia, Libya and the people of the covenant land will fall by the sword along with Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the LORD says: "'The allies of Egypt will fall and her proud strength will fail. From Migdol to Aswan they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to frighten Cush out of her complacency. Anguish will take hold of them on the day of Egypt's doom, for it is sure to come.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: He and his army--the most ruthless of nations--will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.

column.name: text
column.value: I will dry up the streams of the Nile and sell the land to evil men; by the hand of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I the LORD have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. No longer will there be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lay waste Upper Egypt, set fire to Zoan and inflict punishment on Thebes.

column.name: text
column.value: I will pour out my wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the hordes of Thebes.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium will writhe in agony. Thebes will be taken by storm; Memphis will be in constant distress.

column.name: text
column.value: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: Dark will be the day at Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt; there her proud strength will come to an end. She will be covered with clouds, and her villages will go into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will inflict punishment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the eleventh year, in the first month on the seventh day, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bound up for healing or put in a splint so as to become strong enough to hold a sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the good arm as well as the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.

column.name: text
column.value: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he brandishes it against Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: In the eleventh year, in the third month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: "'Who can be compared with you in majesty?

column.name: text
column.value: Consider Assyria, once a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches overshadowing the forest; it towered on high, its top above the thick foliage.

column.name: text
column.value: The waters nourished it, deep springs made it grow tall; their streams flowed all around its base and sent their channels to all the trees of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: So it towered higher than all the trees of the field; its boughs increased and its branches grew long, spreading because of abundant waters.

column.name: text
column.value: All the birds of the air nested in its boughs, all the beasts of the field gave birth under its branches; all the great nations lived in its shade.

column.name: text
column.value: It was majestic in beauty, with its spreading boughs, for its roots went down to abundant waters.

column.name: text
column.value: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it, nor could the pine trees equal its boughs, nor could the plane trees compare with its branches--no tree in the garden of God could match its beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: I made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden in the garden of God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because it towered on high, lifting its top above the thick foliage, and because it was proud of its height,

column.name: text
column.value: I handed it over to the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with according to its wickedness. I cast it aside,

column.name: text
column.value: and the most ruthless of foreign nations cut it down and left it. Its boughs fell on the mountains and in all the valleys; its branches lay broken in all the ravines of the land. All the nations of the earth came out from under its shade and left it.

column.name: text
column.value: All the birds of the air settled on the fallen tree, and all the beasts of the field were among its branches.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore no other trees by the waters are ever to tower proudly on high, lifting their tops above the thick foliage. No other trees so well-watered are ever to reach such a height; they are all destined for death, for the earth below, among mortal men, with those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day it was brought down to the grave I covered the deep springs with mourning for it; I held back its streams, and its abundant waters were restrained. Because of it I clothed Lebanon with gloom, and all the trees of the field withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: I made the nations tremble at the sound of its fall when I brought it down to the grave with those who go down to the pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the trees that were well-watered, were consoled in the earth below.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who lived in its shade, its allies among the nations, had also gone down to the grave with it, joining those killed by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Which of the trees of Eden can be compared with you in splendor and majesty? Yet you, too, will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; you will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. "'This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: "'You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas thrashing about in your streams, churning the water with your feet and muddying the streams.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'With a great throng of people I will cast my net over you, and they will haul you up in my net.

column.name: text
column.value: I will throw you on the land and hurl you on the open field. I will let all the birds of the air settle on you and all the beasts of the earth gorge themselves on you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will spread your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.

column.name: text
column.value: I will drench the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: When I snuff you out, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.

column.name: text
column.value: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you; I will bring darkness over your land, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction among the nations, among lands you have not known.

column.name: text
column.value: I will cause many peoples to be appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I brandish my sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty men--the most ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be overthrown.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters no longer to be stirred by the foot of man or muddied by the hoofs of cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will let her waters settle and make her streams flow like oil, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When I make Egypt desolate and strip the land of everything in it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the lament they will chant for her. The daughters of the nations will chant it; for Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, with those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, 'Are you more favored than others? Go down and be laid among the uncircumcised.'

column.name: text
column.value: They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn; let her be dragged off with all her hordes.

column.name: text
column.value: From within the grave the mighty leaders will say of Egypt and her allies, 'They have come down and they lie with the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Assyria is there with her whole army; she is surrounded by the graves of all her slain, all who have fallen by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All who had spread terror in the land of the living are slain, fallen by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: "Elam is there, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword. All who had spread terror in the land of the living went down uncircumcised to the earth below. They bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: A bed is made for her among the slain, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Because their terror had spread in the land of the living, they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit; they are laid among the slain.

column.name: text
column.value: "Meshech and Tubal are there, with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: Do they not lie with the other uncircumcised warriors who have fallen, who went down to the grave with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads? The punishment for their sins rested on their bones, though the terror of these warriors had stalked through the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: "You too, O Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: "Edom is there, her kings and all her princes; despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: "All the princes of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down with the slain in disgrace despite the terror caused by their power. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: "Pharaoh--he and all his army--will see them and he will be consoled for all his hordes that were killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Although I had him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, speak to your countrymen and say to them: 'When I bring the sword against a land, and the people of the land choose one of their men and make him their watchman,

column.name: text
column.value: and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows the trumpet to warn the people,

column.name: text
column.value: then if anyone hears the trumpet but does not take warning and the sword comes and takes his life, his blood will be on his own head.

column.name: text
column.value: Since he heard the sound of the trumpet but did not take warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had taken warning, he would have saved himself.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people and the sword comes and takes the life of one of them, that man will be taken away because of his sin, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I say to the wicked, 'O wicked man, you will surely die,' and you do not speak out to dissuade him from his ways, that wicked man will die for his sin, and I will hold you accountable for his blood.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do warn the wicked man to turn from his ways and he does not do so, he will die for his sin, but you will have saved yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, say to the house of Israel, 'This is what you are saying: "Our offenses and sins weigh us down, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?" '

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, 'As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! Why will you die, O house of Israel?'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, son of man, say to your countrymen, 'The righteousness of the righteous man will not save him when he disobeys, and the wickedness of the wicked man will not cause him to fall when he turns from it. The righteous man, if he sins, will not be allowed to live because of his former righteousness.'

column.name: text
column.value: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but then he trusts in his righteousness and does evil, none of the righteous things he has done will be remembered; he will die for the evil he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: And if I say to the wicked man, 'You will surely die,' but he then turns away from his sin and does what is just and right--

column.name: text
column.value: if he gives back what he took in pledge for a loan, returns what he has stolen, follows the decrees that give life, and does no evil, he will surely live; he will not die.

column.name: text
column.value: None of the sins he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.

column.name: text
column.value: "Yet your countrymen say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' But it is their way that is not just.

column.name: text
column.value: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does evil, he will die for it.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a wicked man turns away from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live by doing so.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet, O house of Israel, you say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' But I will judge each of you according to his own ways."

column.name: text
column.value: In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month on the fifth day, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has fallen!"

column.name: text
column.value: Now the evening before the man arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and he opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer silent.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, the people living in those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, 'Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as our possession.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Since you eat meat with the blood still in it and look to your idols and shed blood, should you then possess the land?

column.name: text
column.value: You rely on your sword, you do detestable things, and each of you defiles his neighbor's wife. Should you then possess the land?'

column.name: text
column.value: "Say this to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: As surely as I live, those who are left in the ruins will fall by the sword, those out in the country I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those in strongholds and caves will die of a plague.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end, and the mountains of Israel will become desolate so that no one will cross them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the detestable things they have done.'

column.name: text
column.value: "As for you, son of man, your countrymen are talking together about you by the walls and at the doors of the houses, saying to each other, 'Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: My people come to you, as they usually do, and sit before you to listen to your words, but they do not put them into practice. With their mouths they express devotion, but their hearts are greedy for unjust gain.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, to them you are nothing more than one who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays an instrument well, for they hear your words but do not put them into practice.

column.name: text
column.value: "When all this comes true--and it surely will--then they will know that a prophet has been among them."

column.name: text
column.value: In the tenth year, in the tenth month on the twelfth day, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to him and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your streams. You say, "The Nile is mine; I made it for myself."

column.name: text
column.value: But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your streams, with all the fish sticking to your scales.

column.name: text
column.value: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered or picked up. I will give you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the air.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. "'You have been a staff of reed for the house of Israel.

column.name: text
