column.value: When they grasped you with their hands, you splintered and you tore open their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke and their backs were wrenched.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will bring a sword against you and kill your men and their animals.

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD. "'Because you said, "The Nile is mine; I made it,"

column.name: text
column.value: therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.

column.name: text
column.value: No foot of man or animal will pass through it; no one will live there for forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make the land of Egypt desolate among devastated lands, and her cities will lie desolate forty years among ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Yet this is what the Sovereign LORD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestry. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel but will be a reminder of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre; every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from the campaign he led against Tyre.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder the land as pay for his army.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given him Egypt as a reward for his efforts because he and his army did it for me, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "On that day I will make a horn grow for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who only take care of themselves! Should not shepherds take care of the flock?

column.name: text
column.value: You eat the curds, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the choice animals, but you do not take care of the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally.

column.name: text
column.value: So they were scattered because there was no shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild animals.

column.name: text
column.value: My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. They were scattered over the whole earth, and no one searched or looked for them.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, because my flock lacks a shepherd and so has been plundered and has become food for all the wild animals, and because my shepherds did not search for my flock but cared for themselves rather than for my flock,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, O shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against the shepherds and will hold them accountable for my flock. I will remove them from tending the flock so that the shepherds can no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.

column.name: text
column.value: As a shepherd looks after his scattered flock when he is with them, so will I look after my sheep. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will pasture them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the settlements in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will tend them in a good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in a rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: I myself will tend my sheep and have them lie down, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will search for the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak, but the sleek and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice.

column.name: text
column.value: "'As for you, my flock, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will judge between one sheep and another, and between rams and goats.

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink clear water? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?

column.name: text
column.value: Must my flock feed on what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied with your feet?

column.name: text
column.value: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says to them: See, I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak sheep with your horns until you have driven them away,

column.name: text
column.value: I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plundered. I will judge between one sheep and another.

column.name: text
column.value: I will place over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will tend them; he will tend them and be their shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David will be prince among them. I the LORD have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of wild beasts so that they may live in the desert and sleep in the forests in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bless them and the places surrounding my hill. I will send down showers in season; there will be showers of blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: The trees of the field will yield their fruit and the ground will yield its crops; the people will be secure in their land. They will know that I am the LORD, when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hands of those who enslaved them.

column.name: text
column.value: They will no longer be plundered by the nations, nor will wild animals devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will make them afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: I will provide for them a land renowned for its crops, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are people, and I am your God, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir; prophesy against it

column.name: text
column.value: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn your towns into ruins and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Because you harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and cut off from it all who come and go.

column.name: text
column.value: I will fill your mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make you desolate forever; your towns will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Because you have said, "These two nations and countries will be ours and we will take possession of them," even though I the LORD was there,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will treat you in accordance with the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred of them and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I the LORD have heard all the contemptible things you have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, "They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour."

column.name: text
column.value: You boasted against me and spoke against me without restraint, and I heard it.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel became desolate, that is how I will treat you. You will be desolate, O Mount Seir, you and all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, 'O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The enemy said of you, "Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession." '

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because they ravaged and hounded you from every side so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations and the object of people's malicious talk and slander,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign LORD: This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been plundered and ridiculed by the rest of the nations around you--

column.name: text
column.value: this is what the Sovereign LORD says: In my burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, for with glee and with malice in their hearts they made my land their own possession so that they might plunder its pastureland.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I speak in my jealous wrath because you have suffered the scorn of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I swear with uplifted hand that the nations around you will also suffer scorn.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But you, O mountains of Israel, will produce branches and fruit for my people Israel, for they will soon come home.

column.name: text
column.value: I am concerned for you and will look on you with favor; you will be plowed and sown,

column.name: text
column.value: and I will multiply the number of people upon you, even the whole house of Israel. The towns will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.

column.name: text
column.value: I will increase the number of men and animals upon you, and they will be fruitful and become numerous. I will settle people on you as in the past and will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will cause people, my people Israel, to walk upon you. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance; you will never again deprive them of their children.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because people say to you, "You devour men and deprive your nation of its children,"

column.name: text
column.value: therefore you will no longer devour men or make your nation childless, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: No longer will I make you hear the taunts of the nations, and no longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause your nation to fall, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by their conduct and their actions. Their conduct was like a woman's monthly uncleanness in my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: So I poured out my wrath on them because they had shed blood in the land and because they had defiled it with their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered through the countries; I judged them according to their conduct and their actions.

column.name: text
column.value: And wherever they went among the nations they profaned my holy name, for it was said of them, 'These are the LORD'S people, and yet they had to leave his land.'

column.name: text
column.value: I had concern for my holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations where they had gone.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: It is not for your sake, O house of Israel, that I am going to do these things, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you have gone.

column.name: text
column.value: I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Sovereign LORD, when I show myself holy through you before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For I will take you out of the nations; I will gather you from all the countries and bring you back into your own land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your impurities and from all your idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

column.name: text
column.value: You will live in the land I gave your forefathers; you will be my people, and I will be your God.

column.name: text
column.value: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will increase the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field, so that you will no longer suffer disgrace among the nations because of famine.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your sins and detestable practices.

column.name: text
column.value: I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Sovereign LORD. Be ashamed and disgraced for your conduct, O house of Israel!

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will resettle your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

column.name: text
column.value: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through it.

column.name: text
column.value: They will say, "This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Eden; the cities that were lying in ruins, desolate and destroyed, are now fortified and inhabited."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the LORD have rebuilt what was destroyed and have replanted what was desolate. I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.'

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Once again I will yield to the plea of the house of Israel and do this for them: I will make their people as numerous as sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: as numerous as the flocks for offerings at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts. So will the ruined cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of the LORD and set me in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.

column.name: text
column.value: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, bones that were very dry.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I said, "O Sovereign LORD, you alone know."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to these bones and say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life.

column.name: text
column.value: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh come upon you and cover you with skin; I will put breath in you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and tendons and flesh appeared on them and skin covered them, but there was no breath in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to it, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe into these slain, that they may live.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and breath entered them; they came to life and stood up on their feet--a vast army.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me: "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. They say, 'Our bones are dried up and our hope is gone; we are cut off.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: O my people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up from them; I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you, my people, will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I the LORD have spoken, and I have done it, declares the LORD.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, take a stick of wood and write on it, 'Belonging to Judah and the Israelites associated with him.' Then take another stick of wood, and write on it, 'Ephraim's stick, belonging to Joseph and all the house of Israel associated with him.'

column.name: text
column.value: Join them together into one stick so that they will become one in your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: "When your countrymen ask you, 'Won't you tell us what you mean by this?'

column.name: text
column.value: say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph--which is in Ephraim's hand--and of the Israelite tribes associated with him, and join it to Judah's stick, making them a single stick of wood, and they will become one in my hand.'

column.name: text
column.value: Hold before their eyes the sticks you have written on

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will take the Israelites out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them back into their own land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. There will be one king over all of them and they will never again be two nations or be divided into two kingdoms.

column.name: text
column.value: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and vile images or with any of their offenses, for I will save them from all their sinful backsliding, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: "'My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my laws and be careful to keep my decrees.

column.name: text
column.value: They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where your fathers lived. They and their children and their children's children will live there forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and increase their numbers, and I will put my sanctuary among them forever.

column.name: text
column.value: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the nations will know that I the LORD make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn you around and drag you along. I will bring you from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of carrion birds and to the wild animals.

column.name: text
column.value: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in safety in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I will make known my holy name among my people Israel. I will no longer let my holy name be profaned, and the nations will know that I the LORD am the Holy One in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign LORD. This is the day I have spoken of.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them up--the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut it from the forests, because they will use the weapons for fuel. And they will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, in the valley of those who travel east toward the Sea. It will block the way of travelers, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon Gog.

column.name: text
column.value: "'For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.

column.name: text
column.value: All the people of the land will bury them, and the day I am glorified will be a memorable day for them, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Men will be regularly employed to cleanse the land. Some will go throughout the land and, in addition to them, others will bury those that remain on the ground. At the end of the seven months they will begin their search.

column.name: text
column.value: As they go through the land and one of them sees a human bone, he will set up a marker beside it until the gravediggers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon Gog.

column.name: text
column.value: (Also a town called Hamonah will be there.) And so they will cleanse the land.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Call out to every kind of bird and all the wild animals: 'Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrifice I am preparing for you, the great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.

column.name: text
column.value: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as if they were rams and lambs, goats and bulls--all of them fattened animals from Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: At the sacrifice I am preparing for you, you will eat fat till you are glutted and drink blood till you are drunk.

column.name: text
column.value: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, mighty men and soldiers of every kind,' declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the punishment I inflict and the hand I lay upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the nations will know that the people of Israel went into exile for their sin, because they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their offenses, and I hid my face from them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will now bring Jacob back from captivity and will have compassion on all the people of Israel, and I will be zealous for my holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: They will forget their shame and all the unfaithfulness they showed toward me when they lived in safety in their land with no one to make them afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: When I have brought them back from the nations and have gathered them from the countries of their enemies, I will show myself holy through them in the sight of many nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, for though I sent them into exile among the nations, I will gather them to their own land, not leaving any behind.

column.name: text
column.value: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the house of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man brought me to the outer sanctuary and measured the jambs; the width of the jambs was six cubits on each side.

column.name: text
column.value: The entrance was ten cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were five cubits wide. He also measured the outer sanctuary; it was forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the jambs of the entrance; each was two cubits wide. The entrance was six cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were seven cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured the length of the inner sanctuary; it was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits across the end of the outer sanctuary. He said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the wall of the temple; it was six cubits thick, and each side room around the temple was four cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: The side rooms were on three levels, one above another, thirty on each level. There were ledges all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms, so that the supports were not inserted into the wall of the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: The side rooms all around the temple were wider at each successive level. The structure surrounding the temple was built in ascending stages, so that the rooms widened as one went upward. A stairway went up from the lowest floor to the top floor through the middle floor.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it, forming the foundation of the side rooms. It was the length of the rod, six long cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick. The open area between the side rooms of the temple

column.name: text
column.value: and the priests'rooms was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: There were entrances to the side rooms from the open area, one on the north and another on the south; and the base adjoining the open area was five cubits wide all around.

column.name: text
column.value: The building facing the temple courtyard on the west side was seventy cubits wide. The wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length was ninety cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the temple; it was a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.

column.name: text
column.value: The width of the temple courtyard on the east, including the front of the temple, was a hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the length of the building facing the courtyard at the rear of the temple, including its galleries on each side; it was a hundred cubits. The outer sanctuary, the inner sanctuary and the portico facing the court,

column.name: text
column.value: as well as the thresholds and the narrow windows and galleries around the three of them--everything beyond and including the threshold was covered with wood. The floor, the wall up to the windows, and the windows were covered.

column.name: text
column.value: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary and on the walls at regular intervals all around the inner and outer sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: were carved cherubim and palm trees. Palm trees alternated with cherubim. Each cherub had two faces:

column.name: text
column.value: the face of a man toward the palm tree on one side and the face of a lion toward the palm tree on the other. They were carved all around the whole temple.

column.name: text
column.value: From the floor to the area above the entrance, cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the outer sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: The outer sanctuary had a rectangular doorframe, and the one at the front of the Most Holy Place was similar.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a wooden altar three cubits high and two cubits square; its corners, its base and its sides were of wood. The man said to me, "This is the table that is before the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Both the outer sanctuary and the Most Holy Place had double doors.

column.name: text
column.value: Each door had two leaves--two hinged leaves for each door.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the doors of the outer sanctuary were carved cherubim and palm trees like those carved on the walls, and there was a wooden overhang on the front of the portico.

column.name: text
column.value: On the sidewalls of the portico were narrow windows with palm trees carved on each side. The side rooms of the temple also had overhangs.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man led me northward into the outer court and brought me to the rooms opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall on the north side.

column.name: text
column.value: The building whose door faced north was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Both in the section twenty cubits from the inner court and in the section opposite the pavement of the outer court, gallery faced gallery at the three levels.

column.name: text
column.value: In front of the rooms was an inner passageway ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long. Their doors were on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the upper rooms were narrower, for the galleries took more space from them than from the rooms on the lower and middle floors of the building.

column.name: text
column.value: The rooms on the third floor had no pillars, as the courts had; so they were smaller in floor space than those on the lower and middle floors.

column.name: text
column.value: There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms and the outer court; it extended in front of the rooms for fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: While the row of rooms on the side next to the outer court was fifty cubits long, the row on the side nearest the sanctuary was a hundred cubits long.

column.name: text
column.value: The lower rooms had an entrance on the east side as one enters them from the outer court.

column.name: text
column.value: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court, adjoining the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall, were rooms

column.name: text
column.value: with a passageway in front of them. These were like the rooms on the north; they had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions. Similar to the doorways on the north

column.name: text
column.value: were the doorways of the rooms on the south. There was a doorway at the beginning of the passageway that was parallel to the corresponding wall extending eastward, by which one enters the rooms.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, "The north and south rooms facing the temple courtyard are the priests' rooms, where the priests who approach the LORD will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings--the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings--for the place is holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Once the priests enter the holy precincts, they are not to go into the outer court until they leave behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they go near the places that are for the people."

column.name: text
column.value: When he had finished measuring what was inside the temple area, he led me out by the east gate and measured the area all around:

column.name: text
column.value: He measured the east side with the measuring rod; it was five hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured the north side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured the south side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he turned to the west side and measured; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

column.name: text
column.value: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man brought me to the gate facing east,

column.name: text
column.value: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of rushing waters, and the land was radiant with his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when he came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.

column.name: text
column.value: The glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: He said: "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet. This is where I will live among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile my holy name--neither they nor their kings--by their prostitution and the lifeless idols of their kings at their high places.

column.name: text
column.value: When they placed their threshold next to my threshold and their doorposts beside my doorposts, with only a wall between me and them, they defiled my holy name by their detestable practices. So I destroyed them in my anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Now let them put away from me their prostitution and the lifeless idols of their kings, and I will live among them forever.

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their sins. Let them consider the plan,

column.name: text
column.value: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the design of the temple--its arrangement, its exits and entrances--its whole design and all its regulations and laws. Write these down before them so that they may be faithful to its design and follow all its regulations.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the law of the temple: All the surrounding area on top of the mountain will be most holy. Such is the law of the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: "These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits, that cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: Its gutter is a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around the edge. And this is the height of the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge it is two cubits high and a cubit wide, and from the smaller ledge up to the larger ledge it is four cubits high and a cubit wide.

column.name: text
column.value: The altar hearth is four cubits high, and four horns project upward from the hearth.

column.name: text
column.value: The altar hearth is square, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: The upper ledge also is square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around. The steps of the altar face east."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: These will be the regulations for sacrificing burnt offerings and sprinkling blood upon the altar when it is built:

column.name: text
column.value: You are to give a young bull as a sin offering to the priests, who are Levites, of the family of Zadok, who come near to minister before me, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar and on the four corners of the upper ledge and all around the rim, and so purify the altar and make atonement for it.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the designated part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: "On the second day you are to offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering, and the altar is to be purified as it was purified with the bull.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have finished purifying it, you are to offer a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to offer them before the LORD, and the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days they are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; thus they will dedicate it.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Sovereign LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east, and it was shut.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "This gate is to remain shut. It must not be opened; no one may enter through it. It is to remain shut because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it.

column.name: text
column.value: The prince himself is the only one who may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the LORD. He is to enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling the temple of the LORD, and I fell facedown.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to me, "Son of man, look carefully, listen closely and give attention to everything I tell you concerning all the regulations regarding the temple of the LORD. Give attention to the entrance of the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the rebellious house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Enough of your detestable practices, O house of Israel!

column.name: text
column.value: In addition to all your other detestable practices, you brought foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh into my sanctuary, desecrating my temple while you offered me food, fat and blood, and you broke my covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of carrying out your duty in regard to my holy things, you put others in charge of my sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh is to enter my sanctuary, not even the foreigners who live among the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray and who wandered from me after their idols must bear the consequences of their sin.

column.name: text
column.value: They may serve in my sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and serving in it; they may slaughter the burnt offerings and sacrifices for the people and stand before the people and serve them.

column.name: text
column.value: But because they served them in the presence of their idols and made the house of Israel fall into sin, therefore I have sworn with uplifted hand that they must bear the consequences of their sin, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They are not to come near to serve me as priests or come near any of my holy things or my most holy offerings; they must bear the shame of their detestable practices.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will put them in charge of the duties of the temple and all the work that is to be done in it.

column.name: text
column.value: "'But the priests, who are Levites and descendants of Zadok and who faithfully carried out the duties of my sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from me, are to come near to minister before me; they are to stand before me to offer sacrifices of fat and blood, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They alone are to enter my sanctuary; they alone are to come near my table to minister before me and perform my service.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen clothes; they must not wear any woolen garment while ministering at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.

column.name: text
column.value: When they go out into the outer court where the people are, they are to take off the clothes they have been ministering in and are to leave them in the sacred rooms, and put on other clothes, so that they do not consecrate the people by means of their garments.

column.name: text
column.value: "'They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but they are to keep the hair of their heads trimmed.

column.name: text
column.value: No priest is to drink wine when he enters the inner court.

column.name: text
column.value: They must not marry widows or divorced women; they may marry only virgins of Israelite descent or widows of priests.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to teach my people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "'In any dispute, the priests are to serve as judges and decide it according to my ordinances. They are to keep my laws and my decrees for all my appointed feasts, and they are to keep my Sabbaths holy.

column.name: text
column.value: "'A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person; however, if the dead person was his father or mother, son or daughter, brother or unmarried sister, then he may defile himself.

column.name: text
column.value: After he is cleansed, he must wait seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day he goes into the inner court of the sanctuary to minister in the sanctuary, he is to offer a sin offering for himself, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "'I am to be the only inheritance the priests have. You are to give them no possession in Israel; I will be their possession.

column.name: text
column.value: They will eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings; and everything in Israel devoted to the LORD will belong to them.

column.name: text
column.value: The best of all the firstfruits and of all your special gifts will belong to the priests. You are to give them the first portion of your ground meal so that a blessing may rest on your household.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests must not eat anything, bird or animal, found dead or torn by wild animals.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Son of man, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal; prophesy against him

column.name: text
column.value: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws and bring you out with your whole army--your horses, your horsemen fully armed, and a great horde with large and small shields, all of them brandishing their swords.

column.name: text
column.value: Persia, Cush and Put will be with them, all with shields and helmets,

column.name: text
column.value: also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops--the many nations with you.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Get ready; be prepared, you and all the hordes gathered about you, and take command of them.

column.name: text
column.value: After many days you will be called to arms. In future years you will invade a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and now all of them live in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: You and all your troops and the many nations with you will go up, advancing like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil scheme.

column.name: text
column.value: You will say, "I will invade a land of unwalled villages; I will attack a peaceful and unsuspecting people--all of them living without walls and without gates and bars.

column.name: text
column.value: I will plunder and loot and turn my hand against the resettled ruins and the people gathered from the nations, rich in livestock and goods, living at the center of the land."

column.name: text
column.value: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all her villages will say to you, "Have you come to plunder? Have you gathered your hordes to loot, to carry off silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods and to seize much plunder?" '

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In that day, when my people Israel are living in safety, will you not take notice of it?

column.name: text
column.value: You will come from your place in the far north, you and many nations with you, all of them riding on horses, a great horde, a mighty army.

column.name: text
column.value: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In days to come, O Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I show myself holy through you before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Are you not the one I spoke of in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel? At that time they prophesied for years that I would bring you against them.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what will happen in that day: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, my hot anger will be aroused, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In my zeal and fiery wrath I declare that at that time there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the beasts of the field, every creature that moves along the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble at my presence. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble and every wall will fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Sovereign LORD. Every man's sword will be against his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: I will execute judgment upon him with plague and bloodshed; I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones and burning sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And so I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'

column.name: text
column.value: "'When you allot the land as an inheritance, you are to present to the LORD a portion of the land as a sacred district, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide; the entire area will be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Of this, a section 500 cubits square is to be for the sanctuary, with 50 cubits around it for open land.

column.name: text
column.value: In the sacred district, measure off a section 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. In it will be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be the sacred portion of the land for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and who draw near to minister before the LORD. It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy place for the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: An area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide will belong to the Levites, who serve in the temple, as their possession for towns to live in.

column.name: text
column.value: "'You are to give the city as its property an area 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, adjoining the sacred portion; it will belong to the whole house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "'The prince will have the land bordering each side of the area formed by the sacred district and the property of the city. It will extend westward from the west side and eastward from the east side, running lengthwise from the western to the eastern border parallel to one of the tribal portions.

column.name: text
column.value: This land will be his possession in Israel. And my princes will no longer oppress my people but will allow the house of Israel to possess the land according to their tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: You have gone far enough, O princes of Israel! Give up your violence and oppression and do what is just and right. Stop dispossessing my people, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to use accurate scales, an accurate ephah and an accurate bath.

column.name: text
column.value: The ephah and the bath are to be the same size, the bath containing a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer; the homer is to be the standard measure for both.

column.name: text
column.value: The shekel is to consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels equal one mina.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is the special gift you are to offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley.

column.name: text
column.value: The prescribed portion of oil, measured by the bath, is a tenth of a bath from each cor (which consists of ten baths or one homer, for ten baths are equivalent to a homer).

column.name: text
column.value: Also one sheep is to be taken from every flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These will be used for the grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the people, declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: All the people of the land will participate in this special gift for the use of the prince in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be the duty of the prince to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings and drink offerings at the festivals, the New Moons and the Sabbaths--at all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In the first month on the first day you are to take a young bull without defect and purify the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar and on the gateposts of the inner court.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance; so you are to make atonement for the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: "'In the first month on the fourteenth day you are to observe the Passover, a feast lasting seven days, during which you shall eat bread made without yeast.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the prince is to provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Every day during the seven days of the Feast he is to provide seven bulls and seven rams without defect as a burnt offering to the LORD, and a male goat for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: "'During the seven days of the Feast, which begins in the seventh month on the fifteenth day, he is to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings and oil.

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the fall of the city--on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me and he took me there.

column.name: text
column.value: In visions of God he took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose south side were some buildings that looked like a city.

column.name: text
column.value: He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze; he was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: The man said to me, "Son of man, look with your eyes and hear with your ears and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here. Tell the house of Israel everything you see."

column.name: text
column.value: I saw a wall completely surrounding the temple area. The length of the measuring rod in the man's hand was six long cubits, each of which was a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the wall; it was one measuring rod thick and one rod high.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went to the gate facing east. He climbed its steps and measured the threshold of the gate; it was one rod deep.

column.name: text
column.value: The alcoves for the guards were one rod long and one rod wide, and the projecting walls between the alcoves were five cubits thick. And the threshold of the gate next to the portico facing the temple was one rod deep.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the portico of the gateway;

column.name: text
column.value: it was eight cubits deep and its jambs were two cubits thick. The portico of the gateway faced the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Inside the east gate were three alcoves on each side; the three had the same measurements, and the faces of the projecting walls on each side had the same measurements.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the width of the entrance to the gateway; it was ten cubits and its length was thirteen cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: In front of each alcove was a wall one cubit high, and the alcoves were six cubits square.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the gateway from the top of the rear wall of one alcove to the top of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from one parapet opening to the opposite one.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured along the faces of the projecting walls all around the inside of the gateway--sixty cubits. The measurement was up to the portico facing the courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: The distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its portico was fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: The alcoves and the projecting walls inside the gateway were surmounted by narrow parapet openings all around, as was the portico; the openings all around faced inward. The faces of the projecting walls were decorated with palm trees.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me into the outer court. There I saw some rooms and a pavement that had been constructed all around the court; there were thirty rooms along the pavement.

column.name: text
column.value: It abutted the sides of the gateways and was as wide as they were long; this was the lower pavement.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the length and width of the gate facing north, leading into the outer court.

column.name: text
column.value: Its alcoves--three on each side--its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as those of the first gateway. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Its openings, its portico and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured from one gate to the opposite one; it was a hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he led me to the south side and I saw a gate facing south. He measured its jambs and its portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.

column.name: text
column.value: The gateway and its portico had narrow openings all around, like the openings of the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them; it had palm tree decorations on the faces of the projecting walls on each side.

column.name: text
column.value: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side; it was a hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.

column.name: text
column.value: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: (The porticoes of the gateways around the inner court were twenty-five cubits wide and five cubits deep.)

column.name: text
column.value: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.

column.name: text
column.value: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others,

column.name: text
column.value: as did its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico, and it had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.

column.name: text
column.value: A room with a doorway was by the portico in each of the inner gateways, where the burnt offerings were washed.

column.name: text
column.value: In the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered.

column.name: text
column.value: By the outside wall of the portico of the gateway, near the steps at the entrance to the north gateway were two tables, and on the other side of the steps were two tables.

column.name: text
column.value: So there were four tables on one side of the gateway and four on the other--eight tables in all--on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.

column.name: text
column.value: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offerings, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high. On them were placed the utensils for slaughtering the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: And double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were attached to the wall all around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two rooms, one at the side of the north gate and facing south, and another at the side of the south gate and facing north.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "The room facing south is for the priests who have charge of the temple,

column.name: text
column.value: and the room facing north is for the priests who have charge of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who are the only Levites who may draw near to the LORD to minister before him."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the court: It was square--a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the jambs of the portico; they were five cubits wide on either side. The width of the entrance was fourteen cubits and its projecting walls were three cubits wide on either side.

column.name: text
column.value: The portico was twenty cubits wide, and twelve cubits from front to back. It was reached by a flight of stairs, and there were pillars on each side of the jambs.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The gate of the inner court facing east is to be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon it is to be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: The prince is to enter from the outside through the portico of the gateway and stand by the gatepost. The priests are to sacrifice his burnt offering and his fellowship offerings. He is to worship at the threshold of the gateway and then go out, but the gate will not be shut until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: On the Sabbaths and New Moons the people of the land are to worship in the presence of the LORD at the entrance to that gateway.

column.name: text
column.value: The burnt offering the prince brings to the LORD on the Sabbath day is to be six male lambs and a ram, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: The grain offering given with the ram is to be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs is to be as much as he pleases, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day of the New Moon he is to offer a young bull, six lambs and a ram, all without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: He is to provide as a grain offering one ephah with the bull, one ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he wants to give, along with a hin of oil with each ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: When the prince enters, he is to go in through the portico of the gateway, and he is to come out the same way.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When the people of the land come before the LORD at the appointed feasts, whoever enters by the north gate to worship is to go out the south gate; and whoever enters by the south gate is to go out the north gate. No one is to return through the gate by which he entered, but each is to go out the opposite gate.

column.name: text
column.value: The prince is to be among them, going in when they go in and going out when they go out.

column.name: text
column.value: "'At the festivals and the appointed feasts, the grain offering is to be an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and with the lambs as much as one pleases, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: When the prince provides a freewill offering to the LORD--whether a burnt offering or fellowship offerings--the gate facing east is to be opened for him. He shall offer his burnt offering or his fellowship offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he has gone out, the gate will be shut.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Every day you are to provide a year-old lamb without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD; morning by morning you shall provide it.

column.name: text
column.value: You are also to provide with it morning by morning a grain offering, consisting of a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour. The presenting of this grain offering to the LORD is a lasting ordinance.

column.name: text
column.value: So the lamb and the grain offering and the oil shall be provided morning by morning for a regular burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: If the prince makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his sons, it will also belong to his descendants; it is to be their property by inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, he makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, the servant may keep it until the year of freedom; then it will revert to the prince. His inheritance belongs to his sons only; it is theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: The prince must not take any of the inheritance of the people, driving them off their property. He is to give his sons their inheritance out of his own property, so that none of my people will be separated from his property.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate to the sacred rooms facing north, which belonged to the priests, and showed me a place at the western end.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "This is the place where the priests will cook the guilt offering and the sin offering and bake the grain offering, to avoid bringing them into the outer court and consecrating the people."

column.name: text
column.value: He then brought me to the outer court and led me around to its four corners, and I saw in each corner another court.

column.name: text
column.value: In the four corners of the outer court were enclosed courts, forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide; each of the courts in the four corners was the same size.

column.name: text
column.value: Around the inside of each of the four courts was a ledge of stone, with places for fire built all around under the ledge.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple will cook the sacrifices of the people."

column.name: text
column.value: The man brought me back to the entrance of the temple, and I saw water coming out from under the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east). The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He then brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east, and the water was flowing from the south side.

column.name: text
column.value: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and then led me through water that was ankle-deep.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured off another thousand cubits and led me through water that was knee-deep. He measured off another thousand and led me through water that was up to the waist.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured off another thousand, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because the water had risen and was deep enough to swim in--a river that no one could cross.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked me, "Son of man, do you see this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: When I arrived there, I saw a great number of trees on each side of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, where it enters the Sea. When it empties into the Sea, the water there becomes fresh.

column.name: text
column.value: Swarms of living creatures will live wherever the river flows. There will be large numbers of fish, because this water flows there and makes the salt water fresh; so where the river flows everything will live.

column.name: text
column.value: Fishermen will stand along the shore; from En Gedi to En Eglaim there will be places for spreading nets. The fish will be of many kinds--like the fish of the Great Sea.

column.name: text
column.value: But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they will be left for salt.

column.name: text
column.value: Fruit trees of all kinds will grow on both banks of the river. Their leaves will not wither, nor will their fruit fail. Every month they will bear, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will serve for food and their leaves for healing."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "These are the boundaries by which you are to divide the land for an inheritance among the twelve tribes of Israel, with two portions for Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to divide it equally among them. Because I swore with uplifted hand to give it to your forefathers, this land will become your inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is to be the boundary of the land: "On the north side it will run from the Great Sea by the Hethlon road past Lebo Hamath to Zedad,

column.name: text
column.value: Berothah and Sibraim (which lies on the border between Damascus and Hamath), as far as Hazer Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.

column.name: text
column.value: The boundary will extend from the sea to Hazar Enan, along the northern border of Damascus, with the border of Hamath to the north. This will be the north boundary.

column.name: text
column.value: "On the east side the boundary will run between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel, to the eastern sea and as far as Tamar. This will be the east boundary.

column.name: text
column.value: "On the south side it will run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Great Sea. This will be the south boundary.

column.name: text
column.value: "On the west side, the Great Sea will be the boundary to a point opposite Lebo Hamath. This will be the west boundary.

column.name: text
column.value: "You are to distribute this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the aliens who have settled among you and who have children. You are to consider them as native-born Israelites; along with you they are to be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In whatever tribe the alien settles, there you are to give him his inheritance," declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "These are the tribes, listed by name: At the northern frontier, Dan will have one portion; it will follow the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath; Hazar Enan and the northern border of Damascus next to Hamath will be part of its border from the east side to the west side.

column.name: text
column.value: "Asher will have one portion; it will border the territory of Dan from east to west.

column.name: text
column.value: "Naphtali will have one portion; it will border the territory of Asher from east to west.

column.name: text
column.value: "Manasseh will have one portion; it will border the territory of Naphtali from east to west.

column.name: text
column.value: "Ephraim will have one portion; it will border the territory of Manasseh from east to west.

column.name: text
column.value: "Reuben will have one portion; it will border the territory of Ephraim from east to west.

column.name: text
column.value: "Judah will have one portion; it will border the territory of Reuben from east to west.

column.name: text
column.value: "Bordering the territory of Judah from east to west will be the portion you are to present as a special gift. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and its length from east to west will equal one of the tribal portions; the sanctuary will be in the center of it.

column.name: text
column.value: "The special portion you are to offer to the LORD will be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: This will be the sacred portion for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits long on the north side, 10,000 cubits wide on the west side, 10,000 cubits wide on the east side and 25,000 cubits long on the south side. In the center of it will be the sanctuary of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This will be for the consecrated priests, the Zadokites, who were faithful in serving me and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be a special gift to them from the sacred portion of the land, a most holy portion, bordering the territory of the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: "Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites will have an allotment 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. Its total length will be 25,000 cubits and its width 10,000 cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: They must not sell or exchange any of it. This is the best of the land and must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for the common use of the city, for houses and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it

column.name: text
column.value: and will have these measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500 cubits, the east side 4,500 cubits, and the west side 4,500 cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: The pastureland for the city will be 250 cubits on the north, 250 cubits on the south, 250 cubits on the east, and 250 cubits on the west.

column.name: text
column.value: What remains of the area, bordering on the sacred portion and running the length of it, will be 10,000 cubits on the east side and 10,000 cubits on the west side. Its produce will supply food for the workers of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: The workers from the city who farm it will come from all the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits on each side. As a special gift you will set aside the sacred portion, along with the property of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: "What remains on both sides of the area formed by the sacred portion and the city property will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. Both these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center of them.

column.name: text
column.value: So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.

column.name: text
