column.value: A whirlwind will sweep them away, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.

column.name: text
column.value: "Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, O royal house! This judgment is against you: You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

column.name: text
column.value: The rebels are deep in slaughter. I will discipline all of them.

column.name: text
column.value: I know all about Ephraim; Israel is not hidden from me. Ephraim, you have now turned to prostitution; Israel is corrupt.

column.name: text
column.value: "Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. A spirit of prostitution is in their heart; they do not acknowledge the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel's arrogance testifies against them; the Israelites, even Ephraim, stumble in their sin; Judah also stumbles with them.

column.name: text
column.value: When they go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, they will not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.

column.name: text
column.value: They are unfaithful to the LORD; they give birth to illegitimate children. Now their New Moon festivals will devour them and their fields.

column.name: text
column.value: "Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven; lead on, O Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah's leaders are like those who move boundary stones. I will pour out my wrath on them like a flood of water.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim is oppressed, trampled in judgment, intent on pursuing idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to the people of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: "When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sores, then Ephraim turned to Assyria, and sent to the great king for help. But he is not able to cure you, not able to heal your sores.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a great lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will go back to my place until they admit their guilt. And they will seek my face; in their misery they will earnestly seek me."

column.name: text
column.value: "Come, let us return to the LORD. He has torn us to pieces but he will heal us; he has injured us but he will bind up our wounds.

column.name: text
column.value: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will restore us, that we may live in his presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us acknowledge the LORD; let us press on to acknowledge him. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear; he will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: "What can I do with you, Ephraim? What can I do with you, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I cut you in pieces with my prophets, I killed you with the words of my mouth; my judgments flashed like lightning upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: Like Adam, they have broken the covenant--they were unfaithful to me there.

column.name: text
column.value: Gilead is a city of wicked men, stained with footprints of blood.

column.name: text
column.value: As marauders lie in ambush for a man, so do bands of priests; they murder on the road to Shechem, committing shameful crimes.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel. There Ephraim is given to prostitution and Israel is defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: "Also for you, Judah, a harvest is appointed.

column.name: text
column.value: "Whenever I would restore the fortunes of my people, whenever I would heal Israel, the sins of Ephraim are exposed and the crimes of Samaria revealed. They practice deceit, thieves break into houses, bandits rob in the streets;

column.name: text
column.value: but they do not realize that I remember all their evil deeds. Their sins engulf them; they are always before me.

column.name: text
column.value: "They delight the king with their wickedness, the princes with their lies.

column.name: text
column.value: They are all adulterers, burning like an oven whose fire the baker need not stir from the kneading of the dough till it rises.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day of the festival of our king the princes become inflamed with wine, and he joins hands with the mockers.

column.name: text
column.value: Their hearts are like an oven; they approach him with intrigue. Their passion smolders all night; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.

column.name: text
column.value: All of them are hot as an oven; they devour their rulers. All their kings fall, and none of them calls on me.

column.name: text
column.value: "Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is a flat cake not turned over.

column.name: text
column.value: Foreigners sap his strength, but he does not realize it. His hair is sprinkled with gray, but he does not notice.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel's arrogance testifies against him, but despite all this he does not return to the LORD his God or search for him.

column.name: text
column.value: "Ephraim is like a dove, easily deceived and senseless--now calling to Egypt, now turning to Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: When they go, I will throw my net over them; I will pull them down like birds of the air. When I hear them flocking together, I will catch them.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them, because they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against me! I long to redeem them but they speak lies against me.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not cry out to me from their hearts but wail upon their beds. They gather together for grain and new wine but turn away from me.

column.name: text
column.value: I trained them and strengthened them, but they plot evil against me.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not turn to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword because of their insolent words. For this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "Put the trumpet to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the LORD because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel cries out to me, 'O our God, we acknowledge you!'

column.name: text
column.value: But Israel has rejected what is good; an enemy will pursue him.

column.name: text
column.value: They set up kings without my consent; they choose princes without my approval. With their silver and gold they make idols for themselves to their own destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Throw out your calf-idol, O Samaria! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?

column.name: text
column.value: They are from Israel! This calf--a craftsman has made it; it is not God. It will be broken in pieces, that calf of Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: "They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no head; it will produce no flour. Were it to yield grain, foreigners would swallow it up.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel is swallowed up; now she is among the nations like a worthless thing.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.

column.name: text
column.value: Although they have sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them together. They will begin to waste away under the oppression of the mighty king.

column.name: text
column.value: "Though Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings, these have become altars for sinning.

column.name: text
column.value: I wrote for them the many things of my law, but they regarded them as something alien.

column.name: text
column.value: They offer sacrifices given to me and they eat the meat, but the LORD is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their wickedness and punish their sins: They will return to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; Judah has fortified many towns. But I will send fire upon their cities that will consume their fortresses."

column.name: text
column.value: Do not rejoice, O Israel; do not be jubilant like the other nations. For you have been unfaithful to your God; you love the wages of a prostitute at every threshing floor.

column.name: text
column.value: Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people; the new wine will fail them.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not remain in the LORD'S land; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, nor will their sacrifices please him. Such sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat them will be unclean. This food will be for themselves; it will not come into the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: What will you do on the day of your appointed feasts, on the festival days of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: Even if they escape from destruction, Egypt will gather them, and Memphis will bury them. Their treasures of silver will be taken over by briers, and thorns will overrun their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: The days of punishment are coming, the days of reckoning are at hand. Let Israel know this. Because your sins are so many and your hostility so great, the prophet is considered a fool, the inspired man a maniac.

column.name: text
column.value: The prophet, along with my God, is the watchman over Ephraim, yet snares await him on all his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

column.name: text
column.value: They have sunk deep into corruption, as in the days of Gibeah. God will remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: "When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert; when I saw your fathers, it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree. But when they came to Baal Peor, they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol and became as vile as the thing they loved.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim's glory will fly away like a bird--no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.

column.name: text
column.value: Even if they rear children, I will bereave them of every one. Woe to them when I turn away from them!

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim will bring out their children to the slayer."

column.name: text
column.value: Give them, O LORD--what will you give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.

column.name: text
column.value: "Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal, I hated them there. Because of their sinful deeds, I will drive them out of my house. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim is blighted, their root is withered, they yield no fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay their cherished offspring."

column.name: text
column.value: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed him; they will be wanderers among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel was a spreading vine; he brought forth fruit for himself. As his fruit increased, he built more altars; as his land prospered, he adorned his sacred stones.

column.name: text
column.value: Their heart is deceitful, and now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will demolish their altars and destroy their sacred stones.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will say, "We have no king because we did not revere the LORD. But even if we had a king, what could he do for us?"

column.name: text
column.value: They make many promises, take false oaths and make agreements; therefore lawsuits spring up like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

column.name: text
column.value: The people who live in Samaria fear for the calf-idol of Beth Aven. Its people will mourn over it, and so will its idolatrous priests, those who had rejoiced over its splendor, because it is taken from them into exile.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be carried to Assyria as tribute for the great king. Ephraim will be disgraced; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Samaria and its king will float away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: The high places of wickedness will be destroyed--it is the sin of Israel. Thorns and thistles will grow up and cover their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, "Cover us!" and to the hills, "Fall on us!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not war overtake the evildoers in Gibeah?

column.name: text
column.value: When I please, I will punish them; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bonds for their double sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her fair neck. I will drive Ephraim, Judah must plow, and Jacob must break up the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Sow for yourselves righteousness, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and showers righteousness on you.

column.name: text
column.value: But you have planted wickedness, you have reaped evil, you have eaten the fruit of deception. Because you have depended on your own strength and on your many warriors,

column.name: text
column.value: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be devastated--as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will it happen to you, O Bethel, because your wickedness is great. When that day dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

column.name: text
column.value: But the more I called Israel, the further they went from me. They sacrificed to the Baals and they burned incense to images.

column.name: text
column.value: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms; but they did not realize it was I who healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: I led them with cords of human kindness, with ties of love; I lifted the yoke from their neck and bent down to feed them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Will they not return to Egypt and will not Assyria rule over them because they refuse to repent?

column.name: text
column.value: Swords will flash in their cities, will destroy the bars of their gates and put an end to their plans.

column.name: text
column.value: My people are determined to turn from me. Even if they call to the Most High, he will by no means exalt them.

column.name: text
column.value: "How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I treat you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is changed within me; all my compassion is aroused.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not carry out my fierce anger, nor will I turn and devastate Ephraim. For I am God, and not man--the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: They will follow the LORD; he will roar like a lion. When he roars, his children will come trembling from the west.

column.name: text
column.value: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt, like doves from Assyria. I will settle them in their homes," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, the house of Israel with deceit. And Judah is unruly against God, even against the faithful Holy One.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim feeds on the wind; he pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah; he will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: In the womb he grasped his brother's heel; as a man he struggled with God.

column.name: text
column.value: He struggled with the angel and overcame him; he wept and begged for his favor. He found him at Bethel and talked with him there--

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD God Almighty, the LORD is his name of renown!

column.name: text
column.value: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for your God always.

column.name: text
column.value: The merchant uses dishonest scales; he loves to defraud.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim boasts, "I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin."

column.name: text
column.value: "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of your appointed feasts.

column.name: text
column.value: I spoke to the prophets, gave them many visions and told parables through them."

column.name: text
column.value: Is Gilead wicked? Its people are worthless! Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Their altars will be like piles of stones on a plowed field.

column.name: text
column.value: Jacob fled to the country of Aram; Israel served to get a wife, and to pay for her he tended sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt, by a prophet he cared for him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Ephraim has bitterly provoked him to anger; his Lord will leave upon him the guilt of his bloodshed and will repay him for his contempt.

column.name: text
column.value: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God. Your sins have been your downfall!

column.name: text
column.value: Take words with you and return to the LORD. Say to him: "Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount war-horses. We will never again say 'Our gods' to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion."

column.name: text
column.value: "I will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for my anger has turned away from them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon he will send down his roots;

column.name: text
column.value: his young shoots will grow. His splendor will be like an olive tree, his fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.

column.name: text
column.value: Men will dwell again in his shade. He will flourish like the grain. He will blossom like a vine, and his fame will be like the wine from Lebanon.

column.name: text
column.value: O Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? I will answer him and care for him. I am like a green pine tree; your fruitfulness comes from me."

column.name: text
column.value: Who is wise? He will realize these things. Who is discerning? He will understand them. The ways of the LORD are right; the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

column.name: text
column.value: When Ephraim spoke, men trembled; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty of Baal worship and died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they sin more and more; they make idols for themselves from their silver, cleverly fashioned images, all of them the work of craftsmen. It is said of these people, "They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calf-idols."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears, like chaff swirling from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.

column.name: text
column.value: "But I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but me, no Savior except me.

column.name: text
column.value: I cared for you in the desert, in the land of burning heat.

column.name: text
column.value: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot me.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will come upon them like a lion, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a bear robbed of her cubs, I will attack them and rip them open. Like a lion I will devour them; a wild animal will tear them apart.

column.name: text
column.value: "You are destroyed, O Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

column.name: text
column.value: Where is your king, that he may save you? Where are your rulers in all your towns, of whom you said, 'Give me a king and princes'?

column.name: text
column.value: So in my anger I gave you a king, and in my wrath I took him away.

column.name: text
column.value: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up, his sins are kept on record.

column.name: text
column.value: Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him, but he is a child without wisdom; when the time arrives, he does not come to the opening of the womb.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction? "I will have no compassion,

column.name: text
column.value: even though he thrives among his brothers. An east wind from the LORD will come, blowing in from the desert; his spring will fail and his well dry up. His storehouse will be plundered of all its treasures.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of Samaria must bear their guilt, because they have rebelled against their God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to the ground, their pregnant women ripped open."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, you elders; listen, all who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your forefathers?

column.name: text
column.value: Tell it to your children, and let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.

column.name: text
column.value: What the locust swarm has left the great locusts have eaten; what the great locusts have left the young locusts have eaten; what the young locusts have left other locusts have eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine; wail because of the new wine, for it has been snatched from your lips.

column.name: text
column.value: A nation has invaded my land, powerful and without number; it has the teeth of a lion, the fangs of a lioness.

column.name: text
column.value: It has laid waste my vines and ruined my fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.

column.name: text
column.value: Mourn like a virgin in sackcloth grieving for the husband of her youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Grain offerings and drink offerings are cut off from the house of the LORD. The priests are in mourning, those who minister before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The fields are ruined, the ground is dried up; the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the oil fails.

column.name: text
column.value: Despair, you farmers, wail, you vine growers; grieve for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field is destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: The vine is dried up and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, the palm and the apple tree--all the trees of the field--are dried up. Surely the joy of mankind is withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: Put on sackcloth, O priests, and mourn; wail, you who minister before the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, you who minister before my God; for the grain offerings and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare a holy fast; call a sacred assembly. Summon the elders and all who live in the land to the house of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Alas for that day! For the day of the LORD is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes--joy and gladness from the house of our God?

column.name: text
column.value: The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods. The storehouses are in ruins, the granaries have been broken down, for the grain has dried up.

column.name: text
column.value: How the cattle moan! The herds mill about because they have no pasture; even the flocks of sheep are suffering.

column.name: text
column.value: To you, O LORD, I call, for fire has devoured the open pastures and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the wild animals pant for you; the streams of water have dried up and fire has devoured the open pastures.

column.name: text
column.value: Blow the trumpet in Zion; sound the alarm on my holy hill. Let all who live in the land tremble, for the day of the LORD is coming. It is close at hand--

column.name: text
column.value: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like dawn spreading across the mountains a large and mighty army comes, such as never was of old nor ever will be in ages to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Before them fire devours, behind them a flame blazes. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden, behind them, a desert waste--nothing escapes them.

column.name: text
column.value: They have the appearance of horses; they gallop along like cavalry.

column.name: text
column.value: With a noise like that of chariots they leap over the mountaintops, like a crackling fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army drawn up for battle.

column.name: text
column.value: At the sight of them, nations are in anguish; every face turns pale.

column.name: text
column.value: They charge like warriors; they scale walls like soldiers. They all march in line, not swerving from their course.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not jostle each other; each marches straight ahead. They plunge through defenses without breaking ranks.

column.name: text
column.value: They rush upon the city; they run along the wall. They climb into the houses; like thieves they enter through the windows.

column.name: text
column.value: Before them the earth shakes, the sky trembles, the sun and moon are darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD thunders at the head of his army; his forces are beyond number, and mighty are those who obey his command. The day of the LORD is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?

column.name: text
column.value: 'Even now,' declares the LORD, 'return to me with all your heart, with fasting and weeping and mourning.'

column.name: text
column.value: Rend your heart and not your garments. Return to the LORD your God, for he is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love, and he relents from sending calamity.

column.name: text
column.value: Who knows? He may turn and have pity and leave behind a blessing--grain offerings and drink offerings for the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blow the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: Gather the people, consecrate the assembly; bring together the elders, gather the children, those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the priests, who minister before the LORD, weep between the temple porch and the altar. Let them say, 'Spare your people, O LORD. Do not make your inheritance an object of scorn, a byword among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, 'Where is their God?''

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD will be jealous for his land and take pity on his people.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will reply to them: 'I am sending you grain, new wine and oil, enough to satisfy you fully; never again will I make you an object of scorn to the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: 'I will drive the northern army far from you, pushing it into a parched and barren land, with its front columns going into the eastern sea and those in the rear into the western sea. And its stench will go up; its smell will rise.' Surely he has done great things.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not afraid, O land; be glad and rejoice. Surely the LORD has done great things.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not afraid, O wild animals, for the open pastures are becoming green. The trees are bearing their fruit; the fig tree and the vine yield their riches.

column.name: text
column.value: Be glad, O people of Zion, rejoice in the LORD your God, for he has given you the autumn rains in righteousness. He sends you abundant showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.

column.name: text
column.value: The threshing floors will be filled with grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

column.name: text
column.value: 'I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten--the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm--my great army that I sent among you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will have plenty to eat, until you are full, and you will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you; never again will my people be shamed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I am in Israel, that I am the LORD your God, and that there is no other; never again will my people be shamed.

column.name: text
column.value: 'And afterward, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.

column.name: text
column.value: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days.

column.name: text
column.value: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has said, among the survivors whom the LORD calls.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Amos, one of the shepherds of Tekoa--what he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He said: "The LORD roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Carmel withers."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Damascus, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. Because she threshed Gilead with sledges having iron teeth,

column.name: text
column.value: I will send fire upon the house of Hazael that will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.

column.name: text
column.value: I will break down the gate of Damascus; I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Aven and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Gaza, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. Because she took captive whole communities and sold them to Edom,

column.name: text
column.value: I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza that will consume her fortresses.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, till the last of the Philistines is dead," says the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Tyre, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. Because she sold whole communities of captives to Edom, disregarding a treaty of brotherhood,

column.name: text
column.value: I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre that will consume her fortresses."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Edom, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. Because he pursued his brother with a sword, stifling all compassion, because his anger raged continually and his fury flamed unchecked,

column.name: text
column.value: I will send fire upon Teman that will consume the fortresses of Bozrah."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Ammon, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. Because he ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to extend his borders,

column.name: text
column.value: I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah that will consume her fortresses amid war cries on the day of battle, amid violent winds on a stormy day.

column.name: text
column.value: Her king will go into exile, he and his officials together," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: 'In those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning my inheritance, my people Israel, for they scattered my people among the nations and divided up my land.

column.name: text
column.value: They cast lots for my people and traded boys for prostitutes; they sold girls for wine that they might drink.

column.name: text
column.value: 'Now what have you against me, O Tyre and Sidon and all you regions of Philistia? Are you repaying me for something I have done? If you are paying me back, I will swiftly and speedily return on your own heads what you have done.

column.name: text
column.value: For you took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.

column.name: text
column.value: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, that you might send them far from their homeland.

column.name: text
column.value: 'See, I am going to rouse them out of the places to which you sold them, and I will return on your own heads what you have done.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, a nation far away.' The LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for war! Rouse the warriors! Let all the fighting men draw near and attack.

column.name: text
column.value: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weakling say, 'I am strong!'

column.name: text
column.value: Come quickly, all you nations from every side, and assemble there. Bring down your warriors, O LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: 'Let the nations be roused; let them advance into the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit to judge all the nations on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats overflow--so great is their wickedness!'

column.name: text
column.value: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun and moon will be darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem; the earth and the sky will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for his people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: 'Then you will know that I, the LORD your God, dwell in Zion, my holy hill. Jerusalem will be holy; never again will foreigners invade her.

column.name: text
column.value: 'In that day the mountains will drip new wine, and the hills will flow with milk; all the ravines of Judah will run with water. A fountain will flow out of the LORD'S house and will water the valley of acacias.

column.name: text
column.value: But Egypt will be desolate, Edom a desert waste, because of violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah will be inhabited forever and Jerusalem through all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Their bloodguilt, which I have not pardoned, I will pardon.' The LORD dwells in Zion!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Moab, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. Because he burned, as if to lime, the bones of Edom's king,

column.name: text
column.value: I will send fire upon Moab that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth. Moab will go down in great tumult amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy her ruler and kill all her officials with him," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Judah, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. Because they have rejected the law of the LORD and have not kept his decrees, because they have been led astray by false gods, the gods their ancestors followed,

column.name: text
column.value: I will send fire upon Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Israel, even for four, I will not turn back my wrath. They sell the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals.

column.name: text
column.value: They trample on the heads of the poor as upon the dust of the ground and deny justice to the oppressed. Father and son use the same girl and so profane my holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. In the house of their god they drink wine taken as fines.

column.name: text
column.value: "I destroyed the Amorite before them, though he was tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.

column.name: text
column.value: "I brought you up out of Egypt, and I led you forty years in the desert to give you the land of the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: I also raised up prophets from among your sons and Nazirites from among your young men. Is this not true, people of Israel?" declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now then, I will crush you as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.

column.name: text
column.value: The swift will not escape, the strong will not muster their strength, and the warrior will not save his life.

column.name: text
column.value: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet-footed soldier will not get away, and the horseman will not save his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the bravest warriors will flee naked on that day," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word the LORD has spoken against you, O people of Israel--against the whole family I brought up out of Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: "You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your sins."

column.name: text
column.value: Do two walk together unless they have agreed to do so?

column.name: text
column.value: Does a lion roar in the thicket when he has no prey? Does he growl in his den when he has caught nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground where no snare has been set? Does a trap spring up from the earth when there is nothing to catch?

column.name: text
column.value: When a trumpet sounds in a city, do not the people tremble? When disaster comes to a city, has not the LORD caused it?

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the Sovereign LORD does nothing without revealing his plan to his servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: The lion has roared--who will not fear? The Sovereign LORD has spoken--who can but prophesy?

column.name: text
column.value: Proclaim to the fortresses of Ashdod and to the fortresses of Egypt: "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people."

column.name: text
column.value: "They do not know how to do right," declares the LORD, "who hoard plunder and loot in their fortresses."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "An enemy will overrun the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your fortresses."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "As a shepherd saves from the lion's mouth only two leg bones or a piece of an ear, so will the Israelites be saved, those who sit in Samaria on the edge of their beds and in Damascus on their couches."

column.name: text
column.value: "Hear this and testify against the house of Jacob," declares the Lord, the LORD God Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: "On the day I punish Israel for her sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed and the mansions will be demolished," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy and say to your husbands, "Bring us some drinks!"

column.name: text
column.value: The Sovereign LORD has sworn by his holiness: "The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, the last of you with fishhooks.

column.name: text
column.value: You will each go straight out through breaks in the wall, and you will be cast out toward Harmon," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Go to Bethel and sin; go to Gilgal and sin yet more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three years.

column.name: text
column.value: Burn leavened bread as a thank offering and brag about your freewill offerings--boast about them, you Israelites, for this is what you love to do," declares the Sovereign LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I gave you empty stomachs in every city and lack of bread in every town, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I also withheld rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town, but withheld it from another. One field had rain; another had none and dried up.

column.name: text
column.value: People staggered from town to town for water but did not get enough to drink, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards, I struck them with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I overthrew some of you as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel, and because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: He who forms the mountains, creates the wind, and reveals his thoughts to man, he who turns dawn to darkness, and treads the high places of the earth--the LORD God Almighty is his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lament I take up concerning you:

column.name: text
column.value: "Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again, deserted in her own land, with no one to lift her up."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "The city that marches out a thousand strong for Israel will have only a hundred left; the town that marches out a hundred strong will have only ten left."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says to the house of Israel: "Seek me and live;

column.name: text
column.value: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing."

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD and live, or he will sweep through the house of Joseph like a fire; it will devour, and Bethel will have no one to quench it.

column.name: text
column.value: You who turn justice into bitterness and cast righteousness to the ground

column.name: text
column.value: (he who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns blackness into dawn and darkens day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land--the LORD is his name--

column.name: text
column.value: he flashes destruction on the stronghold and brings the fortified city to ruin),

column.name: text
column.value: you hate the one who reproves in court and despise him who tells the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: You trample on the poor and force him to give you grain. Therefore, though you have built stone mansions, you will not live in them; though you have planted lush vineyards, you will not drink their wine.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know how many are your offenses and how great your sins. You oppress the righteous and take bribes and you deprive the poor of justice in the courts.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the prudent man keeps quiet in such times, for the times are evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek good, not evil, that you may live. Then the LORD God Almighty will be with you, just as you say he is.

column.name: text
column.value: Hate evil, love good; maintain justice in the courts. Perhaps the LORD God Almighty will have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord, the LORD God Almighty, says: "There will be wailing in all the streets and cries of anguish in every public square. The farmers will be summoned to weep and the mourners to wail.

column.name: text
column.value: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you who long for the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? That day will be darkness, not light.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be as though a man fled from a lion only to meet a bear, as though he entered his house and rested his hand on the wall only to have a snake bite him.

column.name: text
column.value: Will not the day of the LORD be darkness, not light--pitch-dark, without a ray of brightness?

column.name: text
column.value: "I hate, I despise your religious feasts; I cannot stand your assemblies.

column.name: text
column.value: Even though you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Though you bring choice fellowship offerings, I will have no regard for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Away with the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

column.name: text
column.value: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

column.name: text
column.value: "Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the desert, O house of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: You have lifted up the shrine of your king, the pedestal of your idols, the star of your god--which you made for yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus," says the LORD, whose name is God Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you who are complacent in Zion, and to you who feel secure on Mount Samaria, you notable men of the foremost nation, to whom the people of Israel come!

column.name: text
column.value: Go to Calneh and look at it; go from there to great Hamath, and then go down to Gath in Philistia. Are they better off than your two kingdoms? Is their land larger than yours?

column.name: text
column.value: You put off the evil day and bring near a reign of terror.

column.name: text
column.value: You lie on beds inlaid with ivory and lounge on your couches. You dine on choice lambs and fattened calves.

column.name: text
column.value: You strum away on your harps like David and improvise on musical instruments.

column.name: text
column.value: You drink wine by the bowlful and use the finest lotions, but you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you will be among the first to go into exile; your feasting and lounging will end.

column.name: text
column.value: The Sovereign LORD has sworn by himself--the LORD God Almighty declares: "I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses; I will deliver up the city and everything in it."

column.name: text
column.value: If ten men are left in one house, they too will die.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a relative who is to burn the bodies comes to carry them out of the house and asks anyone still hiding there, "Is anyone with you?" and he says, "No," then he will say, "Hush! We must not mention the name of the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has given the command, and he will smash the great house into pieces and the small house into bits.

column.name: text
column.value: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness--

column.name: text
column.value: you who rejoice in the conquest of Lo Debar and say, "Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?"

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD God Almighty declares, "I will stir up a nation against you, O house of Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts after the king's share had been harvested and just as the second crop was coming up.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had stripped the land clean, I cried out, "Sovereign LORD, forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD relented. "This will not happen," the LORD said.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: The Sovereign LORD was calling for judgment by fire; it dried up the great deep and devoured the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I cried out, "Sovereign LORD, I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD relented. "This will not happen either," the Sovereign LORD said.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what he showed me: The Lord was standing by a wall that had been built true to plumb, with a plumb line in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD asked me, "What do you see, Amos?" "A plumb line," I replied. Then the Lord said, "Look, I am setting a plumb line among my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

column.name: text
column.value: "The high places of Isaac will be destroyed and the sanctuaries of Israel will be ruined; with my sword I will rise against the house of Jeroboam."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent a message to Jeroboam king of Israel: "Amos is raising a conspiracy against you in the very heart of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what Amos is saying: "'Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah said to Amos, "Get out, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't prophesy anymore at Bethel, because this is the king's sanctuary and the temple of the kingdom."

column.name: text
column.value: Amos answered Amaziah, "I was neither a prophet nor a prophet's son, but I was a shepherd, and I also took care of sycamore-fig trees.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD took me from tending the flock and said to me, 'Go, prophesy to my people Israel.'

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, hear the word of the LORD. You say, "'Do not prophesy against Israel, and stop preaching against the house of Isaac.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore this is what the LORD says: "'Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be measured and divided up, and you yourself will die in a pagan country. And Israel will certainly go into exile, away from their native land.'"

column.name: text
column.value: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and he said: "Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people; those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away, none will escape.

column.name: text
column.value: Though they dig down to the depths of the grave, from there my hand will take them. Though they climb up to the heavens, from there I will bring them down.

column.name: text
column.value: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, there I will hunt them down and seize them. Though they hide from me at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.

column.name: text
column.value: Though they are driven into exile by their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. I will fix my eyes upon them for evil and not for good."

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord, the LORD Almighty, he who touches the earth and it melts, and all who live in it mourn--the whole land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt--

column.name: text
column.value: he who builds his lofty palace in the heavens and sets its foundation on the earth, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land--the LORD is his name.

column.name: text
column.value: "Are not you Israelites the same to me as the Cushites?" declares the LORD. "Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?

column.name: text
column.value: "Surely the eyes of the Sovereign LORD are on the sinful kingdom. I will destroy it from the face of the earth--yet I will not totally destroy the house of Jacob," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "For I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will reach the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, 'Disaster will not overtake or meet us.'

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day I will restore David's fallen tent. I will repair its broken places, restore its ruins, and build it as it used to be,

column.name: text
column.value: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear my name," declares the LORD, who will do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring back my exiled people Israel; they will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: I will plant Israel in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land I have given them," says the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: a basket of ripe fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: "What do you see, Amos?" he asked. "A basket of ripe fruit," I answered. Then the LORD said to me, "The time is ripe for my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day," declares the Sovereign LORD, "the songs in the temple will turn to wailing. Many, many bodies--flung everywhere! Silence!"

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, you who trample the needy and do away with the poor of the land,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, "When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath be ended that we may market wheat?"--skimping the measure, boosting the price and cheating with dishonest scales,

column.name: text
column.value: buying the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the sweepings with the wheat.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has sworn by the Pride of Jacob: "I will never forget anything they have done.

column.name: text
column.value: "Will not the land tremble for this, and all who live in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile; it will be stirred up and then sink like the river of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day," declares the Sovereign LORD, "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn your religious feasts into mourning and all your singing into weeping. I will make all of you wear sackcloth and shave your heads. I will make that time like mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.

column.name: text
column.value: "The days are coming," declares the Sovereign LORD, "when I will send a famine through the land--not a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Men will stagger from sea to sea and wander from north to east, searching for the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day "the lovely young women and strong young men will faint because of thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: They who swear by the shame of Samaria, or say, 'As surely as your god lives, O Dan,' or, 'As surely as the god of Beersheba lives'--they will fall, never to rise again."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to Jonah son of Amittai:

column.name: text
column.value: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before me."

column.name: text
column.value: But Jonah ran away from the LORD and headed for Tarshish. He went down to Joppa, where he found a ship bound for that port. After paying the fare, he went aboard and sailed for Tarshish to flee from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD sent a great wind on the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship threatened to break up.

column.name: text
column.value: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone below deck, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: The captain went to him and said, "How can you sleep? Get up and call on your god! Maybe he will take notice of us, and we will not perish."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sailors said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity." They cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah.

column.name: text
column.value: So they asked him, "Tell us, who is responsible for making all this trouble for us? What do you do? Where do you come from? What is your country? From what people are you?"

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, "I am a Hebrew and I worship the LORD, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the land."

column.name: text
column.value: This terrified them and they asked, "What have you done?" (They knew he was running away from the LORD, because he had already told them so.)

column.name: text
column.value: The sea was getting rougher and rougher. So they asked him, "What should we do to you to make the sea calm down for us?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Pick me up and throw me into the sea," he replied, "and it will become calm. I know that it is my fault that this great storm has come upon you."

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, the men did their best to row back to land. But they could not, for the sea grew even wilder than before.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried to the LORD, "O LORD, please do not let us die for taking this man's life. Do not hold us accountable for killing an innocent man, for you, O LORD, have done as you pleased."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took Jonah and threw him overboard, and the raging sea grew calm.

column.name: text
column.value: At this the men greatly feared the LORD, and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD provided a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish three days and three nights.

column.name: text
column.value: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the LORD his God.

column.name: text
column.value: He said: "In my distress I called to the LORD, and he answered me. From the depths of the grave I called for help, and you listened to my cry.

column.name: text
column.value: You hurled me into the deep, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.

column.name: text
column.value: I said, 'I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.'

column.name: text
column.value: The engulfing waters threatened me, the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.

column.name: text
column.value: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you brought my life up from the pit, O LORD my God.

column.name: text
column.value: "When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, LORD, and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: "Those who cling to worthless idols forfeit the grace that could be theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: But I, with a song of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. Salvation comes from the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time:

column.name: text
column.value: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message I give you."

column.name: text
column.value: Jonah obeyed the word of the LORD and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very important city--a visit required three days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day, Jonah started into the city. He proclaimed: "Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned."

column.name: text
column.value: The Ninevites believed God. They declared a fast, and all of them, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth.

column.name: text
column.value: When the news reached the king of Nineveh, he rose from his throne, took off his royal robes, covered himself with sackcloth and sat down in the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he issued a proclamation in Nineveh: "By the decree of the king and his nobles: Do not let any man or beast, herd or flock, taste anything; do not let them eat or drink.

column.name: text
column.value: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth. Let everyone call urgently on God. Let them give up their evil ways and their violence.

column.name: text
column.value: Who knows? God may yet relent and with compassion turn from his fierce anger so that we will not perish."

column.name: text
column.value: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he had compassion and did not bring upon them the destruction he had threatened.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jonah was greatly displeased and became angry.

column.name: text
column.value: He prayed to the LORD, "O LORD, is this not what I said when I was still at home? That is why I was so quick to flee to Tarshish. I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abounding in love, a God who relents from sending calamity.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, O LORD, take away my life, for it is better for me to die than to live."

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD replied, "Have you any right to be angry?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jonah went out and sat down at a place east of the city. There he made himself a shelter, sat in its shade and waited to see what would happen to the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God provided a vine and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the vine.

column.name: text
column.value: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the vine so that it withered.

column.name: text
column.value: When the sun rose, God provided a scorching east wind, and the sun blazed on Jonah's head so that he grew faint. He wanted to die, and said, "It would be better for me to die than to live."

column.name: text
column.value: But God said to Jonah, "Do you have a right to be angry about the vine?" "I do," he said. "I am angry enough to die."

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said, "You have been concerned about this vine, though you did not tend it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.

column.name: text
column.value: But Nineveh has more than a hundred and twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well. Should I not be concerned about that great city?"

column.name: text
column.value: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Sovereign LORD says about Edom--We have heard a message from the LORD: An envoy was sent to the nations to say, "Rise, and let us go against her for battle"--

column.name: text
column.value: "See, I will make you small among the nations; you will be utterly despised.

column.name: text
column.value: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks and make your home on the heights, you who say to yourself, 'Who can bring me down to the ground?'

column.name: text
column.value: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "If thieves came to you, if robbers in the night--Oh, what a disaster awaits you--would they not steal only as much as they wanted? If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes?

column.name: text
column.value: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!

column.name: text
column.value: All your allies will force you to the border; your friends will deceive and overpower you; those who eat your bread will set a trap for you, but you will not detect it.

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day," declares the LORD, "will I not destroy the wise men of Edom, men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?

column.name: text
column.value: Your warriors, O Teman, will be terrified, and everyone in Esau's mountains will be cut down in the slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame; you will be destroyed forever.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.

column.name: text
column.value: You should not look down on your brother in the day of his misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast so much in the day of their trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: You should not march through the gates of my people in the day of their disaster, nor look down on them in their calamity in the day of their disaster, nor seize their wealth in the day of their disaster.

column.name: text
column.value: You should not wait at the crossroads to cut down their fugitives, nor hand over their survivors in the day of their trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: "The day of the LORD is near for all nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your deeds will return upon your own head.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as you drank on my holy hill, so all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and drink and be as if they had never been.

column.name: text
column.value: But on Mount Zion will be deliverance; it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will possess its inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: The house of Jacob will be a fire and the house of Joseph a flame; the house of Esau will be stubble, and they will set it on fire and consume it. There will be no survivors from the house of Esau." The LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: People from the Negev will occupy the mountains of Esau, and people from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: This company of Israelite exiles who are in Canaan will possess the land as far as Zarephath; the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the towns of the Negev.

column.name: text
column.value: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to govern the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will be the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Micah of Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah--the vision he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O peoples, all of you, listen, O earth and all who are in it, that the Sovereign LORD may witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Look! The LORD is coming from his dwelling place; he comes down and treads the high places of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains melt beneath him and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.

column.name: text
column.value: All this is because of Jacob's transgression, because of the sins of the house of Israel. What is Jacob's transgression? Is it not Samaria? What is Judah's high place? Is it not Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones into the valley and lay bare her foundations.

column.name: text
column.value: All her idols will be broken to pieces; all her temple gifts will be burned with fire; I will destroy all her images. Since she gathered her gifts from the wages of prostitutes, as the wages of prostitutes they will again be used."

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this I will weep and wail; I will go about barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.

column.name: text
column.value: For her wound is incurable; it has come to Judah. It has reached the very gate of my people, even to Jerusalem itself.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell it not in Gath; weep not at all. In Beth Ophrah roll in the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: Pass on in nakedness and shame, you who live in Shaphir. Those who live in Zaanan will not come out. Beth Ezel is in mourning; its protection is taken from you.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who live in Maroth writhe in pain, waiting for relief, because disaster has come from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: You who live in Lachish, harness the team to the chariot. You were the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. The town of Aczib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring a conqueror against you who live in Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

column.name: text
column.value: Shave your heads in mourning for the children in whom you delight; make yourselves as bald as the vulture, for they will go from you into exile.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who plan iniquity, to those who plot evil on their beds! At morning's light they carry it out because it is in their power to do it.

column.name: text
column.value: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them. They defraud a man of his home, a fellowman of his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, the LORD says: "I am planning disaster against this people, from which you cannot save yourselves. You will no longer walk proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day men will ridicule you; they will taunt you with this mournful song: 'We are utterly ruined; my people's possession is divided up. He takes it from me! He assigns our fields to traitors.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not prophesy," their prophets say. "Do not prophesy about these things; disgrace will not overtake us."

column.name: text
column.value: Should it be said, O house of Jacob: "Is the Spirit of the LORD angry? Does he do such things?" "Do not my words do good to him whose ways are upright?

column.name: text
column.value: Lately my people have risen up like an enemy. You strip off the rich robe from those who pass by without a care, like men returning from battle.

column.name: text
column.value: You drive the women of my people from their pleasant homes. You take away my blessing from their children forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Get up, go away! For this is not your resting place, because it is defiled, it is ruined, beyond all remedy.

column.name: text
column.value: If a liar and deceiver comes and says, 'I will prophesy for you plenty of wine and beer,' he would be just the prophet for this people!

column.name: text
column.value: "I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob; I will surely bring together the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture; the place will throng with people.

column.name: text
column.value: One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate and go out. Their king will pass through before them, the LORD at their head."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, "Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice,

column.name: text
column.value: you who hate good and love evil; who tear the skin from my people and the flesh from their bones;

column.name: text
column.value: who eat my people's flesh, strip off their skin and break their bones in pieces; who chop them up like meat for the pan, like flesh for the pot?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but he will not answer them. At that time he will hide his face from them because of the evil they have done.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "As for the prophets who lead my people astray, if one feeds them, they proclaim 'peace'; if he does not, they prepare to wage war against him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore night will come over you, without visions, and darkness, without divination. The sun will set for the prophets, and the day will go dark for them.

column.name: text
column.value: The seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced. They will all cover their faces because there is no answer from God."

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the LORD, and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, to Israel his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, you leaders of the house of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and distort all that is right;

column.name: text
column.value: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD and say, "Is not the LORD among us? No disaster will come upon us."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.

column.name: text
column.value: In the last days the mountain of the LORD'S temple will be established as chief among the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and peoples will stream to it.

column.name: text
column.value: Many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths." The law will go out from Zion, the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: He will judge between many peoples and will settle disputes for strong nations far and wide. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

column.name: text
column.value: Every man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid, for the LORD Almighty has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations may walk in the name of their gods; we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day," declares the LORD, "I will gather the lame; I will assemble the exiles and those I have brought to grief.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make the lame a remnant, those driven away a strong nation. The LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion, the former dominion will be restored to you; kingship will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem."

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you now cry aloud--have you no king? Has your counselor perished, that pain seizes you like that of a woman in labor?

column.name: text
column.value: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor, for now you must leave the city to camp in the open field. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you out of the hand of your enemies.

column.name: text
