column.value: But now many nations are gathered against you. They say, "Let her be defiled, let our eyes gloat over Zion!"

column.name: text
column.value: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD; they do not understand his plan, he who gathers them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

column.name: text
column.value: "Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron; I will give you hoofs of bronze and you will break to pieces many nations." You will devote their ill-gotten gains to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Marshal your troops, O city of troops, for a siege is laid against us. They will strike Israel's ruler on the cheek with a rod.

column.name: text
column.value: "But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until the time when she who is in labor gives birth and the rest of his brothers return to join the Israelites.

column.name: text
column.value: He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. And they will live securely, for then his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will be their peace. When the Assyrian invades our land and marches through our fortresses, we will raise against him seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.

column.name: text
column.value: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod with drawn sword. He will deliver us from the Assyrian when he invades our land and marches into our borders.

column.name: text
column.value: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which mauls and mangles as it goes, and no one can rescue.

column.name: text
column.value: Your hand will be lifted up in triumph over your enemies, and all your foes will be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: "In that day," declares the LORD, "I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy your carved images and your sacred stones from among you; you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: I will uproot from among you your Asherah poles and demolish your cities.

column.name: text
column.value: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed me."

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to what the LORD says: "Stand up, plead your case before the mountains; let the hills hear what you have to say.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O mountains, the LORD'S accusation; listen, you everlasting foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against his people; he is lodging a charge against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: I brought you up out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. I sent Moses to lead you, also Aaron and Miriam.

column.name: text
column.value: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD."

column.name: text
column.value: With what shall I come before the LORD and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

column.name: text
column.value: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

column.name: text
column.value: He has showed you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen! The LORD is calling to the city--and to fear your name is wisdom--"Heed the rod and the One who appointed it.

column.name: text
column.value: Am I still to forget, O wicked house, your ill-gotten treasures and the short ephah, which is accursed?

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I acquit a man with dishonest scales, with a bag of false weights?

column.name: text
column.value: Her rich men are violent; her people are liars and their tongues speak deceitfully.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I have begun to destroy you, to ruin you because of your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: You will eat but not be satisfied; your stomach will still be empty. You will store up but save nothing, because what you save I will give to the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: You will plant but not harvest; you will press olives but not use the oil on yourselves, you will crush grapes but not drink the wine.

column.name: text
column.value: You have observed the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab's house, and you have followed their traditions. Therefore I will give you over to ruin and your people to derision; you will bear the scorn of the nations."

column.name: text
column.value: What misery is mine! I am like one who gathers summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster of grapes to eat, none of the early figs that I crave.

column.name: text
column.value: The godly have been swept from the land; not one upright man remains. All men lie in wait to shed blood; each hunts his brother with a net.

column.name: text
column.value: Both hands are skilled in doing evil; the ruler demands gifts, the judge accepts bribes, the powerful dictate what they desire--they all conspire together.

column.name: text
column.value: The best of them is like a brier, the most upright worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen has come, the day God visits you. Now is the time of their confusion.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not trust a neighbor; put no confidence in a friend. Even with her who lies in your embrace be careful of your words.

column.name: text
column.value: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises up against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law--a man's enemies are the members of his own household.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I watch in hope for the LORD, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

column.name: text
column.value: Because I have sinned against him, I will bear the LORD'S wrath, until he pleads my case and establishes my right. He will bring me out into the light; I will see his righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then my enemy will see it and will be covered with shame, she who said to me, "Where is the LORD your God?" My eyes will see her downfall; even now she will be trampled underfoot like mire in the streets.

column.name: text
column.value: The day for building your walls will come, the day for extending your boundaries.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day people will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the result of their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, which lives by itself in a forest, in fertile pasturelands. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead as in days long ago.

column.name: text
column.value: "As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show them my wonders."

column.name: text
column.value: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their power. They will lay their hands on their mouths and their ears will become deaf.

column.name: text
column.value: They will lick dust like a snake, like creatures that crawl on the ground. They will come trembling out of their dens; they will turn in fear to the LORD our God and will be afraid of you.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: You will again have compassion on us; you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be true to Jacob, and show mercy to Abraham, as you pledged on oath to our fathers in days long ago.

column.name: text
column.value: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD takes vengeance and is filled with wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his foes and maintains his wrath against his enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains quake before him and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and all who live in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can withstand his indignation? Who can endure his fierce anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; the rocks are shattered before him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,

column.name: text
column.value: but with an overwhelming flood he will make an end of Nineveh; he will pursue his foes into darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever they plot against the LORD he will bring to an end; trouble will not come a second time.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be entangled among thorns and drunk from their wine; they will be consumed like dry stubble.

column.name: text
column.value: From you, O Nineveh,has one come forth who plots evil against the LORD and counsels wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "Although they have allies and are numerous, they will be cut off and pass away. Although I have afflicted you, O Judah,I will afflict you no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear your shackles away."

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has given a command concerning you, Nineveh: "You will have no descendants to bear your name. I will destroy the carved images and cast idols that are in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, for you are vile."

column.name: text
column.value: Look, there on the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your festivals, O Judah, and fulfill your vows. No more will the wicked invade you; they will be completely destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: An attacker advances against you, Nineveh. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, marshal all your strength!

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and have ruined their vines.

column.name: text
column.value: The shields of his soldiers are red; the warriors are clad in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are made ready; the spears of pine are brandished.

column.name: text
column.value: The chariots storm through the streets, rushing back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches; they dart about like lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: He summons his picked troops, yet they stumble on their way. They dash to the city wall; the protective shield is put in place.

column.name: text
column.value: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.

column.name: text
column.value: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away. Its slave girls moan like doves and beat upon their breasts.

column.name: text
column.value: Nineveh is like a pool, and its water is draining away. "Stop! Stop!" they cry, but no one turns back.

column.name: text
column.value: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The supply is endless, the wealth from all its treasures!

column.name: text
column.value: She is pillaged, plundered, stripped! Hearts melt, knees give way, bodies tremble, every face grows pale.

column.name: text
column.value: Where now is the lions' den, the place where they fed their young, where the lion and lioness went, and the cubs, with nothing to fear?

column.name: text
column.value: The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled the prey for his mate, filling his lairs with the kill and his dens with the prey.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am against you," declares the LORD Almighty. "I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will no longer be heard."

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without victims!

column.name: text
column.value: The crack of whips, the clatter of wheels, galloping horses and jolting chariots!

column.name: text
column.value: Charging cavalry, flashing swords and glittering spears! Many casualties, piles of dead, bodies without number, people stumbling over the corpses--

column.name: text
column.value: all because of the wanton lust of a harlot, alluring, the mistress of sorceries, who enslaved nations by her prostitution and peoples by her witchcraft.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am against you," declares the LORD Almighty. "I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.

column.name: text
column.value: I will pelt you with filth, I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.

column.name: text
column.value: All who see you will flee from you and say, 'Nineveh is in ruins--who will mourn for her?' Where can I find anyone to comfort you?"

column.name: text
column.value: Are you better than Thebes, situated on the Nile, with water around her? The river was her defense, the waters her wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet she was taken captive and went into exile. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. Lots were cast for her nobles, and all her great men were put in chains.

column.name: text
column.value: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: All your fortresses are like fig trees with their first ripe fruit; when they are shaken, the figs fall into the mouth of the eater.

column.name: text
column.value: Look at your troops--they are all women! The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire has consumed their bars.

column.name: text
column.value: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!

column.name: text
column.value: There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down and, like grasshoppers, consume you. Multiply like grasshoppers, multiply like locusts!

column.name: text
column.value: You have increased the number of your merchants till they are more than the stars of the sky, but like locusts they strip the land and then fly away.

column.name: text
column.value: Your guards are like locusts, your officials like swarms of locusts that settle in the walls on a cold day--but when the sun appears they fly away, and no one knows where.

column.name: text
column.value: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your nobles lie down to rest. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.

column.name: text
column.value: Nothing can heal your wound; your injury is fatal. Everyone who hears the news about you claps his hands at your fall, for who has not felt your endless cruelty?

column.name: text
column.value: I will stand at my watch and station myself on the ramparts; I will look to see what he will say to me, and what answer I am to give to this complaint.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD replied: "Write down the revelation and make it plain on tablets so that a herald may run with it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the revelation awaits an appointed time; it speaks of the end and will not prove false. Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.

column.name: text
column.value: "See, he is puffed up; his desires are not upright--but the righteous will live by his faith--

column.name: text
column.value: indeed, wine betrays him; he is arrogant and never at rest. Because he is as greedy as the grave and like death is never satisfied, he gathers to himself all the nations and takes captive all the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: "Will not all of them taunt him with ridicule and scorn, saying, "'Woe to him who piles up stolen goods and makes himself wealthy by extortion! How long must this go on?'

column.name: text
column.value: Will not your debtors suddenly arise? Will they not wake up and make you tremble? Then you will become their victim.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you have plundered many nations, the peoples who are left will plunder you. For you have shed man's blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to him who builds his realm by unjust gain to set his nest on high, to escape the clutches of ruin!

column.name: text
column.value: You have plotted the ruin of many peoples, shaming your own house and forfeiting your life.

column.name: text
column.value: The stones of the wall will cry out, and the beams of the woodwork will echo it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by crime!

column.name: text
column.value: Has not the LORD Almighty determined that the people's labor is only fuel for the fire, that the nations exhaust themselves for nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin till they are drunk, so that he can gaze on their naked bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. Now it is your turn! Drink and be exposed! The cup from the LORD'S right hand is coming around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

column.name: text
column.value: The violence you have done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and your destruction of animals will terrify you. For you have shed man's blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Of what value is an idol, since a man has carved it? Or an image that teaches lies? For he who makes it trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to him who says to wood, 'Come to life!' Or to lifeless stone, 'Wake up!' Can it give guidance? It is covered with gold and silver; there is no breath in it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD is in his holy temple; let all the earth be silent before him."

column.name: text
column.value: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet received.

column.name: text
column.value: How long, O LORD, must I call for help, but you do not listen? Or cry out to you, "Violence!" but you do not save?

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you make me look at injustice? Why do you tolerate wrong? Destruction and violence are before me; there is strife, and conflict abounds.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.

column.name: text
column.value: "Look at the nations and watch--and be utterly amazed. For I am going to do something in your days that you would not believe, even if you were told.

column.name: text
column.value: I am raising up the Babylonians, that ruthless and impetuous people, who sweep across the whole earth to seize dwelling places not their own.

column.name: text
column.value: They are a feared and dreaded people; they are a law to themselves and promote their own honor.

column.name: text
column.value: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their cavalry gallops headlong; their horsemen come from afar. They fly like a vulture swooping to devour;

column.name: text
column.value: they all come bent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind and gather prisoners like sand.

column.name: text
column.value: They deride kings and scoff at rulers. They laugh at all fortified cities; they build earthen ramps and capture them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they sweep past like the wind and go on--guilty men, whose own strength is their god."

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, are you not from everlasting? My God, my Holy One, we will not die. O LORD, you have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, you have ordained them to punish.

column.name: text
column.value: Your eyes are too pure to look on evil; you cannot tolerate wrong. Why then do you tolerate the treacherous? Why are you silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?

column.name: text
column.value: You have made men like fish in the sea, like sea creatures that have no ruler.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked foe pulls all of them up with hooks, he catches them in his net, he gathers them up in his dragnet; and so he rejoices and is glad.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, for by his net he lives in luxury and enjoys the choicest food.

column.name: text
column.value: Is he to keep on emptying his net, destroying nations without mercy?

column.name: text
column.value: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet. On shigionoth .

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, I have heard of your fame; I stand in awe of your deeds, O LORD. Renew them in our day, in our time make them known; in wrath remember mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens and his praise filled the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: His splendor was like the sunrise; rays flashed from his hand, where his power was hidden.

column.name: text
column.value: Plague went before him; pestilence followed his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: He stood, and shook the earth; he looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains crumbled and the age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress, the dwellings of Midian in anguish.

column.name: text
column.value: Were you angry with the rivers, O LORD? Was your wrath against the streams? Did you rage against the sea when you rode with your horses and your victorious chariots?

column.name: text
column.value: You uncovered your bow, you called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers;

column.name: text
column.value: the mountains saw you and writhed. Torrents of water swept by; the deep roared and lifted its waves on high.

column.name: text
column.value: Sun and moon stood still in the heavens at the glint of your flying arrows, at the lightning of your flashing spear.

column.name: text
column.value: In wrath you strode through the earth and in anger you threshed the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: You came out to deliver your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the land of wickedness, you stripped him from head to foot. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: With his own spear you pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though about to devour the wretched who were in hiding.

column.name: text
column.value: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the great waters.

column.name: text
column.value: I heard and my heart pounded, my lips quivered at the sound; decay crept into my bones, and my legs trembled. Yet I will wait patiently for the day of calamity to come on the nation invading us.

column.name: text
column.value: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though there are no sheep in the pen and no cattle in the stalls,

column.name: text
column.value: yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will be joyful in God my Savior.

column.name: text
column.value: The Sovereign LORD is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, he enables me to go on the heights. For the director of music. On my stringed instruments.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: "I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will sweep away both men and animals; I will sweep away the birds of the air and the fish of the sea. The wicked will have only heaps of rubble when I cut off man from the face of the earth," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all who live in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the pagan and the idolatrous priests--

column.name: text
column.value: those who bow down on the roofs to worship the starry host, those who bow down and swear by the LORD and who also swear by Molech,

column.name: text
column.value: those who turn back from following the LORD and neither seek the LORD nor inquire of him.

column.name: text
column.value: Be silent before the Sovereign LORD, for the day of the LORD is near. The LORD has prepared a sacrifice; he has consecrated those he has invited.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day of the LORD'S sacrifice I will punish the princes and the king's sons and all those clad in foreign clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day I will punish all who avoid stepping on the threshold, who fill the temple of their gods with violence and deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: "On that day," declares the LORD, "a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, wailing from the New Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, you who live in the market district; all your merchants will be wiped out, all who trade with silver will be ruined.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those who are complacent, who are like wine left on its dregs, who think, 'The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.'

column.name: text
column.value: Their wealth will be plundered, their houses demolished. They will build houses but not live in them; they will plant vineyards but not drink the wine.

column.name: text
column.value: "The great day of the LORD is near--near and coming quickly. Listen! The cry on the day of the LORD will be bitter, the shouting of the warrior there.

column.name: text
column.value: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

column.name: text
column.value: a day of trumpet and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the corner towers.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring distress on the people and they will walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their entrails like filth.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the LORD'S wrath. In the fire of his jealousy the whole world will be consumed, for he will make a sudden end of all who live in the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: Gather together, gather together, O shameful nation,

column.name: text
column.value: before the appointed time arrives and that day sweeps on like chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes upon you, before the day of the LORD'S wrath comes upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, you who do what he commands. Seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD'S anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins. At midday Ashdod will be emptied and Ekron uprooted.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you who live by the sea, O Kerethite people; the word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines. "I will destroy you, and none will be left."

column.name: text
column.value: The land by the sea, where the Kerethites dwell, will be a place for shepherds and sheep pens.

column.name: text
column.value: It will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon. The LORD their God will care for them; he will restore their fortunes.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the Ammonites, who insulted my people and made threats against their land.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, as surely as I live," declares the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, "surely Moab will become like Sodom, the Ammonites like Gomorrah--a place of weeds and salt pits, a wasteland forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them; the survivors of my nation will inherit their land."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what they will get in return for their pride, for insulting and mocking the people of the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will be awesome to them when he destroys all the gods of the land. The nations on every shore will worship him, every one in its own land.

column.name: text
column.value: "You too, O Cushites, will be slain by my sword."

column.name: text
column.value: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, leaving Nineveh utterly desolate and dry as the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: Flocks and herds will lie down there, creatures of every kind. The desert owl and the screech owl will roost on her columns. Their calls will echo through the windows, rubble will be in the doorways, the beams of cedar will be exposed.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the carefree city that lived in safety. She said to herself, "I am, and there is none besides me." What a ruin she has become, a lair for wild beasts! All who pass by her scoff and shake their fists.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

column.name: text
column.value: She obeys no one, she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the LORD, she does not draw near to her God.

column.name: text
column.value: Her officials are roaring lions, her rulers are evening wolves, who leave nothing for the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: Her prophets are arrogant; they are treacherous men. Her priests profane the sanctuary and do violence to the law.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD within her is righteous; he does no wrong. Morning by morning he dispenses his justice, and every new day he does not fail, yet the unrighteous know no shame.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have cut off nations; their strongholds are demolished. I have left their streets deserted, with no one passing through. Their cities are destroyed; no one will be left--no one at all.

column.name: text
column.value: I said to the city, 'Surely you will fear me and accept correction!' Then her dwelling would not be cut off, nor all my punishments come upon her. But they were still eager to act corruptly in all they did.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore wait for me," declares the LORD, "for the day I will stand up to testify. I have decided to assemble the nations, to gather the kingdoms and to pour out my wrath on them--all my fierce anger. The whole world will be consumed by the fire of my jealous anger.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then will I purify the lips of the peoples, that all of them may call on the name of the LORD and serve him shoulder to shoulder.

column.name: text
column.value: From beyond the rivers of Cush my worshipers, my scattered people, will bring me offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day you will not be put to shame for all the wrongs you have done to me, because I will remove from this city those who rejoice in their pride. Never again will you be haughty on my holy hill.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will leave within you the meek and humble, who trust in the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The remnant of Israel will do no wrong; they will speak no lies, nor will deceit be found in their mouths. They will eat and lie down and no one will make them afraid."

column.name: text
column.value: Sing, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has taken away your punishment, he has turned back your enemy. The LORD, the King of Israel, is with you; never again will you fear any harm.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day they will say to Jerusalem, "Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands hang limp.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God is with you, he is mighty to save. He will take great delight in you, he will quiet you with his love, he will rejoice over you with singing."

column.name: text
column.value: "The sorrows for the appointed feasts I will remove from you; they are a burden and a reproach to you.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I will deal with all who oppressed you; I will rescue the lame and gather those who have been scattered. I will give them praise and honor in every land where they were put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I will gather you; at that time I will bring you home. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your very eyes," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest:

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "These people say, 'The time has not yet come for the LORD'S house to be built.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai:

column.name: text
column.value: "Is it a time for you yourselves to be living in your paneled houses, while this house remains a ruin?"

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is what the LORD Almighty says: "Give careful thought to your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: You have planted much, but have harvested little. You eat, but never have enough. You drink, but never have your fill. You put on clothes, but are not warm. You earn wages, only to put them in a purse with holes in it."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Give careful thought to your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up into the mountains and bring down timber and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be honored," says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "You expected much, but see, it turned out to be little. What you brought home, I blew away. Why?" declares the LORD Almighty. "Because of my house, which remains a ruin, while each of you is busy with his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, because of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth its crops.

column.name: text
column.value: I called for a drought on the fields and the mountains, on the grain, the new wine, the oil and whatever the ground produces, on men and cattle, and on the labor of your hands."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the message of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. And the people feared the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Haggai, the LORD'S messenger, gave this message of the LORD to the people: "I am with you," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people. They came and began to work on the house of the LORD Almighty, their God,

column.name: text
column.value: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of King Darius.

column.name: text
column.value: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai:

column.name: text
column.value: "Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people. Ask them,

column.name: text
column.value: 'Who of you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not seem to you like nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel,' declares the LORD. 'Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,' declares the LORD, 'and work. For I am with you,' declares the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: 'This is what I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt. And my Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.'

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will shake all nations, and the desired of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory,' says the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: 'The silver is mine and the gold is mine,' declares the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: 'The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house,' says the LORD Almighty. 'And in this place I will grant peace,' declares the LORD Almighty."

column.name: text
column.value: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Haggai:

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Ask the priests what the law says:

column.name: text
column.value: If a person carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, oil or other food, does it become consecrated?'" The priests answered, "No."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Haggai said, "If a person defiled by contact with a dead body touches one of these things, does it become defiled?" "Yes," the priests replied, "it becomes defiled."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Haggai said, "'So it is with this people and this nation in my sight,' declares the LORD. 'Whatever they do and whatever they offer there is defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Now give careful thought to this from this day on--consider how things were before one stone was laid on another in the LORD'S temple.

column.name: text
column.value: When anyone came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When anyone went to a wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.

column.name: text
column.value: I struck all the work of your hands with blight, mildew and hail, yet you did not turn to me,' declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: 'From this day on, from this twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, give careful thought to the day when the foundation of the LORD'S temple was laid. Give careful thought:

column.name: text
column.value: Is there yet any seed left in the barn? Until now, the vine and the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne fruit. "'From this day on I will bless you.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth day of the month:

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I will shake the heavens and the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I will overturn royal thrones and shatter the power of the foreign kingdoms. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: "'On that day,' declares the LORD Almighty, 'I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,' declares the LORD, 'and I will make you like my signet ring, for I have chosen you,' declares the LORD Almighty."

column.name: text
column.value: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:

column.name: text
column.value: "The LORD was very angry with your forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore tell the people: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Return to me,' declares the LORD Almighty, 'and I will return to you,' says the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be like your forefathers, to whom the earlier prophets proclaimed: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Turn from your evil ways and your evil practices.' But they would not listen or pay attention to me, declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Where are your forefathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?

column.name: text
column.value: But did not my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, overtake your forefathers? "Then they repented and said, 'The LORD Almighty has done to us what our ways and practices deserve, just as he determined to do.'"

column.name: text
column.value: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo.

column.name: text
column.value: During the night I had a vision--and there before me was a man riding a red horse! He was standing among the myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him were red, brown and white horses.

column.name: text
column.value: I asked, "What are these, my lord?" The angel who was talking with me answered, "I will show you what they are."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, "They are the ones the LORD has sent to go throughout the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: And they reported to the angel of the LORD, who was standing among the myrtle trees, "We have gone throughout the earth and found the whole world at rest and in peace."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD said, "LORD Almighty, how long will you withhold mercy from Jerusalem and from the towns of Judah, which you have been angry with these seventy years?"

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel who was speaking to me said, "Proclaim this word: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,

column.name: text
column.value: but I am very angry with the nations that feel secure. I was only a little angry, but they added to the calamity.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, this is what the LORD says: 'I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there my house will be rebuilt. And the measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem,' declares the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: "Proclaim further: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'My towns will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked up--and there before me were four horns!

column.name: text
column.value: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, "What are these?" He answered me, "These are the horns that scattered Judah, Israel and Jerusalem."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

column.name: text
column.value: I asked, "What are these coming to do?" He answered, "These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head, but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations who lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter its people."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked up--and there before me was a man with a measuring line in his hand!

column.name: text
column.value: I asked, "Where are you going?" He answered me, "To measure Jerusalem, to find out how wide and how long it is."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel who was speaking to me left, and another angel came to meet him

column.name: text
column.value: and said to him: "Run, tell that young man, 'Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the great number of men and livestock in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I myself will be a wall of fire around it,' declares the LORD, 'and I will be its glory within.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north," declares the LORD, "for I have scattered you to the four winds of heaven," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Come, O Zion! Escape, you who live in the Daughter of Babylon!"

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD Almighty says: "After he has honored me and has sent me against the nations that have plundered you--for whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye--

column.name: text
column.value: I will surely raise my hand against them so that their slaves will plunder them. Then you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: "Shout and be glad, O Daughter of Zion. For I am coming, and I will live among you," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: "Many nations will be joined with the LORD in that day and will become my people. I will live among you and you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land and will again choose Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Be still before the LORD, all mankind, because he has roused himself from his holy dwelling."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right side to accuse him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Satan, "The LORD rebuke you, Satan! The LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! Is not this man a burning stick snatched from the fire?"

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel said to those who were standing before him, "Take off his filthy clothes." Then he said to Joshua, "See, I have taken away your sin, and I will put rich garments on you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, "Put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head and clothed him, while the angel of the LORD stood by.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD gave this charge to Joshua:

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'If you will walk in my ways and keep my requirements, then you will govern my house and have charge of my courts, and I will give you a place among these standing here.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Listen, O high priest Joshua and your associates seated before you, who are men symbolic of things to come: I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.

column.name: text
column.value: See, the stone I have set in front of Joshua! There are seven eyes on that one stone, and I will engrave an inscription on it,' says the LORD Almighty, 'and I will remove the sin of this land in a single day.

column.name: text
column.value: "'In that day each of you will invite his neighbor to sit under his vine and fig tree,' declares the LORD Almighty."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel who talked with me returned and wakened me, as a man is wakened from his sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and seven lights on it, with seven channels to the lights.

column.name: text
column.value: Also there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left."

column.name: text
column.value: I asked the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I replied.

column.name: text
column.value: So he said to me, "This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: 'Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit,' says the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: "What are you, O mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become level ground. Then he will bring out the capstone to shouts of 'God bless it! God bless it!'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this temple; his hands will also complete it. Then you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Who despises the day of small things? Men will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. "(These seven are the eyes of the LORD, which range throughout the earth.)"

column.name: text
column.value: Then I asked the angel, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?"

column.name: text
column.value: Again I asked him, "What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?"

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I said.

column.name: text
column.value: So he said, "These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: I looked again--and there before me was a flying scroll!

column.name: text
column.value: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a flying scroll, thirty feet long and fifteen feet wide."

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land; for according to what it says on one side, every thief will be banished, and according to what it says on the other, everyone who swears falsely will be banished.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD Almighty declares, 'I will send it out, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of him who swears falsely by my name. It will remain in his house and destroy it, both its timbers and its stones.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel who was speaking to me came forward and said to me, "Look up and see what this is that is appearing."

column.name: text
column.value: I asked, "What is it?" He replied, "It is a measuring basket." And he added, "This is the iniquity of the people throughout the land."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cover of lead was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!

column.name: text
column.value: He said, "This is wickedness," and he pushed her back into the basket and pushed the lead cover down over its mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked up--and there before me were two women, with the wind in their wings! They had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: "Where are they taking the basket?" I asked the angel who was speaking to me.

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "To the country of Babylonia to build a house for it. When it is ready, the basket will be set there in its place."

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-Melech, together with their men, to entreat the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: by asking the priests of the house of the LORD Almighty and the prophets, "Should I mourn and fast in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD Almighty came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Ask all the people of the land and the priests, 'When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for the past seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?

column.name: text
column.value: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not just feasting for yourselves?

column.name: text
column.value: Are these not the words the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were at rest and prosperous, and the Negev and the western foothills were settled?'"

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came again to Zechariah:

column.name: text
column.value: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Administer true justice; show mercy and compassion to one another.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the alien or the poor. In your hearts do not think evil of each other.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But they refused to pay attention; stubbornly they turned their backs and stopped up their ears.

column.name: text
column.value: They made their hearts as hard as flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the LORD Almighty had sent by his Spirit through the earlier prophets. So the LORD Almighty was very angry.

column.name: text
column.value: "'When I called, they did not listen; so when they called, I would not listen,' says the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: 'I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations, where they were strangers. The land was left so desolate behind them that no one could come or go. This is how they made the pleasant land desolate.'"

column.name: text
column.value: I looked up again--and there before me were four chariots coming out from between two mountains--mountains of bronze!

column.name: text
column.value: The first chariot had red horses, the second black,

column.name: text
column.value: the third white, and the fourth dappled--all of them powerful.

column.name: text
column.value: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, "What are these, my lord?"

column.name: text
column.value: The angel answered me, "These are the four spirits of heaven, going out from standing in the presence of the Lord of the whole world.

column.name: text
column.value: The one with the black horses is going toward the north country, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south."

column.name: text
column.value: When the powerful horses went out, they were straining to go throughout the earth. And he said, "Go throughout the earth!" So they went throughout the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called to me, "Look, those going toward the north country have given my Spirit rest in the land of the north."

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me:

column.name: text
column.value: "Take silver and gold from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

column.name: text
column.value: Take the silver and gold and make a crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell him this is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Here is the man whose name is the Branch, and he will branch out from his place and build the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: It is he who will build the temple of the LORD, and he will be clothed with majesty and will sit and rule on his throne. And he will be a priest on his throne. And there will be harmony between the two.'

column.name: text
column.value: The crown will be given to Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah and Hen son of Zephaniah as a memorial in the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who are far away will come and help to build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the LORD your God."

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD Almighty came to me.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "I am very jealous for Zion; I am burning with jealousy for her."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: "I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD Almighty will be called the Holy Mountain."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Once again men and women of ripe old age will sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each with cane in hand because of his age.

column.name: text
column.value: The city streets will be filled with boys and girls playing there."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "It may seem marvelous to the remnant of this people at that time, but will it seem marvelous to me?" declares the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be faithful and righteous to them as their God."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "You who now hear these words spoken by the prophets who were there when the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD Almighty, let your hands be strong so that the temple may be built.

column.name: text
column.value: Before that time there were no wages for man or beast. No one could go about his business safely because of his enemy, for I had turned every man against his neighbor.

column.name: text
column.value: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the past," declares the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: "The seed will grow well, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will produce its crops, and the heavens will drop their dew. I will give all these things as an inheritance to the remnant of this people.

column.name: text
column.value: As you have been an object of cursing among the nations, O Judah and Israel, so will I save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid, but let your hands be strong."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Just as I had determined to bring disaster upon you and showed no pity when your fathers angered me," says the LORD Almighty,

column.name: text
column.value: "so now I have determined to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the things you are to do: Speak the truth to each other, and render true and sound judgment in your courts;

column.name: text
column.value: do not plot evil against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely. I hate all this," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD Almighty came to me.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become joyful and glad occasions and happy festivals for Judah. Therefore love truth and peace."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come,

column.name: text
column.value: and the inhabitants of one city will go to another and say, 'Let us go at once to entreat the LORD and seek the LORD Almighty. I myself am going.'

column.name: text
column.value: And many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to seek the LORD Almighty and to entreat him."

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "In those days ten men from all languages and nations will take firm hold of one Jew by the hem of his robe and say, 'Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you.'" An Oracle

column.name: text
column.value: Ask the LORD for rain in the springtime; it is the LORD who makes the storm clouds. He gives showers of rain to men, and plants of the field to everyone.

column.name: text
column.value: The idols speak deceit, diviners see visions that lie; they tell dreams that are false, they give comfort in vain. Therefore the people wander like sheep oppressed for lack of a shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: "My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; for the LORD Almighty will care for his flock, the house of Judah, and make them like a proud horse in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler.

column.name: text
column.value: Together they will be like mighty men trampling the muddy streets in battle. Because the LORD is with them, they will fight and overthrow the horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: "I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them. They will be as though I had not rejected them, for I am the LORD their God and I will answer them.

column.name: text
column.value: The Ephraimites will become like mighty men, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will signal for them and gather them in. Surely I will redeem them; they will be as numerous as before.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I scatter them among the peoples, yet in distant lands they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will return.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.

column.name: text
column.value: They will pass through the sea of trouble; the surging sea will be subdued and all the depths of the Nile will dry up. Assyria's pride will be brought down and Egypt's scepter will pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: I will strengthen them in the LORD and in his name they will walk," declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Open your doors, O Lebanon, so that fire may devour your cedars!

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, O pine tree, for the cedar has fallen; the stately trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan; the dense forest has been cut down!

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to the wail of the shepherds; their rich pastures are destroyed! Listen to the roar of the lions; the lush thicket of the Jordan is ruined!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD my God says: "Pasture the flock marked for slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, 'Praise the LORD, I am rich!' Their own shepherds do not spare them.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will no longer have pity on the people of the land," declares the LORD. "I will hand everyone over to his neighbor and his king. They will oppress the land, and I will not rescue them from their hands."

column.name: text
column.value: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter, particularly the oppressed of the flock. Then I took two staffs and called one Favor and the other Union, and I pastured the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: In one month I got rid of the three shepherds. The flock detested me, and I grew weary of them

column.name: text
column.value: and said, "I will not be your shepherd. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish. Let those who are left eat one another's flesh."

column.name: text
column.value: Then I took my staff called Favor and broke it, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: It was revoked on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew it was the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I told them, "If you think it best, give me my pay; but if not, keep it." So they paid me thirty pieces of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, "Throw it to the potter"--the handsome price at which they priced me! So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them into the house of the LORD to the potter.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I broke my second staff called Union, breaking the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, "Take again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am going to raise up a shepherd over the land who will not care for the lost, or seek the young, or heal the injured, or feed the healthy, but will eat the meat of the choice sheep, tearing off their hoofs.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered, his right eye totally blinded!" An Oracle

column.name: text
column.value: This is the word of the LORD concerning Israel. The LORD, who stretches out the heavens, who lays the foundation of the earth, and who forms the spirit of man within him, declares:

column.name: text
column.value: "I am going to make Jerusalem a cup that sends all the surrounding peoples reeling. Judah will be besieged as well as Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day, when all the nations of the earth are gathered against her, I will make Jerusalem an immovable rock for all the nations. All who try to move it will injure themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness," declares the LORD. "I will keep a watchful eye over the house of Judah, but I will blind all the horses of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts, 'The people of Jerusalem are strong, because the LORD Almighty is their God.'

column.name: text
column.value: "On that day I will make the leaders of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will consume right and left all the surrounding peoples, but Jerusalem will remain intact in her place.

column.name: text
column.value: "The LORD will save the dwellings of Judah first, so that the honor of the house of David and of Jerusalem's inhabitants may not be greater than that of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the LORD will shield those who live in Jerusalem, so that the feeblest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the Angel of the LORD going before them.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that attack Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: "And I will pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplication. They will look on me, the one they have pierced, and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for a firstborn son.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the weeping in Jerusalem will be great, like the weeping of Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.

column.name: text
column.value: The land will mourn, each clan by itself, with their wives by themselves: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,

column.name: text
column.value: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives,

column.name: text
column.value: and all the rest of the clans and their wives.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD is against the land of Hadrach and will rest upon Damascus--for the eyes of men and all the tribes of Israel are on the LORD--

column.name: text
column.value: and upon Hamath too, which borders on it, and upon Tyre and Sidon, though they are very skillful.

column.name: text
column.value: Tyre has built herself a stronghold; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord will take away her possessions and destroy her power on the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Ashkelon will see it and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, and Ekron too, for her hope will wither. Gaza will lose her king and Ashkelon will be deserted.

column.name: text
column.value: Foreigners will occupy Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: I will take the blood from their mouths, the forbidden food from between their teeth. Those who are left will belong to our God and become leaders in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will defend my house against marauding forces. Never again will an oppressor overrun my people, for now I am keeping watch.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout, Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your king comes to you, righteous and having salvation, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

column.name: text
column.value: I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the war-horses from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be broken. He will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will free your prisoners from the waterless pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Return to your fortress, O prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bend Judah as I bend my bow and fill it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and make you like a warrior's sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD will appear over them; his arrow will flash like lightning. The Sovereign LORD will sound the trumpet; he will march in the storms of the south,

column.name: text
column.value: and the LORD Almighty will shield them. They will destroy and overcome with slingstones. They will drink and roar as with wine; they will be full like a bowl used for sprinkling the corners of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD their God will save them on that day as the flock of his people. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.

column.name: text
column.value: How attractive and beautiful they will be! Grain will make the young men thrive, and new wine the young women.

column.name: text
column.value: "On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

column.name: text
column.value: "On that day, I will banish the names of the idols from the land, and they will be remembered no more," declares the LORD Almighty. "I will remove both the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And if anyone still prophesies, his father and mother, to whom he was born, will say to him, 'You must die, because you have told lies in the LORD'S name.' When he prophesies, his own parents will stab him.

column.name: text
column.value: "On that day every prophet will be ashamed of his prophetic vision. He will not put on a prophet's garment of hair in order to deceive.

column.name: text
column.value: He will say, 'I am not a prophet. I am a farmer; the land has been my livelihood since my youth.'

column.name: text
column.value: If someone asks him, 'What are these wounds on your body?' he will answer, 'The wounds I was given at the house of my friends.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, against the man who is close to me!" declares the LORD Almighty. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

column.name: text
column.value: In the whole land," declares the LORD, "two-thirds will be struck down and perish; yet one-third will be left in it.

column.name: text
column.value: This third I will bring into the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on my name and I will answer them; I will say, 'They are my people,' and they will say, 'The LORD is our God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: A day of the LORD is coming when your plunder will be divided among you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem to fight against it; the city will be captured, the houses ransacked, and the women raped. Half of the city will go into exile, but the rest of the people will not be taken from the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as he fights in the day of battle.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley, with half of the mountain moving north and half moving south.

column.name: text
column.value: You will flee by my mountain valley, for it will extend to Azel. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day there will be no light, no cold or frost.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be a unique day, without daytime or nighttime--a day known to the LORD. When evening comes, there will be light.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half to the eastern sea and half to the western sea, in summer and in winter.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will be king over the whole earth. On that day there will be one LORD, and his name the only name.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole land, from Geba to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem, will become like the Arabah. But Jerusalem will be raised up and remain in its place, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate, to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be inhabited; never again will it be destroyed. Jerusalem will be secure.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the plague with which the LORD will strike all the nations that fought against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day men will be stricken by the LORD with great panic. Each man will seize the hand of another, and they will attack each other.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah too will fight at Jerusalem. The wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected--great quantities of gold and silver and clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: A similar plague will strike the horses and mules, the camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the survivors from all the nations that have attacked Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD Almighty, and to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: If any of the peoples of the earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD Almighty, they will have no rain.

column.name: text
column.value: If the Egyptian people do not go up and take part, they will have no rain. The LORD will bring on them the plague he inflicts on the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day HOLY TO THE LORD will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the LORD'S house will be like the sacred bowls in front of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the LORD Almighty, and all who come to sacrifice will take some of the pots and cook in them. And on that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: An oracle: The word of the LORD to Israel through Malachi.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have loved you," says the LORD. "But you ask, 'How have you loved us?' "Was not Esau Jacob's brother?" the LORD says. "Yet I have loved Jacob,

column.name: text
column.value: but Esau I have hated, and I have turned his mountains into a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals."

column.name: text
column.value: Edom may say, "Though we have been crushed, we will rebuild the ruins." But this is what the LORD Almighty says: "They may build, but I will demolish. They will be called the Wicked Land, a people always under the wrath of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You will see it with your own eyes and say, 'Great is the LORD--even beyond the borders of Israel!'

column.name: text
column.value: "A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, where is the honor due me? If I am a master, where is the respect due me?" says the LORD Almighty. "It is you, O priests, who show contempt for my name. "But you ask, 'How have we shown contempt for your name?'

column.name: text
column.value: "You place defiled food on my altar. "But you ask, 'How have we defiled you?' "By saying that the LORD'S table is contemptible.

column.name: text
column.value: When you bring blind animals for sacrifice, is that not wrong? When you sacrifice crippled or diseased animals, is that not wrong? Try offering them to your governor! Would he be pleased with you? Would he accept you?" says the LORD Almighty.

column.name: text
