column.name: text
column.value: he is not to 'honor his father' with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.

column.name: text
column.value: You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you:

column.name: text
column.value: "'These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.

column.name: text
column.value: They worship me in vain; their teachings are but rules taught by men.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus called the crowd to him and said, "Listen and understand.

column.name: text
column.value: What goes into a man's mouth does not make him 'unclean,' but what comes out of his mouth, that is what makes him 'unclean.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples came to him and asked, "Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?"

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.

column.name: text
column.value: Leave them; they are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said, "Explain the parable to us."

column.name: text
column.value: "Are you still so dull?" Jesus asked them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Don't you see that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then out of the body?

column.name: text
column.value: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these make a man 'unclean.'

column.name: text
column.value: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.

column.name: text
column.value: These are what make a man 'unclean'; but eating with unwashed hands does not make him 'unclean.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.

column.name: text
column.value: A Canaanite woman from that vicinity came to him, crying out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is suffering terribly from demon-possession."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, "Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us."

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: The woman came and knelt before him. "Lord, help me!" she said.

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "It is not right to take the children's bread and toss it to their dogs."

column.name: text
column.value: "Yes, Lord," she said, "but even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus answered, "Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted." And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.

column.name: text
column.value: Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: The people were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, "I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way."

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples answered, "Where could we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a crowd?"

column.name: text
column.value: "How many loaves do you have?" Jesus asked. "Seven," they replied, "and a few small fish."

column.name: text
column.value: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

column.name: text
column.value: The number of those who ate was four thousand, besides women and children.

column.name: text
column.value: After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "When evening comes, you say, 'It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,'

column.name: text
column.value: and in the morning, 'Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.' You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a miraculous sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah." Jesus then left them and went away.

column.name: text
column.value: When they went across the lake, the disciples forgot to take bread.

column.name: text
column.value: "Be careful," Jesus said to them. "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

column.name: text
column.value: They discussed this among themselves and said, "It is because we didn't bring any bread."

column.name: text
column.value: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, "You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you still not understand? Don't you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

column.name: text
column.value: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

column.name: text
column.value: How is it you don't understand that I was not talking to you about bread? But be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say the Son of Man is?"

column.name: text
column.value: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets."

column.name: text
column.value: "But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?"

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by man, but by my Father in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he warned his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. "Never, Lord!" he said. "This shall never happen to you!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus turned and said to Peter, "Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me will find it.

column.name: text
column.value: What good will it be for a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father's glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom."

column.name: text
column.value: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.

column.name: text
column.value: Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters--one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."

column.name: text
column.value: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!"

column.name: text
column.value: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus came and touched them. "Get up," he said. "Don't be afraid."

column.name: text
column.value: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, "Don't tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead."

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples asked him, "Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "To be sure, Elijah comes and will restore all things.

column.name: text
column.value: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him everything they wished. In the same way the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples understood that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to the crowd, a man approached Jesus and knelt before him.

column.name: text
column.value: "Lord, have mercy on my son," he said. "He has seizures and is suffering greatly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

column.name: text
column.value: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him."

column.name: text
column.value: "O unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy here to me."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and asked, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "Because you have so little faith. I tell you the truth, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you."

column.name: text
column.value: When they came together in Galilee, he said to them, "The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men.

column.name: text
column.value: They will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised to life." And the disciples were filled with grief.

column.name: text
column.value: After Jesus and his disciples arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, "Doesn't your teacher pay the temple tax?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Yes, he does," he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. "What do you think, Simon?" he asked. "From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes--from their own sons or from others?"

column.name: text
column.value: "From others," Peter answered. "Then the sons are exempt," Jesus said to him.

column.name: text
column.value: "But so that we may not offend them, go to the lake and throw out your line. Take the first fish you catch; open its mouth and you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for my tax and yours."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went into the region of Judea to the other side of the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.

column.name: text
column.value: Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Haven't you read," he replied, "that at the beginning the Creator 'made them male and female,'

column.name: text
column.value: and said, 'For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh'?

column.name: text
column.value: So they are no longer two, but one. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate."

column.name: text
column.value: "Why then," they asked, "did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not this way from the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for marital unfaithfulness, and marries another woman commits adultery."

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples said to him, "If this is the situation between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "Not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.

column.name: text
column.value: For some are eunuchs because they were born that way; others were made that way by men; and others have renounced marriage because of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it."

column.name: text
column.value: Then little children were brought to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these."

column.name: text
column.value: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a man came up to Jesus and asked, "Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Why do you ask me about what is good?" Jesus replied. "There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, obey the commandments."

column.name: text
column.value: "Which ones?" the man inquired. Jesus replied, "'Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not give false testimony,

column.name: text
column.value: honor your father and mother,' and 'love your neighbor as yourself.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "All these I have kept," the young man said. "What do I still lack?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

column.name: text
column.value: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "I tell you the truth, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."

column.name: text
column.value: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, "Who then can be saved?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus looked at them and said, "With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter answered him, "We have left everything to follow you! What then will there be for us?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"

column.name: text
column.value: He called a little child and had him stand among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said: "I tell you the truth, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: "And whoever welcomes a little child like this in my name welcomes me.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to sin! Such things must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!

column.name: text
column.value: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life maimed or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into eternal fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

column.name: text
column.value: "See that you do not look down on one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: "What do you think? If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?

column.name: text
column.value: And if he finds it, I tell you the truth, he is happier about that one sheep than about the ninety-nine that did not wander off.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should be lost.

column.name: text
column.value: "If your brother sins against you, go and show him his fault, just between the two of you. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that 'every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.'

column.name: text
column.value: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church; and if he refuses to listen even to the church, treat him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: "Again, I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by my Father in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: For where two or three come together in my name, there am I with them."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother when he sins against me? Up to seven times?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand talents was brought to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Since he was not able to pay, the master ordered that he and his wife and his children and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.

column.name: text
column.value: "The servant fell on his knees before him. 'Be patient with me,' he begged, 'and I will pay back everything.'

column.name: text
column.value: The servant's master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.

column.name: text
column.value: "But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him. 'Pay back what you owe me!' he demanded.

column.name: text
column.value: "His fellow servant fell to his knees and begged him, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you back.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.

column.name: text
column.value: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed and went and told their master everything that had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the master called the servant in. 'You wicked servant,' he said, 'I canceled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.

column.name: text
column.value: Shouldn't you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?'

column.name: text
column.value: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should pay back all he owed.

column.name: text
column.value: "This is how my heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart."

column.name: text
column.value: "For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire men to work in his vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: "About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: He told them, 'You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.'

column.name: text
column.value: So they went. "He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.

column.name: text
column.value: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, 'Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?'

column.name: text
column.value: "'Because no one has hired us,' they answered. "He said to them, 'You also go and work in my vineyard.'

column.name: text
column.value: "When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, 'Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first.'

column.name: text
column.value: "The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.

column.name: text
column.value: So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.

column.name: text
column.value: When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.

column.name: text
column.value: 'These men who were hired last worked only one hour,' they said, 'and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the work and the heat of the day.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But he answered one of them, 'Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Didn't you agree to work for a denarius?

column.name: text
column.value: Take your pay and go. I want to give the man who was hired last the same as I gave you.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?'

column.name: text
column.value: "So the last will be first, and the first will be last."

column.name: text
column.value: Now as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside and said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: "We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death

column.name: text
column.value: and will turn him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the mother of Zebedee's sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.

column.name: text
column.value: "What is it you want?" he asked. She said, "Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom."

column.name: text
column.value: "You don't know what you are asking," Jesus said to them. "Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?" "We can," they answered.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father."

column.name: text
column.value: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave--

column.name: text
column.value: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

column.name: text
column.value: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus stopped and called them. "What do you want me to do for you?" he asked.

column.name: text
column.value: "Lord," they answered, "we want our sight."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: "The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then he sent some more servants and said, 'Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner: My oxen and fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But they paid no attention and went off--one to his field, another to his business.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.

column.name: text
column.value: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.'

column.name: text
column.value: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, both good and bad, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

column.name: text
column.value: "But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: 'Friend,' he asked, 'how did you get in here without wedding clothes?' The man was speechless.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the king told the attendants, 'Tie him hand and foot, and throw him outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

column.name: text
column.value: "For many are invited, but few are chosen."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.

column.name: text
column.value: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren't swayed by men, because you pay no attention to who they are.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, "You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?

column.name: text
column.value: Show me the coin used for paying the tax." They brought him a denarius,

column.name: text
column.value: and he asked them, "Whose portrait is this? And whose inscription?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Caesar's," they replied. Then he said to them, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.

column.name: text
column.value: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

column.name: text
column.value: "Teacher," they said, "Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and have children for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, the woman died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.

column.name: text
column.value: At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But about the resurrection of the dead--have you not read what God said to you,

column.name: text
column.value: 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'? He is not the God of the dead but of the living."

column.name: text
column.value: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.

column.name: text
column.value: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:

column.name: text
column.value: "Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied: "'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.'

column.name: text
column.value: This is the first and greatest commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second is like it: 'Love your neighbor as yourself.'

column.name: text
column.value: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments."

column.name: text
column.value: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

column.name: text
column.value: "What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?" "The son of David," they replied.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him 'Lord'? For he says,

column.name: text
column.value: "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet." '

column.name: text
column.value: If then David calls him 'Lord,' how can he be his son?"

column.name: text
column.value: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:

column.name: text
column.value: "The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat.

column.name: text
column.value: So you must obey them and do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.

column.name: text
column.value: They tie up heavy loads and put them on men's shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Everything they do is done for men to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;

column.name: text
column.value: they love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues;

column.name: text
column.value: they love to be greeted in the marketplaces and to have men call them 'Rabbi.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But you are not to be called 'Rabbi,' for you have only one Master and you are all brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not call anyone on earth 'father,' for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Nor are you to be called 'teacher,' for you have one Teacher, the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: The greatest among you will be your servant.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men's faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, blind guides! You say, 'If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.'

column.name: text
column.value: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?

column.name: text
column.value: You also say, 'If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.'

column.name: text
column.value: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he who swears by heaven swears by God's throne and by the one who sits on it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices--mint, dill and cummin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law--justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.

column.name: text
column.value: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.

column.name: text
column.value: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men's bones and everything unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: And you say, 'If we had lived in the days of our forefathers, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.'

column.name: text
column.value: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your forefathers!

column.name: text
column.value: "You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.

column.name: text
column.value: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, all this will come upon this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing.

column.name: text
column.value: Look, your house is left to you desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do you see all these things?" he asked. "I tell you the truth, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down."

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. "Tell us," they said, "when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered: "Watch out that no one deceives you.

column.name: text
column.value: For many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am the Christ,' and will deceive many.

column.name: text
column.value: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

column.name: text
column.value: All these are the beginning of birth pains.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,

column.name: text
column.value: and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,

column.name: text
column.value: but he who stands firm to the end will be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

column.name: text
column.value: "So when you see standing in the holy place 'the abomination that causes desolation,' spoken of through the prophet Daniel--let the reader understand--

column.name: text
column.value: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no one on the roof of his house go down to take anything out of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no one in the field go back to get his cloak.

column.name: text
column.value: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!

column.name: text
column.value: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now--and never to be equaled again.

column.name: text
column.value: If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'There he is!' do not believe it.

column.name: text
column.value: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and miracles to deceive even the elect--if that were possible.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have told you ahead of time.

column.name: text
column.value: "So if anyone tells you, 'There he is, out in the desert,' do not go out; or, 'Here he is, in the inner rooms,' do not believe it.

column.name: text
column.value: For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.

column.name: text
column.value: "Immediately after the distress of those days "'the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.'

column.name: text
column.value: "At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and all the nations of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky, with power and great glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: "No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;

column.name: text
column.value: and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.

column.name: text
column.value: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.

column.name: text
column.value: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.

column.name: text
column.value: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.

column.name: text
column.value: "Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?

column.name: text
column.value: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, 'My master is staying away a long time,'

column.name: text
column.value: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.

column.name: text
column.value: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.

column.name: text
column.value: He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: "At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

column.name: text
column.value: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.

column.name: text
column.value: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: "At midnight the cry rang out: 'Here's the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: The foolish ones said to the wise, 'Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.'

column.name: text
column.value: "'No,' they replied, 'there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.

column.name: text
column.value: "Later the others also came. 'Sir! Sir!' they said. 'Open the door for us!'

column.name: text
column.value: "But he replied, 'I tell you the truth, I don't know you.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.

column.name: text
column.value: "Again, it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his property to them.

column.name: text
column.value: To one he gave five talents of money, to another two talents, and to another one talent, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who had received the five talents went at once and put his money to work and gained five more.

column.name: text
column.value: So also, the one with the two talents gained two more.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master's money.

column.name: text
column.value: "After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who had received the five talents brought the other five. 'Master,' he said, 'you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more.'

column.name: text
column.value: "His master replied, 'Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!'

column.name: text
column.value: "The man with the two talents also came. 'Master,' he said, 'you entrusted me with two talents; see, I have gained two more.'

column.name: text
column.value: "His master replied, 'Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the man who had received the one talent came. 'Master,' he said, 'I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.

column.name: text
column.value: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.'

column.name: text
column.value: "His master replied, 'You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?

column.name: text
column.value: Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.

column.name: text
column.value: "'Take the talent from him and give it to the one who has the ten talents.

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

column.name: text
column.value: "When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his throne in heavenly glory.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

column.name: text
column.value: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the King will say to those on his right, 'Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,

column.name: text
column.value: I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the righteous will answer him, 'Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?

column.name: text
column.value: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?

column.name: text
column.value: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?'

column.name: text
column.value: "The King will reply, 'I tell you the truth, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did for me.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then he will say to those on his left, 'Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

column.name: text
column.value: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,

column.name: text
column.value: I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.'

column.name: text
column.value: "They also will answer, 'Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?'

column.name: text
column.value: "He will reply, 'I tell you the truth, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: "As you know, the Passover is two days away--and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,

column.name: text
column.value: and they plotted to arrest Jesus in some sly way and kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: "But not during the Feast," they said, "or there may be a riot among the people."

column.name: text
column.value: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of a man known as Simon the Leper,

column.name: text
column.value: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, which she poured on his head as he was reclining at the table.

column.name: text
column.value: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. "Why this waste?" they asked.

column.name: text
column.value: "This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor."

column.name: text
column.value: Aware of this, Jesus said to them, "Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

column.name: text
column.value: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have me.

column.name: text
column.value: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her."

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the Twelve--the one called Judas Iscariot--went to the chief priests

column.name: text
column.value: and asked, "What are you willing to give me if I hand him over to you?" So they counted out for him thirty silver coins.

column.name: text
column.value: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Where do you want us to make preparations for you to eat the Passover?"

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, 'The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And while they were eating, he said, "I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me."

column.name: text
column.value: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, "Surely not I, Lord?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, "Surely not I, Rabbi?" Jesus answered, "Yes, it is you."

column.name: text
column.value: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to his disciples, saying, "Take and eat; this is my body."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the cup, gave thanks and offered it to them, saying, "Drink from it, all of you.

column.name: text
column.value: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father's kingdom."

column.name: text
column.value: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus told them, "This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: "'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

column.name: text
column.value: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter replied, "Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will."

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth," Jesus answered, "this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times."

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter declared, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the other disciples said the same.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, "Sit here while I go over there and pray."

column.name: text
column.value: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me."

column.name: text
column.value: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, "My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. "Could you men not keep watch with me for one hour?" he asked Peter.

column.name: text
column.value: "Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak."

column.name: text
column.value: He went away a second time and prayed, "My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done."

column.name: text
column.value: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.

column.name: text
column.value: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise, let us go! Here comes my betrayer!"

column.name: text
column.value: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: "The one I kiss is the man; arrest him."

column.name: text
column.value: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "Friend, do what you came for."Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.

column.name: text
column.value: With that, one of Jesus' companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

column.name: text
column.value: "Put your sword back in its place," Jesus said to him, "for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

column.name: text
column.value: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?"

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, "Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.

column.name: text
column.value: But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled." Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas, the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward

column.name: text
column.value: and declared, "This fellow said, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, "I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Christ, the Son of God."

column.name: text
column.value: "Yes, it is as you say," Jesus replied. "But I say to all of you: In the future you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, "He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.

column.name: text
column.value: What do you think?" "He is worthy of death," they answered.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they spit in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him

column.name: text
column.value: and said, "Prophesy to us, Christ. Who hit you?"

column.name: text
column.value: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. "You also were with Jesus of Galilee," she said.

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied it before them all. "I don't know what you're talking about," he said.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went out to the gateway, where another girl saw him and said to the people there, "This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth."

column.name: text
column.value: He denied it again, with an oath: "I don't know the man!"

column.name: text
column.value: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, "Surely you are one of them, for your accent gives you away."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he began to call down curses on himself and he swore to them, "I don't know the man!" Immediately a rooster crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: "Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times." And he went outside and wept bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people came to the decision to put Jesus to death.

column.name: text
column.value: They bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate, the governor.

column.name: text
column.value: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was seized with remorse and returned the thirty silver coins to the chief priests and the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have sinned," he said, "for I have betrayed innocent blood." "What is that to us?" they replied. "That's your responsibility."

column.name: text
column.value: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, "It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money."

column.name: text
column.value: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter's field as a burial place for foreigners.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: "They took the thirty silver coins, the price set on him by the people of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: and they used them to buy the potter's field, as the Lord commanded me."

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?" "Yes, it is as you say," Jesus replied.

column.name: text
column.value: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pilate asked him, "Don't you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?"

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge--to the great amazement of the governor.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was the governor's custom at the Feast to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time they had a notorious prisoner, called Barabbas.

column.name: text
column.value: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"

column.name: text
column.value: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.

column.name: text
column.value: While Pilate was sitting on the judge's seat, his wife sent him this message: "Don't have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him."

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.

column.name: text
column.value: "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" asked the governor. "Barabbas," they answered.

column.name: text
column.value: "What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called Christ?" Pilate asked. They all answered, "Crucify him!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"

column.name: text
column.value: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. "I am innocent of this man's blood," he said. "It is your responsibility!"

column.name: text
column.value: All the people answered, "Let his blood be on us and on our children!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.

column.name: text
column.value: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,

column.name: text
column.value: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand and knelt in front of him and mocked him. "Hail, king of the Jews!" they said.

column.name: text
column.value: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.

column.name: text
column.value: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.

column.name: text
column.value: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

column.name: text
column.value: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means The Place of the Skull).

column.name: text
column.value: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

column.name: text
column.value: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.

column.name: text
column.value: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

column.name: text
column.value: Two robbers were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, "You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!"

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.

column.name: text
column.value: "He saved others," they said, "but he can't save himself! He's the King of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.

column.name: text
column.value: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, 'I am the Son of God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way the robbers who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.

column.name: text
column.value: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?"--which means, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

column.name: text
column.value: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "He's calling Elijah."

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a stick, and offered it to Jesus to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest said, "Now leave him alone. Let's see if Elijah comes to save him."

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook and the rocks split.

column.name: text
column.value: The tombs broke open and the bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.

column.name: text
column.value: They came out of the tombs, and after Jesus' resurrection they went into the holy city and appeared to many people.

column.name: text
column.value: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, "Surely he was the Son of God!"

column.name: text
column.value: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.

column.name: text
column.value: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.

column.name: text
column.value: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus' body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

column.name: text
column.value: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

column.name: text
column.value: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: "Sir," they said, "we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, 'After three days I will rise again.'

column.name: text
column.value: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first."

column.name: text
column.value: "Take a guard," Pilate answered. "Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how."

column.name: text
column.value: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.

column.name: text
column.value: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.

column.name: text
column.value: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

column.name: text
column.value: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.

column.name: text
column.value: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: 'He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.' Now I have told you."

column.name: text
column.value: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Suddenly Jesus met them. "Greetings," he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me."

column.name: text
column.value: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,

column.name: text
column.value: telling them, "You are to say, 'His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.'

column.name: text
column.value: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."

column.name: text
column.value: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

column.name: text
column.value: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age."

column.name: text
column.value: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.

column.name: text
column.value: So many gathered that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Some men came, bringing to him a paralytic, carried by four of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus and, after digging through it, lowered the mat the paralyzed man was lying on.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven."

column.name: text
column.value: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,

column.name: text
column.value: "Why does this fellow talk like that? He's blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this was what they were thinking in their hearts, and he said to them, "Why are you thinking these things?

column.name: text
column.value: Which is easier: to say to the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up, take your mat and walk'?

column.name: text
column.value: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins. . . ." He said to the paralytic,

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home."

column.name: text
column.value: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, "We have never seen anything like this!"

column.name: text
column.value: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.

column.name: text
column.value: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collector's booth. "Follow me," Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: While Jesus was having dinner at Levi's house, many tax collectors and "sinners" were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the "sinners" and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: "Why does he eat with tax collectors and 'sinners'?"

column.name: text
column.value: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners."

column.name: text
column.value: Now John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, "How is it that John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.

column.name: text
column.value: "No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.

column.name: text
column.value: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, he pours new wine into new wineskins."

column.name: text
column.value: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees said to him, "Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?

column.name: text
column.value: In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath."

column.name: text
column.value: The beginning of the gospel about Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: It is written in Isaiah the prophet: "I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way"--

column.name: text
column.value: "a voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.'"

column.name: text
column.value: And so John came, baptizing in the desert region and preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

column.name: text
