column.value: "We heard him say, 'I will destroy this man-made temple and in three days will build another, not made by man.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, "Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?"

column.name: text
column.value: "I am," said Jesus. "And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven."

column.name: text
column.value: The high priest tore his clothes. "Why do we need any more witnesses?" he asked.

column.name: text
column.value: "You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?" They all condemned him as worthy of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, "Prophesy!" And the guards took him and beat him.

column.name: text
column.value: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.

column.name: text
column.value: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. "You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus," she said.

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied it. "I don't know or understand what you're talking about," he said, and went out into the entryway.

column.name: text
column.value: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, "This fellow is one of them."

column.name: text
column.value: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, "Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean."

column.name: text
column.value: He began to call down curses on himself, and he swore to them, "I don't know this man you're talking about."

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken to him: "Before the rooster crows twice you will disown me three times." And he broke down and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: As he was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Do you see all these great buildings?" replied Jesus. "Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down."

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately,

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them: "Watch out that no one deceives you.

column.name: text
column.value: Many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am he,' and will deceive many.

column.name: text
column.value: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.

column.name: text
column.value: "You must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given you at the time, for it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: "Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: All men will hate you because of me, but he who stands firm to the end will be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: "When you see 'the abomination that causes desolation' standing where it does not belong--let the reader understand--then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no one on the roof of his house go down or enter the house to take anything out.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no one in the field go back to get his cloak.

column.name: text
column.value: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!

column.name: text
column.value: Pray that this will not take place in winter,

column.name: text
column.value: because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now--and never to be equaled again.

column.name: text
column.value: If the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there he is!' do not believe it.

column.name: text
column.value: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and miracles to deceive the elect--if that were possible.

column.name: text
column.value: So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.

column.name: text
column.value: "But in those days, following that distress, "'the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;

column.name: text
column.value: the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.'

column.name: text
column.value: "At that time men will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, right at the door.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: "No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Be on guard! Be alert! You do not know when that time will come.

column.name: text
column.value: It's like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with his assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back--whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.

column.name: text
column.value: If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.

column.name: text
column.value: What I say to you, I say to everyone: 'Watch!'"

column.name: text
column.value: In those days Caesar Augustus issued a decree that a census should be taken of the entire Roman world.

column.name: text
column.value: (This was the first census that took place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.)

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone went to his own town to register.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to Bethlehem the town of David, because he belonged to the house and line of David.

column.name: text
column.value: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him and was expecting a child.

column.name: text
column.value: While they were there, the time came for the baby to be born,

column.name: text
column.value: and she gave birth to her firstborn, a son. She wrapped him in cloths and placed him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were shepherds living out in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks at night.

column.name: text
column.value: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid. I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is Christ the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: This will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger."

column.name: text
column.value: Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host appeared with the angel, praising God and saying,

column.name: text
column.value: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom his favor rests."

column.name: text
column.value: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, "Let's go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about."

column.name: text
column.value: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby, who was lying in the manger.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had seen him, they spread the word concerning what had been told them about this child,

column.name: text
column.value: and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, which were just as they had been told.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day, when it was time to circumcise him, he was named Jesus, the name the angel had given him before he had been conceived.

column.name: text
column.value: When the time of their purification according to the Law of Moses had been completed, Joseph and Mary took him to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord, "Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the Lord"),

column.name: text
column.value: and to offer a sacrifice in keeping with what is said in the Law of the Lord: "a pair of doves or two young pigeons."

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a man in Jerusalem called Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not die before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Moved by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. When the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for him what the custom of the Law required,

column.name: text
column.value: Simeon took him in his arms and praised God, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: "Sovereign Lord, as you have promised, you now dismiss your servant in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: For my eyes have seen your salvation,

column.name: text
column.value: which you have prepared in the sight of all people,

column.name: text
column.value: a light for revelation to the Gentiles and for glory to your people Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: The child's father and mother marveled at what was said about him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother: "This child is destined to cause the falling and rising of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,

column.name: text
column.value: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed. And a sword will pierce your own soul too."

column.name: text
column.value: There was also a prophetess, Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was very old; she had lived with her husband seven years after her marriage,

column.name: text
column.value: and then was a widow until she was eighty-four. She never left the temple but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.

column.name: text
column.value: Coming up to them at that very moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the child to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: When Joseph and Mary had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee to their own town of Nazareth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: Every year his parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: When he was twelve years old, they went up to the Feast, according to the custom.

column.name: text
column.value: After the Feast was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but they were unaware of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends.

column.name: text
column.value: When they did not find him, they went back to Jerusalem to look for him.

column.name: text
column.value: After three days they found him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers.

column.name: text
column.value: When his parents saw him, they were astonished. His mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for you."

column.name: text
column.value: "Why were you searching for me?" he asked. "Didn't you know I had to be in my Father's house?"

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

column.name: text
column.value: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,

column.name: text
column.value: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

column.name: text
column.value: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah; his wife Elizabeth was also a descendant of Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: Both of them were upright in the sight of God, observing all the Lord's commandments and regulations blamelessly.

column.name: text
column.value: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren; and they were both well along in years.

column.name: text
column.value: Once when Zechariah's division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,

column.name: text
column.value: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.

column.name: text
column.value: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

column.name: text
column.value: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel said to him: "Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,

column.name: text
column.value: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from birth.

column.name: text
column.value: Many of the people of Israel will he bring back to the Lord their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will go on before the Lord, in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous--to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."

column.name: text
column.value: Zechariah asked the angel, "How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years."

column.name: text
column.value: The angel answered, "I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news.

column.name: text
column.value: And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their proper time."

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

column.name: text
column.value: When his time of service was completed, he returned home.

column.name: text
column.value: After this his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion.

column.name: text
column.value: "The Lord has done this for me," she said. "In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people."

column.name: text
column.value: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a town in Galilee,

column.name: text
column.value: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named Joseph, a descendant of David. The virgin's name was Mary.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel went to her and said, "Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you."

column.name: text
column.value: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, you have found favor with God.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be with child and give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

column.name: text
column.value: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever; his kingdom will never end."

column.name: text
column.value: "How will this be," Mary asked the angel, "since I am a virgin?"

column.name: text
column.value: The angel answered, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Even Elizabeth your relative is going to have a child in her old age, and she who was said to be barren is in her sixth month.

column.name: text
column.value: For nothing is impossible with God."

column.name: text
column.value: "I am the Lord's servant," Mary answered. "May it be to me as you have said." Then the angel left her.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea,

column.name: text
column.value: where she entered Zechariah's home and greeted Elizabeth.

column.name: text
column.value: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: In a loud voice she exclaimed: "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear!

column.name: text
column.value: But why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is she who has believed that what the Lord has said to her will be accomplished!"

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary said: "My soul glorifies the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior,

column.name: text
column.value: for he has been mindful of the humble state of his servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed,

column.name: text
column.value: for the Mighty One has done great things for me--holy is his name.

column.name: text
column.value: His mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.

column.name: text
column.value: He has brought down rulers from their thrones but has lifted up the humble.

column.name: text
column.value: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.

column.name: text
column.value: He has helped his servant Israel, remembering to be merciful

column.name: text
column.value: to Abraham and his descendants forever, even as he said to our fathers."

column.name: text
column.value: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.

column.name: text
column.value: When it was time for Elizabeth to have her baby, she gave birth to a son.

column.name: text
column.value: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they shared her joy.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him after his father Zechariah,

column.name: text
column.value: but his mother spoke up and said, "No! He is to be called John."

column.name: text
column.value: They said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who has that name."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the child.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone's astonishment he wrote, "His name is John."

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue was loosed, and he began to speak, praising God.

column.name: text
column.value: The neighbors were all filled with awe, and throughout the hill country of Judea people were talking about all these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, "What then is this child going to be?" For the Lord's hand was with him.

column.name: text
column.value: His father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:

column.name: text
column.value: "Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has come and has redeemed his people.

column.name: text
column.value: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

column.name: text
column.value: (as he said through his holy prophets of long ago),

column.name: text
column.value: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us--

column.name: text
column.value: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember his holy covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: the oath he swore to our father Abraham:

column.name: text
column.value: to rescue us from the hand of our enemies, and to enable us to serve him without fear

column.name: text
column.value: in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him,

column.name: text
column.value: to give his people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,

column.name: text
column.value: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven

column.name: text
column.value: to shine on those living in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace."

column.name: text
column.value: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the desert until he appeared publicly to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar--when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene--

column.name: text
column.value: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: As is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Every valley shall be filled in, every mountain and hill made low. The crooked roads shall become straight, the rough ways smooth.

column.name: text
column.value: And all mankind will see God's salvation.'"

column.name: text
column.value: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

column.name: text
column.value: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."

column.name: text
column.value: "What should we do then?" the crowd asked.

column.name: text
column.value: John answered, "The man with two tunics should share with him who has none, and the one who has food should do the same."

column.name: text
column.value: Tax collectors also came to be baptized. "Teacher," they asked, "what should we do?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Don't collect any more than you are required to," he told them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then some soldiers asked him, "And what should we do?" He replied, "Don't extort money and don't accuse people falsely--be content with your pay."

column.name: text
column.value: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: John answered them all, "I baptize you with water. But one more powerful than I will come, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."

column.name: text
column.value: And with many other words John exhorted the people and preached the good news to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of Herodias, his brother's wife, and all the other evil things he had done,

column.name: text
column.value: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.

column.name: text
column.value: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened

column.name: text
column.value: and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melki, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Melki, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Amminadab, the son of Ram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Kenan,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit in the desert,

column.name: text
column.value: where for forty days he was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Man does not live on bread alone.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, "I will give you all their authority and splendor, for it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to.

column.name: text
column.value: So if you worship me, it will all be yours."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.'"

column.name: text
column.value: The devil led him to Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple. "If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down from here.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written: "'He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully;

column.name: text
column.value: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "It says: 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test.'"

column.name: text
column.value: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside.

column.name: text
column.value: He taught in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

column.name: text
column.value: He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. And he stood up to read.

column.name: text
column.value: The scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:

column.name: text
column.value: "The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to release the oppressed,

column.name: text
column.value: to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him,

column.name: text
column.value: and he began by saying to them, "Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing."

column.name: text
column.value: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. "Isn't this Joseph's son?" they asked.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "Surely you will quote this proverb to me: 'Physician, heal yourself! Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth," he continued, "no prophet is accepted in his hometown.

column.name: text
column.value: I assure you that there were many widows in Israel in Elijah's time, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were many in Israel with leprosy in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed--only Naaman the Syrian."

column.name: text
column.value: All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this.

column.name: text
column.value: They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him down the cliff.

column.name: text
column.value: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath began to teach the people.

column.name: text
column.value: They were amazed at his teaching, because his message had authority.

column.name: text
column.value: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an evil spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,

column.name: text
column.value: "Ha! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are--the Holy One of God!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Be quiet!" Jesus said sternly. "Come out of him!" Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.

column.name: text
column.value: All the people were amazed and said to each other, "What is this teaching? With authority and power he gives orders to evil spirits and they come out!"

column.name: text
column.value: And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon's mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.

column.name: text
column.value: So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.

column.name: text
column.value: When the sun was setting, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: At daybreak Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, "I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent."

column.name: text
column.value: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.

column.name: text
column.value: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, with the people crowding around him and listening to the word of God,

column.name: text
column.value: he saw at the water's edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.

column.name: text
column.value: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch."

column.name: text
column.value: Simon answered, "Master, we've worked hard all night and haven't caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets."

column.name: text
column.value: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.

column.name: text
column.value: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

column.name: text
column.value: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus' knees and said, "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"

column.name: text
column.value: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,

column.name: text
column.value: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon's partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, "Don't be afraid; from now on you will catch men."

column.name: text
column.value: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" And immediately the leprosy left him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus ordered him, "Don't tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them."

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.

column.name: text
column.value: One day as he was teaching, Pharisees and teachers of the law, who had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem, were sitting there. And the power of the Lord was present for him to heal the sick.

column.name: text
column.value: Some men came carrying a paralytic on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When they could not find a way to do this because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, "Friend, your sins are forgiven."

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, "Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, "Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?

column.name: text
column.value: Which is easier: to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up and walk'?

column.name: text
column.value: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins. . . ." He said to the paralyzed man, "I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home."

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, "We have seen remarkable things today."

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. "Follow me," Jesus said to him,

column.name: text
column.value: and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and 'sinners'?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

column.name: text
column.value: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

column.name: text
column.value: They said to him, "John's disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?

column.name: text
column.value: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast."

column.name: text
column.value: He told them this parable: "No one tears a patch from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If he does, he will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.

column.name: text
column.value: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.

column.name: text
column.value: No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.

column.name: text
column.value: And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for he says, 'The old is better.'"

column.name: text
column.value: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus' body.

column.name: text
column.value: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb

column.name: text
column.value: and they asked each other, "Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?"

column.name: text
column.value: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.

column.name: text
column.value: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.

column.name: text
column.value: "Don't be alarmed," he said. "You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.

column.name: text
column.value: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: The most reliable early manuscripts and other ancient witnesses do not have Mark 16:9-20. When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.

column.name: text
column.value: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.

column.name: text
column.value: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.

column.name: text
column.value: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the good news to all creation.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;

column.name: text
column.value: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well."

column.name: text
column.value: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.

column.name: text
column.value: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the Pharisees asked, "Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

column.name: text
column.value: He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

column.name: text
column.value: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, "Get up and stand in front of everyone." So he got up and stood there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, "I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?"

column.name: text
column.value: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He did so, and his hand was completely restored.

column.name: text
column.value: But they were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.

column.name: text
column.value: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:

column.name: text
column.value: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,

column.name: text
column.value: Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,

column.name: text
column.value: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

column.name: text
column.value: He went down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coast of Tyre and Sidon,

column.name: text
column.value: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by evil spirits were cured,

column.name: text
column.value: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.

column.name: text
column.value: Looking at his disciples, he said: "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are you when men hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: "Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their fathers treated the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: "But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will go hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, for that is how their fathers treated the false prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: "But I tell you who hear me: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

column.name: text
column.value: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.

column.name: text
column.value: If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also. If someone takes your cloak, do not stop him from taking your tunic.

column.name: text
column.value: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.

column.name: text
column.value: Do to others as you would have them do to you.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' love those who love them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' do that.

column.name: text
column.value: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' lend to 'sinners,' expecting to be repaid in full.

column.name: text
column.value: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you."

column.name: text
column.value: He also told them this parable: "Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?

column.name: text
column.value: A student is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.

column.name: text
column.value: "Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?

column.name: text
column.value: How can you say to your brother, 'Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,' when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother's eye.

column.name: text
column.value: "No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.

column.name: text
column.value: The good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For out of the overflow of his heart his mouth speaks.

column.name: text
column.value: "Why do you call me, 'Lord, Lord,' and do not do what I say?

column.name: text
column.value: I will show you what he is like who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice.

column.name: text
column.value: He is like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished saying all this in the hearing of the people, he entered Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: There a centurion's servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.

column.name: text
column.value: The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with him, "This man deserves to have you do this,

column.name: text
column.value: because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue."

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus went with them. He was not far from the house when the centurion sent friends to say to him: "Lord, don't trouble yourself, for I do not deserve to have you come under my roof.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and that one, 'Come,' and he comes. I say to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following him, he said, "I tell you, I have not found such great faith even in Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.

column.name: text
column.value: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.

column.name: text
column.value: As he approached the town gate, a dead person was being carried out--the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Lord saw her, his heart went out to her and he said, "Don't cry."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went up and touched the coffin, and those carrying it stood still. He said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!"

column.name: text
column.value: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: They were all filled with awe and praised God. "A great prophet has appeared among us," they said. "God has come to help his people."

column.name: text
column.value: This news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding country.

column.name: text
column.value: John's disciples told him about all these things. Calling two of them,

column.name: text
column.value: he sent them to the Lord to ask, "Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?"

column.name: text
column.value: When the men came to Jesus, they said, "John the Baptist sent us to you to ask, 'Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?'"

column.name: text
column.value: At that very time Jesus cured many who had diseases, sicknesses and evil spirits, and gave sight to many who were blind.

column.name: text
column.value: So he replied to the messengers, "Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who does not fall away on account of me."

column.name: text
column.value: After John's messengers left, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: "What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed swayed by the wind?

column.name: text
column.value: If not, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? No, those who wear expensive clothes and indulge in luxury are in palaces.

column.name: text
column.value: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the one about whom it is written: "'I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.'

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."

column.name: text
column.value: (All the people, even the tax collectors, when they heard Jesus' words, acknowledged that God's way was right, because they had been baptized by John.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees and experts in the law rejected God's purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.)

column.name: text
column.value: "To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

column.name: text
column.value: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other: "'We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not cry.'

column.name: text
column.value: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, 'Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and "sinners." '

column.name: text
column.value: But wisdom is proved right by all her children."

column.name: text
column.value: Now one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, so he went to the Pharisee's house and reclined at the table.

column.name: text
column.value: When a woman who had lived a sinful life in that town learned that Jesus was eating at the Pharisee's house, she brought an alabaster jar of perfume,

column.name: text
column.value: and as she stood behind him at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears. Then she wiped them with her hair, kissed them and poured perfume on them.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know who is touching him and what kind of woman she is--that she is a sinner."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, "Simon, I have something to tell you." "Tell me, teacher," he said.

column.name: text
column.value: "Two men owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he canceled the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"

column.name: text
column.value: Simon replied, "I suppose the one who had the bigger debt canceled." "You have judged correctly," Jesus said.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

column.name: text
column.value: You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven--for she loved much. But he who has been forgiven little loves little."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."

column.name: text
column.value: The other guests began to say among themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,

column.name: text
column.value: and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;

column.name: text
column.value: Joanna the wife of Cuza, the manager of Herod's household; Susanna; and many others. These women were helping to support them out of their own means.

column.name: text
column.value: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:

column.name: text
column.value: "A farmer went out to sow his seed. As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds of the air ate it up.

column.name: text
column.value: Some fell on rock, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.

column.name: text
column.value: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.

column.name: text
column.value: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up and yielded a crop, a hundred times more than was sown." When he said this, he called out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, "The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, "'though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.'

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Those on the rock are the ones who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, but in the time of testing they fall away.

column.name: text
column.value: The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life's worries, riches and pleasures, and they do not mature.

column.name: text
column.value: But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.

column.name: text
column.value: "No one lights a lamp and hides it in a jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, he puts it on a stand, so that those who come in can see the light.

column.name: text
column.value: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken from him."

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus' mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you."

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "My mother and brothers are those who hear God's word and put it into practice."

column.name: text
column.value: One day Jesus said to his disciples, "Let's go over to the other side of the lake." So they got into a boat and set out.

column.name: text
column.value: As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we're going to drown!" He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.

column.name: text
column.value: "Where is your faith?" he asked his disciples. In fear and amazement they asked one another, "Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him."

column.name: text
column.value: They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothes or lived in a house, but had lived in the tombs.

column.name: text
column.value: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell at his feet, shouting at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don't torture me!"

column.name: text
column.value: For Jesus had commanded the evil spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was chained hand and foot and kept under guard, he had broken his chains and had been driven by the demon into solitary places.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" "Legion," he replied, because many demons had gone into him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they begged him repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.

column.name: text
column.value: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. The demons begged Jesus to let them go into them, and he gave them permission.

column.name: text
column.value: When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.

column.name: text
column.value: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside,

column.name: text
column.value: and the people went out to see what had happened. When they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus' feet, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them, because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.

column.name: text
column.value: The man from whom the demons had gone out begged to go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: "Return home and tell how much God has done for you." So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus returned, a crowd welcomed him, for they were all expecting him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a man named Jairus, a ruler of the synagogue, came and fell at Jesus' feet, pleading with him to come to his house

column.name: text
column.value: because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying. As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years, but no one could heal her.

column.name: text
column.value: She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.

column.name: text
column.value: "Who touched me?" Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, "Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you."

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said, "Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman, seeing that she could not go unnoticed, came trembling and fell at his feet. In the presence of all the people, she told why she had touched him and how she had been instantly healed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."

column.name: text
column.value: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue ruler. "Your daughter is dead," he said. "Don't bother the teacher any more."

column.name: text
column.value: Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, "Don't be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed."

column.name: text
column.value: When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child's father and mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile, all the people were wailing and mourning for her. "Stop wailing," Jesus said. "She is not dead but asleep."

column.name: text
column.value: They laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But he took her by the hand and said, "My child, get up!"

column.name: text
column.value: Her spirit returned, and at once she stood up. Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Her parents were astonished, but he ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,

column.name: text
column.value: and he sent them out to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

column.name: text
column.value: He told them: "Take nothing for the journey--no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra tunic.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that town.

column.name: text
column.value: If people do not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave their town, as a testimony against them."

column.name: text
column.value: So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was going on. And he was perplexed, because some were saying that John had been raised from the dead,

column.name: text
column.value: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.

column.name: text
column.value: But Herod said, "I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?" And he tried to see him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,

column.name: text
column.value: but the crowds learned about it and followed him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed healing.

column.name: text
column.value: Late in the afternoon the Twelve came to him and said, "Send the crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside and find food and lodging, because we are in a remote place here."

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "You give them something to eat." They answered, "We have only five loaves of bread and two fish--unless we go and buy food for all this crowd."

column.name: text
column.value: (About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, "Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each."

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples did so, and everybody sat down.

column.name: text
column.value: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke them. Then he gave them to the disciples to set before the people.

column.name: text
column.value: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

column.name: text
column.value: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, "Who do the crowds say I am?"

column.name: text
column.value: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life."

column.name: text
column.value: "But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?" Peter answered, "The Christ of God."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them all: "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me will save it.

column.name: text
column.value: What good is it for a man to gain the whole world, and yet lose or forfeit his very self?

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God."

column.name: text
column.value: About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.

column.name: text
column.value: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: Two men, Moses and Elijah,

column.name: text
column.value: appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus. They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.

column.name: text
column.value: As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters--one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah." (He did not know what he was saying.)

column.name: text
column.value: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.

column.name: text
column.value: A voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him."

column.name: text
column.value: When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves, and told no one at that time what they had seen.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.

column.name: text
column.value: A man in the crowd called out, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

column.name: text
column.value: A spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams; it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It scarcely ever leaves him and is destroying him.

column.name: text
column.value: I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not."

column.name: text
column.value: "O unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you and put up with you? Bring your son here."

column.name: text
column.value: Even while the boy was coming, the demon threw him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, healed the boy and gave him back to his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: "Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men."

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.

column.name: text
column.value: An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, "Whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For he who is least among you all--he is the greatest."

column.name: text
column.value: "Master," said John, "we saw a man driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us."

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not stop him," Jesus said, "for whoever is not against you is for you."

column.name: text
column.value: As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;

column.name: text
column.value: but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, "Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them?"

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus turned and rebuked them,

column.name: text
column.value: and they went to another village.

column.name: text
column.value: As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, "I will follow you wherever you go."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head."

column.name: text
column.value: He said to another man, "Follow me." But the man replied, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God."

column.name: text
column.value: Still another said, "I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say good-by to my family."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God."

column.name: text
column.value: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "When you pray, say: "'Father, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come.

column.name: text
column.value: Give us each day our daily bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, "Suppose one of you has a friend, and he goes to him at midnight and says, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

column.name: text
column.value: because a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have nothing to set before him.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the one inside answers, 'Don't bother me. The door is already locked, and my children are with me in bed. I can't get up and give you anything.'

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, though he will not get up and give him the bread because he is his friend, yet because of the man's boldness he will get up and give him as much as he needs.

column.name: text
column.value: "So I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: "Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?

column.name: text
