column.value: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

column.name: text
column.value: If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon left, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowd was amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them said, "By Beelzebub, the prince of demons, he is driving out demons."

column.name: text
column.value: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them: "Any kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and a house divided against itself will fall.

column.name: text
column.value: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? I say this because you claim that I drive out demons by Beelzebub.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if I drive out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your followers drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come to you.

column.name: text
column.value: "When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.

column.name: text
column.value: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and divides up the spoils.

column.name: text
column.value: "He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not gather with me, scatters.

column.name: text
column.value: "When an evil spirit comes out of a man, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, 'I will return to the house I left.'

column.name: text
column.value: When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that man is worse than the first."

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd called out, "Blessed is the mother who gave you birth and nursed you."

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it."

column.name: text
column.value: As the crowds increased, Jesus said, "This is a wicked generation. It asks for a miraculous sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.

column.name: text
column.value: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon's wisdom, and now one greater than Solomon is here.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now one greater than Jonah is here.

column.name: text
column.value: "No one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead he puts it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light.

column.name: text
column.value: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body also is full of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, and no part of it dark, it will be completely lighted, as when the light of a lamp shines on you."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and reclined at the table.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisee, noticing that Jesus did not first wash before the meal, was surprised.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Lord said to him, "Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?

column.name: text
column.value: But give what is inside the dish to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you Pharisees, because you give God a tenth of your mint, rue and all other kinds of garden herbs, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without leaving the former undone.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you Pharisees, because you love the most important seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, because you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without knowing it."

column.name: text
column.value: One of the experts in the law answered him, "Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "And you experts in the law, woe to you, because you load people down with burdens they can hardly carry, and you yourselves will not lift one finger to help them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, because you build tombs for the prophets, and it was your forefathers who killed them.

column.name: text
column.value: So you testify that you approve of what your forefathers did; they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this, God in his wisdom said, 'I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and others they will persecute.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this generation will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the beginning of the world,

column.name: text
column.value: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, this generation will be held responsible for it all.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus left there, the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to oppose him fiercely and to besiege him with questions,

column.name: text
column.value: waiting to catch him in something he might say.

column.name: text
column.value: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.

column.name: text
column.value: He told them, "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.

column.name: text
column.value: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.

column.name: text
column.value: "When you enter a house, first say, 'Peace to this house.'

column.name: text
column.value: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Stay in that house, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.

column.name: text
column.value: "When you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is set before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, 'The kingdom of God is near you.'

column.name: text
column.value: But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,

column.name: text
column.value: 'Even the dust of your town that sticks to our feet we wipe off against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.'

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woe to you, Korazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to the skies? No, you will go down to the depths.

column.name: text
column.value: "He who listens to you listens to me; he who rejects you rejects me; but he who rejects me rejects him who sent me."

column.name: text
column.value: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, "Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name."

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.

column.name: text
column.value: However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Jesus, full of joy through the Holy Spirit, said, "I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was your good pleasure.

column.name: text
column.value: "All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.

column.name: text
column.value: For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it."

column.name: text
column.value: On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. "Teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

column.name: text
column.value: "What is written in the Law?" he replied. "How do you read it?"

column.name: text
column.value: He answered: "'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind'; and, 'Love your neighbor as yourself.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "You have answered correctly," Jesus replied. "Do this and you will live."

column.name: text
column.value: But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"

column.name: text
column.value: In reply Jesus said: "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him and went away, leaving him half dead.

column.name: text
column.value: A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.

column.name: text
column.value: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, took him to an inn and took care of him.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day he took out two silver coins and gave them to the innkeeper. 'Look after him,' he said, 'and when I return, I will reimburse you for any extra expense you may have.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?"

column.name: text
column.value: The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha opened her home to him.

column.name: text
column.value: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord's feet listening to what he said.

column.name: text
column.value: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations that had to be made. She came to him and asked, "Lord, don't you care that my sister has left me to do the work by myself? Tell her to help me!"

column.name: text
column.value: "Martha, Martha," the Lord answered, "you are worried and upset about many things,

column.name: text
column.value: but only one thing is needed. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her."

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile, when a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling on one another, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples, saying: "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

column.name: text
column.value: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

column.name: text
column.value: What you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the roofs.

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear him who, after the killing of the body, has power to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

column.name: text
column.value: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you, whoever acknowledges me before men, the Son of Man will also acknowledge him before the angels of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But he who disowns me before men will be disowned before the angels of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: "When you are brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say,

column.name: text
column.value: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say."

column.name: text
column.value: Someone in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, "Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; a man's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions."

column.name: text
column.value: And he told them this parable: "The ground of a certain rich man produced a good crop.

column.name: text
column.value: He thought to himself, 'What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then he said, 'This is what I'll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

column.name: text
column.value: And I'll say to myself, "You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink and be merry." '

column.name: text
column.value: "But God said to him, 'You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?'

column.name: text
column.value: "This is how it will be with anyone who stores up things for himself but is not rich toward God."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to his disciples: "Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear.

column.name: text
column.value: Life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!

column.name: text
column.value: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

column.name: text
column.value: Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?

column.name: text
column.value: "Consider how the lilies grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.

column.name: text
column.value: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today, and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith!

column.name: text
column.value: And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.

column.name: text
column.value: But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide purses for yourselves that will not wear out, a treasure in heaven that will not be exhausted, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.

column.name: text
column.value: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

column.name: text
column.value: "Be dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,

column.name: text
column.value: like men waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they can immediately open the door for him.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them watching when he comes. I tell you the truth, he will dress himself to serve, will have them recline at the table and will come and wait on them.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night.

column.name: text
column.value: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.

column.name: text
column.value: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter asked, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?"

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord answered, "Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their food allowance at the proper time?

column.name: text
column.value: It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: But suppose the servant says to himself, 'My master is taking a long time in coming,' and he then begins to beat the menservants and maidservants and to eat and drink and get drunk.

column.name: text
column.value: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.

column.name: text
column.value: "That servant who knows his master's will and does not get ready or does not do what his master wants will be beaten with many blows.

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who does not know and does things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and from the one who has been entrusted with much, much more will be asked.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!

column.name: text
column.value: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is completed!

column.name: text
column.value: Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.

column.name: text
column.value: From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."

column.name: text
column.value: He said to the crowd: "When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, 'It's going to rain,' and it does.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the south wind blows, you say, 'It's going to be hot,' and it is.

column.name: text
column.value: Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don't know how to interpret this present time?

column.name: text
column.value: "Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right?

column.name: text
column.value: As you are going with your adversary to the magistrate, try hard to be reconciled to him on the way, or he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge turn you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny."

column.name: text
column.value: One Sabbath, when Jesus went to eat in the house of a prominent Pharisee, he was being carefully watched.

column.name: text
column.value: There in front of him was a man suffering from dropsy.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in the law, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?"

column.name: text
column.value: But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he asked them, "If one of you has a son or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull him out?"

column.name: text
column.value: And they had nothing to say.

column.name: text
column.value: When he noticed how the guests picked the places of honor at the table, he told them this parable:

column.name: text
column.value: "When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for a person more distinguished than you may have been invited.

column.name: text
column.value: If so, the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, 'Give this man your seat.' Then, humiliated, you will have to take the least important place.

column.name: text
column.value: But when you are invited, take the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, 'Friend, move up to a better place.' Then you will be honored in the presence of all your fellow guests.

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to his host, "When you give a luncheon or dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers or relatives, or your rich neighbors; if you do, they may invite you back and so you will be repaid.

column.name: text
column.value: But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,

column.name: text
column.value: and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous."

column.name: text
column.value: When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, "Blessed is the man who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied: "A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.

column.name: text
column.value: At the time of the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, 'Come, for everything is now ready.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But they all alike began to make excuses. The first said, 'I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Another said, 'I have just bought five yoke of oxen, and I'm on my way to try them out. Please excuse me.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Still another said, 'I just got married, so I can't come.'

column.name: text
column.value: "The servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and ordered his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind and the lame.'

column.name: text
column.value: "'Sir,' the servant said, 'what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the master told his servant, 'Go out to the roads and country lanes and make them come in, so that my house will be full.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:

column.name: text
column.value: "If anyone comes to me and does not hate his father and mother, his wife and children, his brothers and sisters--yes, even his own life--he cannot be my disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: And anyone who does not carry his cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: "Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Will he not first sit down and estimate the cost to see if he has enough money to complete it?

column.name: text
column.value: For if he lays the foundation and is not able to finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, 'This fellow began to build and was not able to finish.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Or suppose a king is about to go to war against another king. Will he not first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?

column.name: text
column.value: If he is not able, he will send a delegation while the other is still a long way off and will ask for terms of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, any of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be my disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: "Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

column.name: text
column.value: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out. "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans because they suffered this way?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Or those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them--do you think they were more guilty than all the others living in Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he told this parable: "A man had a fig tree, planted in his vineyard, and he went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.

column.name: text
column.value: So he said to the man who took care of the vineyard, 'For three years now I've been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven't found any. Cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?'

column.name: text
column.value: "'Sir,' the man replied, 'leave it alone for one more year, and I'll dig around it and fertilize it.

column.name: text
column.value: If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.'"

column.name: text
column.value: On a Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,

column.name: text
column.value: and a woman was there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, "Woman, you are set free from your infirmity."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.

column.name: text
column.value: Indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, the synagogue ruler said to the people, "There are six days for work. So come and be healed on those days, not on the Sabbath."

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord answered him, "You hypocrites! Doesn't each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it out to give it water?

column.name: text
column.value: Then should not this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be set free on the Sabbath day from what bound her?"

column.name: text
column.value: When he said this, all his opponents were humiliated, but the people were delighted with all the wonderful things he was doing.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus asked, "What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?

column.name: text
column.value: It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air perched in its branches."

column.name: text
column.value: Again he asked, "What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?

column.name: text
column.value: It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into a large amount of flour until it worked all through the dough."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Someone asked him, "Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?" He said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: "Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able to.

column.name: text
column.value: Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, 'Sir, open the door for us.' "But he will answer, 'I don't know you or where you come from.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then you will say, 'We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But he will reply, 'I don't know you or where you come from. Away from me, all you evildoers!'

column.name: text
column.value: "There will be weeping there, and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves thrown out.

column.name: text
column.value: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will take their places at the feast in the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last."

column.name: text
column.value: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, "Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you."

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "Go tell that fox, 'I will drive out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach my goal.'

column.name: text
column.value: In any case, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day--for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!

column.name: text
column.value: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing!

column.name: text
column.value: Look, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Now the tax collectors and "sinners" were all gathering around to hear him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law muttered, "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus told them this parable:

column.name: text
column.value: "Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them. Does he not leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost sheep until he finds it?

column.name: text
column.value: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders

column.name: text
column.value: and goes home. Then he calls his friends and neighbors together and says, 'Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.'

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.

column.name: text
column.value: "Or suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Does she not light a lamp, sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?

column.name: text
column.value: And when she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together and says, 'Rejoice with me; I have found my lost coin.'

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus continued: "There was a man who had two sons.

column.name: text
column.value: The younger one said to his father, 'Father, give me my share of the estate.' So he divided his property between them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Not long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living.

column.name: text
column.value: After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs.

column.name: text
column.value: He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.

column.name: text
column.value: "When he came to his senses, he said, 'How many of my father's hired men have food to spare, and here I am starving to death!

column.name: text
column.value: I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

column.name: text
column.value: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired men.'

column.name: text
column.value: So he got up and went to his father. "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: "The son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But the father said to his servants, 'Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let's have a feast and celebrate.

column.name: text
column.value: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.' So they began to celebrate.

column.name: text
column.value: "Meanwhile, the older son was in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.

column.name: text
column.value: So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.

column.name: text
column.value: 'Your brother has come,' he replied, 'and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.'

column.name: text
column.value: "The older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered his father, 'Look! All these years I've been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.

column.name: text
column.value: But when this son of yours who has squandered your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!'

column.name: text
column.value: "'My son,' the father said, 'you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

column.name: text
column.value: But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus told his disciples: "There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: So he called him in and asked him, 'What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your management, because you cannot be manager any longer.'

column.name: text
column.value: "The manager said to himself, 'What shall I do now? My master is taking away my job. I'm not strong enough to dig, and I'm ashamed to beg--

column.name: text
column.value: I know what I'll do so that, when I lose my job here, people will welcome me into their houses.'

column.name: text
column.value: "So he called in each one of his master's debtors. He asked the first, 'How much do you owe my master?'

column.name: text
column.value: "'Eight hundred gallons of olive oil,' he replied. "The manager told him, 'Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it four hundred.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then he asked the second, 'And how much do you owe?' "'A thousand bushels of wheat,' he replied. "He told him, 'Take your bill and make it eight hundred.'

column.name: text
column.value: "The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the people of this world are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the people of the light.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, use worldly wealth to gain friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, you will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: "Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

column.name: text
column.value: So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?

column.name: text
column.value: And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else's property, who will give you property of your own?

column.name: text
column.value: "No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and Money."

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "You are the ones who justify yourselves in the eyes of men, but God knows your hearts. What is highly valued among men is detestable in God's sight.

column.name: text
column.value: "The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the good news of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

column.name: text
column.value: It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: "Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and the man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: "There was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.

column.name: text
column.value: At his gate was laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores

column.name: text
column.value: and longing to eat what fell from the rich man's table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.

column.name: text
column.value: "The time came when the beggar died and the angels carried him to Abraham's side. The rich man also died and was buried.

column.name: text
column.value: In hell, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.

column.name: text
column.value: So he called to him, 'Father Abraham, have pity on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this fire.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But Abraham replied, 'Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here and you are in agony.

column.name: text
column.value: And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been fixed, so that those who want to go from here to you cannot, nor can anyone cross over from there to us.'

column.name: text
column.value: "He answered, 'Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my father's house,

column.name: text
column.value: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also come to this place of torment.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Abraham replied, 'They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.'

column.name: text
column.value: "'No, father Abraham,' he said, 'but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.'

column.name: text
column.value: "He said to him, 'If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to his disciples: "Things that cause people to sin are bound to come, but woe to that person through whom they come.

column.name: text
column.value: It would be better for him to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around his neck than for him to cause one of these little ones to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: So watch yourselves. "If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him.

column.name: text
column.value: If he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times comes back to you and says, 'I repent,' forgive him."

column.name: text
column.value: The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "If you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, 'Be uprooted and planted in the sea,' and it will obey you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Suppose one of you had a servant plowing or looking after the sheep. Would he say to the servant when he comes in from the field, 'Come along now and sit down to eat'?

column.name: text
column.value: Would he not rather say, 'Prepare my supper, get yourself ready and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may eat and drink'?

column.name: text
column.value: Would he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?

column.name: text
column.value: So you also, when you have done everything you were told to do, should say, 'We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood at a distance

column.name: text
column.value: and called out in a loud voice, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"

column.name: text
column.value: When he saw them, he said, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." And as they went, they were cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.

column.name: text
column.value: He threw himself at Jesus' feet and thanked him--and he was a Samaritan.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus asked, "Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?

column.name: text
column.value: Was no one found to return and give praise to God except this foreigner?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to him, "Rise and go; your faith has made you well."

column.name: text
column.value: Once, having been asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, "The kingdom of God does not come with your careful observation,

column.name: text
column.value: nor will people say, 'Here it is,' or 'There it is,' because the kingdom of God is within you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to his disciples, "The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.

column.name: text
column.value: Men will tell you, 'There he is!' or 'Here he is!' Do not go running off after them.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.

column.name: text
column.value: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: "Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.

column.name: text
column.value: "It was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.

column.name: text
column.value: But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

column.name: text
column.value: "It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day no one who is on the roof of his house, with his goods inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Lot's wife!

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever tries to keep his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will preserve it.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.

column.name: text
column.value: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left."

column.name: text
column.value: "Where, Lord?" they asked. He replied, "Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.

column.name: text
column.value: He said: "In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared about men.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, 'Grant me justice against my adversary.'

column.name: text
column.value: "For some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, 'Even though I don't fear God or care about men,

column.name: text
column.value: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will see that she gets justice, so that she won't eventually wear me out with her coming!'"

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, "Listen to what the unjust judge says.

column.name: text
column.value: And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?"

column.name: text
column.value: To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everybody else, Jesus told this parable:

column.name: text
column.value: "Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisee stood up and prayed about himself: 'God, I thank you that I am not like other men--robbers, evildoers, adulterers--or even like this tax collector.

column.name: text
column.value: I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, 'God, have mercy on me, a sinner.'

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."

column.name: text
column.value: People were also bringing babies to Jesus to have him touch them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus called the children to him and said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it."

column.name: text
column.value: A certain ruler asked him, "Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus answered. "No one is good--except God alone.

column.name: text
column.value: You know the commandments: 'Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.'"

column.name: text
column.value: "All these I have kept since I was a boy," he said.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

column.name: text
column.value: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was a man of great wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus looked at him and said, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."

column.name: text
column.value: Those who heard this asked, "Who then can be saved?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "What is impossible with men is possible with God."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said to him, "We have left all we had to follow you!"

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth," Jesus said to them, "no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God

column.name: text
column.value: will fail to receive many times as much in this age and, in the age to come, eternal life."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus took the Twelve aside and told them, "We are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written by the prophets about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be handed over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him, spit on him, flog him and kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: On the third day he will rise again."

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.

column.name: text
column.value: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.

column.name: text
column.value: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."

column.name: text
column.value: He called out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"

column.name: text
column.value: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,

column.name: text
column.value: "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord, I want to see," he replied.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has healed you."

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they also praised God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

column.name: text
column.value: A man was there by the name of Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was wealthy.

column.name: text
column.value: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but being a short man he could not, because of the crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, "Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today."

column.name: text
column.value: So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.

column.name: text
column.value: All the people saw this and began to mutter, "He has gone to be the guest of a 'sinner.'"

column.name: text
column.value: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save what was lost."

column.name: text
column.value: While they were listening to this, he went on to tell them a parable, because he was near Jerusalem and the people thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear at once.

column.name: text
column.value: He said: "A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.

column.name: text
column.value: So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. 'Put this money to work,' he said, 'until I come back.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, 'We don't want this man to be our king.'

column.name: text
column.value: "He was made king, however, and returned home. Then he sent for the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained with it.

column.name: text
column.value: "The first one came and said, 'Sir, your mina has earned ten more.'

column.name: text
column.value: "'Well done, my good servant!' his master replied. 'Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.'

column.name: text
column.value: "The second came and said, 'Sir, your mina has earned five more.'

column.name: text
column.value: "His master answered, 'You take charge of five cities.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then another servant came and said, 'Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.

column.name: text
column.value: I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.'

column.name: text
column.value: "His master replied, 'I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant! You knew, did you, that I am a hard man, taking out what I did not put in, and reaping what I did not sow?

column.name: text
column.value: Why then didn't you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?'

column.name: text
column.value: "Then he said to those standing by, 'Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.'

column.name: text
column.value: "'Sir,' they said, 'he already has ten!'

column.name: text
column.value: "He replied, 'I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what he has will be taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them--bring them here and kill them in front of me.'"

column.name: text
column.value: After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,

column.name: text
column.value: "Go to the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying it?' tell him, 'The Lord needs it.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.

column.name: text
column.value: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, "Why are you untying the colt?"

column.name: text
column.value: They replied, "The Lord needs it."

column.name: text
column.value: They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.

column.name: text
column.value: As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.

column.name: text
column.value: When he came near the place where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples began joyfully to praise God in loud voices for all the miracles they had seen:

column.name: text
column.value: "Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples!"

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you," he replied, "if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out."

column.name: text
column.value: As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it

column.name: text
column.value: and said, "If you, even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace--but now it is hidden from your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: They will dash you to the ground, you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of God's coming to you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he entered the temple area and began driving out those who were selling.

column.name: text
column.value: "It is written," he said to them, "'My house will be a house of prayer'; but you have made it 'a den of robbers.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Every day he was teaching at the temple. But the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the leaders among the people were trying to kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.

column.name: text
column.value: One day as he was teaching the people in the temple courts and preaching the gospel, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.

column.name: text
column.value: "Tell us by what authority you are doing these things," they said. "Who gave you this authority?"

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "I will also ask you a question. Tell me,

column.name: text
column.value: John's baptism--was it from heaven, or from men?"

column.name: text
column.value: They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask, 'Why didn't you believe him?'

column.name: text
column.value: But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet."

column.name: text
column.value: So they answered, "We don't know where it was from."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."

column.name: text
column.value: He went on to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers and went away for a long time.

column.name: text
column.value: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants so they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.

column.name: text
column.value: "Then the owner of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.'

column.name: text
column.value: "But when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. 'This is the heir,' they said. 'Let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'

column.name: text
column.value: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. "What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

column.name: text
column.value: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others." When the people heard this, they said, "May this never be!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus looked directly at them and asked, "Then what is the meaning of that which is written: "'The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone'?

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed."

column.name: text
column.value: The teachers of the law and the chief priests looked for a way to arrest him immediately, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they were afraid of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Keeping a close watch on him, they sent spies, who pretended to be honest. They hoped to catch Jesus in something he said so that they might hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.

column.name: text
column.value: So the spies questioned him: "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

column.name: text
column.value: He saw through their duplicity and said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: "Show me a denarius. Whose portrait and inscription are on it?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Caesar's," they replied. He said to them, "Then give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."

column.name: text
column.value: They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.

column.name: text
column.value: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and have children for his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman and died childless.

column.name: text
column.value: The second

column.name: text
column.value: and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, the woman died too.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, at the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.

column.name: text
column.value: But those who are considered worthy of taking part in that age and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,

column.name: text
column.value: and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God's children, since they are children of the resurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the account of the bush, even Moses showed that the dead rise, for he calls the Lord 'the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

column.name: text
column.value: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive."

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the teachers of the law responded, "Well said, teacher!"

column.name: text
column.value: And no one dared to ask him any more questions.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, "How is it that they say the Christ is the Son of David?

column.name: text
column.value: David himself declares in the Book of Psalms: "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand

column.name: text
column.value: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." '

column.name: text
column.value: David calls him 'Lord.' How then can he be his son?"

column.name: text
column.value: While all the people were listening, Jesus said to his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: "Beware of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and love to be greeted in the marketplaces and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

column.name: text
column.value: They devour widows' houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. Such men will be punished most severely."

column.name: text
column.value: As he looked up, Jesus saw the rich putting their gifts into the temple treasury.

column.name: text
column.value: He also saw a poor widow put in two very small copper coins.

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth," he said, "this poor widow has put in more than all the others.

column.name: text
column.value: All these people gave their gifts out of their wealth; but she out of her poverty put in all she had to live on."

column.name: text
column.value: Some of his disciples were remarking about how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and with gifts dedicated to God. But Jesus said,

column.name: text
column.value: "As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one of them will be thrown down."

column.name: text
column.value: "Teacher," they asked, "when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?"

column.name: text
column.value: He replied: "Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am he,' and, 'The time is near.' Do not follow them.

column.name: text
column.value: When you hear of wars and revolutions, do not be frightened. These things must happen first, but the end will not come right away."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them: "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: "But before all this, they will lay hands on you and persecute you. They will deliver you to synagogues and prisons, and you will be brought before kings and governors, and all on account of my name.

column.name: text
column.value: This will result in your being witnesses to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But make up your mind not to worry beforehand how you will defend yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.

column.name: text
column.value: All men will hate you because of me.

column.name: text
column.value: But not a hair of your head will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: By standing firm you will gain life.

column.name: text
column.value: "When you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.

column.name: text
column.value: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers! There will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.

column.name: text
column.value: They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: "There will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Men will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

column.name: text
column.value: When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near."

column.name: text
column.value: He told them this parable: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees.

column.name: text
column.value: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: "Be careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with dissipation, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you unexpectedly like a trap.

column.name: text
column.value: For it will come upon all those who live on the face of the whole earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man."

column.name: text
column.value: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,

column.name: text
column.value: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to accuse him, saying, "We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Christ, a king."

column.name: text
column.value: So Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the king of the Jews?" "Yes, it is as you say," Jesus replied.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."

column.name: text
column.value: But they insisted, "He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here."

column.name: text
column.value: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.

column.name: text
column.value: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform some miracle.

column.name: text
column.value: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: That day Herod and Pilate became friends--before this they had been enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,

column.name: text
column.value: and said to them, "You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him."

column.name: text
column.value: With one voice they cried out, "Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!"

column.name: text
column.value: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)

column.name: text
column.value: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.

column.name: text
column.value: But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"

column.name: text
column.value: For the third time he spoke to them: "Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him."

column.name: text
column.value: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.

column.name: text
column.value: So Pilate decided to grant their demand.

column.name: text
column.value: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.

column.name: text
column.value: As they led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.

column.name: text
column.value: For the time will come when you will say, 'Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!'

column.name: text
column.value: Then "'they will say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!" '

column.name: text
column.value: For if men do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?"

column.name: text
column.value: Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to the place called the Skull, there they crucified him, along with the criminals--one on his right, the other on his left.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

column.name: text
column.value: The people stood watching, and the rulers even sneered at him. They said, "He saved others; let him save himself if he is the Christ of God, the Chosen One."

column.name: text
column.value: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar

column.name: text
column.value: and said, "If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself."

column.name: text
column.value: There was a written notice above him, which read: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

column.name: text
column.value: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: "Aren't you the Christ? Save yourself and us!"

column.name: text
column.value: But the other criminal rebuked him. "Don't you fear God," he said, "since you are under the same sentence?

column.name: text
column.value: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, "I tell you the truth, today you will be with me in paradise."

column.name: text
column.value: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour,

column.name: text
column.value: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit." When he had said this, he breathed his last.

column.name: text
column.value: The centurion, seeing what had happened, praised God and said, "Surely this was a righteous man."

column.name: text
column.value: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.

column.name: text
column.value: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, a good and upright man,

column.name: text
column.value: who had not consented to their decision and action. He came from the Judean town of Arimathea and he was waiting for the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus' body.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in the rock, one in which no one had yet been laid.

column.name: text
column.value: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.

column.name: text
column.value: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and saw the tomb and how his body was laid in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they went home and prepared spices and perfumes. But they rested on the Sabbath in obedience to the commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,

column.name: text
column.value: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

column.name: text
column.value: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover."

column.name: text
column.value: "Where do you want us to prepare for it?" they asked.

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,

column.name: text
column.value: and say to the owner of the house, 'The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'

column.name: text
column.value: He will show you a large upper room, all furnished. Make preparations there."

column.name: text
column.value: They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, "I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

column.name: text
column.value: For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God."

column.name: text
column.value: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, "Take this and divide it among you.

column.name: text
