column.value: For I tell you I will not drink again of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."

column.name: text
column.value: And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me."

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

column.name: text
column.value: But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed, but woe to that man who betrays him."

column.name: text
column.value: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.

column.name: text
column.value: Also a dispute arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.

column.name: text
column.value: But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.

column.name: text
column.value: For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

column.name: text
column.value: You are those who have stood by me in my trials.

column.name: text
column.value: And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: "Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift you as wheat.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."

column.name: text
column.value: But he replied, "Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus asked them, "When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?" "Nothing," they answered.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don't have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.

column.name: text
column.value: It is written: 'And he was numbered with the transgressors'; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment."

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples said, "See, Lord, here are two swords." "That is enough," he replied.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: On reaching the place, he said to them, "Pray that you will not fall into temptation."

column.name: text
column.value: He withdrew about a stone's throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,

column.name: text
column.value: "Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done."

column.name: text
column.value: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.

column.name: text
column.value: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: "Why are you sleeping?" he asked them. "Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation."

column.name: text
column.value: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,

column.name: text
column.value: but Jesus asked him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus' followers saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus answered, "No more of this!" And he touched the man's ear and healed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, "Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?

column.name: text
column.value: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour--when darkness reigns."

column.name: text
column.value: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.

column.name: text
column.value: A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, "This man was with him."

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied it. "Woman, I don't know him," he said.

column.name: text
column.value: A little later someone else saw him and said, "You also are one of them." "Man, I am not!" Peter replied.

column.name: text
column.value: About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter replied, "Man, I don't know what you're talking about!" Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: "Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times."

column.name: text
column.value: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.

column.name: text
column.value: They blindfolded him and demanded, "Prophesy! Who hit you?"

column.name: text
column.value: And they said many other insulting things to him.

column.name: text
column.value: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you are the Christ," they said, "tell us." Jesus answered, "If I tell you, you will not believe me,

column.name: text
column.value: and if I asked you, you would not answer.

column.name: text
column.value: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God."

column.name: text
column.value: They all asked, "Are you then the Son of God?" He replied, "You are right in saying I am."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said, "Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips."

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

column.name: text
column.value: He was with God in the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.

column.name: text
column.value: In him was life, and that life was the light of men.

column.name: text
column.value: The light shines in the darkness, but the darkness has not understood it.

column.name: text
column.value: There came a man who was sent from God; his name was John.

column.name: text
column.value: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all men might believe.

column.name: text
column.value: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.

column.name: text
column.value: The true light that gives light to every man was coming into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.

column.name: text
column.value: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet to all who received him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God--

column.name: text
column.value: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.

column.name: text
column.value: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the One and Only, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

column.name: text
column.value: John testifies concerning him. He cries out, saying, "This was he of whom I said, 'He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.'"

column.name: text
column.value: From the fullness of his grace we have all received one blessing after another.

column.name: text
column.value: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: No one has ever seen God, but God the One and Only, who is at the Father's side, has made him known.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this was John's testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.

column.name: text
column.value: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Christ."

column.name: text
column.value: They asked him, "Then who are you? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."

column.name: text
column.value: Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"

column.name: text
column.value: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, "I am the voice of one calling in the desert, 'Make straight the way for the Lord.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Now some Pharisees who had been sent

column.name: text
column.value: questioned him, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"

column.name: text
column.value: "I baptize with water," John replied, "but among you stands one you do not know.

column.name: text
column.value: He is the one who comes after me, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie."

column.name: text
column.value: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

column.name: text
column.value: This is the one I meant when I said, 'A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.'

column.name: text
column.value: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.

column.name: text
column.value: I would not have known him, except that the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, 'The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.'

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen and I testify that this is the Son of God."

column.name: text
column.value: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Lamb of God!"

column.name: text
column.value: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, "What do you want?" They said, "Rabbi" (which means Teacher), "where are you staying?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Come," he replied, "and you will see." So they went and saw where he was staying, and spent that day with him. It was about the tenth hour.

column.name: text
column.value: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, "We have found the Messiah" (that is, the Christ).

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, "You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas" (which, when translated, is Peter).

column.name: text
column.value: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, "Follow me."

column.name: text
column.value: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote--Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."

column.name: text
column.value: "Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?" Nathanael asked. "Come and see," said Philip.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is nothing false."

column.name: text
column.value: "How do you know me?" Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, "I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the King of Israel."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You shall see greater things than that."

column.name: text
column.value: He then added, "I tell you the truth, you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."

column.name: text
column.value: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus' mother was there,

column.name: text
column.value: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.

column.name: text
column.value: When the wine was gone, Jesus' mother said to him, "They have no more wine."

column.name: text
column.value: "Dear woman, why do you involve me?" Jesus replied. "My time has not yet come."

column.name: text
column.value: His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."

column.name: text
column.value: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to the servants, "Fill the jars with water"; so they filled them to the brim.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he told them, "Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet." They did so,

column.name: text
column.value: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside

column.name: text
column.value: and said, "Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now."

column.name: text
column.value: This, the first of his miraculous signs, Jesus performed at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed his glory, and his disciples put their faith in him.

column.name: text
column.value: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.

column.name: text
column.value: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: In the temple courts he found men selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.

column.name: text
column.value: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple area, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.

column.name: text
column.value: To those who sold doves he said, "Get these out of here! How dare you turn my Father's house into a market!"

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples remembered that it is written: "Zeal for your house will consume me."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews demanded of him, "What miraculous sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days."

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews replied, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?"

column.name: text
column.value: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.

column.name: text
column.value: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the Scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the miraculous signs he was doing and believed in his name.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all men.

column.name: text
column.value: He did not need man's testimony about man, for he knew what was in a man.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a member of the Jewish ruling council.

column.name: text
column.value: He came to Jesus at night and said, "Rabbi, we know you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the miraculous signs you are doing if God were not with him."

column.name: text
column.value: In reply Jesus declared, "I tell you the truth, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again."

column.name: text
column.value: "How can a man be born when he is old?" Nicodemus asked. "Surely he cannot enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: You should not be surprised at my saying, 'You must be born again.'

column.name: text
column.value: The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit."

column.name: text
column.value: "How can this be?" Nicodemus asked.

column.name: text
column.value: "You are Israel's teacher," said Jesus, "and do you not understand these things?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?

column.name: text
column.value: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven--the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the desert, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

column.name: text
column.value: that everyone who believes in him may have eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: "For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because he has not believed in the name of God's one and only Son.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but men loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what he has done has been done through God."

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were constantly coming to be baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: (This was before John was put in prison.)

column.name: text
column.value: An argument developed between some of John's disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.

column.name: text
column.value: They came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan--the one you testified about--well, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him."

column.name: text
column.value: To this John replied, "A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: You yourselves can testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ but am sent ahead of him.'

column.name: text
column.value: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroom's voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.

column.name: text
column.value: He must become greater; I must become less.

column.name: text
column.value: "The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.

column.name: text
column.value: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.

column.name: text
column.value: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God's wrath remains on him."

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees heard that Jesus was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John,

column.name: text
column.value: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Lord learned of this, he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: Now he had to go through Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Jacob's well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

column.name: text
column.value: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, "Will you give me a drink?"

column.name: text
column.value: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)

column.name: text
column.value: The Samaritan woman said to him, "You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?" (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water."

column.name: text
column.value: "Sir," the woman said, "you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?

column.name: text
column.value: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his flocks and herds?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,

column.name: text
column.value: but whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life."

column.name: text
column.value: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water so that I won't get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water."

column.name: text
column.value: He told her, "Go, call your husband and come back."

column.name: text
column.value: "I have no husband," she replied. Jesus said to her, "You are right when you say you have no husband.

column.name: text
column.value: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true."

column.name: text
column.value: "Sir," the woman said, "I can see that you are a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus declared, "Believe me, woman, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.

column.name: text
column.value: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in spirit and in truth."

column.name: text
column.value: The woman said, "I know that Messiah" (called Christ) "is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus declared, "I who speak to you am he."

column.name: text
column.value: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, "What do you want?" or "Why are you talking with her?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,

column.name: text
column.value: "Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?"

column.name: text
column.value: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, "Rabbi, eat something."

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to them, "I have food to eat that you know nothing about."

column.name: text
column.value: Then his disciples said to each other, "Could someone have brought him food?"

column.name: text
column.value: "My food," said Jesus, "is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not say, 'Four months more and then the harvest'? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: Even now the reaper draws his wages, even now he harvests the crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the saying 'One sows and another reaps' is true.

column.name: text
column.value: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor."

column.name: text
column.value: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman's testimony, "He told me everything I ever did."

column.name: text
column.value: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.

column.name: text
column.value: And because of his words many more became believers.

column.name: text
column.value: They said to the woman, "We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world."

column.name: text
column.value: After the two days he left for Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)

column.name: text
column.value: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, for they also had been there.

column.name: text
column.value: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.

column.name: text
column.value: "Unless you people see miraculous signs and wonders," Jesus told him, "you will never believe."

column.name: text
column.value: The royal official said, "Sir, come down before my child dies."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "You may go. Your son will live." The man took Jesus at his word and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.

column.name: text
column.value: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, "The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, "Your son will live." So he and all his household believed.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the second miraculous sign that Jesus performed, having come from Judea to Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for a feast of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.

column.name: text
column.value: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie--the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.

column.name: text
column.value: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to get well?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Sir," the invalid replied, "I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am trying to get in, someone else goes down ahead of me."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to him, "Get up! Pick up your mat and walk."

column.name: text
column.value: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,

column.name: text
column.value: and so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat."

column.name: text
column.value: But he replied, "The man who made me well said to me, 'Pick up your mat and walk.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So they asked him, "Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?"

column.name: text
column.value: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.

column.name: text
column.value: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, "See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you."

column.name: text
column.value: The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

column.name: text
column.value: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews persecuted him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I, too, am working."

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason the Jews tried all the harder to kill him; not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus gave them this answer: "I tell you the truth, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, to your amazement he will show him even greater things than these.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,

column.name: text
column.value: that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be condemned; he has crossed over from death to life.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son to have life in himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice

column.name: text
column.value: and come out--those who have done good will rise to live, and those who have done evil will rise to be condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: "If I testify about myself, my testimony is not valid.

column.name: text
column.value: There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is valid.

column.name: text
column.value: "You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the very work that the Father has given me to finish, and which I am doing, testifies that the Father has sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,

column.name: text
column.value: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.

column.name: text
column.value: You diligently study the Scriptures because you think that by them you possess eternal life. These are the Scriptures that testify about me,

column.name: text
column.value: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.

column.name: text
column.value: "I do not accept praise from men,

column.name: text
column.value: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: I have come in my Father's name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.

column.name: text
column.value: How can you believe if you accept praise from one another, yet make no effort to obtain the praise that comes from the only God?

column.name: text
column.value: "But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.

column.name: text
column.value: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.

column.name: text
column.value: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?"

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women took the spices they had prepared and went to the tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,

column.name: text
column.value: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: While they were wondering about this, suddenly two men in clothes that gleamed like lightning stood beside them.

column.name: text
column.value: In their fright the women bowed down with their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, "Why do you look for the living among the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: He is not here; he has risen! Remember how he told you, while he was still with you in Galilee:

column.name: text
column.value: 'The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified and on the third day be raised again.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Then they remembered his words.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came back from the tomb, they told all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.

column.name: text
column.value: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the others with them who told this to the apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not believe the women, because their words seemed to them like nonsense.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: As they talked and discussed these things with each other, Jesus himself came up and walked along with them;

column.name: text
column.value: but they were kept from recognizing him.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked them, "What are you discussing together as you walk along?" They stood still, their faces downcast.

column.name: text
column.value: One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, "Are you only a visitor to Jerusalem and do not know the things that have happened there in these days?"

column.name: text
column.value: "What things?" he asked. "About Jesus of Nazareth," they replied. "He was a prophet, powerful in word and deed before God and all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief priests and our rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him;

column.name: text
column.value: but we had hoped that he was the one who was going to redeem Israel. And what is more, it is the third day since all this took place.

column.name: text
column.value: In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning

column.name: text
column.value: but didn't find his body. They came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels, who said he was alive.

column.name: text
column.value: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but him they did not see."

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "How foolish you are, and how slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!

column.name: text
column.value: Did not the Christ have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?"

column.name: text
column.value: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he explained to them what was said in all the Scriptures concerning himself.

column.name: text
column.value: As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus acted as if he were going farther.

column.name: text
column.value: But they urged him strongly, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over." So he went in to stay with them.

column.name: text
column.value: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: They asked each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?"

column.name: text
column.value: They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, "It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.

column.name: text
column.value: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, "Peace be with you."

column.name: text
column.value: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?

column.name: text
column.value: Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have."

column.name: text
column.value: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"

column.name: text
column.value: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,

column.name: text
column.value: and he took it and ate it in their presence.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, "This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

column.name: text
column.value: He told them, "This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

column.name: text
column.value: and repentance and forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: You are witnesses of these things.

column.name: text
column.value: I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high."

column.name: text
column.value: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee, purposely staying away from Judea because the Jews there were waiting to take his life.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near,

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus' brothers said to him, "You ought to leave here and go to Judea, so that your disciples may see the miracles you do.

column.name: text
column.value: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world."

column.name: text
column.value: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus told them, "The right time for me has not yet come; for you any time is right.

column.name: text
column.value: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that what it does is evil.

column.name: text
column.value: You go to the Feast. I am not yet going up to this Feast, because for me the right time has not yet come."

column.name: text
column.value: Having said this, he stayed in Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: However, after his brothers had left for the Feast, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.

column.name: text
column.value: Now at the Feast the Jews were watching for him and asking, "Where is that man?"

column.name: text
column.value: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others replied, "No, he deceives the people."

column.name: text
column.value: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Not until halfway through the Feast did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews were amazed and asked, "How did this man get such learning without having studied?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "My teaching is not my own. It comes from him who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone chooses to do God's will, he will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.

column.name: text
column.value: He who speaks on his own does so to gain honor for himself, but he who works for the honor of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.

column.name: text
column.value: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?"

column.name: text
column.value: "You are demon-possessed," the crowd answered. "Who is trying to kill you?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "I did one miracle, and you are all astonished.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a child on the Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if a child can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing the whole man on the Sabbath?

column.name: text
column.value: Stop judging by mere appearances, and make a right judgment."

column.name: text
column.value: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, "Isn't this the man they are trying to kill?

column.name: text
column.value: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Christ?

column.name: text
column.value: But we know where this man is from; when the Christ comes, no one will know where he is from."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, "Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,

column.name: text
column.value: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me."

column.name: text
column.value: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.

column.name: text
column.value: Still, many in the crowd put their faith in him. They said, "When the Christ comes, will he do more miraculous signs than this man?"

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "I am with you for only a short time, and then I go to the one who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come."

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews said to one another, "Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

column.name: text
column.value: What did he mean when he said, 'You will look for me, but you will not find me,' and'Where I am, you cannot come'?"

column.name: text
column.value: On the last and greatest day of the Feast, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever believes in me, as the Scripture has said, streams of living water will flow from within him."

column.name: text
column.value: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: On hearing his words, some of the people said, "Surely this man is the Prophet."

column.name: text
column.value: Others said, "He is the Christ." Still others asked, "How can the Christ come from Galilee?

column.name: text
column.value: Does not the Scripture say that the Christ will come from David's family and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?"

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, "Why didn't you bring him in?"

column.name: text
column.value: "No one ever spoke the way this man does," the guards declared.

column.name: text
column.value: "You mean he has deceived you also?" the Pharisees retorted.

column.name: text
column.value: "Has any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?

column.name: text
column.value: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law--there is a curse on them."

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,

column.name: text
column.value: "Does our law condemn anyone without first hearing him to find out what he is doing?"

column.name: text
column.value: They replied, "Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee." The earliest and most reliable manuscripts and other ancient witnesses do not have John 7:53-8:11.

column.name: text
column.value: Then each went to his own home.

column.name: text
column.value: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),

column.name: text
column.value: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the miraculous signs he had performed on the sick.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jewish Passover Feast was near.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?"

column.name: text
column.value: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip answered him, "Eight months' wages would not buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!"

column.name: text
column.value: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, spoke up,

column.name: text
column.value: "Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." There was plenty of grass in that place, and the men sat down, about five thousand of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, "Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted."

column.name: text
column.value: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: After the people saw the miraculous sign that Jesus did, they began to say, "Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.

column.name: text
column.value: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,

column.name: text
column.value: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.

column.name: text
column.value: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had rowed three or three and a half miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were terrified.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to them, "It is I; don't be afraid."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.

column.name: text
column.value: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

column.name: text
column.value: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, "Rabbi, when did you get here?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, you are looking for me, not because you saw miraculous signs but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. On him God the Father has placed his seal of approval."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they asked him, "What must we do to do the works God requires?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent."

column.name: text
column.value: So they asked him, "What miraculous sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?

column.name: text
column.value: Our forefathers ate the manna in the desert; as it is written: 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: For the bread of God is he who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."

column.name: text
column.value: "Sir," they said, "from now on give us this bread."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus declared, "I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will never go hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

column.name: text
column.value: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.

column.name: text
column.value: All that the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all that he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: For my Father's will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day."

column.name: text
column.value: At this the Jews began to grumble about him because he said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."

column.name: text
column.value: They said, "Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, 'I came down from heaven'?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Stop grumbling among yourselves," Jesus answered.

column.name: text
column.value: "No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: It is written in the Prophets: 'They will all be taught by God.' Everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him comes to me.

column.name: text
column.value: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, he who believes has everlasting life.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the bread of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Your forefathers ate the manna in the desert, yet they died.

column.name: text
column.value: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which a man may eat and not die.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your forefathers ate manna and died, but he who feeds on this bread will live forever."

column.name: text
column.value: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, "This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?"

column.name: text
column.value: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, "Does this offend you?

column.name: text
column.value: What if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.

column.name: text
column.value: He went on to say, "This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled him."

column.name: text
column.value: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: "You do not want to leave too, do you?" Jesus asked the Twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: We believe and know that you are the Holy One of God."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus replied, "Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!"

column.name: text
column.value: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

column.name: text
column.value: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.

column.name: text
column.value: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group

column.name: text
column.value: and said to Jesus, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?"

column.name: text
column.value: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.

column.name: text
column.value: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, "If any one of you is without sin, let him be the first to throw a stone at her."

column.name: text
column.value: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus straightened up and asked her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"

column.name: text
column.value: "No one, sir," she said. "Then neither do I condemn you," Jesus declared. "Go now and leave your life of sin."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees challenged him, "Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.

column.name: text
column.value: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I do judge, my decisions are right, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.

column.name: text
column.value: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they asked him, "Where is your father?" "You do not know me or my Father," Jesus replied. "If you knew me, you would know my Father also."

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple area near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his time had not yet come.

column.name: text
column.value: Once more Jesus said to them, "I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come."

column.name: text
column.value: This made the Jews ask, "Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, 'Where I go, you cannot come'?"

column.name: text
column.value: But he continued, "You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

column.name: text
column.value: I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am the one I claim to be, you will indeed die in your sins."

column.name: text
column.value: "Who are you?" they asked. "Just what I have been claiming all along," Jesus replied.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is reliable, and what I have heard from him I tell the world."

column.name: text
column.value: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus said, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am the one I claim to be and that I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father has taught me.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him."

column.name: text
column.value: Even as he spoke, many put their faith in him.

column.name: text
column.value: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, "If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

column.name: text
column.value: They answered him, "We are Abraham's descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.

column.name: text
column.value: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

column.name: text
column.value: I know you are Abraham's descendants. Yet you are ready to kill me, because you have no room for my word.

column.name: text
column.value: I am telling you what I have seen in the Father's presence, and you do what you have heard from your father."

column.name: text
column.value: "Abraham is our father," they answered. "If you were Abraham's children," said Jesus, "then you would do the things Abraham did.

column.name: text
column.value: As it is, you are determined to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.

column.name: text
column.value: You are doing the things your own father does." "We are not illegitimate children," they protested. "The only Father we have is God himself."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God and now am here. I have not come on my own; but he sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father's desire. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!

column.name: text
column.value: Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don't you believe me?

column.name: text
column.value: He who belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God."

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews answered him, "Aren't we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?"

column.name: text
column.value: "I am not possessed by a demon," said Jesus, "but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, if anyone keeps my word, he will never see death."

column.name: text
column.value: At this the Jews exclaimed, "Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that if anyone keeps your word, he will never taste death.

column.name: text
column.value: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.

column.name: text
column.value: Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and keep his word.

column.name: text
column.value: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad."

column.name: text
column.value: "You are not yet fifty years old," the Jews said to him, "and you have seen Abraham!"

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth," Jesus answered, "before Abraham was born, I am!"

column.name: text
column.value: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.

column.name: text
column.value: "I tell you the truth, the man who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who enters by the gate is the shepherd of his sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: The watchman opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

column.name: text
column.value: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.

column.name: text
column.value: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger's voice."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus used this figure of speech, but they did not understand what he was telling them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus said again, "I tell you the truth, I am the gate for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: All who ever came before me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. He will come in and go out, and find pasture.

column.name: text
column.value: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: The hired hand is not the shepherd who owns the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.

column.name: text
column.value: The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me--

column.name: text
column.value: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father--and I lay down my life for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life--only to take it up again.

column.name: text
column.value: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father."

column.name: text
column.value: At these words the Jews were again divided.

column.name: text
column.value: Many of them said, "He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?"

column.name: text
column.value: But others said, "These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the Feast of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,

column.name: text
column.value: and Jesus was in the temple area walking in Solomon's Colonnade.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews gathered around him, saying, "How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "I did tell you, but you do not believe. The miracles I do in my Father's name speak for me,

column.name: text
column.value: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one can snatch them out of my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all; no one can snatch them out of my Father's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: I and the Father are one."

column.name: text
column.value: Again the Jews picked up stones to stone him,

column.name: text
column.value: but Jesus said to them, "I have shown you many great miracles from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?"

column.name: text
column.value: "We are not stoning you for any of these," replied the Jews, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your Law, 'I have said you are gods'?

column.name: text
column.value: If he called them 'gods,' to whom the word of God came--and the Scripture cannot be broken--

column.name: text
column.value: what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, 'I am God's Son'?

column.name: text
column.value: Do not believe me unless I do what my Father does.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I do it, even though you do not believe me, believe the miracles, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father."

column.name: text
column.value: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. Here he stayed

column.name: text
column.value: and many people came to him. They said, "Though John never performed a miraculous sign, all that John said about this man was true."

column.name: text
column.value: And in that place many believed in Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

column.name: text
column.value: This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.

column.name: text
column.value: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, "Lord, the one you love is sick."

column.name: text
column.value: When he heard this, Jesus said, "This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for God's glory so that God's Son may be glorified through it."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to his disciples, "Let us go back to Judea."

column.name: text
column.value: "But Rabbi," they said, "a short while ago the Jews tried to stone you, and yet you are going back there?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours of daylight? A man who walks by day will not stumble, for he sees by this world's light.

column.name: text
column.value: It is when he walks by night that he stumbles, for he has no light."

column.name: text
column.value: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up."

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples replied, "Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: So then he told them plainly, "Lazarus is dead,

column.name: text
column.value: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Thomas (called Didymus) said to the rest of the disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him."

column.name: text
column.value: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.

column.name: text
column.value: Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.

column.name: text
column.value: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.

column.name: text
column.value: "Lord," Martha said to Jesus, "if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

column.name: text
column.value: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."

column.name: text
column.value: Martha answered, "I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will live, even though he dies;

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Yes, Lord," she told him, "I believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world."

column.name: text
column.value: And after she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. "The Teacher is here," she said, "and is asking for you."

column.name: text
column.value: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.

column.name: text
column.value: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

column.name: text
column.value: "Where have you laid him?" he asked. "Come and see, Lord," they replied.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus wept.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews said, "See how he loved him!"

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them said, "Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.

column.name: text
column.value: "Take away the stone," he said. "But, Lord," said Martha, the sister of the dead man, "by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said, "Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?"

column.name: text
column.value: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, "Father, I thank you that you have heard me.

column.name: text
column.value: I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me."

column.name: text
column.value: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"

column.name: text
column.value: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, "Take off the grave clothes and let him go."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, put their faith in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. "What are we accomplishing?" they asked. "Here is this man performing many miraculous signs.

column.name: text
column.value: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation."

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, "You know nothing at all!

column.name: text
column.value: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish."

column.name: text
column.value: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,

column.name: text
