column.value: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.

column.name: text
column.value: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the Jews. Instead he withdrew to a region near the desert, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple area they asked one another, "What do you think? Isn't he coming to the Feast at all?"

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that if anyone found out where Jesus was, he should report it so that they might arrest him.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days before the Passover, Jesus arrived at Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Here a dinner was given in Jesus' honor. Martha served, while Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Mary took about a pint of pure nard, an expensive perfume; she poured it on Jesus' feet and wiped his feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.

column.name: text
column.value: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,

column.name: text
column.value: "Why wasn't this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year's wages."

column.name: text
column.value: He did not say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief; as keeper of the money bag, he used to help himself to what was put into it.

column.name: text
column.value: "Leave her alone," Jesus replied. "It was intended that she should save this perfume for the day of my burial.

column.name: text
column.value: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me."

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews found out that Jesus was there and came, not only because of him but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,

column.name: text
column.value: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and putting their faith in him.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day the great crowd that had come for the Feast heard that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, "Hosanna!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Blessed is the King of Israel!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus found a young donkey and sat upon it, as it is written,

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkey's colt."

column.name: text
column.value: At first his disciples did not understand all this. Only after Jesus was glorified did they realize that these things had been written about him and that they had done these things to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the crowd that was with him when he called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to spread the word.

column.name: text
column.value: Many people, because they had heard that he had given this miraculous sign, went out to meet him.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Pharisees said to one another, "See, this is getting us nowhere. Look how the whole world has gone after him!"

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the Feast.

column.name: text
column.value: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, with a request. "Sir," they said, "we would like to see Jesus."

column.name: text
column.value: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who loves his life will lose it, while the man who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now my heart is troubled, and what shall I say? 'Father, save me from this hour'? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.

column.name: text
column.value: Father, glorify your name!" Then a voice came from heaven, "I have glorified it, and will glorify it again."

column.name: text
column.value: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "This voice was for your benefit, not mine.

column.name: text
column.value: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.

column.name: text
column.value: But I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all men to myself."

column.name: text
column.value: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.

column.name: text
column.value: The crowd spoke up, "We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever, so how can you say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up'? Who is this 'Son of Man'?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus told them, "You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. The man who walks in the dark does not know where he is going.

column.name: text
column.value: Put your trust in the light while you have it, so that you may become sons of light." When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Even after Jesus had done all these miraculous signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.

column.name: text
column.value: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: "Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:

column.name: text
column.value: "He has blinded their eyes and deadened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn--and I would heal them."

column.name: text
column.value: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus' glory and spoke about him.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not confess their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;

column.name: text
column.value: for they loved praise from men more than praise from God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus cried out, "When a man believes in me, he does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: When he looks at me, he sees the one who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: "As for the person who hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save it.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; that very word which I spoke will condemn him at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: For I did not speak of my own accord, but the Father who sent me commanded me what to say and how to say it.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say."

column.name: text
column.value: It was just before the Passover Feast. Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he now showed them the full extent of his love.

column.name: text
column.value: The evening meal was being served, and the devil had already prompted Judas Iscariot, son of Simon, to betray Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;

column.name: text
column.value: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

column.name: text
column.value: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples' feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

column.name: text
column.value: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand."

column.name: text
column.value: "No," said Peter, "you shall never wash my feet." Jesus answered, "Unless I wash you, you have no part with me."

column.name: text
column.value: "Then, Lord," Simon Peter replied, "not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "A person who has had a bath needs only to wash his feet; his whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you."

column.name: text
column.value: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. "Do you understand what I have done for you?" he asked them.

column.name: text
column.value: "You call me 'Teacher' and 'Lord,' and rightly so, for that is what I am.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another's feet.

column.name: text
column.value: I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the scripture: 'He who shares my bread has lifted up his heel against me.'

column.name: text
column.value: "I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am He.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me."

column.name: text
column.value: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, "I tell you the truth, one of you is going to betray me."

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.

column.name: text
column.value: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, "Ask him which one he means."

column.name: text
column.value: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, "Lord, who is it?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish." Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, son of Simon.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. "What you are about to do, do quickly," Jesus told him,

column.name: text
column.value: but no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the Feast, or to give something to the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.

column.name: text
column.value: When he was gone, Jesus said, "Now is the Son of Man glorified and God is glorified in him.

column.name: text
column.value: If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.

column.name: text
column.value: "My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.

column.name: text
column.value: "A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: By this all men will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another."

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter asked him, "Lord, where are you going?" Jesus replied, "Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter asked, "Lord, why can't I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus answered, "Will you really lay down your life for me? I tell you the truth, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!

column.name: text
column.value: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Neither this man nor his parents sinned," said Jesus, "but this happened so that the work of God might be displayed in his life.

column.name: text
column.value: As long as it is day, we must do the work of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.

column.name: text
column.value: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world."

column.name: text
column.value: Having said this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man's eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: "Go," he told him, "wash in the Pool of Siloam" (this word means Sent). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

column.name: text
column.value: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, "Isn't this the same man who used to sit and beg?"

column.name: text
column.value: Some claimed that he was. Others said, "No, he only looks like him." But he himself insisted, "I am the man."

column.name: text
column.value: "How then were your eyes opened?" they demanded.

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see."

column.name: text
column.value: "Where is this man?" they asked him. "I don't know," he said.

column.name: text
column.value: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man's eyes was a Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. "He put mud on my eyes," the man replied, "and I washed, and now I see."

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath." But others asked, "How can a sinner do such miraculous signs?" So they were divided.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally they turned again to the blind man, "What have you to say about him? It was your eyes he opened." The man replied, "He is a prophet."

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man's parents.

column.name: text
column.value: "Is this your son?" they asked. "Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?"

column.name: text
column.value: "We know he is our son," the parents answered, "and we know he was born blind.

column.name: text
column.value: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we don't know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself."

column.name: text
column.value: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews, for already the Jews had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.

column.name: text
column.value: That was why his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."

column.name: text
column.value: A second time they summoned the man who had been blind. "Give glory to God," they said. "We know this man is a sinner."

column.name: text
column.value: He replied, "Whether he is a sinner or not, I don't know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then they asked him, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, "I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples, too?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then they hurled insults at him and said, "You are this fellow's disciple! We are disciples of Moses!

column.name: text
column.value: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don't even know where he comes from."

column.name: text
column.value: The man answered, "Now that is remarkable! You don't know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly man who does his will.

column.name: text
column.value: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.

column.name: text
column.value: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing."

column.name: text
column.value: To this they replied, "You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!" And they threw him out.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Who is he, sir?" the man asked. "Tell me so that I may believe in him."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you."

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man said, "Lord, I believe," and he worshiped him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind."

column.name: text
column.value: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, "What? Are we blind too?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do not let your hearts be troubled. Trust in God; trust also in me.

column.name: text
column.value: In my Father's house are many rooms; if it were not so, I would have told you. I am going there to prepare a place for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.

column.name: text
column.value: You know the way to the place where I am going."

column.name: text
column.value: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we don't know where you are going, so how can we know the way?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

column.name: text
column.value: If you really knew me, you would know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him."

column.name: text
column.value: Philip said, "Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered: "Don't you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, 'Show us the Father'?

column.name: text
column.value: Don't you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you are not just my own. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work.

column.name: text
column.value: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the miracles themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, anyone who has faith in me will do what I have been doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Son may bring glory to the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.

column.name: text
column.value: "If you love me, you will obey what I command.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Counselor to be with you forever--

column.name: text
column.value: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him, because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever has my commands and obeys them, he is the one who loves me. He who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love him and show myself to him."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, "But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, "If anyone loves me, he will obey my teaching. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

column.name: text
column.value: He who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: "All this I have spoken while still with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: "You heard me say, 'I am going away and I am coming back to you.' If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.

column.name: text
column.value: I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold on me,

column.name: text
column.value: but the world must learn that I love the Father and that I do exactly what my Father has commanded me. "Come now; let us leave.

column.name: text
column.value: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: "Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.

column.name: text
column.value: For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is eternal life: that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.

column.name: text
column.value: I have brought you glory on earth by completing the work you gave me to do.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.

column.name: text
column.value: For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: I pray for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, for they are yours.

column.name: text
column.value: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name--the name you gave me--so that they may be one as we are one.

column.name: text
column.value: While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.

column.name: text
column.value: They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.

column.name: text
column.value: As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.

column.name: text
column.value: "My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,

column.name: text
column.value: that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one:

column.name: text
column.value: I in them and you in me. May they be brought to complete unity to let the world know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.

column.name: text
column.value: "Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: "Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them."

column.name: text
column.value: When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was an olive grove, and he and his disciples went into it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: So Judas came to the grove, guiding a detachment of soldiers and some officials from the chief priests and Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns and weapons.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, "Who is it you want?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Jesus of Nazareth," they replied. "I am he," Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus said, "I am he," they drew back and fell to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he asked them, "Who is it you want?" And they said, "Jesus of Nazareth."

column.name: text
column.value: "I told you that I am he," Jesus answered. "If you are looking for me, then let these men go."

column.name: text
column.value: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: "I have not lost one of those you gave me."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant's name was Malchus.)

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus commanded Peter, "Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him

column.name: text
column.value: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

column.name: text
column.value: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be good if one man died for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest's courtyard,

column.name: text
column.value: but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the girl on duty there and brought Peter in.

column.name: text
column.value: "You are not one of his disciples, are you?" the girl at the door asked Peter. He replied, "I am not."

column.name: text
column.value: It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have spoken openly to the world," Jesus replied. "I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.

column.name: text
column.value: Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby struck him in the face. "Is this the way you answer the high priest?" he demanded.

column.name: text
column.value: "If I said something wrong," Jesus replied, "testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Annas sent him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: As Simon Peter stood warming himself, he was asked, "You are not one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it, saying, "I am not."

column.name: text
column.value: One of the high priest's servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, "Didn't I see you with him in the olive grove?"

column.name: text
column.value: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews led Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness the Jews did not enter the palace; they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: So Pilate came out to them and asked, "What charges are you bringing against this man?"

column.name: text
column.value: "If he were not a criminal," they replied, "we would not have handed him over to you."

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate said, "Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law." "But we have no right to execute anyone," the Jews objected.

column.name: text
column.value: This happened so that the words Jesus had spoken indicating the kind of death he was going to die would be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Is that your own idea," Jesus asked, "or did others talk to you about me?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Am I a Jew?" Pilate replied. "It was your people and your chief priests who handed you over to me. What is it you have done?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jews. But now my kingdom is from another place."

column.name: text
column.value: "You are a king, then!" said Pilate. Jesus answered, "You are right in saying I am a king. In fact, for this reason I was born, and for this I came into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me."

column.name: text
column.value: "What is truth?" Pilate asked. With this he went out again to the Jews and said, "I find no basis for a charge against him.

column.name: text
column.value: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release 'the king of the Jews'?"

column.name: text
column.value: They shouted back, "No, not him! Give us Barabbas!" Now Barabbas had taken part in a rebellion.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.

column.name: text
column.value: He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunes so that it will be even more fruitful.

column.name: text
column.value: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remain in me, and I will remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine. Neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in me.

column.name: text
column.value: "I am the vine; you are the branches. If a man remains in me and I in him, he will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone does not remain in me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.

column.name: text
column.value: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be given you.

column.name: text
column.value: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: "As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.

column.name: text
column.value: If you obey my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have obeyed my Father's commands and remain in his love.

column.name: text
column.value: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

column.name: text
column.value: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

column.name: text
column.value: You are my friends if you do what I command.

column.name: text
column.value: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

column.name: text
column.value: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you to go and bear fruit--fruit that will last. Then the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.

column.name: text
column.value: This is my command: Love each other.

column.name: text
column.value: "If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.

column.name: text
column.value: If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the words I spoke to you: 'No servant is greater than his master.' If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours also.

column.name: text
column.value: They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the One who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.

column.name: text
column.value: He who hates me hates my Father as well.

column.name: text
column.value: If I had not done among them what no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have seen these miracles, and yet they have hated both me and my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: 'They hated me without reason.'

column.name: text
column.value: "When the Counselor comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father, he will testify about me.

column.name: text
column.value: And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.

column.name: text
column.value: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe

column.name: text
column.value: and went up to him again and again, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!" And they struck him in the face.

column.name: text
column.value: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews, "Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him."

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, "Here is the man!"

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" But Pilate answered, "You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him."

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews insisted, "We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God."

column.name: text
column.value: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,

column.name: text
column.value: and he went back inside the palace. "Where do you come from?" he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.

column.name: text
column.value: "Do you refuse to speak to me?" Pilate said. "Don't you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin."

column.name: text
column.value: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jews kept shouting, "If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar."

column.name: text
column.value: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge's seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).

column.name: text
column.value: It was the day of Preparation of Passover Week, about the sixth hour. "Here is your king," Pilate said to the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: But they shouted, "Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!" "Shall I crucify your king?" Pilate asked. "We have no king but Caesar," the chief priests answered.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).

column.name: text
column.value: Here they crucified him, and with him two others--one on each side and Jesus in the middle.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

column.name: text
column.value: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, "Do not write 'The King of the Jews,' but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews."

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."

column.name: text
column.value: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

column.name: text
column.value: "Let's not tear it," they said to one another. "Let's decide by lot who will get it." This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled which said, "They divided my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing." So this is what the soldiers did.

column.name: text
column.value: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, "Dear woman, here is your son,"

column.name: text
column.value: and to the disciple, "Here is your mother." From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.

column.name: text
column.value: Later, knowing that all was now completed, and so that the Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, "I am thirsty."

column.name: text
column.value: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus' lips.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, "It is finished." With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jews did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.

column.name: text
column.value: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus' side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.

column.name: text
column.value: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: "Not one of his bones will be broken,"

column.name: text
column.value: and, as another scripture says, "They will look on the one they have pierced."

column.name: text
column.value: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jews. With Pilate's permission, he came and took the body away.

column.name: text
column.value: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.

column.name: text
column.value: Taking Jesus' body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.

column.name: text
column.value: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.

column.name: text
column.value: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

column.name: text
column.value: "All this I have told you so that you will not go astray.

column.name: text
column.value: They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.

column.name: text
column.value: They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have told you this, so that when the time comes you will remember that I warned you. I did not tell you this at first because I was with you.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now I am going to him who sent me, yet none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'

column.name: text
column.value: Because I have said these things, you are filled with grief.

column.name: text
column.value: But I tell you the truth: It is for your good that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Counselor will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

column.name: text
column.value: When he comes, he will convict the world of guilt in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: in regard to sin, because men do not believe in me;

column.name: text
column.value: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;

column.name: text
column.value: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.

column.name: text
column.value: He will bring glory to me by taking from what is mine and making it known to you.

column.name: text
column.value: All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will take from what is mine and make it known to you.

column.name: text
column.value: "In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me."

column.name: text
column.value: Some of his disciples said to one another, "What does he mean by saying, 'In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me,' and'Because I am going to the Father'?"

column.name: text
column.value: They kept asking, "What does he mean by'a little while'? We don't understand what he is saying."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this, so he said to them, "Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, 'In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me'?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day you will no longer ask me anything. I tell you the truth, my Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.

column.name: text
column.value: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.

column.name: text
column.value: "Though I have been speaking figuratively, a time is coming when I will no longer use this kind of language but will tell you plainly about my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.

column.name: text
column.value: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus' disciples said, "Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we can see that you know all things and that you do not even need to have anyone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God."

column.name: text
column.value: "You believe at last!" Jesus answered.

column.name: text
column.value: "But a time is coming, and has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own home. You will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, for my Father is with me.

column.name: text
column.value: "I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world."

column.name: text
column.value: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.

column.name: text
column.value: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have put him!"

column.name: text
column.value: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

column.name: text
column.value: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Simon Peter, who was behind him, arrived and went into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,

column.name: text
column.value: as well as the burial cloth that had been around Jesus' head. The cloth was folded up by itself, separate from the linen.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.

column.name: text
column.value: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples went back to their homes,

column.name: text
column.value: but Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb

column.name: text
column.value: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus' body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.

column.name: text
column.value: They asked her, "Woman, why are you crying?" "They have taken my Lord away," she said, "and I don't know where they have put him."

column.name: text
column.value: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: "Woman," he said, "why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?" Thinking he was the gardener, she said, "Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, "Rabboni!" (which means Teacher).

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, "Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet returned to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, 'I am returning to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: "I have seen the Lord!" And she told them that he had said these things to her.

column.name: text
column.value: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"

column.name: text
column.value: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Again Jesus said, "Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you."

column.name: text
column.value: And with that he breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven."

column.name: text
column.value: Now Thomas (called Didymus), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.

column.name: text
column.value: So the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe it."

column.name: text
column.value: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to Thomas, "Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe."

column.name: text
column.value: Thomas said to him, "My Lord and my God!"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus told him, "Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus did many other miraculous signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.

column.name: text
column.value: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Tiberias. It happened this way:

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter, Thomas (called Didymus), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.

column.name: text
column.value: "I'm going out to fish," Simon Peter told them, and they said, "We'll go with you." So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: He called out to them, "Friends, haven't you any fish?" "No," they answered.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, "Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some." When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, "It is the Lord," he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.

column.name: text
column.value: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.

column.name: text
column.value: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish you have just caught."

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter climbed aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, "Come and have breakfast." None of the disciples dared ask him, "Who are you?" They knew it was the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.

column.name: text
column.value: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon son of John, do you truly love me more than these?" "Yes, Lord," he said, "you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Feed my lambs."

column.name: text
column.value: Again Jesus said, "Simon son of John, do you truly love me?" He answered, "Yes, Lord, you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Take care of my sheep."

column.name: text
column.value: The third time he said to him, "Simon son of John, do you love me?" Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, "Do you love me?" He said, "Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Feed my sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you the truth, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go."

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, "Follow me!"

column.name: text
column.value: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, "Lord, who is going to betray you?")

column.name: text
column.value: When Peter saw him, he asked, "Lord, what about him?"

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me."

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?"

column.name: text
column.value: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.

column.name: text
column.value: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach

column.name: text
column.value: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.

column.name: text
column.value: After his suffering, he showed himself to these men and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: "Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.

column.name: text
column.value: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit."

column.name: text
column.value: So when they met together, they asked him, "Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?"

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them: "It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.

column.name: text
column.value: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

column.name: text
column.value: "Men of Galilee," they said, "why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day's walk from the city.

column.name: text
column.value: When they arrived, they went upstairs to the room where they were staying. Those present were Peter, John, James and Andrew; Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew; James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.

column.name: text
column.value: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)

column.name: text
column.value: and said, "Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus--

column.name: text
column.value: he was one of our number and shared in this ministry."

column.name: text
column.value: (With the reward he got for his wickedness, Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines spilled out.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone in Jerusalem heard about this, so they called that field in their language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)

column.name: text
column.value: "For," said Peter, "it is written in the book of Psalms, "'May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,' and, "'May another take his place of leadership.'

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have been with us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

column.name: text
column.value: beginning from John's baptism to the time when Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of his resurrection."

column.name: text
column.value: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they prayed, "Lord, you know everyone's heart. Show us which of these two you have chosen

column.name: text
column.value: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.

column.name: text
column.value: But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day the rulers, elders and teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Annas the high priest was there, and so were Caiaphas, John, Alexander and the other men of the high priest's family.

column.name: text
column.value: They had Peter and John brought before them and began to question them: "By what power or what name did you do this?"

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: "Rulers and elders of the people!

column.name: text
column.value: If we are being called to account today for an act of kindness shown to a cripple and are asked how he was healed,

column.name: text
column.value: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.

column.name: text
column.value: He is "'the stone you builders rejected, which has become the capstone.'

column.name: text
column.value: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved."

column.name: text
column.value: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.

column.name: text
column.value: So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.

column.name: text
column.value: "What are we going to do with these men?" they asked. "Everybody living in Jerusalem knows they have done an outstanding miracle, and we cannot deny it.

column.name: text
column.value: But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn these men to speak no longer to anyone in this name."

column.name: text
column.value: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter and John replied, "Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God's sight to obey you rather than God.

column.name: text
column.value: For we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard."

column.name: text
column.value: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.

column.name: text
column.value: On their release, Peter and John went back to their own people and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard this, they raised their voices together in prayer to God. "Sovereign Lord," they said, "you made the heaven and the earth and the sea, and everything in them.

column.name: text
column.value: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: "'Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against his Anointed One.'

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.

column.name: text
column.value: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform miraculous signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus."

column.name: text
column.value: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.

column.name: text
column.value: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they had.

column.name: text
column.value: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and much grace was upon them all.

column.name: text
column.value: There were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned lands or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales

column.name: text
column.value: and put it at the apostles' feet, and it was distributed to anyone as he had need.

column.name: text
column.value: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means Son of Encouragement),

column.name: text
column.value: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles' feet.

column.name: text
column.value: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer--at three in the afternoon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a man crippled from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.

column.name: text
column.value: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, "Look at us!"

column.name: text
column.value: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said, "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk."

column.name: text
column.value: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man's feet and ankles became strong.

column.name: text
column.value: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.

column.name: text
column.value: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,

column.name: text
column.value: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

column.name: text
column.value: While the beggar held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon's Colonnade.

column.name: text
column.value: When Peter saw this, he said to them: "Men of Israel, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?

column.name: text
column.value: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.

column.name: text
column.value: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.

column.name: text
column.value: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus' name and the faith that comes through him that has given this complete healing to him, as you can all see.

column.name: text
column.value: "Now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.

column.name: text
column.value: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Christ would suffer.

column.name: text
column.value: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,

column.name: text
column.value: and that he may send the Christ, who has been appointed for you--even Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: He must remain in heaven until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses said, 'The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from among his people.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have foretold these days.

column.name: text
column.value: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, 'Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.'

column.name: text
column.value: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."

column.name: text
column.value: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

column.name: text
column.value: Suddenly a sound like the blowing of a violent wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.

column.name: text
column.value: They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

column.name: text
column.value: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard this sound, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking in his own language.

column.name: text
column.value: Utterly amazed, they asked: "Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?

column.name: text
column.value: Then how is it that each of us hears them in his own native language?

column.name: text
column.value: Parthians, Medes and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,

column.name: text
column.value: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome

column.name: text
column.value: (both Jews and converts to Judaism); Cretans and Arabs--we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!"

column.name: text
column.value: Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, "What does this mean?"

column.name: text
column.value: Some, however, made fun of them and said, "They have had too much wine."

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: "Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It's only nine in the morning!

column.name: text
column.value: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:

column.name: text
column.value: "'In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.

column.name: text
column.value: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.

column.name: text
column.value: I will show wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Men of Israel, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.

column.name: text
column.value: This man was handed over to you by God's set purpose and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.

column.name: text
column.value: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.

column.name: text
column.value: David said about him: "'I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will live in hope,

column.name: text
column.value: because you will not abandon me to the grave, nor will you let your Holy One see decay.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.'

column.name: text
column.value: "Brothers, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing what was ahead, he spoke of the resurrection of the Christ, that he was not abandoned to the grave, nor did his body see decay.

column.name: text
column.value: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of the fact.

column.name: text
column.value: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.

column.name: text
column.value: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand

column.name: text
column.value: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." '

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ."

column.name: text
column.value: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, "Brothers, what shall we do?"

column.name: text
column.value: Peter replied, "Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off--for all whom the Lord our God will call."

column.name: text
column.value: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, "Save yourselves from this corrupt generation."

column.name: text
column.value: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.

column.name: text
column.value: They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone was filled with awe, and many wonders and miraculous signs were done by the apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

column.name: text
column.value: Selling their possessions and goods, they gave to anyone as he had need.

column.name: text
column.value: Every day they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts,

column.name: text
column.value: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.

column.name: text
column.value: With his wife's full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles' feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said, "Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?

column.name: text
column.value: Didn't it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn't the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied to men but to God."

column.name: text
column.value: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.

column.name: text
column.value: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter asked her, "Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?" "Yes," she said, "that is the price."

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said to her, "How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also."

column.name: text
column.value: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.

column.name: text
column.value: The apostles performed many miraculous signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon's Colonnade.

column.name: text
