column.value: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

column.name: text
column.value: Since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from God's wrath through him!

column.name: text
column.value: For if, when we were God's enemies, we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!

column.name: text
column.value: Not only is this so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, and in this way death came to all men, because all sinned--

column.name: text
column.value: for before the law was given, sin was in the world. But sin is not taken into account when there is no law.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, death reigned from the time of Adam to the time of Moses, even over those who did not sin by breaking a command, as did Adam, who was a pattern of the one to come.

column.name: text
column.value: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God's grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many!

column.name: text
column.value: Again, the gift of God is not like the result of the one man's sin: The judgment followed one sin and brought condemnation, but the gift followed many trespasses and brought justification.

column.name: text
column.value: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive God's abundant provision of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Consequently, just as the result of one trespass was condemnation for all men, so also the result of one act of righteousness was justification that brings life for all men.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: The law was added so that the trespass might increase. But where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

column.name: text
column.value: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak the truth in Christ--I am not lying, my conscience confirms it in the Holy Spirit--

column.name: text
column.value: I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, those of my own race,

column.name: text
column.value: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory, the covenants, the receiving of the law, the temple worship and the promises.

column.name: text
column.value: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them is traced the human ancestry of Christ, who is God over all, forever praised! Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not as though God's word had failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Nor because they are his descendants are they all Abraham's children. On the contrary, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."

column.name: text
column.value: In other words, it is not the natural children who are God's children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as Abraham's offspring.

column.name: text
column.value: For this was how the promise was stated: "At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son."

column.name: text
column.value: Not only that, but Rebekah's children had one and the same father, our father Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet, before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad--in order that God's purpose in election might stand:

column.name: text
column.value: not by works but by him who calls--she was told, "The older will serve the younger."

column.name: text
column.value: Just as it is written: "Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated."

column.name: text
column.value: What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Not at all!

column.name: text
column.value: For he says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."

column.name: text
column.value: It does not, therefore, depend on man's desire or effort, but on God's mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: "I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display my power in you and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore God has mercy on whom he wants to have mercy, and he hardens whom he wants to harden.

column.name: text
column.value: One of you will say to me: "Then why does God still blame us? For who resists his will?"

column.name: text
column.value: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? "Shall what is formed say to him who formed it, 'Why did you make me like this?'"

column.name: text
column.value: Does not the potter have the right to make out of the same lump of clay some pottery for noble purposes and some for common use?

column.name: text
column.value: What if God, choosing to show his wrath and make his power known, bore with great patience the objects of his wrath--prepared for destruction?

column.name: text
column.value: What if he did this to make the riches of his glory known to the objects of his mercy, whom he prepared in advance for glory--

column.name: text
column.value: even us, whom he also called, not only from the Jews but also from the Gentiles?

column.name: text
column.value: As he says in Hosea: "I will call them 'my people' who are not my people; and I will call her 'my loved one' who is not my loved one,"

column.name: text
column.value: and, "It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, 'You are not my people,' they will be called 'sons of the living God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the Israelites be like the sand by the sea, only the remnant will be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord will carry out his sentence on earth with speed and finality."

column.name: text
column.value: It is just as Isaiah said previously: "Unless the Lord Almighty had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah."

column.name: text
column.value: What then shall we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;

column.name: text
column.value: but Israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.

column.name: text
column.value: Why not? Because they pursued it not by faith but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the "stumbling stone."

column.name: text
column.value: As it is written: "See, I lay in Zion a stone that causes men to stumble and a rock that makes them fall, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set me free from the law of sin and death.

column.name: text
column.value: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the sinful nature, God did by sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful man to be a sin offering. And so he condemned sin in sinful man,

column.name: text
column.value: in order that the righteous requirements of the law might be fully met in us, who do not live according to the sinful nature but according to the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who live according to the sinful nature have their minds set on what that nature desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.

column.name: text
column.value: The mind of sinful man is death, but the mind controlled by the Spirit is life and peace;

column.name: text
column.value: the sinful mind is hostile to God. It does not submit to God's law, nor can it do so.

column.name: text
column.value: Those controlled by the sinful nature cannot please God.

column.name: text
column.value: You, however, are controlled not by the sinful nature but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit, who lives in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation--but it is not to the sinful nature, to live according to it.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you live according to the sinful nature, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the misdeeds of the body, you will live,

column.name: text
column.value: because those who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For you did not receive a spirit that makes you a slave again to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship. And by him we cry, "Abba, Father."

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God's children.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if we are children, then we are heirs--heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.

column.name: text
column.value: The creation waits in eager expectation for the sons of God to be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: For the creation was subjected to frustration, not by its own choice, but by the will of the one who subjected it, in hope

column.name: text
column.value: that the creation itself will be liberated from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

column.name: text
column.value: Not only so, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he already has?

column.name: text
column.value: But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groans that words cannot express.

column.name: text
column.value: And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints in accordance with God's will.

column.name: text
column.value: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

column.name: text
column.value: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the likeness of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: And those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: What, then, shall we say in response to this? If God is for us, who can be against us?

column.name: text
column.value: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all--how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

column.name: text
column.value: Who will bring any charge against those whom God has chosen? It is God who justifies.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is he that condemns? Christ Jesus, who died--more than that, who was raised to life--is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or hardship or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

column.name: text
column.value: As it is written: "For your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered."

column.name: text
column.value: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,

column.name: text
column.value: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is that they may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: For I can testify about them that they are zealous for God, but their zeal is not based on knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they did not know the righteousness that comes from God and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God's righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Christ is the end of the law so that there may be righteousness for everyone who believes.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses describes in this way the righteousness that is by the law: "The man who does these things will live by them."

column.name: text
column.value: But the righteousness that is by faith says: "Do not say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?'" (that is, to bring Christ down)

column.name: text
column.value: "or 'Who will descend into the deep?'" (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).

column.name: text
column.value: But what does it say? "The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart," that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:

column.name: text
column.value: That if you confess with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you confess and are saved.

column.name: text
column.value: As the Scripture says, "Anyone who trusts in him will never be put to shame."

column.name: text
column.value: For there is no difference between Jew and Gentile--the same Lord is Lord of all and richly blesses all who call on him,

column.name: text
column.value: for, "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."

column.name: text
column.value: How, then, can they call on the one they have not believed in? And how can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?

column.name: text
column.value: And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written, "How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!"

column.name: text
column.value: But not all the Israelites accepted the good news. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our message?"

column.name: text
column.value: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But I ask: Did they not hear? Of course they did: "Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world."

column.name: text
column.value: Again I ask: Did Israel not understand? First, Moses says, "I will make you envious by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation that has no understanding."

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah boldly says, "I was found by those who did not seek me; I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me."

column.name: text
column.value: But concerning Israel he says, "All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and obstinate people."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I urge you, brothers, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God--this is your spiritual act of worship.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not conform any longer to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is--his good, pleasing and perfect will.

column.name: text
column.value: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but rather think of yourself with sober judgment, in accordance with the measure of faith God has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function,

column.name: text
column.value: so in Christ we who are many form one body, and each member belongs to all the others.

column.name: text
column.value: We have different gifts, according to the grace given us. If a man's gift is prophesying, let him use it in proportion to his faith.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;

column.name: text
column.value: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is contributing to the needs of others, let him give generously; if it is leadership, let him govern diligently; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.

column.name: text
column.value: Love must be sincere. Hate what is evil; cling to what is good.

column.name: text
column.value: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Honor one another above yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Never be lacking in zeal, but keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Share with God's people who are in need. Practice hospitality.

column.name: text
column.value: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.

column.name: text
column.value: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but be willing to associate with people of low position. Do not be conceited.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everybody.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take revenge, my friends, but leave room for God's wrath, for it is written: "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," says the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary: "If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink. In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head."

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

column.name: text
column.value: I ask then: Did God reject his people? By no means! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: God did not reject his people, whom he foreknew. Don't you know what the Scripture says in the passage about Elijah--how he appealed to God against Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: "Lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars; I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me"?

column.name: text
column.value: And what was God's answer to him? "I have reserved for myself seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal."

column.name: text
column.value: So too, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.

column.name: text
column.value: And if by grace, then it is no longer by works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

column.name: text
column.value: What then? What Israel sought so earnestly it did not obtain, but the elect did. The others were hardened,

column.name: text
column.value: as it is written: "God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes so that they could not see and ears so that they could not hear, to this very day."

column.name: text
column.value: And David says: "May their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them.

column.name: text
column.value: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever."

column.name: text
column.value: Again I ask: Did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Not at all! Rather, because of their transgression, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel envious.

column.name: text
column.value: But if their transgression means riches for the world, and their loss means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!

column.name: text
column.value: I am talking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I make much of my ministry

column.name: text
column.value: in the hope that I may somehow arouse my own people to envy and save some of them.

column.name: text
column.value: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: If the part of the dough offered as firstfruits is holy, then the whole batch is holy; if the root is holy, so are the branches.

column.name: text
column.value: If some of the branches have been broken off, and you, though a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others and now share in the nourishing sap from the olive root,

column.name: text
column.value: do not boast over those branches. If you do, consider this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will say then, "Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in."

column.name: text
column.value: Granted. But they were broken off because of unbelief, and you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: For if God did not spare the natural branches, he will not spare you either.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider therefore the kindness and sternness of God: sternness to those who fell, but kindness to you, provided that you continue in his kindness. Otherwise, you also will be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

column.name: text
column.value: After all, if you were cut out of an olive tree that is wild by nature, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!

column.name: text
column.value: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you may not be conceited: Israel has experienced a hardening in part until the full number of the Gentiles has come in.

column.name: text
column.value: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: "The deliverer will come from Zion; he will turn godlessness away from Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is my covenant with them when I take away their sins."

column.name: text
column.value: As far as the gospel is concerned, they are enemies on your account; but as far as election is concerned, they are loved on account of the patriarchs,

column.name: text
column.value: for God's gifts and his call are irrevocable.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as you who were at one time disobedient to God have now received mercy as a result of their disobedience,

column.name: text
column.value: so they too have now become disobedient in order that they too may now receive mercy as a result of God's mercy to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For God has bound all men over to disobedience so that he may have mercy on them all.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable his judgments, and his paths beyond tracing out!

column.name: text
column.value: "Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?"

column.name: text
column.value: "Who has ever given to God, that God should repay him?"

column.name: text
column.value: For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory forever! Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established. The authorities that exist have been established by God.

column.name: text
column.value: Consequently, he who rebels against the authority is rebelling against what God has instituted, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: For rulers hold no terror for those who do right, but for those who do wrong. Do you want to be free from fear of the one in authority? Then do what is right and he will commend you.

column.name: text
column.value: For he is God's servant to do you good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not bear the sword for nothing. He is God's servant, an agent of wrath to bring punishment on the wrongdoer.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, it is necessary to submit to the authorities, not only because of possible punishment but also because of conscience.

column.name: text
column.value: This is also why you pay taxes, for the authorities are God's servants, who give their full time to governing.

column.name: text
column.value: Give everyone what you owe him: If you owe taxes, pay taxes; if revenue, then revenue; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no debt remain outstanding, except the continuing debt to love one another, for he who loves his fellowman has fulfilled the law.

column.name: text
column.value: The commandments, "Do not commit adultery," "Do not murder," "Do not steal," "Do not covet," and whatever other commandment there may be, are summed up in this one rule: "Love your neighbor as yourself."

column.name: text
column.value: Love does no harm to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: And do this, understanding the present time. The hour has come for you to wake up from your slumber, because our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.

column.name: text
column.value: The night is nearly over; the day is almost here. So let us put aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in orgies and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.

column.name: text
column.value: Rather, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not think about how to gratify the desires of the sinful nature.

column.name: text
column.value: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on disputable matters.

column.name: text
column.value: One man's faith allows him to eat everything, but another man, whose faith is weak, eats only vegetables.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who eats everything must not look down on him who does not, and the man who does not eat everything must not condemn the man who does, for God has accepted him.

column.name: text
column.value: Who are you to judge someone else's servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.

column.name: text
column.value: One man considers one day more sacred than another; another man considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.

column.name: text
column.value: He who regards one day as special, does so to the Lord. He who eats meat, eats to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and he who abstains, does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.

column.name: text
column.value: For none of us lives to himself alone and none of us dies to himself alone.

column.name: text
column.value: If we live, we live to the Lord; and if we die, we die to the Lord. So, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For this very reason, Christ died and returned to life so that he might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.

column.name: text
column.value: You, then, why do you judge your brother? Or why do you look down on your brother? For we will all stand before God's judgment seat.

column.name: text
column.value: It is written: "'As surely as I live,' says the Lord, 'every knee will bow before me; every tongue will confess to God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let us stop passing judgment on one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother's way.

column.name: text
column.value: As one who is in the Lord Jesus, I am fully convinced that no food is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: If your brother is distressed because of what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy your brother for whom Christ died.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not allow what you consider good to be spoken of as evil.

column.name: text
column.value: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: because anyone who serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us therefore make every effort to do what leads to peace and to mutual edification.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a man to eat anything that causes someone else to stumble.

column.name: text
column.value: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything else that will cause your brother to fall.

column.name: text
column.value: So whatever you believe about these things keep between yourself and God. Blessed is the man who does not condemn himself by what he approves.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that does not come from faith is sin.

column.name: text
column.value: We who are strong ought to bear with the failings of the weak and not to please ourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.

column.name: text
column.value: For even Christ did not please himself but, as it is written: "The insults of those who insult you have fallen on me."

column.name: text
column.value: For everything that was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

column.name: text
column.value: May the God who gives endurance and encouragement give you a spirit of unity among yourselves as you follow Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: so that with one heart and mouth you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring praise to God.

column.name: text
column.value: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the Jews on behalf of God's truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs

column.name: text
column.value: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for his mercy, as it is written: "Therefore I will praise you among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to your name."

column.name: text
column.value: Again, it says, "Rejoice, O Gentiles, with his people."

column.name: text
column.value: And again, "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and sing praises to him, all you peoples."

column.name: text
column.value: And again, Isaiah says, "The Root of Jesse will spring up, one who will arise to rule over the nations; the Gentiles will hope in him."

column.name: text
column.value: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: I myself am convinced, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, complete in knowledge and competent to instruct one another.

column.name: text
column.value: I have written you quite boldly on some points, as if to remind you of them again, because of the grace God gave me

column.name: text
column.value: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles with the priestly duty of proclaiming the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I glory in Christ Jesus in my service to God.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obey God by what I have said and done--

column.name: text
column.value: by the power of signs and miracles, through the power of the Spirit. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: It has always been my ambition to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else's foundation.

column.name: text
column.value: Rather, as it is written: "Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand."

column.name: text
column.value: This is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But now that there is no more place for me to work in these regions, and since I have been longing for many years to see you,

column.name: text
column.value: I plan to do so when I go to Spain. I hope to visit you while passing through and to have you assist me on my journey there, after I have enjoyed your company for a while.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem in the service of the saints there.

column.name: text
column.value: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in the Jews' spiritual blessings, they owe it to the Jews to share with them their material blessings.

column.name: text
column.value: So after I have completed this task and have made sure that they have received this fruit, I will go to Spain and visit you on the way.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the full measure of the blessing of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.

column.name: text
column.value: Pray that I may be rescued from the unbelievers in Judea and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there,

column.name: text
column.value: so that by God's will I may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of peace be with you all. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: When I came to you, brothers, I did not come with eloquence or superior wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.

column.name: text
column.value: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: I came to you in weakness and fear, and with much trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: My message and my preaching were not with wise and persuasive words, but with a demonstration of the Spirit's power,

column.name: text
column.value: so that your faith might not rest on men's wisdom, but on God's power.

column.name: text
column.value: We do, however, speak a message of wisdom among the mature, but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: No, we speak of God's secret wisdom, a wisdom that has been hidden and that God destined for our glory before time began.

column.name: text
column.value: None of the rulers of this age understood it, for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

column.name: text
column.value: However, as it is written: "No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no mind has conceived what God has prepared for those who love him"--

column.name: text
column.value: but God has revealed it to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For who among men knows the thoughts of a man except the man's spirit within him? In the same way no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.

column.name: text
column.value: We have not received the spirit of the world but the Spirit who is from God, that we may understand what God has freely given us.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom but in words taught by the Spirit, expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words.

column.name: text
column.value: The man without the Spirit does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him, and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.

column.name: text
column.value: The spiritual man makes judgments about all things, but he himself is not subject to any man's judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: "For who has known the mind of the Lord that he may instruct him?" But we have the mind of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

column.name: text
column.value: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ--their Lord and ours:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I always thank God for you because of his grace given you in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For in him you have been enriched in every way--in all your speaking and in all your knowledge--

column.name: text
column.value: because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: He will keep you strong to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: God, who has called you into fellowship with his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful.

column.name: text
column.value: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree with one another so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be perfectly united in mind and thought.

column.name: text
column.value: My brothers, some from Chloe's household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.

column.name: text
column.value: What I mean is this: One of you says, "I follow Paul"; another, "I follow Apollos"; another, "I follow Cephas"; still another, "I follow Christ."

column.name: text
column.value: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into the name of Paul?

column.name: text
column.value: I am thankful that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,

column.name: text
column.value: so no one can say that you were baptized into my name.

column.name: text
column.value: (Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that, I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.)

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel--not with words of human wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.

column.name: text
column.value: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written: "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate."

column.name: text
column.value: Where is the wise man? Where is the scholar? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

column.name: text
column.value: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.

column.name: text
column.value: Jews demand miraculous signs and Greeks look for wisdom,

column.name: text
column.value: but we preach Christ crucified: a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,

column.name: text
column.value: but to those whom God has called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the foolishness of God is wiser than man's wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than man's strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, think of what you were when you were called. Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were influential; not many were of noble birth.

column.name: text
column.value: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

column.name: text
column.value: He chose the lowly things of this world and the despised things--and the things that are not--to nullify the things that are,

column.name: text
column.value: so that no one may boast before him.

column.name: text
column.value: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God--that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, as it is written: "Let him who boasts boast in the Lord."

column.name: text
column.value: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.

column.name: text
column.value: I ask you to receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints and to give her any help she may need from you, for she has been a great help to many people, including me.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: They risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my dear friend Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Andronicus and Junias, my relatives who have been in prison with me. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Ampliatus, whom I love in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Apelles, tested and approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Herodion, my relative. Greet those in the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, those women who work hard in the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis, another woman who has worked very hard in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me, too.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas and the brothers with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send greetings.

column.name: text
column.value: I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who cause divisions and put obstacles in your way that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Keep away from them.

column.name: text
column.value: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the minds of naive people.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I am full of joy over you; but I want you to be wise about what is good, and innocent about what is evil.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends his greetings to you, as do Lucius, Jason and Sosipater, my relatives.

column.name: text
column.value: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Gaius, whose hospitality I and the whole church here enjoy, sends you his greetings. Erastus, who is the city's director of public works, and our brother Quartus send you their greetings.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to him who is able to establish you by my gospel and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery hidden for long ages past,

column.name: text
column.value: but now revealed and made known through the prophetic writings by the command of the eternal God, so that all nations might believe and obey him--

column.name: text
column.value: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, I could not address you as spiritual but as worldly--mere infants in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for it. Indeed, you are still not ready.

column.name: text
column.value: You are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and quarreling among you, are you not worldly? Are you not acting like mere men?

column.name: text
column.value: For when one says, "I follow Paul," and another, "I follow Apollos," are you not mere men?

column.name: text
column.value: What, after all, is Apollos? And what is Paul? Only servants, through whom you came to believe--as the Lord has assigned to each his task.

column.name: text
column.value: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God made it grow.

column.name: text
column.value: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who plants and the man who waters have one purpose, and each will be rewarded according to his own labor.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are God's fellow workers; you are God's field, God's building.

column.name: text
column.value: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as an expert builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one should be careful how he builds.

column.name: text
column.value: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw,

column.name: text
column.value: his work will be shown for what it is, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will test the quality of each man's work.

column.name: text
column.value: If what he has built survives, he will receive his reward.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss; he himself will be saved, but only as one escaping through the flames.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't you know that you yourselves are God's temple and that God's Spirit lives in you?

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy him; for God's temple is sacred, and you are that temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not deceive yourselves. If any one of you thinks he is wise by the standards of this age, he should become a "fool" so that he may become wise.

column.name: text
column.value: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God's sight. As it is written: "He catches the wise in their craftiness";

column.name: text
column.value: and again, "The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile."

column.name: text
column.value: So then, no more boasting about men! All things are yours,

column.name: text
column.value: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future--all are yours,

column.name: text
column.value: and you are of Christ, and Christ is of God.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and as those entrusted with the secret things of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it is required that those who have been given a trust must prove faithful.

column.name: text
column.value: I care very little if I am judged by you or by any human court; indeed, I do not even judge myself.

column.name: text
column.value: My conscience is clear, but that does not make me innocent. It is the Lord who judges me.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait till the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men's hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, brothers, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us the meaning of the saying, "Do not go beyond what is written." Then you will not take pride in one man over against another.

column.name: text
column.value: For who makes you different from anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?

column.name: text
column.value: Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! You have become kings--and that without us! How I wish that you really had become kings so that we might be kings with you!

column.name: text
column.value: For it seems to me that God has put us apostles on display at the end of the procession, like men condemned to die in the arena. We have been made a spectacle to the whole universe, to angels as well as to men.

column.name: text
column.value: We are fools for Christ, but you are so wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honored, we are dishonored!

column.name: text
column.value: To this very hour we go hungry and thirsty, we are in rags, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.

column.name: text
column.value: We work hard with our own hands. When we are cursed, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;

column.name: text
column.value: when we are slandered, we answer kindly. Up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth, the refuse of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: I am not writing this to shame you, but to warn you, as my dear children.

column.name: text
column.value: Even though you have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers, for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I urge you to imitate me.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I am sending to you Timothy, my son whom I love, who is faithful in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which agrees with what I teach everywhere in every church.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will come to you very soon, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only how these arrogant people are talking, but what power they have.

column.name: text
column.value: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.

column.name: text
column.value: What do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a whip, or in love and with a gentle spirit?

column.name: text
column.value: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that does not occur even among pagans: A man has his father's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And you are proud! Shouldn't you rather have been filled with grief and have put out of your fellowship the man who did this?

column.name: text
column.value: Even though I am not physically present, I am with you in spirit. And I have already passed judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit, and the power of our Lord Jesus is present,

column.name: text
column.value: hand this man over to Satan, so that the sinful nature may be destroyed and his spirit saved on the day of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Your boasting is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast works through the whole batch of dough?

column.name: text
column.value: Get rid of the old yeast that you may be a new batch without yeast--as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let us keep the Festival, not with the old yeast, the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with bread without yeast, the bread of sincerity and truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I have written you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people--

column.name: text
column.value: not at all meaning the people of this world who are immoral, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you would have to leave this world.

column.name: text
column.value: But now I am writing you that you must not associate with anyone who calls himself a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a slanderer, a drunkard or a swindler. With such a man do not even eat.

column.name: text
column.value: What business is it of mine to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?

column.name: text
column.value: God will judge those outside. "Expel the wicked man from among you."

column.name: text
column.value: If any of you has a dispute with another, dare he take it before the ungodly for judgment instead of before the saints?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if you have disputes about such matters, appoint as judges even men of little account in the church!

column.name: text
column.value: I say this to shame you. Is it possible that there is nobody among you wise enough to judge a dispute between believers?

column.name: text
column.value: But instead, one brother goes to law against another--and this in front of unbelievers!

column.name: text
column.value: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means you have been completely defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, and you do this to your brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor male prostitutes nor homosexual offenders

column.name: text
column.value: nor thieves nor the greedy nor drunkards nor slanderers nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: "Everything is permissible for me"--but not everything is beneficial. "Everything is permissible for me"--but I will not be mastered by anything.

column.name: text
column.value: "Food for the stomach and the stomach for food"--but God will destroy them both. The body is not meant for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

column.name: text
column.value: By his power God raised the Lord from the dead, and he will raise us also.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ himself? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, "The two will become one flesh."

column.name: text
column.value: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Flee from sexual immorality. All other sins a man commits are outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;

column.name: text
column.value: you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your body.

column.name: text
column.value: Now for the matters you wrote about: It is good for a man not to marry.

column.name: text
column.value: But since there is so much immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.

column.name: text
column.value: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: The wife's body does not belong to her alone but also to her husband. In the same way, the husband's body does not belong to him alone but also to his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not deprive each other except by mutual consent and for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

column.name: text
column.value: I say this as a concession, not as a command.

column.name: text
column.value: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to the unmarried and the widows I say: It is good for them to stay unmarried, as I am.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry, for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

column.name: text
column.value: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If any brother has a wife who is not a believer and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the unbelieving husband has been sanctified through his wife, and the unbelieving wife has been sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the unbeliever leaves, let him do so. A believing man or woman is not bound in such circumstances; God has called us to live in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or, how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, each one should retain the place in life that the Lord assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is the rule I lay down in all the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man uncircumcised when he was called? He should not be circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God's commands is what counts.

column.name: text
column.value: Each one should remain in the situation which he was in when God called him.

column.name: text
column.value: Were you a slave when you were called? Don't let it trouble you--although if you can gain your freedom, do so.

column.name: text
column.value: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord's freedman; similarly, he who was a free man when he was called is Christ's slave.

column.name: text
column.value: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, each man, as responsible to God, should remain in the situation God called him to.

column.name: text
column.value: Now about virgins: I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord's mercy is trustworthy.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the present crisis, I think that it is good for you to remain as you are.

column.name: text
column.value: Are you married? Do not seek a divorce. Are you unmarried? Do not look for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face many troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.

column.name: text
column.value: What I mean, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;

column.name: text
column.value: those who mourn, as if they did not; those who are happy, as if they were not; those who buy something, as if it were not theirs to keep;

column.name: text
column.value: those who use the things of the world, as if not engrossed in them. For this world in its present form is passing away.

column.name: text
column.value: I would like you to be free from concern. An unmarried man is concerned about the Lord's affairs--how he can please the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: But a married man is concerned about the affairs of this world--how he can please his wife--

column.name: text
column.value: and his interests are divided. An unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the Lord's affairs: Her aim is to be devoted to the Lord in both body and spirit. But a married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world--how she can please her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but that you may live in a right way in undivided devotion to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone thinks he is acting improperly toward the virgin he is engaged to, and if she is getting along in years and he feels he ought to marry, he should do as he wants. He is not sinning. They should get married.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man who has settled the matter in his own mind, who is under no compulsion but has control over his own will, and who has made up his mind not to marry the virgin--this man also does the right thing.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, he who marries the virgin does right, but he who does not marry her does even better.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but he must belong to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: In my judgment, she is happier if she stays as she is--and I think that I too have the Spirit of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all possess knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man who loves God is known by God.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world and that there is no God but one.

column.name: text
column.value: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as indeed there are many "gods" and many "lords"),

column.name: text
column.value: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we live; and there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we live.

column.name: text
column.value: But not everyone knows this. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that when they eat such food they think of it as having been sacrificed to an idol, and since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: But food does not bring us near to God; we are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful, however, that the exercise of your freedom does not become a stumbling block to the weak.

column.name: text
column.value: For if anyone with a weak conscience sees you who have this knowledge eating in an idol's temple, won't he be emboldened to eat what has been sacrificed to idols?

column.name: text
column.value: So this weak brother, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: When you sin against your brothers in this way and wound their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother to fall into sin, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause him to fall.

column.name: text
column.value: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not the result of my work in the Lord?

column.name: text
column.value: Even though I may not be an apostle to others, surely I am to you! For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: This is my defense to those who sit in judgment on me.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't we have the right to food and drink?

column.name: text
column.value: Don't we have the right to take a believing wife along with us, as do the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Cephas?

column.name: text
column.value: Or is it only I and Barnabas who must work for a living?

column.name: text
column.value: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its grapes? Who tends a flock and does not drink of the milk?

column.name: text
column.value: Do I say this merely from a human point of view? Doesn't the Law say the same thing?

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written in the Law of Moses: "Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain." Is it about oxen that God is concerned?

column.name: text
column.value: Surely he says this for us, doesn't he? Yes, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they ought to do so in the hope of sharing in the harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much if we reap a material harvest from you?

column.name: text
column.value: If others have this right of support from you, shouldn't we have it all the more? But we did not use this right. On the contrary, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't you know that those who work in the temple get their food from the temple, and those who serve at the altar share in what is offered on the altar?

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this in the hope that you will do such things for me. I would rather die than have anyone deprive me of this boast.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet when I preach the gospel, I cannot boast, for I am compelled to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!

column.name: text
column.value: If I preach voluntarily, I have a reward; if not voluntarily, I am simply discharging the trust committed to me.

column.name: text
column.value: What then is my reward? Just this: that in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not make use of my rights in preaching it.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I am free and belong to no man, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.

column.name: text
column.value: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), so as to win those under the law.

column.name: text
column.value: To those not having the law I became like one not having the law (though I am not free from God's law but am under Christ's law), so as to win those not having the law.

column.name: text
column.value: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all men so that by all possible means I might save some.

column.name: text
column.value: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, that I may share in its blessings.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last; but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I do not run like a man running aimlessly; I do not fight like a man beating the air.

column.name: text
column.value: No, I beat my body and make it my slave so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified for the prize.

column.name: text
column.value: For I do not want you to be ignorant of the fact, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud and that they all passed through the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: They all ate the same spiritual food

column.name: text
column.value: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them; their bodies were scattered over the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these things occurred as examples to keep us from setting our hearts on evil things as they did.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were; as it is written: "The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in pagan revelry."

column.name: text
column.value: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did--and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.

column.name: text
column.value: We should not test the Lord, as some of them did--and were killed by snakes.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not grumble, as some of them did--and were killed by the destroying angel.

column.name: text
column.value: These things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.

column.name: text
column.value: So, if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you don't fall!

column.name: text
column.value: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can stand up under it.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my dear friends, flee from idolatry.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak to sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: Is not the cup of thanksgiving for which we give thanks a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?

column.name: text
column.value: Because there is one loaf, we, who are many, are one body, for we all partake of the one loaf.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the people of Israel: Do not those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

column.name: text
column.value: Do I mean then that a sacrifice offered to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

column.name: text
column.value: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God, and I do not want you to be participants with demons.

column.name: text
column.value: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot have a part in both the Lord's table and the table of demons.

column.name: text
column.value: Are we trying to arouse the Lord's jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

column.name: text
column.value: "Everything is permissible"--but not everything is beneficial. "Everything is permissible"--but not everything is constructive.

column.name: text
column.value: Nobody should seek his own good, but the good of others.

column.name: text
column.value: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,

column.name: text
column.value: for, "The earth is the Lord's, and everything in it."

column.name: text
column.value: If some unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat whatever is put before you without raising questions of conscience.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone says to you, "This has been offered in sacrifice," then do not eat it, both for the sake of the man who told you and for conscience' sake--

column.name: text
column.value: the other man's conscience, I mean, not yours. For why should my freedom be judged by another's conscience?

column.name: text
column.value: If I take part in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of something I thank God for?

column.name: text
column.value: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not cause anyone to stumble, whether Jews, Greeks or the church of God--

column.name: text
column.value: even as I try to please everybody in every way. For I am not seeking my own good but the good of many, so that they may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I praise you for remembering me in everything and for holding to the teachings, just as I passed them on to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I want you to realize that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

column.name: text
column.value: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head--it is just as though her head were shaved.

column.name: text
column.value: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off; and if it is a disgrace for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.

column.name: text
column.value: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.

column.name: text
column.value: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man;

column.name: text
column.value: neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason, and because of the angels, the woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head.

column.name: text
column.value: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.

column.name: text
column.value: For as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.

column.name: text
column.value: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?

column.name: text
column.value: Does not the very nature of things teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,

column.name: text
column.value: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone wants to be contentious about this, we have no other practice--nor do the churches of God.

column.name: text
column.value: In the following directives I have no praise for you, for your meetings do more harm than good.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first place, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and to some extent I believe it.

column.name: text
column.value: No doubt there have to be differences among you to show which of you have God's approval.

column.name: text
column.value: When you come together, it is not the Lord's Supper you eat,

column.name: text
column.value: for as you eat, each of you goes ahead without waiting for anybody else. One remains hungry, another gets drunk.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't you have homes to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? Certainly not!

column.name: text
column.value: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night he was betrayed, took bread,

column.name: text
column.value: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, "This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me."

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, whenever you drink it, in remembrance of me."

column.name: text
column.value: For whenever you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: A man ought to examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.

column.name: text
column.value: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body of the Lord eats and drinks judgment on himself.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: But if we judged ourselves, we would not come under judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: When we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for each other.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you meet together it may not result in judgment. And when I come I will give further directions.

column.name: text
