column.value: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be ignorant.

column.name: text
column.value: You know that when you were pagans, somehow or other you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I tell you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, "Jesus be cursed," and no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," except by the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: There are different kinds of service, but the same Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: There are different kinds of working, but the same God works all of them in all men.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.

column.name: text
column.value: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by means of the same Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: to another miraculous powers, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in different kinds of tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.

column.name: text
column.value: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he gives them to each one, just as he determines.

column.name: text
column.value: The body is a unit, though it is made up of many parts; and though all its parts are many, they form one body. So it is with Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For we were all baptized by one Spirit into one body--whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free--and we were all given the one Spirit to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the body is not made up of one part but of many.

column.name: text
column.value: If the foot should say, "Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body," it would not for that reason cease to be part of the body.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the ear should say, "Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body," it would not for that reason cease to be part of the body.

column.name: text
column.value: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?

column.name: text
column.value: But in fact God has arranged the parts in the body, every one of them, just as he wanted them to be.

column.name: text
column.value: If they were all one part, where would the body be?

column.name: text
column.value: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.

column.name: text
column.value: The eye cannot say to the hand, "I don't need you!" And the head cannot say to the feet, "I don't need you!"

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,

column.name: text
column.value: and the parts that we think are less honorable we treat with special honor. And the parts that are unpresentable are treated with special modesty,

column.name: text
column.value: while our presentable parts need no special treatment. But God has combined the members of the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,

column.name: text
column.value: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its parts should have equal concern for each other.

column.name: text
column.value: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now you are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, also those having gifts of healing, those able to help others, those with gifts of administration, and those speaking in different kinds of tongues.

column.name: text
column.value: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

column.name: text
column.value: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

column.name: text
column.value: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.

column.name: text
column.value: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

column.name: text
column.value: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: If I give all I possess to the poor and surrender my body to the flames, but have not love, I gain nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.

column.name: text
column.value: Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

column.name: text
column.value: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

column.name: text
column.value: but when perfection comes, the imperfect disappears.

column.name: text
column.value: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put childish ways behind me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we see but a poor reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

column.name: text
column.value: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

column.name: text
column.value: Follow the way of love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.

column.name: text
column.value: For anyone who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries with his spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: But everyone who prophesies speaks to men for their strengthening, encouragement and comfort.

column.name: text
column.value: He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church.

column.name: text
column.value: I would like every one of you to speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the church may be edified.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, brothers, if I come to you and speak in tongues, what good will I be to you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or word of instruction?

column.name: text
column.value: Even in the case of lifeless things that make sounds, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone know what tune is being played unless there is a distinction in the notes?

column.name: text
column.value: Again, if the trumpet does not sound a clear call, who will get ready for battle?

column.name: text
column.value: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.

column.name: text
column.value: Undoubtedly there are all sorts of languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

column.name: text
column.value: If then I do not grasp the meaning of what someone is saying, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.

column.name: text
column.value: So it is with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, try to excel in gifts that build up the church.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason anyone who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret what he says.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

column.name: text
column.value: So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind; I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.

column.name: text
column.value: If you are praising God with your spirit, how can one who finds himself among those who do not understand say "Amen" to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?

column.name: text
column.value: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other man is not edified.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be adults.

column.name: text
column.value: In the Law it is written: "Through men of strange tongues and through the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to me," says the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers but for unbelievers; prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.

column.name: text
column.value: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who do not understand or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your mind?

column.name: text
column.value: But if an unbeliever or someone who does not understand comes in while everybody is prophesying, he will be convinced by all that he is a sinner and will be judged by all,

column.name: text
column.value: and the secrets of his heart will be laid bare. So he will fall down and worship God, exclaiming, "God is really among you!"

column.name: text
column.value: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a hymn, or a word of instruction, a revelation, a tongue or an interpretation. All of these must be done for the strengthening of the church.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two--or at the most three--should speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.

column.name: text
column.value: If there is no interpreter, the speaker should keep quiet in the church and speak to himself and God.

column.name: text
column.value: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a revelation comes to someone who is sitting down, the first speaker should stop.

column.name: text
column.value: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.

column.name: text
column.value: The spirits of prophets are subject to the control of prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace. As in all the congregations of the saints,

column.name: text
column.value: women should remain silent in the churches. They are not allowed to speak, but must be in submission, as the Law says.

column.name: text
column.value: If they want to inquire about something, they should ask their own husbands at home; for it is disgraceful for a woman to speak in the church.

column.name: text
column.value: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only people it has reached?

column.name: text
column.value: If anybody thinks he is a prophet or spiritually gifted, let him acknowledge that what I am writing to you is the Lord's command.

column.name: text
column.value: If he ignores this, he himself will be ignored.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

column.name: text
column.value: But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received and on which you have taken your stand.

column.name: text
column.value: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

column.name: text
column.value: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

column.name: text
column.value: and that he appeared to Peter, and then to the Twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: After that, he appeared to more than five hundred of the brothers at the same time, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

column.name: text
column.value: and last of all he appeared to me also, as to one abnormally born.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the least of the apostles and do not even deserve to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect. No, I worked harder than all of them--yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.

column.name: text
column.value: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

column.name: text
column.value: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is useless and so is your faith.

column.name: text
column.value: More than that, we are then found to be false witnesses about God, for we have testified about God that he raised Christ from the dead. But he did not raise him if in fact the dead are not raised.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the dead are not raised, then Christ has not been raised either.

column.name: text
column.value: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ are lost.

column.name: text
column.value: If only for this life we have hope in Christ, we are to be pitied more than all men.

column.name: text
column.value: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.

column.name: text
column.value: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

column.name: text
column.value: But each in his own turn: Christ, the firstfruits; then, when he comes, those who belong to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the end will come, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father after he has destroyed all dominion, authority and power.

column.name: text
column.value: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

column.name: text
column.value: For he "has put everything under his feet." Now when it says that "everything" has been put under him, it is clear that this does not include God himself, who put everything under Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: When he has done this, then the Son himself will be made subject to him who put everything under him, so that God may be all in all.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if there is no resurrection, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

column.name: text
column.value: And as for us, why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

column.name: text
column.value: I die every day--I mean that, brothers--just as surely as I glory over you in Christ Jesus our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for merely human reasons, what have I gained? If the dead are not raised, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be misled: "Bad company corrupts good character."

column.name: text
column.value: Come back to your senses as you ought, and stop sinning; for there are some who are ignorant of God--I say this to your shame.

column.name: text
column.value: But someone may ask, "How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?"

column.name: text
column.value: How foolish! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

column.name: text
column.value: When you sow, you do not plant the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or of something else.

column.name: text
column.value: But God gives it a body as he has determined, and to each kind of seed he gives its own body.

column.name: text
column.value: All flesh is not the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another and fish another.

column.name: text
column.value: There are also heavenly bodies and there are earthly bodies; but the splendor of the heavenly bodies is one kind, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is another.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun has one kind of splendor, the moon another and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead. The body that is sown is perishable, it is raised imperishable;

column.name: text
column.value: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;

column.name: text
column.value: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

column.name: text
column.value: So it is written: "The first man Adam became a living being"; the last Adam, a life-giving spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: The spiritual did not come first, but the natural, and after that the spiritual.

column.name: text
column.value: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: As was the earthly man, so are those who are of the earth; and as is the man from heaven, so also are those who are of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so shall we bear the likeness of the man from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed--

column.name: text
column.value: in a flash, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

column.name: text
column.value: For the perishable must clothe itself with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

column.name: text
column.value: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come true: "Death has been swallowed up in victory."

column.name: text
column.value: "Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?"

column.name: text
column.value: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

column.name: text
column.value: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my dear brothers, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

column.name: text
column.value: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the sufferings of Christ flow over into our lives, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.

column.name: text
column.value: If we are distressed, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we suffer.

column.name: text
column.value: And our hope for you is firm, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you share in our comfort.

column.name: text
column.value: We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers, about the hardships we suffered in the province of Asia. We were under great pressure, far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, in our hearts we felt the sentence of death. But this happened that we might not rely on ourselves but on God, who raises the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us. On him we have set our hope that he will continue to deliver us,

column.name: text
column.value: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the gracious favor granted us in answer to the prayers of many.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in our relations with you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God. We have done so not according to worldly wisdom but according to God's grace.

column.name: text
column.value: For we do not write you anything you cannot read or understand. And I hope that,

column.name: text
column.value: as you have understood us in part, you will come to understand fully that you can boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Because I was confident of this, I planned to visit you first so that you might benefit twice.

column.name: text
column.value: I planned to visit you on my way to Macedonia and to come back to you from Macedonia, and then to have you send me on my way to Judea.

column.name: text
column.value: When I planned this, did I do it lightly? Or do I make my plans in a worldly manner so that in the same breath I say, "Yes, yes" and "No, no"?

column.name: text
column.value: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not "Yes" and "No."

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by me and Silas and Timothy, was not "Yes" and "No," but in him it has always been "Yes."

column.name: text
column.value: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are "Yes" in Christ. And so through him the "Amen" is spoken by us to the glory of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it is God who makes both us and you stand firm in Christ. He anointed us,

column.name: text
column.value: set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

column.name: text
column.value: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we work with you for your joy, because it is by faith you stand firm.

column.name: text
column.value: Now about the collection for God's people: Do what I told the Galatian churches to do.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day of every week, each one of you should set aside a sum of money in keeping with his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will have to be made.

column.name: text
column.value: Then, when I arrive, I will give letters of introduction to the men you approve and send them with your gift to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: If it seems advisable for me to go also, they will accompany me.

column.name: text
column.value: After I go through Macedonia, I will come to you--for I will be going through Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not want to see you now and make only a passing visit; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will stay on at Ephesus until Pentecost,

column.name: text
column.value: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many who oppose me.

column.name: text
column.value: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is carrying on the work of the Lord, just as I am.

column.name: text
column.value: No one, then, should refuse to accept him. Send him on his way in peace so that he may return to me. I am expecting him along with the brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was quite unwilling to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

column.name: text
column.value: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be men of courage; be strong.

column.name: text
column.value: Do everything in love.

column.name: text
column.value: You know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. I urge you, brothers,

column.name: text
column.value: to submit to such as these and to everyone who joins in the work, and labors at it.

column.name: text
column.value: I was glad when Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

column.name: text
column.value: For they refreshed my spirit and yours also. Such men deserve recognition.

column.name: text
column.value: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

column.name: text
column.value: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone does not love the Lord--a curse be on him. Come, O Lord!

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: So I made up my mind that I would not make another painful visit to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I grieve you, who is left to make me glad but you whom I have grieved?

column.name: text
column.value: I wrote as I did so that when I came I should not be distressed by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would all share my joy.

column.name: text
column.value: For I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to grieve you but to let you know the depth of my love for you.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone has caused grief, he has not so much grieved me as he has grieved all of you, to some extent--not to put it too severely.

column.name: text
column.value: The punishment inflicted on him by the majority is sufficient for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: I urge you, therefore, to reaffirm your love for him.

column.name: text
column.value: The reason I wrote you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.

column.name: text
column.value: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And what I have forgiven--if there was anything to forgive--I have forgiven in the sight of Christ for your sake,

column.name: text
column.value: in order that Satan might not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and found that the Lord had opened a door for me,

column.name: text
column.value: I still had no peace of mind, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said good-by to them and went on to Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumphal procession in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of him.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are to God the aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.

column.name: text
column.value: To the one we are the smell of death; to the other, the fragrance of life. And who is equal to such a task?

column.name: text
column.value: Unlike so many, we do not peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, like men sent from God.

column.name: text
column.value: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?

column.name: text
column.value: You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, known and read by everybody.

column.name: text
column.value: You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Such confidence as this is ours through Christ before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim anything for ourselves, but our competence comes from God.

column.name: text
column.value: He has made us competent as ministers of a new covenant--not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if the ministry that brought death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the Israelites could not look steadily at the face of Moses because of its glory, fading though it was,

column.name: text
column.value: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?

column.name: text
column.value: If the ministry that condemns men is glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry that brings righteousness!

column.name: text
column.value: For what was glorious has no glory now in comparison with the surpassing glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which lasts!

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.

column.name: text
column.value: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at it while the radiance was fading away.

column.name: text
column.value: But their minds were made dull, for to this day the same veil remains when the old covenant is read. It has not been removed, because only in Christ is it taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: Even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

column.name: text
column.value: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his likeness with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since through God's mercy we have this ministry, we do not lose heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Rather, we have renounced secret and shameful ways; we do not use deception, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by setting forth the truth plainly we commend ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.

column.name: text
column.value: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so that they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For we do not preach ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.

column.name: text
column.value: For God, who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

column.name: text
column.value: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;

column.name: text
column.value: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

column.name: text
column.value: For we who are alive are always being given over to death for Jesus' sake, so that his life may be revealed in our mortal body.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.

column.name: text
column.value: It is written: "I believed; therefore I have spoken." With that same spirit of faith we also believe and therefore speak,

column.name: text
column.value: because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus from the dead will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you in his presence.

column.name: text
column.value: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is reaching more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow to the glory of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

column.name: text
column.value: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

column.name: text
column.value: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

column.name: text
column.value: As God's fellow workers we urge you not to receive God's grace in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: For he says, "In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you." I tell you, now is the time of God's favor, now is the day of salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: We put no stumbling block in anyone's path, so that our ministry will not be discredited.

column.name: text
column.value: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships and distresses;

column.name: text
column.value: in beatings, imprisonments and riots; in hard work, sleepless nights and hunger;

column.name: text
column.value: in purity, understanding, patience and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;

column.name: text
column.value: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;

column.name: text
column.value: through glory and dishonor, bad report and good report; genuine, yet regarded as impostors;

column.name: text
column.value: known, yet regarded as unknown; dying, and yet we live on; beaten, and yet not killed;

column.name: text
column.value: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.

column.name: text
column.value: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians, and opened wide our hearts to you.

column.name: text
column.value: We are not withholding our affection from you, but you are withholding yours from us.

column.name: text
column.value: As a fair exchange--I speak as to my children--open wide your hearts also.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers. For what do righteousness and wickedness have in common? Or what fellowship can light have with darkness?

column.name: text
column.value: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? What does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?

column.name: text
column.value: What agreement is there between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: "I will live with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people."

column.name: text
column.value: "Therefore come out from them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you."

column.name: text
column.value: "I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty."

column.name: text
column.value: Now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,

column.name: text
column.value: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.

column.name: text
column.value: For while we are in this tent, we groan and are burdened, because we do not wish to be unclothed but to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it is God who has made us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we are always confident and know that as long as we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: We live by faith, not by sight.

column.name: text
column.value: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: So we make it our goal to please him, whether we are at home in the body or away from it.

column.name: text
column.value: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive what is due him for the things done while in the body, whether good or bad.

column.name: text
column.value: Since, then, we know what it is to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is plain to God, and I hope it is also plain to your conscience.

column.name: text
column.value: We are not trying to commend ourselves to you again, but are giving you an opportunity to take pride in us, so that you can answer those who take pride in what is seen rather than in what is in the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: If we are out of our mind, it is for the sake of God; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ's love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, and therefore all died.

column.name: text
column.value: And he died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for him who died for them and was raised again.

column.name: text
column.value: So from now on we regard no one from a worldly point of view. Though we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has gone, the new has come!

column.name: text
column.value: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

column.name: text
column.value: that God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ, not counting men's sins against them. And he has committed to us the message of reconciliation.

column.name: text
column.value: We are therefore Christ's ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ's behalf: Be reconciled to God.

column.name: text
column.value: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: By the meekness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you--I, Paul, who am "timid" when face to face with you, but "bold" when away!

column.name: text
column.value: I beg you that when I come I may not have to be as bold as I expect to be toward some people who think that we live by the standards of this world.

column.name: text
column.value: For though we live in the world, we do not wage war as the world does.

column.name: text
column.value: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

column.name: text
column.value: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, once your obedience is complete.

column.name: text
column.value: You are looking only on the surface of things. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should consider again that we belong to Christ just as much as he.

column.name: text
column.value: For even if I boast somewhat freely about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than pulling you down, I will not be ashamed of it.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you with my letters.

column.name: text
column.value: For some say, "His letters are weighty and forceful, but in person he is unimpressive and his speaking amounts to nothing."

column.name: text
column.value: Such people should realize that what we are in our letters when we are absent, we will be in our actions when we are present.

column.name: text
column.value: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they are not wise.

column.name: text
column.value: We, however, will not boast beyond proper limits, but will confine our boasting to the field God has assigned to us, a field that reaches even to you.

column.name: text
column.value: We are not going too far in our boasting, as would be the case if we had not come to you, for we did get as far as you with the gospel of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither do we go beyond our limits by boasting of work done by others. Our hope is that, as your faith continues to grow, our area of activity among you will greatly expand,

column.name: text
column.value: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. For we do not want to boast about work already done in another man's territory.

column.name: text
column.value: But, "Let him who boasts boast in the Lord."

column.name: text
column.value: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the Macedonian churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the most severe trial, their overflowing joy and their extreme poverty welled up in rich generosity.

column.name: text
column.value: For I testify that they gave as much as they were able, and even beyond their ability. Entirely on their own,

column.name: text
column.value: they urgently pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: And they did not do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us in keeping with God's will.

column.name: text
column.value: So we urged Titus, since he had earlier made a beginning, to bring also to completion this act of grace on your part.

column.name: text
column.value: But just as you excel in everything--in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness and in your love for us--see that you also excel in this grace of giving.

column.name: text
column.value: I am not commanding you, but I want to test the sincerity of your love by comparing it with the earnestness of others.

column.name: text
column.value: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.

column.name: text
column.value: And here is my advice about what is best for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give but also to have the desire to do so.

column.name: text
column.value: Now finish the work, so that your eager willingness to do it may be matched by your completion of it, according to your means.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the willingness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.

column.name: text
column.value: Our desire is not that others might be relieved while you are hard pressed, but that there might be equality.

column.name: text
column.value: At the present time your plenty will supply what they need, so that in turn their plenty will supply what you need. Then there will be equality,

column.name: text
column.value: as it is written: "He who gathered much did not have too much, and he who gathered little did not have too little."

column.name: text
column.value: I thank God, who put into the heart of Titus the same concern I have for you.

column.name: text
column.value: For Titus not only welcomed our appeal, but he is coming to you with much enthusiasm and on his own initiative.

column.name: text
column.value: And we are sending along with him the brother who is praised by all the churches for his service to the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: What is more, he was chosen by the churches to accompany us as we carry the offering, which we administer in order to honor the Lord himself and to show our eagerness to help.

column.name: text
column.value: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this liberal gift.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are taking pains to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord but also in the eyes of men.

column.name: text
column.value: In addition, we are sending with them our brother who has often proved to us in many ways that he is zealous, and now even more so because of his great confidence in you.

column.name: text
column.value: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you; as for our brothers, they are representatives of the churches and an honor to Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our pride in you, so that the churches can see it.

column.name: text
column.value: I hope you will put up with a little of my foolishness; but you are already doing that.

column.name: text
column.value: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. I promised you to one husband, to Christ, so that I might present you as a pure virgin to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But I am afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent's cunning, your minds may somehow be led astray from your sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For if someone comes to you and preaches a Jesus other than the Jesus we preached, or if you receive a different spirit from the one you received, or a different gospel from the one you accepted, you put up with it easily enough.

column.name: text
column.value: But I do not think I am in the least inferior to those "super-apostles."

column.name: text
column.value: I may not be a trained speaker, but I do have knowledge. We have made this perfectly clear to you in every way.

column.name: text
column.value: Was it a sin for me to lower myself in order to elevate you by preaching the gospel of God to you free of charge?

column.name: text
column.value: I robbed other churches by receiving support from them so as to serve you.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I was with you and needed something, I was not a burden to anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I needed. I have kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.

column.name: text
column.value: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, nobody in the regions of Achaia will stop this boasting of mine.

column.name: text
column.value: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!

column.name: text
column.value: And I will keep on doing what I am doing in order to cut the ground from under those who want an opportunity to be considered equal with us in the things they boast about.

column.name: text
column.value: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workmen, masquerading as apostles of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will be what their actions deserve.

column.name: text
column.value: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me just as you would a fool, so that I may do a little boasting.

column.name: text
column.value: In this self-confident boasting I am not talking as the Lord would, but as a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: Since many are boasting in the way the world does, I too will boast.

column.name: text
column.value: You gladly put up with fools since you are so wise!

column.name: text
column.value: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or pushes himself forward or slaps you in the face.

column.name: text
column.value: To my shame I admit that we were too weak for that! What anyone else dares to boast about--I am speaking as a fool--I also dare to boast about.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham's descendants? So am I.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they servants of Christ? (I am out of my mind to talk like this.) I am more. I have worked much harder, been in prison more frequently, been flogged more severely, and been exposed to death again and again.

column.name: text
column.value: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked, I spent a night and a day in the open sea,

column.name: text
column.value: I have been constantly on the move. I have been in danger from rivers, in danger from bandits, in danger from my own countrymen, in danger from Gentiles; in danger in the city, in danger in the country, in danger at sea; and in danger from false brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: I have labored and toiled and have often gone without sleep; I have known hunger and thirst and have often gone without food; I have been cold and naked.

column.name: text
column.value: Besides everything else, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is weak, and I do not feel weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not inwardly burn?

column.name: text
column.value: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.

column.name: text
column.value: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is to be praised forever, knows that I am not lying.

column.name: text
column.value: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas had the city of the Damascenes guarded in order to arrest me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I was lowered in a basket from a window in the wall and slipped through his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no need for me to write to you about this service to the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting about it to the Macedonians, telling them that since last year you in Achaia were ready to give; and your enthusiasm has stirred most of them to action.

column.name: text
column.value: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove hollow, but that you may be ready, as I said you would be.

column.name: text
column.value: For if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we--not to say anything about you--would be ashamed of having been so confident.

column.name: text
column.value: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you in advance and finish the arrangements for the generous gift you had promised. Then it will be ready as a generous gift, not as one grudgingly given.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

column.name: text
column.value: Each man should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

column.name: text
column.value: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

column.name: text
column.value: As it is written: "He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever."

column.name: text
column.value: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be made rich in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will result in thanksgiving to God.

column.name: text
column.value: This service that you perform is not only supplying the needs of God's people but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanks to God.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the service by which you have proved yourselves, men will praise God for the obedience that accompanies your confession of the gospel of Christ, and for your generosity in sharing with them and with everyone else.

column.name: text
column.value: And in their prayers for you their hearts will go out to you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!

column.name: text
column.value: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to be gained, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of the body I do not know--God knows.

column.name: text
column.value: And I know that this man--whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, but God knows--

column.name: text
column.value: was caught up to paradise. He heard inexpressible things, things that man is not permitted to tell.

column.name: text
column.value: I will boast about a man like that, but I will not boast about myself, except about my weaknesses.

column.name: text
column.value: Even if I should choose to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will think more of me than is warranted by what I do or say.

column.name: text
column.value: To keep me from becoming conceited because of these surpassingly great revelations, there was given me a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ's power may rest on me.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why, for Christ's sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

column.name: text
column.value: I have made a fool of myself, but you drove me to it. I ought to have been commended by you, for I am not in the least inferior to the "super-apostles," even though I am nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: The things that mark an apostle--signs, wonders and miracles--were done among you with great perseverance.

column.name: text
column.value: How were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was never a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

column.name: text
column.value: Now I am ready to visit you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you, because what I want is not your possessions but you. After all, children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will very gladly spend for you everything I have and expend myself as well. If I love you more, will you love me less?

column.name: text
column.value: Be that as it may, I have not been a burden to you. Yet, crafty fellow that I am, I caught you by trickery!

column.name: text
column.value: Did I exploit you through any of the men I sent you?

column.name: text
column.value: I urged Titus to go to you and I sent our brother with him. Titus did not exploit you, did he? Did we not act in the same spirit and follow the same course?

column.name: text
column.value: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? We have been speaking in the sight of God as those in Christ; and everything we do, dear friends, is for your strengthening.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am afraid that when I come I may not find you as I want you to be, and you may not find me as you want me to be. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, gossip, arrogance and disorder.

column.name: text
column.value: I am afraid that when I come again my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual sin and debauchery in which they have indulged.

column.name: text
column.value: This will be my third visit to you. "Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses."

column.name: text
column.value: I already gave you a warning when I was with you the second time. I now repeat it while absent: On my return I will not spare those who sinned earlier or any of the others,

column.name: text
column.value: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.

column.name: text
column.value: For to be sure, he was crucified in weakness, yet he lives by God's power. Likewise, we are weak in him, yet by God's power we will live with him to serve you.

column.name: text
column.value: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Christ Jesus is in you--unless, of course, you fail the test?

column.name: text
column.value: And I trust that you will discover that we have not failed the test.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong. Not that people will see that we have stood the test but that you will do what is right even though we may seem to have failed.

column.name: text
column.value: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: We are glad whenever we are weak but you are strong; and our prayer is for your perfection.

column.name: text
column.value: This is why I write these things when I am absent, that when I come I may not have to be harsh in my use of authority--the authority the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, brothers, good-by. Aim for perfection, listen to my appeal, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: All the saints send their greetings.

column.name: text
column.value: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: Since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.

column.name: text
column.value: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not say this to condemn you; I have said before that you have such a place in our hearts that we would live or die with you.

column.name: text
column.value: I have great confidence in you; I take great pride in you. I am greatly encouraged; in all our troubles my joy knows no bounds.

column.name: text
column.value: For when we came into Macedonia, this body of ours had no rest, but we were harassed at every turn--conflicts on the outside, fears within.

column.name: text
column.value: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

column.name: text
column.value: and not only by his coming but also by the comfort you had given him. He told us about your longing for me, your deep sorrow, your ardent concern for me, so that my joy was greater than ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Though I did regret it--I see that my letter hurt you, but only for a little while--

column.name: text
column.value: yet now I am happy, not because you were made sorry, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you became sorrowful as God intended and so were not harmed in any way by us.

column.name: text
column.value: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

column.name: text
column.value: See what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what concern, what readiness to see justice done. At every point you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did the wrong or of the injured party, but rather that before God you could see for yourselves how devoted to us you are.

column.name: text
column.value: By all this we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

column.name: text
column.value: I had boasted to him about you, and you have not embarrassed me. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting about you to Titus has proved to be true as well.

column.name: text
column.value: And his affection for you is all the greater when he remembers that you were all obedient, receiving him with fear and trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: I am glad I can have complete confidence in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle--sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead--

column.name: text
column.value: and all the brothers with me, To the churches in Galatia:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

column.name: text
column.value: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel--

column.name: text
column.value: which is really no gospel at all. Evidently some people are throwing you into confusion and are trying to pervert the gospel of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let him be eternally condemned!

column.name: text
column.value: As we have already said, so now I say again: If anybody is preaching to you a gospel other than what you accepted, let him be eternally condemned!

column.name: text
column.value: Am I now trying to win the approval of men, or of God? Or am I trying to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I want you to know, brothers, that the gospel I preached is not something that man made up.

column.name: text
column.value: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have heard of my previous way of life in Judaism, how intensely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

column.name: text
column.value: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many Jews of my own age and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: But when God, who set me apart from birth and called me by his grace, was pleased

column.name: text
column.value: to reveal his Son in me so that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I did not consult any man,

column.name: text
column.value: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before I was, but I went immediately into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Peter and stayed with him fifteen days.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw none of the other apostles--only James, the Lord's brother.

column.name: text
column.value: I assure you before God that what I am writing you is no lie.

column.name: text
column.value: Later I went to Syria and Cilicia.

column.name: text
column.value: I was personally unknown to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: They only heard the report: "The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy."

column.name: text
column.value: And they praised God because of me.

column.name: text
column.value: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem, this time with Barnabas. I took Titus along also.

column.name: text
column.value: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. But I did this privately to those who seemed to be leaders, for fear that I was running or had run my race in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.

column.name: text
column.value: This matter arose because some false brothers had infiltrated our ranks to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus and to make us slaves.

column.name: text
column.value: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might remain with you.

column.name: text
column.value: As for those who seemed to be important--whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not judge by external appearance--those men added nothing to my message.

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted with the task of preaching the gospel to the Gentiles, just as Peter had been to the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: For God, who was at work in the ministry of Peter as an apostle to the Jews, was also at work in my ministry as an apostle to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: James, Peter and John, those reputed to be pillars, gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship when they recognized the grace given to me. They agreed that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: All they asked was that we should continue to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do.

column.name: text
column.value: When Peter came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he was clearly in the wrong.

column.name: text
column.value: Before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself from the Gentiles because he was afraid of those who belonged to the circumcision group.

column.name: text
column.value: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.

column.name: text
column.value: When I saw that they were not acting in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter in front of them all, "You are a Jew, yet you live like a Gentile and not like a Jew. How is it, then, that you force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?

column.name: text
column.value: "We who are Jews by birth and not 'Gentile sinners'

column.name: text
column.value: know that a man is not justified by observing the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have put our faith in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by observing the law, because by observing the law no one will be justified.

column.name: text
column.value: "If, while we seek to be justified in Christ, it becomes evident that we ourselves are sinners, does that mean that Christ promotes sin? Absolutely not!

column.name: text
column.value: If I rebuild what I destroyed, I prove that I am a lawbreaker.

column.name: text
column.value: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live for God.

column.name: text
column.value: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!"

column.name: text
column.value: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he owns the whole estate.

column.name: text
column.value: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

column.name: text
column.value: So also, when we were children, we were in slavery under the basic principles of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under law,

column.name: text
column.value: to redeem those under law, that we might receive the full rights of sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, "Abba , Father."

column.name: text
column.value: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, God has made you also an heir.

column.name: text
column.value: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But now that you know God--or rather are known by God--how is it that you are turning back to those weak and miserable principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?

column.name: text
column.value: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!

column.name: text
column.value: I fear for you, that somehow I have wasted my efforts on you.

column.name: text
column.value: I plead with you, brothers, become like me, for I became like you. You have done me no wrong.

column.name: text
column.value: As you know, it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Even though my illness was a trial to you, you did not treat me with contempt or scorn. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus himself.

column.name: text
column.value: What has happened to all your joy? I can testify that, if you could have done so, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?

column.name: text
column.value: Those people are zealous to win you over, but for no good. What they want is to alienate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.

column.name: text
column.value: It is fine to be zealous, provided the purpose is good, and to be so always and not just when I am with you.

column.name: text
column.value: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,

column.name: text
column.value: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you!

column.name: text
column.value: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, are you not aware of what the law says?

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.

column.name: text
column.value: His son by the slave woman was born in the ordinary way; but his son by the free woman was born as the result of a promise.

column.name: text
column.value: These things may be taken figuratively, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children who are to be slaves: This is Hagar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present city of Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written: "Be glad, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have no labor pains; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband."

column.name: text
column.value: Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the son born in the ordinary way persecuted the son born by the power of the Spirit. It is the same now.

column.name: text
column.value: But what does the Scripture say? "Get rid of the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman's son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman's son."

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.

column.name: text
column.value: You foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by observing the law, or by believing what you heard?

column.name: text
column.value: Are you so foolish? After beginning with the Spirit, are you now trying to attain your goal by human effort?

column.name: text
column.value: Have you suffered so much for nothing--if it really was for nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: Does God give you his Spirit and work miracles among you because you observe the law, or because you believe what you heard?

column.name: text
column.value: Consider Abraham: "He believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness."

column.name: text
column.value: Understand, then, that those who believe are children of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and announced the gospel in advance to Abraham: "All nations will be blessed through you."

column.name: text
column.value: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.

column.name: text
column.value: All who rely on observing the law are under a curse, for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law."

column.name: text
column.value: Clearly no one is justified before God by the law, because, "The righteous will live by faith."

column.name: text
column.value: The law is not based on faith; on the contrary, "The man who does these things will live by them."

column.name: text
column.value: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree."

column.name: text
column.value: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, let me take an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or add to a human covenant that has been duly established, so it is in this case.

column.name: text
column.value: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say "and to seeds," meaning many people, but "and to your seed," meaning one person, who is Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: What I mean is this: The law, introduced 430 years later, does not set aside the covenant previously established by God and thus do away with the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God in his grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.

column.name: text
column.value: What, then, was the purpose of the law? It was added because of transgressions until the Seed to whom the promise referred had come. The law was put into effect through angels by a mediator.

column.name: text
column.value: A mediator, however, does not represent just one party; but God is one.

column.name: text
column.value: Is the law, therefore, opposed to the promises of God? Absolutely not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come by the law.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Scripture declares that the whole world is a prisoner of sin, so that what was promised, being given through faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.

column.name: text
column.value: Before this faith came, we were held prisoners by the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: So the law was put in charge to lead us to Christ that we might be justified by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under the supervision of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: for all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

column.name: text
column.value: Mark my words! I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.

column.name: text
column.value: Again I declare to every man who lets himself be circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.

column.name: text
column.value: You who are trying to be justified by law have been alienated from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.

column.name: text
