column.value: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable men who will also be qualified to teach others.

column.name: text
column.value: Endure hardship with us like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: No one serving as a soldier gets involved in civilian affairs--he wants to please his commanding officer.

column.name: text
column.value: Similarly, if anyone competes as an athlete, he does not receive the victor's crown unless he competes according to the rules.

column.name: text
column.value: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.

column.name: text
column.value: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,

column.name: text
column.value: for which I am suffering even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God's word is not chained.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Here is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him;

column.name: text
column.value: if we endure, we will also reign with him. If we disown him, he will also disown us;

column.name: text
column.value: if we are faithless, he will remain faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep reminding them of these things. Warn them before God against quarreling about words; it is of no value, and only ruins those who listen.

column.name: text
column.value: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a workman who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.

column.name: text
column.value: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

column.name: text
column.value: who have wandered away from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already taken place, and they destroy the faith of some.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, God's solid foundation stands firm, sealed with this inscription: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Everyone who confesses the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness."

column.name: text
column.value: In a large house there are articles not only of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay; some are for noble purposes and some for ignoble.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man cleanses himself from the latter, he will be an instrument for noble purposes, made holy, useful to the Master and prepared to do any good work.

column.name: text
column.value: Flee the evil desires of youth, and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord's servant must not quarrel; instead, he must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who oppose him he must gently instruct, in the hope that God will grant them repentance leading them to a knowledge of the truth,

column.name: text
column.value: and that they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.

column.name: text
column.value: But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days.

column.name: text
column.value: People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

column.name: text
column.value: without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good,

column.name: text
column.value: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God--

column.name: text
column.value: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with them.

column.name: text
column.value: They are the kind who worm their way into homes and gain control over weak-willed women, who are loaded down with sins and are swayed by all kinds of evil desires,

column.name: text
column.value: always learning but never able to acknowledge the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth--men of depraved minds, who, as far as the faith is concerned, are rejected.

column.name: text
column.value: But they will not get very far because, as in the case of those men, their folly will be clear to everyone.

column.name: text
column.value: You, however, know all about my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,

column.name: text
column.value: persecutions, sufferings--what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

column.name: text
column.value: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

column.name: text
column.value: while evil men and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have become convinced of, because you know those from whom you learned it,

column.name: text
column.value: and how from infancy you have known the holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,

column.name: text
column.value: so that the man of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

column.name: text
column.value: You must teach what is in accord with sound doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, teach the older women to be reverent in the way they live, not to be slanderers or addicted to much wine, but to teach what is good.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they can train the younger women to love their husbands and children,

column.name: text
column.value: to be self-controlled and pure, to be busy at home, to be kind, and to be subject to their husbands, so that no one will malign the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Similarly, encourage the young men to be self-controlled.

column.name: text
column.value: In everything set them an example by doing what is good. In your teaching show integrity, seriousness

column.name: text
column.value: and soundness of speech that cannot be condemned, so that those who oppose you may be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about us.

column.name: text
column.value: Teach slaves to be subject to their masters in everything, to try to please them, not to talk back to them,

column.name: text
column.value: and not to steal from them, but to show that they can be fully trusted, so that in every way they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive.

column.name: text
column.value: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men.

column.name: text
column.value: It teaches us to say "No" to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,

column.name: text
column.value: while we wait for the blessed hope--the glorious appearing of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: who gave himself for us to redeem us from all wickedness and to purify for himself a people that are his very own, eager to do what is good.

column.name: text
column.value: These, then, are the things you should teach. Encourage and rebuke with all authority. Do not let anyone despise you.

column.name: text
column.value: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I give you this charge:

column.name: text
column.value: Preach the Word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage--with great patience and careful instruction.

column.name: text
column.value: For the time will come when men will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.

column.name: text
column.value: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, keep your head in all situations, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, discharge all the duties of your ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time has come for my departure.

column.name: text
column.value: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day--and not only to me, but also to all who have longed for his appearing.

column.name: text
column.value: Do your best to come to me quickly,

column.name: text
column.value: for Demas, because he loved this world, has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

column.name: text
column.value: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is helpful to me in my ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.

column.name: text
column.value: Alexander the metalworker did me a great deal of harm. The Lord will repay him for what he has done.

column.name: text
column.value: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.

column.name: text
column.value: At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me. May it not be held against them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered from the lion's mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

column.name: text
column.value: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.

column.name: text
column.value: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: All who are under the yoke of slavery should consider their masters worthy of full respect, so that God's name and our teaching may not be slandered.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who have believing masters are not to show less respect for them because they are brothers. Instead, they are to serve them even better, because those who benefit from their service are believers, and dear to them. These are the things you are to teach and urge on them.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone teaches false doctrines and does not agree to the sound instruction of our Lord Jesus Christ and to godly teaching,

column.name: text
column.value: he is conceited and understands nothing. He has an unhealthy interest in controversies and quarrels about words that result in envy, strife, malicious talk, evil suspicions

column.name: text
column.value: and constant friction between men of corrupt mind, who have been robbed of the truth and who think that godliness is a means to financial gain.

column.name: text
column.value: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

column.name: text
column.value: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.

column.name: text
column.value: People who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge men into ruin and destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, man of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.

column.name: text
column.value: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession in the presence of many witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: In the sight of God, who gives life to everything, and of Christ Jesus, who while testifying before Pontius Pilate made the good confession, I charge you

column.name: text
column.value: to keep this command without spot or blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: which God will bring about in his own time--God, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

column.name: text
column.value: who alone is immortal and who lives in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and might forever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Command those who are rich in this present world not to be arrogant nor to put their hope in wealth, which is so uncertain, but to put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

column.name: text
column.value: Command them to do good, to be rich in good deeds, and to be generous and willing to share.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way they will lay up treasure for themselves as a firm foundation for the coming age, so that they may take hold of the life that is truly life.

column.name: text
column.value: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to your care. Turn away from godless chatter and the opposing ideas of what is falsely called knowledge,

column.name: text
column.value: which some have professed and in so doing have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God's elect and the knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness--

column.name: text
column.value: a faith and knowledge resting on the hope of eternal life, which God, who does not lie, promised before the beginning of time,

column.name: text
column.value: and at his appointed season he brought his word to light through the preaching entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior,

column.name: text
column.value: To Titus, my true son in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

column.name: text
column.value: The reason I left you in Crete was that you might straighten out what was left unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

column.name: text
column.value: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, a man whose children believe and are not open to the charge of being wild and disobedient.

column.name: text
column.value: Since an overseer is entrusted with God's work, he must be blameless--not overbearing, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not pursuing dishonest gain.

column.name: text
column.value: Rather he must be hospitable, one who loves what is good, who is self-controlled, upright, holy and disciplined.

column.name: text
column.value: He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so that he can encourage others by sound doctrine and refute those who oppose it.

column.name: text
column.value: For there are many rebellious people, mere talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision group.

column.name: text
column.value: They must be silenced, because they are ruining whole households by teaching things they ought not to teach--and that for the sake of dishonest gain.

column.name: text
column.value: Even one of their own prophets has said, "Cretans are always liars, evil brutes, lazy gluttons."

column.name: text
column.value: This testimony is true. Therefore, rebuke them sharply, so that they will be sound in the faith

column.name: text
column.value: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of those who reject the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are corrupted and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, both their minds and consciences are corrupted.

column.name: text
column.value: They claim to know God, but by their actions they deny him. They are detestable, disobedient and unfit for doing anything good.

column.name: text
column.value: Remind the people to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to do whatever is good,

column.name: text
column.value: to slander no one, to be peaceable and considerate, and to show true humility toward all men.

column.name: text
column.value: At one time we too were foolish, disobedient, deceived and enslaved by all kinds of passions and pleasures. We lived in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared,

column.name: text
column.value: he saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: whom he poured out on us generously through Jesus Christ our Savior,

column.name: text
column.value: so that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: This is a trustworthy saying. And I want you to stress these things, so that those who have trusted in God may be careful to devote themselves to doing what is good. These things are excellent and profitable for everyone.

column.name: text
column.value: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and arguments and quarrels about the law, because these are unprofitable and useless.

column.name: text
column.value: Warn a divisive person once, and then warn him a second time. After that, have nothing to do with him.

column.name: text
column.value: You may be sure that such a man is warped and sinful; he is self-condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

column.name: text
column.value: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way and see that they have everything they need.

column.name: text
column.value: Our people must learn to devote themselves to doing what is good, in order that they may provide for daily necessities and not live unproductive lives.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone with me sends you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank God, whom I serve, as my forefathers did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.

column.name: text
column.value: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.

column.name: text
column.value: I have been reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, now lives in you also.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For God did not give us a spirit of timidity, but a spirit of power, of love and of self-discipline.

column.name: text
column.value: So do not be ashamed to testify about our Lord, or ashamed of me his prisoner. But join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God,

column.name: text
column.value: who has saved us and called us to a holy life--not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,

column.name: text
column.value: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him for that day.

column.name: text
column.value: What you heard from me, keep as the pattern of sound teaching, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you--guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

column.name: text
column.value: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

column.name: text
column.value: May the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.

column.name: text
column.value: May the Lord grant that he will find mercy from the Lord on that day! You know very well in how many ways he helped me in Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our dear friend and fellow worker,

column.name: text
column.value: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier and to the church that meets in your home:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers,

column.name: text
column.value: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: I pray that you may be active in sharing your faith, so that you will have a full understanding of every good thing we have in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, although in Christ I could be bold and order you to do what you ought to do,

column.name: text
column.value: yet I appeal to you on the basis of love. I then, as Paul--an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus--

column.name: text
column.value: I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, who became my son while I was in chains.

column.name: text
column.value: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am sending him--who is my very heart--back to you.

column.name: text
column.value: I would have liked to keep him with me so that he could take your place in helping me while I am in chains for the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that any favor you do will be spontaneous and not forced.

column.name: text
column.value: Perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a little while was that you might have him back for good--

column.name: text
column.value: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a dear brother. He is very dear to me but even dearer to you, both as a man and as a brother in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.

column.name: text
column.value: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.

column.name: text
column.value: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back--not to mention that you owe me your very self.

column.name: text
column.value: I do wish, brother, that I may have some benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

column.name: text
column.value: And one thing more: Prepare a guest room for me, because I hope to be restored to you in answer to your prayers.

column.name: text
column.value: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings.

column.name: text
column.value: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow workers.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: In the past God spoke to our forefathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

column.name: text
column.value: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, and through whom he made the universe.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the exact representation of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: So he became as much superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is superior to theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: For to which of the angels did God ever say, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father"? Or again, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son"?

column.name: text
column.value: And again, when God brings his firstborn into the world, he says, "Let all God's angels worship him."

column.name: text
column.value: In speaking of the angels he says, "He makes his angels winds, his servants flames of fire."

column.name: text
column.value: But about the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever, and righteousness will be the scepter of your kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy."

column.name: text
column.value: He also says, "In the beginning, O Lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

column.name: text
column.value: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed. But you remain the same, and your years will never end."

column.name: text
column.value: To which of the angels did God ever say, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet"?

column.name: text
column.value: Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

column.name: text
column.value: We must pay more careful attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every violation and disobedience received its just punishment,

column.name: text
column.value: how shall we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? This salvation, which was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard him.

column.name: text
column.value: God also testified to it by signs, wonders and various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to his will.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.

column.name: text
column.value: But there is a place where someone has testified: "What is man that you are mindful of him, the son of man that you care for him?

column.name: text
column.value: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor

column.name: text
column.value: and put everything under his feet." In putting everything under him, God left nothing that is not subject to him. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.

column.name: text
column.value: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting that God, for whom and through whom everything exists, should make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.

column.name: text
column.value: Both the one who makes men holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: He says, "I will declare your name to my brothers; in the presence of the congregation I will sing your praises."

column.name: text
column.value: And again, "I will put my trust in him." And again he says, "Here am I, and the children God has given me."

column.name: text
column.value: Since the children have flesh and blood, he too shared in their humanity so that by his death he might destroy him who holds the power of death--that is, the devil--

column.name: text
column.value: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

column.name: text
column.value: For surely it is not angels he helps, but Abraham's descendants.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason he had to be made like his brothers in every way, in order that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, and that he might make atonement for the sins of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, fix your thoughts on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.

column.name: text
column.value: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God's house.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus has been found worthy of greater honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.

column.name: text
column.value: For every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses was faithful as a servant in all God's house, testifying to what would be said in the future.

column.name: text
column.value: But Christ is faithful as a son over God's house. And we are his house, if we hold on to our courage and the hope of which we boast.

column.name: text
column.value: So, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you hear his voice,

column.name: text
column.value: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion, during the time of testing in the desert,

column.name: text
column.value: where your fathers tested and tried me and for forty years saw what I did.

column.name: text
column.value: That is why I was angry with that generation, and I said, 'Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known my ways.'

column.name: text
column.value: So I declared on oath in my anger, 'They shall never enter my rest.'"

column.name: text
column.value: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a sinful, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called Today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin's deceitfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly till the end the confidence we had at first.

column.name: text
column.value: As has just been said: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion."

column.name: text
column.value: Who were they who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?

column.name: text
column.value: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the desert?

column.name: text
column.value: And to whom did God swear that they would never enter his rest if not to those who disobeyed?

column.name: text
column.value: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be found to have fallen short of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For we also have had the gospel preached to us, just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, because those who heard did not combine it with faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we who have believed enter that rest, just as God has said, "So I declared on oath in my anger, 'They shall never enter my rest.'" And yet his work has been finished since the creation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in these words: "And on the seventh day God rested from all his work."

column.name: text
column.value: And again in the passage above he says, "They shall never enter my rest."

column.name: text
column.value: It still remains that some will enter that rest, and those who formerly had the gospel preached to them did not go in, because of their disobedience.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore God again set a certain day, calling it Today, when a long time later he spoke through David, as was said before: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts."

column.name: text
column.value: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

column.name: text
column.value: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God;

column.name: text
column.value: for anyone who enters God's rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from his.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following their example of disobedience.

column.name: text
column.value: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it penetrates even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God's sight Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has gone through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess.

column.name: text
column.value: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who has been tempted in every way, just as we are--yet was without sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

column.name: text
column.value: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming--not the realities themselves. For this reason it can never, by the same sacrifices repeated endlessly year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

column.name: text
column.value: If it could, would they not have stopped being offered? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt guilty for their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,

column.name: text
column.value: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, he said: "Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you prepared for me;

column.name: text
column.value: with burnt offerings and sin offerings you were not pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, 'Here I am--it is written about me in the scroll--I have come to do your will, O God.'"

column.name: text
column.value: First he said, "Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not desire, nor were you pleased with them" (although the law required them to be made).

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, "Here I am, I have come to do your will." He sets aside the first to establish the second.

column.name: text
column.value: And by that will, we have been made holy through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

column.name: text
column.value: Day after day every priest stands and performs his religious duties; again and again he offers the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

column.name: text
column.value: But when this priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool,

column.name: text
column.value: because by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.

column.name: text
column.value: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First he says:

column.name: text
column.value: "This is the covenant I will make with them after that time, says the Lord. I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds."

column.name: text
column.value: Then he adds: "Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more."

column.name: text
column.value: And where these have been forgiven, there is no longer any sacrifice for sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: by a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,

column.name: text
column.value: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

column.name: text
column.value: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

column.name: text
column.value: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us not give up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but let us encourage one another--and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

column.name: text
column.value: If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left,

column.name: text
column.value: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume the enemies of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: How much more severely do you think a man deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God under foot, who has treated as an unholy thing the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and who has insulted the Spirit of grace?

column.name: text
column.value: For we know him who said, "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," and again, "The Lord will judge his people."

column.name: text
column.value: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember those earlier days after you had received the light, when you stood your ground in a great contest in the face of suffering.

column.name: text
column.value: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to insult and persecution; at other times you stood side by side with those who were so treated.

column.name: text
column.value: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, because you knew that you yourselves had better and lasting possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.

column.name: text
column.value: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.

column.name: text
column.value: For in just a very little while, "He who is coming will come and will not delay.

column.name: text
column.value: But my righteous one will live by faith. And if he shrinks back, I will not be pleased with him."

column.name: text
column.value: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who believe and are saved.

column.name: text
column.value: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: and who serves in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.

column.name: text
column.value: Every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, and so it was necessary for this one also to have something to offer.

column.name: text
column.value: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest, for there are already men who offer the gifts prescribed by the law.

column.name: text
column.value: They serve at a sanctuary that is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: "See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain."

column.name: text
column.value: But the ministry Jesus has received is as superior to theirs as the covenant of which he is mediator is superior to the old one, and it is founded on better promises.

column.name: text
column.value: For if there had been nothing wrong with that first covenant, no place would have been sought for another.

column.name: text
column.value: But God found fault with the people and said: "The time is coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: It will not be like the covenant I made with their forefathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not remain faithful to my covenant, and I turned away from them, declares the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after that time, declares the Lord. I will put my laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: No longer will a man teach his neighbor, or a man his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."

column.name: text
column.value: By calling this covenant "new," he has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from acts that lead to death, and of faith in God,

column.name: text
column.value: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And God permitting, we will do so.

column.name: text
column.value: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age,

column.name: text
column.value: if they fall away, to be brought back to repentance, because to their loss they are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting him to public disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: Land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is farmed receives the blessing of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and is in danger of being cursed. In the end it will be burned.

column.name: text
column.value: Even though we speak like this, dear friends, we are confident of better things in your case--things that accompany salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.

column.name: text
column.value: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.

column.name: text
column.value: We do not want you to become lazy, but to imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.

column.name: text
column.value: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater for him to swear by, he swore by himself,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, "I will surely bless you and give you many descendants."

column.name: text
column.value: And so after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.

column.name: text
column.value: Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and the oath confirms what is said and puts an end to all argument.

column.name: text
column.value: Because God wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of what was promised, he confirmed it with an oath.

column.name: text
column.value: God did this so that, by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope offered to us may be greatly encouraged.

column.name: text
column.value: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

column.name: text
column.value: where Jesus, who went before us, has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: A tabernacle was set up. In its first room were the lampstand, the table and the consecrated bread; this was called the Holy Place.

column.name: text
column.value: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,

column.name: text
column.value: which had the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. This ark contained the gold jar of manna, Aaron's staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Above the ark were the cherubim of the Glory, overshadowing the atonement cover. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.

column.name: text
column.value: When everything had been arranged like this, the priests entered regularly into the outer room to carry on their ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: But only the high priest entered the inner room, and that only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.

column.name: text
column.value: The Holy Spirit was showing by this that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.

column.name: text
column.value: This is an illustration for the present time, indicating that the gifts and sacrifices being offered were not able to clear the conscience of the worshiper.

column.name: text
column.value: They are only a matter of food and drink and various ceremonial washings--external regulations applying until the time of the new order.

column.name: text
column.value: When Christ came as high priest of the good things that are already here, he went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not man-made, that is to say, not a part of this creation.

column.name: text
column.value: He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, having obtained eternal redemption.

column.name: text
column.value: The blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that they are outwardly clean.

column.name: text
column.value: How much more, then, will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God, cleanse our consciences from acts that lead to death, so that we may serve the living God!

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance--now that he has died as a ransom to set them free from the sins committed under the first covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: In the case of a will, it is necessary to prove the death of the one who made it,

column.name: text
column.value: because a will is in force only when somebody has died; it never takes effect while the one who made it is living.

column.name: text
column.value: This is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves, together with water, scarlet wool and branches of hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, "This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep."

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle and everything used in its ceremonies.

column.name: text
column.value: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

column.name: text
column.value: It was necessary, then, for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ did not enter a man-made sanctuary that was only a copy of the true one; he entered heaven itself, now to appear for us in God's presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Nor did he enter heaven to offer himself again and again, the way the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Christ would have had to suffer many times since the creation of the world. But now he has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as man is destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,

column.name: text
column.value: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many people; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Every high priest is selected from among men and is appointed to represent them in matters related to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.

column.name: text
column.value: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and are going astray, since he himself is subject to weakness.

column.name: text
column.value: This is why he has to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.

column.name: text
column.value: So Christ also did not take upon himself the glory of becoming a high priest. But God said to him, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father."

column.name: text
column.value: And he says in another place, "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

column.name: text
column.value: During the days of Jesus' life on earth, he offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.

column.name: text
column.value: Although he was a son, he learned obedience from what he suffered

column.name: text
column.value: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him

column.name: text
column.value: and was designated by God to be high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain because you are slow to learn.

column.name: text
column.value: In fact, though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God's word all over again. You need milk, not solid food!

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who lives on milk, being still an infant, is not acquainted with the teaching about righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained themselves to distinguish good from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the defeat of the kings and blessed him,

column.name: text
column.value: and Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. First, his name means "king of righteousness"; then also, "king of Salem" means "king of peace."

column.name: text
column.value: Without father or mother, without genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God he remains a priest forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Just think how great he was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder!

column.name: text
column.value: Now the law requires the descendants of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people--that is, their brothers--even though their brothers are descended from Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: This man, however, did not trace his descent from Levi, yet he collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

column.name: text
column.value: And without doubt the lesser person is blessed by the greater.

column.name: text
column.value: In the one case, the tenth is collected by men who die; but in the other case, by him who is declared to be living.

column.name: text
column.value: One might even say that Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham,

column.name: text
column.value: because when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the body of his ancestor.

column.name: text
column.value: If perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on the basis of it the law was given to the people), why was there still need for another priest to come--one in the order of Melchizedek, not in the order of Aaron?

column.name: text
column.value: For when there is a change of the priesthood, there must also be a change of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, and in regard to that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.

column.name: text
column.value: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,

column.name: text
column.value: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a regulation as to his ancestry but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is declared: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

column.name: text
column.value: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless

column.name: text
column.value: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was not without an oath! Others became priests without any oath,

column.name: text
column.value: but he became a priest with an oath when God said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: 'You are a priest forever.'"

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there have been many of those priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office;

column.name: text
column.value: but because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Such a high priest meets our need--one who is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners, exalted above the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices day after day, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. He sacrificed for their sins once for all when he offered himself.

column.name: text
column.value: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Now faith is being sure of what we hope for and certain of what we do not see.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the ancients were commended for.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God's command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as a righteous man, when God spoke well of his offerings. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Enoch was taken from this life, so that he did not experience death; he could not be found, because God had taken him away. For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.

column.name: text
column.value: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in holy fear built an ark to save his family. By his faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he made his home in the promised land like a stranger in a foreign country; he lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

column.name: text
column.value: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abraham, even though he was past age--and Sarah herself was barren--was enabled to become a father because he considered him faithful who had made the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: And so from this one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

column.name: text
column.value: All these people were still living by faith when they died. They did not receive the things promised; they only saw them and welcomed them from a distance. And they admitted that they were aliens and strangers on earth.

column.name: text
column.value: People who say such things show that they are looking for a country of their own.

column.name: text
column.value: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, they were longing for a better country--a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abraham, when God tested him, offered Isaac as a sacrifice. He who had received the promises was about to sacrifice his one and only son,

column.name: text
column.value: even though God had said to him, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."

column.name: text
column.value: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and figuratively speaking, he did receive Isaac back from death.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in regard to their future.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph's sons, and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt and gave instructions about his bones.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Moses' parents hid him for three months after he was born, because they saw he was no ordinary child, and they were not afraid of the king's edict.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be known as the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: He chose to be mistreated along with the people of God rather than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a short time.

column.name: text
column.value: He regarded disgrace for the sake of Christ as of greater value than the treasures of Egypt, because he was looking ahead to his reward.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the king's anger; he persevered because he saw him who is invisible.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch the firstborn of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to do so, they were drowned.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies, was not killed with those who were disobedient.

column.name: text
column.value: And what more shall I say? I do not have time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel and the prophets,

column.name: text
column.value: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,

column.name: text
column.value: quenched the fury of the flames, and escaped the edge of the sword; whose weakness was turned to strength; and who became powerful in battle and routed foreign armies.

column.name: text
column.value: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused to be released, so that they might gain a better resurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: Some faced jeers and flogging, while still others were chained and put in prison.

column.name: text
column.value: They were stoned; they were sawed in two; they were put to death by the sword. They went about in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, persecuted and mistreated--

column.name: text
column.value: the world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and in caves and holes in the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: These were all commended for their faith, yet none of them received what had been promised.

column.name: text
column.value: God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider him who endured such opposition from sinful men, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

column.name: text
column.value: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And you have forgotten that word of encouragement that addresses you as sons: "My son, do not make light of the Lord's discipline, and do not lose heart when he rebukes you,

column.name: text
column.value: because the Lord disciplines those he loves, and he punishes everyone he accepts as a son."

column.name: text
column.value: Endure hardship as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?

column.name: text
column.value: If you are not disciplined (and everyone undergoes discipline), then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, we have all had human fathers who disciplined us and we respected them for it. How much more should we submit to the Father of our spirits and live!

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers disciplined us for a little while as they thought best; but God disciplines us for our good, that we may share in his holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, strengthen your feeble arms and weak knees.

column.name: text
column.value: "Make level paths for your feet," so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

column.name: text
column.value: Make every effort to live in peace with all men and to be holy; without holiness no one will see the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: See to it that no one misses the grace of God and that no bitter root grows up to cause trouble and defile many.

column.name: text
column.value: See that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward, as you know, when he wanted to inherit this blessing, he was rejected. He could bring about no change of mind, though he sought the blessing with tears.

column.name: text
column.value: You have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom and storm;

column.name: text
column.value: to a trumpet blast or to such a voice speaking words that those who heard it begged that no further word be spoken to them,

column.name: text
column.value: because they could not bear what was commanded: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned."

column.name: text
column.value: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, "I am trembling with fear."

column.name: text
column.value: But you have come to Mount Zion, to the heavenly Jerusalem, the city of the living God. You have come to thousands upon thousands of angels in joyful assembly,

column.name: text
column.value: to the church of the firstborn, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the judge of all men, to the spirits of righteous men made perfect,

column.name: text
column.value: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

column.name: text
column.value: See to it that you do not refuse him who speaks. If they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, how much less will we, if we turn away from him who warns us from heaven?

column.name: text
column.value: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, "Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens."

column.name: text
column.value: The words "once more" indicate the removing of what can be shaken--that is, created things--so that what cannot be shaken may remain.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe,

column.name: text
column.value: for our "God is a consuming fire."

column.name: text
column.value: Keep on loving each other as brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not forget to entertain strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember those in prison as if you were their fellow prisoners, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.

column.name: text
column.value: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure, for God will judge the adulterer and all the sexually immoral.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, "Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you."

column.name: text
column.value: So we say with confidence, "The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?"

column.name: text
column.value: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings. It is good for our hearts to be strengthened by grace, not by ceremonial foods, which are of no value to those who eat them.

column.name: text
column.value: We have an altar from which those who minister at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as a sin offering, but the bodies are burned outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy through his own blood.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us, then, go to him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace he bore.

column.name: text
column.value: For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise--the fruit of lips that confess his name.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: Obey your leaders and submit to their authority. They keep watch over you as men who must give an account. Obey them so that their work will be a joy, not a burden, for that would be of no advantage to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Pray for us. We are sure that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

column.name: text
column.value: I particularly urge you to pray so that I may be restored to you soon.

column.name: text
column.value: May the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: equip you with everything good for doing his will, and may he work in us what is pleasing to him, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, I urge you to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have written you only a short letter.

column.name: text
column.value: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet all your leaders and all God's people. Those from Italy send you their greetings.

column.name: text
column.value: Grace be with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes scattered among the nations: Greetings.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, whenever you face trials of many kinds,

column.name: text
column.value: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.

column.name: text
column.value: Perseverance must finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

column.name: text
column.value: If any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he asks, he must believe and not doubt, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: That man should not think he will receive anything from the Lord;

column.name: text
column.value: he is a double-minded man, unstable in all he does.

column.name: text
column.value: The brother in humble circumstances ought to take pride in his high position.

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who is rich should take pride in his low position, because he will pass away like a wild flower.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its blossom falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich man will fade away even while he goes about his business.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love him.

column.name: text
column.value: When tempted, no one should say, "God is tempting me." For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone;

column.name: text
column.value: but each one is tempted when, by his own evil desire, he is dragged away and enticed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't be deceived, my dear brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

column.name: text
column.value: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of all he created.

column.name: text
column.value: My dear brothers, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry,

column.name: text
column.value: for man's anger does not bring about the righteous life that God desires.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and the evil that is so prevalent and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror

column.name: text
column.value: and, after looking at himself, goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man who looks intently into the perfect law that gives freedom, and continues to do this, not forgetting what he has heard, but doing it--he will be blessed in what he does.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not keep a tight rein on his tongue, he deceives himself and his religion is worthless.

column.name: text
column.value: Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

column.name: text
column.value: My brothers, as believers in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, don't show favoritism.

column.name: text
column.value: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.

column.name: text
column.value: If you show special attention to the man wearing fine clothes and say, "Here's a good seat for you," but say to the poor man, "You stand there" or "Sit on the floor by my feet,"

column.name: text
column.value: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my dear brothers: Has not God chosen those who are poor in the eyes of the world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom he promised those who love him?

column.name: text
column.value: But you have insulted the poor. Is it not the rich who are exploiting you? Are they not the ones who are dragging you into court?

column.name: text
column.value: Are they not the ones who are slandering the noble name of him to whom you belong?

column.name: text
column.value: If you really keep the royal law found in Scripture, "Love your neighbor as yourself," you are doing right.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as lawbreakers.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever keeps the whole law and yet stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For he who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not murder." If you do not commit adultery but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom,

column.name: text
column.value: because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment!

column.name: text
column.value: What good is it, my brothers, if a man claims to have faith but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?

column.name: text
column.value: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.

column.name: text
column.value: If one of you says to him, "Go, I wish you well; keep warm and well fed," but does nothing about his physical needs, what good is it?

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But someone will say, "You have faith; I have deeds." Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by what I do.

column.name: text
column.value: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that--and shudder.

column.name: text
column.value: You foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is useless?

column.name: text
column.value: Was not our ancestor Abraham considered righteous for what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?

column.name: text
column.value: You see that his faith and his actions were working together, and his faith was made complete by what he did.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scripture was fulfilled that says, "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness," and he was called God's friend.

column.name: text
column.value: You see that a person is justified by what he does and not by faith alone.

column.name: text
