column.value: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute considered righteous for what she did when she gave lodging to the spies and sent them off in a different direction?

column.name: text
column.value: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Not many of you should presume to be teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.

column.name: text
column.value: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to keep his whole body in check.

column.name: text
column.value: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can turn the whole animal.

column.name: text
column.value: Or take ships as an example. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot wants to go.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise the tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue also is a fire, a world of evil among the parts of the body. It corrupts the whole person, sets the whole course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.

column.name: text
column.value: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,

column.name: text
column.value: but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

column.name: text
column.value: With the tongue we praise our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God's likeness.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing. My brothers, this should not be.

column.name: text
column.value: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?

column.name: text
column.value: My brothers, can a fig tree bear olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good life, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you harbor bitter envy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast about it or deny the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Such "wisdom" does not come down from heaven but is earthly, unspiritual, of the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: For where you have envy and selfish ambition, there you find disorder and every evil practice.

column.name: text
column.value: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere.

column.name: text
column.value: Peacemakers who sow in peace raise a harvest of righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To God's elect, strangers in the world, scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,

column.name: text
column.value: who have been chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through the sanctifying work of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by his blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

column.name: text
column.value: and into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade--kept in heaven for you,

column.name: text
column.value: who through faith are shielded by God's power until the coming of the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

column.name: text
column.value: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.

column.name: text
column.value: These have come so that your faith--of greater worth than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire--may be proved genuine and may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you do not see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

column.name: text
column.value: for you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning this salvation, the prophets, who spoke of the grace that was to come to you, searched intently and with the greatest care,

column.name: text
column.value: trying to find out the time and circumstances to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow.

column.name: text
column.value: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you, when they spoke of the things that have now been told you by those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, prepare your minds for action; be self-controlled; set your hope fully on the grace to be given you when Jesus Christ is revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.

column.name: text
column.value: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do;

column.name: text
column.value: for it is written: "Be holy, because I am holy."

column.name: text
column.value: Since you call on a Father who judges each man's work impartially, live your lives as strangers here in reverent fear.

column.name: text
column.value: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your forefathers,

column.name: text
column.value: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

column.name: text
column.value: He was chosen before the creation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for your sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and glorified him, and so your faith and hope are in God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that you have purified yourselves by obeying the truth so that you have sincere love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For, "All men are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

column.name: text
column.value: but the word of the Lord stands forever." And this is the word that was preached to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace and peace be yours in abundance through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.

column.name: text
column.value: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature and escape the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.

column.name: text
column.value: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith goodness; and to goodness, knowledge;

column.name: text
column.value: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;

column.name: text
column.value: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you possess these qualities in increasing measure, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone does not have them, he is nearsighted and blind, and has forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my brothers, be all the more eager to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never fall,

column.name: text
column.value: and you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.

column.name: text
column.value: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of this body,

column.name: text
column.value: because I know that I will soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make every effort to see that after my departure you will always be able to remember these things.

column.name: text
column.value: We did not follow cleverly invented stories when we told you about the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: For he received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, saying, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."

column.name: text
column.value: We ourselves heard this voice that came from heaven when we were with him on the sacred mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have the word of the prophets made more certain, and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture came about by the prophet's own interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: For prophecy never had its origin in the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves also with the same attitude, because he who has suffered in his body is done with sin.

column.name: text
column.value: As a result, he does not live the rest of his earthly life for evil human desires, but rather for the will of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have spent enough time in the past doing what pagans choose to do--living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.

column.name: text
column.value: They think it strange that you do not plunge with them into the same flood of dissipation, and they heap abuse on you.

column.name: text
column.value: But they will have to give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the reason the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged according to men in regard to the body, but live according to God in regard to the spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear minded and self-controlled so that you can pray.

column.name: text
column.value: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.

column.name: text
column.value: Each one should use whatever gift he has received to serve others, faithfully administering God's grace in its various forms.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone speaks, he should do it as one speaking the very words of God. If anyone serves, he should do it with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be praised through Jesus Christ. To him be the glory and the power for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, do not be surprised at the painful trial you are suffering, as though something strange were happening to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But rejoice that you participate in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: If you are insulted because of the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

column.name: text
column.value: If you suffer, it should not be as a murderer or thief or any other kind of criminal, or even as a meddler.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who do not obey the gospel of God?

column.name: text
column.value: And, "If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"

column.name: text
column.value: So then, those who suffer according to God's will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander of every kind.

column.name: text
column.value: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,

column.name: text
column.value: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.

column.name: text
column.value: As you come to him, the living Stone--rejected by men but chosen by God and precious to him--

column.name: text
column.value: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For in Scripture it says: "See, I lay a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame."

column.name: text
column.value: Now to you who believe, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, "The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone,"

column.name: text
column.value: and, "A stone that causes men to stumble and a rock that makes them fall." They stumble because they disobey the message--which is also what they were destined for.

column.name: text
column.value: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people belonging to God, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.

column.name: text
column.value: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, I urge you, as aliens and strangers in the world, to abstain from sinful desires, which war against your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Live such good lives among the pagans that, though they accuse you of doing wrong, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day he visits us.

column.name: text
column.value: Submit yourselves for the Lord's sake to every authority instituted among men: whether to the king, as the supreme authority,

column.name: text
column.value: or to governors, who are sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to commend those who do right.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is God's will that by doing good you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish men.

column.name: text
column.value: Live as free men, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Show proper respect to everyone: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaves, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and considerate, but also to those who are harsh.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is commendable if a man bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But how is it to your credit if you receive a beating for doing wrong and endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

column.name: text
column.value: To this you were called, because Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: "He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth."

column.name: text
column.value: When they hurled their insults at him, he did not retaliate; when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he entrusted himself to him who judges justly.

column.name: text
column.value: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

column.name: text
column.value: For you were like sheep going astray, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: What causes fights and quarrels among you? Don't they come from your desires that battle within you?

column.name: text
column.value: You want something but don't get it. You kill and covet, but you cannot have what you want. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask God.

column.name: text
column.value: When you ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may spend what you get on your pleasures.

column.name: text
column.value: You adulterous people, don't you know that friendship with the world is hatred toward God? Anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you think Scripture says without reason that the spirit he caused to live in us envies intensely?

column.name: text
column.value: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."

column.name: text
column.value: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

column.name: text
column.value: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

column.name: text
column.value: Grieve, mourn and wail. Change your laughter to mourning and your joy to gloom.

column.name: text
column.value: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. When you judge the law, you are not keeping it, but sitting in judgment on it.

column.name: text
column.value: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who is able to save and destroy. But you--who are you to judge your neighbor?

column.name: text
column.value: Now listen, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business and make money."

column.name: text
column.value: Why, you do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, you ought to say, "If it is the Lord's will, we will live and do this or that."

column.name: text
column.value: As it is, you boast and brag. All such boasting is evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone, then, who knows the good he ought to do and doesn't do it, sins.

column.name: text
column.value: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder, a witness of Christ's sufferings and one who also will share in the glory to be revealed:

column.name: text
column.value: Be shepherds of God's flock that is under your care, serving as overseers--not because you must, but because you are willing, as God wants you to be; not greedy for money, but eager to serve;

column.name: text
column.value: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

column.name: text
column.value: Young men, in the same way be submissive to those who are older. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."

column.name: text
column.value: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God's mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

column.name: text
column.value: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be self-controlled and alert. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.

column.name: text
column.value: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kind of sufferings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you and make you strong, firm and steadfast.

column.name: text
column.value: To him be the power for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: With the help of Silas, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand fast in it.

column.name: text
column.value: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you her greetings, and so does my son Mark.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now listen, you rich people, weep and wail because of the misery that is coming upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Your wealth has rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and eat your flesh like fire. You have hoarded wealth in the last days.

column.name: text
column.value: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened yourselves in the day of slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: You have condemned and murdered innocent men, who were not opposing you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord's coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop and how patient he is for the autumn and spring rains.

column.name: text
column.value: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord's coming is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Don't grumble against each other, brothers, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers, as an example of patience in the face of suffering, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: As you know, we consider blessed those who have persevered. You have heard of Job's perseverance and have seen what the Lord finally brought about. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: Above all, my brothers, do not swear--not by heaven or by earth or by anything else. Let your "Yes" be yes, and your "No," no, or you will be condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: Is any one of you in trouble? He should pray. Is anyone happy? Let him sing songs of praise.

column.name: text
column.value: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man is powerful and effective.

column.name: text
column.value: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.

column.name: text
column.value: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,

column.name: text
column.value: remember this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save him from death and cover over a multitude of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Wives, in the same way be submissive to your husbands so that, if any of them do not believe the word, they may be won over without words by the behavior of their wives,

column.name: text
column.value: when they see the purity and reverence of your lives.

column.name: text
column.value: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair and the wearing of gold jewelry and fine clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, it should be that of your inner self, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God's sight.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the way the holy women of the past who put their hope in God used to make themselves beautiful. They were submissive to their own husbands,

column.name: text
column.value: like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not give way to fear.

column.name: text
column.value: Husbands, in the same way be considerate as you live with your wives, and treat them with respect as the weaker partner and as heirs with you of the gracious gift of life, so that nothing will hinder your prayers.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, all of you, live in harmony with one another; be sympathetic, love as brothers, be compassionate and humble.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: For, "Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.

column.name: text
column.value: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."

column.name: text
column.value: Who is going to harm you if you are eager to do good?

column.name: text
column.value: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. "Do not fear what they fear; do not be frightened."

column.name: text
column.value: But in your hearts set apart Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect,

column.name: text
column.value: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who speak maliciously against your good behavior in Christ may be ashamed of their slander.

column.name: text
column.value: It is better, if it is God's will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ died for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive by the Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: through whom also he went and preached to the spirits in prison

column.name: text
column.value: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In it only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water,

column.name: text
column.value: and this water symbolizes baptism that now saves you also--not the removal of dirt from the body but the pledge of a good conscience toward God. It saves you by the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: who has gone into heaven and is at God's right hand--with angels, authorities and powers in submission to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the sovereign Lord who bought them--bringing swift destruction on themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Many will follow their shameful ways and will bring the way of truth into disrepute.

column.name: text
column.value: In their greed these teachers will exploit you with stories they have made up. Their condemnation has long been hanging over them, and their destruction has not been sleeping.

column.name: text
column.value: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but sent them to hell, putting them into gloomy dungeons to be held for judgment;

column.name: text
column.value: if he did not spare the ancient world when he brought the flood on its ungodly people, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, and seven others;

column.name: text
column.value: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and made them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;

column.name: text
column.value: and if he rescued Lot, a righteous man, who was distressed by the filthy lives of lawless men

column.name: text
column.value: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)--

column.name: text
column.value: if this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue godly men from trials and to hold the unrighteous for the day of judgment, while continuing their punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: This is especially true of those who follow the corrupt desire of the sinful nature and despise authority. Bold and arrogant, these men are not afraid to slander celestial beings;

column.name: text
column.value: yet even angels, although they are stronger and more powerful, do not bring slanderous accusations against such beings in the presence of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: But these men blaspheme in matters they do not understand. They are like brute beasts, creatures of instinct, born only to be caught and destroyed, and like beasts they too will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. Their idea of pleasure is to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their pleasures while they feast with you.

column.name: text
column.value: With eyes full of adultery, they never stop sinning; they seduce the unstable; they are experts in greed--an accursed brood!

column.name: text
column.value: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing by a donkey--a beast without speech--who spoke with a man's voice and restrained the prophet's madness.

column.name: text
column.value: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.

column.name: text
column.value: For they mouth empty, boastful words and, by appealing to the lustful desires of sinful human nature, they entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.

column.name: text
column.value: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of depravity--for a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.

column.name: text
column.value: If they have escaped the corruption of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and are again entangled in it and overcome, they are worse off at the end than they were at the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than to have known it and then to turn their backs on the sacred command that was passed on to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Of them the proverbs are true: "A dog returns to its vomit," and, "A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud."

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I have written both of them as reminders to stimulate you to wholesome thinking.

column.name: text
column.value: I want you to recall the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets and the command given by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: First of all, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

column.name: text
column.value: They will say, "Where is this 'coming' he promised? Ever since our fathers died, everything goes on as it has since the beginning of creation."

column.name: text
column.value: But they deliberately forget that long ago by God's word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water.

column.name: text
column.value: By these waters also the world of that time was deluged and destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: By the same word the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

column.name: text
column.value: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. He is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything in it will be laid bare.

column.name: text
column.value: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to live holy and godly lives

column.name: text
column.value: as you look forward to the day of God and speed its coming. That day will bring about the destruction of the heavens by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.

column.name: text
column.value: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, the home of righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, dear friends, since you are looking forward to this, make every effort to be found spotless, blameless and at peace with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Bear in mind that our Lord's patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom that God gave him.

column.name: text
column.value: He writes the same way in all his letters, speaking in them of these matters. His letters contain some things that are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, dear friends, since you already know this, be on your guard so that you may not be carried away by the error of lawless men and fall from your secure position.

column.name: text
column.value: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever! Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked at and our hands have touched--this we proclaim concerning the Word of life.

column.name: text
column.value: The life appeared; we have seen it and testify to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and has appeared to us.

column.name: text
column.value: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: We write this to make our joy complete.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.

column.name: text
column.value: If we claim to have fellowship with him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not live by the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

column.name: text
column.value: If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

column.name: text
column.value: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word has no place in our lives.

column.name: text
column.value: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anybody does sin, we have one who speaks to the Father in our defense--Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

column.name: text
column.value: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that we have come to know him if we obey his commands.

column.name: text
column.value: The man who says, "I know him," but does not do what he commands is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone obeys his word, God's love is truly made complete in him. This is how we know we are in him:

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever claims to live in him must walk as Jesus did.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one, which you have had since the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I am writing you a new command; its truth is seen in him and you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates his brother is still in the darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever loves his brother lives in the light, and there is nothing in him to make him stumble.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness; he does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded him.

column.name: text
column.value: I write to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.

column.name: text
column.value: I write to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, dear children, because you have known the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: I write to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God lives in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For everything in the world--the cravings of sinful man, the lust of his eyes and the boasting of what he has and does--comes not from the Father but from the world.

column.name: text
column.value: The world and its desires pass away, but the man who does the will of God lives forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear children, this is the last hour; and as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come. This is how we know it is the last hour.

column.name: text
column.value: They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us.

column.name: text
column.value: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the liar? It is the man who denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a man is the antichrist--he denies the Father and the Son.

column.name: text
column.value: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

column.name: text
column.value: See that what you have heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is what he promised us--even eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things and as that anointing is real, not counterfeit--just as it has taught you, remain in him.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.

column.name: text
column.value: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.

column.name: text
column.value: How great is the love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when he appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as he is pure.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.

column.name: text
column.value: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.

column.name: text
column.value: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. He who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: He who does what is sinful is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil's work.

column.name: text
column.value: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God's seed remains in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: Anyone who does not do what is right is not a child of God; nor is anyone who does not love his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother's were righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. Anyone who does not love remains in death.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life in him.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone has material possessions and sees his brother in need but has no pity on him, how can the love of God be in him?

column.name: text
column.value: Dear children, let us not love with words or tongue but with actions and in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: This then is how we know that we belong to the truth, and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence

column.name: text
column.value: whenever our hearts condemn us. For God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God

column.name: text
column.value: and receive from him anything we ask, because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who obey his commands live in him, and he in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

column.name: text
column.value: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.

column.name: text
column.value: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

column.name: text
column.value: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.

column.name: text
column.value: We are from God, and whoever knows God listens to us; but whoever is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

column.name: text
column.value: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that we live in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in him and he in God.

column.name: text
column.value: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in him.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way, love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment, because in this world we are like him.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

column.name: text
column.value: We love because he first loved us.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone says, "I love God," yet hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

column.name: text
column.value: And he has given us this command: Whoever loves God must also love his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.

column.name: text
column.value: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.

column.name: text
column.value: This is love for God: to obey his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,

column.name: text
column.value: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the one who came by water and blood--Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: For there are three that testify:

column.name: text
column.value: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.

column.name: text
column.value: We accept man's testimony, but God's testimony is greater because it is the testimony of God, which he has given about his Son.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who believes in the Son of God has this testimony in his heart. Anyone who does not believe God has made him out to be a liar, because he has not believed the testimony God has given about his Son.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

column.name: text
column.value: He who has the Son has life; he who does not have the Son of God does not have life.

column.name: text
column.value: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.

column.name: text
column.value: And if we know that he hears us--whatever we ask--we know that we have what we asked of him.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone sees his brother commit a sin that does not lead to death, he should pray and God will give him life. I refer to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying that he should pray about that.

column.name: text
column.value: All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the one who was born of God keeps him safe, and the evil one cannot harm him.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that we are children of God, and that the whole world is under the control of the evil one.

column.name: text
column.value: We know also that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know him who is true. And we are in him who is true--even in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.

column.name: text
column.value: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth--and not I only, but also all who know the truth--

column.name: text
column.value: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, will be with us in truth and love.

column.name: text
column.value: It has given me great joy to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, dear lady, I am not writing you a new command but one we have had from the beginning. I ask that we love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands. As you have heard from the beginning, his command is that you walk in love.

column.name: text
column.value: Many deceivers, who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh, have gone out into the world. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch out that you do not lose what you have worked for, but that you may be rewarded fully.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who runs ahead and does not continue in the teaching of Christ does not have God; whoever continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take him into your house or welcome him.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who welcomes him shares in his wicked work.

column.name: text
column.value: I have much to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of your chosen sister send their greetings.

column.name: text
column.value: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who have been called, who are loved by God the Father and kept by Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Mercy, peace and love be yours in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friends, although I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt I had to write and urge you to contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: For certain men whose condemnation was written about long ago have secretly slipped in among you. They are godless men, who change the grace of our God into a license for immorality and deny Jesus Christ our only Sovereign and Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Though you already know all this, I want to remind you that the Lord delivered his people out of Egypt, but later destroyed those who did not believe.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angels who did not keep their positions of authority but abandoned their own home--these he has kept in darkness, bound with everlasting chains for judgment on the great Day.

column.name: text
column.value: In a similar way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns gave themselves up to sexual immorality and perversion. They serve as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.

column.name: text
column.value: In the very same way, these dreamers pollute their own bodies, reject authority and slander celestial beings.

column.name: text
column.value: But even the archangel Michael, when he was disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring a slanderous accusation against him, but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"

column.name: text
column.value: Yet these men speak abusively against whatever they do not understand; and what things they do understand by instinct, like unreasoning animals--these are the very things that destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them! They have taken the way of Cain; they have rushed for profit into Balaam's error; they have been destroyed in Korah's rebellion.

column.name: text
column.value: These men are blemishes at your love feasts, eating with you without the slightest qualm--shepherds who feed only themselves. They are clouds without rain, blown along by the wind; autumn trees, without fruit and uprooted--twice dead.

column.name: text
column.value: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about these men: "See, the Lord is coming with thousands upon thousands of his holy ones

column.name: text
column.value: to judge everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of all the ungodly acts they have done in the ungodly way, and of all the harsh words ungodly sinners have spoken against him."

column.name: text
column.value: These men are grumblers and faultfinders; they follow their own evil desires; they boast about themselves and flatter others for their own advantage.

column.name: text
column.value: But, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.

column.name: text
column.value: They said to you, "In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow their own ungodly desires."

column.name: text
column.value: These are the men who divide you, who follow mere natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, dear friends, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep yourselves in God's love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: Be merciful to those who doubt;

column.name: text
column.value: snatch others from the fire and save them; to others show mercy, mixed with fear--hating even the clothing stained by corrupted flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: To him who is able to keep you from falling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy--

column.name: text
column.value: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: The elder, To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

column.name: text
column.value: It gave me great joy to have some brothers come and tell about your faithfulness to the truth and how you continue to walk in the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, even though they are strangers to you.

column.name: text
column.value: They have told the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.

column.name: text
column.value: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.

column.name: text
column.value: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such men so that we may work together for the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will have nothing to do with us.

column.name: text
column.value: So if I come, I will call attention to what he is doing, gossiping maliciously about us. Not satisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers. He also stops those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.

column.name: text
column.value: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.

column.name: text
column.value: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone--and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.

column.name: text
column.value: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.

column.name: text
column.value: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face. Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
